Who it is for适用人群

Anyone capable of becoming pregnant.任何可能怀孕的人。

Dose tested已验证剂量

400 µg/d, from at least one month before conception. 4 mg/d if a previous pregnancy was affected.400 微克/天，至少从受孕前一个月开始。若既往有受累妊娠，则 4 毫克/天。

To match that from food用食物达到该剂量

Two routes with different answers. As folic acid, the 400 ug periconceptional dose is reachable in one sitting only from fortified products: one bowl of ready-to-eat cereal fortified to 400 ug folic acid per serving is the entire dose, whereas matching it from yeast extract spread takes about 13 g (a bit over two teaspoons), from instant fortified oatmeal 8.2 packets, and from enriched wheat bread about 69 slices. As natural food folate the equivalent target is 680 ug DFE (400 x 1.7), and this is where the verification pass forced a correction: the submission's cheapest option was 376 g of cooked lentils, but simmered chicken liver at 578 ug food folate per 100 g (FDC 171061) needs only 118 g, under three 44 g livers, which is an ordinary portion, and pan-fried lamb liver at 400 ug DFE per 100 g (FDC 172533) needs 170 g. The plant routes stay awkward: 376 g cooked lentils (1.9 cups), 219 g prepared edamame (1.4 cups), 300 g dried sunflower kernels, 351 g raw spinach (about twelve 30 g cups), 395 g cooked chickpeas, 456 g cooked asparagus (about thirty spears) or 630 g boiled broccoli. So the plain answer is that a person can eat their way to the folate equivalent of the 400 ug dose through liver or through fortified food, and cannot realistically do it through leafy greens; the UK high-risk 5 mg dose (8,500 ug DFE, 1.47 kg of chicken liver or 4.7 kg of cooked lentils every day) is unreachable by any route. Liver carries its own pregnancy restriction on preformed vitamin A grounds, which is why it is rarely offered as the answer to the population that needs the dose.两条路径给出不同答案。按 folic acid 计，孕前 400 µg 的剂量只有强化产品能一次吃到：一碗按每份 400 µg folic acid 强化的即食谷物就是全部剂量；用酵母提取物涂抹酱要约 13 g（两茶匙多一点），用强化速食燕麦片要 8.2 包，用强化面粉做的小麦面包约 69 片。按天然食物叶酸计，等效目标是 680 µg DFE（400 x 1.7），核查环节正是在这里改出一处错误：原稿最省的选项是 376 g 熟扁豆，但炖鸡肝每 100 g 含食物叶酸 578 µg（FDC 171061），只需 118 g，不到三块 44 g 的鸡肝，属于正常份量；煎羊肝每 100 g 400 µg DFE（FDC 172533），需要 170 g。植物路径依旧别扭：376 g 熟扁豆（1.9 杯）、219 g 处理好的毛豆（1.4 杯）、300 g 干葵花籽仁、351 g 生菠菜（约十二杯，每杯 30 g）、395 g 熟鹰嘴豆、456 g 熟芦笋（约三十根）或 630 g 水煮西兰花。所以直白的结论是：一个人可以靠肝脏或强化食品吃到相当于 400 µg 剂量的叶酸量，靠绿叶菜现实中做不到；英国面向高风险人群的 5 mg 剂量（8,500 µg DFE，相当于每天 1.47 kg 鸡肝或 4.7 kg 熟扁豆）任何路径都达不到。肝脏本身因预成型维生素 A 而在孕期受限，这也是它很少被拿来当作那个最需要该剂量的人群的答案的原因。

Does the body make it身体是否自产

Humans have no folate biosynthetic pathway, so every microgram is dietary or supplemental, and NONE here does mean required, with megaloblastic anaemia as the described deficiency state. Colonic bacteria do synthesise folate, and this dataset counts bacterial output as exogenous supply because the human genome carries no such pathway; colonic absorption is limited and the contribution to human status is unquantified. Supplementation therefore fills a real gap when intake is low, and the strongest indication is periconceptional, where folic acid 400 micrograms/day prevents neural tube defects with outcome evidence behind it.人体没有叶酸的生物合成通路, 所以每一微克都来自膳食或补充剂; 这里的 NONE 确实意味着必需, 缺乏症为巨细胞性贫血。结肠细菌确实合成叶酸, 本数据集把细菌产物算作外源供应, 因为人类基因组不含相应通路; 结肠吸收有限, 对人体营养状态的贡献未被定量。因此摄入不足时补充在填补真实缺口, 最强的指征是孕前和围孕期, 叶酸 400 micrograms/day 可预防神经管缺陷, 并有结局证据支持。

What it does它有什么作用

Folate is reduced to tetrahydrofolate, which carries one-carbon groups for thymidylate and purine synthesis and for the remethylation of homocysteine to methionine by methionine synthase (a B12-dependent enzyme). Tissues that divide fastest depend on it most: bone marrow, gut mucosa, and the closing neural tube of an early embryo. Folic acid is the synthetic, fully oxidised form; it must be reduced by dihydrofolate reductase, whose capacity in humans is limited, so unmetabolised folic acid appears in plasma at intakes above roughly 200 to 400 micrograms in one dose. The natural circulating form is 5-methyltetrahydrofolate.叶酸被还原为四氢叶酸，携带一碳基团用于胸苷酸和嘌呤合成，也用于同型半胱氨酸在methionine synthase（一种依赖B12的酶）催化下再甲基化生成蛋氨酸。分裂最快的组织对它依赖程度最高：骨髓、肠黏膜，以及早期胚胎正在闭合的神经管。叶酸是人工合成的完全氧化形式，必须经dihydrofolate reductase还原，该酶在人体内的能力有限，因此单次摄入量超过约200至400微克时，血浆中就会出现未代谢的叶酸。天然的循环形式是5-甲基四氢叶酸。

If you lack it缺乏会怎样

Marrow failure with pancytopenia, severe anaemia, mucosal ulceration and malabsorptive diarrhoea. In pregnancy the severe endpoint is structural: anencephaly is incompatible with life, and open spina bifida causes lifelong paralysis below the lesion, hydrocephalus, and bowel and bladder impairment.骨髓衰竭伴全血细胞减少、重度贫血、黏膜溃疡及吸收不良性腹泻。妊娠期的严重终点是结构性的：无脑畸形与生命不相容，开放性spina bifida会导致病灶平面以下终身瘫痪、脑积水以及肠道和膀胱功能障碍。

Does it reverse补回来能修复吗

The haematological and mucosal effects reverse completely: reticulocytosis begins within a week and the blood count normalises in about two months, with no residual deficit. A neural tube defect that has already formed is permanent and cannot be reversed by any later intake. The neural tube closes 26 to 28 days after conception, so supplementation started after a positive pregnancy test is too late for that specific endpoint, which is the whole argument for taking it before conception.血液学和黏膜方面的影响可完全逆转：网织红细胞增多在一周内开始出现，血细胞计数约两个月后恢复正常，不留残余缺陷。但已经形成的神经管缺陷是永久性的，之后任何摄入都无法逆转。神经管在受孕后26至28天闭合，因此妊娠试验阳性后才开始补充叶酸，对这一特定终点而言已经太晚，这正是主张在受孕前就开始补充的全部理由。

Partly reversible部分可逆		 People with serum 25(OH)D below about 30 nmol/L: dark skin at high latitude, covered clothing, housebound, northern-European winter.血清 25(OH)D 低于约 30 nmol/L 的人：高纬度地区的深肤色人群、遮盖式着装者、久不出门者、北欧的冬季。
Who it is for适用人群

People with serum 25(OH)D below about 30 nmol/L: dark skin at high latitude, covered clothing, housebound, northern-European winter.血清 25(OH)D 低于约 30 nmol/L 的人：高纬度地区的深肤色人群、遮盖式着装者、久不出门者、北欧的冬季。

Dose tested已验证剂量

800-2,000 IU/d, taken daily. Never as an annual or monthly bolus.800 至 2000 IU/天，每日服用。绝不要按年或按月大剂量冲击给药。

To match that from food用食物达到该剂量

1,000 IU (25 µg), the low end of ordinary supplement doses, is about 150 g of cooked sockeye salmon every day, or 155 g to 463 g of grilled herring depending on which herring value holds. 4,000 IU (100 µg) is roughly 600 g of sockeye salmon, 621 g to 1.85 kg of herring, about 109 large egg yolks, or about 890 g of UV-treated portabella mushrooms daily. A 50,000 IU (1,250 µg) weekly loading dose has no food equivalent: 7.5 kg of sockeye salmon, or 7.8 to 23.1 kg of grilled herring. One food gets close on mass alone, UV-treated maitake at the top of its measured range, where 178 g would carry 4,000 IU, and that content is unlabelled, spans 0.1 to 56.1 µg/100 g by growing method and is D2 rather than D3. Above roughly 50 degrees north, cutaneous synthesis is effectively zero from October to March, so there is no sunlight to close the winter shortfall.1,000 IU（25 µg）属于普通补充剂剂量的低端，相当于每天吃约 150 g 熟红鲑，或 155 g 至 463 g 烤鲱鱼（取决于采用哪个鲱鱼数值）。4,000 IU（100 µg）大致等于每天 600 g 红鲑、621 g 至 1.85 kg 鲱鱼、约 109 个大蛋黄，或约 890 g 经紫外线处理的褐菇。每周 50,000 IU（1,250 µg）的负荷剂量在食物里没有对应物：7.5 kg 红鲑，或 7.8 至 23.1 kg 烤鲱鱼。只有一种食物单看质量能接近，即处于实测范围上限的紫外线处理灰树花，178 g 就能提供 4,000 IU，但这一含量不会标注在包装上，随栽培方式在 0.1 至 56.1 µg/100 g 之间波动，而且它是 D2，不是 D3。在北纬约 50 度以上，10 月至次年 3 月皮肤合成实际为零，冬季缺口没有阳光可以填补。

Does the body make it身体是否自产

Skin makes vitamin D3 photochemically: UVB at 290 to 315 nm opens 7-dehydrocholesterol to previtamin D3, which isomerises thermally, after which CYP2R1 in liver makes 25(OH)D and renal CYP27B1 makes the hormone 1,25(OH)2D. Because the first step needs photons rather than an enzyme, production collapses with latitude, season, time of day, skin pigmentation, sunscreen, clothing, indoor living and age, which is why deficiency is common despite a functioning pathway. The recovered entries split on the label, one scoring it FULL conditional on UVB exposure and another calling it the one true CONDITIONAL vitamin, and PARTIAL is taken here because the pathway routinely fails to cover requirement under real exposure conditions; supplementing is therefore genuine repletion of a synthesis shortfall, and serum 25(OH)D makes it targetable and monitorable.皮肤以光化学方式生成维生素 D3: 290 至 315 nm 的 UVB 使 7-dehydrocholesterol 开环成为 previtamin D3, 后者经热异构化, 随后肝脏 CYP2R1 生成 25(OH)D, 肾脏 CYP27B1 生成激素形式 1,25(OH)2D。第一步需要光子而非酶, 所以产量随纬度, 季节, 时段, 皮肤色素, 防晒霜, 衣着, 室内生活和年龄大幅下降, 这就是通路完好却仍常见缺乏的原因。恢复条目中的标签并不统一, 有的记为 FULL (以有 UVB 暴露为条件), 有的称它是唯一真正 CONDITIONAL 的维生素; 这里取 PARTIAL, 因为在真实日照条件下该通路经常覆盖不了需要量。补充属于对合成不足的真正补足, 血清 25(OH)D 使它可以有针对性并可监测。

What it does它有什么作用

Cholecalciferol is hydroxylated in the liver to 25-hydroxyvitamin D, the circulating storage form measured on a blood test, and then in the kidney to 1,25-dihydroxyvitamin D (calcitriol), a steroid hormone acting through the nuclear vitamin D receptor. Calcitriol drives active intestinal absorption of calcium and phosphate, suppresses parathyroid hormone, and maintains the calcium-phosphate product that osteoblasts need to mineralise newly laid osteoid. Vitamin D receptors are present in immune cells, muscle and many other tissues, but the only role with an established human requirement is the calcium and bone axis. Skin synthesis from UVB normally supplies most of it, which is why dietary requirement figures depend heavily on latitude, season and sun exposure.胆钙化醇在肝脏中被羟化为25-羟维生素D，即血液检测测定的循环储存形式，随后在肾脏中被羟化为1,25-二羟维生素D（骨化三醇），一种通过核内维生素D受体发挥作用的类固醇激素。骨化三醇驱动肠道对钙和磷的主动吸收，抑制甲状旁腺激素，并维持成骨细胞矿化新沉积类骨质所需的钙磷乘积。维生素D受体存在于免疫细胞、肌肉及许多其他组织中，但唯一具有明确人体需求的作用是钙和骨骼轴。皮肤经UVB合成通常提供其中大部分，这也是膳食需求量数据高度取决于纬度、季节和日照的原因。

If you lack it缺乏会怎样

In children, growth plates fail to mineralise: bowed legs or knock knees, widened wrists and ankles, the rachitic rosary at the costochondral junctions, delayed walking, poor growth and fractures. Infants can present first with hypocalcaemic tetany, seizures or dilated cardiomyopathy, which can be fatal. In adults, unmineralised osteoid accumulates as osteomalacia, giving bone pain, proximal myopathy with a waddling gait, and Looser zones (pseudofractures) that progress to complete fractures of the pubic rami, femoral neck or ribs.儿童期骨骺生长板矿化失败：出现膝内翻或膝外翻、腕踝增宽、肋软骨连接处的佝偻病串珠、行走延迟、生长不良及骨折。婴儿可首先表现为低钙性手足搐搦、惊厥发作或扩张型心肌病，可致命。成人则因未矿化的类骨质堆积而形成骨软化症，出现骨痛、伴摇摆步态的近端肌病，以及Looser带（假性骨折），可进展为耻骨支、股骨颈或肋骨的完全性骨折。

Does it reverse补回来能修复吗

Biochemistry, bone pain, myopathy, hypocalcaemic seizures and the radiological signs of active rickets correct completely with vitamin D plus adequate calcium, usually over weeks to a few months. Skeletal deformity already established in long-standing rickets often persists, and marked bowing, rachitic dwarfism or pelvic deformity may need surgical correction.补充维生素D并配合充足钙摄入后，生化指标、骨痛、肌病、低钙性惊厥及活动性佝偻病的影像学表现通常可完全恢复，一般需数周至数月。但长期佝偻病已形成的骨骼畸形往往持续存在，明显的骨弯曲、佝偻病性侏儒或骨盆畸形可能需要手术矫正。

Dose tested已验证剂量

50-250 µg/d, or 1,000-2,000 µg once or twice weekly. Deficiency treatment: 1,000-2,000 µg/d orally.50 至 250 微克/天，或每周 1 至 2 次、每次 1000 至 2000 微克。治疗缺乏：口服 1000 至 2000 微克/天。

To match that from food用食物达到该剂量

Against the 2.4 ug/day RDA there is no gap for anyone eating animal food: one 3 oz portion of cooked clams is 35 times the RDA, a slice of beef liver 20 times, a can of sardines 3.4 times. Against the supplement dose the gap cannot be closed. Oral B12 products are typically 500-1,000 ug, and 1,000-2,000 ug for treating deficiency. To have 1,000 ug physically present in a meal takes 1.01 kg of cooked clams, 1.17 kg of pan-fried lamb liver, 1.42 kg of braised beef liver, 4.17 kg of cooked blue mussels, 11.2 kg of canned sardines, 35.7 kg of cooked salmon, or 222 kg of whole milk, which is about 216 litres (the submission's '222 litres' confused grams with litres; 1,000/0.0045 = 222,222 g, and at about 1.03 kg/L that is 216 L). No one could eat any of those. The comparison is also the wrong one, because intrinsic-factor-mediated absorption saturates at about 1.5-2.0 ug per meal (Watanabe, Exp Biol Med 2007;232:1266-74, PMID 17959839), so everything above roughly 2 ug in a single sitting is absorbed only by passive diffusion at on the order of 1%. A 1,000 ug tablet works because 1% of 1,000 ug bypasses the receptor route, which no food can imitate and none needs to unless that route is broken. For a strict vegan the picture inverts: nothing reliably supplies even the 2.4 ug RDA except dried nori, and Watanabe puts the requirement at about 4 g/day of dried purple laver, which is about one and a third 3 g sheets every day (the submission said one and a half) from a product varying about elevenfold by origin. Fortified foods or a tablet are the honest answer.对照每日 2.4 µg 的 RDA，吃动物性食物的人不存在缺口：一份 3 oz 熟蛤蜊是 RDA 的 35 倍，一片牛肝 20 倍，一罐沙丁鱼 3.4 倍。对照补充剂剂量，缺口无法弥合。口服 B12 产品通常是 500-1,000 µg，治疗缺乏时 1,000-2,000 µg。要让一餐里实际存在 1,000 µg，需要 1.01 kg 熟蛤蜊、1.17 kg 煎羊肝、1.42 kg 炖牛肝、4.17 kg 熟蓝贻贝、11.2 kg 罐装沙丁鱼、35.7 kg 熟三文鱼，或 222 kg 全脂牛奶，约合 216 升（原稿写的 222 升把克和升搞混了；1,000/0.0045 = 222,222 g，按约 1.03 kg/L 折算是 216 L）。这些没人吃得下。这个对比本身也问错了问题，因为内因子介导的吸收在每餐约 1.5-2.0 µg 处饱和（Watanabe, Exp Biol Med 2007;232:1266-74, PMID 17959839），一次进食中超过约 2 µg 的部分只能靠被动扩散吸收，效率大约 1%。1,000 µg 的片剂之所以有效，是因为 1,000 µg 的 1% 绕开了受体途径，任何食物都模仿不了，而只要该途径没坏，也不需要模仿。对严格素食者，情况反转：除了干紫菜，没有任何食物能可靠提供哪怕 2.4 µg 的 RDA，Watanabe 把需要量定在每天约 4 g 干紫菜，相当于每天约一又三分之一张 3 g 的紫菜片（原稿说的是一张半），而这种产品的含量随产地相差约十一倍。强化食品或片剂才是诚实的答案。

Does the body make it身体是否自产

Humans have no cobalamin biosynthetic pathway, and the deficiency states are well described, megaloblastic anaemia and subacute combined degeneration. Bacteria in the human colon do make cobalamin and it cannot be absorbed there, because intrinsic factor dependent uptake by cubilin and amnionless is confined to the ileum, upstream of where the bacteria produce it, so colonic B12 synthesis contributes nothing to B12 status. That leaves supplementation as the clearest indication in nutrition for anyone whose dietary or absorptive route fails.人体没有钴胺素的生物合成通路, 缺乏症也很清楚, 即巨细胞性贫血与亚急性联合变性。人体结肠中的细菌确实生成钴胺素, 而它在那里无法被吸收, 因为依赖内因子, 由 cubilin 和 amnionless 介导的摄取只发生在回肠, 位于细菌产生它的部位之上游, 所以结肠 B12 合成对 B12 状态毫无帮助。这使得对膳食或吸收环节失效的人来说, 补充成为营养学中最明确的指征。

What it does它有什么作用

Cobalamin is the cofactor for exactly two human enzymes. Methionine synthase remethylates homocysteine to methionine using 5-methyltetrahydrofolate, which both regenerates usable folate and supplies S-adenosylmethionine for the methylation reactions that maintain myelin. Methylmalonyl-CoA mutase converts methylmalonyl-CoA to succinyl-CoA in the mitochondrion during breakdown of odd-chain fatty acids and branched-chain amino acids. Absorption is elaborate: gastric acid and pepsin release B12 from food protein, intrinsic factor from parietal cells carries it, and receptors in the terminal ileum take it up. Outside vegan diets the usual cause of deficiency is failure somewhere along that route rather than low intake.钴胺素是人体内恰好两种酶的辅因子。methionine synthase利用5-甲基四氢叶酸将同型半胱氨酸再甲基化为蛋氨酸，这一过程既能再生可用的叶酸，又能为维持髓鞘的甲基化反应提供S-腺苷蛋氨酸。methylmalonyl-CoA mutase在线粒体内催化甲基丙二酰辅酶A转化为琥珀酰辅酶A，参与奇数碳链脂肪酸和支链氨基酸的分解代谢。其吸收过程相当复杂：胃酸和胃蛋白酶将B12从食物蛋白中释放，壁细胞分泌的内因子负责转运，回肠末端的受体负责摄取。除严格素食饮食外，缺乏的常见原因是这条通路上某个环节出现故障，而非摄入不足。

Subacute combined degeneration: demyelination of the dorsal columns and lateral corticospinal tracts producing sensory ataxia, spasticity, extensor plantar responses, and bladder and bowel disturbance, progressing untreated to spastic paraparesis and loss of independent walking. Optic atrophy occurs in a minority, as do dementia and psychosis. Severe megaloblastic anaemia with pancytopenia can occur, but it is the neurology that disables.脊髓亚急性联合变性：后索和皮质脊髓侧束脱髓鞘，导致感觉性共济失调、痉挛、跖反射阳性以及膀胱和肠道功能紊乱，未经治疗会进展为痉挛性截瘫并丧失独立行走能力。少数患者出现视神经萎缩，也有出现痴呆和精神病的。严重的巨幼细胞性贫血伴全血细胞减少也可能发生，但真正致残的是神经系统病变。

Does it reverse补回来能修复吗

The blood corrects fully (reticulocytosis within a week, counts normal in roughly eight weeks) while the neurology may not. In the largest series, 153 episodes in 143 patients, 47.1% had complete resolution of neurological abnormalities on treatment and 6.3% were left with moderate-to-severe residual disability; so most treated patients recover fully or nearly so and a minority are left disabled. What survives treatment is inversely related to how severe the deficits were and how long they had run before treatment started. Recovery is fastest in the first two months and continues to about six months. This is exactly why folate must not be given blind for an unexplained macrocytic anaemia: folic acid repairs the blood picture and removes the visible signal while the cord damage carries on.血液学异常可完全纠正（一周内出现网织红细胞增多，计数约八周后恢复正常），但神经系统病变未必如此。在规模最大的一组病例系列中（143例患者共153次发作），47.1%的患者经治疗后神经系统异常完全恢复，6.3%遗留中度至重度残疾，也就是说多数接受治疗的患者可完全或接近完全恢复，少数人会留下残疾。治疗后残留的损害程度与治疗前缺陷的严重程度和持续时间成反比。恢复在最初两个月最快，可持续至约六个月。这正是为什么不明原因的大细胞性贫血绝不能盲目给予叶酸的原因：叶酸会修复血象、消除可见的信号，而脊髓损害仍在继续。

To match that from food用食物达到该剂量

Two supplement doses need two answers. A nutritional dose (14 to 18 mg elemental iron, the EU labelling reference level) is comfortably reachable by eating: 1 cup of boiled lentils (6.6 mg) plus 85 g of braised lamb's liver (7.0 mg) plus 1 oz of pumpkin seeds (2.3 mg) is 15.9 mg in one day, and a single 85 g portion of braised pig's liver is 15.2 mg on its own. A therapeutic dose is out of reach. The absorption and treatment trials gave 60 mg and 120 mg of elemental iron as labelled ferrous sulfate, which is a salt weight of about 325 mg for 65 mg of iron (PMID 29032957). Matching 65 mg of iron by total content takes roughly 363 g of braised pig's liver, 785 g of lamb's liver, 3.3 kg of sirloin steak, 1.95 kg (about 10 cups) of boiled lentils, or 2.4 kg (about 80 cups) of raw spinach in a single day. By absorbed iron the food burden is about 1.6 times larger than the submission claimed, because the trial it cites measured cumulative fractional absorption of 16.3 percent on consecutive days and 21.8 percent on alternate days at 60 mg/d, and 11.8 percent for a single 120 mg dose, rather than the 10 percent assumed. At the source's own 16.3 percent a 65 mg dose delivers about 10.6 mg absorbed. Absorbing 10.6 mg as haem iron at 25 percent requires 42.4 mg of haem iron, about 1.94 kg of braised lean lamb shoulder (2.7 mg total iron per 100 g, 81 percent haem in raw lean; FDC 174331 and PMID 26433293). Absorbing the same 10.6 mg from non-haem food at 5 percent requires 212 mg of non-haem iron, about 6.4 kg of cooked lentils per day. Correcting a diagnosed deficiency cannot be done with food; preventing one can.两种补充剂剂量需要两个答案。营养剂量（14 至 18 mg 元素铁，欧盟标签参考量）靠吃就能轻松达到：1 杯煮扁豆（6.6 mg）加 85 g 炖羊肝（7.0 mg）加 1 oz 南瓜子（2.3 mg），一天合计 15.9 mg；单独一份 85 g 炖猪肝本身就有 15.2 mg。治疗剂量则达不到。吸收和治疗试验给的是以硫酸亚铁形式标示的 60 mg 和 120 mg 元素铁，65 mg 铁对应的盐重约为 325 mg（PMID 29032957）。若按总含量匹配 65 mg 铁，一天大约需要 363 g 炖猪肝、785 g 羊肝、3.3 kg 西冷牛排、1.95 kg（约 10 杯）煮扁豆，或 2.4 kg（约 80 杯）生菠菜。若按吸收铁计算，食物负担约为原稿所称的 1.6 倍，因为它引用的那项试验测得，在 60 mg/d 下连续每日给药的累积分数吸收率为 16.3%，隔日给药为 21.8%，单次 120 mg 剂量为 11.8%，原稿假定的 10% 低于这些实测值。按该来源自己的 16.3% 计算，65 mg 剂量提供约 10.6 mg 吸收铁。以 25% 的吸收率通过血红素铁吸收 10.6 mg，需要 42.4 mg 血红素铁，约合 1.94 kg 炖瘦羊肩肉（每 100 g 总铁 2.7 mg，生瘦肉中 81% 为血红素铁；FDC 174331 与 PMID 26433293）。以 5% 的吸收率从非血红素食物吸收同样的 10.6 mg，需要 212 mg 非血红素铁，约合每天 6.4 kg 熟扁豆。已确诊的缺铁无法靠食物纠正，预防缺铁可以。

Does the body make it身体是否自产

Iron is chemical element 26, and no enzyme can build an element out of anything else, so every iron atom in haemoglobin arrived in food, water or a pill. The body compensates by hoarding: macrophages strip iron from dying red cells and return roughly 20-25 mg/d to plasma, while only about 1-2 mg/d is absorbed to cover obligatory losses. Recycling only reuses atoms already present, so iron supplements are never redundant on this axis and stand or fall entirely on measured status and losses, with no regulated route for excreting the surplus.铁是26号化学元素，没有任何酶能用别的物质造出一种元素，所以血红蛋白里的每一个铁原子都来自食物、水或药片。身体靠囤积来弥补：巨噬细胞从衰老红细胞中回收铁，每天向血浆返还大约 20-25 mg/d，而每天只吸收约 1-2 mg/d 来抵偿必然损失。回收只是重复利用体内已有的原子，因此在合成这一维度上补铁永远不算多余，其成立与否完全取决于实测的铁状态和损失量，而人体没有受调控的铁排泄途径，多余的铁只会积存下来。

What it does它有什么作用

Iron sits at the centre of the haem group in haemoglobin and myoglobin, where it binds and releases oxygen, and in the iron-sulfur clusters of mitochondrial complexes I to III, where it moves electrons during ATP synthesis. It is also the cofactor for ribonucleotide reductase, the rate-limiting enzyme of DNA synthesis, which is why dividing tissues (marrow, gut lining) fail first. In the developing brain it is required for tyrosine hydroxylase (dopamine synthesis), for oligodendrocyte myelination, and for hippocampal maturation, which is the mechanism behind the developmental findings in infants. Absorption is governed by hepcidin, and the direction runs opposite to what is often assumed: when stores are low hepcidin is suppressed, ferroportin survives on enterocytes and macrophages, and fractional absorption rises several-fold, from roughly 10% of intake to 20 to 30%. What hepcidin sets is the ceiling on rate, and there is no regulated route for excreting iron, so a large deficit still takes months to refill and oral iron works slowly. During inflammation hepcidin stays high and blocks absorption despite empty stores, which is why the anaemia of inflammation does not respond to oral iron.铁位于血红蛋白和肌红蛋白血红素基团的中心,负责结合和释放氧气,也存在于线粒体复合体I至III的铁硫簇中,负责在ATP合成过程中传递电子。铁还是ribonucleotide reductase(核糖核苷酸还原酶,DNA合成的限速酶)的辅因子,这就是为何增殖旺盛的组织(骨髓、肠道黏膜)最先受累。在发育中的大脑里,铁是tyrosine hydroxylase(酪氨酸羟化酶,负责多巴胺合成)、少突胶质细胞髓鞘形成以及海马成熟所必需的,这正是婴儿发育相关研究结果背后的机制。铁的吸收受hepcidin(铁调素)调控,其作用方向与常见的误解相反:当体内铁储备低时,铁调素受到抑制,肠上皮细胞和巨噬细胞上的ferroportin(膜铁转运蛋白)得以留存,吸收分数随之成倍上升,从摄入量的约10%升至20%至30%。铁调素设定的是吸收速率的上限,而人体没有可调节的排铁途径,因此大量的铁缺口仍需数月才能补足,口服铁剂起效缓慢。炎症状态下铁调素持续处于高水平,即使铁储备已经耗尽仍会阻断吸收,这就是炎症性贫血对口服铁剂无反应的原因。

If you lack it缺乏会怎样

Haemoglobin falls with small pale red cells, producing pallor, tachycardia, exertional dyspnoea, and in extreme cases high-output cardiac failure. In pregnancy it raises the risk of preterm delivery, low birth weight, and poor infant iron stores. In infancy it impairs motor and cognitive development. In adults over 50 a new iron deficiency is a red flag for occult gastrointestinal bleeding and needs investigation rather than a supplement.血红蛋白下降,红细胞变小变淡,导致面色苍白、心动过速、活动后呼吸困难,极端情况下可出现高排量心力衰竭。孕期缺铁会增加早产、低出生体重及婴儿铁储备不足的风险。婴儿期缺铁会损害运动和认知发育。50岁以上成人新发缺铁是隐匿性消化道出血的警示信号,应及时检查,不应仅仅补充铁剂。

Does it reverse补回来能修复吗

In adults, anaemia and its symptoms correct fully once iron is replaced and the cause is fixed; haemoglobin typically rises within 4 to 8 weeks and stores refill over 3 to 6 months. Iron deficiency during infancy is the exception. Children with severe chronic iron deficiency in infancy still scored worse on cognitive, motor and behavioural measures more than 10 years after full iron treatment, so the developmental window matters more than the correction.在成人中,一旦补铁并纠正病因,贫血及其症状可完全恢复:血红蛋白通常在4至8周内回升,铁储备在3至6个月内补足。婴儿期缺铁是例外。婴儿期曾患严重慢性缺铁的儿童,在接受充分铁剂治疗10年以上后,认知、运动和行为测评得分依然较差,说明发育窗口期比纠正本身更为关键。

To match that from food用食物达到该剂量

There is essentially no gap. A standard iodine supplement or prenatal multivitamin supplies 150 ug, exactly the EFSA adult AI. A single 120 g UK haddock fillet delivers 390 ug, two and a half times the dose. One 115 g cod fillet delivers 131 ug. About 400 ml of milk delivers roughly 156 ug at milk density (412 g); the 151 ug figure quoted previously is what 1.6 USDA cups (398 g) gives, and the two should not be equated. Six large eggs deliver 147 ug. Half a teaspoon of iodised salt (3 g) delivers 152 ug where salt is iodised. Iodine belongs in the small category of supplements a normal eater does not need. The gap opens the moment those specific foods leave the diet, and the UK numbers are stark. Substituting three dairy portions a day (milk, yoghurt, cheese) with plant alternatives cuts the iodine those portions supply from 124 ug to 2.6 ug, a 97.9 percent loss, taking the contribution to the 150 ug recommendation from 83 percent down to 1.8 percent (PMID 35373723). The same market survey identified 146 milk alternatives and 76 yoghurt alternatives, excluded 48 organic products, and found 29 milk alternatives and 4 yoghurt alternatives iodine-fortified; that is 28 percent and 6 percent of the non-organic subset, or 19.9 percent and 5.3 percent of all products identified. The 28 and 6 percent figures quoted earlier against the full denominators were wrong. Against those, 88 percent and 73 percent were fortified with calcium; no cheese alternative and no fish alternative was iodine-fortified; and organic plant alternatives cannot legally be fortified. This shows up in real people: in NDNS years 7 to 9, adults and children consuming milk alternatives exclusively had an iodine intake of 94 ug/d against 129 ug/d for cows' milk consumers, and a median urinary iodine concentration of 79 ug/l against 132 ug/l, which classifies the milk-alternative group as iodine deficient by the WHO criterion while the milk drinkers were sufficient (PMID 32993817). Unfortified milk-alternative concentrations were a median 7.3 ug/kg, 1.7 percent of winter conventional cows' milk; the three fortified products found in 2015 sat at 266 to 287 ug/kg (PMID 28946925).基本上没有缺口。标准的碘补充剂或孕期复合维生素提供 150 ug，正好等于 EFSA 成人 AI。单块 120 g 的英国黑线鳕鱼柳提供 390 ug，是该剂量的两倍半。一块 115 g 鳕鱼柳提供 131 ug。约 400 ml 牛奶按牛奶密度（412 g）计算提供约 156 ug；此前引用的 151 ug 是 1.6 个 USDA 杯（398 g）的量，两者不应等同。六个大号鸡蛋提供 147 ug。在实行加碘的地区，半茶匙加碘盐（3 g）提供 152 ug。碘属于正常饮食者不需要补充的那一小类。一旦这些特定食物离开饮食，缺口立刻出现，英国的数据很直白。把一天三份乳制品（牛奶、酸奶、奶酪）换成植物替代品，这些份量提供的碘从 124 ug 降到 2.6 ug，损失 97.9%，对 150 ug 推荐量的贡献从 83% 降到 1.8%（PMID 35373723）。同一项市场调查识别出 146 种牛奶替代品和 76 种酸奶替代品，排除了 48 种有机产品，发现 29 种牛奶替代品和 4 种酸奶替代品做了碘强化；这相当于非有机子集的 28% 和 6%，或全部已识别产品的 19.9% 和 5.3%。此前按全部分母引用的 28% 和 6% 是错的。相比之下，88% 和 73% 做了钙强化；没有任何奶酪替代品和鱼类替代品做碘强化；有机植物替代品在法律上不能强化。这在真实人群中有体现：在 NDNS 第 7 至 9 年，只饮用植物奶的成人和儿童碘摄入量为 94 ug/d，饮用牛奶者为 129 ug/d，尿碘浓度中位数分别为 79 ug/l 和 132 ug/l，按 WHO 标准前一组属于碘缺乏，而牛奶饮用者充足（PMID 32993817）。未强化植物饮品的碘浓度中位数为 7.3 ug/kg，只有冬季常规牛奶的 1.7%；2015 年发现的三种强化产品在 266 至 287 ug/kg 之间（PMID 28946925）。

Does the body make it身体是否自产

Iodine is chemical element 53, so there is no synthetic route to it and thyroid hormone output falls when dietary supply stops. What the body does make is the hormone itself: thyroid peroxidase attaches dietary iodide to tyrosine residues on thyroglobulin to build T4 and T3, and deiodinases salvage iodide when hormone is degraded. The enzymatic machinery is endogenous while every iodine atom is dietary, so iodine supplementation is genuinely useful wherever intake is low and pointless once intake is adequate.碘是53号化学元素，不存在合成途径，膳食供应中断时甲状腺激素产量就会下降。身体自己造的是激素本身：甲状腺过氧化物酶把膳食碘化物接到甲状腺球蛋白的酪氨酸残基上，组装成 T4 和 T3，激素降解时脱碘酶再把碘化物回收。酶系统是内源的，而每个碘原子都来自膳食，所以在摄入不足的地方补碘确实有用，摄入充足之后补碘毫无意义。

What it does它有什么作用

Iodine has exactly one job: it is the substrate thyroid peroxidase attaches to tyrosine residues on thyroglobulin to make thyroxine (T4) and triiodothyronine (T3). There is no alternative pathway and no substitute element. T3 acting on nuclear thyroid hormone receptors drives basal metabolic rate and thermogenesis in adults. In the fetus it governs neuronal migration, dendritic branching, synaptogenesis and myelination, on a fixed developmental timetable. The fetal thyroid does not begin producing hormone until roughly week 12 to 16, so first-trimester brain development runs entirely on maternal T4 crossing the placenta. Maternal requirement rises to about 250 micrograms per day in pregnancy and lactation.碘只有一项功能:作为thyroid peroxidase(甲状腺过氧化物酶)连接到甲状腺球蛋白酪氨酸残基上的底物,用以合成甲状腺素(T4)和三碘甲状腺原氨酸(T3)。没有替代通路,也没有可替代的元素。T3作用于核甲状腺激素受体,驱动成人的基础代谢率和产热。在胎儿体内,碘按固定的发育时间表调控神经元迁移、树突分支、突触形成和髓鞘化。胎儿甲状腺大约要到第12至16周才开始分泌激素,因此妊娠早期的大脑发育完全依赖经胎盘进入的母体T4。孕期和哺乳期母体需求量升至每日约250微克。

If you lack it缺乏会怎样

Endemic cretinism: severe intellectual disability, deaf-mutism, spastic diplegia and stunted growth in a child whose mother was severely deficient during pregnancy. Adults develop overt hypothyroidism with cold intolerance, weight gain, bradycardia and, in extreme untreated cases, myxoedema. Even mild to moderate maternal deficiency is associated with lower verbal IQ and reading scores in the child, on the order of a few points, which is small individually and large across a population.地方性克汀病:母亲孕期严重缺碘的孩子会出现重度智力障碍、聋哑、痉挛性双侧瘫和生长迟缓。成人则出现明显的甲状腺功能减退,表现为怕冷、体重增加、心动过缓,极端未治疗病例可出现黏液性水肿。即使母体只是轻中度缺碘,孩子的言语智商和阅读成绩也会降低,幅度为几分,个体层面看幅度不大,但放到人群层面影响显著。

Does it reverse补回来能修复吗

Goitre, adult hypothyroidism and impaired thyroid function correct with iodine repletion. Brain damage sustained in utero and in the first two years of life does not. The window is narrower than the whole pregnancy but far wider than the moment a pregnancy is confirmed: in Cao's trial, iodine given in the first or second trimester left 2% of infants with moderate or severe neurologic abnormality, against 9% when it was given in the third trimester or after birth, so treatment up to the end of the second trimester still protects the fetal brain. Beyond that window iodine given to an affected child undoes nothing; only iodine reaching the mother in time prevents the damage. The practical reading is to start immediately, not to conclude it is too late. This is the strongest irreversibility case among common micronutrients, and the reason salt iodisation is a public health programme rather than an individual choice.甲状腺肿、成人甲状腺功能减退及甲状腺功能受损,在补碘后可以纠正。子宫内及出生后头两年内造成的脑损伤则不能。这个窗口期比整个孕期窄,但远比确认怀孕的那一刻宽:在Cao的试验中,妊娠早期或中期补碘的婴儿中有2%出现中度或重度神经系统异常,而妊娠晚期或出生后才补碘的比例为9%,说明在妊娠中期结束前进行治疗仍能保护胎儿大脑。超过这一窗口期后,给患儿补碘无法逆转已造成的损害,只有及时让碘到达母体才能预防损害。实际的启示是应立即开始补碘,而不是认为为时已晚。这是常见微量营养素中不可逆性证据最强的一例,也是食盐加碘作为公共卫生项目而非个人选择的原因。

Does the body make it身体是否自产

Your body builds creatine every day, on the order of 1 g in a young man (an inference from creatinine loss averaging about 2 g/day in 70 kg men aged 20 to 39, roughly half of it replaced by dietary creatine in omnivores), and a normal omnivorous diet covers the rest of the 1 to 3 g/day lost as creatinine. The catch is that this combined supply leaves muscle stores only around 60 to 80 percent saturated and synthesis is feedback-inhibited, so it will not rise to close the gap, while the synthesis that does run costs about 40 percent of the labile methyl groups carried by S-adenosylmethionine and 20 to 30 percent of the amidino groups of arginine. So 3 to 5 g/day adds to existing supply instead of duplicating it, which makes creatine one of the few endogenous compounds where this axis supports supplementing.身体每天都在合成 creatine, 年轻男性在 1 g 量级 (由肌酐流失推算: 70 kg, 20 到 39 岁男性每天约 2 g, 杂食者约一半由膳食 creatine 补回), 正常杂食饮食补上每天以肌酐形式流失的 1 到 3 g 中的其余部分。问题在于这两部分合起来仍只让肌肉储量停在约 60% 到 80% 饱和, 合成又受反馈抑制, 不会自行上调填平缺口; 而已在运行的合成代价不低, 占用 S-adenosylmethionine 提供的全部活性甲基约 40%, 并消耗 arginine 胍基的 20% 到 30%。所以 3 到 5 g/day 是在原有供应之外叠加, 并未重复, creatine 也因此成为这条轴支持补充的少数内源化合物之一。

What it does它有什么作用

Creatine is phosphorylated by creatine kinase to phosphocreatine, a rapid-turnover phosphate reservoir that regenerates ATP from ADP during high-intensity contraction and in neurons. Roughly half of the daily turnover (about 1 to 3 g) is synthesized endogenously from arginine, glycine and methionine by AGAT and GAMT in liver, kidney and pancreas; the remainder comes from meat and fish. There is no dietary requirement. Vegetarians carry intramuscular creatine roughly 10 to 15 percent below omnivores and remain healthy, they simply respond more strongly to supplementation. That range comes from two different designs: Blancquaert et al. 2018 is an intervention trial in 40 omnivorous women in which vastus lateralis total creatine fell 15 percent over 3 months in the vegetarian-plus-placebo arm (against +9.7 percent vegetarian-plus-creatine and +6.8 percent omnivorous control), while cross-sectional comparisons of habitual vegetarians report a smaller gap of around 10 percent. Separately from anything to do with intake, three inborn errors of metabolism produce the cerebral creatine deficiency syndromes: GAMT deficiency, AGAT deficiency and X-linked creatine transporter (SLC6A8) deficiency. These are genetic defects of synthesis or transport, not consequences of eating too little creatine, and no dietary pattern produces them. Onset is in infancy or early childhood with global developmental delay, expressive speech delay out of proportion to other skills and hypotonia, plus early epilepsy and a movement disorder in GAMT deficiency; brain magnetic resonance spectroscopy showing an absent or near-absent creatine peak is the diagnostic finding. Untreated GAMT deficiency causes intractable seizures, autistic features, extrapyramidal movement disorder and severe intellectual disability, with accumulated guanidinoacetate contributing to the neurotoxicity, and creatine transporter deficiency causes lifelong moderate to severe intellectual disability and seizures in affected males. AGAT and GAMT deficiency respond to oral creatine (with arginine restriction and ornithine in GAMT), and 7 of 8 infants treated before 6 months of age had normal developmental outcomes, which is what makes early detection decisive; creatine transporter deficiency does not respond to oral creatine at all, because the transporter that would carry it into the brain is the broken protein. On frequency, GeneReviews gives an estimated GAMT incidence of 1:2,640,000 to 1:250,000; prospective newborn screening in Utah and New York found 1:405,655; a single-centre referral series of 5 patients seen between 2001 and 2011 produced a much higher outlier estimate of 1:114,000. To match that from food用食物达到该剂量

A 1.6 g/kg target is 112 g/day for a 70 kg adult and food covers it without powder. Worked day: 2 boiled eggs (14.1 g) plus a 170 g pot of Greek style yogurt (9.7 g) plus a 130 g grilled chicken breast (41.6 g) plus 200 g cooked red lentils (16.2 g) plus 250 mL semi-skimmed milk (9.0 g) plus 30 g Cheddar (7.6 g) totals 98.2 g; add one 100 g can of tuna in brine and it reaches 123 g, over target. A 100 kg athlete at 1.6 g/kg (160 g) gets there by adding a 150 g grilled turkey breast fillet (52.5 g) or a 170 g rump steak (52.7 g). A shopper does better than the table suggests on dairy, since modern strained pots and skyr run roughly 10-12 g/100 g against CoFID's traditional Greek style yogurt at 5.7 g. The gap appears only at very high targets combined with poor appetite, a low-calorie diet or exclusively plant sources, where food volume becomes the binding constraint. Does the body make it身体是否自产

The roll-up is PARTIAL and it hides three tiers: nine amino acids have no human pathway to their carbon skeletons (histidine, isoleucine, leucine, lysine, methionine, phenylalanine, threonine, tryptophan, valine) and score NONE, five are built freely from central intermediates (alanine, aspartate, asparagine, glutamate, serine) and score FULL, and six sit in the IOM's conditionally indispensable middle tier (arginine, cysteine, glutamine, glycine, proline, tyrosine), made in health and needed from the diet in prematurity, trauma, sepsis or specific enzyme defects. Roughly 250 to 300 g of body protein is degraded and resynthesised per day, several times typical intake, so reutilisation dominates supply and the powder functions as a convenience format for hitting total daily protein. It therefore makes sense only when total intake sits below target, and above roughly 1.62 g/kg/day in resistance trainees it adds nothing.汇总标签是 PARTIAL, 下面藏着三个层级: 九种氨基酸的碳骨架人体无法合成 (histidine, isoleucine, leucine, lysine, methionine, phenylalanine, threonine, tryptophan, valine), 判为 NONE; 五种可由中心代谢中间体自由合成 (alanine, aspartate, asparagine, glutamate, serine), 判为 FULL; 另有六种落在 IOM 的条件性必需中间层 (arginine, cysteine, glutamine, glycine, proline, tyrosine), 健康时自产, 在早产, 创伤, 脓毒症或特定酶缺陷时需从饮食获得。成人每天降解并重新合成的体蛋白约 250 到 300 g, 是典型摄入量的数倍, 供应以再利用为主, 蛋白粉的角色是把每日总蛋白凑够的便利形式。所以只有在总摄入低于目标时才说得通, 抗阻训练者超过约 1.62 g/kg/day 之后它不再带来额外收益。

What it does它有什么作用

Protein powder is isolated food protein (whey, casein, soy, pea, rice, egg) dried and concentrated. It has no function of its own; the function is that of dietary protein, which supplies the nine indispensable amino acids plus nitrogen for synthesis of muscle, enzymes, albumin, immunoglobulins, haemoglobin, hormones and connective tissue. An adult turns over roughly 250 to 300 g of body protein daily, most of it recycled, with dietary intake covering obligatory oxidative losses. The US RDA is 0.8 g/kg/day. The PROT-AGE group recommends 1.0 to 1.2 g/kg/day for healthy older adults and 1.2 to 1.5 g/kg/day in acute or chronic illness, because the muscle protein synthetic response to a given protein dose is blunted with age (PMID 23867520).蛋白粉是从食物中分离出的蛋白质(乳清、酪蛋白、大豆、豌豆、大米、鸡蛋),经干燥浓缩而成。它本身没有独立的功能,其作用就是膳食蛋白质的作用:提供9种必需氨基酸以及用于合成肌肉、酶、白蛋白、免疫球蛋白、血红蛋白、激素和结缔组织的氮源。成人每天约有250至300 g体蛋白发生周转,其中大部分被循环利用,膳食摄入用于弥补必然存在的氧化性丢失。美国的推荐膳食摄入量(RDA)为0.8 g/kg/day。PROT-AGE专家组建议健康老年人摄入1.0至1.2 g/kg/day,急性或慢性疾病状态下摄入1.2至1.5 g/kg/day,因为随着年龄增长,给定蛋白剂量引发的肌肉蛋白合成反应会减弱(PMID 23867520)。

If you lack it缺乏会怎样

Marasmus is severe wasting: weight-for-height far below normal, visible loss of muscle and fat, an aged appearance in a young child. Kwashiorkor adds pitting oedema, an enlarged fatty liver, flaky-paint skin desquamation and hair depigmentation. Both carry high case fatality from hypoglycaemia, hypothermia, electrolyte disturbance and overwhelming infection; without structured refeeding the endpoint is death. In older adults, untreated sarcopenia ends in falls, fracture, loss of independence and raised mortality.消瘦型营养不良表现为严重消瘦:身高别体重远低于正常,肌肉和脂肪明显丢失,幼儿呈现衰老外貌。夸希奥科病在此基础上还有凹陷性水肿、脂肪肝肿大、剥落样皮肤脱屑和毛发脱色。两者都因低血糖、低体温、电解质紊乱和严重感染而具有很高的病死率,若不进行规范化再喂养,结局即为死亡。老年人未经治疗的肌少症最终导致跌倒、骨折、丧失自理能力和死亡率升高。

Does it reverse补回来能修复吗

Acute wasting reverses with careful staged refeeding, and weight-for-height recovers. What does not fully recover is linear growth and neurocognitive development when the episode falls within the first 1000 days: stunting established before age two is largely permanent, and the associated cognitive deficits persist into adulthood. Sarcopenia is partly reversible, since resistance training with adequate protein rebuilds strength and some mass, but muscle lost over decades is not fully regained.急性消瘦通过谨慎的分阶段再喂养可以逆转,身高别体重可恢复。若病程发生在生命最初1000天内,则不能完全恢复的是线性生长和神经认知发育:两岁前形成的生长迟缓大多为永久性的,相关的认知缺陷会持续到成年。肌少症部分可逆,充足蛋白质配合抗阻训练可重建力量和部分肌肉量,但数十年间流失的肌肉无法完全恢复。

Does the body make it身体是否自产

Psyllium is a highly branched arabinoxylan that no human enzyme can cleave, which is the operational meaning of dietary fibre. Being non-digestible is the mechanism: the husk holds water into a viscous gel and the gel does the work on stool form and transit. So the axis has nothing to say against it, and psyllium is the one fibre with reasonable randomised support in IBS.车前子壳是高度分支的阿拉伯木聚糖, 人体没有酶能切开它, 这就是膳食纤维的操作性含义。不可消化本身就是机制: 壳把水保持成粘性凝胶, 凝胶作用于大便形态和转运。所以这条轴没有反对它的理由, 而车前子是在 IBS 中拥有较合理随机证据的那一种纤维。

What it does它有什么作用

Psyllium is the milled seed husk of Plantago ovata, largely a highly branched arabinoxylan that is gel-forming and, unusually among viscous fibres, poorly fermented by colonic bacteria. Because it survives intact to the rectum it retains its water there, producing bulky soft stool with far less gas than fermentable fibres. It normalises stool form in both directions, softening hard stool and firming loose stool. The same gel raises the viscosity of small intestinal contents, which slows glucose absorption and traps bile acids; the resulting loss of bile acids drives hepatic synthesis from cholesterol and lowers LDL. In IBS it is the fibre with actual trial support: ispaghula gave a relative risk of IBS not improving of 0.83 (95% CI 0.73 to 0.94), number needed to treat 7 (95% CI 4 to 25), and is the fibre recommended by the ACG guideline (PMID 33315591).车前子壳是卵叶车前(Plantago ovata)碾磨后的种皮,主要成分是高度支化的阿拉伯木聚糖,具有成胶特性,而且不同于大多数黏性纤维,它很少被结肠细菌发酵。由于它能完整到达直肠,水分得以在那里保留,形成蓬松柔软的粪便,产气也远少于可发酵纤维。它能双向调节粪便性状,使干硬粪便变软,使稀软粪便成形。同样的凝胶还会提高小肠内容物的黏度,减慢葡萄糖吸收并结合胆汁酸,由此造成的胆汁酸流失促使肝脏以胆固醇为原料加速合成,从而降低LDL。在肠易激综合征(IBS)中,车前子壳是真正有试验支持的纤维:洋车前子使IBS未改善的相对风险为0.83(95% CI 0.73至0.94),需治疗人数(NNT)为7(95% CI 4至25),是ACG指南推荐使用的纤维(PMID 33315591)。

3-6 mg/kg body mass, about 60 minutes before exercise. For a 70 kg person that is 210-420 mg.按体重 3 至 6 毫克/公斤，运动前约 60 分钟服用。70 公斤的人为 210 至 420 毫克。

To match that from food用食物达到该剂量

An ergogenic 3-6 mg/kg is 210-420 mg for a 70 kg adult, which is two to four mugs of home brewed coffee at 96 mg each; a 200 mg pre-workout dose is about two mugs or three single espresso shots. What food cannot deliver is a known dose. Measured caffeine in caffeinated specialty coffees ranged 58-259 mg per dose, mean 188 mg (SD 36) for a 16 oz cup, and the same beverage bought from the same outlet on six consecutive days ranged 259-564 mg, a 2.2-fold swing in what the customer thought was an identical drink. Decaffeinated versions still contained up to 17.7 mg per dose. Matcha spans 18.9-44.4 mg/g, so one teaspoon is anywhere from 38 to 89 mg. Reaching the dose from drinks is trivial; hitting it within plus or minus 20% is not, which is why trials use capsules.具有运动增益作用的 3-6 mg/kg 对 70 kg 成年人是 210-420 mg，相当于两到四大杯家庭冲煮咖啡（每杯 96 mg）；200 mg 的训练前剂量约为两大杯，或三份单份浓缩咖啡。食物给不出的是一个已知剂量。含咖啡因的精品咖啡实测每份为 58-259 mg，16 oz 一杯的均值为 188 mg（SD 36）；同一家门店连续六天买同一款饮品，实测范围 259-564 mg，顾客以为一模一样的饮料相差 2.2 倍。脱咖啡因版本每份仍含最多 17.7 mg。抹茶跨度为 18.9-44.4 mg/g，一茶匙从 38 mg 到 89 mg 都有可能。靠饮品达到剂量很容易；把误差控制在正负 20% 以内很难，这就是试验采用胶囊的原因。

Does the body make it身体是否自产

Humans have no caffeine biosynthetic pathway: there is no caffeine synthase and no route from purine nucleotides to caffeine in any animal, so every milligram in your blood was eaten or drunk, and the human enzymology is purely disposal, dominated by hepatic CYP1A2. Note what NONE does and does not imply here, since caffeine is a drug and not a nutrient, so there is no deficiency to correct and no redundancy to worry about. This axis neither supports nor undermines it, and the decision rests entirely on pharmacology and dose.人体没有 caffeine 的生物合成通路: 没有 caffeine synthase, 任何动物体内也没有从嘌呤核苷酸到 caffeine 的路线, 所以血里的每一毫克都是吃进或喝进去的, 人体相关酶学纯属处置, 由肝内 CYP1A2 主导。要注意 NONE 在这里的含义: caffeine 属于药物, 不算营养素, 没有可纠正的缺乏, 也不存在与自身合成重复的问题。这条轴对它既不支持也不反驳, 判断完全落在药理学和剂量上。

What it does它有什么作用

Caffeine is an adenosine receptor antagonist, principally at A1 and A2A receptors. Blocking A1 lifts the inhibitory brake that accumulating adenosine places on arousal circuits, and blocking striatal A2A disinhibits dopaminergic signalling, which produces the alertness and the reduced perception of effort. It is a plant alkaloid and a xenobiotic. No human enzyme, receptor or pathway requires it, and there is no intake below which anything fails. Caffeine withdrawal is not a deficiency state: habitual intake upregulates adenosine receptors, so abrupt cessation unmasks adenosine signalling and produces headache, fatigue and low mood for roughly 2 to 9 days, with headache in about half of regular users. That is physical dependence on a drug, and it resolves completely without resuming the drug.咖啡因是一种腺苷受体拮抗剂,主要作用于A1和A2A受体。阻断A1受体可解除堆积的腺苷对唤醒回路施加的抑制性刹车,而阻断纹状体A2A受体可解除对多巴胺能信号的抑制,由此产生清醒感并降低对用力程度的主观感受。它是一种植物生物碱,也是一种外源化学物。没有任何人体酶、受体或通路需要它,也不存在低于某摄入量就会出现功能失常的情况。咖啡因戒断并非缺乏状态:长期摄入会上调腺苷受体,因此突然停用会使腺苷信号失去掩盖,产生头痛、疲劳和情绪低落,持续约2至9天,约半数常规饮用者会出现头痛。这属于对一种药物的生理依赖,一旦发生便会完全消退,无需恢复用药。

To match that from food用食物达到该剂量

Two doses with two different answers. The physiological dose (EFSA AI 250 mg/day, evidence range 250-500 mg/day) is easily eaten: one 143 g herring fillet a week averages 410 mg/day, one 130 g farmed salmon portion 399 mg/day, one wild salmon portion 342 mg/day. Two mackerel fillets, two 92 g tins of sardines or two 45 g tins of anchovies a week give 258-302 mg/day. In portion terms 250-500 mg/day is 0.6-1.3 salmon portions, 0.6-1.2 herring fillets, 1.7-3.3 mackerel fillets, 1.9-3.9 tins of sardines, 1.9-3.8 tins of anchovies, 2.8-5.6 trout fillets, or 1.2-2.4 USDA 172 g cans of albacore per week. Tinned light tuna is the weakest realistic route at 370 mg per 165 g can, which is 5 cans a week for 250 mg/day and 9 cans a week for 500 mg/day. The pharmacological dose of 4 g/day used in trials and in prescription products (AHA Science Advisory, Circulation 2019, DOI 10.1161/CIR.0000000000000709; REDUCE-IT used 4 g icosapent ethyl) cannot be eaten. It requires 199 g/day of herring (1.4 kg/week), 186 g/day of farmed salmon on 2006-era composition or 294 g/day on 2015 composition (1.3-2.1 kg/week), 288 g/day of pickled herring, 333 g/day of mackerel (3.8 fillets a day), 407 g/day of sardines (4.4 tins a day), 195 g/day of anchovies (4.3 tins a day, with the sodium load that implies), 61 g/day of caviar (about four tablespoons a day), or 464 g/day of tinned albacore. Above roughly 1 g/day of EPA+DHA, supplements are the only realistic route.两种剂量，两个不同的答案。生理剂量（EFSA AI 250 mg/day，证据区间 250-500 mg/day）很容易靠吃达到：每周一片 143 g 鲱鱼柳平均折合 410 mg/day，每周一份 130 g 养殖三文鱼 399 mg/day，一份野生三文鱼 342 mg/day。每周两片鲭鱼柳、两罐 92 g 沙丁鱼或两罐 45 g 凤尾鱼可提供 258-302 mg/day。换算成份数，250-500 mg/day 相当于每周 0.6-1.3 份三文鱼、0.6-1.2 片鲱鱼柳、1.7-3.3 片鲭鱼柳、1.9-3.9 罐沙丁鱼、1.9-3.8 罐凤尾鱼、2.8-5.6 片鳟鱼柳，或 1.2-2.4 罐 USDA 172 g 装长鳍金枪鱼。罐装淡肉金枪鱼是现实可行路径中最弱的一条，每 165 g 罐仅 370 mg，要达到 250 mg/day 需每周 5 罐，500 mg/day 需每周 9 罐。试验和处方产品所用的 4 g/day 药理剂量（AHA Science Advisory, Circulation 2019, DOI 10.1161/CIR.0000000000000709；REDUCE-IT 使用 4 g icosapent ethyl，即二十碳五烯酸乙酯）无法靠吃达到。它需要每天 199 g 鲱鱼（每周 1.4 kg），按 2006 年成分计每天 186 g 养殖三文鱼、按 2015 年成分计每天 294 g（每周 1.3-2.1 kg），每天 288 g 醋渍鲱鱼，每天 333 g 鲭鱼（每天 3.8 片鱼柳），每天 407 g 沙丁鱼（每天 4.4 罐），每天 195 g 凤尾鱼（每天 4.3 罐，随之而来的还有相应的钠负荷），每天 61 g 鱼子酱（约每天四汤匙），或每天 464 g 罐装长鳍金枪鱼。EPA+DHA 超过大约 1 g/day 之后，补充剂是唯一现实的途径。

Does the body make it身体是否自产

Humans can make EPA and DHA, yet only by remodelling a fatty acid they cannot make at all, the plant-derived precursor ALA, and the final steps are the bottleneck. In stable-isotope tracer work the fraction of ingested ALA reaching EPA is 21% in young women, while DHA reaches 9% in young women and stays undetectable in young men for 21 days after dosing, and FADS1 and FADS2 genotype is the largest single modifier between individuals. Because the pathway cannot be driven harder, tissue DHA tracks intake of preformed DHA and barely responds to ALA, so preformed EPA and DHA is one of the few supplements the endogenous route genuinely cannot make redundant.人体能合成 EPA 和 DHA，但只能通过改造一种自己完全无法合成的脂肪酸，即来自植物的前体 ALA，而最后几步是瓶颈。稳定同位素示踪研究显示，摄入的 ALA 转化到 EPA 的比例在年轻女性中为 21%，到 DHA 在年轻女性中为 9%，在年轻男性中给药后 21 天内始终检测不到，而 FADS1 和 FADS2 基因型是个体间转化效率最大的单一修饰因素。由于这条通路无法被推得更快，组织 DHA 跟随现成 DHA 的摄入变化，对 ALA 几乎没有反应，所以现成的 EPA 和 DHA 属于少数几种内源途径确实无法使之变得多余的补充剂。

What it does它有什么作用

EPA (20:5n-3) and DHA (22:6n-3) are the long-chain products of omega-3 metabolism. DHA is the dominant structural fatty acid of retinal photoreceptor outer segments and neuronal synaptic membranes, where it sets membrane fluidity and supports the function of embedded proteins such as rhodopsin. EPA is the substrate for series-3 prostaglandins and series-5 leukotrienes, and both are precursors of the resolvins and protectins that actively terminate inflammation. Because the body can make them from alpha-linolenic acid, they are classed as conditionally essential rather than strictly essential; the conversion is inefficient enough that tissue levels track intake of preformed EPA and DHA closely.EPA(20:5n-3)和DHA(22:6n-3)是omega-3代谢的长链产物。DHA是视网膜光感受器外节和神经元突触膜的主要结构脂肪酸,决定膜的流动性,并支持视紫红质等嵌膜蛋白的功能。EPA是3系前列腺素和5系白三烯的底物,两者都是消退素和保护素的前体,这些物质能主动终止炎症。由于人体可以由α-亚麻酸合成EPA和DHA,它们被归为条件必需脂肪酸而非严格必需脂肪酸,但转化效率低,以至于组织中的水平仍紧密跟随预成EPA和DHA的摄入量。

If you lack it缺乏会怎样

There is no severe clinical syndrome attributable to low EPA and DHA alone in an adult who is otherwise fed. Frank neurological deficiency signs belong to total omega-3 deprivation, which is an ALA problem (see that entry). The clearest documented consequence of low long-chain omega-3 supply is developmental: preterm infants cut off from third-trimester placental DHA transfer accrete far less retinal and brain DHA, with fetal accretion roughly doubling in the last five weeks of gestation.对于饮食其他方面正常的成年人,单纯EPA和DHA偏低不会引起严重临床综合征。明显的神经系统缺乏体征属于omega-3完全缺乏的情形,那是ALA的问题(见该词条)。长链omega-3供应不足最明确记录的后果与发育有关:早产儿因失去妊娠晚期胎盘DHA转运而在视网膜和脑内蓄积的DHA大幅减少,胎儿DHA蓄积速度在妊娠最后五周约翻倍。

Does it reverse补回来能修复吗

In adults repletion is complete. Red cell EPA and DHA rise over roughly three to four months, approximately the erythrocyte lifespan, and normalise fully with sustained intake. The partial designation covers the perinatal window only: in rhesus monkeys deprived of n-3 before birth, brain phospholipids had normalised by three years but retinal DHA reached only 84% of controls. Behavioural visual acuity thresholds were normal at 4, 8 and 12 weeks, but cone and rod ERG a-wave amplitudes stayed persistently reduced, so the residue after prenatal deprivation is functional as well as biochemical, and the study answers its own title question in the negative (Anderson GJ et al., Pediatr Res. 2005;58:865-72).成年人补充后可完全恢复。红细胞EPA和DHA在大约三到四个月内(约相当于红细胞寿命)上升,持续摄入后可完全恢复正常。部分可逆的判定仅针对围产期这一窗口:在出生前被剥夺n-3的恒河猴中,脑磷脂在三岁时已恢复正常,但视网膜DHA仅达到对照组的84%。行为学视敏度阈值在4周、8周和12周时均正常,但视锥和视杆细胞ERG a波振幅持续偏低,因此产前剥夺后留下的残余损害既是功能性的也是生化性的,该研究对自己标题所提的问题给出了否定的答案(Anderson GJ等,Pediatr Res. 2005;58:865-72)。

People with documented low magnesium, chronic proton pump inhibitor or diuretic users, alcohol use disorder, and treated hypertensives.已证实镁偏低者、长期使用质子泵抑制剂或利尿剂者、酒精使用障碍者、已在服药的高血压患者。

365 mg/d elemental for blood pressure. Note magnesium oxide is 60% elemental, citrate 16%, bisglycinate 14%.降血压用元素镁 365 毫克/天。注意氧化镁含 60% 元素镁，柠檬酸镁 16%，甘氨酸螯合镁 14%。

To match that from food用食物达到该剂量

Supplements are sold at 200 to 400 mg elemental magnesium, which is the whole daily requirement, and ordinary food covers that range easily. A worked day: 1 oz pumpkin seeds (156 mg) plus 1 cup cooked black beans (120 mg) plus 1 oz 70-85% dark chocolate (65 mg) is 341 mg before anything else on the plate is counted. Single-food routes are absurd by comparison: 400 mg from dark chocolate alone means 175 g of bar, roughly 1,000 kcal, and 400 mg from wholemeal bread alone means 533 g, about 17 slices. Nobody needs a single-food route, because the mixed-diet route is three normal portions. The safety asymmetry matters more than the arithmetic: the Institute of Medicine set the 350 mg/day upper limit for supplemental magnesium only, and it explicitly excludes magnesium naturally present in food and water, so 700 mg of magnesium from seeds and beans carries no upper limit while 400 mg from tablets is already over the supplemental ceiling. A comparable 250 mg/day EU limit for magnesium added through supplements or fortified foods is normally attributed to the SCF 2001 opinion; the source text could not be retrieved during verification, so that figure is carried here as indicative and unconfirmed.补充剂的售卖规格是 200 至 400 mg 元素镁，也就是一整天的需要量，而普通食物很容易覆盖这个区间。一天的实际算法：1 oz 南瓜籽（156 mg）加 1 杯熟黑豆（120 mg）加 1 oz 70-85% 黑巧克力（65 mg），在盘子里其他东西都还没算进来时就已经是 341 mg。相比之下，单一食物路线荒唐得多：只靠黑巧克力吃到 400 mg 意味着 175 g 巧克力，大约 1,000 kcal；只靠全麦面包吃到 400 mg 意味着 533 g，约 17 片。没有人需要单一食物路线，混合膳食路线只是三份正常分量。算术之外，安全性上的不对称影响更大：Institute of Medicine 设定的 350 mg/天 上限只针对补充剂形式的镁，并明确排除食物和水中天然存在的镁，因此来自种子和豆类的 700 mg 镁不受上限约束，而来自片剂的 400 mg 已经超过补充剂的上限。欧盟对通过补充剂或强化食品添加的镁设有相当的 250 mg/天 限值，通常归于 SCF 2001 意见书；核查期间无法获取原文，因此该数字在此仅作参考，未经确认。

Does the body make it身体是否自产

Magnesium is chemical element 12 and cannot be synthesised, so all of the roughly 25 g in an adult body came from food. Bone holds 50 to 60% of it and the kidney adjusts reabsorption tightly, which buffers short-term intake gaps and is also why serum magnesium is a poor guide to total body stores. With synthesis at zero, the only question is whether habitual intake, drug use or renal and gastrointestinal losses justify supplementing, and for a large share of the population intake alone does.镁是12号化学元素，无法合成，成人体内约 25 g 镁全部来自食物。骨骼中占其 50 至 60%，肾脏对重吸收有紧密调节，这既缓冲了短期摄入缺口，也是血清镁不能代表全身储量的原因。合成为零，剩下的问题只有：习惯摄入量、用药、肾脏和胃肠道损失是否构成补充的理由。对相当大一部分人群来说，仅摄入量这一条就已经构成理由。

What it does它有什么作用

The biologically active form of ATP is Mg-ATP, so magnesium is an obligate participant in every kinase reaction, every ATPase and both DNA and RNA polymerases, more than 300 enzymes in total. It acts as a physiological calcium antagonist: it blocks the NMDA receptor channel at rest and dampens calcium entry in vascular smooth muscle and myocardium, which is why depletion raises neuromuscular excitability and arrhythmia risk. Magnesium is also required both for parathyroid hormone secretion and for end-organ response to it, so depletion produces a hypocalcaemia that will not correct until magnesium is replaced. About 60% of body magnesium is locked in bone and most of the rest is intracellular, leaving only about 1% in serum. Serum magnesium is therefore a poor guide to total body status and can be normal in a genuinely depleted person.ATP的生物活性形式是Mg-ATP,因此镁是每一个激酶反应、每一种ATP酶以及DNA和RNA聚合酶不可或缺的参与者,涉及的酶总数超过300种。镁还是一种生理性钙拮抗剂:静息状态下它阻断NMDA受体通道,并减弱血管平滑肌和心肌中的钙内流,这就是镁耗竭会提高神经肌肉兴奋性和心律失常风险的原因。甲状旁腺激素的分泌及靶器官对其的反应也都需要镁,因此镁耗竭会导致低钙血症,且在补镁之前无法纠正。人体内约60%的镁封存在骨骼中,其余大部分位于细胞内,血清中仅占约1%。因此血清镁并不能很好地反映体内总镁状态,即使在真正镁耗竭的人身上也可能正常。

If you lack it缺乏会怎样

Tetany with positive Chvostek and Trousseau signs, paraesthesiae, seizures, and cardiac arrhythmias including atrial fibrillation and torsades de pointes. Accompanying hypokalaemia and hypocalcaemia resist correction until magnesium itself is replaced, which is the clinically important teaching point. Severe cases are almost always driven by drug or gastrointestinal or renal losses rather than by diet alone.手足搐搦,Chvostek征和Trousseau征阳性,感觉异常,癫痫发作,以及心律失常,包括心房颤动和尖端扭转型室速。伴随的低钾血症和低钙血症在补镁之前均难以纠正,这是临床上的重要教学要点。严重病例几乎总是由药物或消化道、肾脏丢失所致,而非单纯饮食因素。

Does it reverse补回来能修复吗

Repletion corrects the neuromuscular and cardiac features and allows the linked potassium and calcium abnormalities to correct, with no residual deficit once the underlying cause is addressed. The one caveat is timing rather than permanence: serum magnesium normalises before body stores do, so bone and intracellular pools take days to weeks to refill and stopping too early lets the deficit return.补镁可纠正神经肌肉和心脏方面的表现,并使相关的钾、钙异常随之纠正,一旦基础病因得到处理就不会遗留缺陷。这里需要注意的只是恢复所需的时间:血清镁的恢复正常早于体内总储备的恢复,骨骼和细胞内的镁池需要数天至数周才能补足,过早停止补充会导致缺乏复发。

The lozenge dose fails on arithmetic and then fails again on route. Arithmetically, hitting the 80 mg/day of elemental zinc used in the trials (PMID 28515951) every day for the duration of a cold takes 204 g of raw oyster meat, roughly 14 to 15 medium oysters; or 102 g of cooked oysters; or 88 g of canned oysters, about 11 of them; or 479 g of toasted wheat-germ cereal; or 989 g of braised lean beef chuck; or 1.10 kg of braised lamb shoulder; or 1.05 kg of pumpkin seed kernels; or 5.23 kg of boiled chickpeas; or 6.30 kg of boiled lentils. Only oysters make it look even arithmetically plausible, and 14 raw oysters a day for a week is a Vibrio and norovirus decision rather than a nutrition one. Closing the arithmetic would still not reproduce the product, because the lozenge trials work through free Zn2+ released in the oropharynx and held against the mucosa, and swallowed zinc from food or from a capsule bypasses that route entirely. Zinc is chemical element 30 and cannot be synthesised, so the many enzymes and transcription factors that depend on it require a continuous dietary supply, and there is no rapidly mobilisable store analogous to ferritin. Lozenges are a special case: they release ionic zinc into the mouth and throat for a local effect during a cold, so they act as a short-course topical drug and do not correct a systemic shortfall. With synthesis at zero zinc is never redundant on this axis, while long-term use at lozenge doses antagonises copper absorption and is harmful in its own right.锌是30号化学元素，无法合成，依赖它的众多酶和转录因子需要膳食持续供应，体内也没有类似铁蛋白那样可快速动员的专用储库。锭剂是特殊情形：它把离子锌释放到口腔和咽部，在感冒期间发挥局部作用，属于短程局部用药，并不纠正全身性不足。既然合成为零，在这一维度上锌永远不算多余，但按锭剂剂量长期服用会拮抗铜的吸收，本身就造成伤害。

What it does它有什么作用

Zinc is a structural or catalytic component of more than 300 enzymes and of the roughly 2,000 zinc-finger transcription factors that bind DNA, so it is required for gene expression, DNA and RNA synthesis, and cell division. Tissues with fast turnover fail first: gut mucosa, skin, growth plate cartilage, and lymphocytes. Thymic function and T-cell development are zinc-dependent, which is the basis of the immune effects. The lozenge specifically is a different proposition from nutrition: it works (where it works) by releasing ionic zinc onto the oropharyngeal mucosa, where it appears to interfere with rhinovirus replication and ICAM-1 binding locally. That is a short-course pharmacological use in someone whose zinc status is usually normal. Lozenges are a poor way to correct systemic deficiency. On the toxicity side, sustained intake above the 40 mg/day tolerable upper limit induces intestinal metallothionein and progressively impairs copper status; the upper limit itself rests on a marginal fall in erythrocyte superoxide dismutase at around 60 mg/day, a biochemical rather than a clinical endpoint. Frank copper-deficiency anaemia and myeloneuropathy are reported at prolonged intakes several times higher, in the region of 100 to 300 mg/day, typically from high-dose supplements or zinc-containing denture cream.锌是300多种酶的结构或催化成分,也是约2,000种结合DNA的锌指(zinc finger)转录因子的组成部分,因此是基因表达、DNA和RNA合成以及细胞分裂所必需的。更新速度快的组织最先受累:肠黏膜、皮肤、生长板软骨和淋巴细胞。胸腺功能和T细胞发育依赖锌,这是其免疫作用的基础。锌含片本身是与营养补充不同的用法:它(在起效时)通过向口咽黏膜释放离子锌发挥作用,在局部似乎能干扰鼻病毒(rhinovirus)复制及其与ICAM-1的结合。这是一种针对锌状态通常正常者的短程药理学用法。含片并不是纠正全身性缺锌的良好方式。在毒性方面,长期摄入超过每日40毫克的可耐受最高摄入量会诱导肠道金属硫蛋白(metallothionein)生成,并逐渐损害铜的状态;这一上限本身依据的是每日约60毫克摄入时红细胞超氧化物歧化酶(superoxide dismutase)出现的轻微下降,这是一个生化终点,不是临床终点。明显的铜缺乏性贫血和脊髓神经病变见于长期摄入量高出数倍、约每日100至300毫克的情况,通常来自高剂量补充剂或含锌义齿粘合剂。

Melatonin is synthesised from serotonin in the pineal gland on a schedule set by the suprachiasmatic nucleus, rising roughly two hours before habitual sleep onset and clearing by morning. It acts through MT1 and MT2 receptors on the clock itself, so it works as a timing signal rather than a sedative, which is why small evening doses shift sleep phase more reliably than large doses deepen sleep. There is no dietary requirement at all: the body makes every molecule it uses. The synthesis axis does not fit here at all, because these are living organisms and not molecules, which is why the label is NA: forcing NONE would make a live organism look like a plant alkaloid on a screening table. Human cells cannot manufacture a bacterium, and the resident microbiome is acquired at birth and from the environment and then renews itself, so nobody is deficient in a strain the way someone is deficient in a vitamin. The honest test for a probiotic is strain-level trial evidence for a named indication, since effects do not transfer between strains, let alone between species.合成这条轴在这里完全不适用, 因为对象是活体生物, 不是分子, 所以标签用 NA: 硬套 NONE 会让活菌在筛查表上看起来像一种植物生物碱。人细胞无法制造细菌, 常驻菌群在出生时和从环境中获得, 之后自我更新, 所以没人会像缺某种维生素那样缺某一个菌株。对益生菌诚实的检验标准是针对具体适应症的菌株级试验证据, 因为效应在菌株之间不能移植, 跨物种更不行。

What it does它有什么作用

The accepted definition is live micro-organisms which, when administered in adequate amounts, confer a health benefit on the host, and the operative unit of evidence is the strain, written as genus, species and an alphanumeric designator (for example Lacticaseibacillus rhamnosus GG or Saccharomyces boulardii CNCM I-745). Strain-level genetics determine adhesion proteins, bacteriocin production, bile salt hydrolase activity and short-chain fatty acid output, so a trial result for one strain carries no information about a different strain of the same species. Most administered strains transit the gut without colonising, and the effect ceases when dosing stops. This is a therapeutic product class, not a nutrient class, so there is nothing a person can be short of.公认的定义是:以足够数量给予时能为宿主带来健康益处的活微生物,而证据的实际单位是菌株,写法为属名、种名加字母数字编号(例如鼠李糖乳酪杆菌Lacticaseibacillus rhamnosus GG,或布拉迪酵母菌Saccharomyces boulardii CNCM I-745)。菌株层面的遗传差异决定了黏附蛋白、细菌素(bacteriocin)产生、胆盐水解酶(bile salt hydrolase)活性和短链脂肪酸产量,因此某一菌株的试验结果对同一菌种的另一菌株没有任何提示意义。大多数给药菌株只是经过肠道而不定植,给药停止后作用也随之消失。这是一个治疗性产品类别,而不是营养素类别,因此不存在人可能短缺的东西。

Berberine is a protoberberine isoquinoline alkaloid made by plants such as Coptis chinensis, Berberis species and Hydrastis canadensis. The endogenous axis can neither argue for nor against taking it, and the judgement falls to trial data, poor oral bioavailability and interaction burden.小檗碱是原小檗碱型异喹啉生物碱, 由 Coptis chinensis, Berberis 属和 Hydrastis canadensis 等植物合成。人细胞确实能生成上游的苄基异喹啉: 在人 SH-SY5Y 神经母细胞瘤细胞和 DAN-G 胰腺癌细胞中鉴定出 norlaudanosoline, 1(S)-reticuline 和吗啡, 并用标记前体喂养证明它们来自生物合成 (PMID 15383669), 但人缺 berberine bridge enzyme 以及 reticuline 之后的原小檗碱步骤, 所以血中每一毫克小檗碱都来自植物或工厂。因此内源合成这条轴既不能反对也不能支持它, 判断依据是试验数据, 很差的口服生物利用度和药物相互作用负担。

What it does它有什么作用

Berberine is an isoquinoline alkaloid extracted from Berberis, Coptis and Hydrastis species. Its metabolic effects are usually attributed to activation of AMP-activated protein kinase, and the upstream trigger appears to be mild inhibition of mitochondrial complex I that raises the cellular AMP to ATP ratio (Turner et al., Diabetes 2008;57:1414-1418), giving it a mechanistic family resemblance to metformin. AMPK is not the whole account: Xu et al. confirmed the complex I effect but concluded that berberine promotes glucose consumption independently of AMPK activation. Downstream it suppresses hepatic gluconeogenesis, and it upregulates hepatic LDL receptor expression through ERK-dependent stabilisation of LDL receptor mRNA rather than through AMPK (Kong et al., Nat Med 2004;10:1344-1351). Oral absorption is very poor, with absolute bioavailability under 1% in rats, so a substantial share of any effect is probably exerted in the gut lumen and on the microbiota. It is a xenobiotic: no human tissue synthesises it and no physiological process depends on its presence.小檗碱是从小檗属(Berberis)、黄连属(Coptis)和金印草属(Hydrastis)植物中提取的异喹啉类生物碱。其代谢作用通常归因于AMP活化蛋白激酶(AMPK)的激活,而上游触发机制似乎是对线粒体复合体I的轻度抑制,从而升高细胞内AMP与ATP的比值(Turner等,Diabetes 2008;57:1414-1418),这使其在机制上与二甲双胍有某种家族相似性。但AMPK并非全部机制:Xu等人证实了复合体I的这一效应,但得出的结论是小檗碱促进葡萄糖消耗的作用独立于AMPK激活。在下游,它抑制肝脏糖异生,并通过ERK依赖性的LDL受体mRNA稳定作用上调肝脏LDL受体表达,这一途径与AMPK无关(Kong等,Nat Med 2004;10:1344-1351)。口服吸收很差,在大鼠中绝对生物利用度低于1%,因此其作用很可能有相当一部分是在肠腔内及对肠道菌群发挥的。它是一种外源性化合物:人体组织不合成它,任何生理过程也不依赖它的存在。

What it does它有什么作用

Ascorbate is the reducing cofactor that keeps the iron atom in a family of dioxygenases in its active state. The best known are prolyl-4-hydroxylase and lysyl hydroxylase, which hydroxylate collagen so the triple helix is stable and can be cross-linked; without them the collagen laid down is defective, which explains bleeding, poor wound healing and the reopening of old scars. The same chemistry serves dopamine beta-hydroxylase (noradrenaline synthesis), peptidylglycine alpha-amidating monooxygenase (peptide hormone amidation), two carnitine biosynthesis enzymes, and the HIF prolyl hydroxylases and TET and JmjC demethylases in gene regulation. Ascorbate also reduces dietary non-haem iron to the absorbable ferrous form. Does the body make it身体是否自产

Diet supplies only 3 to 5 mg a day, a small contribution next to the tissue pools that endogenous synthesis maintains, so a healthy person is not short of CoQ10 and this is the clearest case in the group of a supplement filling a gap that does not exist. The statin link is real at the level of plasma measurement, where CoQ10 falls by about 0.44 micromol/L on treatment, and its interpretation is limited because plasma CoQ10 is carried on LDL, so part of the fall simply tracks the lipoprotein concentration and tissue or muscle depletion has not been demonstrated; on the endogenous axis nothing here exposes a dietary deficiency to correct.人体每个细胞都通过 mevalonate 通路合成泛醌, 由 PDSS1/PDSS2 制造癸异戊烯基尾链, 经 COQ2 接到 4-hydroxybenzoate 环上, 再由 COQ3 至 COQ9 一系列酶完成分子并还原为泛醇。膳食每天只提供 3 到 5 mg, 相对于内源合成维持的组织池只是很小的一部分, 因此健康人并不缺 CoQ10, 在这一组条目中它最清楚地展示了一种补充剂在填补并不存在的缺口。他汀的关联在血浆测量层面确实存在, 治疗后 CoQ10 下降约 0.44 micromol/L, 但解读受限: 血浆 CoQ10 由 LDL 携带, 下降的一部分只是跟随载脂蛋白浓度, 组织或肌肉 CoQ10 耗竭尚未被证明; 就内源性这条轴而言, 这里没有暴露出任何需要纠正的膳食缺乏。

What it does它有什么作用

Coenzyme Q10 is a lipid-soluble benzoquinone with a ten-unit isoprenoid tail. In the inner mitochondrial membrane it shuttles electrons from complexes I and II to complex III, and it is also the electron acceptor for dihydroorotate dehydrogenase in pyrimidine synthesis and for fatty acid beta-oxidation through ETF-QO. Its reduced form, ubiquinol, is the main lipid-phase antioxidant of membranes and regenerates vitamin E. Humans synthesize it through the mevalonate pathway, the same pathway statins inhibit, and food contributes only a few milligrams a day. It is not a vitamin, there is no dietary requirement, and no dietary CoQ10 deficiency state exists. What does exist is primary coenzyme Q10 deficiency (COQ10D1 to COQ10D10), an autosomal recessive inborn error of CoQ10 biosynthesis caused by variants in PDSS1, PDSS2, COQ2, COQ4, COQ5, COQ6, COQ7, COQ8A, COQ8B or COQ9. That is a genetic disorder of synthesis, not a consequence of low dietary intake, and it is ultra-rare: GeneReviews notes that prevalence data are limited by the small number of affected individuals reported, ranging from 2 to just over 10 families per causative gene. Presentation spans the neonatal period to the seventh decade: steroid-resistant nephrotic syndrome with proteinuria, cerebellar ataxia, exercise intolerance and muscle weakness, or encephalopathy with seizures, and diagnosis rests on CoQ10 measurement in muscle or fibroblasts plus genetic testing. Severe neonatal-onset forms cause fatal multisystem disease with encephalopathy, hypertrophic cardiomyopathy and renal failure, while later-onset forms progress to cerebellar atrophy with disabling ataxia or to end-stage kidney disease. High-dose oral CoQ10 can block progression of the kidney disease and improve some myopathic and encephalopathic features, and works best when started before damage is established; established severe neurological or renal damage does not reverse, and neonatal-onset disease responds poorly, partly because CoQ10 penetrates the blood-brain barrier badly. Separately and far more commonly, statins lower circulating CoQ10. Marcoff and Thompson's narrative systematic review of 9 observational studies and 6 randomised trials reports reductions of 16 to 54 percent, with the largest single trial (n=1,049) finding 38 percent with atorvastatin and 27 percent with lovastatin; pooled meta-analysis puts the effect at a weighted mean difference of -0.44 micromol/L (95% CI -0.52 to -0.37). That is a change in a blood concentration, not the disease described above, and trials of CoQ10 for statin-associated muscle symptoms have given conflicting results.辅酶Q10是一种脂溶性苯醌,带有由十个异戊二烯单位组成的侧链。在线粒体内膜中,它将电子从复合体I和复合体II传递到复合体III,同时也是嘧啶合成中二氢乳清酸脱氢酶以及经ETF-QO途径进行脂肪酸β氧化时的电子受体。其还原型泛醇是细胞膜上主要的脂相抗氧化物质,并能再生维生素E。人体通过甲羟戊酸途径合成辅酶Q10,他汀类药物抑制的正是这一途径,食物每天仅贡献几毫克。它不是维生素,没有膳食摄入需求,也不存在膳食性辅酶Q10缺乏状态。真正存在的是原发性辅酶Q10缺乏症(COQ10D1至COQ10D10),这是一种由PDSS1、PDSS2、COQ2、COQ4、COQ5、COQ6、COQ7、COQ8A、COQ8B或COQ9基因变异引起的、辅酶Q10生物合成缺陷的常染色体隐性遗传病。这是一种合成通路的基因病,而非膳食摄入不足的后果,且极为罕见:GeneReviews指出,由于报告的患者数量很少,患病率数据有限,每个致病基因对应的家系报告数在2至略超10个之间。发病可见于新生儿期至70岁,表现为伴蛋白尿的激素抵抗型肾病综合征、小脑共济失调、运动不耐受和肌无力,或伴癫痫发作的脑病,诊断依赖肌肉或成纤维细胞中辅酶Q10测定加基因检测。重度新生儿起病型可导致致死性多系统疾病,伴脑病、肥厚型心肌病和肾衰竭,而较晚起病型则进展为小脑萎缩伴致残性共济失调,或进展为终末期肾病。大剂量口服辅酶Q10可阻止肾脏疾病进展,并改善部分肌病和脑病表现,在损伤尚未确立前开始治疗效果最佳;而一旦出现严重的神经系统或肾脏损伤则无法逆转,新生儿起病型的反应也较差,部分原因是辅酶Q10难以穿透血脑屏障。与此完全不同、也更为常见的是,他汀类药物会降低循环辅酶Q10水平。Marcoff和Thompson对9项观察性研究和6项随机试验的叙述性系统综述报告降幅为16%至54%,其中单项最大规模试验(n=1,049)发现阿托伐他汀降幅为38%,洛伐他汀为27%;汇总meta分析得出的加权均数差为-0.44微摩尔/升(95%置信区间-0.52至-0.37)。这是一种血液浓度的变化,而非上文所述的疾病,且辅酶Q10用于治疗他汀相关肌肉症状的试验结果并不一致。

Who it is for适用人群

People with symptomatic diabetic distal symmetric polyneuropathy, specifically positive sensory symptoms such as burning and paraesthesia.有症状的糖尿病远端对称性多发性神经病患者，特别是有烧灼感、感觉异常等阳性感觉症状者。

Dose tested已验证剂量

600 mg/d orally. The strong evidence is for the intravenous route at the same dose, which consumers cannot access.口服 600 毫克/天。强证据来自同剂量的静脉给药，而消费者无法使用这一途径。

To match that from food用食物达到该剂量

Using the confirmed plant figures, a 600 mg dose is about 2,143 kg of raw spinach a day, roughly 71,000 cups, and broccoli is similar. Using the richest meat value (turkey heart at 0.40 mg/100 g) it is 150 kg of heart a day, though that meat figure is itself unconfirmed. The arithmetic understates the problem. What food contains is lipoyllysine, lipoic acid amide-bonded to protein-bound lysine, and human lipoamidase activity releases very little free lipoic acid from that bond, so the free-ALA yield from eating spinach is close to unmeasurable rather than merely small. A 600 mg fasting capsule produces micromolar plasma peaks of free racemic lipoic acid; no quantity of food produces a detectable free-ALA peak at all. This is the clearest food-supplement discontinuity in the group.按已确认的植物数值，600 mg 剂量约合每天 2,143 kg 生菠菜，大约 71,000 杯，西兰花的量级相仿。按最富的肉类值（火鸡心 0.40 mg/100 g）是每天 150 kg 心脏，而这个肉类数值本身未经确认。这些算术还低估了问题。食物里含的是硫辛酰赖氨酸，硫辛酸以酰胺键连在蛋白结合的赖氨酸上，人体硫辛酰胺酶从这种键上释放出的游离硫辛酸极少，所以吃菠菜得到的游离 ALA 接近无法测出。600 mg 空腹胶囊能产生微摩尔级的游离消旋硫辛酸血药峰值；任何数量的食物都产生不出可检测的游离 ALA 峰。这是本组中食物与补剂断裂得最彻底的一条。

Does the body make it身体是否自产

Human mitochondria make lipoic acid de novo: an octanoyl chain from the mitochondrial fatty acid synthase route is transferred onto a lysine residue of the target protein, and lipoyl synthase (LIAS) then inserts two sulfur atoms while the chain is already attached. The functional cofactor pool is protein-bound R-lipoyllysine on pyruvate dehydrogenase, alpha-ketoglutarate dehydrogenase, BCKDH and the glycine cleavage H protein, and free lipoate is not a physiological cofactor form, although mammalian lipoamidase, the same protein as serum biotinidase, does hydrolyse lipoyl substrates (PMID 8484735, PMID 2225462), an activity present in human serum and milk (PMID 3168970, PMID 2127386). The FULL label applies to the endogenous cofactor and does not carry over to the capsule: swallowed free ALA is never loaded onto the dehydrogenase complexes, so a supplement works as a short-acting redox drug and not as repletion of a cofactor.人体线粒体能从头合成硫辛酸: 来自线粒体脂肪酸合成途径的辛酰基链先被转移到靶蛋白的赖氨酸残基上, 随后 lipoyl synthase (LIAS) 在链已连接的状态下插入两个硫原子。具有功能的辅因子池是结合在 pyruvate dehydrogenase、alpha-ketoglutarate dehydrogenase、BCKDH 和甘氨酸裂解系统 H 蛋白上的蛋白结合型 R-lipoyllysine, 游离硫辛酸并非生理性的辅因子形式; 不过哺乳动物 lipoamidase 与血清 biotinidase 是同一个蛋白, 能水解 lipoyl 底物 (PMID 8484735, PMID 2225462), 该活性存在于人血清和乳汁中 (PMID 3168970, PMID 2127386)。FULL 这个标签针对的是内源辅因子, 它不能套用到胶囊上: 口服的游离 ALA 不会被装载到脱氢酶复合体上, 所以补充剂起的是短效氧化还原药物的作用, 与补足辅因子无关。

What it does它有什么作用

Lipoic acid functions as a covalently bound prosthetic group (lipoamide) on the E2 subunits of pyruvate dehydrogenase, alpha-ketoglutarate dehydrogenase, branched-chain ketoacid dehydrogenase and the glycine cleavage system, where its dithiolane ring carries acyl groups and reducing equivalents. Humans make it de novo inside mitochondria via lipoic acid synthase and attach it enzymatically to apoproteins; free lipoate from food or capsules is never used for this. Rare biallelic LIAS, LIPT1 or LIPT2 variants cause a severe neonatal encephalopathy with lactic acidosis and hyperglycinaemia, and oral lipoic acid does not rescue the lipoylation defect in patients or in patient fibroblasts, which is precisely why that genetic disorder is not a deficiency of the supplement molecule. Supplemental alpha-lipoic acid therefore acts only as a free redox-active compound, unrelated to the cofactor role, and its best evidence is symptomatic relief in diabetic polyneuropathy.硫辛酸作为共价结合的辅基(硫辛酰胺)存在于丙酮酸脱氢酶、α-酮戊二酸脱氢酶、支链酮酸脱氢酶和甘氨酸裂解系统的E2亚基上,其二硫戊环结构负责传递酰基和还原当量。人体通过硫辛酸合成酶在线粒体内从头合成硫辛酸,并以酶促方式将其连接到脱辅基蛋白上;来自食物或胶囊的游离硫辛酸盐从不用于这一过程。罕见的LIAS、LIPT1或LIPT2双等位基因变异会导致伴乳酸酸中毒和高甘氨酸血症的严重新生儿脑病,口服硫辛酸无法在患者体内或患者成纤维细胞中挽救这一硫辛酰化缺陷,这正是该遗传病并非补充剂分子缺乏症的原因所在。因此,补充用α-硫辛酸只能作为一种游离的氧化还原活性化合物发挥作用,与其辅因子角色无关,其最佳证据体现在缓解糖尿病性多发性神经病变的症状方面。

Athletes whose limiting factor is acidosis in the one to four minute window: middle distance, rowing, combat sports, high-repetition lifting.限制因素是 1 至 4 分钟区间酸中毒的运动员：中距离项目、赛艇、格斗类、高次数举重。

4-6 g/d for at least 2-4 weeks, split into doses of about 1.6 g to limit paraesthesia. Total accumulated dose matters more than daily dose.4 至 6 克/天，至少持续 2 至 4 周，分成每次约 1.6 克以减少刺痛感。累积总量比每日剂量更重要。

To match that from food用食物达到该剂量

Carnosine is 39.4% beta-alanine by mass (89.09/226.23) and anserine 37.1% (89.09/240.26). The lowest dose shown to work is 3.2 g/day for 4 weeks, which raised muscle carnosine 42.1%. From commercial broiler breast at 346 mg beta-alanine equivalent per 100 g, counting both dipeptides, that is 923 g of raw chicken breast every day for the whole loading month, roughly 210 g of protein from one food; counting carnosine alone it is 3.15 kg/day. The carnosine-dense native strain at 767 mg/100 g cuts the requirement to 417 g/day, a large but conceivable portion, except that the breed is not what a supermarket sells. Beef takes 3.8 kg of raw steak per day and chicken thigh over 20 kg. No food delivers free beta-alanine at all.肌肽按质量含 39.4% 的 β-丙氨酸（89.09/226.23），鹅肌肽含 37.1%（89.09/240.26）。已证实有效的最低剂量是 3.2 g/天、持续 4 周，可使肌肉肌肽提升 42.1%。以商业肉鸡胸肉每 100 g 含 346 mg β-丙氨酸当量（两种二肽合计）计算，整个装载月里每天要吃 923 g 生鸡胸，单一食物就带来约 210 g 蛋白质；若只计肌肽，则是 3.15 kg/天。肌肽含量高的本土品系为 767 mg/100 g，需求量降到 417 g/天，份量虽大但可以想象，问题是超市并不卖这个品种。牛肉需要每天 3.8 kg 生牛排，鸡腿肉超过 20 kg。没有任何食物提供游离 β-丙氨酸。

Does the body make it身体是否自产

Your liver does make beta-alanine as a by-product of breaking down the pyrimidine uracil (cytosine reaches the same route by deamination to uracil), and GADL1 makes some from aspartate in certain tissues, while the parallel thymine branch runs the same three enzymes and yields 3-aminoisobutyrate, so thymine contributes none. The amounts are small relative to what muscle could use, and beta-alanine availability is what limits muscle carnosine, since carnosine synthase (CARNS1) is not saturated at resting beta-alanine levels and the enzyme capacity is not the bottleneck. So this is a compound the body makes yet never accumulates to a functionally saturated level, which is why 4 to 6 g/day in divided doses raises muscle carnosine and why supplementing is not redundant.肝确实会生成 beta-alanine, 作为嘧啶 uracil 分解的副产物 (cytosine 经脱氨转为 uracil 后进入同一路线), 某些组织中 GADL1 也能由 aspartate 生成一部分; 并行的 thymine 分支用同样三个酶, 产物是 3-aminoisobutyrate, 对 beta-alanine 没有贡献。相对肌肉可用的量这些产量很小, 限制肌肉 carnosine 的是 beta-alanine 的可得量, 因为 carnosine synthase (CARNS1) 在静息 beta-alanine 水平下并未饱和, 酶活力并非瓶颈。所以这是一种身体会做却从不积累到功能饱和水平的物质, 4 到 6 g/day 分次服用能提高肌肉 carnosine, 补充并不多余。

What it does它有什么作用

Beta-alanine is the rate-limiting substrate for carnosine synthase, which joins it to histidine to form carnosine in skeletal muscle. Carnosine acts as an intracellular pH buffer across the physiological range and also chelates metals and scavenges reactive carbonyls. Supplementation raises muscle carnosine by up to 64 percent at 4 weeks and up to 80 percent at 10 weeks, and produces a small performance gain concentrated in efforts of roughly 0.5 to 10 minutes, with no benefit below 30 seconds and only a non-significant moderate effect beyond 10 minutes (Saunders et al. 2017, 40 studies, 1,461 subjects); the ISSN position stand places the most pronounced benefit in open end-point tasks and time trials lasting 1 to 4 minutes. The body forms beta-alanine from uracil degradation in the liver and also obtains it from meat-derived carnosine and anserine. It is a non-essential amino acid with no recommended intake.β-丙氨酸是肌肽合成酶的限速底物,该酶将其与组氨酸结合,在骨骼肌中生成肌肽。肌肽在生理pH范围内作为细胞内酸碱缓冲剂,同时还能螯合金属并清除活性羰基。补充可使肌肉肌肽在4周时提高多达64%,在10周时提高多达80%,并在约0.5至10分钟的运动中带来小幅的成绩提升,30秒以下无效,超过10分钟则仅有不显著的中等效应(Saunders等2017年,40项研究,1,461名受试者);ISSN立场声明将最明显的效益归于持续1至4分钟的开放式终点任务和计时赛。人体经肝脏中尿嘧啶降解生成β-丙氨酸,也从肉类中的肌肽和鹅肌肽获取。它是一种非必需氨基酸,没有推荐摄入量。

Dietary nitrate / beetroot膳食硝酸盐 / 甜菜根Not a nutrient. Gut and mouth bacteria turn it into nitric oxide, which widens blood vessels.并非一种营养素。肠道和口腔中的细菌将其转化为一氧化氮,从而扩张血管。 CCCCFFDDBBXX Consider可以考虑 Rich丰富 Reachable可达到 Partly部分自产 No deficiency state exists不存在缺乏状态 Recreationally active people rather than elite athletes, and separately anyone using it for blood pressure.休闲运动者而非精英运动员，此外还有把它用于降血压的人。
Who it is for适用人群

Recreationally active people rather than elite athletes, and separately anyone using it for blood pressure.休闲运动者而非精英运动员，此外还有把它用于降血压的人。

Dose tested已验证剂量

At least 6 mmol/d (372 mg) of nitrate, taken for more than 3 days, 2-3 hours before exercise. Read the label in mmol, not millilitres.硝酸盐至少 6 mmol/天（372 毫克），连续服用 3 天以上，运动前 2 至 3 小时。看标签要看 mmol，不是毫升。

To match that from food用食物达到该剂量

At 62 mg per mmol a 6 mmol target is 372 mg of nitrate. At EFSA median concentrations that is 78 g of rocket, 132 g of rhubarb, 140 g of amaranth or 175 g of lamb's lettuce, all portions a person would actually eat, or exactly 100 mL of concentrated beetroot shot, since 70 mL measured 4.2 mmol and 140 mL 8.4 mmol. Beetroot root itself takes 338 g, butterhead lettuce 188 g, iceberg 441 g, raw spinach 474 g and celery 537 g. Wylie's dose-response data put the useful target higher than 6 mmol: 4.2 mmol changed no exercise response, 8.4 mmol reduced steady-state oxygen uptake 1.7% and extended time to task failure 14%, and 16.8 mmol gave no further gain. An 8 mmol target is 496 mg of nitrate, which is about 103 g of rocket or 133 mL of concentrate.按每 mmol 折合 62 mg 计算，6 mmol 的目标是 372 mg 硝酸盐。按 EFSA 中位浓度，这相当于 78 g 芝麻菜、132 g 大黄、140 g 苋菜或 175 g 野苣，都是人真的会吃的份量；也正好等于 100 mL 浓缩甜菜根汁，因为实测 70 mL 为 4.2 mmol、140 mL 为 8.4 mmol。甜菜根本身需要 338 g，奶油生菜 188 g，冰山生菜 441 g，生菠菜 474 g，芹菜 537 g。Wylie 的剂量反应数据把有用的目标定在 6 mmol 以上：4.2 mmol 未改变任何运动反应，8.4 mmol 使稳态摄氧量下降 1.7%、力竭时间延长 14%，16.8 mmol 没有带来进一步收益。8 mmol 的目标是 496 mg 硝酸盐，约合 103 g 芝麻菜或 133 mL 浓缩汁。

Does the body make it身体是否自产

Humans do produce nitrate in quantity: about 1 mmol/day appears from the oxidation of NO, roughly 37 percent of the total body nitrate pool against a dietary intake of about 1700 micromol/day, and that output is no inert waste, since it re-enters the enterosalivary circuit, is concentrated in saliva and is reduced back to nitrite and NO by the same route a beetroot dose exploits. Two limits carry the practical conclusion: endogenous appearance cannot be up-regulated on demand, and raising plasma nitrite enough to lower the O2 cost of exercise needs dietary loading well above endogenous turnover. Keep the two routes separate as well, since NO made from arginine by nitric oxide synthase is independent of the dietary nitrate to nitrite to NO route, so on this axis a nitrate dose is not redundant.人体确实以可观的量生成 nitrate: NO 氧化每天产生约 1 mmol, 约占全身 nitrate 池的 37%, 而膳食摄入约 1700 micromol/day; 这部分产物也不是惰性废物, 它重新进入唾液肠循环, 在唾液中被浓缩, 再沿甜菜根剂量所利用的同一路线还原为 nitrite 和 NO。两条限制支撑实用结论: 内源生成无法按需上调, 而要把血浆 nitrite 提高到足以降低运动氧耗的程度, 需要的膳食负荷远高于内源周转量。两条路线也要分开看, arginine 经 nitric oxide synthase 生成 NO 与膳食 nitrate 到 nitrite 到 NO 的路线彼此独立, 所以在这条轴上补充并不多余。

What it does它有什么作用

Inorganic nitrate from beetroot and leafy greens is absorbed in the proximal small intestine, and roughly a quarter of the circulating pool is actively concentrated by the salivary glands. Commensal bacteria on the posterior tongue reduce it to nitrite, and swallowed nitrite is further reduced to nitric oxide in the acidic stomach and in hypoxic tissue by deoxyhaemoglobin, deoxymyoglobin, xanthine oxidoreductase and other metalloproteins. This enterosalivary route is a supplementary supply line that runs in parallel with the body's own synthesis of nitric oxide from L-arginine by nitric oxide synthase, which is the primary and always-available pathway. That distinction is what makes nitrate a usable substrate rather than a required nutrient: NOS-derived nitric oxide continues normally on a nitrate-free diet. Measured effects are pharmacological and dose-dependent: vasodilation with a modest fall in blood pressure, and a reduced oxygen cost of submaximal exercise. Antibacterial mouthwash abolishes the effect entirely by killing the nitrate-reducing oral flora, which is the clearest demonstration that the mechanism is microbial rather than nutritional.来自甜菜根和绿叶蔬菜的无机硝酸盐在近端小肠被吸收,循环池中约四分之一会被唾液腺主动富集。舌背的共生细菌将其还原为亚硝酸盐,吞咽的亚硝酸盐在酸性胃环境及缺氧组织中,经脱氧血红蛋白、脱氧肌红蛋白、黄嘌呤氧化还原酶(xanthine oxidoreductase)及其他金属蛋白进一步还原为一氧化氮。这条肠道唾液循环通路是一条补充性供应线,与人体自身通过一氧化氮合酶(nitric oxide synthase, NOS)以L-精氨酸合成一氧化氮的主要且始终存在的通路并行运作。这一区别使硝酸盐成为可利用的底物,不是人体必需的营养素:即便饮食中不含硝酸盐,NOS来源的一氧化氮合成仍照常进行。已测得的效应是药理性的且呈剂量依赖:血管扩张伴血压轻度下降,以及次极量运动的耗氧量降低。抗菌漱口水通过杀灭还原硝酸盐的口腔菌群而完全消除这一效应,这清楚地表明该机制本质上是微生物性的,不是营养性的。

Standard antidepressant dosing is 300 mg of standardised extract three times daily, 900 mg/day, delivering roughly 1.1-2.5 mg of hypericin (900 mg x 0.12-0.28%) and 45-54 mg of hyperforin.
