The relevant constituents are hypericin, a naphthodianthrone, and hyperforin, a prenylated phloroglucinol, both made only by Hypericum perforatum. Humans synthesise neither, so nothing here is replacement. On this one the axis being silent matters less than the interaction profile: hyperforin activates PXR and induces CYP3A4, which cuts blood levels of oral contraceptives, ciclosporin, warfarin and HIV protease inhibitors.相关成分是 hypericin (一种萘骈二蒽酮) 和 hyperforin (一种异戊烯化间苯三酚), 只由 Hypericum perforatum 合成。人两者都不合成, 所以这里谈不上替代。这一条上, 这条轴无话可说的意义远小于相互作用特征: hyperforin 激活 PXR 并诱导 CYP3A4, 会降低口服避孕药, 环孢素, 华法林和 HIV 蛋白酶抑制剂的血药水平。

What it does它有什么作用

Hypericum perforatum extracts contain hypericin, pseudohypericin and hyperforin; hyperforin is the antidepressant-relevant constituent and inhibits reuptake of serotonin, noradrenaline and dopamine non-selectively. Hyperforin is also a potent ligand for the pregnane X receptor (Ki 27 nM), the nuclear receptor that drives transcription of CYP3A4 and P-glycoprotein, so the extract induces the clearance of a very wide range of co-administered drugs. Because CYP3A4 handles the oxidative metabolism of more than half of all medicines, this produces documented therapeutic failures with ciclosporin, tacrolimus, indinavir, warfarin and combined oral contraceptives, and serotonin toxicity when combined with SSRIs. To match that from food用食物达到该剂量

Pancreatic enzymes: absolute. Recommended dosing is a minimum of 40,000-50,000 units of lipase with main meals and 20,000-25,000 with snacks, taken with every meal for life (PMID 42011215). No food supplies active lipase in those quantities. Raw pancreas is the only tissue that contains the enzymes at all, it is not eaten raw in any normal diet, cooking denatures them, the delivered activity would be unmeasurable and uncontrolled, and without enteric protection gastric acid would destroy most of what survived. Lactase: there is one genuine partial route, since live yoghurt and kefir carry microbial beta-galactosidase into the gut, but that only handles the lactose in the fermented product itself and does not give a dose-adjustable enzyme to take with an arbitrary lactose-containing meal, which is the point of a lactase capsule. Does the body make it身体是否自产

Both enzymes are made by the body, and both have named states in which that synthesis stops being sufficient, which is what makes them genuine replacement therapy. Lactase is made by small-intestinal enterocytes and its decline after weaning is the normal human pattern, with adult retention the derived trait set by regulatory variants upstream of the LCT gene; pancreatic enzymes are made by acinar cells, and replacement exists precisely because that synthesis fails in pancreatic disease. So these products are correct in the person with the named condition and pointless in everyone else.这两种酶身体都能合成, 而且都有明确的状态使合成不再够用, 这就是它们属于真正替代治疗的原因。乳糖酶由小肠上皮细胞合成, 断奶后活性下降是人类的常态, 成年后仍保留才是衍生性状, 由 LCT 基因上游的调控变异决定; 胰酶由腺泡细胞合成, 替代疗法之所以存在, 正因为胰腺疾病使这种合成失效。所以这些产品对有明确诊断的人是对的, 对其他所有人没有意义。

What it does它有什么作用

Lactase-phlorizin hydrolase sits in the small intestinal brush border and cleaves lactose into glucose and galactose; whatever escapes digestion reaches the colon, where bacteria ferment it into hydrogen, methane and short-chain fatty acids, producing the familiar symptoms. The exocrine pancreas secretes lipase and colipase, amylase, and the proteases trypsinogen and chymotrypsinogen, and lipase is the critical one because no other organ can substitute for it. The gland holds a large functional reserve: in the classic secretion studies, steatorrhoea did not appear until lipase output had fallen to 10% of normal or below, and creatorrhoea only below 10% of normal trypsin, which is why malabsorption in chronic pancreatitis declares itself late. The decline of intestinal lactase after weaning is the normal human developmental programme; retaining it into adulthood (lactase persistence) is the derived condition, driven chiefly by the LCT -13910C>T variant upstream of the lactase gene and selected for in dairying populations.乳糖酶-根皮苷水解酶(lactase-phlorizin hydrolase)位于小肠刷状缘,将乳糖分解为葡萄糖和半乳糖;未被消化的部分进入结肠,由细菌发酵产生氢气、甲烷和短链脂肪酸,从而引起常见症状。胰腺外分泌部分泌脂肪酶(lipase)和辅脂酶(colipase)、淀粉酶(amylase),以及蛋白酶胰蛋白酶原(trypsinogen)和糜蛋白酶原(chymotrypsinogen),其中脂肪酶是关键所在,因为没有其他器官能替代它的功能。胰腺具有很大的功能储备:在经典的分泌研究中,脂肪酶输出降至正常值的10%或以下时才出现脂肪泻(steatorrhoea),胰蛋白酶降至正常值10%以下时才出现肌酸泻(creatorrhoea),这正是慢性胰腺炎中的吸收不良往往迟迟才表现出来的原因。断奶后肠道乳糖酶活性下降是人类正常的发育程序;成年后仍保留乳糖酶活性(乳糖酶持续性)才是衍生出的状态,主要由乳糖酶基因(LCT)上游的-13910C>T变异驱动,并在从事乳制品生产的人群中受到选择。

Untreated exocrine pancreatic insufficiency causes overt steatorrhoea, progressive weight loss and sarcopenia, fat-soluble vitamin deficiency with osteopenia and osteoporosis, and in cystic fibrosis, failure to thrive in infancy; excess mortality in chronic pancreatitis is concentrated in those with untreated malabsorption. Lactase non-persistence has no severe clinical endpoint whatsoever. The only downstream risk is a calcium and vitamin D shortfall in people who eliminate dairy entirely without substituting an alternative source.未经治疗的胰腺外分泌功能不全会导致明显的脂肪泻(steatorrhoea)、进行性体重下降和肌少症(sarcopenia)、脂溶性维生素缺乏并伴骨量减少和骨质疏松,在囊性纤维化(cystic fibrosis)患儿则表现为婴儿期生长发育迟滞;慢性胰腺炎的超额死亡率主要集中在未经治疗、存在吸收不良的患者中。乳糖酶非持续性完全没有任何严重的临床终点。唯一的下游风险是,完全停用乳制品而未以其他来源替代的人可能出现钙和维生素D不足。

Pancreatic enzyme replacement restores fat and protein absorption, reverses weight loss and corrects fat-soluble vitamin levels while it is being taken, but destroyed acinar tissue does not regenerate, so treatment is lifelong and bone density already lost recovers only in part. Lactase non-persistence is permanent because it is the normal genetic programme rather than a lesion; symptoms resolve completely with lactose restriction, fermented dairy or exogenous lactase, and the underlying trait is not something to correct.胰酶替代治疗在持续用药期间可恢复脂肪和蛋白质的吸收、逆转体重下降并纠正脂溶性维生素水平,但已被破坏的腺泡组织不会再生,因此治疗需终身进行,已经丢失的骨密度也只能部分恢复。乳糖酶非持续性是永久性的,因为它是正常的基因程序而非病变;通过限制乳糖摄入、改用发酵乳制品或外源补充乳糖酶,症状可以完全消除,而这一潜在特征本身并不是需要纠正的对象。

To match that from food用食物达到该剂量

There is no single food equivalent of a multivitamin, because a multivitamin is not a nutrient: one tablet supplies roughly 100% of the reference intake for 20 or more nutrients at once, and the only thing matching that profile is a varied diet, which by definition already supplies them. So the answer has to be given per nutrient, and it splits. For most of the tablet (vitamin C, vitamin A, thiamine, riboflavin, niacin, B6, vitamin E, vitamin K, zinc, selenium, copper, iodine) the food gap for anyone eating a normal mixed diet is zero. Vitamin D is reachable but rarely reached: the original claim that UV-treated mushrooms are the only food to hit 15 ug in one portion is arithmetically false, because 3 oz of canned sockeye salmon gives 17.9 ug (119% of the 15 ug RDA), 3 oz of farmed rainbow trout 16.2 ug (108%), a USDA half-fillet (155 g) of cooked sockeye 25.9 ug (173%), and a teaspoon of cod liver oil 11.3 ug (75%), alongside a cup of UV portabella at 24.4 ug. Reaching 15 ug/day from food needs about 90 g of cooked sockeye every day, or 1.15 litres of fortified milk, or 14 large eggs; the UK 10 ug RNI needs about 60 g of oily fish daily or 770 ml of fortified milk. So the vitamin D case for supplementing is behavioural (few people at temperate latitudes eat oily fish daily through winter) rather than compositional, and it argues for vitamin D alone rather than a 25-ingredient tablet. Periconceptional folic acid is a genuine exception: 400 ug/day is food-achievable in bulk (about 220 g of cooked lentils daily) but the trial evidence for preventing neural tube defects is for supplemental folic acid, and food folate is both less bioavailable and more variable, so food substitution is not supported. B12 on a vegan diet is the second real exception, since there is no reliable unfortified plant source, so a supplement or fortified food is mandatory. Two mismatches run the other way: the potassium in a multivitamin is capped at about 99 mg against a 3,500 mg reference intake, and the calcium is typically 100-200 mg, so the tablet cannot address either of the shortfalls the guidelines name, and fibre, the fourth named shortfall, is absent from every tablet. Iodised salt, the global public-health iodine vehicle, belongs in this list as well; verification named it as a complete omission but supplied no composition figure, so no row is given for it.复合维生素没有单一食物的等价物，因为它本身并不是一种营养素：一片药同时提供 20 种以上营养素各约 100% 的参考摄入量，唯一符合这一构成的东西是多样化的膳食，而多样化膳食按定义已经在提供这些营养素。所以答案必须按营养素分别给出，结论也随之分开。药片里的大部分成分（维生素 C、维生素 A、硫胺素、核黄素、烟酸、B6、维生素 E、维生素 K、锌、硒、铜、碘），对任何吃正常混合膳食的人来说食物缺口为零。维生素 D 可以达到，却很少有人达到：原稿称经紫外线处理的蘑菇是唯一能在一份内达到 15 ug 的食物，这在算术上不成立，因为 3 oz 罐装红鲑给出 17.9 ug（15 ug RDA 的 119%），3 oz 养殖虹鳟 16.2 ug（108%），USDA 的半片（155 g）熟红鲑 25.9 ug（173%），一茶匙鱼肝油 11.3 ug（75%），此外一杯紫外线处理的褐菇为 24.4 ug。要从食物做到 15 ug/天，需要每天约 90 g 熟红鲑，或 1.15 litres 强化牛奶，或 14 个大鸡蛋；英国的 10 ug RNI 需要每天约 60 g 多脂鱼或 770 ml 强化牛奶。所以维生素 D 需要补充的理由在行为层面（温带纬度很少有人整个冬天每天吃多脂鱼），与食物成分无关，据此该补的是单独的维生素 D，一片含 25 种成分的药并无必要。孕前和孕早期的叶酸是真正的例外：400 ug/天 靠食物在数量上做得到（每天约 220 g 熟扁豆），但预防神经管缺陷的试验证据针对的是补充剂形式的叶酸，食物叶酸生物利用度更低且变化更大，因此用食物替代得不到支持。素食者的 B12 是第二个真正的例外，植物性食物中没有可靠的未强化来源，所以补充剂或强化食品是必需的。有两处不匹配方向相反：复合维生素中的钾被限制在约 99 mg，而参考摄入量是 3,500 mg；钙通常只有 100-200 mg，因此药片解决不了指南列出的这两项不足，而纤维这第四项不足在任何药片里都不存在。碘盐作为全球公共卫生的碘载体也属于这个名单；核查指出它被完全遗漏，但没有给出成分数值，因此这里不为它单列一行。

Does the body make it身体是否自产

This is a product category rather than a defined substance, so the axis cannot return one biochemical answer for it and the roll-up is NA. The parts do have answers: every mineral element in the bottle is NONE without exception, because no biological process transmutes elements; vitamin C, B12, folate, thiamine, riboflavin, B6, biotin, pantothenate, vitamin E and preformed vitamin A are NONE because no human biosynthetic pathway exists for any of them; vitamin D3 is PARTIAL through UVB-dependent cutaneous synthesis, vitamin K is PARTIAL through UBIAD1 conversion of dietary K1 to MK-4, and niacin is PARTIAL through the tryptophan route at 60 mg tryptophan per 1 mg niacin equivalent. A multivitamin therefore has a real target for whichever components a given person is short of and no target for the rest, so it has to be judged component by component against the doses on the label.这是一个产品类别, 并非界定明确的物质, 所以这条轴无法给出单一的生化答案, 整体判为 NA。它的各个组成部分有答案: 瓶里的每一种矿物元素一律为 NONE, 因为没有任何生物过程能进行元素转变; 维生素 C, B12, 叶酸, thiamine, riboflavin, B6, biotin, pantothenate, 维生素 E 和预成型维生素 A 都是 NONE, 人体对它们都没有生物合成通路; 维生素 D3 因依赖 UVB 的皮肤合成而为 PARTIAL, 维生素 K 因 UBIAD1 把膳食 K1 转化为 MK-4 而为 PARTIAL, 烟酸因色氨酸路线 (60 mg tryptophan 折合 1 mg niacin equivalent) 而为 PARTIAL。因此复合维生素对使用者确实短缺的那些成分有真实目标, 对其余成分没有目标, 只能逐个成分对照标签剂量来判断。

What it does它有什么作用

A multivitamin/multimineral is a product category rather than a substance: a fixed combination typically supplying somewhere around the RDA for ten to thirty vitamins and minerals in a single daily dose. It has no physiology of its own, and whatever it does in the body is simply the sum of the individual nutrients, each acting through its own pathway. Formulations differ enormously in which nutrients are included, in what chemical form (iron as sulphate or bisglycinate, folate as folic acid or 5-MTHF, vitamin D as D2 or D3), and at what fraction or multiple of the RDA, so trial evidence about one product transfers poorly to another. Its coherent use is as insurance against gaps in an inadequate diet. What it does它有什么作用

Collagen is the most abundant protein in the body, roughly a third of total body protein, forming the tensile framework of skin, tendon, ligament, bone matrix, cartilage and vessel wall. The body synthesises it from ordinary amino acids as a repeating Gly-X-Y sequence rich in proline; the post-translational hydroxylation that stabilises the triple helix is carried out by prolyl and lysyl hydroxylases, which require vitamin C, iron and 2-oxoglutarate. Ingested collagen is digested like any other protein, though some di- and tripeptides such as prolyl-hydroxyproline do reach the bloodstream intact, which is the proposed mechanism for any effect beyond amino acid supply. What it does它有什么作用

Glucosamine is an amino sugar produced in every cell from fructose-6-phosphate by glutamine-fructose-6-phosphate amidotransferase, the entry step of the hexosamine biosynthetic pathway that supplies UDP-N-acetylglucosamine for glycosaminoglycans, proteoglycans and O-GlcNAc signalling. Chondroitin sulfate is a sulfated glycosaminoglycan chain assembled on proteoglycan core proteins in the Golgi. Both are made on demand from glucose and glutamine, so neither is a required dietary component and neither has a recommended intake. Orally administered chondroitin is a large polysaccharide with low and variable absorption, and oral glucosamine does not raise synovial fluid concentrations anywhere near those used in cartilage cell experiments. Cells make NMN every day as the middle step of the NAD+ salvage pathway: NAMPT joins nicotinamide to 5-phosphoribosyl-1-pyrophosphate to form NMN, and NMNAT enzymes then convert NMN into NAD+. There is no dietary requirement for NMN at any intake, and NAMPT is feedback inhibited by nicotinamide, NAD+ and ATP (PMID 36746631), so the supplement targets the exact step the body already regulates. Buying NMN means adding an internal intermediate to a self-regulating pathway, and the only genuine dietary need upstream of it is the ordinary niacin requirement of 14 to 16 mg NE/day, which a normal diet covers, so the case for supplementing has to rest on outcome trials and not on repletion.细胞每天自己合成 NMN, 它是 NAD+ 补救合成通路的中间步骤: NAMPT 把 nicotinamide 与 5-phosphoribosyl-1-pyrophosphate 连接成 NMN, 再由 NMNAT 系列酶把 NMN 转成 NAD+。任何摄入水平下都不存在 NMN 的膳食需要量, 而 NAMPT 受 nicotinamide、NAD+ 和 ATP 的反馈抑制 (PMID 36746631), 补充剂瞄准的正是这个被主动调控的步骤。买 NMN 等于往一条自我调节的通路里补它自己的中间物, 上游唯一真实的膳食需求是每日 14 到 16 mg NE 的常规烟酸需要量 (仅靠色氨酸提供 16 mg NE 需要约 960 mg 色氨酸, 而每日 60 到 80 g 蛋白质的摄入能提供数倍于此), 普通饮食已经覆盖, 所以补充的理由只能来自结局试验, 与补足缺乏无关。

What it does它有什么作用

Nicotinamide mononucleotide is an intermediate in the NAD+ salvage pathway, formed when nicotinamide phosphoribosyltransferase attaches nicotinamide to phosphoribosyl pyrophosphate, then converted to NAD+ by NMN adenylyltransferases. NAD+ is the electron carrier for hundreds of dehydrogenases and the consumed substrate for sirtuins, PARPs and CD38. NMN is thought to be dephosphorylated to nicotinamide riboside before cellular uptake, though the human intestinal route is not established and the proposed direct NMN transporter is contested: Slc12a8-mediated uptake was reported in mouse small intestine (Grozio et al. 2019) and then disputed on methodological grounds (Shats et al. 2020), and no human transporter has been demonstrated in either direction. NMN itself is not an essential nutrient and has no recommended intake. The essential nutrient in this pathway is niacin (vitamin B3), whose deficiency causes pellagra, a real and severe disease that has nothing to do with NMN intake.烟酰胺单核苷酸是NAD+补救合成途径中的中间产物,由烟酰胺磷酸核糖转移酶将烟酰胺连接到磷酸核糖焦磷酸上生成,随后经NMN腺苷酰转移酶转化为NAD+。NAD+是数百种脱氢酶的电子载体,也是sirtuin、PARP和CD38消耗的底物。目前认为NMN在被细胞摄取之前会先脱磷酸化为烟酰胺核糖,不过人体肠道内的具体途径尚未确立,而所提出的直接NMN转运体也存在争议:Slc12a8介导的摄取曾在小鼠小肠中被报道(Grozio等2019年),随后又因方法学问题受到质疑(Shats等2020年),目前尚无论证表明人体存在这种方向上的转运体。NMN本身并非必需营养素,也没有推荐摄入量。这一通路中真正的必需营养素是烟酸(维生素B3),其缺乏会导致糙皮病,这是一种真实存在的严重疾病,与NMN摄入与否无关。

NR is also an internal NAD intermediate: the body generates it by stripping the phosphate off NMN using CD73 and alkaline phosphatases, and it circulates in human blood and appears in milk without anyone supplementing. The first-pass finding that oral NR is mostly broken down to nicotinamide in the liver comes from mouse tracer work (PMID 27721479 mouse arm; PMID 29685734 in C57BL/6 mice), so the species label matters, and the human evidence is pharmacokinetic. Supplementing does raise blood NAD metabolites measurably, which makes NR a real pharmacological agent, and it still corrects no deficiency in a person eating normally, since NR, NMN, nicotinamide and nicotinic acid all feed the same NAD pool and the two vitamin forms cost a fraction of the price.NR 同样是体内的 NAD 中间物: 机体通过 CD73 和碱性磷酸酶把 NMN 上的磷酸去掉来生成它, 在无人补充的情况下它也存在于人血液循环并出现在乳汁中。口服 NR 在肝脏首过时大部分被降解为 nicotinamide, 这一结论来自小鼠示踪研究 (PMID 27721479 的小鼠部分; PMID 29685734 使用 C57BL/6 小鼠), 因此物种标注很重要, 人体证据属于药代动力学层面。补充确实能可测量地提高血中 NAD 代谢物, 这使 NR 成为一种真实的药理制剂, 但对饮食正常的人它并不纠正任何缺乏: NR、NMN、nicotinamide 和 nicotinic acid 都汇入同一个 NAD 池, 其中两种维生素形式的价格只有它的零头。

What it does它有什么作用

Nicotinamide riboside is the riboside of nicotinamide, phosphorylated by nicotinamide riboside kinases to NMN and then to NAD+, bypassing the NAMPT step. It occurs naturally in trace amounts in milk. Single oral doses raise whole-blood NAD+ dose-dependently in humans, which is the basis for marketing it as an NAD+ booster; whether raising NAD+ produces clinical benefit in healthy people remains unsettled. NR is a minor chemical form of vitamin B3 rather than a separate essential nutrient. Vitamin B3 deficiency does exist and is called pellagra (dermatitis, diarrhoea, dementia), but it results from lack of dietary niacin and tryptophan and is treated with nicotinamide or nicotinic acid, not with NR.烟酰胺核糖是烟酰胺的核糖苷,经烟酰胺核糖激酶磷酸化为NMN,再进一步转化为NAD+,绕过了NAMPT这一步骤。它天然微量存在于牛奶中。单次口服可剂量依赖性地升高人体全血NAD+水平,这是将其作为NAD+助推剂进行营销的依据;但升高NAD+是否能给健康人带来临床获益仍未确定。NR是维生素B3的一种次要化学形式,而非独立的必需营养素。维生素B3缺乏确实存在,称为糙皮病(皮炎、腹泻、痴呆),但其成因是膳食烟酸和色氨酸摄入不足,治疗用烟酰胺或烟酸,而非NR。

Possibly people who already have type 2 diabetes. The healthy-ageing consumer is in the null subgroup.可能适用于已患 2 型糖尿病的人。以“健康抗老”为目的的消费者正处在无效的那个亚组里。

Dose tested已验证剂量

Trials span 150 mg/d to gram doses. The EU caps synthetic trans-resveratrol at 150 mg/d in supplements, adults only.试验剂量从 150 毫克/天到克级。欧盟把合成反式白藜芦醇在补充剂中的上限定为 150 毫克/天，且仅限成人。

To match that from food用食物达到该剂量

A 150 mg resveratrol dose equals 79 litres of average red wine (150 divided by 1.9 mg/L), about 105 standard 750 mL bottles or roughly 450 glasses, every day. Even at the top of the corroborated sample spread of 0.361 to 1.972 mg/L it is still 76 litres a day. From grapes it is 30 kg daily; from boiled peanuts 29 kg, and from roasted peanuts 2.7 tonnes. Trials commonly use 150 to 1,000 mg/day and the SRT501 cancer studies used up to 5 g/day, all of it manufactured. Measured population intakes sit far lower again (a Spanish study found a median of 100 ug/day and a mean of 933 ug/day for resveratrol plus piceid, and French wine consumption yields about 0.2 mg/day), and no plausible diet gets past about 5 mg/day.150 mg 白藜芦醇的剂量相当于每天 79 升平均含量的红葡萄酒（150 除以 1.9 mg/L），约 105 瓶 750 mL 标准装，或大约 450 杯。即便取已获旁证的样本区间 0.361 至 1.972 mg/L 的上限，也仍需每天 76 升。换成葡萄是每天 30 kg；水煮花生 29 kg；烤花生 2.7 吨。试验常用剂量为每天 150 至 1,000 mg，SRT501 的肿瘤研究用到每天 5 g，全部为人工制造。实测的人群摄入量远低于此（西班牙一项研究得出白藜芦醇加虎杖苷（piceid）的中位数为每天 100 ug、均值为每天 933 ug；法国的葡萄酒消费约折合每天 0.2 mg），任何合理的饮食都超不过每天约 5 mg。

Does the body make it身体是否自产

Resveratrol is a plant stress compound, a stilbene assembled by stilbene synthase from 4-coumaroyl-CoA and malonyl-CoA in grapevine, peanut and Polygonum. Humans have no stilbene synthase and no phenylpropanoid pathway at all, so every molecule in the body arrived from food or a capsule. The endogenous axis therefore gives resveratrol no free pass and no handicap: the whole case has to rest on clinical outcomes, and the practical obstacle is that absorbed resveratrol is conjugated almost immediately.白藜芦醇是植物的应激化合物, 属于芪类, 在葡萄藤、花生和 Polygonum 中由 stilbene synthase 以 4-coumaroyl-CoA 和 malonyl-CoA 为底物组装而成。人体既没有 stilbene synthase, 也完全没有 phenylpropanoid 通路, 所以体内的每一个分子都来自食物或胶囊。内源性这一维度对它既不加分也不减分: 全部论证只能落在临床结局上, 而现实障碍是被吸收的白藜芦醇几乎立刻被结合代谢。

What it does它有什么作用

Resveratrol is a stilbene phytoalexin produced by grapevines, Japanese knotweed and peanuts in response to injury and fungal attack. In cell and yeast systems it appears to activate SIRT1, an effect later shown to depend substantially on the fluorophore-tagged assay substrate rather than on the enzyme, and it activates AMPK at high concentrations. In humans absorption is good but bioavailability is very low: it is almost completely converted to sulfate and glucuronide conjugates on first pass, leaving free plasma resveratrol far below the concentrations used in cell experiments. It is a plant secondary metabolite. No human transporter, receptor or enzyme requires it, and nothing in the body fails in its absence.白藜芦醇是一种茋类植物抗毒素,由葡萄藤、虎杖和花生在受到损伤或真菌侵袭时产生。在细胞和酵母系统中,它似乎能激活SIRT1,但后续研究表明这一效应在很大程度上取决于所用荧光标记检测底物,而非对该酶的真实作用;在高浓度下它还能激活AMPK。在人体内它吸收良好,但生物利用度很低:首过代谢中几乎完全被转化为硫酸盐和葡萄糖醛酸盐结合物,使血浆中游离白藜芦醇浓度远低于细胞实验所用的浓度。它是一种植物次生代谢物。没有任何人体转运体、受体或酶需要它,缺乏它也不会导致人体任何功能失常。

Spermidine亚精胺A polyamine your own cells make, needed to activate a key protein-building factor.一种由自身细胞合成的多胺,是激活某个关键蛋白质合成因子所必需的。 SSDDFFDDBBXX Skip it不必买 Rich丰富 Reachable可达到 Body makes it身体自产 No deficiency state exists不存在缺乏状态 Nobody demonstrably.没有可证实的适用人群。

Nobody demonstrably.没有可证实的适用人群。

Dose tested已验证剂量

0.9 mg/d was the dose in the definitive trial. Commercial products supply roughly 1-6 mg/d.决定性试验用的是 0.9 毫克/天。市售产品约提供 1 至 6 毫克/天。

To match that from food用食物达到该剂量

The gap runs backwards. Two tablespoons of wheat germ (14 g) supply 3.1 to 5.0 mg, three to five times the 0.9 mg/day dose used in the SmartAge trial. A cup of cooked green peas supplies about 8.7 mg and a cup of sliced mushrooms 6.2 to 7.6 mg, each close to an entire ordinary day's intake. Against habitual intakes of 7.9 to 15.0 mg/day, a typical 1 mg capsule adds 6.7 to 12.7 per cent on top of what the person already eats, which is inside the day-to-day variation of a normal diet, and matching a day's dietary spermidine from capsules would take 8 to 15 of them. Anyone who wants more spermidine should buy wheat germ, which costs a fraction of the capsules and delivers several times the dose.差距是反向的。两大勺小麦胚芽（14 g）提供 3.1 到 5.0 mg，是 SmartAge 试验所用 0.9 mg/天 剂量的三到五倍。一杯煮熟的青豌豆提供约 8.7 mg，一杯切片蘑菇 6.2 到 7.6 mg，各自都接近普通人一整天的摄入量。对照 7.9 到 15.0 mg/天 的习惯摄入量，一粒常见的 1 mg 胶囊只在既有饮食之上增加 6.7 到 12.7 个百分点，落在正常饮食的日常波动范围内；要用胶囊凑够一天的膳食亚精胺，需要 8 到 15 粒。想多摄入亚精胺的人应该去买小麦胚芽，价格只是胶囊的一小部分，提供的量却是数倍。

Does the body make it身体是否自产

Spermidine synthase builds spermidine from putrescine plus an aminopropyl group donated by decarboxylated S-adenosylmethionine, with ornithine decarboxylase as the tightly regulated rate-limiting entry step, while arginine decarboxylase plus agmatinase (AGMAT) provide a second, agmatine-derived route into the putrescine pool. Cells hold polyamines at high micromolar to millimolar concentrations, recycle them continuously through SSAT and polyamine oxidases, and also absorb polyamines produced by gut bacteria, and how that supply splits between host synthesis, diet and microbiota has never been quantified in humans. The FULL label covers the host pathway only, and the practical reading is that a fixed daily dose is an awkward intervention against a homeostatic system the body makes on demand and regulates in both directions.Spermidine synthase 以 putrescine 加上由脱羧 S-adenosylmethionine 提供的氨丙基合成亚精胺, ornithine decarboxylase 是受严格调控的限速起始步骤, arginine decarboxylase 加 agmatinase (AGMAT) 构成另一条经 agmatine 进入 putrescine 池的途径。细胞把多胺维持在高微摩尔到毫摩尔浓度, 通过 SSAT 和多胺氧化酶持续回收, 也吸收肠道细菌产生的多胺, 这一供给在宿主合成、膳食和菌群之间如何分配, 在人体中从未被定量。FULL 标签只针对宿主通路, 微生物来源单独计算; 实际含义是机体按需制造并双向调节这类物质, 对这样一个稳态系统施加固定日剂量属于别扭的干预。

What it does它有什么作用

Spermidine is a polyamine synthesized from putrescine by spermidine synthase using decarboxylated S-adenosylmethionine. Its one indispensable and unique function is donating the aminobutyl group for hypusination of eukaryotic translation initiation factor 5A, a modification required to translate polyproline-containing proteins. It also stabilises nucleic acids and induces autophagy in model organisms, which is the basis of the longevity marketing. Humans get it from three simultaneous sources: de novo synthesis in essentially every cell, gut bacterial production, and food such as wheat germ, aged cheese, soy and mushrooms. Because synthesis is ubiquitous and tightly regulated, dietary intake is never limiting and no deficiency state exists.亚精胺是一种多胺,由腐胺经亚精胺合酶利用脱羧S-腺苷甲硫氨酸合成而来。它唯一不可替代且独特的功能是为真核翻译起始因子5A的亚精胺化(hypusination)提供氨丁基基团,这一修饰是翻译含多聚脯氨酸蛋白质所必需的。它还能稳定核酸,并在模式生物中诱导自噬,这正是其长寿营销概念的依据。人体同时从三个来源获得亚精胺:几乎所有细胞的从头合成、肠道细菌的产生,以及小麦胚芽、熟成奶酪、大豆和蘑菇等食物。由于合成过程普遍存在且受到严格调控,膳食摄入从不构成限制因素,也不存在任何缺乏状态。

A spice compound, with no role in human physiology.姜黄的黄色色素成分。一种香料化合物,在人体生理中没有作用。 SSCCFFDDBBXX Skip it不必买 Rich丰富 Out of reach达不到 Cannot不能 No deficiency state exists不存在缺乏状态 At most, people with symptomatic knee osteoarthritis, if the meta-analytic signal survives the bias problem.最多适用于有症状的膝骨关节炎患者，前提是那个 meta 分析信号能扛过偏倚问题。
Who it is for适用人群

Dose tested已验证剂量

About 1,000 mg/d of curcuminoids in the knee osteoarthritis trials. Culinary turmeric is a different exposure entirely.膝骨关节炎试验中约为姜黄素类 1000 毫克/天。烹饪用姜黄的暴露量完全是另一回事。

To match that from food用食物达到该剂量

A 1,000 mg curcuminoid capsule equals about 21 to 32 g of turmeric powder every day: 32 g counting curcumin only at 3.14% w/w, about 21 g counting all three curcuminoids at roughly 4.7% (a conventional ratio the cited source does not establish). That is 7 to 11 level teaspoons, close to a third of a supermarket spice jar per day, and nobody eats that. A generous curry portion carries 1 to 2 g of turmeric, or 30 to 60 mg of curcumin, and a heavy South Asian intake of 2 to 2.5 g turmeric per day yields 63 to 79 mg of curcumin, so the capsule is about 13 to 16 times a heavy dietary intake on a curcumin basis, and about 8.5 to 11 times if the comparison is made on total curcuminoids. There is no eating route to the dose.一粒 1,000 mg 姜黄素类化合物胶囊相当于每天约 21 至 32 g 姜黄粉：只按 3.14% w/w 的姜黄素计算是 32 g，按三种姜黄素类化合物合计约 4.7% 计算约为 21 g（这个换算比例属惯用值，所引来源并未确立）。折合 7 至 11 平茶匙，接近每天吃掉三分之一瓶超市香料罐，没有人会这么吃。一份量足的咖喱含 1 至 2 g 姜黄，即 30 至 60 mg 姜黄素；南亚地区偏高的摄入量为每天 2 至 2.5 g 姜黄，可得 63 至 79 mg 姜黄素。按姜黄素计，胶囊约为高膳食摄入量的 13 至 16 倍；若按总姜黄素类化合物比较，约为 8.5 至 11 倍。靠吃东西达不到这个剂量。

Does the body make it身体是否自产

Curcuminoids are plant polyketides: Curcuma longa builds them from feruloyl-CoA and malonyl-CoA using two type III polyketide synthases, diketide-CoA synthase and curcumin synthase. Humans have no phenylpropanoid pathway and no type III polyketide synthase, so curcumin is a xenobiotic the body can only absorb, conjugate and clear. Endogenous synthesis is irrelevant to the buying decision here, and the operative limit is pharmacokinetic: oral curcumin is glucuronidated and sulfated so fast that free plasma concentrations stay very low, which is why any case for it rests on trial evidence for a named indication and on the specific formulation used.姜黄素类是植物聚酮化合物: Curcuma longa 以 feruloyl-CoA 和 malonyl-CoA 为底物, 通过两种 III 型聚酮合酶 (diketide-CoA synthase 和 curcumin synthase) 合成。人体没有 phenylpropanoid 通路, 也没有 III 型聚酮合酶, 因此姜黄素是一种外源物, 机体只能吸收、结合和清除。内源合成与这里的购买决策无关, 真正起作用的限制是药代动力学: 口服姜黄素被葡糖醛酸化和硫酸化的速度极快, 游离血浆浓度始终很低, 所以任何理由都必须来自针对具体适应症的试验证据以及所用的具体制剂。

What it does它有什么作用

Curcumin is a diarylheptanoid pigment making up roughly 2 to 5 percent of turmeric rhizome. It binds and weakly inhibits a very large number of unrelated proteins in vitro, which is why it appears in thousands of papers; medicinal chemists classify it as a pan-assay interference compound, since its chemical reactivity, aggregation and fluorescence generate false positives across screening assays. Unformulated curcumin is poorly absorbed, rapidly glucuronidated and sulfated, and essentially undetectable as the free compound in plasma even after gram doses, though piperine, phospholipid and nanoparticle formulations raise exposure. It is a plant secondary metabolite with no physiological role in humans and no requirement.姜黄素是一种二芳基庚烷类色素,约占姜黄根茎的2%至5%。它在体外能与大量互不相关的蛋白质结合并弱抑制其活性,这也是它在数千篇论文中出现的原因;药物化学家将其归类为泛测定干扰化合物(PAINS),因为其化学反应活性、聚集性和荧光特性会在各类筛选测定中产生假阳性。未经处理的姜黄素吸收很差,会被迅速葡萄糖醛酸化和硫酸化,即使服用克级剂量,血浆中游离化合物也基本检测不到,不过胡椒碱、磷脂或纳米颗粒制剂可提高其暴露量。它是一种植物次生代谢物,在人体内没有生理作用,也没有摄入需求。

Dose tested已验证剂量

Trials used 2 g/d (the 2023 trial) up to 6 g/d (the 2006 pilot). No effective dose is established.试验用量从 2 克/天（2023 年试验）到 6 克/天（2006 年预试验）。没有确立的有效剂量。

To match that from food用食物达到该剂量

The gap cannot be computed, and the submission's figures (909 kg of milk for a 3 g dose, 1,875 litres of coffee, 450 kg of milk for the 1.5 g low end) are withdrawn because every one of them was built on DMSO measurements. Qualitatively the answer is still no: supplement doses are 1.5 to 6 g/day, no food has been shown to contain MSM at anything approaching that, and no MSM deficiency has ever been described. Anyone quoting a per-cup or per-kilogram MSM figure is quoting a mislabelled DMSO table.差距无法计算，原提交稿的数字（3 g 剂量需 909 kg 牛奶、1,875 升咖啡，1.5 g 低端需 450 kg 牛奶）全部撤回，因为它们都建立在 DMSO 的测定值上。定性的答案依然是否：补剂剂量为 1.5 到 6 g/天，没有任何食物被证明含有接近这一水平的 MSM，也从未有人描述过 MSM 缺乏。凡是引用每杯或每公斤 MSM 数字的人，引用的都是一张贴错标签的 DMSO 表。

Does the body make it身体是否自产

Dimethyl sulfone is a normal trace constituent of human blood and cerebrospinal fluid in people taking no supplement, measured at 0 to 25 micromol/L, and host enzymes do produce it: thiol S-methyltransferase methylates methanethiol to dimethyl sulfide, and flavin-containing monooxygenases oxidise that to DMSO and then to dimethyl sulfone. What is not endogenous is the precursor supply, which comes mostly from bacterial methionine catabolism in the gut and from diet, and no human enzyme has MSM as its designated end product. There is no requirement, no deficiency state and no known physiological function, so the endogenous axis offers no repletion rationale at all and any claim has to stand on symptom trials.二甲基砜是未服用任何补充剂的人血液和脑脊液中的正常微量成分, 实测浓度为 0 到 25 micromol/L, 宿主的酶确实会生成它: thiol S-methyltransferase 把甲硫醇甲基化为二甲基硫, flavin-containing monooxygenases 再把它氧化为 DMSO, 进而氧化为二甲基砜。不属于内源的是前体供给, 它主要来自肠道细菌的 methionine 分解代谢和膳食, 而且没有任何人体酶以 MSM 作为其指定终产物。它没有需要量, 没有缺乏状态, 也没有已知生理功能, 所以内源性这一维度提供不了补足缺乏的理由, 任何主张只能依靠症状学试验。

What it does它有什么作用

Methylsulfonylmethane is dimethyl sulfone, the oxidised metabolite of dimethyl sulfoxide, present in trace amounts in some foods and in the marine sulfur cycle. It is well absorbed and distributes widely, including into cerebrospinal fluid, and a fraction of its sulfur can enter the methionine and cysteine pools. That contribution is trivial next to dietary protein, which supplies all the sulfur amino acid a person needs. Proposed anti-inflammatory effects via NF-kB inhibition come from cell and animal work, and human osteoarthritis trials are small and short. A 12 mg daily dose, the commonest in the clinical literature, equals 315 to 460 g of wild sockeye salmon every day at 26 to 38 mg/kg, or about 550 g using the cited review's own dietary anchor of 3.6 mg per 165 g portion. A single 140 g sockeye fillet already covers 30 to 44% of the dose, which no other entry here manages, so a meaningful fraction is reachable by eating while the full dose is not: sustaining 350 to 500 g of oily fish daily would push past standard advice on methylmercury and persistent organic pollutants.临床文献中最常见的每天 12 mg 剂量，按 26 至 38 mg/kg 计相当于每天吃 315 至 460 g 野生红鲑，若按所引综述自身的膳食参照（每 165 g 一份含 3.6 mg）计算则约为 550 g。换成养殖大西洋鲑是每天 1.5 至 2.0 kg，去壳虾肉约 1.4 kg，整只湿重磷虾 1.2 至 1.5 kg。单是一片 140 g 的红鲑鱼柳就已覆盖该剂量的 30 至 44%，这是此处其他条目都做不到的，所以靠吃可以拿到相当一部分，全量则不行：每天持续吃 350 至 500 g 多脂鱼会突破关于甲基汞和持久性有机污染物的常规建议。

Astaxanthin is a ketocarotenoid produced by microalgae such as Haematococcus pluvialis and by some bacteria and yeasts, using a beta-carotene ketolase (BKT/CrtW) plus a hydroxylase (CrtZ). What it does它有什么作用

Astaxanthin is a xanthophyll carotenoid produced by the microalga Haematococcus pluvialis and concentrated up the food chain into salmon, trout, shrimp and flamingo feathers. Polar keto and hydroxyl groups on both ionone rings let the molecule span the lipid bilayer, which underlies claims that it quenches singlet oxygen and lipid radicals more efficiently than beta-carotene. Unlike beta-carotene it has no provitamin A activity in humans: it is not cleaved to retinal and cannot contribute to vitamin A status. Humans cannot synthesize it and have no need to, since no metabolic process requires it and no intake recommendation exists.虾青素是由雨生红球藻产生的一种叶黄素类类胡萝卜素,经食物链富集进入鲑鱼、鳟鱼、虾以及火烈鸟羽毛。其两个紫罗兰酮环上的极性酮基和羟基使该分子能够横跨脂质双分子层,这也是它被认为比β-胡萝卜素更有效地淬灭单线态氧和脂质自由基的依据。与β-胡萝卜素不同,它在人体内没有维生素A原活性:它不会被裂解为视黄醛,也不能对维生素A状态有所贡献。人体无法合成它,也没有合成它的需要,因为没有任何代谢过程需要它,也不存在摄入推荐量。

To match that from food用食物达到该剂量

There is no food HMB figure to work from, so the gap has to be argued through the precursor. About 80% of leucine is directed to protein synthesis, and approximately 5-10% of alpha-ketoisocaproate, the leucine transamination product, is converted to HMB; treating that 5-10% as a leucine-to-HMB yield is generous, so the arithmetic below is a ceiling. Even on that generous reading, 3 g of HMB implies about 60 g of leucine per day, which is 2.6 kg of cooked chicken breast at 2.33 g leucine per 100 g, carrying roughly 800 g of protein. At the optimistic 10% figure it is 30 g of leucine, about 1.3 kg of cooked breast and 400 g of protein. Measured endogenous output in healthy adults is only 0.3-0.4 g/day, 8 to 20 times below the 3-6 g/day used in trials, and eating more protein or leucine does not move it, because the bottleneck is the branched-chain pathway rather than the intake.没有食物 HMB 数值可用，只能通过前体来论证这个差距。约 80% 的亮氨酸被导向蛋白质合成，亮氨酸转氨产物 α-酮异己酸中大约 5-10% 转化为 HMB；把这 5-10% 当作亮氨酸到 HMB 的产率已经很宽松，所以下面的算术是一个上限。即便按这种宽松读法，3 g HMB 也意味着每天约 60 g 亮氨酸，按熟鸡胸每 100 g 含 2.33 g 亮氨酸计算是 2.6 kg 熟鸡胸，随之带来约 800 g 蛋白质。按乐观的 10% 计算是 30 g 亮氨酸，约 1.3 kg 熟鸡胸和 400 g 蛋白质。健康成年人实测的内源产量只有 0.3-0.4 g/天，比试验所用的 3-6 g/天低 8 到 20 倍，多吃蛋白质或亮氨酸也无法提高，因为瓶颈是支链氨基酸通路的容量，摄入量本身并不构成限制。

HMB is a normal human metabolite of leucine, made whenever leucine is metabolised, but only about 5 percent of whole-body leucine flux takes that branch, which comes to roughly 0.2 to 0.4 g/day in a 70 kg adult. The studied dose is 3 g/day, and reaching that from food would take about 60 g of leucine, over 600 g of high quality protein, so endogenous production is real yet roughly a tenth of the dose being tested. That makes supplementation a coherent premise on this axis and hardly a duplication, while whether 3 g/day does anything useful in healthy trained people is a separate and much weaker question, and the form matters, since the free acid and the calcium salt differ in absorption rate and peak plasma concentration.HMB 是 leucine 的正常人体代谢产物, leucine 被代谢时就会生成, 但只有全身 leucine 通量的约 5% 走这个分支, 在 70 kg 成人相当于每天约 0.2 到 0.4 g。被研究的剂量是 3 g/day, 靠食物达到需要约 60 g leucine, 即超过 600 g 优质蛋白, 所以内源生成真实存在, 却只有受试剂量的十分之一左右。这使补充在这条轴上成为自洽的前提, 谈不上重复; 3 g/day 在健康训练人群里是否有用是另一个证据弱得多的问题, 剂型也有影响, 游离酸与钙盐在吸收速率和血浆峰浓度上不同。

What it does它有什么作用

Beta-hydroxy-beta-methylbutyrate is a downstream metabolite of the amino acid leucine. About 5 percent of leucine catabolism proceeds through ketoisocaproate to HMB, so at ordinary protein intakes the body produces only about 0.2 to 0.4 g a day from dietary leucine, and preformed HMB in food (grapefruit, catfish, alfalfa, corn silage) is present in milligram quantities and contributes essentially nothing. The scale is easier to see from the other direction: obtaining a typical 3 g supplemental dose from food would require the 60 g of leucine contained in over 600 g of high quality protein. Its main described action is suppression of muscle proteolysis through the ubiquitin-proteasome pathway, with a weaker effect on mTOR-mediated protein synthesis than leucine itself. Clinical interest sits in muscle-wasting settings such as bed rest, older adults and cancer cachexia. It is a metabolite of an essential amino acid, not an essential nutrient in its own right.β-羟基-β-甲基丁酸是氨基酸亮氨酸的下游代谢产物。亮氨酸分解代谢中约5%经α-酮异己酸途径生成HMB,因此在通常的蛋白质摄入水平下,人体每天仅由膳食亮氨酸生成约0.2至0.4 g HMB,而食物(西柚、鲶鱼、苜蓿、青贮玉米)中天然存在的HMB仅为毫克级,贡献基本可以忽略。从另一个角度更容易看出其量级:要从食物中获得典型的3 g补充剂量,需要摄入600多克优质蛋白质中所含的60 g亮氨酸。其已知的主要作用是通过泛素蛋白酶体途径抑制肌肉蛋白水解,对mTOR介导的蛋白质合成的促进作用则弱于亮氨酸本身。临床关注点在于肌肉消耗相关情境,如卧床、老年人和癌症恶病质。它是一种必需氨基酸的代谢产物,本身并非必需营养素。

Clinical dosing is 120-240 mg/day of EGb 761. At a 35-67:1 drug-to-extract ratio that corresponds to 4.2-16 g of dried ginkgo leaf per day, and dried leaf is not something people eat; a leaf tea extracts only part of the terpene lactones and none of the concentration. Via the edible nut the gap cannot be closed at all, because the nut does not carry the leaf profile, and attempting it would be dangerous rather than merely futile: acute poisoning has been reported after 10-50 cooked seeds at one sitting, Hong Kong's Centre for Food Safety advises no more than 10 kernels a day for adults and three for children, and cooking does not destroy ginkgotoxin because it is heat-stable. Standardised extracts contain flavonol glycosides of quercetin and kaempferol plus the terpene trilactones ginkgolide A, B, C, J and bilobalide, a group of molecules found only in Ginkgo biloba. No human tissue produces flavonoids or ginkgolides, so intake is entirely exogenous. That removes any deficiency-correction claim and leaves the outcome trials, which have been largely negative for preventing cognitive decline.标准化提取物含槲皮素和山奈酚的黄酮醇糖苷, 以及萜类三内酯 ginkgolide A, B, C, J 和 bilobalide, 这组分子只见于 Ginkgo biloba。人体任何组织都不产生类黄酮或银杏内酯, 所以摄入完全是外源的。这样一来纠正缺乏的说法就不成立, 只剩结局试验, 而这些试验在预防认知衰退上大体为阴性。

What it does它有什么作用

Standardised extracts such as EGb 761 contain about 24% flavone glycosides and 6% terpene lactones, the latter comprising ginkgolides A, B and C plus bilobalide, with ginkgolide B acting as a platelet-activating factor antagonist. The largest prevention trial, the Ginkgo Evaluation of Memory study, randomised 3069 community volunteers aged 75 and over and followed them for a median 6.1 years, finding no reduction in all-cause dementia or Alzheimer disease. Ginkgolides and bilobalide are plant terpenoids absent from human metabolism, so no shortfall is possible from not taking them. The clinically relevant issue is the opposite direction: antiplatelet effect layered onto anticoagulants or aspirin.标准化提取物如EGb 761含约24%黄酮苷及6%萜内酯,后者包括银杏内酯A、B、C(ginkgolides A、B、C)和白果内酯(bilobalide),其中银杏内酯B是血小板活化因子的拮抗剂。规模最大的预防性试验,即银杏记忆评估研究,纳入3069名75岁及以上的社区志愿者,中位随访6.1年,结果显示对全因痴呆或阿尔茨海默病(Alzheimer disease)没有降低作用。银杏内酯和白果内酯是植物萜类化合物,人体代谢中不存在,因此不摄入它们不会造成任何短缺。真正具有临床意义的问题方向恰恰相反:抗血小板作用叠加在抗凝药或阿司匹林之上。

Typical use is 400-900 mg of dried root extract before bed, or 2-3 g of dried root as an infusion. A quality target of at least 3 mg/g valerenic acid in the dried root has been recommended for commercial material and marketed extracts are sold around 0.8% valerenic acid, so a night's dose is roughly 3-8 mg of valerenic acid. Valerian's activity is attributed to valerenic acid and the valepotriates, sesquiterpenes whose carbon skeleton is built by a plant terpene synthase (valerenadiene synthase) found in Valeriana officinalis roots. Humans use farnesyl diphosphate for sterols, dolichol, the polyprenyl side chain of ubiquinone (CoQ10), the farnesyl group of heme A and protein farnesylation and geranylgeranylation, and have no sesquiterpene cyclase to close a valerenane ring. Valeriana officinalis root yields valerenic acid, valerenol and a variable mixture of valepotriates whose content differs widely between commercial products and degrades on storage. Valerenic acid binds a distinct site on GABA-A receptors that depends on the beta2 and beta3 subunits: the N265M point mutation in those subunits abolishes the drug response, and valerenic acid and valerenol are anxiolytic in mouse elevated plus-maze and light/dark tests. Rhodiola rosea rhizome supplies the rosavins (rosavin, rosin, rosarin) and salidroside, and the best studied preparation, SHR-5, is standardised to roughly 3% rosavins and 1% salidroside. Proposed actions include weak monoamine oxidase inhibition and blunting of stress-induced cortisol responses, neither well characterised in humans. A 2021 systematic review of 39 randomised trials spanning four Rhodiola species (23 of R. rosea, 8 of R. crenulata, 8 of R. wallichiana and 1 of R. sacra, the last excluded from quality assessment) found that no study met all CONSORT criteria, so reporting quality is too poor to support firm efficacy conclusions and trials of different species are routinely conflated. An earlier review restricted to 11 placebo-controlled trials of R. rosea alone judged methodological quality moderate or good (5 of 10 scored above 3 on Jadad) and concluded the species may benefit physical performance, mental performance and certain mental-health conditions, its stated limitation being the absence of independent replication. Hericium erinaceus fruiting bodies contain hericenones and the mycelium contains erinacines, both of which stimulate nerve growth factor synthesis in cultured cells, with erinacine A shown to cross the blood-brain barrier in animals. Bacopa monnieri contains triterpenoid saponins known as bacosides, and extracts are standardised to bacoside content, typically 20 to 55%. To match that from food用食物达到该剂量

For 5-HTP itself the gap is absolute: no food contains it in measurable quantity, so no eating quantity reproduces the 50-300 mg/day used in trials. From the manufacturing raw material, 100 mg of 5-HTP sits in about 0.64 g of Griffonia seed at 156 mg/g, a striking number and irrelevant to eating, since Griffonia seed is not a food and carries other constituents. Via the dietary precursor the arithmetic runs deceptively the other way. An ordinary mixed diet supplies roughly 900-1000 mg of tryptophan a day, three to twenty times a 5-HTP dose by mass, and a single chicken breast supplies 434 mg, yet that intake does not act like 5-HTP for three reasons. Over 95% of tryptophan is degraded down the kynurenine pathway by TDO and IDO, with only about 1-2% passing through tryptophan hydroxylase to serotonin (PMC5398323; PMC9292703). Tryptophan competes with the other large neutral amino acids, leucine, isoleucine, valine, phenylalanine and tyrosine, for the LAT1 transporter at the blood-brain barrier, and every protein food raises tryptophan and its competitors together, so a high-protein meal can leave the brain tryptophan ratio flat or lower. And tryptophan hydroxylase is the regulated rate-limiting step, so raising substrate does little. 5-HTP sidesteps all three: it is past the rate-limiting hydroxylation and is decarboxylated by ubiquitous AADC. Adding 300 mg of tryptophan to a meal is therefore not equivalent to 300 mg of 5-HTP, and no realistic quantity of food makes it so.就 5-HTP 本身而言，差距是绝对的：没有食物含有可测量的量，所以没有任何进食量能重现试验所用的 50-300 mg/天。从生产原料看，按 156 mg/g 计算，100 mg 5-HTP 存在于约 0.64 g Griffonia 种子中，这个数字很惊人，与吃东西无关，因为 Griffonia 种子不是食物，还含有其他成分。走膳食前体这条路，算术的方向反而具有欺骗性。普通混合膳食每天提供约 900-1000 mg 色氨酸，按质量计是 5-HTP 剂量的三到二十倍，单块鸡胸肉就提供 434 mg，但这种摄入不会像 5-HTP 那样起作用，原因有三。超过 95% 的色氨酸经 TDO 和 IDO 沿犬尿氨酸通路降解，只有约 1-2% 经色氨酸羟化酶转向血清素（PMC5398323；PMC9292703）。色氨酸要与其他大分子中性氨基酸（亮氨酸、异亮氨酸、缬氨酸、苯丙氨酸和酪氨酸）竞争血脑屏障上的 LAT1 转运体，而每种蛋白质食物都会同时提高色氨酸和它的竞争者，所以一顿高蛋白餐可能让脑内色氨酸比值持平甚至下降。而色氨酸羟化酶是受调控的限速步骤，提高底物作用很小。5-HTP 绕开了这三点：它已越过限速的羟化步骤，并由普遍存在的 AADC 脱羧。因此在一餐中加 300 mg 色氨酸并不等于 300 mg 5-HTP，任何现实的食物量都做不到这一点。

Does the body make it身体是否自产

Every serotonin-producing cell makes its own 5-HTP continuously from dietary tryptophan, and none of it accumulates because aromatic L-amino acid decarboxylase converts it straight to serotonin. The recovered row labelled it INTERMEDIATE because 5-HTP is an obligate transient intermediate with no storage pool, no dietary requirement and no measurable body pool; on this enum it rolls up to FULL, since the human pathway is complete and covers basal need in health. Tryptophan hydroxylase is the rate-limiting and regulated step, and swallowing 5-HTP forces the pathway past that control point, producing serotonin wherever aromatic L-amino acid decarboxylase sits, mainly the gut, where most body serotonin already is.每个产血清素的细胞都在用膳食色氨酸持续生成自己的 5-HTP, 而且不会积累, 因为 aromatic L-amino acid decarboxylase 立刻把它转成血清素。原条目标为 INTERMEDIATE, 理由是 5-HTP 是必经的瞬时中间体, 没有储存池, 没有膳食需要量, 也没有可测的体内池; 在本枚举下归入 FULL, 因为人体通路完整且健康时覆盖基础需要。tryptophan hydroxylase 是限速且受调控的一步, 口服 5-HTP 会把途径推过这个控制点, 在任何有 aromatic L-amino acid decarboxylase 的地方生成血清素, 主要是肠道, 而全身大部分血清素本来就在那里。

What it does它有什么作用

5-hydroxytryptophan is the intermediate between the essential amino acid tryptophan and serotonin: tryptophan hydroxylase produces it, and aromatic L-amino acid decarboxylase converts it onward to serotonin. Supplemental 5-HTP bypasses the rate-limiting hydroxylation step and escapes diversion into the kynurenine pathway, which is why it raises serotonin synthesis more directly than tryptophan does, including in peripheral tissues where that is not wanted. Ordinary food supplies essentially none of it; the dietary requirement is for tryptophan, and that is where any nutritional argument belongs. Impaired central serotonin synthesis in tetrahydrobiopterin disorders and in aromatic L-amino acid decarboxylase deficiency is an inborn error of metabolism, entirely separate from intake, and 5-HTP is prescribed or withheld in those conditions on genetic grounds.5-羟色氨酸(5-HTP)是必需氨基酸色氨酸(tryptophan)与血清素之间的中间产物:由色氨酸羟化酶(tryptophan hydroxylase)生成,再由芳香族L-氨基酸脱羧酶(aromatic L-amino acid decarboxylase)进一步转化为血清素。补充的5-HTP绕过了限速的羟化步骤,并避开了向犬尿氨酸通路的分流,这就是它比色氨酸更直接地提高血清素合成的原因,包括在不希望发生此事的外周组织中。普通食物基本不提供5-HTP,膳食需求针对的是色氨酸,任何营养学论证都应落在色氨酸上。四氢生物蝶呤(tetrahydrobiopterin)代谢障碍及芳香族L-氨基酸脱羧酶缺乏症中出现的中枢血清素合成受损,是一种先天性代谢缺陷,与摄入量完全无关,在这些情况下是否使用5-HTP是基于遗传学理由决定的。

Dose tested已验证剂量

MK-7 180-720 µg/d in trials. MK-4 45 mg/d in the Japanese fracture trial, roughly 250 times the MK-7 dose.试验中 MK-7 为 180 至 720 微克/天。日本骨折试验中 MK-4 为 45 毫克/天，约为 MK-7 剂量的 250 倍。

To match that from food用食物达到该剂量

MK-7 and MK-4 give opposite answers. MK-7 at supplement and trial doses of 90 to 180 µg/day is fully covered by food: one 50 g pack of natto carries 470 µg, so a pack every second or third day matches a 180 µg capsule. Nothing else comes close, since 180 µg/day from cheddar at 2.7 µg MK-7 per 100 g would take 6.7 kg of cheese daily and from butter about 4.3 kg. MK-4 is the reverse. The Japanese clinical dose, menatetrenone for osteoporosis, is 45 mg/day (45,000 µg), usually 15 mg three times daily. At the richest food value in the composition literature, goose liver paste at about 369 µg/100 g, that is 12.2 kg per day, and at barbecue chicken's 22.1 µg/100 g it is about 204 kg. Even a modest 1.5 mg consumer MK-4 pill needs 407 g of goose liver paste, 6.8 kg of chicken, or 150 kg of whole milk. Measured whole-diet MK-4 intake sits around 17 µg/day (7.3% of a mean total vitamin K intake of about 230 µg/day in Japanese women, Kamao 2007), roughly one 2,600th of the pharmacological dose. MK-4 at supplement strength is unreachable by eating.MK-7 和 MK-4 给出相反的答案。MK-7 在 90 至 180 µg/天 的补充剂和试验剂量上完全能由食物覆盖：一盒 50 g 纳豆含 470 µg，每两三天吃一盒就相当于一粒 180 µg 胶囊。别的食物都远远不及，按切达奶酪 2.7 µg MK-7/100 g 计算，每天 180 µg 需要 6.7 kg 奶酪，用黄油则约 4.3 kg。MK-4 的情况相反。日本用于骨质疏松的临床剂量，四烯甲萘醌，为 45 mg/天（45,000 µg），通常一日三次、每次 15 mg。按成分文献中最高的食物数值，鹅肝酱约 369 µg/100 g，这相当于每天 12.2 kg；按烧烤鸡肉 22.1 µg/100 g 计算约为 204 kg。哪怕是一粒普通消费级 1.5 mg 的 MK-4 药片，也需要 407 g 鹅肝酱、6.8 kg 鸡肉，或 150 kg 全脂牛奶。实测整膳食 MK-4 摄入量约为 17 µg/天（日本女性维生素 K 总摄入量约 230 µg/天，MK-4 占 7.3%，Kamao 2007），大约是药理剂量的 1/2,600。补充剂强度的 MK-4 靠吃达不到。

Does the body make it身体是否自产

Humans cannot make the naphthoquinone ring, so vitamin K itself is strictly dietary, while UBIAD1 prenylates menadione derived from dietary phylloquinone (K1) to MK-4 in most tissues, which means the MK-4 in artery wall, bone and brain is already partly endogenous. MK-7 and the longer chains MK-7 to MK-13 are bacterial products that humans do not synthesise, and the colonic contribution is modest and hard to quantify because much of it stays unabsorbed. PARTIAL is the roll-up for the pair: supplementing MK-4 duplicates a conversion the body already runs on ordinary K1 intake, and the honest case for an MK-7 product is pharmacokinetic (a much longer half-life than K1) and dietary, for people eating little natto, cheese or leafy greens.人体无法合成萘醌环, 所以维生素 K 本身严格依赖膳食; 而 UBIAD1 在多数组织中把源自膳食 phylloquinone (K1) 的 menadione 异戊烯化为 MK-4, 因此动脉壁, 骨与脑中的 MK-4 已经部分是内源的。MK-7 以及 MK-7 至 MK-13 的长链形式是细菌产物, 人体不合成, 结肠的贡献不大且难以量化, 因为其中很大一部分留在结肠未被吸收。两者合起来的标签是 PARTIAL: 补充 MK-4 重复了身体在普通 K1 摄入下本就在做的转化, 而支持 MK-7 产品的合理理由在于药代动力学 (半衰期远长于 K1) 和膳食 (纳豆, 干酪或深色叶菜吃得很少的人)。

What it does它有什么作用

Every form of vitamin K works as the cofactor for gamma-glutamyl carboxylase, the enzyme that converts specific glutamate residues into gamma-carboxyglutamate (Gla), giving those proteins the ability to bind calcium and function. In the liver this activates clotting factors II, VII, IX and X together with the anticoagulant proteins C, S and Z, which is the function the dietary requirement is set on. Outside the liver the same reaction activates osteocalcin in bone and matrix Gla protein in vascular smooth muscle, matrix Gla protein being a local inhibitor of arterial calcification. MK-7 differs from phylloquinone (K1) mainly in pharmacokinetics: a long isoprenoid side chain gives it a circulating half-life of days rather than hours, so it reaches extrahepatic tissue more consistently. MK-4 is the form tissues synthesise for themselves from K1 or menadione via UBIAD1, and as a supplement it clears within hours. Whether raising menaquinone intake above the amount that maintains normal carboxylation changes bone or vascular outcomes is a question about supplementation, separate from the vitamin's essential role.各种形式的维生素K都作为γ-谷氨酰羧化酶（gamma-glutamyl carboxylase）的辅因子发挥作用，该酶将特定谷氨酸残基转化为γ-羧基谷氨酸（Gla），使相关蛋白获得结合钙并发挥功能的能力。在肝脏中，这一反应激活凝血因子II、VII、IX和X，以及抗凝蛋白C、S和Z，这也是膳食需求量所依据的功能。在肝脏之外，同样的反应激活骨骼中的骨钙素（osteocalcin）及血管平滑肌中的基质Gla蛋白（matrix Gla protein），后者是动脉钙化的局部抑制因子。MK-7与叶绿醌（phylloquinone，K1）的主要区别在于药代动力学：其较长的异戊二烯侧链使其循环半衰期为数天而非数小时，因而能更稳定地到达肝外组织。MK-4是组织通过UBIAD1由K1或甲萘醌自行合成的形式，作为补充剂时其清除时间为数小时。将甲萘醌摄入量提高到超过维持正常羧化所需水平是否会改变骨骼或血管相关结局，属于补充剂层面的问题，不同于该维生素本身的必需作用。

If you lack it缺乏会怎样

In newborns, classic VKDB appears in the first week as bleeding from the umbilical stump, gastrointestinal tract, circumcision site or puncture wounds. Late VKDB appears at 2 to 12 weeks and is the dangerous form: roughly half of cases present with intracranial haemorrhage, causing death or lasting neurological injury. In adults with severe malabsorption, cholestasis or prolonged broad-spectrum antibiotics plus poor intake, deficiency produces spontaneous gastrointestinal, retroperitoneal or intracranial bleeding.新生儿中，经典型VKDB在出生第一周内出现，表现为脐残端、消化道、包皮环切部位或穿刺伤口出血。迟发型VKDB出现于出生后2至12周，是危险性更高的类型：约半数病例表现为颅内出血，导致死亡或永久性神经损伤。成人中，若存在严重吸收不良、胆汁淤积，或长期使用广谱抗生素合并摄入不足，缺乏可导致自发性消化道、腹膜后或颅内出血。

Does it reverse补回来能修复吗

The coagulopathy itself corrects completely and quickly: parenteral vitamin K restores clotting factor activity within hours, and prothrombin complex concentrate acts immediately. What does not reverse is the injury from a bleed that has already happened, and intracranial haemorrhage in late VKDB leaves permanent neurological deficit or death in a substantial proportion of affected infants. This is why prophylaxis at birth matters more than treatment.凝血功能障碍本身可完全且迅速纠正：肠外途径给予维生素K可在数小时内恢复凝血因子活性，凝血酶原复合物浓缩剂则可立即起效。无法逆转的是已经发生的出血所造成的损伤，迟发型VKDB中的颅内出血会使相当一部分患儿遗留永久性神经损害或死亡。这正是出生时预防性用药比事后治疗更重要的原因。

Who it is for适用人群

See the strain-specific entry in the Consider tier. A blend with no strain designators has nothing behind it.见“可以考虑”一档中的菌株特异性条目。不标菌株编号的复方产品背后没有任何依据。

Dose tested已验证剂量

Marketed as 50 billion CFU and similar. The dose threshold that matters is at least 5 billion CFU/d, but only for the two specific indications.常以“500 亿 CFU”之类标示。真正有意义的剂量门槛是至少 50 亿 CFU/天，但只对那两个特定适应证有效。

To match that from food用食物达到该剂量

For total live cells there is no gap. The source review calculates that about 10^10 cells is the intake likely needed to affect the microbiota and that this is met by 100 g of a food carrying 10^8 cells/g (PMID 30197628). One cup of kefir, one cup of yoghurt, about 120 g of raw sauerkraut, a cup of kimchi or a cup of natto each clear that bar, and kimchi at the top of its measured range delivers more live organisms in one serving than most 50-billion-CFU capsules. The gap is qualitative: identity, characterisation and consistency. Fermented food counts vary across four to six orders of magnitude between products and batches (yoghurt below 10^4 to 10^9 CFU/g), the organisms are usually not identified to strain, and none of them are the strains on the label of the blend.就活菌总数而言不存在差距。原综述估算，可能影响菌群所需的摄入量约为 10^10 个菌体，而 100 g 含 10^8 菌体/g 的食物即可达到（PMID 30197628）。一杯开菲尔、一杯酸奶、约 120 g 生德式酸菜、一杯韩式泡菜或一杯纳豆都能越过这条线，处于实测区间上端的韩式泡菜一份提供的活菌数超过大多数标称 50 billion CFU 的胶囊。差距是定性的：身份、表征和一致性。发酵食品的菌数在不同产品和批次之间跨越四到六个数量级（酸奶从低于 10^4 到 10^9 CFU/g），其中的微生物通常没有鉴定到菌株层面，而且没有一个是复配产品标签上的菌株。

Does the body make it身体是否自产

Same axis mismatch as any probiotic, since these are living organisms, with an additional problem specific to blends: labels that name only genus and species carry no evidence, because probiotic effects are strain-specific. Laboratory checking of commercial products supports that concern, though the cited evidence is one survey: Kesavelu 2020 tested 20 products sold in India (8 single-strain, 12 multi-strain) and reported poor correlation between label and laboratory values for viable count, genus and species identification and contaminants, without giving a numeric mismatch rate. A blend cannot inherit the trial record of a product it does not actually contain, so more strains on the label does not mean more evidence.与任何益生菌一样存在轴不匹配的问题, 因为对象是活体生物; 复方还多一层麻烦: 只写属和种的标签不带任何证据, 因为益生菌效应是菌株特异的。对市售产品的实验室检测支持这一担忧, 但所引证据只有一项调查: Kesavelu 2020 检测了在印度销售的 20 个产品 (8 个单菌株, 12 个复方), 报告标签值与实验室值在活菌数, 属种鉴定和污染物方面相关性差, 未给出量化的不符率。复方不能继承一个它实际并不含有的产品的试验记录, 标签上菌株更多也不等于证据更多。

What it does它有什么作用

These products name only genus and species (Lactobacillus acidophilus, Bifidobacterium bifidum and similar) and omit the alphanumeric strain designation on which the entire clinical evidence base is built, so no published result can legitimately be attributed to what is in the capsule. Independent testing repeatedly finds discrepancies between labelled and actual colony-forming units, species misidentification, and organisms no longer viable at the end of shelf life. Adding more strains does not sum their individual effects; strains can antagonise one another through bacteriocins and niche competition, and mixtures are rarely tested as mixtures. Because this is a commercial product category rather than a nutrient, no requirement and no deficiency state exists.这类产品只标注属名和种名(如嗜酸乳杆菌Lactobacillus acidophilus、两歧双歧杆菌Bifidobacterium bifidum等),省略了整个临床证据基础所依赖的字母数字菌株编号,因此已发表的任何结果都不能合理归因于胶囊中的实际内容物。独立检测反复发现标签菌落形成单位(CFU)与实际含量不符、菌种鉴定错误,以及在保质期结束时已不再存活的菌体。增加菌株种类并不等于各菌株效果的叠加,菌株之间可通过细菌素和生态位竞争相互拮抗,而混合制剂很少作为整体进行测试。由于这是一个商业产品类别而非营养素,因此不存在需求,也不存在缺乏状态。

Who it is for适用人群

On current evidence, no clearly identifiable group.按现有证据，没有可清楚界定的适用人群。

Dose tested已验证剂量

1 billion CFU/d, one capsule, assessed at 4 weeks. This is the trialled dose, not a dose shown to work.10 亿 CFU/天，每日一粒，4 周后评估。这是试验用的剂量，不是被证明有效的剂量。

To match that from food用食物达到该剂量

No quantity of any food supplies this strain. The trial dose is small in absolute terms, 1x10^8 CFU, which is roughly the number of live bacteria in half a gram of unpasteurised sauerkraut at 8.3 log CFU/g, so the dose is not the obstacle and the identity is. Fermented foods can supply a thousand times more live cells than the effective dose of 35624 while supplying none of it. Note that the source trial expressed its doses as CFU/mL rather than CFU/day.任何食物的任何摄入量都无法提供这个菌株。试验剂量在绝对值上很小，1x10^8 CFU，大致相当于 8.3 log CFU/g 的未杀菌德式酸菜半克中的活菌数，所以障碍与剂量无关，障碍在于身份。发酵食品能提供比 35624 有效剂量多一千倍的活菌，却一个 35624 都提供不了。请注意，原始试验把剂量表述为 CFU/mL 而非 CFU/day。

Does the body make it身体是否自产

This is a live organism, so the synthesis axis does not apply and the body never makes bacteria under any circumstances. Whole-genome sequencing and core-genome phylogenetic taxon assignment reclassified the strain from Bifidobacterium infantis to Bifidobacterium longum subsp. longum 35624, a common adult coloniser, so the infant-coloniser and adult colonisation-gap argument built on the old name does not apply and has been dropped. What distinguishes 35624 is the trial record: a fully identified single strain tested against placebo at a stated dose, which is the standard the rest of the category should be held to, and the reclassification does not affect those strain-specific results.这是活体生物, 合成这条轴不适用, 人体在任何情况下都不制造细菌。全基因组测序和核心基因组系统发生分类把该菌株从 Bifidobacterium infantis 重新归类为 Bifidobacterium longum subsp. longum 35624, 这是成人常见的定植菌, 所以建立在旧名称上的婴儿定植菌和成人定植缺口论证不成立, 已删除。35624 的特点在于试验记录: 一个完全鉴定的单一菌株在明确剂量下与安慰剂对照, 这正是这一类别其余产品应达到的标准; 重新分类不影响这些菌株特异的结果。

What it does它有什么作用

Bifidobacterium longum subsp. infantis 35624, still widely labelled Bifidobacterium infantis 35624, was isolated from healthy human gut mucosa and is one of the few probiotic strains tested at a defined dose in a trial large enough to matter. In 362 primary care women with irritable bowel syndrome of any bowel habit subtype, 1 x 10^8 cfu daily for 4 weeks was superior to placebo for abdominal pain and for a composite of bloating, bowel dysfunction, incomplete evacuation, straining and passage of gas, with global symptom improvement exceeding placebo by more than 20%; higher and lower doses did not work, which is itself informative about formulation. Proposed mechanisms include induction of regulatory T cells and reduction in circulating pro-inflammatory cytokines. It is a live organism administered as a therapy, so nobody is short of it and there is no deficiency state to describe.长双歧杆菌婴儿亚种35624(Bifidobacterium longum subsp. infantis 35624),目前仍广泛标注为Bifidobacterium infantis 35624,分离自健康人体肠道黏膜,是少数在足够规模的试验中以确定剂量测试过的益生菌菌株之一。在362名任意肠道习惯亚型的肠易激综合征初级保健女性患者中,每日1×10^8 cfu、持续4周,在腹痛以及由腹胀、排便功能障碍、排便不尽感、用力排便和排气组成的综合评分方面均优于安慰剂,总体症状改善超出安慰剂组20%以上;更高或更低剂量均无效,这一点本身也提示了配方的重要性。所提出的机制包括诱导调节性T细胞及降低循环促炎细胞因子水平。它是作为一种疗法给予的活微生物,因此没有人会短缺它,也不存在需要描述的缺乏状态。

That is a biomarker advantage.最多适用于希望用更小剂量把 omega-3 指数提上去的人。那是生物标志物层面的优势。
Who it is for适用人群

At most, people wanting a given rise in omega-3 index from a smaller dose. That is a biomarker advantage.最多适用于希望用更小剂量把 omega-3 指数提上去的人。那是生物标志物层面的优势。

Dose tested已验证剂量

2 g/d for 24 weeks in the knee osteoarthritis trial. Bioavailability trials used about 1.1 g/d of actual omega-3.膝骨关节炎试验为 2 克/天、持续 24 周。生物利用度试验用的是实际 omega-3 约 1.1 克/天。

To match that from food用食物达到该剂量

There is effectively no gap, which is the useful finding. Measured EPA plus DHA in 20 commercial krill oils from the Korean market spanned 14.2-34.8% of total fatty acids (Lee 2024, PMID 39233519, DOI 10.4014/jmb.2406.06026, range confirmed; the sampling is one national market). Converting that percentage to capsule mass overstates the content, because total fatty acids are less than capsule mass once phospholipid head groups, free sterols, astaxanthin and excipients are counted, so every figure that follows is a ceiling rather than a point estimate. A 1 g capsule carries at most roughly 140-350 mg EPA+DHA. Two capsules (2 g) deliver at most about 280-700 mg, which is matched or beaten by one 92 g tin of sardines (903 mg), one 45 g tin of anchovies (924 mg), one mackerel fillet (1,059 mg) or one tablespoon of caviar (1,046 mg). At the top of the trial range, 4 g/day of krill oil supplies at most roughly 570-1,400 mg, equal to at most 0.6-1.5 tins of sardines. Because these are ceilings, the real gap runs further in favour of fish than the raw numbers suggest. Going the other way, matching a krill oil dose by eating krill is not a real option: the catch is not sold as food outside a small Japanese and Russian market, and the shell must be removed for fluoride reasons.实际上不存在差距，这本身就是有用的结论。对韩国市场 20 种商品磷虾油的实测显示，EPA 加 DHA 占总脂肪酸的 14.2-34.8%（Lee 2024, PMID 39233519, DOI 10.4014/jmb.2406.06026，区间已确认；取样限于一个国家的市场）。把这个百分比直接换算成胶囊质量会高估含量，因为计入磷脂头基、游离甾醇、虾青素和辅料后，总脂肪酸低于胶囊质量，所以下面每个数字都是上限，不能当作点估计。一粒 1 g 胶囊最多含约 140-350 mg EPA+DHA。两粒（2 g）最多提供约 280-700 mg，一罐 92 g 沙丁鱼（903 mg）、一罐 45 g 凤尾鱼（924 mg）、一片鲭鱼柳（1,059 mg）或一汤匙鱼子酱（1,046 mg）都能与之相当或超过。取试验剂量范围的上端，4 g/day 磷虾油最多提供约 570-1,400 mg，最多相当于 0.6-1.5 罐沙丁鱼。由于这些都是上限，真实差距比原始数字显示的更偏向鱼类。反过来看，靠吃磷虾来匹配磷虾油剂量并不现实：除了日本和俄罗斯的小规模市场，渔获并不作为食品销售，而且出于氟的原因必须去壳。

Does the body make it身体是否自产

Taken as a product the roll-up is PARTIAL, because its main actives are the same EPA and DHA the body can only build partially from dietary ALA, with limited EPA synthesis and DHA synthesis that is undetectable in young men. The exception is astaxanthin, which is NONE: vertebrates including humans have no carotenoid biosynthetic pathway and can only cleave or modify what they eat, unlike aphids, spider mites and some other arthropods that synthesise carotenoids using horizontally transferred genes. Nothing in the product duplicates something the body already makes in quantity, so the real caveat is dose rather than redundancy, since krill oil carries less EPA and DHA per gram than concentrated fish or algal oil and the milligrams on the label matter more than the phospholipid-form claim.作为产品整体判为 PARTIAL，因为它的主要活性成分就是身体只能从膳食 ALA 部分合成的 EPA 和 DHA：EPA 合成有限，DHA 合成在年轻男性中检测不到。例外是虾青素，它属于 NONE，脊椎动物（包括人）不具备类胡萝卜素生物合成通路，只能对吃进来的类胡萝卜素做裂解或修饰，而蚜虫、叶螨和另一些节肢动物则通过横向转移获得的基因能够从头合成。产品中没有任何成分重复身体已能充分制造的物质，所以真正需要提醒的是剂量而非冗余：磷虾油每克所含的 EPA 和 DHA 少于浓缩鱼油或藻油，标签上的毫克数比磷脂形式这套说法更重要。

What it does它有什么作用

Krill oil is extracted from Euphausia superba. Its distinguishing feature is chemical form: a large share of the EPA and DHA is esterified to phospholipid, mainly phosphatidylcholine, with some present as free fatty acid, whereas fish oil carries them as triglycerides or ethyl esters. This alters absorption kinetics. It also contains small amounts of astaxanthin, a carotenoid acting as an antioxidant within the oil. EPA plus DHA content per capsule is typically lower than in fish oil, so dose comparisons need to be made per milligram of omega-3. Acute crossover studies find equal or modestly higher plasma phospholipid incorporation from krill per unit EPA plus DHA (PMID 21854650), but a reanalysis of these studies concluded the acute differences have not translated reliably into different long-term omega-3 status (PMID 25156381).磷虾油提取自南极磷虾(Euphausia superba)。其显著特点在于化学形式:相当一部分EPA和DHA以磷脂形式酯化,主要是磷脂酰胆碱,部分以游离脂肪酸形式存在,而鱼油中这些成分则以甘油三酯或乙酯形式存在。这会改变吸收动力学。磷虾油还含有少量虾青素,一种在油脂中起抗氧化作用的类胡萝卜素。每粒胶囊所含的EPA加DHA通常低于鱼油,因此剂量比较需按每毫克omega-3计算。急性交叉研究发现,按每单位EPA加DHA计算,磷虾来源的血浆磷脂掺入量相等或略高(PMID 21854650),但一项对这些研究的再分析认为,这种急性差异并未可靠地转化为长期omega-3水平的差异(PMID 25156381)。

Who it is for适用人群

Arguably nobody, given modern alternatives.考虑到现代替代品，可以说没有适用人群。

Dose tested已验证剂量

No established effective dose for any endpoint. The binding constraint is retinol, not omega-3.对任何终点都没有确立的有效剂量。真正的限制因素是视黄醇，不是 omega-3。

To match that from food用食物达到该剂量

For the EPA and DHA at a traditional teaspoon dose there is no gap, and food matches it easily: 806 mg per teaspoon is a little under one 92 g tin of sardines (903 mg) and about a quarter of a herring fillet (2,873 mg). Cod liver oil is also efficient in the other direction: 250-500 mg/day of EPA+DHA needs only 1.4-2.8 g of oil, a third to two thirds of a teaspoon, carrying 419-838 ug RAE of vitamin A, comfortably inside the 3,000 ug/day UL. The gap that opens at pharmacological doses is a toxicity gap rather than a volume one. Reaching 4 g/day of EPA+DHA takes 22.3 g of cod liver oil, about 1.6 tablespoons, delivering 6,704 ug RAE of preformed vitamin A every day, 2.2 times the EFSA adult UL. Traditional cod liver oil therefore cannot be dose-escalated to the level used in triglyceride-lowering trials, and food cannot reach 4 g/day either (see the Omega-3 entry). That is what plain fish oil and purified concentrates exist for.在传统的一茶匙剂量上，EPA 和 DHA 不存在差距，食物很容易匹配：每茶匙 806 mg，略低于一罐 92 g 沙丁鱼（903 mg），约为一片鲱鱼柳（2,873 mg）的四分之一。反过来看鳕鱼肝油也很高效：250-500 mg/day 的 EPA+DHA 只需 1.4-2.8 g 油，即三分之一到三分之二茶匙，随之摄入 419-838 ug RAE 维生素 A，稳稳低于 3,000 ug/day 的 UL。药理剂量下出现的差距是毒性上的差距，与吃得下多少无关。达到 4 g/day 的 EPA+DHA 需要 22.3 g 鳕鱼肝油，约 1.6 汤匙，每天随之摄入 6,704 ug RAE 预形成维生素 A，为 EFSA 成人 UL 的 2.2 倍。因此传统鳕鱼肝油无法加量到降甘油三酯试验所用的水平，食物同样达不到 4 g/day（见欧米伽-3 条目）。这正是普通鱼油和纯化浓缩物存在的理由。

Does the body make it身体是否自产

As a product the roll-up is PARTIAL, since cod liver oil bundles three actives with three different verdicts and the body covers only part of what is in the bottle. Its EPA and DHA are partly synthesisable from dietary ALA (PARTIAL), its vitamin D3 is genuinely manufactured in your own skin from 7-dehydrocholesterol whenever UVB reaches it, with cutaneous synthesis alone able to meet requirement and no risk of toxicity because previtamin D3 photodegrades and CYP24A1 clears the active hormone (FULL, conditional on exposure), and its retinol cannot be built at all because human cells only cleave dietary provitamin A carotenoids (NONE). For anyone with real sun exposure the redundant part is the vitamin D, and the retinol load makes this a poor carrier, since plain D3 plus fish or algal oil gives the same benefit without pushing retinol towards the upper limit.作为产品整体判为 PARTIAL：鱼肝油把三种活性成分捆在一起，三者的结论各不相同，身体只能覆盖瓶子里的一部分。它的 EPA 和 DHA 只能从膳食 ALA 部分合成（PARTIAL）；它的维生素D3 确实由自己的皮肤用 7-脱氢胆固醇制造，只要 UVB 照到皮肤，单靠皮肤合成就能满足需要量，而且不会中毒，因为前维生素D3 会光降解，CYP24A1 会清除活性激素（FULL，以有日照为条件）；它的视黄醇则完全无法从头合成，人体细胞只能裂解膳食中的维生素A原类胡萝卜素（NONE）。因此对真正有日照的人来说，多余的那部分是维生素D，而视黄醇负荷让鱼肝油成为一个糟糕的载体：单纯的 D3 加鱼油或藻油能提供同样的好处，又不会把视黄醇推向上限。

What it does它有什么作用

Cod liver oil is a food product, oil rendered from the livers of Gadus species, carrying three active constituents in one dose: vitamin D3, preformed vitamin A as retinyl esters, and the long-chain omega-3 fatty acids EPA and DHA. Each has its own physiology (see the vitamin D3 and preformed vitamin A entries; EPA and DHA are incorporated into membrane phospholipids and serve as precursors to eicosanoids and specialised pro-resolving mediators, with DHA concentrated in retinal photoreceptor and neuronal membranes). It has historical standing because it was the agent that treated and then largely eliminated rickets in the polluted industrial cities of the early twentieth century, before vitamin D itself had been identified. Modern products vary widely in content depending on whether the natural vitamins were stripped during refining and re-added, so the label matters. The practical constraint on dosing is the preformed retinol: an amount large enough to deliver a meaningful EPA and DHA intake can push vitamin A toward or past the tolerable upper limit, and the vitamin A here is retinol, not beta-carotene.鱼肝油是一种食品，由鳕属（Gadus）鱼类的肝脏炼制而成，一次服用即含三种活性成分：维生素D3、以视黄酯形式存在的预成型维生素A，以及长链omega-3脂肪酸EPA和DHA。三者各有其自身的生理作用（参见维生素D3及预成型维生素A条目；EPA和DHA被纳入膜磷脂，并作为类花生酸及特化促消退介质的前体，其中DHA集中于视网膜光感受器和神经元膜中）。鱼肝油具有历史地位，因为在维生素D本身被鉴定出来之前，它正是在20世纪初污染严重的工业城市中用于治疗并进而大幅消除佝偻病的制剂。现代产品含量差异很大，取决于精炼过程中是否去除了天然维生素并重新添加，因此标签内容很重要。剂量的实际限制因素是其中的预成型视黄醇：足以提供有意义EPA和DHA摄入量的剂量，可能使维生素A摄入逼近或超过可耐受最高摄入量，且这里的维生素A是视黄醇，不是β-胡萝卜素。

Who it is for适用人群

People who eat no marine products at all and will not take algal oil. It at least maintains essential fatty acid status.完全不吃海产、也不愿吃藻油的人。它至少能维持必需脂肪酸的状态。

Dose tested已验证剂量

Adequate intake 1.6 g/d for men and 1.1 g/d for women. No upper limit; the practical constraint is calories from oil.适宜摄入量：男性 1.6 克/天，女性 1.1 克/天。没有上限；实际限制是油带来的热量。

To match that from food用食物达到该剂量

For ALA itself there is zero gap: one tablespoon of ground flaxseed (1.60 g), one ounce of walnuts (2.57 g), one ounce of hulled hemp seed (2.46 g), one tablespoon of walnut oil (1.41 g) or one tablespoon of rapeseed oil (about 1.2 g) each meet or exceed the 1.1-1.4 g/day AI, and one tablespoon of flaxseed oil supplies 7.26 g. The gap appears only when ALA is sold as a substitute for EPA and DHA, and the two substances need separate answers. For EPA, substitution is plausible at modest intakes: Burdge and Wootton 2002 measured 21% net fractional conversion of labelled ALA to EPA in young women (PMID 12323090, DOI 10.1079/BJN2002689), so a 250 mg/day EPA target needs 1.19 g ALA/day, which is about 0.7 tablespoons of ground flaxseed. For DHA, substitution fails at any realistic intake. The same paper gives 9% conversion to DHA and 6% to DPA in women, while in young men roughly 33% of the dose was oxidised within 24 hours, EPA and DPA were the only meaningful products, and no labelled DHA was detectable in plasma at any point over 21 days (PMID 12323085, DOI 10.1079/bjn2002662). Whole-body estimates are lower still, commonly 0.1-0.5% for DHA. At 0.5% you need 50 g ALA/day, which is 219 g of flaxseed or roughly 100 mL of flaxseed oil daily; at 0.1% you need 250 g ALA/day, over a kilogram of seed. No one eats that. Feeding trials agree, with plasma DHA unchanged after a month of flaxseed in any form (Austria 2008, PMID 18689552). State it plainly: flaxseed, chia and walnut oil can substitute for EPA at modest intakes and cannot supply DHA at any realistic intake. Express any of these requirements in milled seed rather than whole, since whole flaxseed produced no significant plasma ALA rise in that trial.就 ALA 本身而言差距为零：一汤匙亚麻籽粉（1.60 g）、一盎司核桃（2.57 g）、一盎司去壳大麻籽（2.46 g）、一汤匙核桃油（1.41 g）或一汤匙菜籽油（约 1.2 g），都达到或超过 1.1-1.4 g/day 的 AI，而一汤匙亚麻籽油提供 7.26 g。差距只在把 ALA 当作 EPA 和 DHA 的替代品出售时才出现，这两种物质需要分开回答。对 EPA，在中等摄入量下替代是可行的：Burdge 与 Wootton 2002 在年轻女性中测得标记 ALA 转化为 EPA 的净分数转化率为 21%（PMID 12323090, DOI 10.1079/BJN2002689），因此 250 mg/day 的 EPA 目标需要 1.19 g ALA/day，约合 0.7 汤匙亚麻籽粉。对 DHA，在任何现实摄入量下替代都行不通。同一篇论文给出女性向 DHA 的转化率为 9%、向 DPA 为 6%；而在年轻男性中，约 33% 的剂量在 24 小时内被氧化，EPA 和 DPA 是唯一有意义的产物，21 天内任何时间点血浆中都检测不到标记 DHA（PMID 12323085, DOI 10.1079/bjn2002662）。全身水平的估计更低，DHA 常见为 0.1-0.5%。按 0.5% 计需要 50 g ALA/day，即每天 219 g 亚麻籽或约 100 mL 亚麻籽油；按 0.1% 计需要 250 g ALA/day，超过一公斤籽。没有人这么吃。喂养试验的结果一致：食用任何形式的亚麻籽一个月后血浆 DHA 均无变化（Austria 2008, PMID 18689552）。直说结论：亚麻籽、奇亚籽和核桃油在中等摄入量下可以替代 EPA，在任何现实摄入量下都无法提供 DHA。上述需求量都应以研磨后的籽来表述，整粒籽不适用，因为该试验中整粒亚麻籽未使血浆 ALA 显著升高。

Does the body make it身体是否自产

The verdict for the substance actually in the bottle is NONE: humans lack the omega-3 (delta-15) desaturase that plants have, so ALA synthesis is zero, exactly as it is for the chemical elements. The exception is downstream, where the products people buy flax, chia or walnut oil for are PARTIAL: 21% of a labelled ALA dose reaches EPA and 9% reaches DHA in young women, while in young men EPA and DPA appear and DHA stays undetectable for 21 days, and most of the dose is simply burned as fuel. A precursor the body cannot make plus a conversion step that mostly fails means these oils are a defensible source of ALA itself and an unreliable route to DHA.瓶子里那种物质的结论是 NONE：人体缺少植物拥有的 omega-3（delta-15）去饱和酶，ALA 合成为零，与化学元素的判定一致。例外在下游，人们买亚麻籽油、奇亚籽油或核桃油真正想要的产物属于 PARTIAL：年轻女性中标记 ALA 剂量的 21% 到达 EPA，9% 到达 DHA；年轻男性中出现 EPA 和 DPA，21 天内检测不到 DHA，而大部分剂量直接被当燃料烧掉。前体身体无法合成，转化步骤又大半落空，所以这类油作为 ALA 本身的来源站得住，作为 DHA 的途径并不可靠。

What it does它有什么作用

Alpha-linolenic acid (18:3n-3) is a genuine essential nutrient. Humans lack the desaturase that places a double bond at the n-3 position of a fatty acid, so every omega-3 molecule in the body traces back to dietary ALA or to preformed EPA and DHA. ALA is incorporated into membrane phospholipids, is a substantial oxidative fuel (a large share of an ingested dose is simply burned), and is the substrate for the elongation and desaturation pathway producing EPA, DPA and DHA. Stable-isotope tracer work puts net conversion to EPA at about 8% in young men and 21% in young women, with DHA formation around 9% in women and undetectable in men (PMID 12323085, PMID 12323090). The US Adequate Intake is 1.6 g/day for men and 1.1 g/day for women.α-亚麻酸(18:3n-3)是真正意义上的必需营养素。人体缺乏能在脂肪酸n-3位置引入双键的desaturase,因此体内每一个omega-3分子都来自膳食ALA或预成的EPA和DHA。ALA被掺入膜磷脂,也是重要的氧化燃料(摄入剂量中相当大一部分直接被氧化供能),同时是生成EPA、DPA和DHA的延长去饱和途径的底物。稳定同位素示踪研究显示,年轻男性向EPA的净转化率约为8%,年轻女性约为21%,DHA生成率女性约为9%,男性检测不到(PMID 12323085, PMID 12323090)。美国的适宜摄入量男性为1.6 g/day,女性为1.1 g/day。

If you lack it缺乏会怎样

In the index case, a six-year-old girl maintained on parenteral nutrition rich in linoleate but nearly devoid of linolenate developed, after five months, episodes of numbness, paraesthesia, leg pain, weakness, inability to walk and blurred vision (Holman et al., PMID 6801965). Patients on long-term gastric-tube feeding with n-3-poor formulas developed scaly dermatitis and a haemorrhagic folliculitis (Bjerve et al.). Deficiency of this severity effectively arises only when the entire fat supply is medically controlled.在首例报告中,一名6岁女孩接受富含亚油酸盐但几乎不含亚麻酸盐的肠外营养,五个月后出现发作性麻木、感觉异常、腿痛、乏力、无法行走及视物模糊(Holman等,PMID 6801965)。长期使用贫n-3配方经胃管喂养的患者出现鳞屑性皮炎和出血性毛囊炎(Bjerve等)。这种严重程度的缺乏实际上只发生在全部脂肪供给都由医疗手段控制的情况下。

Does it reverse补回来能修复吗

In every documented human case, neurological symptoms disappeared and skin lesions resolved once an n-3-containing lipid source was substituted, with plasma fatty acid profiles normalising alongside. No residual deficit was reported. The honest caveat is that all reported cases were identified within months; the consequences of much longer deprivation in humans are unknown.在所有已记录的人体病例中,一旦改用含n-3的脂质来源,神经系统症状即消失,皮肤病变随之消退,血浆脂肪酸谱同步恢复正常,未见报告有残留缺陷。需要如实说明的是,所有报告病例均在数月内被发现,人体长期缺乏的后果尚不清楚。

Algal oil (vegan DHA and EPA)藻油（纯素 DHA 与 EPA）Oil from marine microalgae that supplies ready-made DHA, and in some products EPA, without fish.来自海洋微藻的油脂,可在不吃鱼的情况下提供现成的DHA,部分产品还含EPA。 SSCCFFDDBBXX Skip it不必买 Trace痕量 Out of reach达不到 Partly部分自产 No deficiency state exists不存在缺乏状态 Vegans and vegetarians, people avoiding fish contaminants, and people with fish or shellfish allergy.纯素者与素食者、想避开鱼类污染物的人、以及鱼类或贝类过敏者。
Who it is for适用人群

Vegans and vegetarians, people avoiding fish contaminants, and people with fish or shellfish allergy.纯素者与素食者、想避开鱼类污染物的人、以及鱼类或贝类过敏者。

Dose tested已验证剂量

Matched to fish oil equivalents. For pregnancy the tested DHA doses are the same as fish-derived, 200-1,000 mg/d.按鱼油等效量给药。妊娠期已验证的 DHA 剂量与鱼源相同，为 200 至 1000 毫克/天。

To match that from food用食物达到该剂量

For a strict vegan the gap is unbridgeable for DHA and absurd for EPA. Typical algal oil products sit at 250 mg/day of DHA for general adult use and 450 mg/day for pregnancy and lactation. Matching 250 mg of EPA from nori would take 312 g of raw laver, about 120 sheets a day. Matching any amount of DHA from nori is impossible, since the USDA value is 0.000 g, and spirulina supplies zero of both. No seaweed portion, no fermented food and no oilseed closes this gap, which is why algal oil is one of the few supplements in this reference with a real and unavoidable role. For a lacto-ovo vegetarian eggs get partway and no further: 250 mg of DHA is about nine large eggs a day, so two eggs (58 mg) cover 23% of the target and one covers 12%. DHA-enriched eggs shorten that considerably. For an omnivore the same 250 mg of DHA is one 45 g tin of anchovies (580 mg DHA) or half a tin of sardines.对严格素食者来说，DHA 的差距无法弥合，EPA 的差距则荒谬。典型藻油产品对一般成人为 250 mg/day DHA，孕期和哺乳期为 450 mg/day。用紫菜凑足 250 mg EPA 需要 312 g 生紫菜，约每天 120 张。用紫菜凑任何数量的 DHA 都不可能，因为 USDA 数值为 0.000 g，而螺旋藻两者都是零。没有任何一份海藻、任何发酵食品或任何油料籽能填上这个缺口，这也是藻油成为本参考资料中少数具有真实且不可回避作用的补充剂的原因。对蛋奶素食者，鸡蛋只能补上一段：250 mg DHA 约相当于每天九枚大鸡蛋，因此两枚（58 mg）覆盖目标的 23%，一枚覆盖 12%。DHA 强化蛋能把这个数字大幅缩短。对杂食者，同样的 250 mg DHA 等于一罐 45 g 凤尾鱼（580 mg DHA）或半罐沙丁鱼。

Does the body make it身体是否自产

Algal oil delivers preformed DHA, and in newer products EPA as well, which is precisely the step human metabolism cannot deliver: the ELOVL2 elongation and second FADS2 desaturation that carry EPA through to DHA are the rate-limiting stretch, yielding 9% conversion in young women and nothing measurable in young men. Plasma and tissue DHA rise dose-dependently with preformed DHA and hardly at all with ALA, so taking DHA directly bypasses the bottleneck instead of duplicating something the body already does well. That makes algal oil a defensible supplement for anyone off oily fish, with plasma DHA approaching a maximum response at about 2 g/d.藻油提供现成 DHA，新一代产品还含 EPA，而这恰好是人体代谢无法完成的那一步：把 EPA 推到 DHA 的 ELOVL2 延长和第二次 FADS2 去饱和是限速段，年轻女性的转化率为 9%，年轻男性测不到。血浆和组织 DHA 随现成 DHA 剂量上升，对 ALA 几乎没有反应，所以直接补 DHA 是绕过瓶颈，并没有重复身体本来就做得好的事情。因此对不吃多脂鱼的人，藻油是站得住的补充剂，血浆 DHA 在约 2 g/d 附近接近最大反应。

What it does它有什么作用

Algal oil is extracted from cultured heterotrophic microalgae, chiefly Schizochytrium species and Crypthecodinium cohnii. These are the organisms at the base of the marine food chain that actually synthesise DHA; fish accumulate it by eating them. Crypthecodinium products supply DHA only, while Schizochytrium products supply DHA plus a smaller amount of EPA. Physiologically the oil does nothing that DHA and EPA do not do, so the mechanism sits in the Omega-3 (EPA and DHA) entry. Controlled feeding work found algal-oil capsules and cooked salmon to be nutritionally equivalent sources of DHA in terms of plasma incorporation (PMID 18589030), which is why algal DHA has been the standard source in infant formula for decades.藻油提取自培养的异养微藻,主要是裂殖壶菌属(Schizochytrium)物种和寇氏隐甲藻(Crypthecodinium cohnii)。这些是海洋食物链底端真正合成DHA的生物,鱼类是通过摄食它们而积累DHA。寇氏隐甲藻产品只提供DHA,裂殖壶菌产品则提供DHA外加少量EPA。从生理学角度看,该油脂的作用不超出DHA和EPA本身的作用范围,其机制见Omega-3(EPA和DHA)词条。对照喂养研究发现,就血浆掺入而言,藻油胶囊和熟三文鱼是营养上等效的DHA来源(PMID 18589030),这也是藻源DHA数十年来一直是婴儿配方奶粉标准来源的原因。

The 10 g/day of bran tested against psyllium and placebo in IBS (PMID 19713235) is about 3 heaped tablespoons of plain wheat bran, which carries 4.28 g of dietary fibre. Matched on fibre, that is about 1 serving of bran flakes, not the 2 the submission claimed: one 29 g serving supplies 4.90 g, so two servings deliver more than double the fibre in the trial dose. What it does它有什么作用

Wheat bran is the outer layer of the wheat kernel, composed mainly of insoluble arabinoxylan, cellulose and lignin. It acts through particle bulk and mechanical stimulation of the mucosa rather than by forming a gel: coarse particles increase stool mass and provoke secretion and peristalsis, whereas finely ground bran loses this effect and can slow transit. It holds far less water than psyllium and is partly fermented, generating gas. In IBS these properties work against the patient, since mechanical stimulation acts on a hypersensitive gut and bran also carries fructans, making it high-FODMAP. Meta-analysis found no significant benefit of bran for global IBS symptoms (relative risk of not improving 0.90, 95% CI 0.79 to 1.03), in contrast to ispaghula (NNT 7), and the ACG guideline recommends soluble fibre for IBS (PMID 33315591).小麦麸皮是小麦籽粒的外层,主要由不溶性阿拉伯木聚糖、纤维素和木质素组成。它的作用方式是颗粒体积和对黏膜的机械刺激,而不是成胶:粗颗粒能增加粪便质量并促进分泌和蠕动,而磨得很细的麸皮会失去这种效果,甚至可能减慢转运。它保水能力远低于车前子壳,且部分被发酵而产气。在IBS患者中,这些特性反而不利,因为机械刺激作用于本已过度敏感的肠道,而且麸皮还含有果聚糖,属于高FODMAP食物。荟萃分析未发现麸皮对IBS整体症状有显著获益(未改善的相对风险为0.90,95% CI 0.79至1.03),与洋车前子(NNT为7)形成对比,ACG指南推荐IBS患者使用可溶性纤维(PMID 33315591)。
