To match that from food用食物达到该剂量

Bromelain supplements are dosed by activity, typically 500-2,000 mg of a preparation standardised to around 2,400 GDU/g, giving roughly 1,200-4,800 GDU per dose. On the activities reported for pineapple by-products, that is equivalent to about 0.41-1.65 g of basal stem or about 1.0-4.1 g of peel, and neither the basal stem nor the peel is eaten (those per-gram activity values are from a genuine, on-topic paper whose individual figures could not be retrieved, so treat them as unconfirmed). Expressed against food you would actually put in your mouth, the dose cannot be matched: the crown has no detectable activity, the core is usually discarded, and no sourced activity figure exists for the ripe flesh. Fresh pineapple and green kiwifruit do deliver active protease into the stomach, so the effect is not zero, but with no confirmed activity value for edible flesh there is no way to express a food equivalent of a GDU dose. For papain the source material is the latex of the unripe fruit, which is irritant and is not food. For the fungal amylase, protease and lipase components there is no food source at all.菠萝蛋白酶补充剂按活性给药，典型为 500-2,000 mg 标准化到约 2,400 GDU/g 的制剂，每次剂量约 1,200-4,800 GDU。按菠萝副产物报告的活性折算，这相当于约 0.41-1.65 g 茎基部或约 1.0-4.1 g 果皮，而茎基部和果皮都不会被吃掉（这些每克活性值出自一篇真实且切题的论文，其中的单项数字无法调取，应视为未确认）。若换成真正会放进嘴里的食物来表达，这个剂量无法匹配：冠芽检测不到活性，果心通常被丢弃，成熟果肉则没有有据可查的活性数据。新鲜菠萝和绿肉猕猴桃确实会把有活性的蛋白酶送进胃里，所以效果不为零，但在缺少可食果肉活性确认值的情况下，没有办法把 GDU 剂量换算成食物当量。木瓜蛋白酶的原料是未熟果实的乳汁，有刺激性，不属于食物。至于真菌来源的淀粉酶、蛋白酶和脂肪酶组分，根本没有食物来源。

Does the body make it身体是否自产

This is a product category rather than a defined substance, so the axis label is NA and the split has to be read ingredient by ingredient. The amylase, protease and lipase in these blends duplicate what a working pancreas already secretes in large excess, so for those three the axis reads FULL and the capsule is redundant; the same capsule usually also carries enzyme functions the human gut lumen does not perform, namely fungal alpha-galactosidase for raffinose-family oligosaccharides, fungal cellulase, and the plant proteases bromelain and papain, which read NONE. Humans do make an alpha-galactosidase, the lysosomal alpha-galactosidase A encoded by GLA whose deficiency causes Fabry disease, plus alpha-N-acetylgalactosaminidase (NAGA), and what is missing is a luminal or brush-border alpha-galactosidase, so a blend has no coherent target in a person with a normal pancreas.这是产品类别, 不是一种确定的物质, 所以轴标签为 NA, 拆分要按成分逐项读。复方里的淀粉酶, 蛋白酶和脂肪酶重复了功能正常的胰腺本已大量过剩分泌的东西, 这三者在这条轴上读作 FULL, 胶囊是多余的; 同一个胶囊通常还含人肠腔并不执行的酶功能, 即用于棉子糖族寡糖的真菌 alpha-galactosidase, 真菌纤维素酶, 以及植物蛋白酶菠萝蛋白酶和木瓜蛋白酶, 这些读作 NONE。人确实合成一种 alpha-galactosidase, 即由 GLA 编码的溶酶体 alpha-galactosidase A (其缺陷导致 Fabry 病), 另有 alpha-N-acetylgalactosaminidase (NAGA); 缺的是肠腔或刷状缘的 alpha-galactosidase, 所以对胰腺功能正常的人, 这类复方没有连贯的作用靶点。

What it does它有什么作用

These blends typically combine fungal amylase and protease, cellulase, bromelain, papain and sometimes lipase, at doses and in formulations that are not designed to survive gastric acid or to be matched to a meal's fat content. Prescription pancrelipase is a different class of product: enteric-coated, dosed in thousands of lipase units per gram of dietary fat, and regulated in the US as a drug requiring an approved application since 2010. Two components have a defined use in people who need them, lactase for lactose intolerance and alpha-galactosidase for gas from raffinose-family oligosaccharides in legumes; the broad multi-enzyme blends have no established indication in anyone with a normal pancreas, since a healthy gland already secretes roughly ten times the lipase needed. This is a commercial product category rather than a nutrient, so no requirement and no deficiency state applies.这类复合制剂通常混合真菌来源的淀粉酶(amylase)和蛋白酶(protease)、纤维素酶(cellulase)、菠萝蛋白酶(bromelain)、木瓜蛋白酶(papain),有时还含脂肪酶(lipase),其剂量和剂型并非为耐受胃酸或与某一餐脂肪含量相匹配而设计。处方级胰脂酶制剂(pancrelipase)属于不同类别的产品:采用肠溶包衣,按每克膳食脂肪所需的千单位脂肪酶计量,自2010年起在美国被作为需持有批准申请的药品监管。有两种成分在确有需要的人群中有明确用途,即用于乳糖不耐受的乳糖酶(lactase),以及用于缓解豆类中棉子糖家族低聚糖所致胀气的α-半乳糖苷酶(alpha-galactosidase);而广谱多酶复合制剂在胰腺功能正常者中没有确立的适应证,因为健康的胰腺本身分泌的脂肪酶量已是所需量的约十倍。这是一个商业产品类别而非营养素,因此不存在需求,也不适用缺乏状态。

The trial dose is 5 g three times daily, 15 g/day for 8 weeks, in post-infectious diarrhoea-predominant IBS with increased intestinal permeability (Zhou et al., Gut 2019;68:996-1002, PMID 30108163). On the combined Glu plus Gln figures, 15 g comes from about 50-60 g of vital wheat gluten, about 79-88 g of soy protein isolate, about 183 g of parmesan, about 323 g of cooked chicken breast, about 440 g of cod (about 2.5 fillets), about 450 g of natto (corrected from the submission's 865 g, which was wrong by 1.9x) or roughly 1.1 kg of cooked lentils. Does the body make it身体是否自产

Glutamine is the most abundant free amino acid in the body, about 20 percent of the free amino acid pool in blood and 40 to 60 percent in muscle and liver, and whole-body endogenous production is 40 to 80 g/day, with skeletal muscle the dominant synthetic site and net exporter to enterocytes and immune cells while lung, liver, brain and adipose also contribute. A healthy adult eating normally is nowhere near short, so a 5 g scoop for leaky gut is a rounding error against the flux already arriving at the gut wall, and leaky gut is not a validated clinical entity in the first place, so the scoop has no defined target. Severe catabolic illness is where this changes, with demand exceeding synthesis and plasma glutamine falling, which is what CONDITIONAL means: self-sufficient in health and insufficient in named states.glutamine 是体内含量最高的游离氨基酸, 约占血中游离氨基酸池的 20%, 在肌肉和肝占 40% 到 60%, 全身内源生成 40 到 80 g/day, 骨骼肌是主要合成部位和净输出者, 向肠上皮细胞和免疫细胞输送, 肺, 肝, 脑和脂肪组织也有贡献。正常进食的健康成人远谈不上缺乏, 为肠漏而吃的 5 g 一勺, 相对已抵达肠壁的通量只是舍入误差, 而肠漏本身也不是经过验证的临床实体, 这一勺没有明确的作用目标。严重分解代谢疾病中情况确实变化, 需求超过合成, 血浆 glutamine 下降, 这就是 CONDITIONAL 的含义: 健康时自给, 在点名的状态下不足。

What it does它有什么作用

Glutamine is the most abundant free amino acid in plasma and skeletal muscle. Muscle synthesises and exports it continuously via glutamine synthetase, so supply is normally set by endogenous production rather than by diet. Enterocytes and rapidly dividing immune cells use it as a preferred respiratory fuel and as the nitrogen donor for purine, pyrimidine and glutathione synthesis, which is the biochemistry behind the gut-repair claim. It is classed as non-essential in health and conditionally essential in severe catabolic states, where muscle export cannot keep pace with consumption. Human trials of oral glutamine for intestinal permeability, IBS and inflammatory bowel disease have been small and inconsistent, and the strongest evidence is in specific clinical contexts rather than in healthy people.谷氨酰胺是血浆和骨骼肌中含量最丰富的游离氨基酸。肌肉通过glutamine synthetase持续合成并输出谷氨酰胺,因此其供给通常由内源性生成决定,而非由饮食决定。肠上皮细胞和快速分裂的免疫细胞将其作为首选的呼吸燃料,并作为嘌呤、嘧啶和谷胱甘肽合成的氮供体,这正是肠道修复说法背后的生化基础。健康状态下它被归为非必需氨基酸,在严重分解代谢状态下(此时肌肉输出跟不上消耗)则为条件必需氨基酸。关于口服谷氨酰胺用于肠道通透性、肠易激综合征和炎症性肠病的人体试验规模小且结果不一致,最强的证据出现在特定临床情境中,而非健康人群中。

To match that from food用食物达到该剂量

For inulin and FOS the answer depends on which food. A 5 g/day dose is reachable from about 250 g of raw onion (two to three medium onions), about 10-19 cloves of garlic on the corrected 9-16 g/100 g range (the submission's 30 cloves was wrong by roughly 3x and contradicted its own food row), about 23-63 g of Jerusalem artichoke, or about 30 g of salsify on an unconfirmed figure. It is out of reach from banana (about 4.5 kg), leek (about 2.1 kg) and asparagus (roughly 1-5 kg, the range reflecting a fivefold uncertainty in the fresh-weight figure; the submission's flat 5 kg used the low end only). The tolerance ceiling is the more useful number than the dose: up to 10 g/day of native inulin and up to 5 g/day of oligofructose were well tolerated in a randomised crossover trial, while 10 g of oligofructose substantially increased symptoms, chiefly flatulence then bloating (Bonnema et al., PMID 20497775). One 150 g cup of Jerusalem artichoke delivers roughly 12-33 g of inulin, so between one and three times the tolerated daily ceiling in a single sitting. For GOS the answer is a flat no: the beta-GOS doses used in trials are made industrially and no ordinary food supplies them.对菊粉和 FOS 来说，答案取决于选哪种食物。5 g/day 的剂量可以由约 250 g 生洋葱（两到三个中等大小洋葱）、按更正后的 9-16 g/100 g 范围计约 10-19 瓣蒜（原稿的 30 瓣偏差约 3 倍，并与其自己的食物行自相矛盾）、约 23-63 g 洋姜，或按一个未确认数值计约 30 g 婆罗门参达到。靠香蕉（约 4.5 kg）、韭葱（约 2.1 kg）和芦笋（约 1-5 kg，区间反映鲜重数值存在五倍不确定性；原稿写死 5 kg，只用了低端值）则达不到。比剂量更有用的数字是耐受上限：一项随机交叉试验中，天然菊粉每天最多 10 g、低聚果糖每天最多 5 g 耐受良好，而 10 g 低聚果糖显著加重症状，主要是排气，其次是腹胀（Bonnema et al., PMID 20497775）。一杯 150 g 洋姜提供约 12-33 g 菊粉，一顿就相当于每日耐受上限的一到三倍。对 GOS 的答案是明确的否：试验所用的 beta-GOS 剂量由工业制造，没有任何普通食物能提供。

Does the body make it身体是否自产

Inulin and fructo-oligosaccharides are beta(2->1) fructans, and commercial galacto-oligosaccharides are galactose oligomers of DP2 to DP6 usually carrying a terminal glucose, produced by beta-galactosidase transgalactosylation of lactose. The 2017 ISAPP consensus defines a prebiotic as a substrate selectively utilized by host microorganisms conferring a health benefit, and imposes no non-digestibility requirement, so the operative criteria are selective utilisation plus a demonstrated benefit; non-digestibility remains a practical property of the common fructans and of GOS at DP3 and above, which is why they reach the colon to be fermented. Nothing here is endogenous, so the real question is dose tolerance, because the fermentation that produces the benefit also produces gas.菊粉和低聚果糖是 beta(2->1) 果聚糖, 商品化的低聚半乳糖是 DP2 至 DP6 的半乳糖寡聚物, 末端通常带一个葡萄糖, 由 beta-galactosidase 对乳糖进行转半乳糖基化制得。2017 年 ISAPP 共识把益生元定义为被宿主微生物选择性利用并带来健康益处的底物, 并未要求不可消化, 所以实际判据是选择性利用加上已证实的健康益处; 不可消化性仍然是常见果聚糖和 DP3 及以上 GOS 的实际性质, 也是它们能到结肠被发酵的原因。这里没有内源成分, 所以真正的问题是剂量耐受性, 因为产生益处的发酵同时产生气体。

What it does它有什么作用

Inulin and fructo-oligosaccharides are fructose polymers from chicory root, Jerusalem artichoke, onion, garlic and wheat, differing mainly in chain length: FOS has a degree of polymerisation below about 9, inulin extends to 60. GOS are galactose oligomers produced enzymatically from lactose and are structural analogues of human milk oligosaccharides. All three resist human digestive enzymes, reach the colon intact and are selectively fermented, reproducibly raising Bifidobacterium abundance, which is the basis of the ISAPP definition of a prebiotic as a substrate selectively used by host microorganisms to confer a health benefit (PMID 28611480). Fermentation yields acetate, propionate and butyrate; butyrate is the primary respiratory fuel of the colonocyte, and the short-chain fatty acid pool lowers luminal pH and supports barrier function. That same fermentability produces the gas and bloating these compounds are known for, and is why they are classed as high-FODMAP.菊粉和低聚果糖是来自菊苣根、菊芋、洋葱、大蒜和小麦的果糖聚合物,两者主要区别在于链长:FOS的聚合度低于约9,菊粉可延伸到60。GOS是由乳糖经酶促反应生成的半乳糖寡糖,是人乳低聚糖的结构类似物。这三者都能抵抗人体消化酶,完整到达结肠并被选择性发酵,可重复性地提高双歧杆菌丰度,这也是ISAPP将益生元定义为被宿主微生物选择性利用、能带来健康益处的底物这一定义的依据(PMID 28611480)。发酵产生乙酸、丙酸和丁酸,丁酸是结肠上皮细胞的主要呼吸燃料,短链脂肪酸池能降低肠腔pH并支持屏障功能。正是这种可发酵性也造成了这些化合物以产气和腹胀著称,因而被归为高FODMAP食物。

To match that from food用食物达到该剂量

For saffron the gap is zero or negative, which is the most useful finding in the set: the 30 mg/day used in the depression RCTs is about 15 threads at published thread weights near 2 mg, or about 6 to 9 threads if a thread weighs the 3 to 5 mg implied by the commonly quoted 20 to 30 threads per 0.1 g, which is under a generous culinary pinch, and one teaspoon of saffron in a paella is over twenty doses. The barrier is cost rather than physiology. For SAMe there is nothing to compute, because there is no food source: trials use 400 to 1,600 mg/day of a manufactured molecule, while the body's own SAMe turnover (on the order of grams per day) is fed by roughly 1 g/day of dietary methionine from protein foods, which is a different intervention from swallowing SAMe. For the remaining botanicals (St John's wort typically 300 mg three times daily of a 0.3% hypericin extract, rhodiola 200 to 600 mg, ashwagandha 300 to 600 mg root extract, 5-HTP 100 to 300 mg) the food gap is undefined because the source plants are not foods at any quantity.藏红花的差距为零甚至为负，这是本组中最有用的发现：抑郁症 RCT 使用的每天 30 mg，按已发表的每根柱头约 2 mg 计约为 15 根；若按常被引用的每 0.1 g 有 20 至 30 根（即每根 3 至 5 mg）推算，则约为 6 至 9 根，都不到烹饪中一小撮的量，而西班牙海鲜饭里放一茶匙藏红花就超过二十个剂量。障碍在于成本，与生理无关。SAMe 无从计算，因为它没有食物来源：试验使用每天 400 至 1,600 mg 的人工制造分子，而人体自身的 SAMe 周转（每天以克计）靠蛋白质食物提供的每天约 1 g 膳食甲硫氨酸来支撑，这与直接口服 SAMe 属于两种不同的干预。至于其余植物制剂（贯叶连翘通常为 0.3% 金丝桃素提取物每次 300 mg、每天三次，红景天 200 至 600 mg，南非醉茄根提取物 300 至 600 mg，5-HTP 100 至 300 mg），食物差距无从界定，因为这些原植物在任何用量下都不是食物。

Does the body make it身体是否自产

Saffron's constituents are apocarotenoids, the crocins plus crocetin, picrocrocin and safranal, cleaved from zeaxanthin in Crocus sativus stigmas, and human tissue makes no part of them, which holds for the other plant members of this group too, so the roll-up for the bundle is NONE. The one member at the opposite end of the axis is SAMe, which is FULL: the body's universal methyl donor, made in every cell from methionine and ATP and most heavily in the liver, with a CONDITIONAL carve-out in chronic liver disease and cholestasis where MAT1A activity and hepatic SAMe fall. For the botanicals the axis is silent and the case rests on trial evidence; for SAMe an oral dose is pharmacology, since a healthy person eating normal protein cannot be deficient.藏红花的成分是脱辅基类胡萝卜素, 即 crocins 以及 crocetin, picrocrocin 和 safranal, 由 Crocus sativus 柱头中的玉米黄质裂解而来, 人体组织不合成其中任何部分, 本组其他植物成分同理, 所以整条的汇总标签是 NONE。处在这条轴另一端的成员只有 SAMe, 它是 FULL: 全身通用的甲基供体, 每个细胞都能用 methionine 和 ATP 合成, 肝脏合成量最大; 有一个 CONDITIONAL 的例外, 慢性肝病和胆汁淤积时 MAT1A 活性和肝内 SAMe 下降。对植物成分这条轴无话可说, 判断依赖试验证据; 对 SAMe, 口服属药理剂量, 因为蛋白摄入正常的健康人不会缺它。

What it does它有什么作用

Saffron supplies crocin, crocetin and safranal from Crocus sativus stigmas, and trials of about 30 mg/day over 6 to 8 weeks report antidepressant effects, though most are small, brief and concentrated in a narrow set of centres, which limits confidence. SAMe is chemically different in kind: the body synthesises it from methionine and ATP through methionine adenosyltransferase, and it serves as the universal methyl donor for DNA, phospholipid, catecholamine and creatine methylation. A Cochrane review of 8 trials and 934 participants found no clear difference between SAMe and imipramine or escitalopram used alone, and only low-quality evidence favouring SAMe added to an SSRI. Neither category is an essential nutrient: saffron constituents are plant secondary metabolites, and SAMe is made endogenously, with low tissue SAMe appearing only as a downstream consequence of folate or vitamin B12 deficiency or of the inborn error MAT1A deficiency.藏红花(Crocus sativus)柱头提供藏红花素(crocin)、藏红花酸(crocetin)和藏红花醛(safranal),每日约30 mg、持续6至8周的试验报告显示有抗抑郁效果,但多数研究规模小、时程短且集中在少数几个中心,这限制了结果的可信度。SAMe在化学性质上完全不同:人体通过甲硫氨酸腺苷转移酶(methionine adenosyltransferase)由甲硫氨酸和ATP合成SAMe,它是DNA、磷脂、儿茶酚胺和肌酸甲基化反应的通用甲基供体。一项纳入8项试验、934名受试者的Cochrane系统评价发现,单独使用时SAMe与丙咪嗪(imipramine)或艾司西酞普兰(escitalopram)之间没有明显差异,而SAMe加用于SSRI类药物的证据质量较低,仅有限地支持其有效。这两类都不是必需营养素:藏红花成分是植物次生代谢物,而SAMe由人体内源合成,组织内SAMe水平偏低只是叶酸或维生素B12缺乏、或先天性代谢缺陷MAT1A基因缺乏的下游后果。

To match that from food用食物达到该剂量

QUERCETIN: trials use 500-1,000 mg/day. From raw capers at 233.84 mg/100 g that is 214-428 g per day, 14 to 29 tablespoons of a salt-cured condiment and a salt load nobody should take; from dock leaves at 86.20 mg/100 g it is 580 g to 1.16 kg; from wild rocket at 66.19 mg/100 g it is 756 g to 1.51 kg; from raw red onion at 39.21 mg/100 g it is 1.28-2.55 kg; from apples with skin at 4.01 mg/100 g it is 12.5-25 kg, about 70 to 140 apples. A 500 mg capsule is roughly 25 to 50 times what a diet delivers. TAURINE: trials use 1-6 g/day, commonly 3 g. From beef at 61.1 mg/100 g that is 4.9 kg of raw steak per day, from chicken thigh at 47.34 mg/100 g it is 6.3 kg, and from clam meat at roughly 450 mg/100 g as eaten it is about 670 g of clam meat daily, the only route within an order of magnitude of feasible and still nothing a person eats. Neither dose is reachable by eating normally.槲皮素：试验剂量为 500-1,000 mg/天。按生刺山柑 233.84 mg/100 g 计算，每天要 214-428 g，也就是 14 到 29 汤匙盐渍调味小菜，那样的钠负荷谁都不该承受；按酸模叶 86.20 mg/100 g 计算是 580 g 到 1.16 kg；按野生芝麻菜 66.19 mg/100 g 计算是 756 g 到 1.51 kg；按生红洋葱 39.21 mg/100 g 计算是 1.28-2.55 kg；按带皮苹果 4.01 mg/100 g 计算是 12.5-25 kg，约 70 到 140 个苹果。一粒 500 mg 胶囊大致相当于膳食供给量的 25 到 50 倍。牛磺酸：试验剂量为 1-6 g/天，常用 3 g。按牛肉 61.1 mg/100 g 计算，每天要 4.9 kg 生牛排；按鸡腿肉 47.34 mg/100 g 计算是 6.3 kg；按可食状态下蛤肉约 450 mg/100 g 计算，每天约 670 g 蛤肉，这是唯一在可行性一个数量级之内的路径，仍然不是人的日常吃法。两种剂量都无法靠正常饮食达到。

Does the body make it身体是否自产

Two different verdicts in one row, so the roll-up is PARTIAL and the split has to be named. Quercetin scores NONE: it is a plant flavonol, no animal synthesises flavonoids at all because the pathway requires chalcone synthase, which humans lack, so every microgram is dietary and there is no requirement and no deficiency state. Taurine scores PARTIAL: you make it from cysteine by three routes, CSAD, which has low activity in humans, GADL1, which decarboxylates cysteine sulfinate to hypotaurine, and the cysteamine route where cysteamine from coenzyme A degradation is oxidised to hypotaurine by cysteamine dioxygenase (ADO), and that limited overall capacity is why tissue and plasma taurine track intake of meat, fish and shellfish. So any case for quercetin has to be pharmacological and runs into poor bioavailability and heavy conjugation, while taurine has a genuine dietary contribution and a short list of states where it matters.一行里两个不同判断, 汇总为 PARTIAL, 并要说明拆分: quercetin 为 NONE, taurine 为 PARTIAL。quercetin 是植物黄酮醇, 任何动物都不合成类黄酮, 因为该通路需要人类没有的 chalcone synthase, 每一微克都来自饮食, 既无需求也无缺乏状态。taurine 由 cysteine 合成, 有三条路线: 人体活性偏低的 CSAD, 把 cysteine sulfinate 脱羧为 hypotaurine 的 GADL1, 以及辅酶 A 降解产生的 cysteamine 由 cysteamine dioxygenase (ADO) 氧化为 hypotaurine 的路线; 总体能力仍然有限, 所以组织和血浆 taurine 随肉, 鱼, 贝类的摄入而变化。因此 quercetin 的任何理由都只能是药理性的, 且会撞上生物利用度差和大量结合代谢, 而 taurine 有真实的膳食贡献和一份明确的适用状态清单。

What it does它有什么作用

These are two unrelated molecules sold together for convenience. Quercetin is a plant flavonol from onions, capers, apples and tea; it is heavily glucuronidated and sulfated on first pass, so free aglycone concentrations in plasma stay in the nanomolar range and most antioxidant actions demonstrated in cell culture cannot occur at achievable oral doses. It has no physiological role in humans and no deficiency state of any kind. Taurine is a sulfur-containing beta-amino acid, the most abundant free amino acid in heart, retina and leukocytes. It conjugates bile acids, stabilises membranes, modulates calcium handling and cell volume, and is required for the mitochondrial tRNA modification that supports respiratory chain protein synthesis. Adults synthesize taurine from cysteine via cysteine sulfinic acid decarboxylase and obtain roughly 40 to 400 mg a day from meat and seafood, so nobody eating ordinary food becomes taurine depleted. Taurine is classified as conditionally essential, and the one documented human depletion is iatrogenic rather than dietary: in children fed long-term on taurine-free parenteral nutrition, plasma taurine ran about 26 plus or minus 13 versus 57 plus or minus 16 micromol/L in controls, and all 8 children tested had abnormal electroretinograms with delayed rod and cone implicit times, detectable before any visual problem was noticed. Taurine depletion also contributes to parenteral-nutrition-associated cholestasis in infants. Adding taurine to the intravenous solution restored plasma taurine in 4 supplemented children and normalised the electroretinogram in 3 of those 4, though plasma taurine relapsed in 2 of those 3 within a year of intravenous taurine being stopped, and the whole evidence base is a small 1985 case series. Paediatric parenteral amino acid solutions now routinely contain taurine, which prevents the problem at source.这是两种为方便合并销售的不相关分子。槲皮素是一种来自洋葱、刺山柑、苹果和茶的植物黄酮醇;它在首过代谢中被大量葡萄糖醛酸化和硫酸化,因此血浆中游离苷元浓度维持在纳摩尔范围,细胞培养中展示的大多数抗氧化作用在可达到的口服剂量下都无法实现。它在人体内没有生理作用,也不存在任何形式的缺乏状态。牛磺酸是一种含硫β-氨基酸,是心脏、视网膜和白细胞中含量最高的游离氨基酸。它结合胆汁酸、稳定细胞膜、调节钙处理和细胞体积,并且是支持呼吸链蛋白合成的线粒体tRNA修饰所必需的。成人通过半胱氨酸亚磺酸脱羧酶由半胱氨酸合成牛磺酸,并从肉类和海鲜中获得每日约40至400 mg,因此正常饮食的人不会出现牛磺酸缺乏。牛磺酸被归类为条件必需营养素,而目前唯一有记录的人体缺乏是医源性而非饮食性的:在长期接受不含牛磺酸的肠外营养的儿童中,血浆牛磺酸约为26加减13,而对照组为57加减16微摩尔/升,受检测的8名儿童全部出现视网膜电图异常,表现为视杆和视锥内隐含时延长,且在出现任何视觉问题之前即可检出。牛磺酸缺乏还与婴儿肠外营养相关性胆汁淤积有关。在静脉输液中添加牛磺酸使4名接受补充的儿童血浆牛磺酸恢复正常,其中3名的视网膜电图恢复正常,不过这3名中有2名在停用静脉牛磺酸后一年内血浆牛磺酸出现反弹,而且整个证据基础仅来自1985年的一项小型病例系列。目前儿科肠外氨基酸溶液已常规含有牛磺酸,从源头上预防了这一问题。

Dose tested已验证剂量

No effective dose exists. The doses tested and found harmful were 20 mg/d and 30 mg/d combined with retinyl palmitate.不存在有效剂量。经检验并被发现有害的剂量是 20 毫克/天，以及 30 毫克/天与棕榈酸视黄酯联用。

To match that from food用食物达到该剂量

By label mass the trial doses are reachable: 20 mg/day is about 241 g of raw carrot (four medium carrots), 174 g of baked sweet potato, or 215 g of carrot juice, and 30 mg/day is about 362 g of raw carrot. Carrot juice is the case that really tests this, because it is the one form anyone actually consumes in the volume required. By absorbed dose the answer flips. The Dietary Reference Intake conversion factors treat 12 µg of food beta-carotene as equivalent to 1 µg retinol activity against 2 µg for supplemental beta-carotene in oil, implying the supplement form is about six times more available (Institute of Medicine, DRIs for Vitamin A and related micronutrients, 2001, DOI 10.17226/10026). Matching the absorbed exposure of a 20 mg capsule therefore takes on the order of 120 mg of food beta-carotene, roughly 1.45 kg of raw carrots daily, which nobody eats and the gut would not absorb anyway. Food matches the label number and does not match the plasma exposure that produced the trial results.按标签质量算，试验剂量是够得着的：20 mg/天 约等于 241 g 生胡萝卜（四根中等大小），或 174 g 烤红薯，或 215 g 胡萝卜汁；30 mg/天 约为 362 g 生胡萝卜。真正检验这一点的是胡萝卜汁，因为它是唯一一种人们确实会按所需体积喝下去的形式。按吸收剂量算，答案就翻转了。膳食参考摄入量的换算系数把 12 µg 食物来源 β-胡萝卜素算作 1 µg 视黄醇活性当量，油溶补充剂形式的 β-胡萝卜素则是 2 µg，意味着补充剂形式的可利用度约高六倍（Institute of Medicine，DRIs for Vitamin A and related micronutrients，2001，DOI 10.17226/10026）。因此要在吸收暴露上匹配一粒 20 mg 胶囊，需要约 120 mg 食物来源 β-胡萝卜素，大致相当于每天 1.45 kg 生胡萝卜，没有人这么吃，肠道也吸收不了。食物能对上标签上的数字，对不上产生试验结果的那个血浆暴露水平。

Does the body make it身体是否自产

Humans synthesise no carotenoids whatsoever, so everything in the body reflects intake and there is no deficiency state for beta-carotene as such. The recovered set also carries a PARTIAL label for vitamin A from beta-carotene, and that PARTIAL describes the conversion of dietary beta-carotene into retinol rather than any synthesis of the carotenoid, so the two labels sit on different things and do not conflict. On this axis a beta-carotene supplement has no shortfall to correct, and it stands or falls on trial results for whatever endpoint is claimed.人体完全不合成任何类胡萝卜素, 所以体内的全部 beta-carotene 都反映摄入量, 也不存在针对 beta-carotene 本身的缺乏状态。恢复条目中还有一个标签把由 beta-carotene 得到的维生素 A 记为 PARTIAL, 那个 PARTIAL 说的是膳食 beta-carotene 向视黄醇的转化, 与类胡萝卜素本身的合成无关, 两个标签指向不同的东西, 并不冲突。在这条轴上, beta-carotene 补充剂没有可补的缺口, 成败完全取决于它所宣称终点的试验结果。

What it does它有什么作用

Beta-carotene is a provitamin A carotenoid, the orange pigment of carrots, sweet potato, pumpkin and dark green leaves. In the intestinal mucosa, beta-carotene 15,15'-oxygenase (BCO1) cleaves it to retinal, which is reduced to retinol and esterified for storage. The conversion is feedback-regulated and inefficient: the Institute of Medicine assigns 12 micrograms of dietary beta-carotene the vitamin A activity of 1 microgram of retinol. Purified beta-carotene in an oil matrix, the form in a capsule, bypasses the food-matrix release step and carries a separate and much more favourable ratio of 2 micrograms per 1 microgram retinol activity equivalent, so a supplement delivers roughly six times the retinol activity of the same weight eaten in food. Common BCO1 variants reduce conversion markedly in a substantial minority of people. Uncleaved beta-carotene acts as a lipid-phase antioxidant and singlet oxygen quencher in laboratory systems, but no human physiological process depends on the intact molecule, and every requirement it can meet is a vitamin A requirement that preformed retinol meets directly.β-胡萝卜素是一种维生素A原类胡萝卜素，是胡萝卜、红薯、南瓜及深绿色叶菜中的橙色色素。在肠黏膜中，β-胡萝卜素15,15'-加氧酶（beta-carotene 15,15'-oxygenase, BCO1）将其裂解为视黄醛，后者被还原为视黄醇并酯化储存。这一转化受反馈调节且效率不高：美国医学研究所（Institute of Medicine）将12 micrograms膳食β-胡萝卜素的维生素A活性定为等同于1 microgram视黄醇。以油基质形式存在的纯化β-胡萝卜素，即胶囊中的形式，绕过了食物基质的释放步骤，其换算比例更有利，为2 micrograms对应1 microgram视黄醇活性当量，因此补充剂提供的视黄醇活性约为同等重量食物摄入的六倍。常见的BCO1基因变异会使相当一部分人群的转化效率显著降低。未被裂解的β-胡萝卜素在实验体系中可作为脂相抗氧化剂及单线态氧猝灭剂，但人体没有任何生理过程依赖完整分子本身，而它所能满足的一切需求，都是预成型视黄醇可以直接满足的维生素A需求。

Documented deficiency, which in practice means fat malabsorption: abetalipoproteinaemia, cholestatic liver disease, cystic fibrosis, short bowel.已证实的缺乏，实际上指脂肪吸收不良：无β脂蛋白血症、胆汁淤积性肝病、囊性纤维化、短肠。

Dose tested已验证剂量

No effective preventive dose exists. 400 IU/d was the harmful dose. ATBC low-dose 50 mg/d produced neither benefit nor lung cancer harm.不存在有效的预防剂量。400 IU/天是有害剂量。ATBC 中 50 毫克/天的低剂量既无获益也未增加肺癌。

To match that from food用食物达到该剂量

400 IU of natural vitamin E is 268 mg of RRR-alpha-tocopherol. Reaching that every day from food means about 762 g of sunflower seeds (roughly 4,450 kcal), or 1.05 kg of almonds, or 179 g of wheatgerm oil (about 13 tablespoons of neat oil), or 550 g of sunflower oil at the CoFID value and 654 g at USDA's lower one. If the capsule is synthetic all-rac (180 mg for 400 IU), it is still 512 g of sunflower seeds or about 8.9 tablespoons of wheatgerm oil daily. Habitual intakes cluster around 5 to 20 mg/day, so 400 IU sits one to two orders of magnitude above anything eating produces. No dietary pattern gets there.400 IU 天然维生素 E 等于 268 mg RRR-α-生育酚。每天从食物达到这个量，意味着约 762 g 葵花籽（约 4,450 kcal），或 1.05 kg 杏仁，或 179 g 小麦胚芽油（约 13 汤匙纯油），或按 CoFID 数值 550 g 葵花籽油、按 USDA 较低数值 654 g。如果胶囊是合成的 all-rac 形式（400 IU 对应 180 mg），每天仍需 512 g 葵花籽，或约 8.9 汤匙小麦胚芽油。习惯摄入量集中在 5 至 20 mg/天，400 IU 比吃出来的任何量高出一到两个数量级。没有任何饮食模式能达到。

Does the body make it身体是否自产

Alpha-tocopherol is entirely dietary: humans carry no tocopherol or tocotrienol biosynthetic pathway, and human enzymology handles absorption with dietary fat, hepatic selection of the alpha-tocopherol form and lipoprotein transport only. NONE here does imply a requirement, and a deficiency state exists, described in the recovered prose in fat malabsorption and abetalipoproteinaemia. The axis therefore supports correcting a documented shortfall and gives no argument for 400 IU/d and above, which is a pharmacological antioxidant dose to be judged on its own trial and risk record.alpha-tocopherol 完全依赖膳食: 人体没有 tocopherol 或 tocotrienol 的合成通路, 人体酶学只负责随膳食脂肪的吸收, 肝脏对 alpha-tocopherol 形式的选择以及脂蛋白转运。这里的 NONE 确实意味着必需, 并且存在缺乏状态, 恢复文本把它写在脂肪吸收不良和 abetalipoproteinaemia 中。因此这条轴支持纠正有记录的不足, 对 400 IU/d 及以上没有任何依据, 那属于药理性抗氧化剂量, 应按其自身的试验与风险记录判断。

What it does它有什么作用

Alpha-tocopherol is the only form of vitamin E the body retains. After absorption, hepatic alpha-tocopherol transfer protein (TTPA) selectively loads alpha-tocopherol onto VLDL for export to tissues, while the other tocopherols and the tocotrienols are metabolised and excreted. Its established function is to break the chain reaction of lipid peroxidation in the polyunsaturated fatty acids of cell membranes and lipoproteins, donating a hydrogen atom to lipid peroxyl radicals and then being regenerated by ascorbate. The tissues that suffer first without it are peripheral nerve axons, the posterior columns and cerebellum, the retina, and the erythrocyte membrane. Converting the dose properly (1 mg alpha-tocopherol = 1.49 IU natural-source RRR, 2.22 IU synthetic all-rac), 400 IU is 268 mg of natural-source or 180 mg of synthetic alpha-tocopherol, roughly 12 to 18 times the adult RDA of 15 mg/d depending on which form the product uses, so at that level it is being used pharmacologically rather than to correct any dietary shortfall.α-生育酚是人体唯一保留的维生素E形式。吸收后，肝脏中的α-生育酚转运蛋白（TTPA）选择性地将α-生育酚装载到VLDL上以输送至各组织，而其余的生育酚及生育三烯酚则被代谢并排出。其确立的功能是阻断细胞膜及脂蛋白中多不饱和脂肪酸的脂质过氧化链式反应，向脂质过氧自由基提供一个氢原子，随后由抗坏血酸再生。缺乏时最先受损的组织是周围神经轴突、脊髓后索和小脑、视网膜以及红细胞膜。按正确换算（1 mg α-生育酚=1.49 IU天然来源RRR型，或2.22 IU合成all-rac型），400 IU相当于268 mg天然来源或180 mg合成α-生育酚，约为成人RDA（15 mg/d）的12至18倍，具体倍数取决于产品所用的形式，因此该剂量已是药理性使用，超出了纠正膳食摄入不足所需的范围。

If you lack it缺乏会怎样

Untreated, it progresses to a combined spinocerebellar and sensory picture: ataxia from posterior column degeneration, dysarthria, ophthalmoplegia, head titubation, proximal weakness, and pigmentary retinopathy with declining visual acuity. The endpoint is a person who can no longer walk unaided, with fixed sensory ataxia and neuropathy.若不治疗，将进展为脊髓小脑及感觉联合受损的表现：后索变性所致共济失调、构音障碍、眼肌麻痹、头部震颤、近端肌无力，以及伴视力下降的色素性视网膜病变。终末阶段患者无法独立行走，遗留固定性感觉性共济失调和神经病变。

Does it reverse补回来能修复吗

High-dose repletion reliably halts progression, and when started early (within roughly a year of symptom onset, or before symptoms in a child with known malabsorption) much of the neuropathy recovers. Long-standing posterior column and cerebellar degeneration and established retinopathy usually do not fully resolve, so treatment prevents more than it restores.大剂量补充能可靠地阻止病情进展，若在早期开始治疗（症状出现后约一年内，或在已知吸收不良的患儿出现症状之前），大部分神经病变可恢复。长期存在的脊髓后索和小脑变性以及已形成的视网膜病变通常无法完全恢复，因此治疗的作用重在预防，已造成的损害难以逆转。

Partly reversible部分可逆		 People with genuinely low selenium status: low-soil regions, long-term parenteral nutrition, severe malabsorption.硒状态确实偏低的人：土壤低硒地区、长期肠外营养、严重吸收不良。
Who it is for适用人群

People with genuinely low selenium status: low-soil regions, long-term parenteral nutrition, severe malabsorption.硒状态确实偏低的人：土壤低硒地区、长期肠外营养、严重吸收不良。

Dose tested已验证剂量

RDA is 55 µg/d and food intake meets it in most Western diets. 200 µg/d is the dose used in the failed and harmful trials.推荐摄入量为 55 微克/天，多数西方饮食通过食物即可满足。200 微克/天是那些失败并有害的试验所用剂量。

To match that from food用食物达到该剂量

There is almost no gap, and that is the finding. 200 ug/d is met by 2.1 average Brazil nuts (10 g), or 64 g of braised pork kidney, or 91 g of braised lamb kidney, or 185 g of cooked yellowfin tuna, or 180 g of braised lamb's liver, or 223 g of cooked blue mussels, or 243 g of simmered chicken liver, or 263 g of canned light tuna in oil, or 532 g of cooked cod, or 4 tins of sardines, or 13 eggs. Kidney and Brazil nuts overshoot in one normal portion: an 85 g portion of braised pork kidney is 265 ug, already 133 percent of the supplement dose and above the EFSA upper level on its own, and an 85 g portion of braised lamb kidney is 186 ug, 93 percent of the dose. Because the dose is so easy to reach, the useful calculation runs the other way. The EFSA AI is 70 ug/d and the EFSA upper level is 255 ug/d, a working margin of about 185 ug. A person on a 200 ug/d supplement plus an ordinary diet is at roughly 270 ug and already over the upper level; add two average Brazil nuts and they are at about 462 ug. The UL derives from alopecia observed in SELECT at a LOAEL of 330 ug/d, so this is an observed human effect at achievable intakes rather than a theoretical ceiling (DOI 10.2903/j.efsa.2023.7704). Selenium is the case where food easily matches the supplement, and the honest advice is to pick one route.几乎没有缺口，这本身就是结论。200 ug/d 可由 2.1 颗平均水平的巴西坚果（10 g）达到，或 64 g 炖猪肾、91 g 炖羊肾、185 g 熟黄鳍金枪鱼、180 g 炖羊肝、223 g 熟蓝贻贝、243 g 文火煮鸡肝、263 g 油浸罐装淡金枪鱼、532 g 熟鳕鱼、4 罐沙丁鱼，或 13 个鸡蛋。肾脏和巴西坚果在一份正常份量里就会超出：85 g 一份炖猪肾含 265 ug，已是补充剂剂量的 133%，单独就超过 EFSA 上限；85 g 一份炖羊肾含 186 ug，为该剂量的 93%。由于这个剂量太容易达到，有用的计算要反过来做。EFSA AI 为 70 ug/d，EFSA 上限为 255 ug/d，可用余量约 185 ug。一个每天服用 200 ug 补充剂并保持普通饮食的人，大约在 270 ug，已经超过上限；再加两颗平均水平的巴西坚果，就到约 462 ug。该上限源自 SELECT 中在 LOAEL 330 ug/d 观察到的脱发，这是在可达到的摄入量下观察到的人体效应，并非理论推算的天花板（DOI 10.2903/j.efsa.2023.7704）。硒是食物可以轻松匹配补充剂的例子，诚实的建议是两条路只选一条。

Does the body make it身体是否自产

Selenium is chemical element 34, so none of it can be made, although its functional form is partly homemade: the body builds selenocysteine on its own tRNA and inserts it at recoded UGA codons, using selenium supplied entirely by diet. At 200 µg/d the limiting issue is saturation, since selenoprotein P was optimised at an estimated intake of 49 µg/d in 98 healthy Chinese adults whose baseline intake was only 14 µg/d, and 75 µg Se/d as l-selenomethionine is postulated rather than measured to allow full selenoprotein expression in US residents, so the extra 125 to 150 µg buys no further selenoprotein. Supplementing at this dose therefore makes sense only for documented deficiency, and above the plateau the dose is pharmacological, with type 2 diabetes incidence raised in the Nutritional Prevention of Cancer trial (overall hazard ratio 1.55) and high-grade prostate cancer in SELECT.硒是34号化学元素，本身完全无法合成，但它的功能形式部分是体内自制的：身体在自己的 tRNA 上组装硒代半胱氨酸，并把它插入被重新编码的 UGA 密码子，所用的硒全部来自膳食。在 200 µg/d 这个剂量上，关键问题是饱和：硒蛋白 P 在 98 名基线摄入仅 14 µg/d 的健康中国成年人中，估计摄入 49 µg/d 即可达到最优，而以 l-硒代甲硫氨酸形式 75 µg Se/d 可让美国居民完整表达硒蛋白（这是推定值，并非实测值），所以多出来的 125 至 150 µg 换不来更多硒蛋白。因此这个剂量只有在已确诊缺乏时才说得通，超过平台之后剂量已属药理范畴：Nutritional Prevention of Cancer 试验中2型糖尿病发生率升高（总体风险比 1.55），SELECT 中高级别前列腺癌增加。

What it does它有什么作用

Selenium is incorporated as the amino acid selenocysteine into about 25 human selenoproteins. The glutathione peroxidases (GPX1 to GPX4) reduce hydrogen peroxide and lipid hydroperoxides, GPX4 specifically preventing ferroptotic membrane damage. Thioredoxin reductases maintain cellular redox state and support DNA synthesis. The iodothyronine deiodinases convert T4 to active T3, which links selenium status to thyroid function. Selenoprotein P is the plasma transport form and the best status marker. The dose in this entry matters. Plasma glutathione peroxidase (GPX3) plateaus near 55 micrograms per day, which is what the RDA is built on. Selenoprotein P plateaus somewhere in the range of roughly 50 to 105 micrograms per day depending on baseline status: about 49 micrograms per day in selenium-deficient Chinese subjects, against about 105 micrograms per day of total intake in UK adults (a 50 microgram supplement on top of roughly 55 micrograms habitual). Either way, 200 micrograms per day supplies three to four times the adult RDA and produces no further enzyme activity in someone already replete, while sitting halfway to the tolerable upper limit of 400 micrograms per day. In the Nutritional Prevention of Cancer trial, 200 micrograms per day for a mean 7.7 years raised type 2 diabetes incidence (hazard ratio 1.55, 95% CI 1.03 to 2.33), concentrated in participants who started in the highest baseline selenium tertile (hazard ratio 2.70).硒以硒代半胱氨酸(selenocysteine)的形式掺入约25种人体硒蛋白中。谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶(GPX1至GPX4)可还原过氧化氢和脂质氢过氧化物,其中GPX4特异性地防止铁死亡相关的膜损伤。硫氧还蛋白还原酶(thioredoxin reductase)维持细胞氧化还原状态并支持DNA合成。碘甲腺原氨酸脱碘酶(iodothyronine deiodinase)将T4转化为活性T3,这将硒的状态与甲状腺功能联系起来。硒蛋白P(selenoprotein P)是血浆中的转运形式,也是评估硒状态的最佳指标。本条目中的剂量至关重要。血浆谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶(GPX3)在每日约55微克摄入时达到平台,这正是每日推荐摄入量(RDA)的依据。硒蛋白P的平台值因基线状态而异,大致在每日50至105微克之间:在硒缺乏的中国受试者中约为每日49微克,而在英国成人中总摄入量约为每日105微克(在约55微克习惯摄入基础上加50微克补充剂)。无论按哪个指标,每日200微克都相当于成人RDA的三到四倍,对于已经硒充足的人不会带来任何进一步的酶活性提升,同时已达到每日400微克可耐受最高摄入量的一半。在Nutritional Prevention of Cancer(营养预防癌症)试验中,平均7.7年每日200微克使2型糖尿病发病率上升(风险比1.55,95%置信区间1.03至2.33),这一效应集中在基线硒水平处于最高三分位的受试者中(风险比2.70)。

If you lack it缺乏会怎样

Keshan disease presents acutely with cardiogenic shock and arrhythmia, or chronically as congestive cardiomyopathy with cardiac enlargement and multifocal myocardial necrosis and fibrosis. It classically strikes children and women of childbearing age in low-soil-selenium areas and is fatal without treatment. A coxsackievirus co-factor is thought to trigger the acute form in a selenium-depleted host. Kashin-Beck disease destroys growth-plate and articular cartilage, producing shortened fingers, deformed ankles, knees, wrists and elbows, and permanently limited movement.克山病急性发作时表现为心源性休克和心律失常,慢性表现为充血性心肌病,伴心脏扩大及多灶性心肌坏死和纤维化。该病典型地侵袭低土壤硒地区的儿童和育龄期女性,若不治疗可致命。柯萨奇病毒被认为是在硒耗竭宿主中触发急性型的协同因素。大骨节病破坏生长板和关节软骨,导致手指变短、踝、膝、腕、肘关节畸形,并造成永久性活动受限。

Does it reverse补回来能修复吗

Early Keshan disease responds well to selenium replacement, and heart failure can improve substantially or resolve if caught before the myocardium is remodelled. Once dilated cardiomyopathy with established fibrosis has developed, the myocardial damage does not fully reverse and outcomes are poor. Kashin-Beck cartilage necrosis and the resulting joint deformity are permanent. Prophylactic sodium selenite in endemic Chinese counties prevented new cases, which is the clearest evidence the causal direction is right.早期克山病对补硒反应良好,若在心肌发生重塑之前发现,心力衰竭可显著改善甚至消退。一旦发展为伴有明确纤维化的扩张型心肌病,心肌损伤就不能完全逆转,预后较差。大骨节病造成的软骨坏死及由此产生的关节畸形是永久性的。在中国地方病流行县实施预防性亚硒酸钠干预可预防新发病例,这是因果关系方向正确的最有力证据。

Partly reversible部分可逆		 Clinical vitamin A deficiency in low-income settings, fat malabsorption, cystic fibrosis. In replete Western adults, nobody.低收入地区的临床维生素 A 缺乏、脂肪吸收不良、囊性纤维化。在营养充足的西方成人中，没有适用人群。
Who it is for适用人群

Clinical vitamin A deficiency in low-income settings, fat malabsorption, cystic fibrosis. In replete Western adults, nobody.低收入地区的临床维生素 A 缺乏、脂肪吸收不良、囊性纤维化。在营养充足的西方成人中，没有适用人群。

Dose tested已验证剂量

RDA 900 µg RAE for men and 700 µg for women. The upper limit is 3,000 µg/d, which is exactly 10,000 IU.推荐摄入量：男性 900 微克 RAE，女性 700 微克。上限为 3000 微克/天，正好等于 10000 IU。

To match that from food用食物达到该剂量

There is no gap to close. About 12 g of fried calf liver supplies the full 3,000 µg (10,000 IU) of a high-dose retinol capsule, and a normal 100 g portion of any liver delivers 3.5 to 8.4 times that dose in one sitting. A 40 g serving of liver pate is functionally a 10,000 IU tablet at 2,920 µg (9,730 IU). A tablespoon of cod liver oil is 2,448 µg (8,160 IU). Anyone eating liver weekly is already taking supraphysiological preformed vitamin A intermittently, and a 10,000 IU supplement on top compounds a load the body stores rather than clears. For scale, the US tolerable upper intake level for preformed vitamin A is 3,000 µg/day, which is the supplement dose itself, against a UK RNI of 700 µg for men and 600 µg for women.这里没有需要填补的缺口。约 12 g 油炸小牛肝就能提供高剂量视黄醇胶囊的全部 3,000 µg（10,000 IU），而任何一种肝脏的常规 100 g 份量，一餐就能送来该剂量的 3.5 至 8.4 倍。40 g 肝酱含 2,920 µg（9,730 IU），功能上等同一片 10,000 IU 的药片。一汤匙鱼肝油是 2,448 µg（8,160 IU）。每周吃肝的人已经在间歇性摄入超生理量的预制型维生素 A，再叠加 10,000 IU 补充剂，只会加重身体倾向储存而非清除的负荷。作为参照，美国预制型维生素 A 的可耐受最高摄入量是 3,000 µg/天，恰好就是这个补充剂剂量本身，而英国 RNI 为男性 700 µg、女性 600 µg。

Does the body make it身体是否自产

Retinol cannot be built from scratch at all, because human cells only cleave dietary provitamin A carotenoids to make it and there is no de novo retinoid pathway. NONE means required here, so ordinary vitamin A intake has a real target and deficiency is a genuine clinical state. The axis says nothing for 10,000 IU and above of preformed retinol, where the retinol load itself is the hazard, and high retinol doses are specifically to be avoided in pregnancy because of teratogenicity.视黄醇完全无法从头合成, 人体细胞只能裂解膳食中的维生素 A 原类胡萝卜素来获得它, 没有从头合成的类视黄醇通路。这里的 NONE 意味着必需, 所以常规维生素 A 摄入有真实的作用目标, 缺乏也是真实的临床状态。这条轴对 10,000 IU 及以上的预成型视黄醇没有任何依据, 那里的问题正是视黄醇负荷本身, 妊娠期尤其要避免高剂量视黄醇, 因为有致畸性。

What it does它有什么作用

Retinol is oxidised to 11-cis-retinal, which binds opsin to form rhodopsin, the photopigment of the rod cells that makes vision in dim light possible. By a separate route it is oxidised to all-trans and 9-cis retinoic acid, ligands for the nuclear RAR and RXR receptors, which regulate transcription of genes controlling epithelial differentiation (goblet cells and mucin production in the conjunctiva, cornea, respiratory tract and gut), embryonic patterning, haematopoiesis, and both innate and adaptive immunity including gut-homing of T lymphocytes. Preformed retinol from liver, dairy, eggs and supplements is absorbed efficiently and stored in hepatic stellate cells, which buffer plasma concentrations for months. 10,000 IU is about 3,000 micrograms retinol activity equivalents, roughly four times the adult RDA and at the tolerable upper intake level, so at this dose the clinically relevant question is excess rather than shortfall.视黄醇被氧化为11-顺式视黄醛，后者与视蛋白结合形成视紫红质，即视杆细胞的感光色素，使暗光视觉成为可能。经另一条途径，它被氧化为全反式及9-顺式视黄酸，是核内RAR和RXR受体的配体，调控相关基因的转录，这些基因控制上皮分化（结膜、角膜、呼吸道及肠道中杯状细胞和黏蛋白生成）、胚胎发育模式形成、造血功能，以及包括T淋巴细胞归巢肠道在内的固有免疫和适应性免疫。来自肝脏、乳制品、蛋类及补充剂的预成型视黄醇吸收效率高，储存于肝星状细胞中，可缓冲血浆浓度长达数月。10,000 IU约为3,000 micrograms视黄醇活性当量，约为成人RDA的四倍，已达到可耐受最高摄入量水平。因此在此剂量下，临床上真正需要关注的是过量问题，摄入不足并非重点。

If you lack it缺乏会怎样

Corneal xerosis progresses to punctate keratopathy, then corneal ulceration, then keratomalacia, in which the corneal stroma liquefies over a few days and frequently perforates. The eye is structurally destroyed and blindness is permanent. Deficiency also substantially raises child mortality from measles, diarrhoeal disease and respiratory infection, and roughly half of the children who go blind from it die within twelve months.角膜干燥进展为点状角膜病变，继而角膜溃疡，最终发展为角膜软化症：角膜基质在数天内液化，常伴穿孔。眼球结构被破坏，失明为永久性。缺乏还会大幅提高儿童因麻疹、腹泻及呼吸道感染导致的死亡率，因此致盲的儿童中约半数在12个月内死亡。

Does it reverse补回来能修复吗

Night blindness, conjunctival xerosis and Bitot spots reverse within days to weeks of high-dose retinol. Once the cornea ulcerates or melts, the loss is structural and permanent, and vitamin A deficiency remains a leading cause of preventable childhood blindness worldwide. The window between the fully reversible and the irreversible stage can be only a few days in a sick, depleted child, which is why treatment is given on clinical suspicion without waiting for a retinol assay.大剂量视黄醇治疗后，夜盲、结膜干燥及Bitot斑可在数天至数周内恢复。一旦角膜发生溃疡或液化，损害即为结构性且永久性的，维生素A缺乏症至今仍是全球儿童可预防性失明的主要病因之一。在病情严重、储备耗竭的患儿中，从完全可逆到不可逆阶段之间的窗口期可能仅有数天，这也是临床一旦怀疑即予治疗、不等视黄醇检测结果的原因。

High-dose vitamin B6大剂量维生素 B6Vitamin B6 powers amino acid enzymes; at high doses it damages sensory nerves.维生素B6为多种氨基酸代谢酶提供动力，大剂量时则会损伤感觉神经。 AABBFFDDBBXX Avoid不要吃 Rich丰富 Out of reach达不到 Cannot不能 Named deficiency disease有明确的缺乏症 People on isoniazid, cycloserine, hydralazine or penicillamine, where B6 is protective against drug-induced neuropathy. Pregnant women with nausea and vomiting, at obstetric direction.服用异烟肼、环丝氨酸、肼屈嗪或青霉胺者，此时 B6 可预防药物性神经病。妊娠恶心呕吐的孕妇，需遵产科医嘱。
Who it is for适用人群

People on isoniazid, cycloserine, hydralazine or penicillamine, where B6 is protective against drug-induced neuropathy. Pregnant women with nausea and vomiting, at obstetric direction.服用异烟肼、环丝氨酸、肼屈嗪或青霉胺者，此时 B6 可预防药物性神经病。妊娠恶心呕吐的孕妇，需遵产科医嘱。

Dose tested已验证剂量

RDA is 1.3 mg/d. EFSA set the upper limit at 12 mg/d in 2023. The US IOM figure is still 100 mg/d.推荐摄入量为 1.3 毫克/天。EFSA 于 2023 年把上限定为 12 毫克/天。美国 IOM 的数字仍是 100 毫克/天。

To match that from food用食物达到该剂量

A 100 mg pyridoxine tablet is 77 times the RDA. Matching it by eating, in one day, takes 7.46 kg of dried sunflower kernels, 8.93 kg of pistachios, 9.80 kg of braised beef liver, 10.7 kg of raw yellowfin tuna, 16.7 kg of roasted chicken breast, or 27.2 kg of banana, about 231 medium bananas. A 50 mg tablet still needs 4.46 kg of pistachios or 116 bananas. Even the regulatory ceiling sits outside dietary reach: EFSA's 2023 tolerable upper intake level of 12 mg/day for adults corresponds to about 1.07 kg of pistachios or 3.27 kg of banana, roughly 28 bananas, every single day. Nobody eats any of that. Ordinary diets deliver a few mg per day, an order of magnitude below the UL and two to three orders below the supplement, and that is the mechanical reason dietary B6 has never produced the sensory neuropathy that supplements produce: no food is concentrated enough to approach the toxic range. The syndrome was described in seven adults taking megadose pyridoxine (Schaumburg H et al., 'Sensory neuropathy from pyridoxine abuse. A new megavitamin syndrome', N Engl J Med 1983;309:445-8, PMID 6308447), all of whom improved after withdrawal; the widely quoted 2-6 g/day range is secondary-literature summary that does not appear in the abstract, so treat it as unconfirmed and source any dose figure to the full text or to EFSA's case tabulation. Cases have since been reported at far lower supplemental doses, and EFSA cut the adult UL from the SCF's 25 mg/day to 12 mg/day on peripheral neuropathy grounds, from a 50 mg/day reference point with an uncertainty factor of 4 (EFSA NDA Panel, EFSA J 2023;21:e08006, PMID 37207271, DOI 10.2903/j.efsa.2023.8006). Not one case has been attributed to food B6.一片 100 mg 的吡哆醇是 RDA 的 77 倍。要在一天之内靠吃达到同样的量，需要 7.46 kg 干葵花籽仁、8.93 kg 开心果、9.80 kg 炖牛肝、10.7 kg 生黄鳍金枪鱼、16.7 kg 烤鸡胸肉，或 27.2 kg 香蕉，约 231 根中等大小的香蕉。50 mg 的片剂也仍需 4.46 kg 开心果或 116 根香蕉。连监管上限都在膳食可及范围之外：EFSA 2023 年为成人定的可耐受最高摄入量 12 mg/天，相当于每天约 1.07 kg 开心果或 3.27 kg 香蕉，约 28 根香蕉。这些没有人会吃。普通饮食每天提供几 mg，比 UL 低一个数量级，比补充剂低两到三个数量级，这就是膳食 B6 从未造成补充剂那种感觉神经病变的机械原因：没有食物浓到能接近中毒范围。该综合征最初描述于 7 名服用超大剂量吡哆醇的成年人（Schaumburg H 等, Sensory neuropathy from pyridoxine abuse. A new megavitamin syndrome, N Engl J Med 1983;309:445-8, PMID 6308447），停用后全部好转；被广泛引用的 2-6 g/天这个区间出自二手文献的概述，摘要里并没有，因此按未确认处理，任何剂量数字都应回到全文或 EFSA 的病例汇总去核对。此后在低得多的补充剂量下也有病例报告，EFSA 以周围神经病变为依据，把成人 UL 从 SCF 的 25 mg/天下调到 12 mg/天，参考点为 50 mg/天，不确定系数取 4（EFSA NDA Panel, EFSA J 2023;21:e08006, PMID 37207271, DOI 10.2903/j.efsa.2023.8006）。没有一例被归因于食物中的 B6。

Does the body make it身体是否自产

Humans have no vitamin B6 biosynthetic pathway; human enzymology only absorbs the dietary vitamers, interconverts them and phosphorylates them to pyridoxal 5-phosphate, the cofactor form. NONE means required, and the recovered prose names seizures and dermatitis as the deficiency picture, so ordinary B6 intake has a real target. The axis supports correcting a shortfall and gives no argument for the high-dose part, which is pharmacological and has to be judged on its own trial and safety record.人体没有维生素 B6 的生物合成通路; 人体酶学只负责吸收膳食中的各种 vitamer, 在它们之间相互转化, 并磷酸化为辅因子形式 pyridoxal 5-phosphate。NONE 意味着必需, 恢复文本把缺乏表现写为癫痫发作与皮炎, 所以常规 B6 摄入有真实的作用目标。这条轴支持纠正不足, 对高剂量这一部分没有任何依据, 那属于药理用法, 应按其自身的试验与安全记录判断。

What it does它有什么作用

The active form, pyridoxal 5'-phosphate, is the cofactor for well over 100 enzymes, most of them in amino acid metabolism: transaminases, the decarboxylases that make serotonin, dopamine, GABA and histamine, the first committed step of haem synthesis (ALA synthase), glycogen phosphorylase, and cystathionine beta-synthase and gamma-lyase, which dispose of homocysteine by transsulphuration. Requirement rises with protein intake. Above the point where these enzymes are saturated, extra B6 adds no function. High-dose products (typically 50 to 500 mg/day, sold for premenstrual symptoms, carpal tunnel syndrome, nausea in pregnancy, or hidden inside B-complex and energy formulations) instead produce a dose-dependent and duration-dependent sensory neuropathy, with the dorsal root ganglion as the target. On toxicity, which is a separate question from the deficiency rated below: because the injury is to the sensory nerve cell bodies in the dorsal root ganglion rather than to the axon alone, recovery after stopping the supplement is often incomplete. Numbness and impaired position sense usually improve over several months, sometimes substantially, but residual deficit persists in some people (Schaumburg 1983). Time to onset is inversely related to dose, so grams per day can do it in weeks while tens of milligrams may take years, which is why EFSA applied an uncertainty factor of 4 to a 50 mg/day reference point when setting the 12 mg/day adult upper level in 2023.活性形式5'-磷酸吡哆醛是100多种酶的辅因子，其中多数参与氨基酸代谢：转氨酶、合成血清素、多巴胺、GABA和组胺的脱羧酶、血红素合成的第一个限速步骤（ALA synthase）、glycogen phosphorylase，以及通过转硫途径清除同型半胱氨酸的cystathionine beta-synthase和gamma-lyase。需要量随蛋白质摄入量增加而上升。超过这些酶的饱和点后，额外补充的B6不再增加任何功能。大剂量产品（通常每日50至500 mg，用于经前症状、腕管综合征、妊娠恶心，或隐藏在复合B族维生素和能量补充剂中）反而会产生与剂量和持续时间相关的感觉神经病变，靶点是背根神经节。关于毒性问题，这与下文评定的缺乏症是两个不同的问题：由于损伤的是背根神经节内感觉神经元的胞体而非仅是轴突，停用补充剂后的恢复往往并不完全。麻木和位置觉障碍通常在数月内改善，有时改善明显，但部分人会遗留残余缺陷（Schaumburg 1983）。起病时间与剂量成反比，每日以克计的剂量可在数周内致病，而每日数十毫克则可能需要数年，这正是EFSA在2023年设定成人每日12 mg上限时，对50 mg/day参考点采用不确定系数4的原因。

If you lack it缺乏会怎样

Hypochromic microcytic anaemia from impaired haem synthesis (distinct from X-linked ALAS2 pyridoxine-responsive sideroblastic anaemia, which is genetic, not dietary), and a peripheral sensory neuropathy. In infants, deficiency causes seizures through failure of GABA synthesis. Isolated severe deficiency is rare and is nearly always secondary: isoniazid, cycloserine, hydralazine or penicillamine treatment, alcohol dependence, dialysis, or malabsorption. Note that both deficiency and excess of B6 produce peripheral neuropathy, so neuropathy in a supplement user is at least as likely to be caused by the supplement as corrected by it.血红素合成受损导致的低色素小细胞性贫血（不同于X连锁ALAS2基因相关的吡哆醇反应性铁粒幼细胞性贫血，后者是遗传性的，而非饮食性的），以及周围感觉神经病变。婴儿缺乏时会因GABA合成障碍而引发癫痫发作。单纯的重度缺乏很少见，几乎总是继发于：异烟肼、环丝氨酸、肼屈嗪或青霉胺治疗、酒精依赖、透析或吸收不良。需要注意的是，B6缺乏和过量都会导致周围神经病变，因此补充剂使用者出现的神经病变，由补充剂本身引起的可能性并不低于由其纠正的可能性。

Does it reverse补回来能修复吗

This field rates recovery from the deficiency, and B6 deficiency corrects fully within weeks on modest repletion, with no residual deficit: the mucocutaneous signs clear, the anaemia resolves, and pyridoxine-responsive infantile seizures stop once the vitamin is given. Recovery from high-dose B6 neuropathy is a different question with a different answer (often incomplete) and is set out in the function description above, not here.本字段评定的是缺乏症的恢复情况，适度补充数周内B6缺乏即可完全纠正，不留残余缺陷：皮肤黏膜体征消退，贫血缓解，给予维生素后吡哆醇反应性婴儿癫痫发作停止。大剂量B6神经病变的恢复是另一个问题，答案也不同（往往不完全），已在上文的功能描述中说明，此处不再重复。

Green tea extract (EGCG)绿茶提取物（EGCG）A tea polyphenol the body does not need; concentrated extracts can injure the liver.一种人体并不需要的茶多酚;高浓度提取物可能损伤肝脏。 AABBFFDDBBXX Avoid不要吃 Rich丰富 Reachable可达到 Cannot不能 No deficiency state exists不存在缺乏状态 Nobody for the marketed indications. Drinking green tea is fine and is a different exposure.就其宣传的功效而言没有适用人群。喝绿茶没问题，那是完全不同的暴露方式。
Who it is for适用人群

Nobody for the marketed indications. Drinking green tea is fine and is a different exposure.就其宣传的功效而言没有适用人群。喝绿茶没问题，那是完全不同的暴露方式。

Dose tested已验证剂量

Commercial products commonly deliver 250-500 mg EGCG/d. EFSA found significant transaminase elevation at or above 800 mg/d.市售产品常提供 EGCG 250 至 500 毫克/天。EFSA 发现在 800 毫克/天及以上转氨酶显著升高。

To match that from food用食物达到该剂量

800 mg EGCG, the dose at which supplements produce measurable liver enzyme rises, is about 4 to 5 cups of green tea at EFSA's mean brewed concentration of 70.2 mg/100 mL, or 10 to 16 cups of more weakly brewed retail tea, or about 7 to 8 bowls of matcha at 2 g each. EFSA's high-level consumers already reach 308 to 866 mg/day from infusions alone, so the top of that range is at the supplement dose. What differs is the vehicle: the tea drinker's 800 mg arrives spread over a day in two to three litres of water, usually with food, while the supplement delivers it as a single fasted bolus.补充剂在 800 mg EGCG 这一剂量上会造成可测得的肝酶升高。按 EFSA 冲泡液平均浓度 70.2 mg/100 mL 计算，这相当于约 4 至 5 杯绿茶，或 10 至 16 杯冲泡较淡的零售茶，或每碗 2 g 的抹茶约 7 至 8 碗。EFSA 的高摄入人群仅靠冲泡茶饮就已达到每天 308 至 866 mg，该区间上限正处在补充剂剂量水平。差别在载体：饮茶者的 800 mg 分散在一天两到三升水中摄入，通常还伴随食物，而补充剂是空腹一次性大剂量给药。

Does the body make it身体是否自产

EGCG is a galloylated flavan-3-ol built in the tea plant by the shikimate and phenylpropanoid pathways plus chalcone synthase, with a dedicated epicatechin galloyltransferase adding the gallate group. Humans have none of those enzymes, starting with phenylalanine ammonia-lyase, so intake is the only source and no deficiency exists. On this axis EGCG is optional by definition, which shifts the whole question onto trial benefit and onto safety, where concentrated catechin extracts carry a documented liver injury signal that brewed tea does not.EGCG 是一种没食子酰化的黄烷-3-醇, 在茶树中由莽草酸通路、phenylpropanoid 通路以及 chalcone synthase 合成, 并由专门的 epicatechin galloyltransferase 加上没食子酰基。人体从 phenylalanine ammonia-lyase 起就没有这些酶, 因此摄入是唯一来源, 也不存在缺乏。在这个维度上 EGCG 按定义就是可选项, 于是全部问题落到试验获益和安全性上, 而浓缩儿茶素提取物有明确记录的肝损伤信号, 冲泡茶饮没有。

What it does它有什么作用

Epigallocatechin-3-gallate is the dominant catechin of green tea. It is poorly absorbed, extensively methylated, glucuronidated and sulfated, and degraded by gut microbiota, leaving free plasma EGCG in the sub-micromolar range. Proposed actions include inhibition of catechol-O-methyltransferase, modest effects on fat oxidation and binding to the 67 kDa laminin receptor, none of which establish any physiological requirement. The important safety fact runs the other way: concentrated extracts, especially taken while fasting, cause idiosyncratic hepatocellular injury, with published cases spanning intakes of roughly 140 to 1000 mg EGCG per day and a strong association with the HLA-B*35:01 allele. Brewed tea as a beverage is not implicated at these concentrations.表没食子儿茶素没食子酸酯(EGCG)是绿茶中含量最高的儿茶素。它吸收较差,会被大量甲基化、葡萄糖醛酸化和硫酸化,并被肠道菌群降解,使血浆中游离EGCG浓度维持在亚微摩尔范围。所提出的作用包括抑制儿茶酚-O-甲基转移酶、对脂肪氧化的轻微影响,以及与67 kDa层粘连蛋白受体的结合,但这些都不能确立任何生理需求。真正重要的安全事实方向恰恰相反:高浓度提取物,尤其是在空腹状态下服用时,可引起特异质性肝细胞损伤,已发表病例涉及的EGCG摄入量约为每天140至1000 mg,并与HLA-B*35:01等位基因存在密切关联。作为饮品的冲泡茶在这些浓度下不涉及该风险。

Trials use 300-600 mg/day of standardised root extract. KSM-66 is a root-only extract standardised to a minimum 5% withanolides, Sensoril is a root-and-leaf extract at 10%, and Shoden is standardised to 35% withanolide glycosides, so a typical daily dose is roughly 15-60 mg of withanolides. Traditional practice uses 3-6 g/day of dried root powder to reach a comparable place. No food quantity supplies this at any size, because no food plant contains withanolides. Quoting an equivalent weight of an ordinary food would require inventing a content value, so the honest answer is that the dietary route does not exist.试验用量为标准化根提取物 300-600 mg/天。KSM-66 是仅用根的提取物，标准化到至少 5% 睡茄内酯；Sensoril 是根加叶提取物，含量 10%；Shoden 标准化到 35% 睡茄内酯糖苷。因此典型每日剂量约相当于 15-60 mg 睡茄内酯。传统做法用 3-6 g/天的干根粉达到大致相当的水平。任何份量的食物都无法提供这个量，因为没有食用植物含睡茄内酯。要给出某种普通食物的等效重量，就必须凭空编一个含量值，所以诚实的答案是：膳食途径不存在。

Does the body make it身体是否自产

The active constituents are withanolides, steroidal lactones such as withaferin A and withanolide A, built in the plant from mevalonate-derived sterols. Humans make sterols but not withanolides, and there is no human enzyme that produces the withanolide lactone ring. Nothing about ashwagandha can be framed as replacing something the body has run short of.活性成分是 withanolides, 即 withaferin A 和 withanolide A 这类甾体内酯, 在植物体内由甲羟戊酸途径来源的甾醇构建。人能合成甾醇, 不能合成 withanolides, 也没有任何人类酶能生成 withanolide 的内酯环。因此不能把服用南非醉茄说成补充身体短缺的东西。

What it does它有什么作用

Withania somnifera root contains withanolides (principally withaferin A and withanolide A) together with sitoindosides, and commercial extracts are standardised to withanolide content. Randomised trials running 8 to 12 weeks report modest reductions in self-rated stress scales and in morning serum cortisol, while the proposed HPA axis and GABA-A receptor mechanisms rest largely on animal and in vitro work. Nothing in the human body synthesises withanolides and no metabolic pathway requires them, so this is a pharmacological exposure rather than a nutritional one. Liver injury is a documented harm: a case series from Iceland and the US Drug-Induced Liver Injury Network described five patients (3 male, 2 female, mean age 43, range 21 to 62) who became jaundiced 2 to 12 weeks after starting ashwagandha, with cholestatic or mixed injury (R ratios 1.4 to 3.3) and hyperbilirubinaemia persisting 5 to 20 weeks. Liver tests normalised within 1 to 5 months in four of the five and the fifth was lost to follow-up; no patient developed hepatic failure and there were no deaths or transplants in the series.睡茄(Withania somnifera)根含有睡茄内酯类成分(主要是withaferin A和withanolide A),并伴有sitoindosides,商业提取物通常按睡茄内酯含量进行标准化。为期8至12周的随机试验报告显示,自评压力量表评分和晨间血清皮质醇有轻度下降,而所提出的下丘脑垂体肾上腺轴及GABA-A受体机制主要依据动物和体外实验。人体没有任何组织合成睡茄内酯,也没有代谢通路需要它,因此这属于药理学暴露,而非营养摄入。肝损伤是已被记录的一种危害:冰岛与美国药物性肝损伤网络(DILIN)的一份病例系列报道了5例患者(男性3例,女性2例,平均年龄43岁,范围21至62岁),在开始服用南非醉茄后2至12周出现黄疸,呈胆汁淤积性或混合性损伤(R值1.4至3.3),高胆红素血症持续5至20周。5例中有4例的肝功能在1至5个月内恢复正常,第5例失访。该系列中无一例发展为肝功能衰竭,也无死亡或肝移植病例。

Component by component. Caffeine: 200 mg is four to five 150 mL cups of filter coffee on the cited Brazilian table, or about two 240 mL US/UK mugs at roughly 95 mg each, or five cups of green tea, so this one is trivially reachable (guarana powder, yerba mate, cocoa and energy drinks belong in the same picture and appear in the same cited caffeine table, but no per-portion figure was verified here, so they get no row). p-Synephrine: a single 240 mL glass of Seville orange juice at about 13 mg already sits inside the 10 to 53 mg/day range used in the pooled overweight and obese subjects, whose individual study doses spanned 5.5 to 80 mg. Garcinia: 3 g of dried rind souring a pot for four carries 300 to 900 mg HCA at 10 to 30% w/w, about 75 to 225 mg per person against supplement doses of 72 to 900 mg HCA, and less again because HCA transfers only partly into the broth and the rind is fished out rather than eaten, so culinary use lands in the lower middle of the supplement range rather than at its top. This is a blended product category whose actual contents are not a defined substance, so the axis label is NA and the split has to be stated: caffeine, synephrine, green tea catechins and yohimbine are plant compounds with no human biosynthetic route and read NONE, while the same blends routinely include L-carnitine, which is endogenously synthesised and CONDITIONAL in its own right, and sometimes CLA, whose c9,t11 isomer has a partial human route. Typical declared ingredients are caffeine, green tea catechins, synephrine, yohimbine, garcinia and undisclosed stimulant analogues, often behind a proprietary blend label that conceals individual doses. Weight-loss products accounted for 317 of the 776 supplements associated with US FDA warnings from 2007 to 2016, and within them 84.9% contained sibutramine, an appetite suppressant suspended in the EU in January 2010 and withdrawn in the US in October 2010 over cardiovascular events, though it remained on the market in some countries afterwards; 23.7% contained the laxative phenolphthalein, 6.3% contained sibutramine analogues and 5.4% contained fluoxetine. Non-bodybuilding herbal and dietary supplements as a class carry the worst liver outcomes in the US Drug-Induced Liver Injury Network: among DILIN-enrolled liver-injury cases, death or liver transplantation occurred in 13% of the 85 non-bodybuilding supplement cases against 3% for conventional medications. That group is heterogeneous, covering weight-loss along with energy, joint, immune and mixed products, and the figure describes outcomes among adjudicated cases already in a hepatology referral network rather than the risk of taking such a product. A healthy man's testes already make about 7 mg of testosterone a day, output pinned where it is by LH feedback through the hypothalamic-pituitary-gonadal axis, so in a eugonadal man there is no idle synthetic capacity for a capsule to unlock, and the CONDITIONAL tier exists because total testosterone declines roughly 1 percent a year from midlife and the body demonstrably does not make enough in primary or secondary hypogonadism. Tribulus, fenugreek and ashwagandha withanolides score NONE with no requirement and no deficiency state attached, and the compounds that reliably move testosterone are drugs (anabolic steroids, SARMs, hCG, aromatase inhibitors) that work by overriding or suppressing that feedback loop, so no case for these products can be built on this axis.判为 NA, 因为这是商业产品类别, 内容物不是确定的物质, 这条轴无法作用于产品本身; 已研究的分类是健康年轻男性 FULL, 衰老, 性腺功能低下和 HPG 轴受抑制为 CONDITIONAL, 植物成分为 NONE。健康男性的睾丸每天已生成约 7 mg 睾酮, 产量由下丘脑垂体性腺轴的 LH 反馈固定在那个水平, 性腺功能正常的男性没有闲置的合成能力等一粒胶囊去解锁; CONDITIONAL 这一层的存在, 是因为总睾酮从中年起每年下降约 1%, 而在原发性或继发性性腺功能低下中身体确实造不够。tribulus, fenugreek 和 ashwagandha withanolides 判为 NONE, 这个 NONE 不含任何需求含义, 它们既无需求也无缺乏状态; 能可靠改变睾酮的化合物都是药物 (合成类固醇, SARMs, hCG, 芳香化酶抑制剂), 作用方式是压过或抑制那个反馈回路, 所以这些产品在这条轴上得不到支持。

These are plant materials, mainly yohimbe bark, Epimedium, maca and Tribulus, so nothing in them is endogenous and the synthesis axis cannot screen them at all; the endogenous members once grouped here, L-citrulline, L-arginine and DHEA, sit in their own rows. What it does它有什么作用

Marketed as herbal or all-natural, these products routinely contain undeclared PDE5 inhibitors. Of 776 dietary supplements associated with US FDA warnings between 2007 and 2016, 353 (45.5%) were sexual enhancement products, and within that group sildenafil was identified in 47.0%, sildenafil analogues in 38.0%, tadalafil in 20.4% and the antidepressant dapoxetine in 4.0%. The botanicals actually named on the label (Panax ginseng, Tribulus terrestris, Epimedium, yohimbe, maca) have no established effect on erectile function at the quantities supplied, so any felt effect points to the hidden pharmaceutical. The concrete danger is a vasodilator taken unknowingly alongside nitrates or in the presence of cardiac disease, since the user believes the product is herbal and does not mention it to a clinician. What it does它有什么作用

Folic acid with B12, often with B6 added, reliably lowers plasma total homocysteine by roughly a quarter, because both vitamins feed the methionine synthase step that converts homocysteine back to methionine. The rationale was observational: raised homocysteine tracks with vascular disease and stroke. Randomised trials separated the biomarker from the disease. The Cochrane review included 15 trials and 71,422 participants in total, with each outcome pooled from a subset of those trials: no effect on myocardial infarction (7.1% versus 6.0%, RR 1.02, 95% CI 0.95 to 1.10; 12 trials, 46,699 participants) and none on death from any cause (11.7% versus 12.3%, RR 1.01, 95% CI 0.96 to 1.06; 11 trials, 44,817 participants), with a small reduction in stroke (4.3% versus 5.1%, RR 0.90, 95% CI 0.82 to 0.99; 10 trials, 44,224 participants) driven largely by trials in populations without folic acid fortification and with low baseline folate. The label has to be PARTIAL, because the class as scoped here (vitamins A, C and E, carotenoids, CoQ10) contains nutrients the body cannot make at all: humans carry a non-functional GULO (L-gulonolactone oxidase) pseudogene and synthesise zero ascorbate (PMID 8175804), and alpha-tocopherol is entirely dietary, while CoQ10 is fully endogenous, which is the split inside the category. The enzymatic arm is endogenous but nutrient-dependent: every glutathione peroxidase and thioredoxin reductase is a selenoprotein requiring dietary selenium, and glutathione regeneration needs NADPH supplied through G6PD and the pentose phosphate pathway, on top of the substantial system the body runs by itself (millimolar intracellular glutathione, superoxide dismutases 1 to 3, catalase, glutathione peroxidases, peroxiredoxins and thioredoxins). This entry is a clinical scenario rather than a substance, and there is no antioxidant deficiency to correct. Anthracyclines, platinum agents, alkylating agents and radiotherapy kill tumour cells partly through reactive oxygen species and oxidative DNA damage, so high-dose antioxidants taken concurrently could in principle shield the tumour along with normal tissue, and tumour cells themselves often depend on antioxidant defences to survive. In the largest prospective dataset, 1,134 women in the SWOG S0221 adjuvant breast cancer trial, self-reported use of any antioxidant supplement (vitamin A, C or E, carotenoids or coenzyme Q10) both before and during chemotherapy was associated with a borderline increase in recurrence (adjusted hazard ratio 1.41, 95% CI 0.98 to 2.04, P = .06) and in death (adjusted hazard ratio 1.40, 95% CI 0.90 to 2.18, P = .14), with separately significant signals for vitamin B12 and for iron. What it does它有什么作用

The rationale was that critical illness collapses gut microbial diversity and promotes translocation of pathogens across a compromised barrier, so restoring commensals might prevent ventilator-associated pneumonia and sepsis. PROSPECT randomised 2650 mechanically ventilated ICU patients across 44 units to Lacticaseibacillus rhamnosus GG or placebo and found ventilator-associated pneumonia in 21.9% versus 21.3% (hazard ratio 1.03, 95% CI 0.87 to 1.22), with no benefit on any secondary outcome. Calcium supplements are sold at 500 to 600 mg elemental per tablet, and the trials that generated the safety signals gave 1,000 to 1,200 mg/day on top of whatever participants were already eating. Matching 1,000 mg from food takes 3.6 cups of milk, or 141 g of Cheddar, or about 85 g of Parmesan, or one 1/2-cup serving of calcium-set tofu (861 mg) plus one cup of cooked kale (177 mg) for 1,038 mg, or 3.2 pots of low-fat yogurt (about 546 g), or two small cans of sardines plus a glass of fortified soy drink (1,001 mg). The 'three pots of yogurt' route quoted in the original submission is wrong: 3 x 311 mg is 933 mg, 93% of the target and short of it. Every one of the corrected routes is a normal day of eating, so in a person whose diet already provides 1,000 mg a 1,000 mg supplement does not fill a deficit, it doubles the intake and delivers the added half as a single soluble bolus. Does the body make it身体是否自产

Calcium is chemical element 20, so none of the 1000 to 1200 g in an adult skeleton is manufactured and all of it is dietary in origin. The body defends blood calcium hard through PTH, calcitriol and bone turnover, and part of that defence is throttling absorption, since fractional intestinal absorption falls as intake rises, so a supplement added to an already adequate intake is absorbed inefficiently and largely excreted. That raised urinary calcium is the mechanism behind the excess kidney stones in the Women's Health Initiative calcium plus vitamin D trial (hazard ratio 1.17, 95% CI 1.02 to 1.34), so on an adequate diet the net account is a limited skeletal gain set against a real stone risk.钙是20号化学元素，成人骨骼中 1000 至 1200 g 钙没有一克是体内制造的，全部来自膳食。身体通过 PTH、骨化三醇和骨转换严密维持血钙，其中一环就是抑制吸收：摄入升高时肠道分数吸收率随之下降，因此在摄入已经充足的基础上再补钙，吸收效率低且大部分被排出。尿钙升高正是 Women's Health Initiative 钙加维生素D试验中肾结石增多的机制（风险比 1.17，95% CI 1.02 至 1.34），所以膳食充足时的总账是一点有限的骨骼收益，对应一份真实的结石风险。

What it does它有什么作用

About 99% of body calcium is hydroxyapatite crystal in bone and teeth, serving a structural role. The remaining 1% is the cell's universal second messenger: it triggers excitation-contraction coupling in muscle, neurotransmitter release at synapses, and several steps of the coagulation cascade. Serum ionised calcium is defended within a very narrow range by parathyroid hormone, calcitriol and bone resorption, so a low dietary intake does not lower blood calcium. It is paid for out of the skeleton instead. That regulation is the key to this particular entry. Fractional absorption falls as intake rises, so in a person already meeting requirements from food, additional supplemental calcium contributes little to bone mineral and the surplus is largely excreted. What a supplement does add that food does not is a large absorptive bolus, and that is the context for the constipation, the increased kidney stone risk seen in the Women's Health Initiative, and the contested cardiovascular signal.人体内约99%的钙以羟基磷灰石晶体形式存在于骨骼和牙齿中,发挥结构作用。剩余1%是细胞通用的第二信使:触发肌肉的兴奋收缩偶联、突触处神经递质释放,以及凝血级联反应中的若干步骤。血清游离钙受甲状旁腺激素、骨化三醇和骨吸收的严格调节,维持在很窄的范围内,因此饮食摄入不足不会降低血钙,由骨骼来承担这部分支出。这种调节机制正是本条目的关键所在。随着摄入量增加,吸收分数会下降,因此对于已经从食物中摄入足量钙的人来说,额外补充的钙对骨矿物质的贡献很小,多余部分大多被排出体外。补充剂相较于食物真正带来的额外效应,是一次性大量的吸收负荷,这正是便秘、Women's Health Initiative(妇女健康倡议)研究中观察到的肾结石风险增加,以及尚有争议的心血管信号背后的原因。

If you lack it缺乏会怎样

In children, rickets with bowed legs, widened wrists and costochondral junctions, bone pain and delayed growth. In adults, osteomalacia with diffuse bone pain, proximal muscle weakness and pseudofractures, and over decades accelerated bone loss with increased fragility fracture risk. Symptomatic hypocalcaemia with tetany and paraesthesiae comes from parathyroid or vitamin D failure rather than from dietary shortfall alone, because the skeleton buffers intake so effectively.儿童出现佝偻病,表现为腿部弯曲、腕部和肋软骨连接处增宽、骨痛和生长迟缓。成人出现骨软化症,表现为弥漫性骨痛、近端肌无力和假性骨折,数十年间骨量加速丢失,脆性骨折风险增加。伴手足搐搦和感觉异常的症状性低钙血症,病因是甲状旁腺或维生素D功能衰竭;单纯饮食摄入不足很少导致这种情况,因为骨骼对摄入不足的缓冲作用非常有效。

Does it reverse补回来能修复吗

Rickets and osteomalacia heal with calcium repletion (plus vitamin D where that is also deficient), and bone mineral density largely restores. Two things do not fully recover: skeletal deformity already established in a growing child, along with the height lost to it, and peak bone mass never accrued during adolescence, which sets the lifetime baseline and cannot be rebuilt later by supplementing.佝偻病和骨软化症在补钙(若同时缺乏维生素D,也需补充维生素D)后可以痊愈,骨矿物质密度大部分可恢复。有两点无法完全恢复:生长期儿童已形成的骨骼畸形及由此损失的身高,以及青春期未能积累的峰值骨量,后者决定了终生基线,日后补充也无法重建。

How to read a spec strip规格条怎么读

Five cells, always in the same order. The second cell has no colour on purpose: an evidence grade measures how sure the literature is, and a confident answer can be a no.五个格子，顺序固定。第二格刻意不上色：证据分级衡量的是文献有多确定，而一个确定的答案完全可以是“无效”。

1  Verdict1  结论

  • TTake it Worth taking if you are in the group named under Who. Evidence is strong for that group and for that purpose only.值得吃 如果你属于“适用人群”一栏所写的群体，值得吃。证据只对那个群体、那个用途成立。
  • CConsider Defensible in one narrow situation. Outside that situation there is no case for it.可以考虑 只在一种很窄的情形下站得住。离开那个情形，就没有理由吃。
  • SSkip it No good evidence of benefit for the marketed claim. Money wasted rather than harm done, unless a Cons entry says otherwise.不必买 对其宣传的功效没有像样的证据。除非“缺点”一栏另有说明，否则问题是浪费钱，不是危害健康。
  • AAvoid Published evidence of harm in randomised trials, prospective registries or national surveillance.不要吃 在随机试验、前瞻性登记或全国性监测中已有公开的致害证据。

2  Evidence grade2  证据分级

  • AConsistent meta-analyses of randomised trials with clinical endpoints.多项随机试验的一致性 meta 分析，且使用临床终点。
  • BMeta-analyses with surrogate endpoints, or good trials with mixed results.使用替代终点的 meta 分析，或结果不一致的高质量试验。
  • CSmall or short randomised trials only.仅有小样本或短周期的随机试验。
  • DMechanistic, animal or observational evidence only, or the claim has been refuted.只有机制、动物或观察性证据，或该主张已被推翻。

3  In food3  食物中

  • FRich Several ordinary foods supply a meaningful amount丰富 若干普通食物能提供有意义的量
  • FTrace Present in food, but orders of magnitude below a useful dose痕量 食物中存在，但比有用剂量低几个数量级
  • FNone No meaningful dietary presence; the supplement is manufactured无 膳食中无有意义的存在；补充剂为人工制造
  • FNot food Comes from a plant or tissue not eaten in normal diets非食物 来自正常饮食中不食用的植物或组织

4  Dose from food4  靠吃达到剂量

  • DReachable A realistic diet can reach the dose used in trials可达到 现实饮食可以达到试验所用剂量
  • DPartly Diet gets part of the way, not all部分 饮食能达到一部分，但不是全部
  • DOut of reach No realistic diet reaches the dose达不到 没有现实的饮食能达到该剂量
  • DNo dose A product category with no single dose to compare无剂量 产品类别，没有单一剂量可比

5  Body makes it5  身体自产

  • BBody makes it Under normal conditions the body makes all it needs身体自产 正常情况下身体自产足够
  • BPartly The body makes some, but not enough on its own部分自产 身体能合成一部分，但不够
  • BUsually Normally enough, but not in a named condition通常够 通常足够，但在特定情况下不够
  • BCannot The body cannot make this at all; it must come from outside不能 身体完全无法合成，必须外部获取

6  If you lack it6  缺乏后果

  • XNamed deficiency disease A recognised deficiency disease exists and is described in the clinical literature有明确的缺乏症 存在公认的缺乏性疾病，临床文献中有明确描述
  • XLow status causes dysfunction No named disease, but low status causes measurable dysfunction偏低会引起功能异常 没有命名的疾病，但状态偏低会引起可测量的功能异常
  • XNo deficiency state exists Not an essential nutrient. You cannot be deficient in this不存在缺乏状态 不是必需营养素。不存在“缺乏”这回事

02How to read this怎么读这份文件

Five axes, and they answer five different questions. The commonest way to misread this material is to let one of them stand in for another.五个维度，回答五个不同的问题。误读这类材料最常见的方式，就是拿其中一个去顶替另一个。

Axis维度 Question问题 Trap陷阱
1 Verdict1 结论Should you take it?你该不该吃？It is per group, never universal. Take means take if you are the named person.它针对特定人群，从来不是普遍适用。“值得吃”的意思是：如果你是那类人，才值得吃。
2 Evidence grade2 证据分级How sure is the literature?文献有多确定？A high grade does not mean it works. Selenium is grade A because Cochrane established with high certainty that it does not prevent cancer. This cell is deliberately colourless.高分级不等于有效。硒是 A 级，因为 Cochrane 高确定性地证明它不能预防癌症。这一格刻意不上色。
3 In food3 食物中Does the substance occur in ordinary food?这种物质在普通食物中有吗？Rich in food says nothing about whether the dose is reachable. Those are axes 3 and 4.“食物中丰富”完全不说明剂量能否达到。那是第 3 和第 4 两个不同的维度。
4 Dose from food4 靠吃达到剂量Could eating reach the tested dose?靠吃能达到试验剂量吗？This is the axis that decides whether food can stand in for the pill. Of 66 items, 44 are rich in food but only 20 let you reach the dose.这是决定“食物能否顶替药片”的那个维度。66 个条目中有 44 个食物来源丰富，但只有 20 个能靠吃达到剂量。
5 Body makes it5 身体自产Can you synthesise it yourself?你自己能合成吗？32 substances here your body cannot make at all, and 9 it makes in full. A molecule you already produce in quantity is a weak thing to buy.这里有 32 种物质你的身体完全无法合成，另有 9 种可以完全自产。一个你本来就大量制造的分子，买它的理由很弱。
Worked example举个例子

Vitamin E is genuinely rich in food, so axis 3 reads Rich. One tablespoon of wheatgerm oil covers the daily reference intake. But the dose in the harm trials was 400 IU, which is 268 mg of alpha-tocopherol, roughly 18 times the reference intake, so axis 4 reads Out of reach. And the body cannot make tocopherol at all, so axis 5 reads Cannot. All three are true at once, and only reading them together tells you anything useful.维生素 E 在食物中确实丰富，所以第 3 轴显示“丰富”：一勺小麦胚芽油就够一天的参考摄入量。但致害试验用的剂量是 400 IU，相当于 268 毫克 α-生育酚，约为参考摄入量的 18 倍，所以第 4 轴显示“达不到”。而人体完全无法合成生育酚，所以第 5 轴显示“不能”。三者同时成立，只有合起来读才有意义。

Nine ways this material gets misread这类材料被误读的九种方式

  1. A high grade does not mean it works. It means we are confident about the answer, and the answer can be no. Selenium is Grade A in this document because Cochrane established with HIGH certainty that it does NOT prevent cancer. Read the Grade column together with the Verdict column, never on its own.高分级不等于有效。它的意思是“我们对结论有把握”，而结论完全可以是“无效”。本文给硒评 A 级，是因为 Cochrane 以高确定性证明它并不能预防癌症。“证据分级”这一栏必须和“结论”一栏合起来读，绝不能单看。
  2. A grade attaches to one specific claim, not to the substance in general. Vitamin D3 is Grade A for correcting documented deficiency and Grade D for preventing cancer or cardiovascular disease. Those are the same molecule and two different questions.分级针对的是某一个具体主张，而不是这种物质本身。维生素 D3 在“纠正已证实的缺乏”上是 A 级，在“预防癌症或心血管病”上是 D 级。同一个分子，两个完全不同的问题。
  3. An official statement of insufficient evidence is not an endorsement. The USPSTF gives multivitamins an I statement. That means the trials could neither prove benefit nor rule out harm. The industry quotes it as vindication.官方所说的“证据不足”不是背书。USPSTF 给复合维生素的是 I 级声明，意思是现有试验既不能证明有益，也不能排除有害。行业却把它当成背书来引用。
  4. No upper limit set means nobody has assessed it. It is a gap in the science, not a finding of safety. Most botanicals and every probiotic in this document fall into that gap.“未设定上限”的意思是没有人评估过。这是科学上的空白，不是安全性结论。本文中的多数植物类产品和全部益生菌都落在这个空白里。
  5. Risk ratios below 1 mean fewer events, above 1 mean more events. When the confidence interval crosses 1, no effect was demonstrated. That is the entire logic of Figure 5.风险比小于 1 表示事件更少，大于 1 表示事件更多。当置信区间跨过 1 时，说明没有证明出效应。图 5 的全部逻辑就是这一条。
  6. Relative reductions are not absolute reductions. REDUCE-IT is quoted everywhere as a 25% reduction. The absolute reduction was 4.8 percentage points over 4.9 years, meaning about 21 people take the drug for one to benefit.相对下降不等于绝对下降。REDUCE-IT 到处被引用为“下降 25%”。而绝对下降是 4.9 年里的 4.8 个百分点，也就是约 21 个人服药才有 1 个人获益。
  7. The number on a mineral label is usually the compound, not the mineral. Magnesium oxide is about 60% magnesium, magnesium citrate about 16%. A capsule labelled 500 mg magnesium citrate delivers roughly 80 mg of magnesium.矿物质标签上的数字通常是化合物的量，不是矿物质本身的量。氧化镁约含 60% 的镁，柠檬酸镁约 16%。一粒标着“柠檬酸镁 500 毫克”的胶囊，实际提供的镁约为 80 毫克。
  8. The safety record of a food does not transfer to a concentrated extract of it. Drinking green tea is fine. Green tea extract has caused more than 100 published cases of liver injury, 8% of which went to transplant.一种食物的安全记录，不会自动转移到它的浓缩提取物上。喝绿茶没问题。绿茶提取物已造成 100 例以上公开报告的肝损伤，其中 8% 走到了肝移植。
  9. A certification mark says nothing about whether the product works. USP Verified, NSF and Informed Sport all certify content and purity. None of them assesses efficacy, and USP Verified does not screen for substances banned in sport.认证标识对“产品有没有用”只字未提。USP Verified、NSF 和 Informed Sport 认证的都是成分与纯度。没有一个评估有效性，而且 USP Verified 并不筛查运动违禁物质。

03Why the market looks like this这个市场为什么是这个样子

One regulatory fact explains most of what follows. Under the US Dietary Supplement Health and Education Act of 1994, supplements are legally food. No pre-market approval for safety or efficacy, and no statutory cap on the dose of an ingredient.一条监管事实解释了后面的大部分内容。按照美国 1994 年《膳食补充剂健康与教育法》，补充剂在法律上属于食品。上市前不需要安全性或有效性审批，法规也不对成分剂量设上限。

Indicator指标 Figure数字 Source来源
Global market全球市场~USD 209.5bn (2025)约 2095 亿美元（2025）Grand View Research, unauditedGrand View Research，未经审计
Growth since 19941994 年以来USD 4bn and ~4,000 products, to ~USD 200bn and 50,000-80,000 products从 40 亿美元、约 4000 个产品，到约 2000 亿美元、5 万至 8 万个产品USP / FDA
