04Take it值得吃

Strong evidence, but only for the group named under Who. None of these is for everyone.证据充分，但只对“适用人群”一栏所写的群体成立。没有一样适合所有人。

TTAAFFDDBBXXFolic acid叶酸
Verdict结论Take it值得吃
Evidence证据Grade AA 级
Dose tested已验证剂量400 µg/d, from at least one month before conception. 4 mg/d if a previous pregnancy was affected.400 微克/天，至少从受孕前一个月开始。若既往有受累妊娠，则 4 毫克/天。
Who适用人群Anyone capable of becoming pregnant.任何可能怀孕的人。
Pros优点
  • Neural tube defects RR 0.31 (95% CI 0.17-0.58) across 5 trials and 6,708 births. This is the strongest single result in the whole supplement literature.神经管缺陷 RR 0.31（95% CI 0.17-0.58），5 项试验、6708 例分娩。这是整个补充剂文献中最强的单项结果。
  • The MRC Vitamin Study (n=1,817 high-risk women) showed a 72% protective effect at 4 mg/d.MRC 维生素研究（1817 名高危女性）在 4 毫克/天下显示 72% 的保护效应。
  • Population fortification works at scale: US grain fortification prevents about 1,326 affected births per year.人群强化在规模上有效：美国面粉强化每年避免约 1326 例受累出生。
  • Costs a few pounds a year. No meaningful downside at 400 µg.一年只要几英镑。在 400 微克剂量下没有实质性坏处。
Cons缺点
  • Never take it alone when B12 status is unknown. Folic acid corrects the anaemia of B12 deficiency while the neurological damage silently progresses. This is the stated basis of the upper limit.B12 状态不明时绝不要单独服用。叶酸会纠正 B12 缺乏引起的贫血，而神经损害在无声中继续加重。这正是设定上限的理由。
  • High-dose folic acid plus B12 taken for cardiovascular reasons raised cancer incidence (HR 1.21) and cancer mortality (HR 1.38) in pooled Norwegian trials. That is a different product at a different dose for a different purpose, and it should not be confused with the 400 µg periconceptional dose.为心血管目的服用的大剂量叶酸加 B12，在挪威两项试验合并分析中升高了癌症发病（HR 1.21）和癌症死亡（HR 1.38）。那是另一个剂量、另一个目的下的另一种用法，不应与 400 微克的围孕期剂量混为一谈。
  • Upper limit 1,000 µg/d of synthetic folate, which applies to supplements and fortified food but not to folate from whole food.合成叶酸上限 1000 微克/天，适用于补充剂和强化食品，不适用于天然食物中的叶酸。
What it does, and what happens without it它有什么作用，缺了会怎样

Supplies the one-carbon units cells need to build DNA and divide.提供细胞合成DNA和分裂所需的一碳单位。

Named deficiency disease有明确的缺乏症 Partly reversible部分可逆

In detail详细Folate is reduced to tetrahydrofolate, which carries one-carbon groups for thymidylate and purine synthesis and for the remethylation of homocysteine to methionine by methionine synthase (a B12-dependent enzyme). Tissues that divide fastest depend on it most: bone marrow, gut mucosa, and the closing neural tube of an early embryo. Folic acid is the synthetic, fully oxidised form; it must be reduced by dihydrofolate reductase, whose capacity in humans is limited, so unmetabolised folic acid appears in plasma at intakes above roughly 200 to 400 micrograms in one dose. The natural circulating form is 5-methyltetrahydrofolate.叶酸被还原为四氢叶酸，携带一碳基团用于胸苷酸和嘌呤合成，也用于同型半胱氨酸在methionine synthase（一种依赖B12的酶）催化下再甲基化生成蛋氨酸。分裂最快的组织对它依赖程度最高：骨髓、肠黏膜，以及早期胚胎正在闭合的神经管。叶酸是人工合成的完全氧化形式，必须经dihydrofolate reductase还原，该酶在人体内的能力有限，因此单次摄入量超过约200至400微克时，血浆中就会出现未代谢的叶酸。天然的循环形式是5-甲基四氢叶酸。

Deficiency disease缺乏症Megaloblastic (macrocytic) anaemia. In early pregnancy, low folate status raises the risk of neural tube defects (anencephaly, spina bifida, encephalocele); periconceptional folic acid prevents a large proportion but not all of them.巨幼细胞性（大细胞性）贫血。孕早期叶酸水平不足会增加神经管缺陷（无脑畸形、spina bifida、脑膨出）的风险，孕前及孕早期补充叶酸可预防其中大部分，但不能预防全部。

First signs早期表现Serum folate falls first, then red cell folate. Raised mean corpuscular volume appears before anaemia, with hypersegmented neutrophils on the film. Symptoms are non-specific: tiredness, breathlessness on exertion, sore tongue, mouth ulcers, mild diarrhoea. In pregnancy there are no maternal warning signs at all; the first evidence of a neural tube defect is usually the anomaly scan.血清叶酸先下降，随后是红细胞叶酸。平均红细胞体积升高出现在贫血之前，血涂片可见中性粒细胞分叶过多。症状无特异性：疲劳、活动后气促、舌痛、口腔溃疡、轻度腹泻。妊娠期母体完全没有预警征象，神经管缺陷的首个证据通常来自胎儿畸形筛查超声。

Untreated不治疗会怎样Marrow failure with pancytopenia, severe anaemia, mucosal ulceration and malabsorptive diarrhoea. In pregnancy the severe endpoint is structural: anencephaly is incompatible with life, and open spina bifida causes lifelong paralysis below the lesion, hydrocephalus, and bowel and bladder impairment.骨髓衰竭伴全血细胞减少、重度贫血、黏膜溃疡及吸收不良性腹泻。妊娠期的严重终点是结构性的：无脑畸形与生命不相容，开放性spina bifida会导致病灶平面以下终身瘫痪、脑积水以及肠道和膀胱功能障碍。

Does it reverse补回来能修复吗The haematological and mucosal effects reverse completely: reticulocytosis begins within a week and the blood count normalises in about two months, with no residual deficit. A neural tube defect that has already formed is permanent and cannot be reversed by any later intake. The neural tube closes 26 to 28 days after conception, so supplementation started after a positive pregnancy test is too late for that specific endpoint, which is the whole argument for taking it before conception.血液学和黏膜方面的影响可完全逆转：网织红细胞增多在一周内开始出现，血细胞计数约两个月后恢复正常，不留残余缺陷。但已经形成的神经管缺陷是永久性的，之后任何摄入都无法逆转。神经管在受孕后26至28天闭合，因此妊娠试验阳性后才开始补充叶酸，对这一特定终点而言已经太晚，这正是主张在受孕前就开始补充的全部理由。

Who becomes deficient谁会缺乏Women who could become pregnant, particularly with an unplanned pregnancy. Coeliac disease and other malabsorption. Heavy alcohol use. Drugs that block folate handling: methotrexate, sulfasalazine, trimethoprim, phenytoin and other anticonvulsants. High-turnover states such as chronic haemolysis and exfoliative skin disease. Dialysis.有可能怀孕的女性，尤其是意外妊娠的情形。乳糜泻及其他吸收不良疾病。大量饮酒。干扰叶酸代谢的药物：甲氨蝶呤、柳氮磺吡啶、甲氧苄啶、苯妥英及其他抗惊厥药。慢性溶血和剥脱性皮肤病等细胞高周转状态。透析。

How common有多常见In the fortified United States, 18.6% of women aged 12 to 49 had red cell folate below the threshold associated with elevated neural tube defect risk (748 nmol/L) in 2011 to 2016, down from 23.2% in 2007 to 2010 (PMID 31504109). Frank folate-deficiency anaemia is now uncommon where fortification is mandatory and is seen more often where it is not.在实行强制强化的美国，2011至2016年间，12至49岁女性中有18.6%的红细胞叶酸低于与神经管缺陷风险升高相关的阈值（748 nmol/L），低于2007至2010年的23.2%（PMID 31504109）。在强制强化的地区，典型的叶酸缺乏性贫血现已不常见，在未强化的地区则更常见。

Source来源PMID 31504109 (Pfeiffer et al., Am J Clin Nutr 2019, US folate status 20 years after fortification); PMID 1677062 (MRC Vitamin Study, Lancet 1991: 4 mg/day periconceptional folic acid cut neural tube defect recurrence by 72%, RR 0.28, 95% CI 0.12 to 0.71)

Food and the body食物与身体
In food: None食物中：无 Dose from food: Partly靠吃达到剂量：部分 Body makes it: Cannot身体自产：不能 Food data: High食物数据：高

Folic acid (pteroylmonoglutamic acid) is manufactured by chemical synthesis, a Waller-type condensation of a triaminopyrimidinone with a three-carbon unit and p-aminobenzoyl-L-glutamic acid, giving a fully oxidised molecule carrying a single glutamate that does not occur in unfortified food. Ordinary food supplies reduced folate polyglutamates instead, chiefly 5-methyltetrahydrofolate, and USDA's component structure keeps 'folic acid' and 'folate, food' as separate entries: beef liver, lentils, spinach, chickpeas, asparagus and boiled broccoli all read folic acid 0 with folate food equal to folate total. Two distinct answers therefore sit inside one word, so they are separated here: the nutrient class folate is rich in ordinary food, while the marketed molecule folic acid enters the food supply only through fortification and enrichment, which is what every food row below is. Enriched pasta and enriched white rice are the other mandated US enrichment vehicles; their contents are label-dependent per product and no verified figure was available, so they get no row.合成叶酸（folic acid，蝶酰单谷氨酸 pteroylmonoglutamic acid）由化学合成制造，通过 Waller 型缩合反应把三氨基嘧啶酮、一个三碳单元和对氨基苯甲酰-L-谷氨酸缩合起来，得到一个完全氧化、只带单个谷氨酸残基的分子，未强化的食物里并不存在这种形式。普通食物提供的是还原型叶酸多谷氨酸盐，主要是 5-甲基四氢叶酸。USDA 的成分体系把 folic acid 和 folate, food 列为两个独立条目：牛肝、扁豆、菠菜、鹰嘴豆、芦笋和水煮西兰花的 folic acid 全部读作 0，而 folate food 等于 folate total。一个词里装着两个答案，这里把它们分开：作为营养素类别的叶酸在普通食物中含量丰富；作为在售分子的 folic acid 只能通过强化和营养素添加进入食物供应，下面每一行食物都属于这种情况。强化意面和强化白米是美国另外两种法定的营养素添加载体，含量随具体产品的标签而定，没有可核实的数据，因此不单列。

Rows tagged unconfirmed carry a figure the checking pass could not trace back to its cited source. Hover the tag for the reason.标记未核实的行，其数值在核查中无法追溯到所引来源。把鼠标移到标记上可看原因。

To match the dose要达到该剂量Two routes with different answers. As folic acid, the 400 ug periconceptional dose is reachable in one sitting only from fortified products: one bowl of ready-to-eat cereal fortified to 400 ug folic acid per serving is the entire dose, whereas matching it from yeast extract spread takes about 13 g (a bit over two teaspoons), from instant fortified oatmeal 8.2 packets, and from enriched wheat bread about 69 slices. As natural food folate the equivalent target is 680 ug DFE (400 x 1.7), and this is where the verification pass forced a correction: the submission's cheapest option was 376 g of cooked lentils, but simmered chicken liver at 578 ug food folate per 100 g (FDC 171061) needs only 118 g, under three 44 g livers, which is an ordinary portion, and pan-fried lamb liver at 400 ug DFE per 100 g (FDC 172533) needs 170 g. The plant routes stay awkward: 376 g cooked lentils (1.9 cups), 219 g prepared edamame (1.4 cups), 300 g dried sunflower kernels, 351 g raw spinach (about twelve 30 g cups), 395 g cooked chickpeas, 456 g cooked asparagus (about thirty spears) or 630 g boiled broccoli. So the plain answer is that a person can eat their way to the folate equivalent of the 400 ug dose through liver or through fortified food, and cannot realistically do it through leafy greens; the UK high-risk 5 mg dose (8,500 ug DFE, 1.47 kg of chicken liver or 4.7 kg of cooked lentils every day) is unreachable by any route. Liver carries its own pregnancy restriction on preformed vitamin A grounds, which is why it is rarely offered as the answer to the population that needs the dose.两条路径给出不同答案。按 folic acid 计，孕前 400 µg 的剂量只有强化产品能一次吃到：一碗按每份 400 µg folic acid 强化的即食谷物就是全部剂量；用酵母提取物涂抹酱要约 13 g（两茶匙多一点），用强化速食燕麦片要 8.2 包，用强化面粉做的小麦面包约 69 片。按天然食物叶酸计，等效目标是 680 µg DFE（400 x 1.7），核查环节正是在这里改出一处错误：原稿最省的选项是 376 g 熟扁豆，但炖鸡肝每 100 g 含食物叶酸 578 µg（FDC 171061），只需 118 g，不到三块 44 g 的鸡肝，属于正常份量；煎羊肝每 100 g 400 µg DFE（FDC 172533），需要 170 g。植物路径依旧别扭：376 g 熟扁豆（1.9 杯）、219 g 处理好的毛豆（1.4 杯）、300 g 干葵花籽仁、351 g 生菠菜（约十二杯，每杯 30 g）、395 g 熟鹰嘴豆、456 g 熟芦笋（约三十根）或 630 g 水煮西兰花。所以直白的结论是：一个人可以靠肝脏或强化食品吃到相当于 400 µg 剂量的叶酸量，靠绿叶菜现实中做不到；英国面向高风险人群的 5 mg 剂量（8,500 µg DFE，相当于每天 1.47 kg 鸡肝或 4.7 kg 熟扁豆）任何路径都达不到。肝脏本身因预成型维生素 A 而在孕期受限，这也是它很少被拿来当作那个最需要该剂量的人群的答案的原因。

Food vs supplement食物与补充剂Folic acid is not bioidentical to food folate and the difference cuts both ways. It must be reduced by dihydrofolate reductase before entering one-carbon metabolism, and human DHFR capacity is low: unmetabolised folic acid appears in serum above a threshold of about 266 ug of folic acid per meal (Kelly et al., Am J Clin Nutr 1997;65:1790-5, PMID 9174474), which a 400 ug tablet exceeds. That is why the adult UL of 1,000 ug/day applies to folic acid from supplements and fortified food with no UL on food folate: high folic acid can correct the megaloblastic anaemia of B12 deficiency while neurological damage continues, masking the diagnosis. Food folate has no toxicity ceiling and the synthetic form does. Running the other way, the quantity of food folate is not the only obstacle. Cuskelly, McNulty and Scott randomised 62 women to an extra 400 ug/day as a folic acid supplement, as folic-acid-fortified food, as natural food folate, or as dietary advice: red cell folate rose only in the supplement and fortified-food arms and did not move in the food-folate arms despite documented increases in intake (Lancet 1996;347:657-9, PMID 8596381). The two trials that established the neural-tube-defect effect used synthetic folic acid, 4 mg/day in the MRC Vitamin Study (Lancet 1991;338:131-7, PMID 1677062) and 0.8 mg/day in a multivitamin (Czeizel and Dudas, N Engl J Med 1992;327:1832-5, PMID 1307234). Substituting leafy greens for the tablet before pregnancy has never been tested against that endpoint. On L-5-methyltetrahydrofolate (calcium methylfolate), the marketed 'MTHFR-friendly' alternative: EFSA's 2022 derivation of DFE factors for it judged 5-MTHF more bioavailable than folic acid at supplement doses of 400 ug/day and above (2.0 versus 1.7; PMC9399872), so the case against it is not absorption. It is that no periconceptional trial has been run on it, and the neural-tube-defect evidence base is specifically folic acid (Czeizel, Ann Nutr Metab 2011, PMID 21865678).folic acid 与食物叶酸并非生物等同，差异在两个方向上都成立。它必须先由二氢叶酸还原酶（DHFR）还原才能进入一碳代谢，而人的 DHFR 能力很低：每餐 folic acid 超过约 266 µg 这一阈值后，血清中就会出现未代谢的 folic acid（Kelly 等, Am J Clin Nutr 1997;65:1790-5, PMID 9174474），一片 400 µg 的片剂已经超过。这正是成人每日 1,000 µg 的 UL 只适用于补充剂和强化食品中的 folic acid、而食物叶酸没有 UL 的原因：高剂量 folic acid 可以纠正 B12 缺乏引起的巨幼细胞性贫血，同时神经损害继续进展，掩盖诊断。食物叶酸没有毒性上限，合成形式有。反方向看，食物叶酸的障碍也不止于量。Cuskelly、McNulty 与 Scott 把 62 名女性随机分组，每天额外补 400 µg，分别以 folic acid 补充剂、folic acid 强化食品、天然食物叶酸或饮食指导的形式给予：红细胞叶酸只在补充剂组和强化食品组上升，食物叶酸组尽管摄入量有记录在案的增加却毫无变化（Lancet 1996;347:657-9, PMID 8596381）。确立神经管缺陷预防效果的两项试验用的都是合成 folic acid：MRC Vitamin Study 的 4 mg/天（Lancet 1991;338:131-7, PMID 1677062），以及 Czeizel 与 Dudas 用复合维生素给的 0.8 mg/天（N Engl J Med 1992;327:1832-5, PMID 1307234）。孕前用绿叶菜替代片剂，从未针对这一终点做过检验。关于 L-5-甲基四氢叶酸（甲基叶酸钙），也就是市面上以适合 MTHFR 基因型为卖点的替代品：EFSA 2022 年推导其 DFE 系数时判定，在每天 400 µg 及以上的补充剂量下，5-MTHF 的生物利用度高于 folic acid（2.0 对 1.7；PMC9399872），所以反对它的理由与吸收无关。问题在于至今没有做过孕前使用的试验，而神经管缺陷的证据基础明确是 folic acid（Czeizel, Ann Nutr Metab 2011, PMID 21865678）。

Absorption吸收Food folate is roughly 50% available against about 85% for folic acid eaten with food and close to 100% fasting, which is where the 1.7 and 2.0 DFE multipliers come from (Suitor and Bailey, J Am Diet Assoc 2000;100:88-94, PMID 10646010). Food folate is a polyglutamate that must be deconjugated at the brush border before absorption, and it is chemically fragile. USDA Table of Nutrient Retention Factors Release 6 (2007) gives folate retention of 45% for legumes boiled 45-75 min and drained (code 0521), 30% for legumes boiled 2-2.5 h (code 0541), 60% for greens boiled in water to cover and drained (code 3005) and 90% for potatoes baked in the skin (code 3301). A cup of dried lentils simmered for an hour loses over half its folate, so a composition table value describes the cooked food only when the cooking matches. Folic acid in a fortified food or a tablet is stable and its dose is what the label says.食物叶酸的可利用率大致 50%，与食物一起摄入的 folic acid 约 85%，空腹接近 100%，1.7 和 2.0 两个 DFE 换算系数就是从这里来的（Suitor 与 Bailey, J Am Diet Assoc 2000;100:88-94, PMID 10646010）。食物叶酸是多谷氨酸盐，吸收前必须在刷状缘去结合，而且化学性质脆弱。USDA 营养素保留系数表（Table of Nutrient Retention Factors）第 6 版（2007）给出的叶酸保留率是：豆类煮 45-75 min 后沥干 45%（代码 0521），豆类煮 2-2.5 h 为 30%（代码 0541），绿叶菜加水没过煮后沥干 60%（代码 3005），带皮烤马铃薯 90%（代码 3301）。一杯干扁豆炖一小时会损失一半以上的叶酸，因此成分表数值只有在烹饪方式对得上时才描述熟食的实际含量。强化食品或片剂里的 folic acid 稳定，剂量就是标签写的那个数。

Food data note食物数据说明Every per-100 g composition value, gram weight and per-portion figure in the food rows and the dose comparison traces to a named USDA FoodData Central record and recomputes exactly, and all six cited PMIDs resolve to the stated journal, volume and pages. Two qualifications: the fortified-cereal row is an indicative label figure rather than a sourced composition record, and one uncited bioavailability claim was removed rather than kept高。食物行和剂量对比中的每一个每 100 g 成分值、克重和每份数值都可追溯到具名的 USDA FoodData Central 记录，重算完全吻合，引用的六个 PMID 全部指向所述期刊、卷号和页码。两点限定：强化谷物那一行是指示性的标签数据，并非有来源的成分记录；另有一条没有引文的生物利用度说法被删除，没有保留。

Does the body make it身体是否自产Humans have no folate biosynthetic pathway, so every microgram is dietary or supplemental, and NONE here does mean required, with megaloblastic anaemia as the described deficiency state. Colonic bacteria do synthesise folate, and this dataset counts bacterial output as exogenous supply because the human genome carries no such pathway; colonic absorption is limited and the contribution to human status is unquantified. Supplementation therefore fills a real gap when intake is low, and the strongest indication is periconceptional, where folic acid 400 micrograms/day prevents neural tube defects with outcome evidence behind it.人体没有叶酸的生物合成通路, 所以每一微克都来自膳食或补充剂; 这里的 NONE 确实意味着必需, 缺乏症为巨细胞性贫血。结肠细菌确实合成叶酸, 本数据集把细菌产物算作外源供应, 因为人类基因组不含相应通路; 结肠吸收有限, 对人体营养状态的贡献未被定量。因此摄入不足时补充在填补真实缺口, 最强的指征是孕前和围孕期, 叶酸 400 micrograms/day 可预防神经管缺陷, 并有结局证据支持。

Pathway合成通路NOT APPLICABLE for synthesis. Human enzymology handles absorption and use only: PCFT (SLC46A1) and the reduced folate carrier bring folate in, and 5-methyl-THF is the methyl donor for MTR, which remethylates homocysteine to methionine using vitamin B12. Bacterial folate synthesis in the colonic lumen sits outside the human genome and counts as exogenous supply in this dataset.合成为 NOT APPLICABLE。人体酶学只负责吸收与利用: 叶酸经 PCFT (SLC46A1) 和还原型叶酸载体进入体内, 5-methyl-THF 是 MTR 的甲基供体, MTR 利用维生素 B12 把 homocysteine 再甲基化为 methionine。结肠腔内的细菌叶酸合成不在人类基因组之内, 在本数据集中算作外源供应。

Amount made自产量0 µg/d synthesised by human cells. The contribution of colonic microbial folate synthesis to human vitamin status is NOT ESTABLISHED in µg/d. Reference point: folate RDA 400 µg DFE/d.人体细胞合成量 0 µg/d。结肠微生物合成的叶酸对人体维生素状态的贡献 (µg/d) NOT ESTABLISHED。参照点: 叶酸 RDA 400 µg DFE/d。

Still matters when仍有意义的情形Preconception and pregnancy, where folic acid 400 micrograms/day prevents neural tube defects and the outcome evidence is the strongest recovered for folate. Also documented deficiency with megaloblastic anaemia, malabsorption, and low intake. Broad-spectrum antibiotics and colectomy reduce whatever microbial contribution exists, which was never quantified in the first place.孕前和妊娠期, 叶酸 400 micrograms/day 预防神经管缺陷, 这是恢复文本中关于叶酸最有力的结局证据。还有伴巨细胞性贫血的确诊缺乏, 吸收不良, 以及摄入偏低。广谱抗生素和结肠切除会削弱本就存在的那部分微生物贡献, 而这部分从一开始就没有被定量。

Synthesis source合成来源Recovered entries BCAAs sold separately, and B12, folate, thiamine, riboflavin, B6, biotin, pantothenate and vitamin E (scores folate NONE; folic acid 400 micrograms/day periconceptionally with outcome evidence) and Nutrients made by colonic bacteria (menaquinones, biotin, folate and vitamin B12) (PCFT/SLC46A1 and reduced folate carrier; folate RDA 400 µg DFE/d); MTR and 5-methyl-THF from S-adenosylmethionine (SAMe). Label assigned per the dataset's definitions row.

TTAAFFDDBBXXVitamin D3 (cholecalciferol)维生素 D3（胆钙化醇）
Verdict结论Take it值得吃
Evidence证据Grade AA 级
Dose tested已验证剂量800-2,000 IU/d, taken daily. Never as an annual or monthly bolus.800 至 2000 IU/天，每日服用。绝不要按年或按月大剂量冲击给药。
Who适用人群People with serum 25(OH)D below about 30 nmol/L: dark skin at high latitude, covered clothing, housebound, northern-European winter.血清 25(OH)D 低于约 30 nmol/L 的人：高纬度地区的深肤色人群、遮盖式着装者、久不出门者、北欧的冬季。
Pros优点
  • Correcting genuine deficiency is real medicine: it treats rickets and osteomalacia, and no other intervention does.纠正真正的缺乏是实打实的治疗：它能治佝偻病和骨软化症，没有别的干预能做到这一点。
  • With calcium, it cuts hip fracture in frail institutionalised elderly, RR 0.84 (0.74-0.96) across 9 trials and 49,853 people.与钙合用，可降低体弱的养老机构老人的髋部骨折，RR 0.84（0.74-0.96），9 项试验、49853 人。
  • Deficiency is genuinely common in the target groups: 17.5% of non-Hispanic Black Americans are below 30 nmol/L versus 2.1% of white Americans, and 17.7% of Europeans are below it in the October to March window.在目标人群中，缺乏确实普遍：非西班牙裔黑人美国人中 17.5% 低于 30 nmol/L，白人为 2.1%；欧洲人在 10 月至次年 3 月这段时间有 17.7% 低于该值。
  • Costs almost nothing. Generic D3 at 1,000 IU is a few pounds a year.几乎不花钱。1000 IU 的普通 D3 一年只要几英镑。
Cons缺点
  • It does not prevent cancer or cardiovascular disease. VITAL (n=25,871, 5.3 years): invasive cancer HR 0.96 (0.88-1.06), major cardiovascular events HR 0.97 (0.85-1.12). D-Health (n=21,315): all-cause mortality HR 1.04. ViDA (n=5,108): cardiovascular disease HR 1.02.它不能预防癌症或心血管病。VITAL（n=25871，5.3 年）：浸润性癌 HR 0.96（0.88-1.06），主要心血管事件 HR 0.97（0.85-1.12）。D-Health（n=21315）：全因死亡 HR 1.04。ViDA（n=5108）：心血管病 HR 1.02。
  • Vitamin D alone does nothing for fractures. Cochrane: hip fracture RR 1.12 (0.98-1.29) without calcium. The calcium is doing the work.单用维生素 D 对骨折毫无作用。Cochrane：不加钙时髋部骨折 RR 1.12（0.98-1.29）。起作用的是钙。
  • More is actively worse, and this is the least-marketed finding in the field. Annual 500,000 IU increased falls (IRR 1.15) and fractures (IRR 1.26). Monthly 60,000 IU raised the proportion of people falling from 47.9% to 66.9%. Three years at 4,000 or 10,000 IU/d caused dose-dependent LOSS of radial bone density versus 400 IU/d.剂量越大反而越糟，而这是该领域最少被宣传的发现。每年 50 万 IU 增加跌倒（IRR 1.15）和骨折（IRR 1.26）。每月 6 万 IU 使跌倒人群比例从 47.9% 升到 66.9%。每天 4000 或 10000 IU 连服三年，桡骨骨密度相对 400 IU/天出现剂量依赖性的下降。
  • The 30 ng/mL threshold that drives most deficiency marketing came from the Endocrine Society, and that society walked it back in 2024. Its current guideline suggests against routine testing in healthy adults and against empiric supplementation above the reference intake in healthy under-75s.推动大部分“缺乏”营销的 30 ng/mL 阈值来自内分泌学会，而该学会在 2024 年已经收回了这个说法。其现行指南建议：健康成人不必常规检测，75 岁以下健康人也不建议在参考摄入量之上经验性补充。
  • Contraindicated in hypercalcaemia, primary hyperparathyroidism and granulomatous disease such as sarcoidosis or tuberculosis. Upper limit 4,000 IU/d.高钙血症、原发性甲状旁腺功能亢进、以及结节病或结核等肉芽肿性疾病禁用。上限 4000 IU/天。
What it does, and what happens without it它有什么作用，缺了会怎样

Lets the gut absorb calcium and phosphate so that bone can mineralise properly.使肠道吸收钙和磷，从而让骨骼正常矿化。

Named deficiency disease有明确的缺乏症 Partly reversible部分可逆

In detail详细Cholecalciferol is hydroxylated in the liver to 25-hydroxyvitamin D, the circulating storage form measured on a blood test, and then in the kidney to 1,25-dihydroxyvitamin D (calcitriol), a steroid hormone acting through the nuclear vitamin D receptor. Calcitriol drives active intestinal absorption of calcium and phosphate, suppresses parathyroid hormone, and maintains the calcium-phosphate product that osteoblasts need to mineralise newly laid osteoid. Vitamin D receptors are present in immune cells, muscle and many other tissues, but the only role with an established human requirement is the calcium and bone axis. Skin synthesis from UVB normally supplies most of it, which is why dietary requirement figures depend heavily on latitude, season and sun exposure.胆钙化醇在肝脏中被羟化为25-羟维生素D，即血液检测测定的循环储存形式，随后在肾脏中被羟化为1,25-二羟维生素D（骨化三醇），一种通过核内维生素D受体发挥作用的类固醇激素。骨化三醇驱动肠道对钙和磷的主动吸收，抑制甲状旁腺激素，并维持成骨细胞矿化新沉积类骨质所需的钙磷乘积。维生素D受体存在于免疫细胞、肌肉及许多其他组织中，但唯一具有明确人体需求的作用是钙和骨骼轴。皮肤经UVB合成通常提供其中大部分，这也是膳食需求量数据高度取决于纬度、季节和日照的原因。

Deficiency disease缺乏症Rickets in growing children, osteomalacia in adults. Severe infant deficiency also causes hypocalcaemic seizures and dilated cardiomyopathy.生长期儿童表现为佝偻病，成人表现为骨软化症（osteomalacia）。婴儿严重缺乏还可引起低钙血症性惊厥和扩张型心肌病。

First signs早期表现Serum 25(OH)D falls first, then parathyroid hormone rises (secondary hyperparathyroidism) while serum calcium is still normal or low-normal. At this stage a person notices little or nothing: vague aching in the hips, ribs and shins, and proximal muscle weakness showing up as difficulty rising from a low chair or climbing stairs. A blood test shows low 25(OH)D, raised PTH and often raised alkaline phosphatase before any X-ray change.血清25(OH)D首先下降，随后甲状旁腺激素升高（继发性甲状旁腺功能亢进），而血钙仍正常或处于正常低值。此阶段患者几乎无自觉症状：可能有髋部、肋骨和胫骨的隐约酸痛，以及近端肌无力，表现为从矮椅上站起或爬楼梯困难。血液检查显示25(OH)D偏低、PTH升高，且碱性磷酸酶常已升高，此时X线尚无改变。

Untreated不治疗会怎样In children, growth plates fail to mineralise: bowed legs or knock knees, widened wrists and ankles, the rachitic rosary at the costochondral junctions, delayed walking, poor growth and fractures. Infants can present first with hypocalcaemic tetany, seizures or dilated cardiomyopathy, which can be fatal. In adults, unmineralised osteoid accumulates as osteomalacia, giving bone pain, proximal myopathy with a waddling gait, and Looser zones (pseudofractures) that progress to complete fractures of the pubic rami, femoral neck or ribs.儿童期骨骺生长板矿化失败：出现膝内翻或膝外翻、腕踝增宽、肋软骨连接处的佝偻病串珠、行走延迟、生长不良及骨折。婴儿可首先表现为低钙性手足搐搦、惊厥发作或扩张型心肌病，可致命。成人则因未矿化的类骨质堆积而形成骨软化症，出现骨痛、伴摇摆步态的近端肌病，以及Looser带（假性骨折），可进展为耻骨支、股骨颈或肋骨的完全性骨折。

Does it reverse补回来能修复吗Biochemistry, bone pain, myopathy, hypocalcaemic seizures and the radiological signs of active rickets correct completely with vitamin D plus adequate calcium, usually over weeks to a few months. Skeletal deformity already established in long-standing rickets often persists, and marked bowing, rachitic dwarfism or pelvic deformity may need surgical correction.补充维生素D并配合充足钙摄入后，生化指标、骨痛、肌病、低钙性惊厥及活动性佝偻病的影像学表现通常可完全恢复，一般需数周至数月。但长期佝偻病已形成的骨骼畸形往往持续存在，明显的骨弯曲、佝偻病性侏儒或骨盆畸形可能需要手术矫正。

Who becomes deficient谁会缺乏People with little effective sun exposure: housebound or institutionalised older adults, those who cover the skin fully, and anyone living at high latitude through winter. Darker skin at high latitude (more melanin means less UVB synthesis). Exclusively breastfed infants not given a supplement, since breast milk is low in vitamin D. Obesity (sequestration in adipose tissue). Fat malabsorption from coeliac disease, cystic fibrosis, cholestasis or bariatric surgery. Chronic kidney or liver disease, and long-term anticonvulsant or glucocorticoid therapy.有效日照不足者：居家或机构照护的老年人、全身遮盖皮肤者，以及冬季居于高纬度地区者。高纬度地区深肤色人群（黑色素较多意味着UVB合成较少）。未额外补充维生素D的纯母乳喂养婴儿，因母乳中维生素D含量低。肥胖者（脂肪组织中维生素D被隔离）。乳糜泻、囊性纤维化、胆汁淤积或减重手术导致的脂肪吸收不良者。慢性肾病或肝病患者，以及长期使用抗惊厥药或糖皮质激素者。

How common有多常见NHANES 2011-2014: 5.0% of the US population aged 1 year and over had serum 25(OH)D below 30 nmol/L (at risk of deficiency) and 18.3% fell between 30 and 49.9 nmol/L; the below-30 figure was 17.5% in non-Hispanic Black participants against 2.1% in non-Hispanic White participants (PMID 31076739). Clinical nutritional rickets is uncommon in high-income countries but has not disappeared, and remains common in parts of the Middle East, Africa and South Asia (PMID 26741135).NHANES 2011-2014年数据：美国1岁及以上人群中，5.0%血清25(OH)D低于30 nmol/L（属缺乏风险），18.3%处于30至49.9 nmol/L之间；低于30 nmol/L的比例在非西班牙裔黑人中为17.5%，而非西班牙裔白人中仅为2.1%（PMID 31076739）。临床营养性佝偻病在高收入国家已不常见但并未消失，在中东、非洲及南亚部分地区仍较为常见（PMID 26741135）。

Source来源PMID 31076739 (Herrick KA et al., Am J Clin Nutr 2019, Vitamin D status in the United States 2011-2014); PMID 26741135 (Munns CF et al., Horm Res Paediatr 2016;85(2):83-106, Global Consensus Recommendations on Prevention and Management of Nutritional Rickets; co-published in J Clin Endocrinol Metab 2016;101(2):394-415, which is PMID 26745253)

Food and the body食物与身体
In food: Rich食物中：丰富 Dose from food: Partly靠吃达到剂量：部分 Body makes it: Partly身体自产：部分自产 Food data: Low食物数据：低

Oily fish, egg yolk and UV-treated mushrooms supply measurable vitamin D, and fortified fat spreads, milk, breakfast cereals and juices add small amounts, so this is a genuine dietary nutrient rather than a manufactured one. The RICH label needs qualifying on two counts: the food base is narrow (oily fish, egg yolk, UV-treated mushrooms), and two of the stronger rows below are not ordinary foods, since cod liver oil behaves as a supplement and fortified orange juice is a manufactured delivery vehicle. Population evidence points the same way, because SACN concluded the 10 µg/day RNI is difficult to achieve from natural food sources and set it as a year-round RNI for everyone aged 4 and over; UK mean intakes from food are around a third of that (the often-quoted NDNS figures of 2.8 µg/day at ages 19 to 65 and 3.3 µg/day in over-65s are carried here as uncorroborated, since the full SACN report could not be retrieved to confirm them).多脂鱼、蛋黄和经紫外线处理的菇类都能提供可测量的维生素 D，强化脂肪涂抹酱、牛奶、早餐谷物和果汁再补上少量，所以这是一种真正来自膳食的营养素，并非只能靠工业制造。RICH 这个标签需要在两点上加以限定：食物基础很窄（多脂鱼、蛋黄、经紫外线处理的菇类），而且下表中较强的两行并不是普通食物，鱼肝油的行为更接近补充剂，强化橙汁则是工业化的输送载体。人群证据指向同一方向：SACN 认为 10 µg/天 的 RNI 很难仅从天然食物来源达到，并把它定为 4 岁及以上所有人群的全年 RNI；英国来自食物的平均摄入量约为该值的三分之一（常被引用的 NDNS 数字，19 至 65 岁 2.8 µg/天、65 岁以上 3.3 µg/天，此处标为未获证实，因为无法取得完整的 SACN 报告加以确认）。

To match the dose要达到该剂量1,000 IU (25 µg), the low end of ordinary supplement doses, is about 150 g of cooked sockeye salmon every day, or 155 g to 463 g of grilled herring depending on which herring value holds. 4,000 IU (100 µg) is roughly 600 g of sockeye salmon, 621 g to 1.85 kg of herring, about 109 large egg yolks, or about 890 g of UV-treated portabella mushrooms daily. A 50,000 IU (1,250 µg) weekly loading dose has no food equivalent: 7.5 kg of sockeye salmon, or 7.8 to 23.1 kg of grilled herring. One food gets close on mass alone, UV-treated maitake at the top of its measured range, where 178 g would carry 4,000 IU, and that content is unlabelled, spans 0.1 to 56.1 µg/100 g by growing method and is D2 rather than D3. Above roughly 50 degrees north, cutaneous synthesis is effectively zero from October to March, so there is no sunlight to close the winter shortfall.1,000 IU（25 µg）属于普通补充剂剂量的低端，相当于每天吃约 150 g 熟红鲑，或 155 g 至 463 g 烤鲱鱼（取决于采用哪个鲱鱼数值）。4,000 IU（100 µg）大致等于每天 600 g 红鲑、621 g 至 1.85 kg 鲱鱼、约 109 个大蛋黄，或约 890 g 经紫外线处理的褐菇。每周 50,000 IU（1,250 µg）的负荷剂量在食物里没有对应物：7.5 kg 红鲑，或 7.8 至 23.1 kg 烤鲱鱼。只有一种食物单看质量能接近，即处于实测范围上限的紫外线处理灰树花，178 g 就能提供 4,000 IU，但这一含量不会标注在包装上，随栽培方式在 0.1 至 56.1 µg/100 g 之间波动，而且它是 D2，不是 D3。在北纬约 50 度以上，10 月至次年 3 月皮肤合成实际为零，冬季缺口没有阳光可以填补。

Food vs supplement食物与补充剂Mushroom vitamin D is D2 (ergocalciferol), a different molecule from the D3 in fish, egg yolk and almost all supplements, and D3 raises serum 25(OH)D more effectively, with the gap widest for intermittent bolus dosing (Tripkovic et al., Am J Clin Nutr 2012;95:1357-64, PMID 22552031, DOI 10.3945/ajcn.111.031070, mean difference 34.10 nmol/L for bolus dosing, P = 0.0002; the advantage is lost with daily dosing, P = 0.10). UV mushroom content is wildly variable and usually unlabelled: USDA measured UV-treated portabella at 3.4 µg/100 g from one producer and 25.6 µg/100 g from another, maitake from 0.1 to 56.1 µg/100 g by growing method, and untreated white mushrooms at 0.1 to 0.2 µg/100 g, so buying ordinary mushrooms because 'mushrooms have vitamin D' gets you essentially nothing. Species and provenance matter as much as the food name: the salmon row is wild sockeye, while farmed Atlantic salmon, which is what most shoppers buy, runs several-fold lower, so 'salmon' on a pack does not deliver the sockeye figure. Cod liver oil is nominally a food but behaves as a supplement and carries 18,000 µg retinol per 100 g (CoFID 17-488, unconfirmed), so a tablespoon delivers about 8,160 IU of preformed vitamin A alongside the D3, which rules it out in pregnancy. Several real UK vehicles are missing from the table for want of a verifiable figure and should not be forgotten: fortified margarine and fat spreads (a statutory UK vitamin D vehicle for decades, and a larger contributor to UK intake than the US fortified orange juice listed), fortified breakfast cereals, kippers and other smoked herring, canned red sockeye (higher than the canned pink listed), herring and cod roe, and sun-dried shiitake for D2. Oily fish delivers D3 inside a fat matrix with EPA/DHA, protein, iodine and selenium; a capsule delivers D3 alone.菇类的维生素 D 是 D2（麦角钙化醇），与鱼类、蛋黄以及几乎所有补充剂中的 D3 是不同的分子，D3 提升血清 25(OH)D 的效率更高，间歇性大剂量给药时差距最大（Tripkovic 等，Am J Clin Nutr 2012;95:1357-64，PMID 22552031，DOI 10.3945/ajcn.111.031070，大剂量给药的平均差值为 34.10 nmol/L，P = 0.0002；每日给药时这一优势消失，P = 0.10）。紫外线处理菇类的含量波动极大，通常也不标注：USDA 测得一家生产商的紫外线处理褐菇为 3.4 µg/100 g，另一家为 25.6 µg/100 g，灰树花随栽培方式在 0.1 至 56.1 µg/100 g 之间，未处理的白蘑菇为 0.1 至 0.2 µg/100 g，所以只因为“菇类含维生素 D”就买普通蘑菇，基本什么都得不到。物种和产地与食物名称同样重要：表中的鲑鱼是野生红鲑，而大多数消费者买到的养殖大西洋鲑要低数倍，包装上写着“鲑鱼”并不能提供红鲑的数值。鱼肝油名义上是食物，行为上更像补充剂，每 100 g 含 18,000 µg 视黄醇（CoFID 17-488，未证实），因此一汤匙除 D3 之外还带来约 8,160 IU 的预制型维生素 A，孕期不宜使用。还有几种英国实际存在的载体因缺少可核实的数据而未列入表中，但不应被忽略：强化人造黄油和脂肪涂抹酱（数十年来英国法定的维生素 D 载体，对英国摄入量的贡献大于表中所列的美国强化橙汁）、强化早餐谷物、烟熏鲱鱼（kippers）及其他熏制鲱鱼、罐装红鲑（高于表中所列的罐装粉红鲑）、鲱鱼籽和鳕鱼籽，以及提供 D2 的晒干香菇。多脂鱼把 D3 放在脂肪基质中一并送来，同时带有 EPA/DHA、蛋白质、碘和硒；胶囊只送来 D3。

Absorption吸收Vitamin D from both food and capsules is fat-soluble and absorbed better with a meal containing fat, which oily fish and egg yolk supply themselves. Form matters more than source: D2 from mushrooms is less effective per microgram than D3 (PMID 22552031). Egg yolk additionally contains 25-hydroxycholecalciferol, an already-hydroxylated metabolite that supplements do not normally provide. Composition tables bundle 25-OH-D3 into the headline total under the convention total = cholecalciferol + 5 x 25-OH-D3, so a 'vitamin D' number for eggs, trout or canned salmon is not strictly comparable to the D3 in a capsule; the canned pink salmon (12.1 + 5 x 0.30 = 13.6), trout (7.19 + 5 x 0.20 = 8.19) and whole egg (2.30 + 5 x 0.18 = 3.20) totals here all follow it.食物和胶囊里的维生素 D 都是脂溶性的，随含脂餐一起摄入吸收更好，而多脂鱼和蛋黄本身就自带脂肪。形式比来源更要紧：菇类的 D2 按每微克计算效力低于 D3（PMID 22552031）。蛋黄还额外含有 25-羟基胆钙化醇，这是一种已经羟化的代谢物，补充剂通常不提供。成分表按“总量 = 胆钙化醇 + 5 x 25-OH-D3”的惯例把 25-OH-D3 并入头条总量，所以鸡蛋、鳟鱼或罐装鲑鱼的“维生素 D”数字与胶囊中的 D3 并不严格可比；此处罐装粉红鲑（12.1 + 5 x 0.30 = 13.6）、鳟鱼（7.19 + 5 x 0.20 = 8.19）和全蛋（2.30 + 5 x 0.18 = 3.20）的总量都遵循这一惯例。

Food data note食物数据说明The single richest confirmed food (cooked sockeye salmon) and the UV portabella and fortified orange juice values check out, but most rows rest on McCance and Widdowson CoFID 2021 codes and not one CoFID code or value in the submission could be independently confirmed, because the dataset was not retrievable. Where USDA could be checked against CoFID the two diverged badly in this group: egg yolk vitamin D was overstated 2.4x and herring 3x. The maitake, eel and swordfish figures are indicative only, and the NDNS population intake figures could not be traced to the SACN report低。唯一一个获得证实的最富含食物（熟红鲑）以及紫外线处理褐菇和强化橙汁的数值都能核对通过，但多数行依赖 McCance and Widdowson CoFID 2021 的食物编码，而提交材料中没有任何一个 CoFID 编码或数值能够独立确认，因为该数据集无法取得。本组中凡是能用 USDA 与 CoFID 对照的地方，两者差异都很大：蛋黄维生素 D 被高估 2.4 倍，鲱鱼高估 3 倍。灰树花、鳗鱼和剑鱼的数字仅为指示性，NDNS 的人群摄入量数字也无法追溯到 SACN 报告。

Does the body make it身体是否自产Skin makes vitamin D3 photochemically: UVB at 290 to 315 nm opens 7-dehydrocholesterol to previtamin D3, which isomerises thermally, after which CYP2R1 in liver makes 25(OH)D and renal CYP27B1 makes the hormone 1,25(OH)2D. Because the first step needs photons rather than an enzyme, production collapses with latitude, season, time of day, skin pigmentation, sunscreen, clothing, indoor living and age, which is why deficiency is common despite a functioning pathway. The recovered entries split on the label, one scoring it FULL conditional on UVB exposure and another calling it the one true CONDITIONAL vitamin, and PARTIAL is taken here because the pathway routinely fails to cover requirement under real exposure conditions; supplementing is therefore genuine repletion of a synthesis shortfall, and serum 25(OH)D makes it targetable and monitorable.皮肤以光化学方式生成维生素 D3: 290 至 315 nm 的 UVB 使 7-dehydrocholesterol 开环成为 previtamin D3, 后者经热异构化, 随后肝脏 CYP2R1 生成 25(OH)D, 肾脏 CYP27B1 生成激素形式 1,25(OH)2D。第一步需要光子而非酶, 所以产量随纬度, 季节, 时段, 皮肤色素, 防晒霜, 衣着, 室内生活和年龄大幅下降, 这就是通路完好却仍常见缺乏的原因。恢复条目中的标签并不统一, 有的记为 FULL (以有 UVB 暴露为条件), 有的称它是唯一真正 CONDITIONAL 的维生素; 这里取 PARTIAL, 因为在真实日照条件下该通路经常覆盖不了需要量。补充属于对合成不足的真正补足, 血清 25(OH)D 使它可以有针对性并可监测。

Pathway合成通路7-dehydrocholesterol (a mevalonate/cholesterol pathway intermediate and the DHCR7 substrate) plus UVB at 290-315 nm gives previtamin D3 by non-enzymatic photolysis in the epidermis, followed by thermal isomerisation to vitamin D3; DBP (GC) transports it to liver for 25-hydroxylation by CYP2R1 (and CYP27A1), then to kidney and extrarenal sites for 1-alpha-hydroxylation by CYP27B1 under PTH and FGF23 control; inactivation by CYP24A1 (24-hydroxylation); action through the nuclear receptor VDR.表皮中的 7-dehydrocholesterol (mevalonate 与胆固醇通路的中间物, 也是 DHCR7 的底物) 在 290-315 nm 的 UVB 作用下经非酶光解生成 previtamin D3, 随后热异构为 vitamin D3; 由 DBP (GC) 运至肝脏, 经 CYP2R1 (以及 CYP27A1) 进行 25 位羟化; 再到肾脏和肾外部位, 由 CYP27B1 在 PTH 与 FGF23 调控下进行 1-alpha 位羟化; 由 CYP24A1 (24 位羟化) 失活; 通过核受体 VDR 起作用。

Amount made自产量Cutaneous synthesis has no fixed daily figure because it is UVB-dependent, so NOT ESTABLISHED as a constant. Whole-body exposure to one minimal erythemal dose of UVB equates to roughly 10,000-25,000 IU (250-625 µg) cholecalciferol, and IOM cites an estimate that average summer cutaneous synthesis at northern latitudes equates to about 2,000 IU/d. Dietary reference values: RDA 600 IU (15 micrograms)/day for ages 1 to 70 and 800 IU/day above 70, UL 4,000 IU/day (IOM 2011).皮肤合成没有固定的每日数值, 因为它依赖 UVB, 作为常量判为 NOT ESTABLISHED。全身暴露于一个最小红斑剂量的 UVB 相当于大约 10,000-25,000 IU (250-625 µg) cholecalciferol; IOM 引用的估计是北方纬度夏季平均皮肤合成量约相当于 2,000 IU/d。膳食参考值: 1 至 70 岁 RDA 600 IU (15 micrograms)/day, 70 岁以上 800 IU/day, UL 4,000 IU/day (IOM 2011)。

Still matters when仍有意义的情形Rickets and osteomalacia, exclusively breastfed infants, dark skin at high latitude, housebound or fully covered individuals, obesity (sequestration in adipose tissue), fat malabsorption and bariatric surgery, anticonvulsant or glucocorticoid therapy that induces catabolism, and chronic kidney disease, where activated forms are needed because CYP27B1 activity is lost. Excess causes hypercalcaemia, so mega-dosing is not a stronger version of adequacy, and intermittent very high doses performed worse than daily dosing in fracture and fall trials. Redundant for someone with regular summer sun on bare skin at low latitude.佝偻病和骨软化症, 纯母乳喂养的婴儿, 高纬度地区的深色皮肤人群, 居家不出或全身遮盖者, 肥胖 (脂肪组织的隔离作用), 脂肪吸收不良和减重手术后, 诱导分解代谢的抗癫痫药或糖皮质激素治疗, 以及慢性肾病 (因 CYP27B1 活性丧失而需要活化形式)。过量会引起高钙血症, 超大剂量并非更强的充足状态, 在骨折与跌倒试验中间断超大剂量给药的表现不如每日给药。对低纬度夏季经常裸露皮肤晒太阳的人, 它是多余的。

Synthesis source合成来源PMID 17634462 (Holick, N Engl J Med 2007;357:266-281, DOI 10.1056/NEJMra070553); IOM, Dietary Reference Intakes for Calcium and Vitamin D (2011), NCBI Bookshelf NBK56070. Merged from the recovered entries Vitamin D3 (cholecalciferol), Vitamin D (cholecalciferol) and Vitamin D (cholecalciferol) as a standalone supplement.

Refs.文献 VITAL PMID 30415629; D-Health PMID 35026158; ViDA PMID 28384800; Cochrane PMID 24729336; Herrick PMID 31076739; Cashman PMID 26864360; Endocrine Society PMID 38828931; Sanders PMID 20460620; Bischoff-Ferrari PMID 26747333; Burt PMID 31454046
TTBBFFDDBBXXVitamin B12 (cobalamin)维生素 B12（钴胺素）
Verdict结论Take it值得吃
Evidence证据Grade BB 级
Dose tested已验证剂量50-250 µg/d, or 1,000-2,000 µg once or twice weekly. Deficiency treatment: 1,000-2,000 µg/d orally.50 至 250 微克/天，或每周 1 至 2 次、每次 1000 至 2000 微克。治疗缺乏：口服 1000 至 2000 微克/天。
Who适用人群Vegans and long-term vegetarians, metformin users, people on a proton pump inhibitor for over two years, post-bariatric patients, pernicious anaemia.纯素与长期素食者、二甲双胍使用者、服用质子泵抑制剂超过两年者、减重手术后患者、恶性贫血患者。
Pros优点
  • The deficiency is real and the neurological damage is irreversible once established, so correcting it early genuinely matters.这种缺乏是真实存在的，一旦形成，神经损害不可逆，所以及早纠正确实要紧。
  • Oral works as well as injection. Cochrane found 1,000 µg/d oral matched intramuscular, and at 2,000 µg/d oral was better by 680 pg/mL. Injections are a business model.口服和注射一样好。Cochrane 发现口服 1000 微克/天与肌注相当，2000 微克/天时口服还高出 680 pg/mL。打针是一门生意。
  • Risk in the named groups is well quantified: metformin lowers B12 by 19% over 4.3 years; two or more years of PPI use gives OR 1.65.上述人群的风险已被量化得很清楚：二甲双胍在 4.3 年内使 B12 下降 19%；使用 PPI 两年以上 OR 为 1.65。
  • No tolerable upper intake level has been needed, because no adverse effect has been found from excess.至今不需要设定可耐受上限，因为没有发现过量带来的不良反应。
Cons缺点
  • It does nothing for energy, mood or cognition in people who are not deficient. That is the entire marketing claim and it has no support.对不缺乏的人，它在精力、情绪和认知上毫无作用。而这恰恰是它全部的营销卖点，且毫无依据。
  • Do not treat with folate alone if B12 status is unknown, for the reason given under folic acid.B12 状态不明时不要单用叶酸治疗，理由见叶酸条目。
  • Cyanocobalamin should be avoided in Leber hereditary optic neuropathy and in renal failure. Use hydroxocobalamin instead.Leber 遗传性视神经病变和肾衰竭者应避免氰钴胺，改用羟钴胺。
  • High-dose biotin in the same B-complex product interferes with immunoassays including troponin, which can mimic or mask a heart attack on a blood test.同一款复合 B 族产品中的大剂量生物素会干扰包括肌钙蛋白在内的免疫检测，可能在化验上模仿或掩盖心肌梗死。
What it does, and what happens without it它有什么作用，缺了会怎样

Needed by two enzymes: one for making new blood cells, one for nerve insulation.为两种酶所必需：一种用于生成新血细胞，一种用于神经髓鞘的维护。

Named deficiency disease有明确的缺乏症 Permanent damage损害不可逆

In detail详细Cobalamin is the cofactor for exactly two human enzymes. Methionine synthase remethylates homocysteine to methionine using 5-methyltetrahydrofolate, which both regenerates usable folate and supplies S-adenosylmethionine for the methylation reactions that maintain myelin. Methylmalonyl-CoA mutase converts methylmalonyl-CoA to succinyl-CoA in the mitochondrion during breakdown of odd-chain fatty acids and branched-chain amino acids. Absorption is elaborate: gastric acid and pepsin release B12 from food protein, intrinsic factor from parietal cells carries it, and receptors in the terminal ileum take it up. Outside vegan diets the usual cause of deficiency is failure somewhere along that route rather than low intake.钴胺素是人体内恰好两种酶的辅因子。methionine synthase利用5-甲基四氢叶酸将同型半胱氨酸再甲基化为蛋氨酸，这一过程既能再生可用的叶酸，又能为维持髓鞘的甲基化反应提供S-腺苷蛋氨酸。methylmalonyl-CoA mutase在线粒体内催化甲基丙二酰辅酶A转化为琥珀酰辅酶A，参与奇数碳链脂肪酸和支链氨基酸的分解代谢。其吸收过程相当复杂：胃酸和胃蛋白酶将B12从食物蛋白中释放，壁细胞分泌的内因子负责转运，回肠末端的受体负责摄取。除严格素食饮食外，缺乏的常见原因是这条通路上某个环节出现故障，而非摄入不足。

Deficiency disease缺乏症Pernicious anaemia (autoimmune intrinsic factor failure) and subacute combined degeneration of the spinal cord; megaloblastic anaemia is the haematological presentation.恶性贫血（自身免疫性内因子缺失）和脊髓亚急性联合变性，巨幼细胞性贫血是其血液学表现。

First signs早期表现Methylmalonic acid and homocysteine rise before serum B12 drops into the clearly deficient range, which is why borderline results are often followed with those metabolites. Symmetrical tingling and numbness in the feet and hands, loss of vibration sense and joint position sense, unsteadiness that is worse in the dark. Macrocytosis with hypersegmented neutrophils, sore smooth tongue, fatigue, mild cognitive slowing and low mood. Neurological signs can be present with a completely normal full blood count.甲基丙二酸和同型半胱氨酸的升高早于血清B12降至明确缺乏的范围，这也是临界结果常需复查这两项代谢物的原因。表现为手足对称性刺痛和麻木、振动觉和关节位置觉丧失、暗处更明显的步态不稳。还可见大细胞增多伴中性粒细胞分叶过多、舌痛且舌面光滑、疲劳、轻度认知迟缓和情绪低落。神经系统体征可以在全血细胞计数完全正常的情况下出现。

Untreated不治疗会怎样Subacute combined degeneration: demyelination of the dorsal columns and lateral corticospinal tracts producing sensory ataxia, spasticity, extensor plantar responses, and bladder and bowel disturbance, progressing untreated to spastic paraparesis and loss of independent walking. Optic atrophy occurs in a minority, as do dementia and psychosis. Severe megaloblastic anaemia with pancytopenia can occur, but it is the neurology that disables.脊髓亚急性联合变性：后索和皮质脊髓侧束脱髓鞘，导致感觉性共济失调、痉挛、跖反射阳性以及膀胱和肠道功能紊乱，未经治疗会进展为痉挛性截瘫并丧失独立行走能力。少数患者出现视神经萎缩，也有出现痴呆和精神病的。严重的巨幼细胞性贫血伴全血细胞减少也可能发生，但真正致残的是神经系统病变。

Does it reverse补回来能修复吗The blood corrects fully (reticulocytosis within a week, counts normal in roughly eight weeks) while the neurology may not. In the largest series, 153 episodes in 143 patients, 47.1% had complete resolution of neurological abnormalities on treatment and 6.3% were left with moderate-to-severe residual disability; so most treated patients recover fully or nearly so and a minority are left disabled. What survives treatment is inversely related to how severe the deficits were and how long they had run before treatment started. Recovery is fastest in the first two months and continues to about six months. This is exactly why folate must not be given blind for an unexplained macrocytic anaemia: folic acid repairs the blood picture and removes the visible signal while the cord damage carries on.血液学异常可完全纠正（一周内出现网织红细胞增多，计数约八周后恢复正常），但神经系统病变未必如此。在规模最大的一组病例系列中（143例患者共153次发作），47.1%的患者经治疗后神经系统异常完全恢复，6.3%遗留中度至重度残疾，也就是说多数接受治疗的患者可完全或接近完全恢复，少数人会留下残疾。治疗后残留的损害程度与治疗前缺陷的严重程度和持续时间成反比。恢复在最初两个月最快，可持续至约六个月。这正是为什么不明原因的大细胞性贫血绝不能盲目给予叶酸的原因：叶酸会修复血象、消除可见的信号，而脊髓损害仍在继续。

Who becomes deficient谁会缺乏Adults over 60 with atrophic gastritis and food-bound B12 malabsorption. Autoimmune pernicious anaemia. Gastrectomy or gastric bypass, ileal resection, Crohn's disease. Long-term metformin. Long-term proton pump inhibitors or H2 blockers. Strict vegans and, importantly, their exclusively breastfed infants. Repeated nitrous oxide exposure, recreational or occupational, which inactivates methionine synthase directly.60岁以上患有萎缩性胃炎、食物结合型B12吸收不良的成年人。自身免疫性恶性贫血患者。胃切除或胃旁路手术、回肠切除、克罗恩病患者。长期使用二甲双胍者。长期使用质子泵抑制剂或H2受体阻滞剂者。严格素食者，尤其重要的是其纯母乳喂养的婴儿。反复接触一氧化二氮者，无论是娱乐性还是职业性接触，这会直接使methionine synthase失活。

How common有多常见About 6% of people aged 60 and over in large US and UK surveys have plasma B12 below 148 pmol/L, and close to 20% are in the marginal range of 148 to 221 pmol/L; prevalence rises with age and is considerably higher in low-income countries across the whole life span (PMID 19116323).美国和英国的大型调查显示，60岁及以上人群中约6%的血浆B12低于148 pmol/L，另有接近20%处于148至221 pmol/L的边缘范围，患病率随年龄增长而升高，且在低收入国家的各个年龄段都明显更高（PMID 19116323）。

Source来源PMID 19116323 (Allen, Am J Clin Nutr 2009, How common is vitamin B-12 deficiency?); PMID 1648656 (Healton et al., Medicine 1991, 153 episodes of neurological cobalamin deficiency; residual deficit predicted by severity and duration before treatment)

Food and the body食物与身体
In food: Rich食物中：丰富 Dose from food: Out of reach靠吃达到剂量：达不到 Body makes it: Cannot身体自产：不能 Food data: High食物数据：高

Rich in animal foods and effectively absent from plant foods, because cobalamin is synthesised only by bacteria and archaea: every reliable source is an animal that accumulated bacterial B12, or a bacterially fermented or fortified product. The single word RICH is population-dependent and hides a reversal, so state it plainly: for an omnivore B12 is one of the easiest nutrients in the food supply, while for someone on an unfortified plant-based diet the same evidence makes it effectively absent, the only credible source being dried purple laver at 2.33 ug per 3 g sheet from a product whose content varies about elevenfold by origin and degrades with toasting and storage. On the contested plant candidates: spirulina is not usable, since 83% of its cobamide is pseudovitamin B12 (adeninylcobamide), inactive in humans, with only 17% real B12, and microbiological assays cannot tell them apart, which is why the labels claim high B12 (Watanabe et al., J Agric Food Chem 1999;47:4736-41, PMID 10552882); nori is usable and is the only credible plant source, carrying five biologically active cobalamin forms with adenosyl- and methylcobalamin about 60% of the total, and it corrected B12 status in deficient rats (Takenaka S et al., Br J Nutr 2001;85:699-703, PMID 11430774); tempeh is unreliable at 0.7-8.0 ug/100 g depending on which bacteria happened to contaminate the Rhizopus fermentation; mushrooms are not usable, with dried shiitake averaging 5.61 ug/100 g dry weight (range 1.3-12.7), black trumpet and golden chanterelle 1.09-2.65 ug/100 g dry weight and most other species about 0.09 ug/100 g or trace; chlorella ranges from zero to several hundred ug/100 g between products and cannot be relied on (all from Watanabe et al., Nutrients 2014;6:1861-73, PMID 24803097). Two further claims in the original submission, that kimchi and fermented vegetables sit below 0.1 ug/100 g and that lion's mane contains the inactive B12[c-lactone] analogue, could not be traced to the cited review and are recorded here as indicative and unsourced.动物性食物中含量丰富，植物性食物中基本没有，因为钴胺素只由细菌和古菌合成：所有可靠来源都是积累了细菌 B12 的动物，或经细菌发酵、或经强化的产品。RICH 这一个词依人群而定，还藏着一次反转，所以直说：对杂食者，B12 是整个食物供应里最容易获得的营养素之一；对吃未强化植物性饮食的人，同样的证据意味着它基本缺席，唯一可信来源是干紫菜，每张 3 g 的紫菜片含 2.33 µg，而这种产品的含量随产地相差约十一倍，并会因烘烤和储存而降解。关于几种有争议的植物候选来源：螺旋藻不可用，其钴酰胺中 83% 是假维生素 B12（腺嘌呤基钴酰胺），对人无活性，真正的 B12 只占 17%，微生物法测定又无法区分两者，这就是标签上 B12 数值很高的原因（Watanabe 等, J Agric Food Chem 1999;47:4736-41, PMID 10552882）；紫菜可用，是唯一可信的植物来源，含五种有生物活性的钴胺素形式，其中腺苷钴胺素和甲基钴胺素约占总量的 60%，并在缺乏 B12 的大鼠身上纠正了 B12 状态（Takenaka S 等, Br J Nutr 2001;85:699-703, PMID 11430774）；天贝不可靠，0.7-8.0 µg/100 g，取决于根霉发酵过程中恰好污染进去的是哪种细菌；食用菌不可用，干香菇平均 5.61 µg/100 g 干重（范围 1.3-12.7），黑喇叭菌（black trumpet）和金黄鸡油菌 1.09-2.65 µg/100 g 干重，其他多数种类约 0.09 µg/100 g 或仅为痕量；小球藻在不同产品之间从零到几百 µg/100 g 不等，无法依赖（以上均出自 Watanabe 等, Nutrients 2014;6:1861-73, PMID 24803097）。原稿另有两处说法，即泡菜和发酵蔬菜低于 0.1 µg/100 g，以及猴头菇含无活性的 B12[c-lactone] 类似物，无法在所引综述中找到出处，这里记为指示性且无来源。

To match the dose要达到该剂量Against the 2.4 ug/day RDA there is no gap for anyone eating animal food: one 3 oz portion of cooked clams is 35 times the RDA, a slice of beef liver 20 times, a can of sardines 3.4 times. Against the supplement dose the gap cannot be closed. Oral B12 products are typically 500-1,000 ug, and 1,000-2,000 ug for treating deficiency. To have 1,000 ug physically present in a meal takes 1.01 kg of cooked clams, 1.17 kg of pan-fried lamb liver, 1.42 kg of braised beef liver, 4.17 kg of cooked blue mussels, 11.2 kg of canned sardines, 35.7 kg of cooked salmon, or 222 kg of whole milk, which is about 216 litres (the submission's '222 litres' confused grams with litres; 1,000/0.0045 = 222,222 g, and at about 1.03 kg/L that is 216 L). No one could eat any of those. The comparison is also the wrong one, because intrinsic-factor-mediated absorption saturates at about 1.5-2.0 ug per meal (Watanabe, Exp Biol Med 2007;232:1266-74, PMID 17959839), so everything above roughly 2 ug in a single sitting is absorbed only by passive diffusion at on the order of 1%. A 1,000 ug tablet works because 1% of 1,000 ug bypasses the receptor route, which no food can imitate and none needs to unless that route is broken. For a strict vegan the picture inverts: nothing reliably supplies even the 2.4 ug RDA except dried nori, and Watanabe puts the requirement at about 4 g/day of dried purple laver, which is about one and a third 3 g sheets every day (the submission said one and a half) from a product varying about elevenfold by origin. Fortified foods or a tablet are the honest answer.对照每日 2.4 µg 的 RDA，吃动物性食物的人不存在缺口：一份 3 oz 熟蛤蜊是 RDA 的 35 倍，一片牛肝 20 倍，一罐沙丁鱼 3.4 倍。对照补充剂剂量，缺口无法弥合。口服 B12 产品通常是 500-1,000 µg，治疗缺乏时 1,000-2,000 µg。要让一餐里实际存在 1,000 µg，需要 1.01 kg 熟蛤蜊、1.17 kg 煎羊肝、1.42 kg 炖牛肝、4.17 kg 熟蓝贻贝、11.2 kg 罐装沙丁鱼、35.7 kg 熟三文鱼，或 222 kg 全脂牛奶，约合 216 升（原稿写的 222 升把克和升搞混了；1,000/0.0045 = 222,222 g，按约 1.03 kg/L 折算是 216 L）。这些没人吃得下。这个对比本身也问错了问题，因为内因子介导的吸收在每餐约 1.5-2.0 µg 处饱和（Watanabe, Exp Biol Med 2007;232:1266-74, PMID 17959839），一次进食中超过约 2 µg 的部分只能靠被动扩散吸收，效率大约 1%。1,000 µg 的片剂之所以有效，是因为 1,000 µg 的 1% 绕开了受体途径，任何食物都模仿不了，而只要该途径没坏，也不需要模仿。对严格素食者，情况反转：除了干紫菜，没有任何食物能可靠提供哪怕 2.4 µg 的 RDA，Watanabe 把需要量定在每天约 4 g 干紫菜，相当于每天约一又三分之一张 3 g 的紫菜片（原稿说的是一张半），而这种产品的含量随产地相差约十一倍。强化食品或片剂才是诚实的答案。

Food vs supplement食物与补充剂Supplements use cyanocobalamin, a form not found in food, where the cyanide ligand is an artefact of the purification step and is removed intracellularly. Food B12 is protein-bound and needs gastric acid and pepsin to release it before intrinsic factor can take it up, so proton pump inhibitors, atrophic gastritis, gastric surgery and metformin knock out food B12 while leaving free crystalline B12 in a tablet or fortified cereal largely usable. Here the supplement is the mechanistically correct choice, and not merely the convenient one. The form risk with algae products runs opposite to the usual concentration worry: a spirulina capsule sold as a B12 source delivers mostly inactive pseudovitamin B12, and the microbiological assay behind the label number could not distinguish it from the real thing, so the label overstates delivered B12 rather than the dose being too strong. Note also that USDA gives yeast extract spread only 0.50 ug B12/100 g (FDC 167717), which is 0.03 ug per 6 g teaspoon: yeast does not make B12, so any yeast product that is a real source has been fortified and the number belongs to the fortification.补充剂用的是氰钴胺，食物中不存在这种形式，其中的氰基是提纯步骤留下的产物，进入细胞后会被去除。食物中的 B12 与蛋白结合，需要胃酸和胃蛋白酶先把它释放出来，内因子才能摄取，所以质子泵抑制剂、萎缩性胃炎、胃部手术和二甲双胍会废掉食物 B12，而片剂或强化谷物里游离的结晶 B12 大体仍可利用。在这一项上，补充剂是机制上正确的选择，不只是图方便。藻类产品的形式风险与通常担心的浓度问题方向相反：作为 B12 来源出售的螺旋藻胶囊，交付的主要是无活性的假维生素 B12，而标签数字背后的微生物法测定无法把它和真货区分开，所以标签高估了实际提供的 B12，这里的风险与剂量过强无关。另外注意，USDA 给酵母提取物涂抹酱的 B12 只有 0.50 µg/100 g（FDC 167717），每 6 g 一茶匙合 0.03 µg：酵母不产生 B12，所以任何真能算作来源的酵母产品都经过强化，那个数字属于强化本身。

Absorption吸收About 50% of dietary B12 is assumed absorbed from a normal meal, but it varies sharply by food: fish 42%, sheep meat 56-89%, chicken 61-66% and eggs under 9% (Watanabe 2007, PMID 17959839). The egg figure matters because eggs are routinely offered to vegetarians as a B12 food; on absorbed B12 a large egg delivers about 0.04 ug, which is 1.7% of the RDA rather than the 19% the content figure implies. Cooking costs real B12. USDA Table of Nutrient Retention Factors Release 6 (2007) gives 70% for roasted beef (code 0601), 60% for beef braised or simmered without the drippings (0651/0653), 65% for roasted chicken (0805), 60% for liver simmered without drippings (1152), 90% for baked lean finfish (2301), 60% for shellfish boiled in the shell (2701) against 90% steamed (2702), and 30% for milk held at heat for an hour (2153). Keeping the pan juices recovers much of it, which is why the with-drippings factors run exactly 15 points higher. One methodological point earned by the corrected mussel row: where USDA publishes a cooked composition entry, use it, because a hand-applied retention factor ignores the moisture loss that concentrates B12 and in this case halved the figure for the food people actually eat.一般假定正常膳食中约 50% 的 B12 被吸收，但按食物差别很大：鱼 42%，羊肉 56-89%，鸡肉 61-66%，鸡蛋不到 9%（Watanabe 2007, PMID 17959839）。鸡蛋这个数字要紧，因为素食者常被推荐把鸡蛋当作 B12 食物来源；按实际吸收量算，一个大鸡蛋提供约 0.04 µg，占 RDA 的 1.7%，而含量数字给人的印象是 19%。烹饪会真实损失 B12。USDA 营养素保留系数表（Table of Nutrient Retention Factors）第 6 版（2007）给出：烤牛肉 70%（代码 0601），牛肉炖或煮且不计肉汁 60%（0651/0653），烤鸡 65%（0805），肝脏煮制不计肉汁 60%（1152），瘦身有鳍鱼烤制 90%（2301），带壳水煮贝类 60%（2701）而蒸制 90%（2702），牛奶持续加热一小时 30%（2153）。留住锅里的汤汁能收回很大一部分，这也是带肉汁的系数正好高 15 个百分点的原因。修正后的贻贝那一行还带出一个方法学要点：USDA 只要发布了熟食成分条目就该用它，因为手工套用保留系数会忽略水分流失对 B12 的浓缩作用，本例中这样做把人们真正吃到的那种食物的数值砍掉了一半。

Food data note食物数据说明for the animal-food rows: every per-100 g value and gram weight traces to a named FoodData Central record and every per-portion figure and percentage recomputes, and the Watanabe and Takenaka citations resolve to the stated journals, volumes and pages. Lower in two places that are stated rather than hidden: the nori figures and the whole vegan-diet conclusion rest on a single compiled review (Watanabe 2014) whose own product spread is about elevenfold, and the kimchi and lion's mane claims could not be traced to any cited source and are marked indicative. The 3 oz portion basis for lamb liver and Pacific oyster is stated by this dataset, not taken from a USDA household measure动物性食物各行为高：每一个每 100 g 数值和克重都可追溯到具名的 FoodData Central 记录，每个每份数值和百分比都能重算得出，Watanabe 和 Takenaka 的引文也都指向所述期刊、卷号和页码。有两处较低，并且是明说而非隐藏：紫菜数据和整个纯素饮食结论都依赖单一份汇编综述（Watanabe 2014），该综述自身的产品含量跨度约十一倍；泡菜和猴头菇两条说法无法追溯到任何引用来源，已标为指示性。羊肝和太平洋牡蛎的 3 oz 份量基准由本数据集给出，并非取自 USDA 的家庭常用量。

Does the body make it身体是否自产Humans have no cobalamin biosynthetic pathway, and the deficiency states are well described, megaloblastic anaemia and subacute combined degeneration. Bacteria in the human colon do make cobalamin and it cannot be absorbed there, because intrinsic factor dependent uptake by cubilin and amnionless is confined to the ileum, upstream of where the bacteria produce it, so colonic B12 synthesis contributes nothing to B12 status. That leaves supplementation as the clearest indication in nutrition for anyone whose dietary or absorptive route fails.人体没有钴胺素的生物合成通路, 缺乏症也很清楚, 即巨细胞性贫血与亚急性联合变性。人体结肠中的细菌确实生成钴胺素, 而它在那里无法被吸收, 因为依赖内因子, 由 cubilin 和 amnionless 介导的摄取只发生在回肠, 位于细菌产生它的部位之上游, 所以结肠 B12 合成对 B12 状态毫无帮助。这使得对膳食或吸收环节失效的人来说, 补充成为营养学中最明确的指征。

Pathway合成通路NOT APPLICABLE for synthesis. Host handling only: haptocorrin binding, release by gastric acid and pepsin, intrinsic factor from gastric parietal cells, cubilin and amnionless mediated uptake in the ileal epithelium, transcobalamin transport in blood and CD320 uptake by tissues, with no colonic step anywhere in the sequence. Inside cells B12 serves MTR, which remethylates homocysteine using 5-methyl-THF.合成为 NOT APPLICABLE。只有宿主处理: 与 haptocorrin 结合, 由胃酸和胃蛋白酶释放, 胃壁细胞提供内因子, 在回肠上皮细胞由 cubilin 与 amnionless 介导摄取, 血中由 transcobalamin 转运, 组织经 CD320 摄取, 整个过程没有任何结肠环节。在细胞内, B12 服务于 MTR, 后者利用 5-methyl-THF 把 homocysteine 再甲基化。

Amount made自产量0 µg/d synthesised by human cells, and effectively 0 µg/d absorbable from colonic bacterial production. Reference point: vitamin B12 RDA 2.4 µg/d.人体细胞合成量 0 µg/d; 结肠细菌产生的部分可吸收量实际为 0 µg/d。参照点: 维生素 B12 RDA 2.4 µg/d。

Still matters when仍有意义的情形Vegans and long-term vegetarians, pernicious anaemia, after gastrectomy or ileal resection, with metformin and long-term proton pump inhibitor use, and in older adults with atrophic gastritis; colonic bacterial production never substitutes for any of these. B12 is usually an absorption problem rather than a pure intake problem outside vegan diets, so the route and dose should follow the mechanism of failure. Broad-spectrum antibiotics and colectomy remove whatever microbial output exists, which was never absorbable anyway.纯素者和长期素食者, 恶性贫血, 胃切除或回肠切除后, 使用 metformin 和长期使用质子泵抑制剂者, 以及伴萎缩性胃炎的老年人; 结肠细菌的生成永远不能替代这些情形下的补充。除纯素饮食外, B12 通常是吸收环节的问题, 所以给药途径和剂量应当跟着失效机制走。广谱抗生素和结肠切除会去掉那部分微生物产量, 而它本来也无法被吸收。

Synthesis source合成来源Recovered entries Nutrients made by colonic bacteria (menaquinones, biotin, folate and vitamin B12) and BCAAs sold separately, and B12, folate, thiamine, riboflavin, B6, biotin, pantothenate and vitamin E. Ileal, intrinsic factor dependent B12 absorption via cubilin and amnionless: Nielsen MJ, Rasmussen MR, Andersen CB, Nexo E, Moestrup SK.

Refs.文献 Cochrane PMID 29543316; de Jager BMJ 2010 PMID 20488910; Lam JAMA 2013 PMID 24327038; Pawlak review

Evidence证据Grade AA 级
Dose tested已验证剂量Test ferritin first. Treatment 60-120 mg elemental iron. Ferrous sulfate 325 mg delivers 65 mg elemental.先查铁蛋白。治疗剂量为元素铁 60 至 120 毫克。硫酸亚铁 325 毫克提供 65 毫克元素铁。
Who适用人群Menstruating women with ferritin at or below about 50 µg/L, pregnancy, blood donors, post-bariatric patients.铁蛋白在约 50 微克/升及以下的经期女性、孕妇、献血者、减重手术后患者。
Pros优点
  • Grade A for treating iron-deficiency anaemia and for pregnancy outcomes, across 57 trials and 48,971 women.在治疗缺铁性贫血和改善妊娠结局上属 A 级，涵盖 57 项试验、48971 名女性。
  • Fatigue improves in non-anaemic iron-deficient women, but only below a ferritin threshold of about 50 µg/L. Above that, nothing happens.在无贫血但缺铁的女性中疲劳会改善，但仅限于铁蛋白低于约 50 微克/升。高于这个值就没有变化。
  • Cheap and generic. Ferrous sulfate is the reference standard and there is no evidence that premium salts work better.便宜且通用。硫酸亚铁是参照标准，没有证据表明高价盐型更有效。
Cons缺点
  • Alternate-day dosing is oversold. The absorption physiology is real (21.8% versus 16.3% fractional absorption) but the only adequately sized randomised trial with haemoglobin as the endpoint found the same final ferritin either way. Treat it as a tolerability strategy, not a superiority one.隔日给药被过度宣传。吸收生理学是真的（分次吸收率 21.8% 对 16.3%），但唯一以血红蛋白为终点、样本量足够的随机试验显示两种方案最终铁蛋白相同。把它当作改善耐受性的办法，而不是更有效的办法。
  • Never supplement anaemia that has not been shown to be iron-deficient. Anaemia of inflammation and haemochromatosis both get worse. Unexplained anaemia in an adult needs investigation, not a pill.绝不要对未证实是缺铁的贫血补铁。炎症性贫血和血色病都会因此加重。成年人不明原因的贫血需要检查，而不是吃药。
  • Contraindicated in hereditary haemochromatosis (HFE C282Y homozygotes) and in transfusion-dependent anaemias such as thalassaemia and myelodysplastic syndrome.遗传性血色病（HFE C282Y 纯合子）以及地中海贫血、骨髓增生异常综合征等依赖输血的贫血禁用。
  • Acute iron overdose was historically a leading cause of fatal poisoning in children under six, which is why unit-dose packaging exists. Keep it locked away.急性铁过量在历史上曾是六岁以下儿童致死性中毒的主要原因之一，单剂量包装正是因此而来。要锁好放置。
  • Gastrointestinal side effects are the main reason people stop. Upper limit 45 mg/d (US); EFSA sets no limit but a safe level of 40 mg/d.胃肠道副作用是人们停药的主要原因。美国上限 45 毫克/天；EFSA 未设上限，但给出 40 毫克/天的安全水平。
What it does, and what happens without it它有什么作用，缺了会怎样

Carries oxygen in the blood and powers the enzymes that turn food into usable energy.铁负责在血液中运输氧气,并驱动把食物转化为可用能量的酶系统。

Named deficiency disease有明确的缺乏症 Partly reversible部分可逆

In detail详细Iron sits at the centre of the haem group in haemoglobin and myoglobin, where it binds and releases oxygen, and in the iron-sulfur clusters of mitochondrial complexes I to III, where it moves electrons during ATP synthesis. It is also the cofactor for ribonucleotide reductase, the rate-limiting enzyme of DNA synthesis, which is why dividing tissues (marrow, gut lining) fail first. In the developing brain it is required for tyrosine hydroxylase (dopamine synthesis), for oligodendrocyte myelination, and for hippocampal maturation, which is the mechanism behind the developmental findings in infants. Absorption is governed by hepcidin, and the direction runs opposite to what is often assumed: when stores are low hepcidin is suppressed, ferroportin survives on enterocytes and macrophages, and fractional absorption rises several-fold, from roughly 10% of intake to 20 to 30%. What hepcidin sets is the ceiling on rate, and there is no regulated route for excreting iron, so a large deficit still takes months to refill and oral iron works slowly. During inflammation hepcidin stays high and blocks absorption despite empty stores, which is why the anaemia of inflammation does not respond to oral iron.铁位于血红蛋白和肌红蛋白血红素基团的中心,负责结合和释放氧气,也存在于线粒体复合体I至III的铁硫簇中,负责在ATP合成过程中传递电子。铁还是ribonucleotide reductase(核糖核苷酸还原酶,DNA合成的限速酶)的辅因子,这就是为何增殖旺盛的组织(骨髓、肠道黏膜)最先受累。在发育中的大脑里,铁是tyrosine hydroxylase(酪氨酸羟化酶,负责多巴胺合成)、少突胶质细胞髓鞘形成以及海马成熟所必需的,这正是婴儿发育相关研究结果背后的机制。铁的吸收受hepcidin(铁调素)调控,其作用方向与常见的误解相反:当体内铁储备低时,铁调素受到抑制,肠上皮细胞和巨噬细胞上的ferroportin(膜铁转运蛋白)得以留存,吸收分数随之成倍上升,从摄入量的约10%升至20%至30%。铁调素设定的是吸收速率的上限,而人体没有可调节的排铁途径,因此大量的铁缺口仍需数月才能补足,口服铁剂起效缓慢。炎症状态下铁调素持续处于高水平,即使铁储备已经耗尽仍会阻断吸收,这就是炎症性贫血对口服铁剂无反应的原因。

Deficiency disease缺乏症Iron deficiency anaemia (microcytic, hypochromic anaemia). Iron deficiency without anaemia is a recognised earlier stage of the same process.缺铁性贫血(小细胞低色素性贫血)。不伴贫血的缺铁是同一病理过程公认的更早期阶段。

First signs早期表现Serum ferritin falls long before haemoglobin does, so a blood test shows depleted stores while the full blood count is still normal. What a person notices at that stage: fatigue disproportionate to activity, breathlessness on stairs, cold hands, hair shedding, restless legs at night, and sometimes pica (craving ice or chalk). Ferritin is an acute-phase protein, so inflammation or infection can mask true depletion.血清铁蛋白的下降远早于血红蛋白,因此血液检查可显示铁储备已耗竭,而全血细胞计数仍正常。此阶段患者可能察觉到的表现包括:与活动量不相称的疲劳、爬楼梯气短、手脚发凉、脱发、夜间不宁腿,有时还有异食癖(嗜食冰块或粉笔)。铁蛋白是一种急性期蛋白,因此炎症或感染可能掩盖真实的铁储备耗竭。

Untreated不治疗会怎样Haemoglobin falls with small pale red cells, producing pallor, tachycardia, exertional dyspnoea, and in extreme cases high-output cardiac failure. In pregnancy it raises the risk of preterm delivery, low birth weight, and poor infant iron stores. In infancy it impairs motor and cognitive development. In adults over 50 a new iron deficiency is a red flag for occult gastrointestinal bleeding and needs investigation rather than a supplement.血红蛋白下降,红细胞变小变淡,导致面色苍白、心动过速、活动后呼吸困难,极端情况下可出现高排量心力衰竭。孕期缺铁会增加早产、低出生体重及婴儿铁储备不足的风险。婴儿期缺铁会损害运动和认知发育。50岁以上成人新发缺铁是隐匿性消化道出血的警示信号,应及时检查,不应仅仅补充铁剂。

Does it reverse补回来能修复吗In adults, anaemia and its symptoms correct fully once iron is replaced and the cause is fixed; haemoglobin typically rises within 4 to 8 weeks and stores refill over 3 to 6 months. Iron deficiency during infancy is the exception. Children with severe chronic iron deficiency in infancy still scored worse on cognitive, motor and behavioural measures more than 10 years after full iron treatment, so the developmental window matters more than the correction.在成人中,一旦补铁并纠正病因,贫血及其症状可完全恢复:血红蛋白通常在4至8周内回升,铁储备在3至6个月内补足。婴儿期缺铁是例外。婴儿期曾患严重慢性缺铁的儿童,在接受充分铁剂治疗10年以上后,认知、运动和行为测评得分依然较差,说明发育窗口期比纠正本身更为关键。

Who becomes deficient谁会缺乏Menstruating women, especially with heavy periods; pregnant women (requirement roughly doubles); infants 6 to 24 months, particularly preterm or low-birth-weight; frequent blood donors; endurance athletes; people with coeliac disease, inflammatory bowel disease, H. pylori gastritis or after bariatric surgery; vegetarian and vegan diets high in phytate; and anyone with chronic gastrointestinal blood loss.处于月经期的女性,尤其是月经量大者;孕妇(需求量约增加一倍);6至24个月龄的婴儿,尤其是早产儿或低出生体重儿;频繁献血者;耐力运动员;患有乳糜泻、炎症性肠病、H. pylori胃炎或接受减重手术后的人群;富含植酸的素食及纯素饮食者;以及任何存在慢性消化道失血的人。

How common有多常见Anaemia affects about 33.7% of women aged 15 to 49 worldwide on GBD 2021 figures (age-standardised prevalence 33,716.77 per 100,000); WHO's 2019 estimates are lower, near 30% in non-pregnant women and 36 to 37% in pregnant women of that age band, about 29.9% overall. Iron deficiency is the single largest cause. In the US, the reported prevalence of iron deficiency in women depends on both the age band and the ferritin cut-off, which is why published figures disagree so widely: in females aged 12 to 21, ferritin below 25 micrograms/L gives about 38 to 39% (Weyand et al., JAMA 2023), while in a 62,685-woman US and Canadian sample of mean age 49.6 the same cut-off gives 15.33% and ferritin below 15 gives 7.43%; restricted to ages 25 to 54, three definitions span 4.46% to 21.23%.根据GBD 2021数据,全球15至49岁女性中约33.7%患贫血(年龄标准化患病率33,716.77/100,000);世卫组织2019年的估计值较低,非孕妇约30%,同龄段孕妇为36%至37%,总体约29.9%。缺铁是贫血最主要的单一病因。在美国,女性缺铁患病率的报告数字取决于年龄段和铁蛋白临界值,这也是各项发表数据差异巨大的原因:在12至21岁女性中,铁蛋白低于25微克/升时患病率约为38%至39%(Weyand等,JAMA 2023);而在一项62,685名美国和加拿大女性、平均年龄49.6岁的样本中,同一临界值下患病率为15.33%,铁蛋白低于15时为7.43%;若限定在25至54岁,三种定义下的患病率范围为4.46%至21.23%。

Source来源Lozoff B, Jimenez E, Hagen J, Mollen E, Wolf AW. Pediatrics 2000;105(4):e51, PMID 10742372 (poorer behavioural and developmental outcome more than 10 years after treatment for iron deficiency in infancy); GBD 2021 anaemia analysis (age-standardised prevalence in women of reproductive age); WHO anaemia fact sheet and Global Health Observatory indicator (2019 estimates); Weyand AC et al., JAMA 2023;329(24):2191-2193, and 'Prevalence of Iron Deficiency Using 3 Definitions Among Women in the US and Canada', PMID 38848068; Camaschella C, N Engl J Med 2015;372:1832-1843.

Food and the body食物与身体
In food: Rich食物中：丰富 Dose from food: Partly靠吃达到剂量：部分 Body makes it: Cannot身体自产：不能 Food data: High食物数据：高

Iron is genuinely abundant in ordinary food, in two chemically distinct forms that behave differently. Haem iron (offal, red meat, shellfish, blood sausage) is absorbed by a dedicated transporter and is largely indifferent to the rest of the plate; non-haem iron (legumes, seeds, greens, fortified flour) is the bulk of most people's intake and is absorbed at a fraction of the rate, heavily modified by vitamin C, polyphenols, phytate and calcium. Haem accounts for 77 percent of total iron in raw lean beef, 81 percent in lamb, 88 percent in pork and 74 percent in chicken (PMID 26433293), higher than the 40 percent assumed in the older Monsen equation; those fractions were measured in raw lean meat, so the haem share of a braised product is probably slightly lower than the calculations below imply. Reference point used in the table: EFSA PRI 16 mg/d for premenopausal women, 11 mg/d for men (EFSA, Dietary Reference Values for nutrients Summary report, approved 4 December 2017, doi 10.2903/sp.efsa.2017.e15121, Tables 5 and 7; underlying opinion EFSA Journal 2015;13(10):4254).铁在普通食物中确实丰富，并以两种化学性质不同、吸收表现也不同的形式存在。血红素铁（内脏、红肉、贝类、血肠）由专门的转运体吸收，基本不受同一餐其他食物影响；非血红素铁（豆类、种子、绿叶菜、强化面粉）构成多数人摄入量的主体，吸收率只有前者的一小部分，并明显受维生素 C、多酚、植酸和钙的影响。血红素铁占生瘦牛肉总铁的 77%，羊肉 81%，猪肉 88%，鸡肉 74%（PMID 26433293），高于较早的 Monsen 方程所假定的 40%；这些比例是在生瘦肉中测得的，因此炖煮产品中血红素铁的占比很可能略低于下文计算所暗示的水平。表中使用的参考值：EFSA PRI 绝经前女性 16 mg/d，男性 11 mg/d（EFSA，Dietary Reference Values for nutrients Summary report，2017 年 12 月 4 日通过，doi 10.2903/sp.efsa.2017.e15121，表 5 和表 7；基础意见书 EFSA Journal 2015;13(10):4254）。

To match the dose要达到该剂量Two supplement doses need two answers. A nutritional dose (14 to 18 mg elemental iron, the EU labelling reference level) is comfortably reachable by eating: 1 cup of boiled lentils (6.6 mg) plus 85 g of braised lamb's liver (7.0 mg) plus 1 oz of pumpkin seeds (2.3 mg) is 15.9 mg in one day, and a single 85 g portion of braised pig's liver is 15.2 mg on its own. A therapeutic dose is out of reach. The absorption and treatment trials gave 60 mg and 120 mg of elemental iron as labelled ferrous sulfate, which is a salt weight of about 325 mg for 65 mg of iron (PMID 29032957). Matching 65 mg of iron by total content takes roughly 363 g of braised pig's liver, 785 g of lamb's liver, 3.3 kg of sirloin steak, 1.95 kg (about 10 cups) of boiled lentils, or 2.4 kg (about 80 cups) of raw spinach in a single day. By absorbed iron the food burden is about 1.6 times larger than the submission claimed, because the trial it cites measured cumulative fractional absorption of 16.3 percent on consecutive days and 21.8 percent on alternate days at 60 mg/d, and 11.8 percent for a single 120 mg dose, rather than the 10 percent assumed. At the source's own 16.3 percent a 65 mg dose delivers about 10.6 mg absorbed. Absorbing 10.6 mg as haem iron at 25 percent requires 42.4 mg of haem iron, about 1.94 kg of braised lean lamb shoulder (2.7 mg total iron per 100 g, 81 percent haem in raw lean; FDC 174331 and PMID 26433293). Absorbing the same 10.6 mg from non-haem food at 5 percent requires 212 mg of non-haem iron, about 6.4 kg of cooked lentils per day. Correcting a diagnosed deficiency cannot be done with food; preventing one can.两种补充剂剂量需要两个答案。营养剂量（14 至 18 mg 元素铁，欧盟标签参考量）靠吃就能轻松达到：1 杯煮扁豆（6.6 mg）加 85 g 炖羊肝（7.0 mg）加 1 oz 南瓜子（2.3 mg），一天合计 15.9 mg；单独一份 85 g 炖猪肝本身就有 15.2 mg。治疗剂量则达不到。吸收和治疗试验给的是以硫酸亚铁形式标示的 60 mg 和 120 mg 元素铁，65 mg 铁对应的盐重约为 325 mg（PMID 29032957）。若按总含量匹配 65 mg 铁，一天大约需要 363 g 炖猪肝、785 g 羊肝、3.3 kg 西冷牛排、1.95 kg（约 10 杯）煮扁豆，或 2.4 kg（约 80 杯）生菠菜。若按吸收铁计算，食物负担约为原稿所称的 1.6 倍，因为它引用的那项试验测得，在 60 mg/d 下连续每日给药的累积分数吸收率为 16.3%，隔日给药为 21.8%，单次 120 mg 剂量为 11.8%，原稿假定的 10% 低于这些实测值。按该来源自己的 16.3% 计算，65 mg 剂量提供约 10.6 mg 吸收铁。以 25% 的吸收率通过血红素铁吸收 10.6 mg，需要 42.4 mg 血红素铁，约合 1.94 kg 炖瘦羊肩肉（每 100 g 总铁 2.7 mg，生瘦肉中 81% 为血红素铁；FDC 174331 与 PMID 26433293）。以 5% 的吸收率从非血红素食物吸收同样的 10.6 mg，需要 212 mg 非血红素铁，约合每天 6.4 kg 熟扁豆。已确诊的缺铁无法靠食物纠正，预防缺铁可以。

Food vs supplement食物与补充剂Three traps, and the first is narrower than usually stated. (1) The retinol hazard belongs to liver, not to offal as a class. Braised lamb liver carries 7,490 ug retinol activity equivalents per 100 g, which is 6,367 ug in an 85 g portion, and braised beef liver 9,440 ug RAE per 100 g (raw beef liver 4,970 ug RAE; FDC 172532, 168626, 169451). That is why liver is contraindicated in pregnancy in most national guidance. The hazard separates cleanly by organ: braised lamb kidney is 12.4 mg iron with 137 ug RAE (FDC 174355) and braised pork kidney 5.29 mg iron with 78 ug RAE (FDC 167860), so kidney beats every muscle-meat row on iron without the vitamin A problem. The earlier claim that the iron benefit and the vitamin A hazard travel together and cannot be separated is withdrawn. (2) Liver's iron is largely ferritin and haemosiderin iron, so its headline 8.28 mg is less absorbable than the haem fraction of plain muscle meat implies, and muscle meat with a smaller number can deliver more absorbed iron. (3) Supplement iron behaves unlike food iron: a 60 mg dose raises hepcidin and suppresses absorption of the next dose, which is why alternate-day dosing absorbed 21.8 percent against 16.3 percent on consecutive days (PMID 29032957). Food iron arriving in small amounts across the day never triggers that. On spinach, the correction runs both ways. Isotope work found that potassium oxalate added to a low-oxalate kale meal did not change non-haem iron absorption (11.5 percent against 10.7 percent, P=0.86), so the textbook oxalate explanation does not survive testing. But the spinach meal in the same study absorbed 24 percent less than the matched kale meal without reaching significance (P>0.16), and although the paper reports spinach as significantly higher in calcium and polyphenols it does not attribute the absorption difference to them. The honest reading is that spinach iron was numerically lower in a single small study, the oxalate mechanism is refuted, and no replacement mechanism is established. Either way a 30 g bowl of raw spinach leaves contains 0.81 mg of iron and yields a rounding error.三个陷阱，其中第一个的适用范围比通常所说的更窄。(1) 视黄醇危害属于肝脏，并不适用于内脏这一整类。炖羊肝每 100 g 含 7,490 ug 视黄醇活性当量，85 g 一份即 6,367 ug；炖牛肝每 100 g 含 9,440 ug RAE（生牛肝 4,970 ug RAE；FDC 172532、168626、169451）。这正是多数国家指南在孕期禁食肝脏的原因。危害按器官清晰分开：炖羊肾每 100 g 含铁 12.4 mg、视黄醇 137 ug RAE（FDC 174355），炖猪肾含铁 5.29 mg、78 ug RAE（FDC 167860），所以肾脏在含铁量上胜过表中所有肌肉肉类，同时没有维生素 A 问题。此前关于铁的益处与维生素 A 危害必然同行、无法分开的说法予以撤回。(2) 肝脏中的铁大部分是铁蛋白铁和血铁黄素铁，因此 8.28 mg 这个表面数值的可吸收性低于普通肌肉肉中血红素铁比例所暗示的水平，数字更小的肌肉肉反而能提供更多吸收铁。(3) 补充剂铁的行为与食物铁不同：60 mg 的剂量会升高铁调素并抑制下一次剂量的吸收，这就是隔日给药吸收 21.8%、而连续每日给药为 16.3% 的原因（PMID 29032957）。食物铁在一天之内小量陆续到达，从不触发这一机制。关于菠菜，纠正是双向的。同位素研究发现，向低草酸的羽衣甘蓝餐中加入草酸钾并未改变非血红素铁吸收（11.5% 对 10.7%，P=0.86），教科书式的草酸解释经不起检验。但同一研究中菠菜餐的吸收比配对的羽衣甘蓝餐低 24%，未达显著（P>0.16）；论文虽报告菠菜的钙和多酚显著更高，却没有把吸收差异归因于它们。诚实的解读是：在一项小样本研究中菠菜铁的吸收数值偏低，草酸机制已被否定，替代机制尚未确立。无论如何，一碗 30 g 生菠菜叶含铁 0.81 mg，得到的只是一个舍入误差。

Absorption吸收Haem iron is absorbed at roughly 15 to 35 percent and non-haem at 2 to 20 percent, with iron status the dominant variable. Across whole diets rather than single meals, bioavailability is 14 to 18 percent for mixed diets and 5 to 12 percent for vegetarian diets in people with no iron stores, and the authors note that iron status generally has a greater effect than diet composition (PMID 20200263). Vitamin C: the source concludes that about 50 mg of ascorbic acid in each main meal is desirable for optimum effect, with the most pronounced effects in meals high in inhibitory ligands such as phytates and tannins (PMID 3700141). The '25 mg' lower bound and the 'several-fold' multiplier claimed earlier are not in that source and have been dropped. When the same amount of ascorbic acid is given across a complete diet over days, the facilitating effect is far less pronounced (PMID 11124756): squeezing lemon on your lentils helps, and it does not turn plant iron into meat iron. Tea and coffee inhibition, with numbers: a cup of coffee cut non-haem absorption from a hamburger meal by 39 percent and tea by 64 percent; instant coffee at double strength drove absorption from 5.88 percent to 0.53 percent; coffee one hour before the meal did no harm, while coffee one hour after inhibited as much as coffee with the meal (PMID 6402915). Black tea inhibited non-haem absorption by 79 to 94 percent, peppermint tea by 84 percent, cocoa by 71 percent and chamomile by 47 percent, dose-dependently on total polyphenols, and adding milk made no difference (PMID 10999016). That is polyphenol inhibition; phytate is a separate inhibitor sitting inside the wholegrains and legumes themselves. Practical consequence: the highest-yield single change for someone with low iron stores is moving tea and coffee to between meals rather than with or after them.血红素铁的吸收率大约为 15% 至 35%，非血红素铁为 2% 至 20%，铁营养状况是主导变量。若看整体膳食而非单餐，无铁储备者混合膳食的生物利用度为 14% 至 18%，素食膳食为 5% 至 12%，作者指出铁营养状况的影响通常大于膳食组成（PMID 20200263）。维生素 C：该来源的结论是每一主餐中约 50 mg 抗坏血酸有利于取得最佳效果，在植酸、鞣质等抑制性配体含量高的餐食中效果最明显（PMID 3700141）。此前声称的 25 mg 下限和数倍增幅并不见于该来源，已删除。当同样剂量的抗坏血酸在数天内随完整膳食给予时，促进作用要弱得多（PMID 11124756）：在扁豆上挤点柠檬有帮助，但不会把植物铁变成肉类铁。茶与咖啡的抑制作用，附上数字：一杯咖啡使汉堡餐的非血红素铁吸收下降 39%，茶下降 64%；双倍浓度的速溶咖啡把吸收率从 5.88% 压到 0.53%；餐前 1 小时喝咖啡无害，餐后 1 小时喝咖啡的抑制程度与随餐喝相当（PMID 6402915）。红茶使非血红素铁吸收降低 79% 至 94%，薄荷茶 84%，可可 71%，洋甘菊 47%，抑制程度随总多酚量呈剂量依赖，加奶没有区别（PMID 10999016）。这是多酚的抑制作用；植酸是另一种抑制因素，本身就存在于全谷物和豆类之中。实际后果：对铁储备偏低的人，收益最高的单一改变是把茶和咖啡移到两餐之间，避免随餐或餐后饮用。

Food data note食物数据说明Every per-100 g figure carried over from the submission matched FoodData Central to the digit on independent retrieval, and all cited PMIDs and DOIs resolved to papers saying what they are cited as saying. Two lower-confidence spots are flagged in the rows themselves: the blood sausage entry is a US proxy whose UK equivalent could not be confirmed, and the eleven newly added rows use conventional portion sizes rather than USDA's own measure table, so their per-portion figures are derived rather than tabulated高。从原稿沿用的每一个每 100 g 数值在独立检索时都与 FoodData Central 逐位一致，所引用的全部 PMID 和 DOI 都能查到对应论文，内容与引用说法相符。两处置信度较低的地方已在相应行标出：血肠条目是美国替代数据，其英国对应值无法确认；新增的十一行使用常规份量而非 USDA 自己的计量表，因此其每份数值是推算的，并非表中列出的。

Does the body make it身体是否自产Iron is chemical element 26, and no enzyme can build an element out of anything else, so every iron atom in haemoglobin arrived in food, water or a pill. The body compensates by hoarding: macrophages strip iron from dying red cells and return roughly 20-25 mg/d to plasma, while only about 1-2 mg/d is absorbed to cover obligatory losses. Recycling only reuses atoms already present, so iron supplements are never redundant on this axis and stand or fall entirely on measured status and losses, with no regulated route for excreting the surplus.铁是26号化学元素，没有任何酶能用别的物质造出一种元素，所以血红蛋白里的每一个铁原子都来自食物、水或药片。身体靠囤积来弥补：巨噬细胞从衰老红细胞中回收铁，每天向血浆返还大约 20-25 mg/d，而每天只吸收约 1-2 mg/d 来抵偿必然损失。回收只是重复利用体内已有的原子，因此在合成这一维度上补铁永远不算多余，其成立与否完全取决于实测的铁状态和损失量，而人体没有受调控的铁排泄途径，多余的铁只会积存下来。

Pathway合成通路NOT APPLICABLE (chemical element, zero biosynthetic route). Downstream use only: haem is built in eight enzymatic steps split between two compartments, starting from glycine plus succinyl-CoA with ALAS2 in the erythroblast mitochondrion, continuing with ALAD, HMBS, UROS and UROD in the cytosol, then CPOX, PPOX and ferrochelatase (FECH) back in the mitochondrion, where the iron atom FECH inserts is entirely dietary. Absorption: duodenal cytochrome b (CYBRD1) reduces Fe3+, DMT1 (SLC11A2) carries Fe2+ into the enterocyte, and basolateral ferroportin (SLC40A1) exports it under hepcidin control, with ferritin as the store.NOT APPLICABLE（不适用：化学元素，没有任何生物合成途径）。只有下游利用：血红素由八步酶反应完成，分布在两个区室，起点是甘氨酸加琥珀酰辅酶A，第一步 ALAS2 位于成红细胞线粒体，随后 ALAD、HMBS、UROS、UROD 在胞质，再由 CPOX、PPOX 和亚铁螯合酶（FECH）回到线粒体，FECH 插入的那个铁原子完全来自膳食。肠腔侧吸收由十二指肠细胞色素 b（CYBRD1）把 Fe3+ 还原，DMT1（SLC11A2）把 Fe2+ 运进肠上皮细胞，基底侧由 ferroportin（SLC40A1）在 hepcidin 调控下外排，铁蛋白负责储存。

Amount made自产量0 mg/d synthesised. For scale, internal recycling returns about 20-25 mg Fe/d to plasma against obligatory losses of roughly 1-2 mg/d in adults; RDA 8 mg/d men, 18 mg/d premenopausal women.合成量 0 mg/d。作为量级参照：体内回收每天向血浆返还约 20-25 mg Fe/d，成人必然损失约 1-2 mg/d；RDA 男性 8 mg/d，绝经前女性 18 mg/d。

Still matters when仍有意义的情形NEVER ON THIS AXIS as a redundancy argument, since synthesis is zero. Justification comes from intake or loss instead: menstrual or gastrointestinal blood loss, pregnancy, frequent blood donation, infant and adolescent growth, high-phytate or plant-based diets, malabsorption or post-bariatric surgery, documented low ferritin or transferrin saturation. Not justified in iron-replete adults, where surplus iron is stored and cannot be excreted.NEVER ON THIS AXIS（在这一维度上永不成立）：合成为零，冗余论证无从谈起。理由只能来自摄入或损失：月经或胃肠道失血、妊娠、频繁献血、婴幼儿与青春期生长、高植酸或纯植物膳食、吸收不良或减重手术后、已记录的低铁蛋白或低转铁蛋白饱和度。铁储备充足的成人没有理由补，多出来的铁会被储存起来，排不出去。

Synthesis source合成来源Ganz T. Systemic iron homeostasis. Physiol Rev. 2013;93(4):1721-41. PMID 24137020, DOI 10.1152/physrev.00008.2013 (eight-enzyme haem pathway with mitochondrial and cytosolic steps, hepcidin and ferroportin control); IOM, Dietary Reference Intakes for Vitamin A, Vitamin K, Arsenic, Boron, Chromium, Copper, Iodine, Iron, Manganese, Molybdenum, Nickel, Silicon, Vanadium and Zinc (RDA 8 and 18 mg/d).
