Refs.文献 Cochrane 2024; Stoffel PMID 29032957; von Siebenthal PMID 38021373; Verdon BMJ 2003
TTAAFFDDBBXXIodine碘
Verdict结论Take it值得吃
Evidence证据Grade AA 级
Dose tested已验证剂量150 µg/d as potassium iodide. 250 µg/d in pregnancy and lactation (WHO).碘化钾形式 150 微克/天。妊娠期与哺乳期 250 微克/天（WHO）。
Who适用人群Preconception, pregnancy and lactation, vegans, and anyone avoiding both dairy and fish.备孕、孕期与哺乳期、纯素者，以及同时回避乳制品和鱼类的人。
Pros优点
  • Universal salt iodisation is the single most successful micronutrient intervention in public health, and it works because iodine is the sole substrate for thyroid hormone.全民食盐加碘是公共卫生史上最成功的微量营养素干预，它之所以有效，是因为碘是甲状腺激素唯一的合成原料。
  • The deficiency has quietly returned in the UK and parts of Europe. UK schoolgirls had a median urinary iodine of 80.1 µg/L against a WHO adequacy threshold of 100, with 51% mildly deficient.这种缺乏在英国和欧洲部分地区已悄然回潮。英国女学生尿碘中位数为 80.1 微克/升，而 WHO 的充足阈值是 100，其中 51% 属轻度缺乏。
  • The requirement rises about 50% in pregnancy, and the window for fetal brain development does not reopen.妊娠期需求上升约 50%，而胎儿脑发育的窗口一旦错过就不再打开。
Cons缺点
  • Correcting status during pregnancy may be too late. MITCH randomised 832 mildly deficient pregnant women to 200 µg/d and found a verbal IQ difference of -0.7 in their children at age 5-6. Fix it before conception.在孕期才纠正可能已经太晚。MITCH 试验把 832 名轻度缺碘孕妇随机分到 200 微克/天，其子女在 5 至 6 岁时言语智商差异为 -0.7。要在受孕前解决。
  • Avoid kelp and bladderwrack entirely. Content is wildly variable and can deliver many times the upper limit in a single dose.完全避开海带和墨角藻。其含量极不稳定，单次剂量就可能达到上限的许多倍。
  • An iodine load can precipitate iodine-induced hyperthyroidism in autonomous thyroid nodules or multinodular goitre, and can cause hypothyroidism in autoimmune thyroid disease. Anyone with a thyroid history needs medical advice first.在自主功能性甲状腺结节或多结节性甲状腺肿中，碘负荷可诱发碘致甲亢；在自身免疫性甲状腺病中则可能导致甲减。有甲状腺病史者必须先咨询医生。
  • Upper limit 1,100 µg/d (US) but only 600 µg/d (EFSA).美国上限 1100 微克/天，而 EFSA 只有 600 微克/天。
What it does, and what happens without it它有什么作用，缺了会怎样

The raw material for thyroid hormone, which sets metabolic rate and builds the fetal brain.甲状腺激素的原料,决定代谢率并构建胎儿大脑。

Named deficiency disease有明确的缺乏症 Permanent damage损害不可逆

In detail详细Iodine has exactly one job: it is the substrate thyroid peroxidase attaches to tyrosine residues on thyroglobulin to make thyroxine (T4) and triiodothyronine (T3). There is no alternative pathway and no substitute element. T3 acting on nuclear thyroid hormone receptors drives basal metabolic rate and thermogenesis in adults. In the fetus it governs neuronal migration, dendritic branching, synaptogenesis and myelination, on a fixed developmental timetable. The fetal thyroid does not begin producing hormone until roughly week 12 to 16, so first-trimester brain development runs entirely on maternal T4 crossing the placenta. Maternal requirement rises to about 250 micrograms per day in pregnancy and lactation.碘只有一项功能:作为thyroid peroxidase(甲状腺过氧化物酶)连接到甲状腺球蛋白酪氨酸残基上的底物,用以合成甲状腺素(T4)和三碘甲状腺原氨酸(T3)。没有替代通路,也没有可替代的元素。T3作用于核甲状腺激素受体,驱动成人的基础代谢率和产热。在胎儿体内,碘按固定的发育时间表调控神经元迁移、树突分支、突触形成和髓鞘化。胎儿甲状腺大约要到第12至16周才开始分泌激素,因此妊娠早期的大脑发育完全依赖经胎盘进入的母体T4。孕期和哺乳期母体需求量升至每日约250微克。

Deficiency disease缺乏症Iodine deficiency disorders: endemic goitre and hypothyroidism in adults, and endemic cretinism as the severe congenital form.碘缺乏病:成人表现为地方性甲状腺肿和甲状腺功能减退,严重的先天型为地方性克汀病。

First signs早期表现The thyroid enlarges (goitre) as TSH rises to extract more iodine from a falling supply. On testing, a population median urinary iodine concentration below 100 micrograms/L (below 150 in pregnancy) and a raised serum thyroglobulin signal inadequacy before any clinical change. A pregnant woman with mild to moderate deficiency usually notices nothing at all, which is what makes this dangerous.随着促甲状腺激素(TSH)升高以从减少的供应中提取更多碘,甲状腺会增大(甲状腺肿)。在检测层面,人群尿碘浓度中位数低于100微克/升(孕期低于150)以及血清甲状腺球蛋白升高,会在出现任何临床变化之前就提示碘摄入不足。轻中度缺碘的孕妇通常毫无察觉,这正是其危险所在。

Untreated不治疗会怎样Endemic cretinism: severe intellectual disability, deaf-mutism, spastic diplegia and stunted growth in a child whose mother was severely deficient during pregnancy. Adults develop overt hypothyroidism with cold intolerance, weight gain, bradycardia and, in extreme untreated cases, myxoedema. Even mild to moderate maternal deficiency is associated with lower verbal IQ and reading scores in the child, on the order of a few points, which is small individually and large across a population.地方性克汀病:母亲孕期严重缺碘的孩子会出现重度智力障碍、聋哑、痉挛性双侧瘫和生长迟缓。成人则出现明显的甲状腺功能减退,表现为怕冷、体重增加、心动过缓,极端未治疗病例可出现黏液性水肿。即使母体只是轻中度缺碘,孩子的言语智商和阅读成绩也会降低,幅度为几分,个体层面看幅度不大,但放到人群层面影响显著。

Does it reverse补回来能修复吗Goitre, adult hypothyroidism and impaired thyroid function correct with iodine repletion. Brain damage sustained in utero and in the first two years of life does not. The window is narrower than the whole pregnancy but far wider than the moment a pregnancy is confirmed: in Cao's trial, iodine given in the first or second trimester left 2% of infants with moderate or severe neurologic abnormality, against 9% when it was given in the third trimester or after birth, so treatment up to the end of the second trimester still protects the fetal brain. Beyond that window iodine given to an affected child undoes nothing; only iodine reaching the mother in time prevents the damage. The practical reading is to start immediately, not to conclude it is too late. This is the strongest irreversibility case among common micronutrients, and the reason salt iodisation is a public health programme rather than an individual choice.甲状腺肿、成人甲状腺功能减退及甲状腺功能受损,在补碘后可以纠正。子宫内及出生后头两年内造成的脑损伤则不能。这个窗口期比整个孕期窄,但远比确认怀孕的那一刻宽:在Cao的试验中,妊娠早期或中期补碘的婴儿中有2%出现中度或重度神经系统异常,而妊娠晚期或出生后才补碘的比例为9%,说明在妊娠中期结束前进行治疗仍能保护胎儿大脑。超过这一窗口期后,给患儿补碘无法逆转已造成的损害,只有及时让碘到达母体才能预防损害。实际的启示是应立即开始补碘,而不是认为为时已晚。这是常见微量营养素中不可逆性证据最强的一例,也是食盐加碘作为公共卫生项目而非个人选择的原因。

Who becomes deficient谁会缺乏Pregnant and lactating women anywhere, since requirements rise sharply. Populations in iodine-poor soil regions (mountainous and flood-plain areas) without salt iodisation. People who avoid iodised salt while also avoiding dairy, eggs and seafood, including strict vegans without a deliberate iodine source. Users of non-iodised speciality salts (pink, sea, kosher), which supply essentially no iodine.任何地方的孕妇和哺乳期女性,因为需求量急剧上升。土壤缺碘地区(山区和洪泛平原地区)且未实行食盐加碘的人群。既不使用加碘盐、又同时不摄入乳制品、鸡蛋和海鲜的人,包括未刻意补充碘来源的严格素食者。使用非加碘特种盐(粉盐、海盐、犹太盐)的人,这类盐基本不含碘。

How common有多常见21 countries still had insufficient population iodine intake as of 2020-2021, down from 113 in 1993, thanks to salt iodisation (IGN Global Scorecard of Iodine Nutrition). Mild to moderate deficiency in pregnant women persists in countries whose general populations are replete, including the UK, Norway and Australia. Iodine deficiency remains the leading preventable cause of intellectual disability worldwide.截至2020至2021年,仍有21个国家人群碘摄入不足,得益于食盐加碘,这一数字已从1993年的113个下降(IGN全球碘营养记分卡)。在英国、挪威、澳大利亚等一般人群碘充足的国家,孕妇轻中度缺碘依然存在。碘缺乏仍是全球可预防性智力障碍的首要病因。

Source来源Cao XY et al., N Engl J Med 1994;331:1739-1744, doi:10.1056/NEJM199412293312603, PMID 7984194 (timing of iodine treatment in pregnancy and neurologic outcome in the child); Hetzel BS, 'Iodine deficiency and fetal brain damage', N Engl J Med 1994;331:1770-1771, doi:10.1056/NEJM199412293312610, PMID 7984200 (accompanying editorial); Bath SC et al., Lancet 2013;382:331-337 (mild maternal deficiency and child IQ, ALSPAC); Iodine Global Network, Global Scorecard of Iodine Nutrition, ign.org/scorecard; Zimmermann MB, Lancet 2008;372:1251-1262.

Food and the body食物与身体
In food: Rich食物中：丰富 Dose from food: Reachable靠吃达到剂量：可达到 Body makes it: Cannot身体自产：不能 Food data: High食物数据：高

Iodine occurs in ordinary food, and the answer rests on a narrow set of foods: dairy, white fish, eggs, shellfish and, where a country iodises it, table salt. Nothing else contributes meaningfully. The RICH classification carries a jurisdictional qualifier: for a UK reader it rests on dairy, white fish and eggs alone, because the UK has no salt iodisation programme, so the US iodised salt row below is not transferable and is marked as such. Iodine in milk is not intrinsic to the cow, it arrives from fortified cattle feed and iodophor teat disinfectants, which is why it is seasonal (higher in winter housing) and why organic milk is lower. Reference point used in the table: EFSA AI 150 ug/d for adults, 200 ug/d in pregnancy and lactation (EFSA, Dietary Reference Values for nutrients Summary report, approved 4 December 2017, doi 10.2903/sp.efsa.2017.e15121, Tables 5 and 7; underlying opinion EFSA Journal 2014;12(5):3660).碘存在于普通食物中，答案落在一小组食物上：乳制品、白肉鱼、蛋、贝类，以及在实行食盐加碘的国家里的食用盐。其他食物的贡献都不明显。RICH（丰富）这一分类带有辖区限定：对英国读者而言，它只依靠乳制品、白肉鱼和蛋，因为英国没有食盐加碘计划，所以下表中的美国加碘盐一行不可套用，并已如此标注。牛奶中的碘来自强化饲料和碘伏乳头消毒剂，并非奶牛自身产生，这也是它随季节波动（冬季圈养期更高）以及有机牛奶含量更低的原因。表中使用的参考值：EFSA AI 成人 150 ug/d，孕期和哺乳期 200 ug/d（EFSA，Dietary Reference Values for nutrients Summary report，2017 年 12 月 4 日通过，doi 10.2903/sp.efsa.2017.e15121，表 5 和表 7；基础意见书 EFSA Journal 2014;12(5):3660）。

To match the dose要达到该剂量There is essentially no gap. A standard iodine supplement or prenatal multivitamin supplies 150 ug, exactly the EFSA adult AI. A single 120 g UK haddock fillet delivers 390 ug, two and a half times the dose. One 115 g cod fillet delivers 131 ug. About 400 ml of milk delivers roughly 156 ug at milk density (412 g); the 151 ug figure quoted previously is what 1.6 USDA cups (398 g) gives, and the two should not be equated. Six large eggs deliver 147 ug. Half a teaspoon of iodised salt (3 g) delivers 152 ug where salt is iodised. Iodine belongs in the small category of supplements a normal eater does not need. The gap opens the moment those specific foods leave the diet, and the UK numbers are stark. Substituting three dairy portions a day (milk, yoghurt, cheese) with plant alternatives cuts the iodine those portions supply from 124 ug to 2.6 ug, a 97.9 percent loss, taking the contribution to the 150 ug recommendation from 83 percent down to 1.8 percent (PMID 35373723). The same market survey identified 146 milk alternatives and 76 yoghurt alternatives, excluded 48 organic products, and found 29 milk alternatives and 4 yoghurt alternatives iodine-fortified; that is 28 percent and 6 percent of the non-organic subset, or 19.9 percent and 5.3 percent of all products identified. The 28 and 6 percent figures quoted earlier against the full denominators were wrong. Against those, 88 percent and 73 percent were fortified with calcium; no cheese alternative and no fish alternative was iodine-fortified; and organic plant alternatives cannot legally be fortified. This shows up in real people: in NDNS years 7 to 9, adults and children consuming milk alternatives exclusively had an iodine intake of 94 ug/d against 129 ug/d for cows' milk consumers, and a median urinary iodine concentration of 79 ug/l against 132 ug/l, which classifies the milk-alternative group as iodine deficient by the WHO criterion while the milk drinkers were sufficient (PMID 32993817). Unfortified milk-alternative concentrations were a median 7.3 ug/kg, 1.7 percent of winter conventional cows' milk; the three fortified products found in 2015 sat at 266 to 287 ug/kg (PMID 28946925).基本上没有缺口。标准的碘补充剂或孕期复合维生素提供 150 ug，正好等于 EFSA 成人 AI。单块 120 g 的英国黑线鳕鱼柳提供 390 ug，是该剂量的两倍半。一块 115 g 鳕鱼柳提供 131 ug。约 400 ml 牛奶按牛奶密度（412 g）计算提供约 156 ug；此前引用的 151 ug 是 1.6 个 USDA 杯（398 g）的量，两者不应等同。六个大号鸡蛋提供 147 ug。在实行加碘的地区，半茶匙加碘盐（3 g）提供 152 ug。碘属于正常饮食者不需要补充的那一小类。一旦这些特定食物离开饮食，缺口立刻出现，英国的数据很直白。把一天三份乳制品（牛奶、酸奶、奶酪）换成植物替代品，这些份量提供的碘从 124 ug 降到 2.6 ug，损失 97.9%，对 150 ug 推荐量的贡献从 83% 降到 1.8%（PMID 35373723）。同一项市场调查识别出 146 种牛奶替代品和 76 种酸奶替代品，排除了 48 种有机产品，发现 29 种牛奶替代品和 4 种酸奶替代品做了碘强化；这相当于非有机子集的 28% 和 6%，或全部已识别产品的 19.9% 和 5.3%。此前按全部分母引用的 28% 和 6% 是错的。相比之下，88% 和 73% 做了钙强化；没有任何奶酪替代品和鱼类替代品做碘强化；有机植物替代品在法律上不能强化。这在真实人群中有体现：在 NDNS 第 7 至 9 年，只饮用植物奶的成人和儿童碘摄入量为 94 ug/d，饮用牛奶者为 129 ug/d，尿碘浓度中位数分别为 79 ug/l 和 132 ug/l，按 WHO 标准前一组属于碘缺乏，而牛奶饮用者充足（PMID 32993817）。未强化植物饮品的碘浓度中位数为 7.3 ug/kg，只有冬季常规牛奶的 1.7%；2015 年发现的三种强化产品在 266 至 287 ug/kg 之间（PMID 28946925）。

Food vs supplement食物与补充剂Kelp is the dangerous answer, and the danger is dosing variability rather than iodine itself. Across 12 species of commercially sold edible seaweed, iodine ranged from 16 ug/g in nori to over 8,165 ug/g in processed kelp granules from Laminaria digitata sold as a salt substitute, a 510-fold spread, and within a single species it varied with preharvest conditions (514 ug/g in sun-bleached blades, 6,571 ug/g in fresh juvenile blades) (PMID 15588380). One gram of those granules is 54 times the adult AI. A 2021 survey of 96 commercial macroalgae products found 128 to 62,400 ug of iodine per portion in wholefood kelp products and 5 to 5,600 ug per supplement dose, that for 54 of the 96 products a single serving or dose would exceed the tolerable upper intake level, and that species labelling and declared iodine content were frequently inadequate or inaccurate (PMID 33889064). A kelp tablet is therefore an unlabelled dose of a potent thyroid-active substance, and excess iodine causes both hypothyroidism and hyperthyroidism. If iodine is the goal, potassium iodide at a known 150 ug, or milk, fish and eggs, are the correct answers and kelp is not. Second, milk: iodine there comes from feed and dairy hygiene, so it moves with farming practice. Organic milk was 42.1 percent lower in iodine than conventional in a 172-sample UK retail survey (median 144.5 against 249.5 ng/g; PMID 21781365), and winter milk runs higher than summer. Someone switching to organic milk has quietly cut their main iodine source by nearly half without changing anything visible. Third, iodised salt: the USDA entry in the table is a US product, the UK has no iodisation programme, and that is precisely why the Bath group repeatedly identify milk, dairy and fish as the main UK iodine sources. Fourth, the plant drinks in the table are fortified products, with calcium and vitamin A, that skip iodine. That is the mechanism behind the 97.9 percent substitution loss rather than an absence of fortification technology.海带是那个危险的答案，危险之处在于剂量的不可预期，碘本身并非问题。在 12 种商售可食海藻中，碘含量从海苔的 16 ug/g 到作为盐替代品出售的指状海带（Laminaria digitata）加工海带颗粒的 8,165 ug/g 以上，相差 510 倍；同一物种内部也随采收前条件而变（日晒漂白的叶片 514 ug/g，新鲜幼叶 6,571 ug/g）（PMID 15588380）。一克这种颗粒相当于成人 AI 的 54 倍。2021 年对 96 种商售大型藻类产品的调查发现，整食型海带产品每份含碘 128 至 62,400 ug，补充剂每次剂量 5 至 5,600 ug；96 种产品中有 54 种，一次食用或一次剂量就会超过可耐受最高摄入量；物种标注和申报的碘含量常常不充分或不准确（PMID 33889064）。因此一片海带片剂就是一剂未标明用量的强效甲状腺活性物质，而碘过量既可导致甲减也可导致甲亢。若目标是补碘，正确答案是剂量已知为 150 ug 的碘化钾，或牛奶、鱼和蛋，海带不在其中。其次是牛奶：其中的碘来自饲料和乳品卫生措施，因此会随养殖方式变化。在一项 172 份英国零售样品的调查中，有机牛奶的碘含量比常规牛奶低 42.1%（中位数 144.5 对 249.5 ng/g；PMID 21781365），冬季牛奶高于夏季。换成有机牛奶的人，在没有任何可见改变的情况下已经把主要碘来源砍掉近一半。第三是加碘盐：表中的 USDA 条目是美国产品，英国没有加碘计划，这正是 Bath 研究组反复把牛奶、乳制品和鱼列为英国主要碘来源的原因。第四，表中的植物饮品是强化产品，强化了钙和维生素 A，却跳过了碘。这就是 97.9% 替代损失背后的机制，问题并不在于缺少强化技术。

Absorption吸收Iodine bioavailability is the simple case. Iodide from milk, iodised salt and potassium iodide supplements is almost completely absorbed, and urinary iodine excretion is used directly as the intake biomarker on the standard assumption that about 90 percent of ingested iodine is excreted in urine (PMID 25274294). There is no meaningful absorption advantage to any form and no matrix effect worth chasing: 150 ug from a fillet of cod, a pot of yoghurt or a tablet are close to interchangeable systemically. The one real form difference sits at the top end. Organically bound iodine in seaweed is released variably during digestion and cooking, and boiling kelp leaches a large fraction of its iodine into the water, so a seaweed dose is uncertain in both directions. Two further practical points: iodine and selenium interact, because the deiodinase enzymes that convert thyroxine to the active hormone are selenoproteins, so iodine repletion in a selenium-poor person behaves differently; and goitrogens in raw brassicas and cassava compete with iodide uptake, which matters only when iodine intake is already marginal.碘的生物利用度属于简单情形。来自牛奶、加碘盐和碘化钾补充剂的碘化物几乎完全被吸收，尿碘排出量被直接用作摄入量的生物标志物，其标准假设是摄入碘约 90% 经尿排出（PMID 25274294）。任何形式都没有值得追求的吸收优势，也没有值得计较的基质效应：来自一块鳕鱼柳、一小杯酸奶或一片药片的 150 ug，在体内几乎可以互换。唯一真实的形式差异出现在高端。海藻中有机结合的碘在消化和烹调过程中的释放量不稳定，煮海带会把其中很大一部分碘浸出到水里，因此海藻的剂量在两个方向上都不确定。另有两个实用要点：碘和硒相互作用，因为把甲状腺素转化为活性激素的脱碘酶属于硒蛋白，所以硒不足的人补碘的表现会不同；生十字花科蔬菜和木薯中的致甲状腺肿物质会与碘化物摄取竞争，这只在碘摄入本已处于边缘水平时才重要。

Food data note食物数据说明for the core of the item. All USDA figures matched FoodData Central to the digit, and the Bath-group and Nicol PMIDs were confirmed verbatim including the 97.9 percent loss, the 94 against 129 ug/d NDNS intakes, the 79 against 132 ug/l urinary concentrations, the 438 and 324 ug/kg milk medians and the 42.1 percent organic deficit. Two rows are weaker and marked in place: the haddock and scampi figures come from a compiled UK secondary table (BDA Iodine Food Fact Sheet) rather than a primary analysis, so they are indicative高，就该条目的核心而言。所有 USDA 数值与 FoodData Central 逐位一致，Bath 研究组和 Nicol 的 PMID 均经逐字核实，包括 97.9% 的损失、NDNS 中 94 对 129 ug/d 的摄入量、79 对 132 ug/l 的尿碘浓度、438 和 324 ug/kg 的牛奶中位数以及 42.1% 的有机牛奶差距。两行较弱并已就地标注：黑线鳕和挪威海螯虾的数值来自一份英国二次汇编表（BDA Iodine Food Fact Sheet），而非一手分析，只作参考。

Does the body make it身体是否自产Iodine is chemical element 53, so there is no synthetic route to it and thyroid hormone output falls when dietary supply stops. What the body does make is the hormone itself: thyroid peroxidase attaches dietary iodide to tyrosine residues on thyroglobulin to build T4 and T3, and deiodinases salvage iodide when hormone is degraded. The enzymatic machinery is endogenous while every iodine atom is dietary, so iodine supplementation is genuinely useful wherever intake is low and pointless once intake is adequate.碘是53号化学元素，不存在合成途径，膳食供应中断时甲状腺激素产量就会下降。身体自己造的是激素本身：甲状腺过氧化物酶把膳食碘化物接到甲状腺球蛋白的酪氨酸残基上，组装成 T4 和 T3，激素降解时脱碘酶再把碘化物回收。酶系统是内源的，而每个碘原子都来自膳食，所以在摄入不足的地方补碘确实有用，摄入充足之后补碘毫无意义。

Pathway合成通路NOT APPLICABLE (chemical element). Downstream use only: the sodium-iodide symporter NIS (SLC5A5) traps iodide at the basolateral membrane of thyroid follicular cells, pendrin (SLC26A4) moves it across the apical membrane, DUOX2 with its maturation factor DUOXA2 supplies the H2O2 that thyroid peroxidase needs, and TPO iodinates thyroglobulin tyrosines in the follicular lumen. Salvage runs at two levels: iodotyrosine dehalogenase (IYD, also called DEHAL1) recovers iodide from MIT and DIT inside the follicular cell, while peripherally DIO1 is the main iodide-recycling deiodinase and DIO2 is the hormone-activating one.NOT APPLICABLE（不适用：化学元素）。只有下游利用：钠碘同向转运体 NIS（SLC5A5）在甲状腺滤泡细胞基底侧摄取碘化物，pendrin（SLC26A4）把它送过顶端膜，DUOX2 与其成熟因子 DUOXA2 提供甲状腺过氧化物酶所需的 H2O2，TPO 在滤泡腔内把甲状腺球蛋白的酪氨酸碘化。回收分两个层次：滤泡细胞内由碘酪氨酸脱卤酶（IYD，又称 DEHAL1）把 MIT 和 DIT 上的碘化物取回再用；外周则以 DIO1 为主要的碘回收脱碘酶，DIO2 是激素活化酶。

Amount made自产量0 µg/d synthesised. Reference points: thyroid iodine stores 15-20 mg in an iodine-sufficient adult; RDA 150 µg/d adults, 220 µg/d in pregnancy and 290 µg/d in lactation (IOM); WHO, UNICEF and ICCIDD recommend 250 µg/d in pregnancy and lactation; adult UL 1100 µg/d (IOM).合成量 0 µg/d。参照点：碘充足成人的甲状腺碘储量 15-20 mg；RDA 成人 150 µg/d，妊娠 220 µg/d，哺乳 290 µg/d（IOM）；WHO、UNICEF 和 ICCIDD 建议妊娠与哺乳期均为 250 µg/d；成人 UL 1100 µg/d（IOM）。

Still matters when仍有意义的情形NEVER ON THIS AXIS. Justification is intake-based: pregnancy and lactation, diets excluding iodised salt, dairy and seafood (including many vegan diets), regions of endemic deficiency and goitre. Excess is actively harmful rather than merely wasteful, since high intakes can precipitate hypothyroidism or thyrotoxicosis (adult UL 1100 µg/d, IOM).NEVER ON THIS AXIS（在这一维度上永不成立）。理由只能基于摄入：妊娠与哺乳、不含碘盐、乳制品和海产的膳食（包括许多纯素膳食）、地方性缺碘和地方性甲状腺肿地区。过量不只是浪费，还会直接造成伤害，高摄入可诱发甲状腺功能减退或甲状腺毒症（成人 UL 1100 µg/d，IOM）。

Synthesis source合成来源Zimmermann MB. Iodine deficiency. Endocr Rev. 2009;30(4):376-408. PMID 19460960, DOI 10.1210/er.2009-0011. DRI values (RDA 150, 220 and 290 µg/d; UL 1100 µg/d) from IOM; WHO, UNICEF and ICCIDD pregnancy and lactation figure 250 µg/d. Mapped from the recovered entry Iodine.

TTAAFFDDBBXXCreatine monohydrate一水肌酸
Verdict结论Take it值得吃
Evidence证据Grade AA 级
Dose tested已验证剂量3-5 g/d. Loading is optional: 20 g/d for 6 days and 3 g/d for 28 days reach the same muscle saturation.3 至 5 克/天。冲击期可有可无：20 克/天服 6 天与 3 克/天服 28 天，肌肉饱和程度相同。
Who适用人群Anyone doing resistance training, and older adults in particular. Also vegetarians and vegans, whose baseline stores are lower.任何做抗阻训练的人，尤其是老年人。此外还有素食者和纯素者，他们的基础储备更低。
Pros优点
  • The best-evidenced ergogenic aid on the market. In older adults doing resistance training, +1.37 kg lean tissue mass (95% CI 0.97-1.76) over training alone, across 22 randomised trials.市面上证据最扎实的运动增效补剂。在做抗阻训练的老年人中，比单纯训练多增加 1.37 公斤瘦体重（95% CI 0.97-1.76），来自 22 项随机试验。
  • Extremely cheap. Monohydrate costs pennies per dose and is the form used in essentially every trial.极其便宜。一水肌酸每次的成本只有几便士，而且几乎所有试验用的都是这个形式。
  • Long safety record: no signal of harm in healthy kidneys across years of use in trials.安全记录长：在肾功能正常者中，多年的试验使用未见危害信号。
Cons缺点
  • The cognition claim is weaker than the marketing. Pooled memory effect SMD 0.31 (0.18-0.44), and EFSA formally concluded in 2024 that a cause-and-effect relationship with cognitive function has NOT been established.认知方面的说法远弱于营销。记忆的合并效应 SMD 0.31（0.18-0.44），而 EFSA 在 2024 年正式认定，与认知功能的因果关系尚未成立。
  • Do not pay for HCl, buffered, liquid or micronised premium forms. They are price increases with no comparative evidence behind them.不要为盐酸盐、缓冲型、液态或“微粒化”高端形式付钱。它们只是涨价，背后没有对照证据。
  • Existing chronic kidney disease or dialysis requires nephrology supervision, because the safety data are in healthy kidneys only.已有慢性肾病或在透析者需在肾科监督下使用，因为安全数据只来自肾功能正常的人。
  • Expect 1-2 kg of water weight in the first weeks. That is intracellular water, not fat, but it matters if you compete in a weight class.头几周会增加 1 至 2 公斤水重。那是细胞内水分而非脂肪，但如果你参加分级别的比赛，这一点很要紧。
  • No official upper limit exists. The commonly quoted safety envelope comes from an industry-affiliated position stand, and the actual sentence is absence of evidence of harm rather than demonstrated safety.没有官方上限。常被引用的安全区间来自一份与行业有关联的立场声明，而其原话是“没有证据显示有害”，而不是“已证明安全”。
What it does, and what happens without it它有什么作用，缺了会怎样

Recycles ATP inside muscle and brain cells, buffering energy during short bursts of intense effort.在肌肉和脑细胞内循环再生ATP,在短时间高强度用力时缓冲能量供应。

No deficiency state exists不存在缺乏状态

In detail详细Creatine is phosphorylated by creatine kinase to phosphocreatine, a rapid-turnover phosphate reservoir that regenerates ATP from ADP during high-intensity contraction and in neurons. Roughly half of the daily turnover (about 1 to 3 g) is synthesized endogenously from arginine, glycine and methionine by AGAT and GAMT in liver, kidney and pancreas; the remainder comes from meat and fish. There is no dietary requirement. Vegetarians carry intramuscular creatine roughly 10 to 15 percent below omnivores and remain healthy, they simply respond more strongly to supplementation. That range comes from two different designs: Blancquaert et al. 2018 is an intervention trial in 40 omnivorous women in which vastus lateralis total creatine fell 15 percent over 3 months in the vegetarian-plus-placebo arm (against +9.7 percent vegetarian-plus-creatine and +6.8 percent omnivorous control), while cross-sectional comparisons of habitual vegetarians report a smaller gap of around 10 percent. Separately from anything to do with intake, three inborn errors of metabolism produce the cerebral creatine deficiency syndromes: GAMT deficiency, AGAT deficiency and X-linked creatine transporter (SLC6A8) deficiency. These are genetic defects of synthesis or transport, not consequences of eating too little creatine, and no dietary pattern produces them. Onset is in infancy or early childhood with global developmental delay, expressive speech delay out of proportion to other skills and hypotonia, plus early epilepsy and a movement disorder in GAMT deficiency; brain magnetic resonance spectroscopy showing an absent or near-absent creatine peak is the diagnostic finding. Untreated GAMT deficiency causes intractable seizures, autistic features, extrapyramidal movement disorder and severe intellectual disability, with accumulated guanidinoacetate contributing to the neurotoxicity, and creatine transporter deficiency causes lifelong moderate to severe intellectual disability and seizures in affected males. AGAT and GAMT deficiency respond to oral creatine (with arginine restriction and ornithine in GAMT), and 7 of 8 infants treated before 6 months of age had normal developmental outcomes, which is what makes early detection decisive; creatine transporter deficiency does not respond to oral creatine at all, because the transporter that would carry it into the brain is the broken protein. On frequency, GeneReviews gives an estimated GAMT incidence of 1:2,640,000 to 1:250,000; prospective newborn screening in Utah and New York found 1:405,655; a single-centre referral series of 5 patients seen between 2001 and 2011 produced a much higher outlier estimate of 1:114,000. Creatine transporter deficiency is reported in 0.4 to 1.4 percent of cohorts of males with intellectual disability, and separately in 2.64 percent of a more recent cohort of individuals with neurodevelopmental disorders that was neither male-restricted nor restricted to intellectual disability of unknown cause.肌酸经肌酸激酶磷酸化生成磷酸肌酸,这是一个周转迅速的磷酸储库,在高强度收缩期间及神经元中由ADP再生ATP。每日周转量中约一半(约1至3 g)由AGAT和GAMT在肝、肾和胰腺中以精氨酸、甘氨酸和蛋氨酸为原料内源合成;其余来自肉类和鱼类。没有膳食摄入需求。素食者肌内肌酸含量比杂食者低约10%至15%,但仍然健康,只是对补充的反应更强。这一范围来自两种不同的研究设计:Blancquaert等2018年的研究是在40名杂食女性中进行的干预试验,其中素食加安慰剂组的股外侧肌总肌酸在3个月内下降15%(相比之下,素食加肌酸组升高9.7%,杂食对照组升高6.8%);而对习惯性素食者的横断面比较报告的差距较小,约为10%。与摄入量无关的是,三种先天性代谢缺陷会导致脑肌酸缺乏综合征:GAMT缺乏症、AGAT缺乏症和X连锁肌酸转运体(SLC6A8)缺乏症。这些是合成或转运的基因缺陷,并非肌酸摄入不足的后果,任何膳食模式都不会导致它们。起病于婴儿期或幼儿早期,表现为全面发育迟缓、与其他能力不成比例的表达性言语迟缓和肌张力低下,GAMT缺乏症还伴有早发性癫痫和运动障碍;脑磁共振波谱显示肌酸峰缺失或接近缺失是诊断依据。未经治疗的GAMT缺乏症会导致顽固性癫痫发作、孤独症样特征、锥体外系运动障碍和重度智力障碍,胍基乙酸的蓄积也促成了神经毒性;肌酸转运体缺乏症则导致患病男性终身中至重度智力障碍和癫痫发作。AGAT和GAMT缺乏症对口服肌酸有反应(GAMT缺乏症需同时限制精氨酸并补充鸟氨酸),6月龄前接受治疗的8名婴儿中有7名发育结局正常,这正是早期检测具有决定性意义的原因;肌酸转运体缺乏症则对口服肌酸完全无反应,因为将肌酸转运入脑的转运蛋白本身就是受损蛋白。在发病率方面,GeneReviews给出的GAMT估计发病率为1:2,640,000至1:250,000;犹他州和纽约州的前瞻性新生儿筛查发现发病率为1:405,655;一项2001至2011年间收治5名患者的单中心转诊病例系列得出了高得多的离群估计值1:114,000。肌酸转运体缺乏症在智力障碍男性队列中的报告比例为0.4%至1.4%,而在另一项更近期、既不限于男性也不限于病因不明智力障碍的神经发育障碍个体队列中,比例为2.64%。

There is no deficiency state for this. It is not an essential nutrient, so being short of it is not a thing that can happen.它不存在缺乏状态。它不是必需营养素，所以“缺了它”这件事本身并不成立。

Source来源GeneReviews, Creatine Deficiency Disorders, NCBI Bookshelf NBK3794; PMID 29569535 (Blancquaert et al., Br J Nutr 2018;119(7):759-770, 3-month vegetarian diet intervention in 40 omnivorous women); Burke et al., Med Sci Sports Exerc 2003 (cross-sectional vegetarian versus omnivore muscle creatine); Pediatrics 2023;152(2):e2023062100, PMID 37465909 (newborn screening evidence review)

Food and the body食物与身体
In food: Rich食物中：丰富 Dose from food: Out of reach靠吃达到剂量：达不到 Body makes it: Partly身体自产：部分自产 Food data: Medium食物数据：中

Creatine is a genuine dietary constituent, confined to the skeletal muscle of animals: Harris 1997 measured about 30 mmol/kg (393 mg/100 g) in uncooked beef, chicken and rabbit muscle. Organ distribution is the trap, because ox heart holds 295 mg/100 g while ox liver holds only 30 mg/100 g despite the liver being where creatine is synthesised. Plant foods contain none, so for a vegetarian or vegan the dietary status is effectively zero rather than RICH; baseline muscle total creatine was 117 mmol/kg dry mass in vegetarians against 130 in non-vegetarians.肌酸是真实存在的膳食成分，只存在于动物的骨骼肌中：Harris 1997 在生牛肉、鸡肉和兔肉肌肉中测得约 30 mmol/kg（393 mg/100 g）。器官分布是个陷阱，牛心为 295 mg/100 g，而牛肝只有 30 mg/100 g，尽管肝脏正是合成肌酸的部位。植物性食物完全不含肌酸，所以对素食者或纯素者而言，膳食中的肌酸实际为零，谈不上丰富；素食者肌肉总肌酸基线为 117 mmol/kg 干重，非素食者为 130。

To match the dose要达到该剂量On the verified Harris figure of 393 mg/100 g, 3 g/day of creatine takes 763 g of raw lean beef and 5 g/day takes 1,272 g, about six 200 g steaks every day, carrying roughly 280 g of protein and its full fat and calorie load. On Balsom's slightly higher 4.5 g/kg for beef it is 667 g and 1,111 g. Balsom's herring figure is the highest on the list and would still need 500-770 g of raw herring daily, and that figure is indicative only. Cooking makes the plate-equivalent worse, since creatine converts to inert creatinine, so the raw-basis numbers are the optimistic case. Nobody eats this way.按已核实的 Harris 数值 393 mg/100 g 计算，每天 3 g 肌酸需要 763 g 生瘦牛肉，5 g/天需要 1,272 g，相当于每天约六块 200 g 的牛排，随之带来约 280 g 蛋白质以及全部脂肪和热量负担。若按 Balsom 略高的牛肉 4.5 g/kg 计算，则分别为 667 g 和 1,111 g。Balsom 给出的鲱鱼数值在整张表里最高，仍需每天 500-770 g 生鲱鱼，而且该数值只能算参考性质。烹饪会让真正到嘴的量更不划算，因为肌酸会转化为无活性的肌酸酐，所以以生重为基础的数字已经是最乐观的情形。没有人会这样吃饭。

Absorption吸收Creatine monohydrate is close to completely absorbed and dietary creatine from meat is also efficiently absorbed, so absorption is not the limiting step; dose size is. The responsive variable is baseline muscle store: vegetarians started at 117 mmol/kg dry mass versus 130 in non-vegetarians and showed larger increases in total creatine, phosphocreatine, lean tissue and work performance after supplementation (Burke DG et al., Med Sci Sports Exerc 2003;35(11):1946-55, PMID 14600563). Habitual omnivore intake is roughly 1-2 g/day against a whole-body turnover of about 2 g/day in a 70 kg male, with the balance made endogenously (PMID 7817065), which is why a supplement of 3-5 g/day is a two- to five-fold multiple of anything a diet delivers. Cooking losses are the one real bioavailability penalty for the food form: in cooked beef, creatine and taurine are the compounds most reduced, partly by conversion to creatinine and partly by loss into the cooking juices (Purchas RW, Rutherfurd SM, Pearce PD, Vather R, Wilkinson BHP, Meat Sci 2004;68(2):201-7, PMID 22062229).一水肌酸几乎可以完全吸收，肉类中的膳食肌酸也吸收良好，限制因素是剂量大小，吸收环节没有障碍。真正有反应的变量是肌肉基线储量：素食者起点为 117 mmol/kg 干重，非素食者为 130，补充后素食者在总肌酸、磷酸肌酸、瘦体组织和做功能力上的提升幅度更大（Burke DG et al., Med Sci Sports Exerc 2003;35(11):1946-55, PMID 14600563）。杂食者的习惯摄入量大约 1-2 g/天，而 70 kg 男性的全身周转量约 2 g/天，差额由体内自行合成（PMID 7817065），这也是 3-5 g/天的补充剂相当于膳食供给量二到五倍的原因。烹饪损失是食物形式唯一真正的吸收代价：熟牛肉中减少最多的化合物正是肌酸和牛磺酸，一部分转化为肌酸酐，一部分随肉汁流失（Purchas RW, Rutherfurd SM, Pearce PD, Vather R, Wilkinson BHP, Meat Sci 2004;68(2):201-7, PMID 22062229）。

Food data note食物数据说明The five Harris 1997 rows (beef, chicken, rabbit, ox heart, ox liver) were confirmed against the paper down to the mmol/kg conversions, and the whole dose-gap arithmetic was re-derived and held. Five of the ten rows (pork loin, herring, salmon, cod, milk) rest entirely on a single 1994 narrative review's compiled table with no traceable primary analysis, and no composition database carries creatine, so those figures cannot be raised above indicative中。Harris 1997 的五行（牛肉、鸡肉、兔肉、牛心、牛肝）已对照原文核实，连 mmol/kg 换算都逐一验证，整套剂量差额的算术也重新推导并成立。十行中有五行（猪里脊、鲱鱼、三文鱼、鳕鱼、牛奶）完全依赖 1994 年一篇叙述性综述汇编的表格，找不到可追溯的原始分析，而且没有任何成分数据库收录肌酸，因此这些数字只能停留在参考级别。

Does the body make it身体是否自产Your body builds creatine every day, on the order of 1 g in a young man (an inference from creatinine loss averaging about 2 g/day in 70 kg men aged 20 to 39, roughly half of it replaced by dietary creatine in omnivores), and a normal omnivorous diet covers the rest of the 1 to 3 g/day lost as creatinine. The catch is that this combined supply leaves muscle stores only around 60 to 80 percent saturated and synthesis is feedback-inhibited, so it will not rise to close the gap, while the synthesis that does run costs about 40 percent of the labile methyl groups carried by S-adenosylmethionine and 20 to 30 percent of the amidino groups of arginine. So 3 to 5 g/day adds to existing supply instead of duplicating it, which makes creatine one of the few endogenous compounds where this axis supports supplementing.身体每天都在合成 creatine, 年轻男性在 1 g 量级 (由肌酐流失推算: 70 kg, 20 到 39 岁男性每天约 2 g, 杂食者约一半由膳食 creatine 补回), 正常杂食饮食补上每天以肌酐形式流失的 1 到 3 g 中的其余部分。问题在于这两部分合起来仍只让肌肉储量停在约 60% 到 80% 饱和, 合成又受反馈抑制, 不会自行上调填平缺口; 而已在运行的合成代价不低, 占用 S-adenosylmethionine 提供的全部活性甲基约 40%, 并消耗 arginine 胍基的 20% 到 30%。所以 3 到 5 g/day 是在原有供应之外叠加, 并未重复, creatine 也因此成为这条轴支持补充的少数内源化合物之一。

Pathway合成通路Glycine plus the amidino group of arginine gives guanidinoacetate via AGAT (GATM), mainly in kidney and pancreas. Guanidinoacetate is methylated by GAMT using S-adenosylmethionine (methyl group from dietary methionine), mainly in liver. Creatine is exported and taken up against a gradient by muscle, heart and brain through the transporter CRT1 (SLC6A8), phosphorylated by creatine kinase isoforms and lost non-enzymatically as creatinine. The brain expresses AGAT and GAMT itself and makes most of its own creatine behind the blood-brain barrier, which is why the SLC6A8 transporter defect does not respond to oral creatine.glycine 与 arginine 的胍基经 AGAT (GATM) 生成 guanidinoacetate, 主要在肾和胰。guanidinoacetate 由 GAMT 用 S-adenosylmethionine 甲基化 (甲基来自膳食 methionine), 主要在肝。creatine 输出后由肌肉, 心脏和脑通过转运体 CRT1 (SLC6A8) 逆梯度摄取, 由肌酸激酶同工酶磷酸化, 并以非酶方式转为肌酐流失。脑自身也表达 AGAT 和 GAMT, 在血脑屏障内自产大部分 creatine, 这正是 SLC6A8 转运体缺陷对口服 creatine 无反应的原因。

Amount made自产量Roughly 1 g/day of endogenous synthesis against about 2 g/day of total turnover in a 70 kg adult, with 1.5 to 2 percent of the creatine pool converted to creatinine daily (PMID 10893433). Creatinine loss averages about 2 g (14.6 mmol)/day in 70 kg men aged 20 to 39 and about half of that loss is replaced by dietary creatine in omnivores, implying endogenous synthesis on the order of 1 g/day (PMID 21387089); women and older people lose less with lower muscle mass and synthesise proportionally less, and that paper does not give the 0.75 g/day figure often quoted for women.70 kg 成人内源合成约 1 g/day, 总周转约 2 g/day, 每天有 1.5% 到 2% 的肌酸池转为肌酐 (PMID 10893433)。70 kg, 20 到 39 岁男性每天肌酐流失平均约 2 g (14.6 mmol), 杂食者约一半由膳食 creatine 补回, 由此推算内源合成在 1 g/day 量级 (PMID 21387089); 女性和年长人群肌肉量较低, 流失更少, 合成量按比例下降, 该文献未给出 0.75 g/day 这一常被引用的女性数值。

Still matters when仍有意义的情形Vegetarians and vegans, who start with measurably lower muscle total creatine (117 versus 130 mmol/kg dry mass) and gain most from loading (PMID 14600563); repeated high-intensity and resistance work; probably older adults; and inborn errors of AGAT (GATM), GAMT or SLC6A8, where dosing is clinical and the response differs by defect, since the two synthetic defects respond to oral creatine and the transporter defect largely does not. Rising creatinine on supplementation reflects the enlarged creatine pool and carries no implication of kidney injury.素食者和纯素者, 其肌肉总 creatine 起点明显更低 (117 对 130 mmol/kg 干重), 从负荷期获益最大 (PMID 14600563); 反复高强度运动和抗阻训练; 老年人很可能受益; 以及 AGAT (GATM), GAMT 或 SLC6A8 的先天缺陷, 此时用药属临床决定, 两种合成酶缺陷对口服 creatine 有反应, 转运体缺陷基本没有。补充后血肌酐升高反映肌酸池扩大, 与肾损伤无关。

Synthesis source合成来源PMID 21387089 (Brosnan JT, da Silva RP, Brosnan ME, The metabolic burden of creatine synthesis, Amino Acids 2011;40:1325-31); PMID 10893433 (Wyss M, Kaddurah-Daouk R, Physiol Rev 2000;80:1107-1213); PMID 14600563. Merged from the recovered entries Creatine monohydrate, Creatine, and Creatine, CoQ10, glutathione and alpha-lipoic acid.

Refs.文献 Kreider PMID 28615996; Hultman PMID 8828669; Chilibeck PMID 29138605; Xu Front Nutr 2024; EFSA PMID 39564533
TTAAFFDDBBXXProtein powder蛋白粉
Verdict结论Take it值得吃
Evidence证据Grade AA 级
Dose tested已验证剂量Whatever brings total daily protein to about 1.6 g/kg. The powder itself has no special property.补到每日总蛋白约 1.6 克/公斤即可。粉末本身没有任何特殊之处。
Who适用人群People doing resistance training who are currently falling short of 1.6 g/kg/d from food.正在做抗阻训练、且靠食物达不到 1.6 克/公斤/天的人。
Pros优点
  • The nutrient is Grade A. Protein supplementation on top of resistance training adds 2.49 kg to 1RM strength and 0.30 kg of fat-free mass across 49 randomised trials and 1,863 people.作为营养素属 A 级。在抗阻训练之外补充蛋白，49 项随机试验、1863 人的数据显示 1RM 力量增加 2.49 公斤、去脂体重增加 0.30 公斤。
  • The dose-response is precisely mapped: fat-free mass gains plateau at 1.62 g/kg/d, so you know exactly when to stop paying for more.量效关系被测得很精确：去脂体重的增益在 1.62 克/公斤/天见顶，所以你清楚知道从哪里开始不必再多花钱。
  • Convenient and shelf-stable, which is a real advantage for people who cannot cook three protein-containing meals.方便、耐储存，对做不到三餐都有蛋白的人来说，这是实实在在的好处。
  • Kidney fear is unfounded in healthy people. The reassuring data are solid, though they apply to healthy kidneys only.在健康人身上，对肾脏的担心没有根据。这方面的数据扎实，但只适用于肾功能正常者。
Cons缺点
  • The benefit is real and small. Three hundred grams of extra muscle over months of training is what the meta-analysis actually found. Food protein does the same job.收益真实但很小。meta 分析真正得到的，是数月训练后多出的 300 克肌肉。食物蛋白能起同样的作用。
  • Branched-chain amino acids sold alongside are redundant and mechanistically incoherent. No human study has ever quantified muscle protein synthesis from oral BCAAs alone, and both intravenous studies found BCAAs DECREASED it. A 25 g whey serving already contains 5-6 g of BCAAs plus the six essential amino acids BCAAs lack.与之一同销售的支链氨基酸既多余，机制上也说不通。从没有人体研究定量过单独口服 BCAA 对肌蛋白合成的作用，而仅有的两项静脉研究都发现 BCAA 反而降低了合成。一份 25 克乳清本身就含 5 至 6 克 BCAA，外加 BCAA 所缺的那六种必需氨基酸。
  • Heavy-metal loading is a genuine issue in plant and organic powders, which carry more cadmium and lead than whey. Third-party testing matters here more than in most categories.植物蛋白和有机蛋白粉的重金属负荷是个真问题，其镉和铅含量高于乳清。在这个品类里，第三方检测比多数品类都重要。
  • Chronic kidney disease stage 3 or above requires a renal dietitian to set the protein prescription.慢性肾病 3 期及以上，蛋白摄入量必须由肾科营养师制定。
What it does, and what happens without it它有什么作用，缺了会怎样

Concentrated food protein supplying the amino acids used to build and repair muscle and every tissue.浓缩食物蛋白质,提供用于构建和修复肌肉及各种组织的氨基酸。

Named deficiency disease有明确的缺乏症 Partly reversible部分可逆

In detail详细Protein powder is isolated food protein (whey, casein, soy, pea, rice, egg) dried and concentrated. It has no function of its own; the function is that of dietary protein, which supplies the nine indispensable amino acids plus nitrogen for synthesis of muscle, enzymes, albumin, immunoglobulins, haemoglobin, hormones and connective tissue. An adult turns over roughly 250 to 300 g of body protein daily, most of it recycled, with dietary intake covering obligatory oxidative losses. The US RDA is 0.8 g/kg/day. The PROT-AGE group recommends 1.0 to 1.2 g/kg/day for healthy older adults and 1.2 to 1.5 g/kg/day in acute or chronic illness, because the muscle protein synthetic response to a given protein dose is blunted with age (PMID 23867520).蛋白粉是从食物中分离出的蛋白质(乳清、酪蛋白、大豆、豌豆、大米、鸡蛋),经干燥浓缩而成。它本身没有独立的功能,其作用就是膳食蛋白质的作用:提供9种必需氨基酸以及用于合成肌肉、酶、白蛋白、免疫球蛋白、血红蛋白、激素和结缔组织的氮源。成人每天约有250至300 g体蛋白发生周转,其中大部分被循环利用,膳食摄入用于弥补必然存在的氧化性丢失。美国的推荐膳食摄入量(RDA)为0.8 g/kg/day。PROT-AGE专家组建议健康老年人摄入1.0至1.2 g/kg/day,急性或慢性疾病状态下摄入1.2至1.5 g/kg/day,因为随着年龄增长,给定蛋白剂量引发的肌肉蛋白合成反应会减弱(PMID 23867520)。

Deficiency disease缺乏症Protein-energy malnutrition, presenting as marasmus and as wasting. Two conditions often listed here do not belong to dietary protein. Kwashiorkor is a form of severe acute malnutrition of uncertain aetiology, not the consequence of eating too little protein: affected children often have protein intakes comparable to marasmic children, some are still breastfed, and high-protein repletion does not preferentially resolve it. Sarcopenia is a muscle disease of ageing, inactivity, inflammation, anabolic resistance and comorbidity under the EWGSOP2 definition, and it occurs in older adults meeting the RDA; low protein intake is one modifiable contributor to it, not the deficiency state itself.蛋白质能量营养不良,表现为消瘦型营养不良(marasmus)和消瘦。这里常被列入的另外两种情况实际上不属于膳食蛋白质问题。夸希奥科病(kwashiorkor)是一种病因尚不明确的重度急性营养不良,并非蛋白质摄入过少的后果:患病儿童的蛋白质摄入量往往与消瘦型营养不良儿童相当,部分患儿仍在母乳喂养,高蛋白补充也不能优先改善该病。肌少症(sarcopenia)按照EWGSOP2定义是一种由衰老、活动不足、炎症、合成代谢抵抗及合并症共同导致的肌肉疾病,即使摄入量达到RDA的老年人也会发病,蛋白质摄入不足只是其中一个可调节的促成因素,而不是缺乏状态本身。

First signs早期表现Unintentional weight loss, falling mid-upper arm circumference, loss of subcutaneous fat and muscle bulk, thinning brittle hair, delayed wound healing and more frequent infections. Serum albumin falls late and is heavily confounded by inflammation, so it is a poor early marker. In older adults, declining grip strength and slower gait speed usually appear before visible muscle loss.非自主性体重下降,上臂中段周径减小,皮下脂肪和肌肉量减少,头发变细变脆,伤口愈合延迟,感染更为频繁。血清白蛋白下降出现较晚,且受炎症严重干扰,因此不是良好的早期指标。老年人中,握力下降和步速减慢通常出现在肉眼可见的肌肉丢失之前。

Untreated不治疗会怎样Marasmus is severe wasting: weight-for-height far below normal, visible loss of muscle and fat, an aged appearance in a young child. Kwashiorkor adds pitting oedema, an enlarged fatty liver, flaky-paint skin desquamation and hair depigmentation. Both carry high case fatality from hypoglycaemia, hypothermia, electrolyte disturbance and overwhelming infection; without structured refeeding the endpoint is death. In older adults, untreated sarcopenia ends in falls, fracture, loss of independence and raised mortality.消瘦型营养不良表现为严重消瘦:身高别体重远低于正常,肌肉和脂肪明显丢失,幼儿呈现衰老外貌。夸希奥科病在此基础上还有凹陷性水肿、脂肪肝肿大、剥落样皮肤脱屑和毛发脱色。两者都因低血糖、低体温、电解质紊乱和严重感染而具有很高的病死率,若不进行规范化再喂养,结局即为死亡。老年人未经治疗的肌少症最终导致跌倒、骨折、丧失自理能力和死亡率升高。

Does it reverse补回来能修复吗Acute wasting reverses with careful staged refeeding, and weight-for-height recovers. What does not fully recover is linear growth and neurocognitive development when the episode falls within the first 1000 days: stunting established before age two is largely permanent, and the associated cognitive deficits persist into adulthood. Sarcopenia is partly reversible, since resistance training with adequate protein rebuilds strength and some mass, but muscle lost over decades is not fully regained.急性消瘦通过谨慎的分阶段再喂养可以逆转,身高别体重可恢复。若病程发生在生命最初1000天内,则不能完全恢复的是线性生长和神经认知发育:两岁前形成的生长迟缓大多为永久性的,相关的认知缺陷会持续到成年。肌少症部分可逆,充足蛋白质配合抗阻训练可重建力量和部分肌肉量,但数十年间流失的肌肉无法完全恢复。

Who becomes deficient谁会缺乏Children in food-insecure settings, especially around weaning and following infection. Hospitalised, post-surgical and critically ill patients. Older adults with poor appetite, dental problems, dysphagia or social isolation. People with malabsorption, cirrhosis, or cachexia from cancer, advanced kidney or heart failure. Anorexia nervosa. Healthy adults in wealthy countries eating adequate calories almost never fall short of protein.处于食物不安全环境中的儿童,尤其是断奶前后及感染之后。住院患者、术后患者和重症患者。食欲不振、牙齿问题、吞咽困难或社会孤立的老年人。存在吸收不良、肝硬化,或因癌症、晚期肾衰竭或心力衰竭而恶病质的人。神经性厌食症患者。富裕国家中摄入充足热量的健康成年人几乎不会出现蛋白质不足。

How common有多常见In 2024, 42.8 million children under five were wasted (6.6%) and 12.2 million severely wasted (1.9%); 150.2 million were stunted (UNICEF/WHO/World Bank Joint Malnutrition Estimates, 2025 edition). Pooled sarcopenia prevalence in older adults is 17.7% under EWGSOP1 and 11% under EWGSOP2, with study-level ranges of 6.2% to 35.3% and 3.2% to 26.3% respectively (Fernandes LV et al., Aging Clin Exp Res. 2022;34:505-514).2024年,5岁以下儿童中有4280万人消瘦(6.6%),其中1220万人为重度消瘦(1.9%),另有1.502亿人生长迟缓(联合国儿童基金会/世界卫生组织/世界银行联合营养不良估计,2025年版)。老年人肌少症的合并患病率在EWGSOP1标准下为17.7%,在EWGSOP2标准下为11%,各研究间的范围分别为6.2%至35.3%和3.2%至26.3%(Fernandes LV等,Aging Clin Exp Res. 2022;34:505-514)。

Source来源UNICEF/WHO/World Bank Joint Child Malnutrition Estimates 2025 (https://data.unicef.org/resources/jme/); PMID 23867520 (Bauer J et al. PROT-AGE. J Am Med Dir Assoc. 2013;14:542-59); doi:10.1007/s40520-021-01951-7 (Fernandes LV et al. Aging Clin Exp Res. 2022;34:505-514, sarcopenia prevalence under EWGSOP1 and EWGSOP2)

Food and the body食物与身体
In food: Rich食物中：丰富 Dose from food: Reachable靠吃达到剂量：可达到 Body makes it: Partly身体自产：部分自产 Food data: High食物数据：高

Protein powder is itself a food fraction, so there is no molecule here that food lacks: whey and casein are dairy by-products, soya and pea isolates are legume fractions. Ordinary single portions deliver 5-53 g each, with grilled turkey breast fillet at 35.0 g/100 g and fresh Parmesan at 36.2 g/100 g topping the table. This is the one item on the list where everyday food comfortably beats the supplement.蛋白粉本身就是食物的一个组分，这里没有任何食物缺少的分子：乳清和酪蛋白是乳品副产物，大豆和豌豆分离蛋白是豆类组分。普通的单份食物就能提供 5-53 g，表中最高的是烤火鸡胸肉 35.0 g/100 g 和新鲜帕玛森干酪 36.2 g/100 g。这是全表唯一一项日常食物轻松胜过补充剂的成分。

To match the dose要达到该剂量A 1.6 g/kg target is 112 g/day for a 70 kg adult and food covers it without powder. Worked day: 2 boiled eggs (14.1 g) plus a 170 g pot of Greek style yogurt (9.7 g) plus a 130 g grilled chicken breast (41.6 g) plus 200 g cooked red lentils (16.2 g) plus 250 mL semi-skimmed milk (9.0 g) plus 30 g Cheddar (7.6 g) totals 98.2 g; add one 100 g can of tuna in brine and it reaches 123 g, over target. A 100 kg athlete at 1.6 g/kg (160 g) gets there by adding a 150 g grilled turkey breast fillet (52.5 g) or a 170 g rump steak (52.7 g). A shopper does better than the table suggests on dairy, since modern strained pots and skyr run roughly 10-12 g/100 g against CoFID's traditional Greek style yogurt at 5.7 g. The gap appears only at very high targets combined with poor appetite, a low-calorie diet or exclusively plant sources, where food volume becomes the binding constraint. Powder solves convenience and calorie density.1.6 g/kg 的目标对 70 kg 成年人是 112 g/天，普通饮食不靠蛋白粉就能覆盖。示范一天：2 个煮鸡蛋（14.1 g）加 1 盒 170 g 希腊式酸奶（9.7 g）加 130 g 烤鸡胸（41.6 g）加 200 g 煮熟红扁豆（16.2 g）加 250 mL 半脱脂牛奶（9.0 g）加 30 g 切达干酪（7.6 g），合计 98.2 g；再加 1 罐 100 g 盐水金枪鱼即达到 123 g，超过目标。100 kg 运动员按 1.6 g/kg 需要 160 g，再加一份 150 g 烤火鸡胸肉（52.5 g）或 170 g 牛臀肉排（52.7 g）就够。乳制品这一栏，消费者的实际处境比表格更好，因为现在的过滤型酸奶和 skyr 大约在 10-12 g/100 g，而 CoFID 收录的传统希腊式酸奶只有 5.7 g。缺口只出现在目标很高又叠加食欲差、低热量饮食或全植物来源的情况，此时食物体积成为约束条件。蛋白粉解决的是便利性和热量密度。

Absorption吸收Absorption differences between food and powder are about speed and amino acid pattern, not quantity absorbed. Animal-source protein is more digestible and more leucine-dense per gram than most plant sources: roast chicken breast is 31.0 g protein and 2.33 g leucine per 100 g, that is 7.5% of protein as leucine (USDA FoodData Central FDC ID 171477, SR Legacy NDB 5064, both values verified). Whey is faster and more leucine-rich per gram than whole food, casein and whole-food meals are slower, and for total daily protein this difference is small. One genuine food-form penalty: composition tables report protein as nitrogen multiplied by a conversion factor, so figures for plant foods with non-protein nitrogen slightly overstate usable protein, and cooking method changes yield per gram bought (raw beef mince is 19.7 g/100 g versus 21.8 g/100 g stewed as water is lost, CoFID 18-469 and 18-470, both verified).食物与蛋白粉之间的吸收差别在速度和氨基酸模式上，吸收总量相当。动物蛋白比多数植物来源更易消化，每克含亮氨酸也更多：烤鸡胸每 100 g 含 31.0 g 蛋白质和 2.33 g 亮氨酸，亮氨酸占蛋白质的 7.5%（USDA FoodData Central FDC ID 171477，SR Legacy NDB 5064，两个数值均已核实）。乳清比整食吸收更快、每克亮氨酸更高，酪蛋白和整食餐更慢，就全天蛋白质总量而言这点差别不大。食物形式确有一处真实的折扣：成分表把氮乘以换算系数报告为蛋白质，所以含非蛋白氮的植物性食物数值会略微高估可用蛋白，而烹饪方式会改变每克买入原料的产出（生牛肉末为 19.7 g/100 g，炖后因失水为 21.8 g/100 g，CoFID 18-469 和 18-470，均已核实）。

Food data note食物数据说明All 12 original CoFID codes and protein values were queried against the dataset itself and matched to the decimal, including the three the verifier specifically suspected (cottage cheese 9.4, boiled egg 14.1, red lentils 8.1), as did the beef mince pair and the USDA leucine figure. The seven added rows come from CoFID 2021 as identified in the verification report; food codes were supplied for turkey breast and Parmesan only, so the other five carry the dataset attribution without a code高。原有 12 个 CoFID 编码及其蛋白质数值全部在数据集中查证，逐位小数吻合，包括核查者特别怀疑的三项（白干酪 9.4、水煮鸡蛋 14.1、红扁豆 8.1），牛肉末的一对数值和 USDA 亮氨酸数值同样吻合。新增的七行来自核查报告中标明的 CoFID 2021，其中只有火鸡胸肉和帕玛森干酪给出了食物编码，另外五行只标注数据集来源，没有编码。

Does the body make it身体是否自产The roll-up is PARTIAL and it hides three tiers: nine amino acids have no human pathway to their carbon skeletons (histidine, isoleucine, leucine, lysine, methionine, phenylalanine, threonine, tryptophan, valine) and score NONE, five are built freely from central intermediates (alanine, aspartate, asparagine, glutamate, serine) and score FULL, and six sit in the IOM's conditionally indispensable middle tier (arginine, cysteine, glutamine, glycine, proline, tyrosine), made in health and needed from the diet in prematurity, trauma, sepsis or specific enzyme defects. Roughly 250 to 300 g of body protein is degraded and resynthesised per day, several times typical intake, so reutilisation dominates supply and the powder functions as a convenience format for hitting total daily protein. It therefore makes sense only when total intake sits below target, and above roughly 1.62 g/kg/day in resistance trainees it adds nothing.汇总标签是 PARTIAL, 下面藏着三个层级: 九种氨基酸的碳骨架人体无法合成 (histidine, isoleucine, leucine, lysine, methionine, phenylalanine, threonine, tryptophan, valine), 判为 NONE; 五种可由中心代谢中间体自由合成 (alanine, aspartate, asparagine, glutamate, serine), 判为 FULL; 另有六种落在 IOM 的条件性必需中间层 (arginine, cysteine, glutamine, glycine, proline, tyrosine), 健康时自产, 在早产, 创伤, 脓毒症或特定酶缺陷时需从饮食获得。成人每天降解并重新合成的体蛋白约 250 到 300 g, 是典型摄入量的数倍, 供应以再利用为主, 蛋白粉的角色是把每日总蛋白凑够的便利形式。所以只有在总摄入低于目标时才说得通, 抗阻训练者超过约 1.62 g/kg/day 之后它不再带来额外收益。

Pathway合成通路Dispensable amino acids come from central metabolism: alanine from pyruvate, glutamate and glutamine from alpha-ketoglutarate, aspartate from oxaloacetate, asparagine from aspartate via asparagine synthetase (ASNS), serine from 3-phosphoglycerate, glycine from serine via SHMT, proline from glutamate, cysteine from methionine sulfur plus the serine carbon skeleton by transsulfuration, tyrosine from phenylalanine, and arginine through the intestinal-renal citrulline axis. There is no human route to the carbon skeletons of the nine indispensable amino acids, so dietary protein is a genuine requirement that no supply of glucose or fat substitutes for.可自身合成的氨基酸来自中心代谢: alanine 来自 pyruvate, glutamate 和 glutamine 来自 alpha-ketoglutarate, aspartate 来自 oxaloacetate, asparagine 由 aspartate 经 asparagine synthetase (ASNS) 生成, serine 来自 3-phosphoglycerate, glycine 由 serine 经 SHMT 生成, proline 来自 glutamate, cysteine 由 methionine 的硫加 serine 碳骨架经转硫途径生成, tyrosine 来自 phenylalanine, arginine 走肠肾 citrulline 轴。九种必需氨基酸的碳骨架没有人体合成路线, 所以膳食蛋白是真实需求, 葡萄糖或脂肪无法替代。

Amount made自产量Roughly 250 to 300 g of body protein is degraded and resynthesised per day in an adult, several times typical Western intake, so amino acid reutilisation dominates supply (FAO/WHO/UNU 2007; IOM DRI 2005, standard turnover figures 3 to 4 g/kg/day). The adult dietary requirement is 0.8 g protein/kg/day, about 56 g for a 70 kg adult (IOM DRI 2005). Net synthesis of the nine indispensable amino acids is 0.成人每天降解并重新合成的体蛋白约 250 到 300 g, 是典型西方摄入量的数倍, 因此氨基酸再利用主导供应 (FAO/WHO/UNU 2007; IOM DRI 2005, 常用周转值 3 到 4 g/kg/day)。成人膳食需求 0.8 g protein/kg/day, 70 kg 成人约 56 g (IOM DRI 2005)。九种必需氨基酸的净合成量为 0。

Still matters when仍有意义的情形Total daily protein below target, energy deficit, older adults with anabolic resistance, vegan diets low in leucine and lysine, clinical malnutrition, burns and recovery. For resistance trainees the meta-regression breakpoint is about 1.62 g/kg/day (95% CI 1.03 to 2.20), beyond which extra protein produced no further fat-free mass gain (PMID 28698222); above that intake the powder is redundant.每日总蛋白低于目标, 能量赤字, 存在合成抵抗的老年人, leucine 和 lysine 偏低的纯素饮食, 临床营养不良, 烧伤和康复期。抗阻训练者的 meta 回归拐点约 1.62 g/kg/day (95% CI 1.03 to 2.20), 超过该摄入后额外蛋白不再带来去脂体重增加 (PMID 28698222); 高于这个摄入量, 蛋白粉是多余的。

Synthesis source合成来源IOM, Dietary Reference Intakes for Energy, Carbohydrate, Fiber, Fat, Fatty Acids, Cholesterol, Protein, and Amino Acids, National Academies Press 2005; FAO/WHO/UNU 2007; PMID 28698222. Recovered entry Protein powder.

Refs.文献 Morton PMID 28698222; Jager PMID 28642676; Wolfe PMID 28852372; Kato PMID 27322029
TTBBFFDDBBXXPsyllium husk (ispaghula)洋车前子壳
Verdict结论Take it值得吃
Evidence证据Grade BB 级
Dose tested已验证剂量About 10 g/d, always with a full glass of fluid. Separate from other oral drugs by about two hours.约 10 克/天，务必配一整杯水。与其他口服药间隔约两小时。
Who适用人群People with raised LDL cholesterol, irritable bowel syndrome of either subtype, or chronic constipation.低密度脂蛋白胆固醇偏高者、任一亚型的肠易激综合征患者、慢性便秘者。
Pros优点
  • LDL cholesterol falls 0.33 mmol/L (95% CI -0.38 to -0.27) at a median 10.2 g/d across 28 trials, and the apolipoprotein B evidence is graded HIGH quality, which is rare anywhere in this field.28 项试验、中位剂量 10.2 克/天下，低密度脂蛋白胆固醇下降 0.33 mmol/L（95% CI -0.38 至 -0.27），且载脂蛋白 B 的证据被评为高质量，这在整个领域都很少见。
  • Irritable bowel syndrome: relative risk of persistent symptoms 0.83 (0.73-0.94), NNT 7. Very few gut products have a number this good.肠易激综合征：症状持续的相对风险 0.83（0.73-0.94），NNT 7。肠道类产品里很少有这么漂亮的数字。
  • Cheap, generic and unglamorous, which is why it is under-sold rather than over-sold.便宜、通用、毫不起眼，正因如此它是被低估而不是被过度营销的。
  • Works in both constipation-predominant and diarrhoea-predominant IBS, because it is a gel-forming fibre rather than a stimulant.在便秘型和腹泻型肠易激中都有效，因为它是形成凝胶的纤维，而不是刺激性泻剂。
Cons缺点
  • No hard-outcome trial exists. The LDL reduction is a surrogate endpoint, so nobody has shown psyllium prevents a heart attack.没有硬终点试验。低密度脂蛋白的下降是替代终点，没有人证明过洋车前子能预防心肌梗死。
  • Contraindicated in dysphagia and in known or suspected bowel obstruction, stricture, impaction or ileus. This is an explicit FDA contraindication, not a formality.吞咽困难，以及已知或疑似的肠梗阻、狭窄、粪嵌塞或肠麻痹禁用。这是 FDA 明确列出的禁忌，不是走过场。
  • It must be taken with enough fluid. Bed-bound patients with poor fluid intake should not use it.必须配足够的液体服用。卧床且饮水少的患者不应使用。
  • It delays absorption of other oral drugs taken at the same time, which matters for narrow-therapeutic-index medicines.它会延迟同时服用的其他口服药的吸收，这对治疗窗窄的药物很要紧。
  • Wheat bran, sold beside it under identical digestive-health signage, is a different product and is null in IBS (RR 0.90) and often makes it worse. Do not substitute.摆在旁边、挂着同样“肠道健康”招牌的麦麸是另一种东西，在肠易激中无效（RR 0.90），还常常加重症状。不要替换。
What it does, and what happens without it它有什么作用，缺了会怎样

A gel-forming fibre that holds water in stool, making it softer, bulkier and easier to pass.一种成胶纤维,能在粪便中保留水分,使其更软、更蓬松、更易排出。

No deficiency state exists不存在缺乏状态

In detail详细Psyllium is the milled seed husk of Plantago ovata, largely a highly branched arabinoxylan that is gel-forming and, unusually among viscous fibres, poorly fermented by colonic bacteria. Because it survives intact to the rectum it retains its water there, producing bulky soft stool with far less gas than fermentable fibres. It normalises stool form in both directions, softening hard stool and firming loose stool. The same gel raises the viscosity of small intestinal contents, which slows glucose absorption and traps bile acids; the resulting loss of bile acids drives hepatic synthesis from cholesterol and lowers LDL. In IBS it is the fibre with actual trial support: ispaghula gave a relative risk of IBS not improving of 0.83 (95% CI 0.73 to 0.94), number needed to treat 7 (95% CI 4 to 25), and is the fibre recommended by the ACG guideline (PMID 33315591).车前子壳是卵叶车前(Plantago ovata)碾磨后的种皮,主要成分是高度支化的阿拉伯木聚糖,具有成胶特性,而且不同于大多数黏性纤维,它很少被结肠细菌发酵。由于它能完整到达直肠,水分得以在那里保留,形成蓬松柔软的粪便,产气也远少于可发酵纤维。它能双向调节粪便性状,使干硬粪便变软,使稀软粪便成形。同样的凝胶还会提高小肠内容物的黏度,减慢葡萄糖吸收并结合胆汁酸,由此造成的胆汁酸流失促使肝脏以胆固醇为原料加速合成,从而降低LDL。在肠易激综合征(IBS)中,车前子壳是真正有试验支持的纤维:洋车前子使IBS未改善的相对风险为0.83(95% CI 0.73至0.94),需治疗人数(NNT)为7(95% CI 4至25),是ACG指南推荐使用的纤维(PMID 33315591)。

There is no deficiency state for this. It is not an essential nutrient, so being short of it is not a thing that can happen.它不存在缺乏状态。它不是必需营养素，所以“缺了它”这件事本身并不成立。

Source来源PMID 30638909 (Reynolds A et al. Lancet. 2019;393:434-45); PMID 33315591 (Lacy BE et al. ACG Clinical Guideline: Management of IBS. Am J Gastroenterol. 2021;116:17-44); Quagliani D, Felt-Gunderson P. Am J Lifestyle Med. 2017;11:80-85 (5% meeting the fibre AI); Miketinas DC et al., NHANES 2013-2018 (7.4% meeting 14 g/1000 kcal); NCBI Bookshelf NBK589559, FSRG Dietary Data Brief, WWEIA NHANES 2009-2010 (mean 16 g/day)

Food and the body食物与身体
In food: Rich食物中：丰富 Dose from food: Reachable靠吃达到剂量：可达到 Body makes it: Cannot身体自产：不能 Food data: Medium食物数据：中

Psyllium husk is itself a food ingredient, the milled seed coat of Plantago ovata, so the supplement and the food are the same material and nothing is extracted or concentrated. Among ordinary foods, the genuine analogues for viscous gel-forming fibre are oat and barley beta-glucan and the mucilage of ground flaxseed and chia; konjac glucomannan and guar gum are also sold as foods and are more viscous still, though no confirmed per-portion figure was available for them here. Legumes are not in the same class and have been dropped from that claim: their soluble fibre measures 0.41-1.36 g/100 g and, as this entry's own bioavailability section says, it ferments proximally and behaves differently at the same gram intake. Beta-glucan is also chemically distinct from psyllium's arabinoxylan gel.洋车前子壳本身就是食品原料，是卵叶车前（Plantago ovata）种皮经研磨得到的产物，所以补充剂与食物是同一种材料，没有任何提取或浓缩步骤。在普通食物里，能与之对应的黏性成胶纤维是燕麦和大麦的 β-葡聚糖（beta-glucan），以及亚麻籽粉和奇亚籽的黏质；魔芋葡甘聚糖和瓜尔胶同样作为食品出售，黏度还要更高，但本次没有可确认的每份含量数据。豆类不属于同一类，已从该说法中删去：其可溶性纤维为 0.41-1.36 g/100 g，并且按本条自己的生物利用度部分所述，它在近端结肠发酵，在相同克数摄入下表现完全不同。β-葡聚糖在化学上也与洋车前子的阿拉伯木聚糖凝胶不同。

To match the dose要达到该剂量The 10 g/day husk dose that beat placebo in primary-care IBS (Bijkerk 2009, BMJ 339:b3154, PMID 19713235) is about one heaped tablespoon of a product sold as food, and 9 g of husk powder already supplies 6.0 g of soluble fibre, so for psyllium itself the gap is zero. Matching that 6-7 g of soluble fibre from other ordinary foods is a different question: at 0.42 g/100 g you would need roughly 1.6 kg of cooked porridge (about 6.8 cups), and canned kidney beans at 1.36 g/100 g would take about 493 g, which is 2.8 cups at 177 g per cup, corrected from the submission's 3 cups. Both of those soluble-fibre fractions come from one study table that could not be retrieved, so treat the kilogram figures as indicative. The separate and easier target of 3 g/day of oat or barley beta-glucan is reachable by eating: about 67-75 g of dry rolled oats at 4-4.5% w/w, about 40-55 g of oat bran at 5.5-8%, or about 75 g of barley at 4%. The submission's 40-50 g of dry oats applied an oat-bran-level percentage to whole oats and has been corrected.在基层医疗 IBS 研究中优于安慰剂的 10 g/day 壳粉剂量（Bijkerk 2009, BMJ 339:b3154, PMID 19713235）大约是一满汤匙作为食品出售的产品，9 g 壳粉本身已提供 6.0 g 可溶性纤维，所以对洋车前子而言差距为零。用其他普通食物凑出这 6-7 g 可溶性纤维是另一回事：按 0.42 g/100 g 计算需要约 1.6 kg 煮好的燕麦粥（约 6.8 杯），罐装红腰豆按 1.36 g/100 g 计算需要约 493 g，即按每杯 177 g 折算的 2.8 杯（原稿写 3 杯，已更正）。这两个可溶性纤维分项都来自同一份无法调取的研究表格，因此这些千克级数字只能视为指示性。另一个更容易达到的目标是每天 3 g 燕麦或大麦 β-葡聚糖（beta-glucan），单靠吃就能实现：按 4-4.5% w/w 计约 67-75 g 干燕麦片，按 5.5-8% 计约 40-55 g 燕麦麸，或按 4% 计约 75 g 大麦。原稿写 40-50 g 干燕麦，是把燕麦麸水平的百分比套到整燕麦上，已更正。

Food vs supplement食物与补充剂There is no extract-versus-food problem because psyllium husk is unprocessed plant material, but three real caveats apply. Physical: the husk must be taken with a full glass of fluid, since a gel-forming dose swallowed dry can obstruct the oesophagus or bowel. Compositional: 'soluble fibre' on a label is not one substance. Psyllium's arabinoxylan gel is viscous and poorly fermented, while inulin carries the same soluble-fibre label and ferments fast with gas production, which is the opposite of what an IBS patient wants, so gram-for-gram substitution is a mistake. Processing: oat beta-glucan's benefit tracks viscosity, which depends on molecular weight, and milling, extrusion and prolonged heating degrade it, so a heavily processed oat product with an identical gram figure on the label is not equivalent to whole rolled oats.洋车前子壳是未加工的植物材料，因此不存在提取物与食物之别的问题，但有三个真实的注意点。物理层面：服用时必须配一整杯液体，干吞成胶剂量可能堵塞食管或肠道。成分层面：标签上的“可溶性纤维”并非单一物质。洋车前子的阿拉伯木聚糖凝胶黏度高、难发酵，而菊粉挂着同样的可溶性纤维标签，却发酵快并产气，这与 IBS 患者的需求正好相反，按克数等量替换是个错误。加工层面：燕麦 β-葡聚糖（beta-glucan）的获益跟随黏度，而黏度取决于分子量，研磨、挤压膨化和长时间加热都会使其降解，所以标签克数相同的深加工燕麦产品并不等同于整粒燕麦片。

Absorption吸收Nothing here is absorbed, so bioavailability means viscosity, water-holding and fermentability. Psyllium holds water through the whole colon with a low gas yield, which is why it helps both constipation and diarrhoea; legume soluble fibre and inulin are largely fermented in the proximal colon and behave quite differently at the same gram intake. Analytical method is a genuine source of confusion: AOAC 991.43 gravimetric soluble-fibre values run systematically higher than the enzymatic-chemical (Englyst/NSP) values used in UK tables, so soluble-fibre numbers from different tables should not be mixed. Head-to-head evidence supports the distinction between fibre classes: at the same 10 g dose, psyllium beat placebo at one and two months while wheat bran did not (PMID 19713235).这里的物质都不被吸收，所以生物利用度指的是黏度、持水能力和可发酵性。洋车前子在整个结肠都能持水且产气量低，这是它对便秘和腹泻都有帮助的原因；豆类可溶性纤维和菊粉主要在近端结肠被发酵，在相同克数摄入下表现相差很大。分析方法是混乱的真实来源：AOAC 991.43 重量法测得的可溶性纤维值系统性高于英国食物成分表采用的酶化学法（Englyst/NSP）值，所以不同表格的可溶性纤维数字不应混用。头对头证据支持纤维类别之间的区分：同为 10 g 剂量，洋车前子在第一个月和第二个月均优于安慰剂，小麦麸则没有（PMID 19713235）。

Food data note食物数据说明The USDA total-fibre values (oat bran 15.4, barley 3.8) and the Bijkerk trial details were confirmed. Two weaknesses remain: the headline psyllium composition rests on a branded manufacturer-label record whose own total-fibre field reads 0 g, and every soluble/insoluble split for oatmeal and legumes comes from one 2002 table that could not be retrieved. The added flax and chia figures are the verification report's own range, not a traced composition record中。USDA 的总纤维值（燕麦麸 15.4，大麦 3.8）和 Bijkerk 试验细节已确认。仍有两处薄弱：洋车前子的主打成分数据依赖一份品牌厂家标签记录，而该记录自身的总纤维字段读数为 0 g；燕麦粥和豆类的所有可溶/不可溶分项都来自一份无法调取的 2002 年表格。新增的亚麻籽和奇亚籽数字取自核查报告自己给出的范围，并非可追溯的成分记录。

Does the body make it身体是否自产Psyllium is a highly branched arabinoxylan that no human enzyme can cleave, which is the operational meaning of dietary fibre. Being non-digestible is the mechanism: the husk holds water into a viscous gel and the gel does the work on stool form and transit. So the axis has nothing to say against it, and psyllium is the one fibre with reasonable randomised support in IBS.车前子壳是高度分支的阿拉伯木聚糖, 人体没有酶能切开它, 这就是膳食纤维的操作性含义。不可消化本身就是机制: 壳把水保持成粘性凝胶, 凝胶作用于大便形态和转运。所以这条轴没有反对它的理由, 而车前子是在 IBS 中拥有较合理随机证据的那一种纤维。

Pathway合成通路NOT APPLICABLE. Dietary fibre is defined by resistance to human digestive enzymes; humans lack the glycoside hydrolases that would depolymerise the arabinoxylan backbone.NOT APPLICABLE。膳食纤维的定义就是耐受人体消化酶; 人缺少能把阿拉伯木聚糖主链解聚的糖苷水解酶。

Amount made自产量0 (no human biosynthetic pathway; intake is the only variable)0 (人体没有生物合成途径; 摄入量是唯一变量)

Still matters when仍有意义的情形Every gram must be eaten, so intake is the whole question. In primary care IBS (n=275: 85 psyllium, 97 bran, 93 placebo, ages 18 to 65), 10 g/day psyllium gave adequate symptom relief in 57 percent versus 35 percent on placebo at month 1 (RR 1.60, 95 percent CI 1.13 to 2.26), also favoured psyllium at month 2 (59 percent versus 41 percent, RR 1.44, 95 percent CI 1.02 to 2.06), and reduced the symptom severity score by 90 points at 3 months against 49 for placebo (P=0.03). Start low and titrate, since gas and bloating are dose-related.每一克都得吃进去, 所以摄入量就是全部问题。在基层医疗的 IBS 人群中 (n=275: 车前子 85 例, 麦麸 97 例, 安慰剂 93 例, 年龄 18 至 65 岁), 10 g/day 车前子在第 1 个月使 57% 的人症状得到充分缓解, 安慰剂为 35% (RR 1.60, 95% CI 1.13 至 2.26); 第 2 个月同样占优 (59% 对 41%, RR 1.44, 95% CI 1.02 至 2.06); 3 个月时症状严重度评分下降 90 分, 安慰剂为 49 分 (P=0.03)。从小剂量开始逐步加量, 因为胀气和腹胀与剂量相关。

Synthesis source合成来源PMID 19713235 (Bijkerk CJ, BMJ 2009;339:b3154, Soluble or insoluble fibre in irritable bowel syndrome in primary care?); PMID 24725724 (Jones JM, Nutr J 2014)

Refs.文献 Jovanovski PMID 30239559; Moayyedi PMID 25070054; Bijkerk BMJ 2009 PMID 19713235; Reynolds Lancet 2019 PMID 30638909
TTAAFFDDBBXXCaffeine咖啡因
Verdict结论Take it值得吃
Evidence证据Grade AA 级
Dose tested已验证剂量3-6 mg/kg body mass, about 60 minutes before exercise. For a 70 kg person that is 210-420 mg.按体重 3 至 6 毫克/公斤，运动前约 60 分钟服用。70 公斤的人为 210 至 420 毫克。
Who适用人群Almost anyone training, trained or untrained. Also shift workers and the sleep-deprived, for the separate alertness effect.几乎所有训练的人，无论是否受过训练。此外还有轮班工作者和睡眠不足者，用的是另一个提高警觉的效应。
Pros优点
  • The most reliably ergogenic legal substance in this document. An umbrella review of 11 systematic reviews containing 21 meta-analyses, all of moderate or high quality, found benefit for aerobic endurance, strength, muscle endurance, power, jumping and speed.本文中最可靠的合法运动增效物质。一项涵盖 11 篇系统综述、21 项 meta 分析的伞式综述（全部为中高质量）显示，对有氧耐力、力量、肌耐力、爆发力、弹跳和速度均有益。
  • Cheap, well characterised, and the dose-response is known.便宜、特性清楚，量效关系已知。
  • The mechanism is central rather than metabolic, so it works by reducing perceived effort and pain, which is why it helps across so many different tasks.其机制是中枢性而非代谢性的，通过降低主观用力感和疼痛感起作用，这也是它在如此多不同任务上都有效的原因。
Cons缺点
  • Genotype changes the sign of the effect. CYP1A2 AA carriers gain (SMD 0.30), AC carriers gain a little (0.16), and CC carriers get WORSE (SMD -0.22). Most people do not know their genotype.基因型会改变效应的方向。CYP1A2 的 AA 型获益（SMD 0.30），AC 型略有获益（0.16），而 CC 型表现变差（SMD -0.22）。多数人并不知道自己的基因型。
  • 9 mg/kg brings a high incidence of side effects with no added benefit. More is not better past 6 mg/kg.9 毫克/公斤会带来大量副作用而没有额外收益。超过 6 毫克/公斤就不是越多越好。
  • The fat-burner claim is the oversold part of the category. Thermogenesis is real and trivial.“燃脂”是这个品类里被过度吹嘘的部分。产热效应真实但微不足道。
  • Contraindicated or needing care in uncontrolled hypertension, arrhythmia, anxiety and panic disorder. EFSA caps pregnancy at 200 mg/d, and derives no safe intake for children.未控制的高血压、心律失常、焦虑症和惊恐障碍者禁用或需谨慎。EFSA 把妊娠期上限定在 200 毫克/天，对儿童则无法推导出安全摄入量。
  • Fluvoxamine is a potent CYP1A2 inhibitor and can raise caffeine exposure severalfold. Taken late, it damages the sleep that training depends on.氟伏沙明是强效 CYP1A2 抑制剂，可使咖啡因暴露量成倍升高。服用时间太晚则会损害训练所依赖的睡眠。
What it does, and what happens without it它有什么作用，缺了会怎样

Blocks the brain's sleepiness signal, so you feel more alert and effort feels easier.阻断大脑的困倦信号,使人更清醒,并让用力的感觉变得更轻松。

No deficiency state exists不存在缺乏状态

In detail详细Caffeine is an adenosine receptor antagonist, principally at A1 and A2A receptors. Blocking A1 lifts the inhibitory brake that accumulating adenosine places on arousal circuits, and blocking striatal A2A disinhibits dopaminergic signalling, which produces the alertness and the reduced perception of effort. It is a plant alkaloid and a xenobiotic. No human enzyme, receptor or pathway requires it, and there is no intake below which anything fails. Caffeine withdrawal is not a deficiency state: habitual intake upregulates adenosine receptors, so abrupt cessation unmasks adenosine signalling and produces headache, fatigue and low mood for roughly 2 to 9 days, with headache in about half of regular users. That is physical dependence on a drug, and it resolves completely without resuming the drug.咖啡因是一种腺苷受体拮抗剂,主要作用于A1和A2A受体。阻断A1受体可解除堆积的腺苷对唤醒回路施加的抑制性刹车,而阻断纹状体A2A受体可解除对多巴胺能信号的抑制,由此产生清醒感并降低对用力程度的主观感受。它是一种植物生物碱,也是一种外源化学物。没有任何人体酶、受体或通路需要它,也不存在低于某摄入量就会出现功能失常的情况。咖啡因戒断并非缺乏状态:长期摄入会上调腺苷受体,因此突然停用会使腺苷信号失去掩盖,产生头痛、疲劳和情绪低落,持续约2至9天,约半数常规饮用者会出现头痛。这属于对一种药物的生理依赖,一旦发生便会完全消退,无需恢复用药。

There is no deficiency state for this. It is not an essential nutrient, so being short of it is not a thing that can happen.它不存在缺乏状态。它不是必需营养素，所以“缺了它”这件事本身并不成立。

Source来源PMID 15448977 (Juliano & Griffiths, critical review of caffeine withdrawal, Psychopharmacology 2004); EFSA Scientific Opinion on the safety of caffeine, EFSA Journal 2015;13(5):4102

Food and the body食物与身体
In food: Rich食物中：丰富 Dose from food: Reachable靠吃达到剂量：可达到 Body makes it: Cannot身体自产：不能 Food data: High食物数据：高

Caffeine in ordinary drinks sits at the same scale as the supplement dose: USDA gives home brewed coffee 40 mg/100 g and restaurant espresso 212 mg/100 g, and the Brazilian caffeine table gives espresso 279 mg/100 mL. Guarana seed powder at roughly 2-6 g/100 g and instant coffee powder on a dry basis at roughly 3-4 g/100 g overshoot a full dose from a spoonful, though neither figure was traced to a primary analysis in this review. Tea, matcha, cola and dark chocolate all contribute at tens of milligrams per serving, and yerba mate belongs in the same group though no figure was available to place it.日常饮品里的咖啡因与补充剂剂量处在同一量级：USDA 给出家庭冲煮咖啡 40 mg/100 g、餐厅浓缩咖啡 212 mg/100 g，巴西咖啡因数据表给出浓缩咖啡 279 mg/100 mL。瓜拉纳籽粉约 2-6 g/100 g，速溶咖啡粉以干重计约 3-4 g/100 g，一勺就超过一个完整剂量，不过本次核查未能把这两个数字追溯到原始分析。茶、抹茶、可乐和黑巧克力每份都能贡献几十毫克，马黛茶属于同一档，只是没有可用数值来定位它。
