To match the dose要达到该剂量An ergogenic 3-6 mg/kg is 210-420 mg for a 70 kg adult, which is two to four mugs of home brewed coffee at 96 mg each; a 200 mg pre-workout dose is about two mugs or three single espresso shots. What food cannot deliver is a known dose. Measured caffeine in caffeinated specialty coffees ranged 58-259 mg per dose, mean 188 mg (SD 36) for a 16 oz cup, and the same beverage bought from the same outlet on six consecutive days ranged 259-564 mg, a 2.2-fold swing in what the customer thought was an identical drink. Decaffeinated versions still contained up to 17.7 mg per dose. Matcha spans 18.9-44.4 mg/g, so one teaspoon is anywhere from 38 to 89 mg. Reaching the dose from drinks is trivial; hitting it within plus or minus 20% is not, which is why trials use capsules.具有运动增益作用的 3-6 mg/kg 对 70 kg 成年人是 210-420 mg，相当于两到四大杯家庭冲煮咖啡（每杯 96 mg）；200 mg 的训练前剂量约为两大杯，或三份单份浓缩咖啡。食物给不出的是一个已知剂量。含咖啡因的精品咖啡实测每份为 58-259 mg，16 oz 一杯的均值为 188 mg（SD 36）；同一家门店连续六天买同一款饮品，实测范围 259-564 mg，顾客以为一模一样的饮料相差 2.2 倍。脱咖啡因版本每份仍含最多 17.7 mg。抹茶跨度为 18.9-44.4 mg/g，一茶匙从 38 mg 到 89 mg 都有可能。靠饮品达到剂量很容易；把误差控制在正负 20% 以内很难，这就是试验采用胶囊的原因。

Food vs supplement食物与补充剂The caveat is inverted here. Anhydrous caffeine powder is the same molecule and is dangerous precisely because it is concentrated: a level teaspoon is several grams, in the range associated with fatal poisoning, whereas the same amount as brewed coffee would be 30 to 50 mugs and physically self-limiting. Whole-drink forms carry matrix effects that change the experience and the risk profile. Coffee brings chlorogenic acids and, when unfiltered, diterpenes that raise LDL; tea and matcha bring L-theanine and catechins that alter the subjective stimulation; energy drinks bring sugar, taurine and often glucuronolactone, so a caffeine dose from a can is never only caffeine. Guarana concentrates the same molecule in a seed powder, which is how many energy products reach their potency without looking like a caffeine tablet. Tea and coffee polyphenols also inhibit non-haem iron absorption when taken with meals, a cost the capsule does not impose. Energy drink and specialty coffee servings are large and easy to stack, and label values are nominal rather than analysed.这一项的提醒是反向的。无水咖啡因粉是同一分子，危险恰恰来自它的浓度：一平茶匙就有几克，落在与致死性中毒相关的区间，而同样的量换成冲煮咖啡是 30 到 50 大杯，生理上自然会喝不下去。完整饮品形式带有基质效应，会改变体验和风险特征。咖啡带来绿原酸，未过滤时还带来会升高 LDL 的二萜；茶和抹茶带来 L-茶氨酸和儿茶素，改变主观兴奋感；能量饮料带来糖、牛磺酸，常常还有葡萄糖醛酸内酯，所以一罐提供的咖啡因剂量从来不只是咖啡因。瓜拉纳把同一分子浓缩在籽粉里，许多能量产品正是靠它达到效力，外观上又不像咖啡因药片。茶和咖啡的多酚随餐摄入还会抑制非血红素铁的吸收，这是胶囊没有的代价。能量饮料和精品咖啡的份量偏大，容易叠加，而标签数值只是标称值，并未经过分析测定。

Absorption吸收Caffeine is essentially completely absorbed from every form tested, so there is no meaningful absorption penalty for the food route; the differences are in rate and in dose certainty. Liquids reach peak plasma concentrations faster than capsules, chewing gum faster still, and a hot drink sipped over 20 minutes produces a flatter curve than a capsule swallowed at once, which matters for timing a pre-exercise dose and not for total exposure. Analytical values differ between databases for the same drink because brewing dominates: USDA lists brewed coffee at 40 mg/100 g and espresso at 212 mg/100 g (FDC 171890, 171891), while the Brazilian table lists espresso at 279 mg/100 mL (DOI 10.3390/nu14204417). Both are correct for what they measured, which is the whole point: the food is the variable, and the absorption is not.所有受试形式的咖啡因基本都能完全吸收，走食物途径没有值得一提的吸收折扣；差别在速率和剂量确定性上。液体比胶囊更快达到血浆峰值，咀嚼胶更快；一杯热饮分 20 分钟慢慢喝，曲线比一口吞下的胶囊平缓，这影响运动前的服用时机，不影响总暴露量。同一种饮品在不同数据库之间的分析值不同，因为冲煮方式起主导作用：USDA 列出冲煮咖啡 40 mg/100 g、浓缩咖啡 212 mg/100 g（FDC 171890、171891），巴西数据表列出浓缩咖啡 279 mg/100 mL（DOI 10.3390/nu14204417）。就各自测定的对象而言两者都对，这恰恰是要点所在：变量在食物本身，吸收环节没有变量。

Food data note食物数据说明for the database and BraCaffT rows. All four USDA FDC IDs were verified down to NDB number, description and nutrient value; all six BraCaffT values, the matcha range and every McCusker variability figure were confirmed verbatim. The two added rows, guarana and instant coffee powder, rest on approximate ranges from the verification report with no primary source traced, and are labelled indicative. Yerba mate is a known omission with no figure to place it数据库行和 BraCaffT 行为高。四个 USDA FDC ID 全部核实到 NDB 编号、描述和营养素数值；六个 BraCaffT 数值、抹茶范围以及 McCusker 的每一项变异性数据都逐字确认。新增的两行，瓜拉纳籽粉和速溶咖啡粉，依据的是核查报告给出的近似范围，没有追溯到原始来源，已标为参考性质。马黛茶是已知的遗漏，没有可用数值来定位。

Does the body make it身体是否自产Humans have no caffeine biosynthetic pathway: there is no caffeine synthase and no route from purine nucleotides to caffeine in any animal, so every milligram in your blood was eaten or drunk, and the human enzymology is purely disposal, dominated by hepatic CYP1A2. Note what NONE does and does not imply here, since caffeine is a drug and not a nutrient, so there is no deficiency to correct and no redundancy to worry about. This axis neither supports nor undermines it, and the decision rests entirely on pharmacology and dose.人体没有 caffeine 的生物合成通路: 没有 caffeine synthase, 任何动物体内也没有从嘌呤核苷酸到 caffeine 的路线, 所以血里的每一毫克都是吃进或喝进去的, 人体相关酶学纯属处置, 由肝内 CYP1A2 主导。要注意 NONE 在这里的含义: caffeine 属于药物, 不算营养素, 没有可纠正的缺乏, 也不存在与自身合成重复的问题。这条轴对它既不支持也不反驳, 判断完全落在药理学和剂量上。

Pathway合成通路NOT APPLICABLE in humans. In Coffea and Camellia, xanthosine is methylated by 7-methylxanthosine synthase (XMT), the ribose is then removed by an N-methylnucleosidase to give 7-methylxanthine, which is methylated to theobromine by theobromine synthase (MXMT) and then to caffeine by caffeine synthase (DXMT), a bifunctional enzyme. Human enzymology covers disposal only, dominated by hepatic CYP1A2.在人体 NOT APPLICABLE。在 Coffea 和 Camellia 中, xanthosine 由 7-methylxanthosine synthase (XMT) 甲基化, 再由一个 N-methylnucleosidase 去掉核糖得到 7-methylxanthine, 经 theobromine synthase (MXMT) 甲基化为 theobromine, 再由双功能酶 caffeine synthase (DXMT) 甲基化为 caffeine。人体只有处置一侧的酶学, 由肝内 CYP1A2 主导。

Amount made自产量0 mg/day, no endogenous synthesis. On the disposal side, CYP1A2 metabolises about 95 percent of ingested caffeine (PMID 29514871).0 mg/day, 没有内源合成。在处置一侧, CYP1A2 代谢摄入 caffeine 的约 95% (PMID 29514871)。

Still matters when仍有意义的情形Whenever acute adenosine receptor antagonism is the goal: alertness, reduced perceived effort, endurance and sprint performance, typically 3 to 6 mg/kg. The endogenous axis is silent on caffeine; the real constraints are habitual tolerance, CYP1A2 genotype, sleep disruption and cumulative daily dose.凡以急性拮抗 adenosine 受体为目的时: 清醒度, 主观用力感下降, 耐力和冲刺表现, 常用 3 到 6 mg/kg。内源轴对 caffeine 无话可说; 真正的限制是习惯性耐受, CYP1A2 基因型, 睡眠干扰和每日累积剂量。

Synthesis source合成来源PMID 29514871 (Nehlig A, Pharmacol Rev 2018;70:384-411); Ashihara H, Sano H, Crozier A, Caffeine and related purine alkaloids: biosynthesis, catabolism, function and genetic engineering. Recovered entry Caffeine.

Refs.文献 Guest ISSN PMID 33388079; Grgic PMID 30926628; Barreto PMID 37844569; EFSA J 2015;13(5):4102
TTBBFFDDBBXXOmega-3 (EPA and DHA)Omega-3（EPA 与 DHA）
Verdict结论Take it值得吃
Evidence证据Grade BB 级
Dose tested已验证剂量4 g/d of prescription-grade product if fasting triglycerides are at or above 500 mg/dL. Otherwise eat oily fish.若空腹甘油三酯达到或超过 500 mg/dL，用处方级产品 4 克/天。否则请吃多脂鱼。
Who适用人群People with severe hypertriglyceridaemia. Separately, pregnant women with genuinely low baseline DHA, and people who eat essentially no fish.重度高甘油三酯血症患者。另外还有基础 DHA 确实偏低的孕妇，以及基本不吃鱼的人。
Pros优点
  • Triglyceride lowering is genuine pharmacology: 4 g/d cuts triglycerides by at least 30% in severe hypertriglyceridaemia, and the AHA endorses this specific indication.降甘油三酯是实打实的药理作用：在重度高甘油三酯血症中，4 克/天至少降低 30%，美国心脏协会明确支持这一适应证。
  • REDUCE-IT was strongly positive in statin-treated patients with established cardiovascular disease: primary composite 17.2% versus 22.0%, HR 0.75 (0.68-0.83), an absolute reduction of 4.8 percentage points over 4.9 years.REDUCE-IT 在已服他汀且患有心血管病的人群中结果强阳性：主要复合终点 17.2% 对 22.0%，HR 0.75（0.68-0.83），4.9 年内绝对下降 4.8 个百分点。
  • Pregnancy: Cochrane found preterm birth before 37 weeks RR 0.89 (0.81-0.97) and before 34 weeks RR 0.58 (0.44-0.77), both graded high quality, across 70 trials and 19,927 women.妊娠期：Cochrane 在 70 项试验、19927 名女性中发现，37 周前早产 RR 0.89（0.81-0.97），34 周前早产 RR 0.58（0.44-0.77），两项均被评为高质量。
Cons缺点
  • It does not prevent cardiovascular disease at supplement doses. Cochrane, 86 trials and 162,796 people: all-cause mortality RR 0.97 (0.93-1.01) at HIGH certainty, stroke RR 1.02. VITAL and ASCEND both missed their primary endpoints at 1 g/d.在补充剂剂量下，它不能预防心血管病。Cochrane 纳入 86 项试验、162796 人：全因死亡 RR 0.97（0.93-1.01），高确定性；卒中 RR 1.02。VITAL 和 ASCEND 在 1 克/天下都未达主要终点。
  • The two big high-dose trials contradict each other. STRENGTH tested 4 g/d of EPA plus DHA against corn oil in 13,078 people and was flatly null (HR 0.99), stopped for futility. REDUCE-IT used a mineral-oil placebo that raised LDL, apolipoprotein B and hs-CRP in the control arm, so part of its 25% may be placebo-arm harm. Quote both trials or neither.两项大型高剂量试验互相矛盾。STRENGTH 在 13078 人中用 4 克/天的 EPA 加 DHA 对比玉米油，结果完全阴性（HR 0.99），因无效终止。REDUCE-IT 用的矿物油安慰剂使对照组的低密度脂蛋白、载脂蛋白 B 和超敏 C 反应蛋白升高，因此那 25% 中可能有一部分来自对照组受损。要引就两项一起引，否则一项也别引。
  • Atrial fibrillation risk rises with dose: HR 1.25 (1.07-1.46), dose-dependent across 7 trials. Prior atrial fibrillation is a reason to stay away.房颤风险随剂量上升：7 项试验中 HR 1.25（1.07-1.46），呈剂量依赖。有房颤史就是不该用的理由。
  • Bleeding risk on warfarin, direct oral anticoagulants, aspirin and clopidogrel. REDUCE-IT showed serious bleeding 2.7% versus 2.1%.与华法林、直接口服抗凝药、阿司匹林和氯吡格雷合用有出血风险。REDUCE-IT 中严重出血为 2.7% 对 2.1%。
  • Product quality is poor. Half of North American products exceeded voluntary oxidation limits, and 38% of Australian products exceeded primary oxidation limits, with premium pricing giving no advantage. Buy encapsulated, unflavoured and in date.产品质量差。北美一半的产品超过自愿性氧化限值，澳大利亚 38% 的产品超过初级氧化限值，而高价并不带来优势。要买胶囊装、无调味、在有效期内的。
  • Pregnancy is not straightforward either: ORIP (n=5,486, 900 mg/d) was null and showed excess very-large-for-gestational-age infants. Benefit concentrates in women with low baseline DHA.妊娠期也并不简单：ORIP（n=5486，900 毫克/天）为阴性，并出现超大于胎龄儿增多。获益集中在基础 DHA 偏低的女性身上。
What it does, and what happens without it它有什么作用，缺了会怎样

Long-chain fats built into brain, retina and heart cell membranes; they also help resolve inflammation.构建脑、视网膜和心脏细胞膜的长链脂肪酸,同时有助于消退炎症。

Low status causes dysfunction偏低会引起功能异常 Partly reversible部分可逆

In detail详细EPA (20:5n-3) and DHA (22:6n-3) are the long-chain products of omega-3 metabolism. DHA is the dominant structural fatty acid of retinal photoreceptor outer segments and neuronal synaptic membranes, where it sets membrane fluidity and supports the function of embedded proteins such as rhodopsin. EPA is the substrate for series-3 prostaglandins and series-5 leukotrienes, and both are precursors of the resolvins and protectins that actively terminate inflammation. Because the body can make them from alpha-linolenic acid, they are classed as conditionally essential rather than strictly essential; the conversion is inefficient enough that tissue levels track intake of preformed EPA and DHA closely.EPA(20:5n-3)和DHA(22:6n-3)是omega-3代谢的长链产物。DHA是视网膜光感受器外节和神经元突触膜的主要结构脂肪酸,决定膜的流动性,并支持视紫红质等嵌膜蛋白的功能。EPA是3系前列腺素和5系白三烯的底物,两者都是消退素和保护素的前体,这些物质能主动终止炎症。由于人体可以由α-亚麻酸合成EPA和DHA,它们被归为条件必需脂肪酸而非严格必需脂肪酸,但转化效率低,以至于组织中的水平仍紧密跟随预成EPA和DHA的摄入量。

Deficiency disease缺乏症NONE. No named clinical deficiency disease exists for EPA and DHA specifically, because they can be synthesised from ALA.无。EPA和DHA本身没有专属的临床缺乏病命名,因为它们可以由ALA合成。

First signs早期表现Nothing a person would notice. The first measurable change is biochemical: a falling omega-3 index, meaning EPA plus DHA as a percentage of red cell fatty acids. Values at or below about 4% define the low band and 8% or above was the proposed target (Harris and von Schacky, PMID 15208005). Symptoms sometimes attributed to low omega-3 status, such as dry skin or low mood, are non-specific and have not been shown to track the index.本人不会察觉到任何症状。最早可测得的变化是生化指标:omega-3指数下降,即EPA加DHA占红细胞脂肪酸的百分比。约4%及以下为低水平区间,8%及以上是提出的目标值(Harris和von Schacky,PMID 15208005)。有时被归因于omega-3水平偏低的症状,如皮肤干燥或情绪低落,均属非特异性表现,尚未证实与该指数相关。

Untreated不治疗会怎样There is no severe clinical syndrome attributable to low EPA and DHA alone in an adult who is otherwise fed. Frank neurological deficiency signs belong to total omega-3 deprivation, which is an ALA problem (see that entry). The clearest documented consequence of low long-chain omega-3 supply is developmental: preterm infants cut off from third-trimester placental DHA transfer accrete far less retinal and brain DHA, with fetal accretion roughly doubling in the last five weeks of gestation.对于饮食其他方面正常的成年人,单纯EPA和DHA偏低不会引起严重临床综合征。明显的神经系统缺乏体征属于omega-3完全缺乏的情形,那是ALA的问题(见该词条)。长链omega-3供应不足最明确记录的后果与发育有关:早产儿因失去妊娠晚期胎盘DHA转运而在视网膜和脑内蓄积的DHA大幅减少,胎儿DHA蓄积速度在妊娠最后五周约翻倍。

Does it reverse补回来能修复吗In adults repletion is complete. Red cell EPA and DHA rise over roughly three to four months, approximately the erythrocyte lifespan, and normalise fully with sustained intake. The partial designation covers the perinatal window only: in rhesus monkeys deprived of n-3 before birth, brain phospholipids had normalised by three years but retinal DHA reached only 84% of controls. Behavioural visual acuity thresholds were normal at 4, 8 and 12 weeks, but cone and rod ERG a-wave amplitudes stayed persistently reduced, so the residue after prenatal deprivation is functional as well as biochemical, and the study answers its own title question in the negative (Anderson GJ et al., Pediatr Res. 2005;58:865-72).成年人补充后可完全恢复。红细胞EPA和DHA在大约三到四个月内(约相当于红细胞寿命)上升,持续摄入后可完全恢复正常。部分可逆的判定仅针对围产期这一窗口:在出生前被剥夺n-3的恒河猴中,脑磷脂在三岁时已恢复正常,但视网膜DHA仅达到对照组的84%。行为学视敏度阈值在4周、8周和12周时均正常,但视锥和视杆细胞ERG a波振幅持续偏低,因此产前剥夺后留下的残余损害既是功能性的也是生化性的,该研究对自己标题所提的问题给出了否定的答案(Anderson GJ等,Pediatr Res. 2005;58:865-72)。

Who becomes deficient谁会缺乏People who eat no oily fish and take no supplement. Vegans and vegetarians, who have no direct dietary source of preformed EPA or DHA. Preterm infants. Carriers of FADS1/FADS2 minor alleles, who have lower desaturase activity and convert ALA less efficiently.不吃富脂鱼类又不服用补充剂的人。纯素食者和素食者,因为他们没有直接摄入预成EPA或DHA的膳食来源。早产儿。携带FADS1/FADS2次要等位基因的人,其desaturase活性较低,ALA转化效率较差。

How common有多常见Not a disease rate. As a status distribution, omega-3 index values at or below 4% are typical across North America, Central and South America, Europe, the Middle East, Southeast Asia and Africa, while levels above 8% occur mainly around the Sea of Japan, in Scandinavia and in some indigenous coastal populations, based on 298 studies (Stark et al., PMID 27216485).并非疾病发生率。作为一种状态分布,omega-3指数在4%及以下在北美、中南美洲、欧洲、中东、东南亚和非洲较为常见,而8%以上的水平主要见于日本海周边、斯堪的纳维亚地区以及部分沿海原住民人群,数据基于298项研究(Stark等,PMID 27216485)。

Source来源PMID 15208005 (Harris WS, von Schacky C. Prev Med. 2004); PMID 27216485 (Stark KD et al. Prog Lipid Res. 2016); Anderson GJ, Neuringer M, Lin DS, Connor WE. Pediatr Res. 2005;58:865-72, doi:10.1203/01.pdr.0000182188.31596.5a

Food and the body食物与身体
In food: Rich食物中：丰富 Dose from food: Partly靠吃达到剂量：部分 Body makes it: Partly身体自产：部分自产 Food data: High食物数据：高

Oily fish supply EPA and DHA in gram quantities per ordinary portion, so this is one of the few supplement categories where food competes with capsules at physiological doses. One 143 g herring fillet or one 130 g salmon portion delivers 1.8-2.9 g EPA+DHA, roughly seven to twelve times a single day's EFSA Adequate Intake of 250 mg (EFSA Journal 2010;8(3):1461, DOI 10.2903/j.efsa.2010.1461; EFSA DRVs summary 2017). The lower end of that range is deliberate: the USDA farmed-salmon entry reflects older analyses, and in over 3,000 Scottish farmed salmon EPA+DHA fell from 2.74 g to 1.36 g per 100 g wet weight between 2006 and 2015 as feed shifted from fish oil to vegetable oil (Sprague 2016, DOI 10.1038/srep21892), giving 1.8 g for the same 130 g portion. Treat the farmed-salmon figures below as an upper bound and roughly halve them for current farmed fish. The richest sources in the USDA database are not fillets at all: caviar carries 6,540 mg EPA+DHA per 100 g and mixed fish roe 2,343 mg, both above cooked herring.多脂鱼每份常规食用量就能提供克级的 EPA 和 DHA，因此在生理剂量层面，这是少数几类食物能与胶囊正面竞争的补充剂。一片 143 g 的鲱鱼柳或一份 130 g 的三文鱼可提供 1.8-2.9 g EPA+DHA，约为 EFSA 单日适宜摄入量 250 mg 的七到十二倍（EFSA Journal 2010;8(3):1461, DOI 10.2903/j.efsa.2010.1461；EFSA DRVs summary 2017）。这个区间的下限是刻意保留的：USDA 的养殖三文鱼条目反映的是较早的分析数据，而在 3,000 多条苏格兰养殖三文鱼中，随着饲料从鱼油转向植物油，2006 至 2015 年间 EPA+DHA 从每 100 g 湿重 2.74 g 降至 1.36 g（Sprague 2016, DOI 10.1038/srep21892），同样 130 g 的一份就只有 1.8 g。下表中的养殖三文鱼数值应视为上限，对当前的养殖鱼大致折半。USDA 数据库里含量最高的来源都不是鱼柳：鱼子酱每 100 g 含 6,540 mg EPA+DHA，混合鱼卵含 2,343 mg，两者都高于熟鲱鱼。

To match the dose要达到该剂量Two doses with two different answers. The physiological dose (EFSA AI 250 mg/day, evidence range 250-500 mg/day) is easily eaten: one 143 g herring fillet a week averages 410 mg/day, one 130 g farmed salmon portion 399 mg/day, one wild salmon portion 342 mg/day. Two mackerel fillets, two 92 g tins of sardines or two 45 g tins of anchovies a week give 258-302 mg/day. In portion terms 250-500 mg/day is 0.6-1.3 salmon portions, 0.6-1.2 herring fillets, 1.7-3.3 mackerel fillets, 1.9-3.9 tins of sardines, 1.9-3.8 tins of anchovies, 2.8-5.6 trout fillets, or 1.2-2.4 USDA 172 g cans of albacore per week. Tinned light tuna is the weakest realistic route at 370 mg per 165 g can, which is 5 cans a week for 250 mg/day and 9 cans a week for 500 mg/day. The pharmacological dose of 4 g/day used in trials and in prescription products (AHA Science Advisory, Circulation 2019, DOI 10.1161/CIR.0000000000000709; REDUCE-IT used 4 g icosapent ethyl) cannot be eaten. It requires 199 g/day of herring (1.4 kg/week), 186 g/day of farmed salmon on 2006-era composition or 294 g/day on 2015 composition (1.3-2.1 kg/week), 288 g/day of pickled herring, 333 g/day of mackerel (3.8 fillets a day), 407 g/day of sardines (4.4 tins a day), 195 g/day of anchovies (4.3 tins a day, with the sodium load that implies), 61 g/day of caviar (about four tablespoons a day), or 464 g/day of tinned albacore. Above roughly 1 g/day of EPA+DHA, supplements are the only realistic route.两种剂量，两个不同的答案。生理剂量（EFSA AI 250 mg/day，证据区间 250-500 mg/day）很容易靠吃达到：每周一片 143 g 鲱鱼柳平均折合 410 mg/day，每周一份 130 g 养殖三文鱼 399 mg/day，一份野生三文鱼 342 mg/day。每周两片鲭鱼柳、两罐 92 g 沙丁鱼或两罐 45 g 凤尾鱼可提供 258-302 mg/day。换算成份数，250-500 mg/day 相当于每周 0.6-1.3 份三文鱼、0.6-1.2 片鲱鱼柳、1.7-3.3 片鲭鱼柳、1.9-3.9 罐沙丁鱼、1.9-3.8 罐凤尾鱼、2.8-5.6 片鳟鱼柳，或 1.2-2.4 罐 USDA 172 g 装长鳍金枪鱼。罐装淡肉金枪鱼是现实可行路径中最弱的一条，每 165 g 罐仅 370 mg，要达到 250 mg/day 需每周 5 罐，500 mg/day 需每周 9 罐。试验和处方产品所用的 4 g/day 药理剂量（AHA Science Advisory, Circulation 2019, DOI 10.1161/CIR.0000000000000709；REDUCE-IT 使用 4 g icosapent ethyl，即二十碳五烯酸乙酯）无法靠吃达到。它需要每天 199 g 鲱鱼（每周 1.4 kg），按 2006 年成分计每天 186 g 养殖三文鱼、按 2015 年成分计每天 294 g（每周 1.3-2.1 kg），每天 288 g 醋渍鲱鱼，每天 333 g 鲭鱼（每天 3.8 片鱼柳），每天 407 g 沙丁鱼（每天 4.4 罐），每天 195 g 凤尾鱼（每天 4.3 罐，随之而来的还有相应的钠负荷），每天 61 g 鱼子酱（约每天四汤匙），或每天 464 g 罐装长鳍金枪鱼。EPA+DHA 超过大约 1 g/day 之后，补充剂是唯一现实的途径。

Food vs supplement食物与补充剂Whole fish and fish oil are not interchangeable in the evidence base. VITAL randomised 25,871 adults to a 1 g/day capsule supplying 840 mg EPA+DHA (460 mg EPA, 380 mg DHA) and found no reduction in major cardiovascular events (HR 0.92, 95% CI 0.80-1.06) or cancer incidence (HR 1.03) over 5.3 years (Manson 2019, PMID 30415637). The benefit at 4 g/day in REDUCE-IT came from purified prescription EPA rather than a food-equivalent mixture, and high-dose omega-3 carries an atrial fibrillation signal that eating fish does not. On contaminants, the direction of the tradeoff is clear but the numbers are weaker than they look: the FDA/EPA per-species mercury means quoted in the earlier draft (1.45 ppm Gulf of Mexico tilefish, 1.00 swordfish, 0.98 shark, 0.73 king mackerel, 0.35 albacore, 0.13 canned light tuna, 0.01-0.08 for sardine, salmon, anchovy, Atlantic mackerel, trout and herring) could not be retrieved from any live FDA or EPA page, so treat every one of them as indicative and unconfirmed. The tilefish figure in particular should be re-checked, since FDA's published Gulf of Mexico mean is usually cited as 1.123 ppm. What the surviving EPA page does confirm is the qualitative placement: anchovies, Atlantic mackerel, sardines and trout are all 'Best Choices'. Independent synthesis in Karimi 2012 (PMID 22732656) gives grand means of 0.882 ppm for shark and 0.883 ppm for tilefish, and 0.450 ppm for fresh or frozen tuna, which is not the canned product and should not be read as such. The earlier claim that high-mercury predators are also mediocre omega-3 sources has been withdrawn: it rested on a swordfish figure of 108 mg EPA per 85 g with no FDC ID that could not be traced, and an EPA-only figure understates a DHA-dominant fish. Dioxins run the other way, concentrating in the fat of oily fish. EFSA cut the tolerable weekly intake to 2 pg TEQ/kg body weight and reported it exceeded across all European age groups with fatty fish among the top contributors (EFSA Journal 2018;16(11):5333, DOI 10.2903/j.efsa.2018.5333, document confirmed; the '5 to 15 fold' exceedance figure inside it was not independently verified). Refined fish oils must meet 1.75 pg WHO-TEQ/g fat for dioxins and 6.0 pg/g fat for dioxins plus dioxin-like PCBs under Regulation (EU) 2023/915 (limits not re-verified in this pass), so a purified concentrate can carry a lower contaminant load per gram of EPA+DHA than the fish it came from. One processing detail: draining oil-packed tuna pours away omega-3, and it takes both fatty acids with it. Canned white tuna in oil retains 66 mg EPA and 178 mg DHA per 100 g after draining, a total of 244 mg, against 233 mg EPA and 629 mg DHA (862 mg total) for the water-packed product, a 72% loss of total EPA+DHA (USDA FDC 175157 versus 175158, both confirmed).在证据层面，整鱼和鱼油不能互换。VITAL 将 25,871 名成人随机分配至每日 1 g 胶囊（提供 840 mg EPA+DHA，其中 EPA 460 mg、DHA 380 mg），在 5.3 年间未见主要心血管事件减少（HR 0.92, 95% CI 0.80-1.06），癌症发病率也无下降（HR 1.03）（Manson 2019, PMID 30415637）。REDUCE-IT 中 4 g/day 的获益来自纯化的处方级 EPA，这种成分与食物提供的等效混合物并不等同；高剂量欧米伽-3 还带有吃鱼所没有的心房颤动信号。在污染物问题上，权衡的方向是清楚的，但数字比看上去要弱：早前草稿引用的 FDA/EPA 分物种汞均值（墨西哥湾方头鱼 1.45 ppm、剑鱼 1.00、鲨鱼 0.98、王鲭 0.73、长鳍金枪鱼 0.35、罐装淡肉金枪鱼 0.13，沙丁鱼、三文鱼、凤尾鱼、大西洋鲭、鳟鱼和鲱鱼为 0.01-0.08）无法从任何在线的 FDA 或 EPA 页面检索到，因此每一个都应当作参考性且未经确认的数值。其中方头鱼的数值尤其需要复核，因为 FDA 公布的墨西哥湾均值通常被引作 1.123 ppm。仍可访问的 EPA 页面能够确认的是定性分档：凤尾鱼、大西洋鲭、沙丁鱼和鳟鱼均属“最佳选择”（Best Choices）。Karimi 2012（PMID 22732656）的独立汇总给出鲨鱼总均值 0.882 ppm、方头鱼 0.883 ppm，以及鲜或冻金枪鱼 0.450 ppm；后者指的是鲜冻产品，不能当成罐装产品来读。早前关于高汞掠食性鱼类同时也是平庸欧米伽-3 来源的说法已撤回：它依据的是一个每 85 g 含 108 mg EPA 的剑鱼数值，无 FDC ID 且无法追溯，而只看 EPA 的数字会低估以 DHA 为主的鱼类。二噁英的方向相反，它富集在多脂鱼的脂肪中。EFSA 将每周耐受摄入量下调至 2 pg TEQ/kg 体重，并报告欧洲所有年龄组均已超标，多脂鱼是主要贡献来源之一（EFSA Journal 2018;16(11):5333, DOI 10.2903/j.efsa.2018.5333，文件已确认；其中“超标 5 至 15 倍”的数字未经独立核实）。按 Regulation (EU) 2023/915，精炼鱼油的二噁英须不高于 1.75 pg WHO-TEQ/g 脂肪，二噁英加类二噁英 PCBs 须不高于 6.0 pg/g 脂肪（本轮未重新核实这些限值），因此按每克 EPA+DHA 计，纯化浓缩物的污染物负荷可以低于其原料鱼。一个加工细节：沥掉油浸金枪鱼的油会把欧米伽-3 一起倒掉，两种脂肪酸都会流失。油浸白肉金枪鱼罐头沥干后每 100 g 保留 66 mg EPA 和 178 mg DHA，合计 244 mg；水浸产品为 233 mg EPA 和 629 mg DHA（合计 862 mg），EPA+DHA 总量损失 72%（USDA FDC 175157 对 175158，两者均已确认）。

Absorption吸收Chemical form changes absorption measurably. Using natural triglyceride fish oil as the 100% reference, the bioavailability index was 124% for re-esterified triglyceride and 73% for ethyl ester (Dyerberg 2010, PMID 20638827, both values confirmed). The 91% figure for free fatty acid and the 3.1-3.6 g/day matched dose range are consistent with the paper as usually cited but were not independently confirmed. Most cheap concentrates are ethyl esters, which also depend more on a fat-containing meal for absorption, so a 1,000 mg ethyl-ester capsule taken on an empty stomach does not deliver what the label implies. Fish is delivered as natural triglyceride inside a fat and protein matrix and needs no such allowance. Preparation matters more than cooking method: canning in oil and then draining removes omega-3, whereas canning in water and draining does not.化学形式对吸收有可测量的影响。以天然甘油三酯型鱼油为 100% 参照，重新酯化甘油三酯的生物利用度指数为 124%，乙酯型为 73%（Dyerberg 2010, PMID 20638827，两个数值均已确认）。游离脂肪酸的 91% 以及 3.1-3.6 g/day 的匹配剂量区间与该文献常见的引用一致，但未经独立确认。多数廉价浓缩产品是乙酯型，其吸收也更依赖含脂餐食，因此空腹服用一粒 1,000 mg 乙酯型胶囊，实际摄入达不到标签暗示的水平。鱼肉中的欧米伽-3 以天然甘油三酯形式存在于脂肪和蛋白质基质中，无需这类附加条件。加工方式比烹饪方法更重要：油浸罐装再沥干会带走欧米伽-3，水浸罐装沥干则不会。

Food data note食物数据说明All eleven USDA composition rows resolved to exactly the described food with the stated EPA and DHA values, and roughly 60 dose-gap calculations recomputed correctly. The two defects were invented portion weights, now replaced with USDA's own measures. Confidence drops only on the peripheral material: the FDA/EPA per-species mercury means, the EU 2023/915 dioxin limits and the swordfish EPA figure are unconfirmed and are labelled as such高。全部十一行 USDA 成分数据都精确对应所描述的食物及所列 EPA 和 DHA 数值，约 60 项剂量差距计算复算无误。两处缺陷是编造的份量重量，现已替换为 USDA 自带的计量。信心下降只出现在周边材料上：FDA/EPA 分物种汞均值、EU 2023/915 二噁英限值和剑鱼 EPA 数值均未确认，并已如实标注。

Does the body make it身体是否自产Humans can make EPA and DHA, yet only by remodelling a fatty acid they cannot make at all, the plant-derived precursor ALA, and the final steps are the bottleneck. In stable-isotope tracer work the fraction of ingested ALA reaching EPA is 21% in young women, while DHA reaches 9% in young women and stays undetectable in young men for 21 days after dosing, and FADS1 and FADS2 genotype is the largest single modifier between individuals. Because the pathway cannot be driven harder, tissue DHA tracks intake of preformed DHA and barely responds to ALA, so preformed EPA and DHA is one of the few supplements the endogenous route genuinely cannot make redundant.人体能合成 EPA 和 DHA，但只能通过改造一种自己完全无法合成的脂肪酸，即来自植物的前体 ALA，而最后几步是瓶颈。稳定同位素示踪研究显示，摄入的 ALA 转化到 EPA 的比例在年轻女性中为 21%，到 DHA 在年轻女性中为 9%，在年轻男性中给药后 21 天内始终检测不到，而 FADS1 和 FADS2 基因型是个体间转化效率最大的单一修饰因素。由于这条通路无法被推得更快，组织 DHA 跟随现成 DHA 的摄入变化，对 ALA 几乎没有反应，所以现成的 EPA 和 DHA 属于少数几种内源途径确实无法使之变得多余的补充剂。

Pathway合成通路ALA 18:3n-3 → FADS2 (delta-6 desaturase) → 18:4n-3 → ELOVL5 → 20:4n-3 → FADS1 (delta-5 desaturase) → EPA 20:5n-3 → ELOVL5 and ELOVL2 → DPA 22:5n-3 → ELOVL2 → 24:5n-3 → FADS2 again (delta-6, the same enzyme reused) → 24:6n-3 → one round of peroxisomal beta-oxidation (ACOX1, D-bifunctional protein) → DHA 22:6n-3, then re-esterified in the endoplasmic reticulum. Mainly hepatic; linoleic acid competes for the same FADS2 step.ALA 18:3n-3 → FADS2（delta-6 去饱和酶）→ 18:4n-3 → ELOVL5 → 20:4n-3 → FADS1（delta-5 去饱和酶）→ EPA 20:5n-3 → ELOVL5 和 ELOVL2 → DPA 22:5n-3 → ELOVL2 → 24:5n-3 → 再次用 FADS2（delta-6，同一个酶重复使用）→ 24:6n-3 → 一轮过氧化物酶体 beta 氧化（ACOX1，D-双功能蛋白）→ DHA 22:6n-3，随后在内质网重新酯化。主要发生在肝脏；亚油酸在同一个 FADS2 步骤上与之竞争。

Amount made自产量Established as fractional conversion of ALA rather than as mg/d, and the figures are not commensurable because the denominators differ. Burdge and Wootton 2002: net fractional interconversion estimated within the plasma tracer pool (phosphatidylcholine, TAG and non-esterified fatty acids) over 21 days after a single 700 mg dose of 13C-ALA, young women EPA 21%, DPA 6%, DHA 9%. Burdge, Jones and Wootton 2002: in young men EPA and DPA appear while DHA stays undetectable to 21 days. Absolute mg/d of endogenous EPA and DHA: NOT ESTABLISHED.这一项以 ALA 的分数转化率而非 mg/d 确立，下面几组数值的分母不同，彼此不可直接比较。Burdge 与 Wootton 2002：单次 700 mg 13C-ALA 给药后 21 天内，在血浆示踪池（磷脂酰胆碱、TAG 和非酯化脂肪酸）中估算的净分数转化，年轻女性 EPA 21%，DPA 6%，DHA 9%。Burdge、Jones 与 Wootton 2002：年轻男性只出现 EPA 和 DPA，21 天内检测不到 DHA。内源 EPA 和 DHA 的绝对量（mg/d）：NOT ESTABLISHED（未确立）。

Still matters when仍有意义的情形Justified for anyone not eating oily fish, and specifically in pregnancy and lactation for fetal and infant DHA accretion, in vegans and vegetarians, in adult men whose measured ALA to DHA conversion is effectively nil, and at pharmacological doses for hypertriglyceridaemia. Partial synthesis does not cover requirement here, so the supplement is doing real work.不吃多脂鱼的人都有理由使用，尤其是妊娠和哺乳期（为胎儿和婴儿累积 DHA）、纯素和素食者、实测 ALA 转 DHA 基本为零的成年男性，以及以药理剂量治疗高甘油三酯血症。部分合成在这里不足以覆盖需要量，补充剂确实在起作用。

Synthesis source合成来源Burdge GC, Wootton SA. Br J Nutr. 2002;88(4):411-20. PMID 12323090, DOI 10.1079/BJN2002689 (women: EPA 21%, DPA 6%, DHA 9%). Burdge GC, Jones AE, Wootton SA. Br J Nutr. 2002;88(4):355-63. PMID 12323085, DOI 10.1079/BJN2002662 (men). Mapped from the recovered entry Omega-3 (EPA and DHA), with the men's citation completed from the parallel recovered omega-3 rows.

05Consider it可以考虑

Defensible in one specific situation. Outside it there is no case.只在一种特定情形下站得住。离开那个情形就没有理由。

CCBBFFDDBBXXMagnesium镁
Verdict结论Consider可以考虑
Evidence证据Grade BB 级
Dose tested已验证剂量365 mg/d elemental for blood pressure. Note magnesium oxide is 60% elemental, citrate 16%, bisglycinate 14%.降血压用元素镁 365 毫克/天。注意氧化镁含 60% 元素镁，柠檬酸镁 16%，甘氨酸螯合镁 14%。
Who适用人群People with documented low magnesium, chronic proton pump inhibitor or diuretic users, alcohol use disorder, and treated hypertensives.已证实镁偏低者、长期使用质子泵抑制剂或利尿剂者、酒精使用障碍者、已在服药的高血压患者。
Pros优点
  • Blood pressure falls by a real amount in the right people: -5.97 mmHg systolic in the hypomagnesaemic and -7.68 mmHg in treated hypertensives.在合适的人身上血压确有下降：低镁血症者收缩压降 5.97 mmHg，已服药的高血压患者降 7.68 mmHg。
  • Proton-pump-inhibitor-induced hypomagnesaemia is an established, under-recognised clinical problem that this genuinely fixes.质子泵抑制剂引起的低镁血症是一个确凿而常被忽视的临床问题，补镁确实能解决。
  • Cheap, and dietary intake is genuinely low in many Western diets.便宜，而且在许多西方饮食中摄入量确实偏低。
Cons缺点
  • In replete normotensive people the pooled blood pressure effect did not reach significance. The general-population heart-health pitch is unsupported.在镁充足且血压正常的人中，合并的降压效应未达显著。面向普通人群的“护心”说法没有依据。
  • The sleep claim, now the dominant marketing angle, rests on 3 trials and 151 older adults, all at moderate to high risk of bias, and the review authors called the literature substandard for making recommendations.如今主导营销的助眠说法，只建立在 3 项试验、151 名老年人之上，全部为中高偏倚风险，综述作者直言这些文献的质量不足以据此提出建议。
  • The 600 mg/d migraine dose exceeds the US supplemental upper limit of 350 mg and is 2.4 times the EFSA limit of 250 mg. Diarrhoea is the dose-limiting effect.偏头痛用的 600 毫克/天超过美国 350 毫克的补充剂上限，是 EFSA 250 毫克上限的 2.4 倍。腹泻是剂量限制性反应。
  • Contraindicated without supervision in chronic kidney disease stage 4-5 and dialysis, where hypermagnesaemia causes bradycardia, hypotension and respiratory depression. Also in myasthenia gravis.慢性肾病 4 至 5 期和透析患者未经监督禁用，高镁血症会导致心动过缓、低血压和呼吸抑制。重症肌无力同样禁用。
  • Chelates tetracyclines, fluoroquinolones and bisphosphonates. Separate by 2-4 hours.会与四环素类、氟喹诺酮类和双膦酸盐螯合。间隔 2 至 4 小时。
What it does, and what happens without it它有什么作用，缺了会怎样

A cofactor in hundreds of reactions; every molecule of ATP works bound to magnesium.数百种反应的辅因子;每一分子ATP都要与镁结合才能发挥作用。

Named deficiency disease有明确的缺乏症 Fully reversible完全可逆

In detail详细The biologically active form of ATP is Mg-ATP, so magnesium is an obligate participant in every kinase reaction, every ATPase and both DNA and RNA polymerases, more than 300 enzymes in total. It acts as a physiological calcium antagonist: it blocks the NMDA receptor channel at rest and dampens calcium entry in vascular smooth muscle and myocardium, which is why depletion raises neuromuscular excitability and arrhythmia risk. Magnesium is also required both for parathyroid hormone secretion and for end-organ response to it, so depletion produces a hypocalcaemia that will not correct until magnesium is replaced. About 60% of body magnesium is locked in bone and most of the rest is intracellular, leaving only about 1% in serum. Serum magnesium is therefore a poor guide to total body status and can be normal in a genuinely depleted person.ATP的生物活性形式是Mg-ATP,因此镁是每一个激酶反应、每一种ATP酶以及DNA和RNA聚合酶不可或缺的参与者,涉及的酶总数超过300种。镁还是一种生理性钙拮抗剂:静息状态下它阻断NMDA受体通道,并减弱血管平滑肌和心肌中的钙内流,这就是镁耗竭会提高神经肌肉兴奋性和心律失常风险的原因。甲状旁腺激素的分泌及靶器官对其的反应也都需要镁,因此镁耗竭会导致低钙血症,且在补镁之前无法纠正。人体内约60%的镁封存在骨骼中,其余大部分位于细胞内,血清中仅占约1%。因此血清镁并不能很好地反映体内总镁状态,即使在真正镁耗竭的人身上也可能正常。

Deficiency disease缺乏症Symptomatic hypomagnesaemia (ICD-10 E83.4). There is no eponymous deficiency disease; the severe presentation is hypomagnesaemic tetany with refractory hypocalcaemia and hypokalaemia. Inherited renal magnesium wasting (Gitelman syndrome, familial hypomagnesaemia with hypercalciuria) is a genetic tubular disorder rather than a dietary deficiency.症状性低镁血症(ICD-10 E83.4)。没有以人名命名的缺乏病;严重表现为低镁性手足搐搦,伴顽固性低钙血症和低钾血症。遗传性肾性失镁(Gitelman综合征、家族性低镁血症伴高钙尿症)属于遗传性肾小管疾病,不是饮食性缺乏。

First signs早期表现Usually nothing at all. Low dietary intake shows up as intake below the estimated average requirement with a normal serum magnesium, because the kidney conserves aggressively. The first things a person notices are muscle cramps, eyelid or hand tremor, and irritability or poor sleep, all of which are non-specific. In practice a low serum magnesium is most often spotted incidentally on a metabolic panel run for unexplained hypokalaemia or hypocalcaemia.通常完全没有症状。低摄入表现为摄入量低于估计平均需要量,而血清镁正常,因为肾脏会积极地保留镁。患者最先察觉到的是肌肉痉挛、眼睑或手部震颤,以及易激惹或睡眠不佳,这些表现都缺乏特异性。实际中,血清镁偏低最常是在为不明原因低钾血症或低钙血症所做的代谢检查中偶然发现的。

Untreated不治疗会怎样Tetany with positive Chvostek and Trousseau signs, paraesthesiae, seizures, and cardiac arrhythmias including atrial fibrillation and torsades de pointes. Accompanying hypokalaemia and hypocalcaemia resist correction until magnesium itself is replaced, which is the clinically important teaching point. Severe cases are almost always driven by drug or gastrointestinal or renal losses rather than by diet alone.手足搐搦,Chvostek征和Trousseau征阳性,感觉异常,癫痫发作,以及心律失常,包括心房颤动和尖端扭转型室速。伴随的低钾血症和低钙血症在补镁之前均难以纠正,这是临床上的重要教学要点。严重病例几乎总是由药物或消化道、肾脏丢失所致,而非单纯饮食因素。

Does it reverse补回来能修复吗Repletion corrects the neuromuscular and cardiac features and allows the linked potassium and calcium abnormalities to correct, with no residual deficit once the underlying cause is addressed. The one caveat is timing rather than permanence: serum magnesium normalises before body stores do, so bone and intracellular pools take days to weeks to refill and stopping too early lets the deficit return.补镁可纠正神经肌肉和心脏方面的表现,并使相关的钾、钙异常随之纠正,一旦基础病因得到处理就不会遗留缺陷。这里需要注意的只是恢复所需的时间:血清镁的恢复正常早于体内总储备的恢复,骨骼和细胞内的镁池需要数天至数周才能补足,过早停止补充会导致缺乏复发。

Who becomes deficient谁会缺乏Chronic alcohol use, one of the leading causes. Gastrointestinal losses from chronic diarrhoea, malabsorption, short bowel and after bariatric surgery, together with renal losses, account for a large share of clinically encountered hypomagnesaemia. Long-term proton pump inhibitor use, which can cause profound hypomagnesaemia. Loop and thiazide diuretics, cisplatin, amphotericin, and calcineurin inhibitors; drug causes dominate in hospital populations. Poorly controlled diabetes with osmotic diuresis. Refeeding syndrome. In someone with normal kidneys and a normal gut, diet alone rarely produces symptomatic deficiency.长期饮酒,是主要病因之一。慢性腹泻、吸收不良、短肠综合征及减重手术后引起的消化道丢失,连同肾脏丢失,构成了临床所见低镁血症的很大一部分。长期使用质子泵抑制剂,可引起严重低镁血症。袢利尿剂和噻嗪类利尿剂、顺铂、两性霉素及钙调神经磷酸酶抑制剂;药物性病因在住院人群中占主导。血糖控制不佳伴渗透性利尿的糖尿病患者。再喂养综合征。对于肾脏和肠道功能均正常的人,单纯饮食因素很少导致症状性缺镁。

How common有多常见About 48% of Americans of all ages consume less magnesium from food and beverages than their estimated average requirement (NHANES 2013-2016). Clinically significant hypomagnesaemia is less common than that figure suggests: roughly 2.5% to 15% in the general population, rising to about 10% to 20% of hospitalised patients and higher in intensive care. The gap between the intake figure and the clinical one is why low intake is often overstated as widespread deficiency.约48%的美国人(各年龄段合计)从食物和饮料中摄入的镁低于其估计平均需要量(NHANES 2013至2016)。具有临床意义的低镁血症并不像这一数字所暗示的那样普遍:一般人群中约为2.5%至15%,住院患者中升至约10%至20%,重症监护患者中更高。摄入不足数字与临床数字之间的差距,正是低摄入常被夸大为普遍缺乏的原因。

Source来源NIH Office of Dietary Supplements, Magnesium Health Professional Fact Sheet, ods.od.nih.gov/factsheets/Magnesium-HealthProfessional (NHANES 2013-2016 intake data); Ayuk J, Gittoes NJL, Ann Clin Biochem 2014;51:179-188, PMID 24402002 (contemporary view of hypomagnesaemia; 2.5-15% general population); Gragossian A et al., Hypomagnesemia, StatPearls, NCBI Bookshelf NBK500003.

Food and the body食物与身体
In food: Rich食物中：丰富 Dose from food: Reachable靠吃达到剂量：可达到 Body makes it: Cannot身体自产：不能 Food data: High食物数据：高

Magnesium sits in the chlorophyll molecule and in the outer layers of seeds and grains, so every unrefined plant food carries some; nuts, seeds, cocoa, wholegrains, legumes and dark leafy greens are all meaningful contributors, and a mixed diet built on them reaches the adult RDA (420 mg/day men 31+, 320 mg/day women 31+, Institute of Medicine 1997) with no supplement. Refining is what strips it, and the honest like-for-like comparison is CoFID wholemeal bread at 66 mg/100 g against white bread at 22 mg/100 g (11-981 and 11-1145), a three-fold gap. The wheat bran figure of 389 mg/100 g (CoFID 11-906) is a dry milling fraction, so setting it against a roughly 40%-water baked loaf inflates the effect of refining to eighteen-fold and should not be used that way.镁存在于叶绿素分子中，也集中在种子和谷物的外层，因此任何未精制的植物性食物都含有一定量；坚果、种子、可可、全谷物、豆类和深色叶菜都是有意义的贡献者，以它们为基础的混合膳食无需补充剂就能达到成人 RDA（31 岁以上男性 420 mg/天，31 岁以上女性 320 mg/天，Institute of Medicine 1997）。真正把镁剥掉的是精制加工，诚实的同类对比是 CoFID 全麦面包 66 mg/100 g 对白面包 22 mg/100 g（11-981 和 11-1145），相差三倍。麦麸的 389 mg/100 g（CoFID 11-906）是干磨组分，把它拿去和含水量约 40% 的烤制面包对比，会把精制的影响夸大到十八倍，不应这样使用。

To match the dose要达到该剂量Supplements are sold at 200 to 400 mg elemental magnesium, which is the whole daily requirement, and ordinary food covers that range easily. A worked day: 1 oz pumpkin seeds (156 mg) plus 1 cup cooked black beans (120 mg) plus 1 oz 70-85% dark chocolate (65 mg) is 341 mg before anything else on the plate is counted. Single-food routes are absurd by comparison: 400 mg from dark chocolate alone means 175 g of bar, roughly 1,000 kcal, and 400 mg from wholemeal bread alone means 533 g, about 17 slices. Nobody needs a single-food route, because the mixed-diet route is three normal portions. The safety asymmetry matters more than the arithmetic: the Institute of Medicine set the 350 mg/day upper limit for supplemental magnesium only, and it explicitly excludes magnesium naturally present in food and water, so 700 mg of magnesium from seeds and beans carries no upper limit while 400 mg from tablets is already over the supplemental ceiling. A comparable 250 mg/day EU limit for magnesium added through supplements or fortified foods is normally attributed to the SCF 2001 opinion; the source text could not be retrieved during verification, so that figure is carried here as indicative and unconfirmed.补充剂的售卖规格是 200 至 400 mg 元素镁，也就是一整天的需要量，而普通食物很容易覆盖这个区间。一天的实际算法：1 oz 南瓜籽（156 mg）加 1 杯熟黑豆（120 mg）加 1 oz 70-85% 黑巧克力（65 mg），在盘子里其他东西都还没算进来时就已经是 341 mg。相比之下，单一食物路线荒唐得多：只靠黑巧克力吃到 400 mg 意味着 175 g 巧克力，大约 1,000 kcal；只靠全麦面包吃到 400 mg 意味着 533 g，约 17 片。没有人需要单一食物路线，混合膳食路线只是三份正常分量。算术之外，安全性上的不对称影响更大：Institute of Medicine 设定的 350 mg/天 上限只针对补充剂形式的镁，并明确排除食物和水中天然存在的镁，因此来自种子和豆类的 700 mg 镁不受上限约束，而来自片剂的 400 mg 已经超过补充剂的上限。欧盟对通过补充剂或强化食品添加的镁设有相当的 250 mg/天 限值，通常归于 SCF 2001 意见书；核查期间无法获取原文，因此该数字在此仅作参考，未经确认。

Food vs supplement食物与补充剂The difference is dose kinetics rather than chemistry. Food delivers magnesium in small amounts across a day inside a matrix that slows release, so the unabsorbed fraction stays small and osmotic diarrhoea does not happen. A 400 mg bolus of a soluble magnesium salt leaves a large unabsorbed load in the gut lumen, and that load is the mechanism of the laxative effect that set the upper limit in the first place. Magnesium citrate and magnesium hydroxide are marketed as laxatives at doses close to supplement doses. In anyone with reduced renal clearance (CKD stage 4-5, elderly patients on multiple drugs) supplements can cause symptomatic hypermagnesaemia, while food magnesium is handled by renal excretion across the normal intake range. There is no situation where the food form is the risky one.差别在于剂量动力学，与化学性质无关。食物在一天之内以小剂量提供镁，并且处在减缓释放的基质里，未被吸收的部分始终很少，不会引起渗透性腹泻。一次 400 mg 可溶性镁盐会在肠腔留下大量未吸收的负荷，这一负荷正是当初设定上限所依据的导泻机制。柠檬酸镁和氢氧化镁本身就以接近补充剂剂量的剂量作为泻药销售。在肾清除率下降的人群中（CKD 4-5 期、同时服用多种药物的老年患者），补充剂可造成有症状的高镁血症，而食物来源的镁在正常摄入范围内由肾排泄处理。不存在食物形式反而更危险的情形。

Absorption吸收Net absorption of dietary magnesium is 40 to 60% at an intake averaging 380 mg/day, falling to 15-36% at higher daily intakes of 550 to 850 mg (Institute of Medicine DRI report 1997, Chapter 6, NCBI Bookshelf NBK109816). NIH ODS quotes 30-40% for public guidance, so the working figure should be the lower half of the DRI range rather than the 50% midpoint. Phytate is the main food inhibitor and can cut fractional absorption by up to 60% in a dose-dependent way, so the magnesium in bran, seeds and legumes is not fully realised. Oxalate matters much less than the textbook version implies: Bohn et al. (Br J Nutr 2004;91:601-606) measured 26.7% fractional absorption from a spinach meal against 36.5% from kale and concluded the spinach penalty is at least partly counterbalanced by its higher native magnesium content, so a cooked cup of spinach delivers roughly 42 mg absorbed against roughly 11 mg from a cooked cup of kale. Supplement forms differ sharply among themselves: Firoz and Graber (Magnesium Research 2001;14(4):257-262, PMID 11794633) measured fractional absorption of about 4% for magnesium oxide against 9-11% for the lactate, aspartate and chloride forms, and magnesium oxide is the cheapest and most widely sold form. A 400 mg magnesium oxide tablet can therefore deliver less absorbed magnesium than a handful of pumpkin seeds while producing the loose stools.在平均摄入 380 mg/天 时，膳食镁的净吸收率为 40 至 60%；当日摄入量升到 550 至 850 mg，吸收率降至 15-36%（Institute of Medicine DRI 报告 1997，第 6 章，NCBI Bookshelf NBK109816）。NIH ODS 在公众指导中引用 30-40%，因此实际取值应落在 DRI 区间的下半段，而不取 50% 的中点。植酸是食物中的主要抑制因素，可以按剂量依赖的方式把吸收分数削减最多 60%，所以麦麸、种子和豆类里的镁并没有被完全实现。草酸的影响远小于教科书版本的说法：Bohn 等（Br J Nutr 2004;91:601-606）测得菠菜餐的吸收分数为 26.7%，羽衣甘蓝为 36.5%，并认为菠菜的损失至少部分被其本身较高的镁含量抵消，因此一杯熟菠菜实际提供约 42 mg 吸收量，一杯熟羽衣甘蓝约 11 mg。补充剂各形式之间差别很大：Firoz 和 Graber（Magnesium Research 2001;14(4):257-262，PMID 11794633）测得氧化镁的吸收分数约 4%，乳酸镁、天门冬氨酸镁和氯化镁为 9-11%，而氧化镁恰恰是最便宜、卖得最多的形式。因此一片 400 mg 氧化镁提供的可吸收镁可能少于一小把南瓜籽，同时还带来稀便。

Food data note食物数据说明for composition and arithmetic: verification checked every cited FDC ID against the USDA SR Legacy April 2018 dataset and every CoFID code against CoFID 2021, and found no fabricated identifier, no wrong per-100 g value and no wrong portion weight, with all per-portion multiplications reproducing. Two lower-confidence pockets are flagged in place: the mineral water row carries no sourced figure at all, and the flaxseed, wheat germ, wheat bran and cocoa portion weights are conventions rather than dataset portions. The EU SCF 250 mg/day added-magnesium limit is consistent with the standard figure but was not confirmable from the source text组成与算术为高：核查把每个引用的 FDC ID 对照 USDA SR Legacy 2018 年 4 月数据集、每个 CoFID 代码对照 CoFID 2021 逐一检查，未发现编造的标识符、错误的每 100 g 数值或错误的分量重量，所有按分量的乘算也都能复现。两处置信度较低的地方已就地标注：矿泉水那一行完全没有来源数值；亚麻籽、小麦胚芽、麦麸和可可粉的分量重量属于惯例，并非数据集分量。欧盟 SCF 关于添加镁 250 mg/天 的限值与通行数字一致，但无法从原文确认。

Does the body make it身体是否自产Magnesium is chemical element 12 and cannot be synthesised, so all of the roughly 25 g in an adult body came from food. Bone holds 50 to 60% of it and the kidney adjusts reabsorption tightly, which buffers short-term intake gaps and is also why serum magnesium is a poor guide to total body stores. With synthesis at zero, the only question is whether habitual intake, drug use or renal and gastrointestinal losses justify supplementing, and for a large share of the population intake alone does.镁是12号化学元素，无法合成，成人体内约 25 g 镁全部来自食物。骨骼中占其 50 至 60%，肾脏对重吸收有紧密调节，这既缓冲了短期摄入缺口，也是血清镁不能代表全身储量的原因。合成为零，剩下的问题只有：习惯摄入量、用药、肾脏和胃肠道损失是否构成补充的理由。对相当大一部分人群来说，仅摄入量这一条就已经构成理由。

Pathway合成通路NOT APPLICABLE (chemical element). Handling only: TRPM6 and TRPM7 channels for intestinal and distal tubular uptake, with TRPM6 activity regulated by EGF acting through EGFR, efflux by the CNNM proteins (CNNM2 in kidney and brain, CNNM4 in intestine) and SLC41, paracellular reabsorption through claudin-16 and claudin-19 in the thick ascending limb, and bone as the exchangeable reservoir.NOT APPLICABLE（不适用：化学元素）。只有体内处理：TRPM6 和 TRPM7 通道负责肠道和肾远曲小管的摄取，其中 TRPM6 的活性受 EGF 经 EGFR 调节；外排由 CNNM 蛋白（肾和脑中的 CNNM2，肠道中的 CNNM4）和 SLC41 承担；肾脏髓袢升支粗段通过 claudin-16 和 claudin-19 进行细胞旁重吸收；骨骼充当可交换储库。

Amount made自产量0 mg/d synthesised. Reference points: adult body content about 25 g, 50 to 60% of it in bone; RDA 400-420 mg/d men and 310-320 mg/d women; UL 350 mg/d for supplemental magnesium only, with food magnesium uncapped.合成量 0 mg/d。参照点：成人体内含量约 25 g，其中 50 至 60% 在骨骼；RDA 男性 400-420 mg/d，女性 310-320 mg/d；UL 350 mg/d 只针对补充剂形式的镁，食物中的镁不设上限。

Still matters when仍有意义的情形Justified by intake or loss: habitual intake below the EAR, proton pump inhibitors, loop and thiazide diuretics, chronic alcohol use, type 2 diabetes, Crohn disease or coeliac disease, refeeding, documented hypomagnesaemia. Not justified as a routine add-on on an already adequate diet, where the main effect of surplus oral magnesium salts is osmotic diarrhoea.摄入或损失构成理由：习惯摄入低于 EAR、质子泵抑制剂、袢利尿剂和噻嗪类利尿剂、长期饮酒、2型糖尿病、克罗恩病或乳糜泻、再喂养、已记录的低镁血症。膳食本已充足时把它当常规附加品没有依据，多余的口服镁盐主要造成渗透性腹泻。

Synthesis source合成来源NIH Office of Dietary Supplements, Magnesium Fact Sheet for Health Professionals; IOM, Dietary Reference Intakes for Calcium, Phosphorus, Magnesium, Vitamin D and Fluoride (RDA values and the 350 mg/d UL for supplemental magnesium). Mapped from the recovered entry Magnesium.

Refs.文献 Argeros Hypertension 2025 PMID 41000008; Mah & Pitre PMID 33865376; Peikert PMID 8792038
CCBBFFDDBBXXZinc lozenges锌含片
Verdict结论Consider可以考虑
Evidence证据Grade BB 级
Dose tested已验证剂量75-100 mg/d elemental, split into 6-8 lozenges, started within 24 hours of symptom onset and stopped when symptoms resolve.元素锌 75 至 100 毫克/天，分 6 至 8 片含服，症状出现 24 小时内开始，症状消失即停。
Who适用人群Someone at the very start of a cold who will actually follow the lozenge schedule.感冒刚起、且真的能按含片时间表执行的人。
Pros优点
  • Cold duration shortens. Hemila found -33% (21-45%) across lozenge trials, with no additional benefit above 100 mg/d.感冒病程会缩短。Hemila 在含片试验中得到 -33%（21-45%），且超过 100 毫克/天没有额外收益。
  • Cheap, and the treatment window is short enough that the copper risk does not apply.便宜，而且疗程短到不会触发铜缺乏的风险。
  • Zinc for acute childhood diarrhoea in deficient populations is a separate and much stronger indication, used as standard of care in low-income settings.在缺锌人群中用锌治疗儿童急性腹泻是另一个适应证，证据强得多，在低收入地区已是标准治疗。
Cons缺点
  • The evidence is genuinely contested, and honest reporting means saying so. Cochrane 2024 rated duration LOW certainty at -2.37 days, found prevention null and severity null. Hemila published a methodological rebuttal alleging Cochrane pooled a 190 mg/d lozenge trial with a 0.046 mg/d nasal trial, a 4,300-fold dose difference.证据确实存在争议，诚实的做法是把这一点说出来。Cochrane 2024 把病程缩短 2.37 天评为低确定性，并发现预防无效、严重程度无改善。Hemila 发表了方法学反驳，指出 Cochrane 把一项 190 毫克/天的含片试验与一项 0.046 毫克/天的鼻用试验合并，剂量相差 4300 倍。
  • Chronic intake above 40 mg/d causes copper depletion, which produces sideroblastic anaemia, neutropenia and an irreversible myelopathy that mimics subacute combined degeneration. This is the reason the treatment must be short.长期摄入超过 40 毫克/天会造成铜缺乏，引起铁粒幼细胞性贫血、中性粒细胞减少，以及一种模仿亚急性联合变性的不可逆脊髓病。这正是疗程必须短的原因。
  • Formulation matters and most retail lozenges are wrong. Citric acid and sorbitol bind zinc and stop it being released.剂型很关键，而多数零售含片是错的。柠檬酸和山梨醇会结合锌，使其无法释放。
  • Chelates fluoroquinolones and tetracyclines. Nasal zinc caused permanent anosmia and should never be used.会与氟喹诺酮类和四环素类螯合。鼻用锌曾造成永久性嗅觉丧失，绝不可使用。
What it does, and what happens without it它有什么作用，缺了会怎样

Zinc runs hundreds of enzymes; the lozenge form targets cold symptoms in the throat.锌驱动数百种酶;含片剂型则针对咽喉部的感冒症状。

Named deficiency disease有明确的缺乏症 Partly reversible部分可逆

In detail详细Zinc is a structural or catalytic component of more than 300 enzymes and of the roughly 2,000 zinc-finger transcription factors that bind DNA, so it is required for gene expression, DNA and RNA synthesis, and cell division. Tissues with fast turnover fail first: gut mucosa, skin, growth plate cartilage, and lymphocytes. Thymic function and T-cell development are zinc-dependent, which is the basis of the immune effects. The lozenge specifically is a different proposition from nutrition: it works (where it works) by releasing ionic zinc onto the oropharyngeal mucosa, where it appears to interfere with rhinovirus replication and ICAM-1 binding locally. That is a short-course pharmacological use in someone whose zinc status is usually normal. Lozenges are a poor way to correct systemic deficiency. On the toxicity side, sustained intake above the 40 mg/day tolerable upper limit induces intestinal metallothionein and progressively impairs copper status; the upper limit itself rests on a marginal fall in erythrocyte superoxide dismutase at around 60 mg/day, a biochemical rather than a clinical endpoint. Frank copper-deficiency anaemia and myeloneuropathy are reported at prolonged intakes several times higher, in the region of 100 to 300 mg/day, typically from high-dose supplements or zinc-containing denture cream.锌是300多种酶的结构或催化成分,也是约2,000种结合DNA的锌指(zinc finger)转录因子的组成部分,因此是基因表达、DNA和RNA合成以及细胞分裂所必需的。更新速度快的组织最先受累:肠黏膜、皮肤、生长板软骨和淋巴细胞。胸腺功能和T细胞发育依赖锌,这是其免疫作用的基础。锌含片本身是与营养补充不同的用法:它(在起效时)通过向口咽黏膜释放离子锌发挥作用,在局部似乎能干扰鼻病毒(rhinovirus)复制及其与ICAM-1的结合。这是一种针对锌状态通常正常者的短程药理学用法。含片并不是纠正全身性缺锌的良好方式。在毒性方面,长期摄入超过每日40毫克的可耐受最高摄入量会诱导肠道金属硫蛋白(metallothionein)生成,并逐渐损害铜的状态;这一上限本身依据的是每日约60毫克摄入时红细胞超氧化物歧化酶(superoxide dismutase)出现的轻微下降,这是一个生化终点,不是临床终点。明显的铜缺乏性贫血和脊髓神经病变见于长期摄入量高出数倍、约每日100至300毫克的情况,通常来自高剂量补充剂或含锌义齿粘合剂。

Deficiency disease缺乏症Nutritional zinc deficiency (growth failure, chronic diarrhoea, impaired immunity, characteristic dermatitis). Acrodermatitis enteropathica is the inherited form, caused by SLC39A4 mutations impairing zinc uptake, and is a genetic disorder rather than a consequence of diet.营养性缺锌(生长发育不良、慢性腹泻、免疫功能受损、特征性皮炎)。Acrodermatitis enteropathica(肠病性肢端皮炎)是其遗传性形式,由SLC39A4基因突变导致锌摄取受损引起。这是一种遗传性疾病,不是饮食因素造成的。

First signs早期表现Blunted taste and smell, poor appetite, slow wound healing, and infections that are more frequent and last longer. In children, growth velocity crosses centiles downward before any skin change appears. There is no good early biomarker: plasma zinc falls only late, drops during any inflammatory episode, and varies with time of day and recent meals, so a normal plasma zinc does not exclude deficiency.味觉和嗅觉减退、食欲不振、伤口愈合缓慢,以及感染更频繁且病程更长。在儿童中,生长速度会先跨百分位曲线下降,之后才出现皮肤改变。目前没有良好的早期生物标志物:血浆锌只有在晚期才下降,任何炎症发作期间都会降低,并随一天中的时间和近期进食而波动,因此血浆锌正常并不能排除缺锌。

Untreated不治疗会怎样Stunting and delayed sexual maturation in children, persistent diarrhoea that worsens the deficiency in a loop, alopecia, and a distinctive bullous, crusted dermatitis around the mouth, eyes, genitals and on the hands and feet. Cell-mediated immunity is impaired, with thymic atrophy and reduced T-cell counts. In young children in low-income settings, zinc deficiency contributes measurably to deaths from diarrhoeal disease and pneumonia.儿童出现生长迟缓和性成熟延迟,持续性腹泻又反过来加重缺锌形成恶性循环,还有脱发,以及口周、眼周、外阴部和手足部特征性的大疱性结痂皮炎。细胞介导免疫功能受损,表现为胸腺萎缩和T细胞计数下降。在低收入地区的幼儿中,缺锌对腹泻病和肺炎死亡有可测量的促成作用。

Does it reverse补回来能修复吗Dermatitis, taste disturbance, diarrhoea and immune function recover within days to a few weeks of repletion, and the response is often dramatic. Linear growth is the part that does not fully catch up: height lost during a prolonged deficiency spanning a growth period is only partly recovered, and final adult stature can remain reduced.皮炎、味觉障碍、腹泻和免疫功能在补锌后数天至数周内恢复,而且往往恢复明显。线性生长是无法完全追赶的部分:在跨越生长期的长期缺锌中损失的身高只能部分恢复,成年后最终身高可能仍然偏矮。

Who becomes deficient谁会缺乏People on cereal-based diets high in phytate with little animal protein, which is the dominant global pattern. Children in low-income settings. Malabsorption from Crohn's disease, coeliac disease or short bowel; bariatric surgery. Chronic alcohol use, which causes urinary zinc loss. Chronic diarrhoea, sickle cell disease, and older adults with restricted intake. High-dose supplemental iron taken at the same time competes for the same absorptive route.以谷物为主、富含植酸而动物蛋白摄入少的饮食人群,这是全球最主要的膳食模式。低收入地区的儿童。因克罗恩病、乳糜泻或短肠导致吸收不良者;接受过减重手术者。长期饮酒者,会造成尿锌丢失增加。慢性腹泻患者、镰状细胞病患者,以及摄入受限的老年人。同时服用高剂量铁补充剂会竞争同一吸收通路。

How common有多常见An estimated 17.3% of the world's population is at risk of inadequate zinc intake, based on national food-supply zinc availability (Wessells and Brown, 2012). Clinically overt nutritional zinc deficiency in healthy adults in high-income countries is uncommon.根据各国食物供应中的锌可获得量估算,全球约17.3%的人口存在锌摄入不足风险(Wessells and Brown, 2012)。在高收入国家健康成人中,临床明显的营养性缺锌并不常见。

Source来源Wessells KR, Brown KH. PLoS One 2012;7:e50568, PMID 23209782; King JC et al., J Nutr 2016;146:858S-885S (IZiNCG biomarkers); Hemila H et al., Br J Clin Pharmacol 2016;82:1393-1398 (individual patient data meta-analysis, zinc acetate lozenges and common cold duration); Hemila H, JRSM Open 2017;8(5):2054270417694291 (zinc acetate versus gluconate and dose); NIH Office of Dietary Supplements, Zinc Fact Sheet for Health Professionals (UL 40 mg/d, basis and copper interaction).

Food and the body食物与身体
In food: Rich食物中：丰富 Dose from food: Out of reach靠吃达到剂量：达不到 Body makes it: Cannot身体自产：不能 Food data: High食物数据：高

Two separate questions share a mineral name here, and they get different answers. Zinc the nutrient is abundant in ordinary food: oysters are the outlier of the entire composition table, red meat and offal follow, and wheat germ, seeds and legumes carry useful amounts, so on the question of whether the substance is in food the answer is RICH. Zinc lozenges are not a nutritional product: the trials used more than 75 mg/day of elemental zinc, most commonly 80 to 92 mg/day and in two trials 192 to 207 mg/day, delivered as slowly dissolving zinc acetate or gluconate lozenges taken roughly every two hours while awake (PMID 28515951), and the mechanism depends on free zinc ions released in the mouth and throat over 20 to 30 minutes in contact with the pharyngeal mucosa. Food zinc is swallowed and absorbed in the small intestine, so no amount of it reproduces the intended local effect, which is why dose_from_food is NO while food_status is RICH. Reference point used in the table: EFSA PRI 7.5 mg/d for adult women and 9.4 mg/d for adult men at a phytate intake of 300 mg/d (EFSA, Dietary Reference Values for nutrients Summary report, approved 4 December 2017, doi 10.2903/sp.efsa.2017.e15121, Tables 5 and 7; underlying opinion EFSA Journal 2014;12(10):3844).这里有两个不同的问题共用一个矿物名称，它们得到不同的答案。作为营养素的锌在普通食物中很丰富：牡蛎是整张成分表的极端值，红肉和内脏其次，小麦胚芽、种子和豆类也提供可用的量，所以就这种物质是否存在于食物中而言，答案是 RICH。锌含片并非营养产品：试验使用的是每天超过 75 mg 元素锌，最常见为每天 80 至 92 mg，两项试验为每天 192 至 207 mg，以缓慢溶解的醋酸锌或葡萄糖酸锌含片给药，清醒时约每两小时一次（PMID 28515951），其机制依赖在口腔和咽部释放的游离锌离子在 20 至 30 分钟内与咽部黏膜保持接触。食物中的锌被吞下并在小肠吸收，任何量都无法复制这种预期的局部作用，这就是 dose_from_food 为 NO 而 food_status 为 RICH 的原因。表中使用的参考值：在植酸摄入 300 mg/d 的条件下，EFSA PRI 成年女性 7.5 mg/d、成年男性 9.4 mg/d（EFSA，Dietary Reference Values for nutrients Summary report，2017 年 12 月 4 日通过，doi 10.2903/sp.efsa.2017.e15121，表 5 和表 7；基础意见书 EFSA Journal 2014;12(10):3844）。

To match the dose要达到该剂量The lozenge dose fails on arithmetic and then fails again on route. Arithmetically, hitting the 80 mg/day of elemental zinc used in the trials (PMID 28515951) every day for the duration of a cold takes 204 g of raw oyster meat, roughly 14 to 15 medium oysters; or 102 g of cooked oysters; or 88 g of canned oysters, about 11 of them; or 479 g of toasted wheat-germ cereal; or 989 g of braised lean beef chuck; or 1.10 kg of braised lamb shoulder; or 1.05 kg of pumpkin seed kernels; or 5.23 kg of boiled chickpeas; or 6.30 kg of boiled lentils. Only oysters make it look even arithmetically plausible, and 14 raw oysters a day for a week is a Vibrio and norovirus decision rather than a nutrition one. Closing the arithmetic would still not reproduce the product, because the lozenge trials work through free Zn2+ released in the oropharynx and held against the mucosa, and swallowed zinc from food or from a capsule bypasses that route entirely. On scale, 80 to 92 mg/day is roughly 11 to 12 times the EFSA female PRI of 7.5 mg/d (10.7 and 12.3 times); the 'eight times' figure quoted earlier corresponds to the male PRI of 9.4 mg/d, not the female one named in the sentence. Separately, and this is the part food answers easily, the nutritional dose is trivially reachable: 85 g of braised lean beef chuck (6.9 mg) or 6 medium raw oysters (33.4 mg) meets or vastly exceeds the 7.5 to 9.4 mg PRI in one portion.含片剂量先在算术上不成立，接着在给药途径上再次不成立。就算术而言，要在感冒期间每天达到试验所用的 80 mg 元素锌（PMID 28515951），需要 204 g 生牡蛎肉，约 14 至 15 个中等大小牡蛎；或 102 g 熟牡蛎；或 88 g 罐装牡蛎，约 11 个；或 479 g 焙烤小麦胚芽谷物；或 989 g 炖瘦牛肩肉；或 1.10 kg 炖羊肩肉；或 1.05 kg 南瓜子仁；或 5.23 kg 煮鹰嘴豆；或 6.30 kg 煮扁豆。只有牡蛎在算术上看起来还有些可能，而连续一周每天吃 14 个生牡蛎，要权衡的是弧菌和诺如病毒的风险，与营养无关。即便把算术凑齐，也复制不出这个产品，因为含片试验的作用依赖在口咽部释放并停留在黏膜上的游离 Zn2+，而来自食物或胶囊的锌被吞下后完全绕过这条途径。在量级上，每天 80 至 92 mg 约为 EFSA 女性 PRI 7.5 mg/d 的 11 至 12 倍（10.7 倍和 12.3 倍）；此前引用的八倍对应的是男性 PRI 9.4 mg/d，并非句中提到的女性值。另外一点是食物能轻松回答的：营养剂量非常容易达到，85 g 炖瘦牛肩肉（6.9 mg）或 6 个中等大小生牡蛎（33.4 mg），一份就达到或远超 7.5 至 9.4 mg 的 PRI。

Food vs supplement食物与补充剂Zinc gluconate lozenges shortened colds by 28 percent and zinc acetate lozenges by 40 percent, a 12-point difference that was not statistically significant (95% CI -12 to +36), and there is no evidence that doses above 100 mg/day do better than 80 to 92 mg/day (PMID 28515951). The salt matters less than people claim and the lozenge format matters more. Zinc capsules, tablets, syrups and food are not substitutes in this indication, because the local contact is the point. Two safety notes follow from the numbers: 80 to 92 mg/day is roughly 11 to 12 times the EFSA female PRI and well above nutritional upper levels, defensible only for a few days because sustained high zinc antagonises copper absorption; and this is a short pharmacological course with an actual end date, unlike a nutrient. One earlier claim about the oyster records has to be withdrawn. Cooking does concentrate oyster zinc by moisture loss (raw 89.0 g water, cooked 78.2 g; dry matter 11.0 g against 21.8 g, so solids exactly double and zinc exactly doubles from 39.3 to 78.6 mg per 100 g). Canning does not work that way: canned oysters hold 85.1 g water and 14.9 g dry matter, only 1.35 times the raw solids, yet 2.3 times the zinc at 91.0 mg, which is 1.7 times richer per gram of solids (611 mg zinc per 100 g dry matter against 357 raw and 361 cooked). The canned entry reflects different material or different analyses rather than moisture loss. Per-100 g comparisons across preparation states remain misleading either way unless the yield is tracked.葡萄糖酸锌含片使感冒病程缩短 28%，醋酸锌含片缩短 40%，两者相差 12 个百分点，未达统计显著（95% CI -12 至 +36）；也没有证据表明每天超过 100 mg 的剂量优于 80 至 92 mg（PMID 28515951）。盐型的重要性低于人们所说，含片这一剂型的重要性更高。在这一适应症下，锌胶囊、片剂、糖浆和食物都不能替代含片，局部接触才是关键。从这些数字引出两条安全提示：每天 80 至 92 mg 约为 EFSA 女性 PRI 的 11 至 12 倍，远高于营养性上限，只有在数天之内才站得住脚，因为长期高锌会拮抗铜的吸收；这是一个有明确终点的短期药理疗程，与长期摄入的营养素不同。此前关于牡蛎数据条目的一个说法必须撤回。烹熟确实通过失水提高了牡蛎的锌浓度（生品含水 89.0 g，熟品 78.2 g；干物质 11.0 g 对 21.8 g，固形物正好翻倍，锌也正好从每 100 g 39.3 mg 翻倍到 78.6 mg）。罐装不是这样：罐装牡蛎含水 85.1 g、干物质 14.9 g，只有生品固形物的 1.35 倍，锌却是 2.3 倍，达到 91.0 mg，按固形物计算浓 1.7 倍（每 100 g 干物质含锌 611 mg，生品 357 mg，熟品 361 mg）。罐装条目反映的是不同原料或不同分析，与失水无关。无论哪种情形，除非同时追踪出品率，跨加工状态的每 100 g 比较仍然会误导。

Absorption吸收Oysters are the outlier of the entire food composition table. At 39.3 mg/100 g raw and up to 91.0 mg/100 g canned they carry four to twelve times the zinc of red meat, which is itself the next best category, and they are why oysters answer every zinc question. Beyond oysters, absorption efficiency does most of the work and phytate is the variable. Human whole-body-retention studies of matched cereal meals found fractional zinc absorption of 26.8 percent from a rye bread meal containing 100 umol of phytic acid, falling to 8.4 percent from oatmeal porridge containing 600 umol, a threefold loss driven by phytate alone (PMID 2824731). Fractional absorption is not the whole story, and the earlier version of this section had the direction of the bread comparison backwards. A related study found that a lower absolute amount of zinc was absorbed from white bread than from the same amount of wholemeal bread, because wholemeal supplies more zinc and the phytate penalty on fractional absorption did not overturn that content advantage; white bread only won once both breads were enriched with zinc chloride. Adding milk products did improve zinc absorption from the wholemeal meal (PMID 7361691). Replacing 25 percent of the beef protein in a composite meal with defatted soy flour lowered both the zinc content and the zinc absorbed, while the same substitution in a chicken meal changed neither (PMID 6893252). EFSA builds phytate straight into the requirement: the adult male PRI rises from 9.4 mg/d at 300 mg phytate/day to 11.7, 14.0 and 16.3 mg/d at 600, 900 and 1,200 mg, and the female PRI from 7.5 to 9.3, 11.0 and 12.7 mg/d across the same range, ratios of 1.73 and 1.69. A high-legume, high-wholegrain diet therefore needs about 70 percent more zinc on the label to deliver the same absorbed zinc. On mitigations, the evidence is narrower than previously claimed: the cited review covers added Aspergillus niger phytase (12 iron studies, 5 zinc studies) and states that for zinc not enough information is available to determine optimal activities (PMID 24050000), so added phytase is supported while soaking, sprouting and sourdough fermentation need a fermentation-specific source. Animal protein and milk in the same meal do raise absorption, and vegetarians consequently sit at the top of the EFSA PRI range rather than the bottom (PMID 12936958).牡蛎是整张食物成分表的极端值。生品每 100 g 39.3 mg，罐装最高每 100 g 91.0 mg，是红肉的四到十二倍，而红肉本身已是次优类别，这也是牡蛎能回答所有锌相关问题的原因。牡蛎之外，吸收效率承担了大部分工作，植酸是那个变量。对配对谷物餐的人体全身滞留研究发现，含 100 umol 植酸的黑麦面包餐锌分数吸收率为 26.8%，含 600 umol 的燕麦粥降到 8.4%，仅由植酸造成三倍的差距（PMID 2824731）。分数吸收率不是全部，本节此前的版本把面包比较的方向弄反了。一项相关研究发现，从白面包吸收的锌绝对量低于同等量的全麦面包，因为全麦提供更多锌，植酸对分数吸收率的惩罚没有抵消这一含量优势；只有当两种面包都用氯化锌强化后，白面包才占优。在全麦餐中加入乳制品确实改善了锌的吸收（PMID 7361691）。在一份复合餐中用脱脂大豆粉替代 25% 的牛肉蛋白，锌含量和吸收的锌都下降，而在鸡肉餐中做同样替代则两者都没有变化（PMID 6893252）。EFSA 把植酸直接纳入需要量：成年男性 PRI 从植酸 300 mg/d 时的 9.4 mg/d，在 600、900 和 1,200 mg 时升至 11.7、14.0 和 16.3 mg/d；女性 PRI 在同一区间从 7.5 升至 9.3、11.0 和 12.7 mg/d，比值分别为 1.73 和 1.69。因此高豆类、高全谷物的膳食需要标签上多出约 70% 的锌，才能提供同样的吸收锌。关于缓解措施，证据比此前所称更窄：所引综述涵盖的是添加黑曲霉（Aspergillus niger）植酸酶（12 项铁研究、5 项锌研究），并指出就锌而言现有信息不足以确定最佳酶活（PMID 24050000），所以添加植酸酶有支持，而浸泡、发芽和酸面团发酵需要专门针对发酵的来源。同餐中的动物蛋白和牛奶确实提高吸收，素食者因此落在 EFSA PRI 区间的上端（PMID 12936958）。

Food data note食物数据说明All eleven original per-100 g figures were confirmed to the digit against FoodData Central, the Hemila lozenge meta-analysis was confirmed on every parameter (dose threshold, the 80 to 92 and 192 to 207 mg/day bands, 40 against 28 percent by salt, no benefit above 100 mg/day), and the EFSA phytate-graded PRI table matched the source text. The six added rows use conventional portion sizes rather than USDA measure-table entries, so their per-portion figures are derived and are flagged as such in place高。原稿全部十一个每 100 g 数值都与 FoodData Central 逐位核实一致，Hemila 的含片荟萃分析在每一项参数上都得到确认（剂量阈值、每天 80 至 92 mg 和 192 至 207 mg 两个区间、按盐型 40% 对 28%、每天超过 100 mg 无额外益处），EFSA 按植酸分级的 PRI 表与来源文本一致。新增的六行使用常规份量而非 USDA 计量表条目，因此其每份数值是推算的，并已就地标注。

Does the body make it身体是否自产Zinc is chemical element 30 and cannot be synthesised, so the many enzymes and transcription factors that depend on it require a continuous dietary supply, and there is no rapidly mobilisable store analogous to ferritin. Lozenges are a special case: they release ionic zinc into the mouth and throat for a local effect during a cold, so they act as a short-course topical drug and do not correct a systemic shortfall. With synthesis at zero zinc is never redundant on this axis, while long-term use at lozenge doses antagonises copper absorption and is harmful in its own right.锌是30号化学元素，无法合成，依赖它的众多酶和转录因子需要膳食持续供应，体内也没有类似铁蛋白那样可快速动员的专用储库。锭剂是特殊情形：它把离子锌释放到口腔和咽部，在感冒期间发挥局部作用，属于短程局部用药，并不纠正全身性不足。既然合成为零，在这一维度上锌永远不算多余，但按锭剂剂量长期服用会拮抗铜的吸收，本身就造成伤害。

Pathway合成通路NOT APPLICABLE (chemical element). Transport and buffering only: ZIP family uptake transporters (SLC39, with ZIP4/SLC39A4 as the apical intestinal route lost in acrodermatitis enteropathica), ZnT efflux transporters (SLC30) and metallothionein binding, across intestine, liver and all tissues.NOT APPLICABLE（不适用：化学元素）。只有转运与缓冲：ZIP 家族摄取转运体（SLC39，其中 ZIP4/SLC39A4 是肠道顶端通路，肠病性肢端皮炎中功能丧失）、ZnT 外排转运体（SLC30）以及金属硫蛋白结合，分布于肠道、肝脏和所有组织。

Amount made自产量0 mg/d synthesised. Reference points: adult body content about 1.5-2.5 g, roughly 60% in skeletal muscle and 30% in bone; RDA 11 mg/d men, 8 mg/d women; UL 40 mg/d elemental zinc for adults, which most lozenge regimens exceed.合成量 0 mg/d。参照点：成人体内含量约 1.5-2.5 g，约 60% 在骨骼肌，30% 在骨骼；RDA 男性 11 mg/d，女性 8 mg/d；成人元素锌 UL 40 mg/d，多数锭剂方案会超过这个上限。

Still matters when仍有意义的情形NEVER ON THIS AXIS. Justification is use-case or intake-based: documented deficiency, high-phytate or vegetarian diets, chronic diarrhoea, inflammatory bowel disease or post-bariatric malabsorption, sickle cell disease, acrodermatitis enteropathica (ZIP4/SLC39A4 loss of function, which needs systemic zinc salts and cannot be treated with lozenges), pregnancy and lactation. The common cold use case is contested: the Cochrane review Zinc for the common cold was retracted (PMID 25924708) and later reviews have been publicly challenged (Hemilä and Chalker, PMID 39478818 and PMID 40680659), so the evidence should be described as unsettled.NEVER ON THIS AXIS（在这一维度上永不成立）。理由基于具体用途或摄入：已确诊的缺乏、高植酸或素食膳食、慢性腹泻、炎症性肠病或减重手术后吸收不良、镰状细胞病、肠病性肢端皮炎（ZIP4/SLC39A4 功能丧失，需要全身性锌盐，锭剂无法治疗）、妊娠与哺乳。感冒起病时短程使用这一用途的证据存在争议：Cochrane 综述 Zinc for the common cold 已撤稿（PMID 25924708），后续综述也受到公开质疑（Hemilä 与 Chalker，PMID 39478818 和 PMID 40680659），因此应说明证据尚未定论。

Synthesis source合成来源NIH Office of Dietary Supplements, Zinc Fact Sheet for Health Professionals (RDA 11/8 mg/d and UL 40 mg/d from IOM, Dietary Reference Intakes for Vitamin A, Vitamin K, Arsenic, Boron, Chromium, Copper, Iodine, Iron, Manganese, Molybdenum, Nickel, Silicon, Vanadium and Zinc); retracted Cochrane review PMID 25924708; Hemilä and Chalker PMID 39478818 and PMID 40680659. Mapped from the recovered entry Zinc lozenges.

CCBBFFDDBBXXMelatonin褪黑素
Verdict结论Consider可以考虑
Evidence证据Grade BB 级
Dose tested已验证剂量0.5-5 mg. Timing is the active ingredient, not dose. For phase advance, 0.5 mg taken 2-4 hours before dim-light melatonin onset.0.5 至 5 毫克。起作用的是服用时间，不是剂量。要提前相位，在暗光褪黑素起始前 2 至 4 小时服 0.5 毫克。
Who适用人群Jet lag eastward across five or more time zones, delayed sleep-wake phase disorder, shift work, and blind people with free-running rhythms.向东跨越五个及以上时区的时差、睡眠时相延迟障碍、轮班工作，以及节律自由运转的盲人。
Pros优点
  • Circadian phase-shifting is real pharmacology with a mapped phase-response curve. For jet lag across five or more zones the NNT is 2, and 9 of 10 trials were positive.昼夜节律相位调整是真实的药理作用，其相位反应曲线已被测绘。对跨五个以上时区的时差，NNT 为 2，10 项试验中有 9 项阳性。
  • In delayed sleep-wake phase disorder, sleep onset advanced by 0.67 hours and endogenous melatonin onset by 1.18 hours.在睡眠时相延迟障碍中，入睡时间提前 0.67 小时，内源性褪黑素起始提前 1.18 小时。
  • Short-term safety is good and it is not habit-forming in the way sedatives are.短期安全性良好，也不像镇静剂那样形成依赖。
Cons缺点
  • For ordinary insomnia it barely does anything: 7 minutes off sleep latency and 8 minutes more total sleep across 19 trials and 1,683 people. The AASM guideline explicitly suggests clinicians NOT use it for insomnia.对普通失眠几乎没用：19 项试验、1683 人的数据是入睡潜伏期缩短 7 分钟、总睡眠时间增加 8 分钟。美国睡眠医学会指南明确建议临床不要用它治失眠。
  • Retail dose accuracy is the worst documented in this document. 22 of 25 gummy products were inaccurately labelled, at 74-347% of the declared amount, and one product labelled 3 mg contained no melatonin at all but 31.3 mg of CBD. A separate analysis of 31 products found -83% to +478% of label and serotonin contamination in 8 of them.零售剂量准确度是本文中记录到最差的。25 个软糖产品中有 22 个标签不准确，实测为标示量的 74 至 347%，其中一个标注 3 毫克的产品完全不含褪黑素，却含 31.3 毫克 CBD。另一项对 31 个产品的分析发现含量为标示量的 -83% 至 +478%，其中 8 个检出血清素污染。
  • Not for children. The gummy format plus up to 347% overdosing plus palatability is a bad combination.不要给儿童。软糖剂型、最高 347% 的超量、加上好吃，是很糟的组合。
  • Retail doses of 5-10 mg are far above what the pharmacology needs and can shift the clock the wrong way if taken at the wrong time.零售常见的 5 至 10 毫克远高于药理所需，而且在错误的时间服用还会把生物钟推向错误的方向。
  • Cochrane specifically flagged caution in people on warfarin and people with epilepsy. Fluvoxamine markedly raises melatonin exposure via CYP1A2 inhibition.Cochrane 特别提示华法林使用者和癫痫患者需谨慎。氟伏沙明通过抑制 CYP1A2 显著升高褪黑素暴露量。
What it does, and what happens without it它有什么作用，缺了会怎样

A hormone the pineal gland releases after dark to tell the body clock that night has begun.松果体在天黑后分泌的一种激素,用来告知生物钟夜晚已经开始。

No deficiency state exists不存在缺乏状态

In detail详细Melatonin is synthesised from serotonin in the pineal gland on a schedule set by the suprachiasmatic nucleus, rising roughly two hours before habitual sleep onset and clearing by morning. It acts through MT1 and MT2 receptors on the clock itself, so it works as a timing signal rather than a sedative, which is why small evening doses shift sleep phase more reliably than large doses deepen sleep. There is no dietary requirement at all: the body makes every molecule it uses. Nocturnal peak concentrations do fall with age (pooled maxima around 49 pg/mL in study populations averaging 65 to 70 years and around 28 pg/mL in those 75 and over), and ordinary evening room light below 200 lux delays melatonin onset in 99% of people and shortens the nocturnal melatonin window by about 90 minutes, so the common problem is a mistimed or blunted signal rather than an absent nutrient.褪黑素由松果体以血清素为原料合成,合成节律受视交叉上核控制,通常在习惯入睡时间前约两小时开始上升,清晨降至基线。它通过生物钟本身的MT1和MT2受体发挥作用,是一种定时信号而非镇静剂,这正是傍晚小剂量比大剂量更能可靠地移动睡眠时相、却不能像大剂量那样加深睡眠的原因。人体完全不存在对它的膳食需求:所用的每一个分子都由自身合成。夜间峰值浓度会随年龄下降(研究人群平均年龄65至70岁时汇总峰值约为49 pg/mL,75岁及以上人群约为28 pg/mL),而200 lux以下的普通傍晚室内光照会使99%的人褪黑素起始时间推迟,并将夜间褪黑素窗口缩短约90分钟。因此常见的问题是信号时相错位或信号减弱,并非营养素缺乏。

There is no deficiency state for this. It is not an essential nutrient, so being short of it is not a thing that can happen.它不存在缺乏状态。它不是必需营养素，所以“缺了它”这件事本身并不成立。

Source来源PMID 27302542 (Scholtens et al., J Psychosom Res 2016;86:20-27, physiological melatonin levels in healthy older people); PMID 21193540 (Gooley et al., J Clin Endocrinol Metab 2011;96:E463-72, evening room light suppresses melatonin onset)

Food and the body食物与身体
In food: Trace食物中：痕量 Dose from food: Out of reach靠吃达到剂量：达不到 Body makes it: Body makes it身体自产：身体自产 Food data: Medium食物数据：中

Melatonin is genuinely present across a wide range of plant and animal foods, and the richest of them are not the fruits and nuts usually named: roasted coffee, red wine and germinated legumes carry far more than tart cherries or walnuts. Even so, every realistic portion sits one to four orders of magnitude below a 0.5-5 mg supplement dose. The supplement is a separate article from the dietary substance: commercial melatonin is chemically synthesised rather than extracted from food, so a product sold as natural melatonin is a manufactured molecule and would be labelled SYNTHETIC if this field described the pill instead of the substance.褪黑素确实广泛存在于各类植物性和动物性食物中，其中含量最高的并不是人们常提到的那些水果和坚果：烘焙咖啡、红葡萄酒和发芽豆类的含量远高于酸樱桃或核桃。即便如此，任何现实份量都比 0.5-5 mg 的补充剂剂量低一到四个数量级。补充剂与膳食中的这种物质属于两回事：市售褪黑素为化学合成产物，并非从食物中提取，所以标着“天然褪黑素”出售的产品其实是人工制造的分子；如果本字段描述的是药片而非物质本身，标签应为 SYNTHETIC。
