To match the dose要达到该剂量1 mg requires roughly 104 g of roasted coffee grounds, the closest any food comes, and grounds are not consumed whole (brewing transfers an uncharacterised fraction to the cup); or 7.7 L of red wine; or about 918 g of dry-matter germinated lentils; or 1.9 kg dry-matter germinated kidney beans; or 5.3 kg of white mustard seed; or 9.7 kg of dried goji at the review value of 103 ng/g dry weight; or 23 kg of fenugreek seed, 34 kg of sunflower seed, 42 kg of tomato, 74 kg of Montmorency cherries, 89 kg of strawberries, 286 kg of walnuts, 485 kg of Balaton cherries, 818 kg of almonds, about 655-670 kg of egg (13,100-13,400 eggs) and about 64,500 L of milk. Pistachios cannot be given a single number: the point estimate is 383 kg but the reported SD (3096 pg/g) exceeds the mean (2609 pg/g), so the true requirement is uncertain by roughly an order of magnitude in either direction. Halve all of these for a 0.5 mg dose, multiply by five for 5 mg. The submission's headline claim that goji berries are the one food a human could theoretically eat to a dose does not survive correction, because it rested on an unreplicated outlier; at the authoritative value no food in the table reaches a supplement dose in an edible quantity.要摄入 1 mg，大约需要 104 g 烘焙咖啡粉，这是所有食物中最接近的，而咖啡粉不会被整份吃下（冲泡时转入杯中的比例未经表征）；或 7.7 L 红葡萄酒；或约 918 g 干物质计的发芽扁豆；或 1.9 kg 干物质计的发芽菜豆；或 5.3 kg 白芥子；或按综述值 103 ng/g 干重计算的 9.7 kg 干枸杞；或 23 kg 葫芦巴籽、34 kg 葵花籽、42 kg 番茄、74 kg Montmorency 酸樱桃、89 kg 草莓、286 kg 核桃、485 kg Balaton 酸樱桃、818 kg 杏仁、约 655-670 kg 鸡蛋（13,100-13,400 个）以及约 64,500 L 牛奶。开心果无法给出单一数值：点估计为 383 kg，但报告的标准差（3096 pg/g）超过均值（2609 pg/g），因此真实需求量在两个方向上都有约一个数量级的不确定性。0.5 mg 剂量把上述数字减半，5 mg 剂量乘以五。原稿的核心结论称枸杞是人类理论上唯一能吃到剂量的食物，经修正后不成立，因为它依赖一个未被重复验证的离群值；按权威值计算，表中没有任何食物能在可食用的份量内达到补充剂剂量。

Food vs supplement食物与补充剂Food melatonin is not a smaller version of a tablet. Tart cherry juice concentrate measurably raises urinary 6-sulfatoxymelatonin and improved actigraphy-measured sleep efficiency at 2 x 30 mL/day (Howatson et al. Eur J Nutr 2012;51(8):909-916, PMID 22038497, verified), yet no melatonin content figure for the concentrate could be sourced here, so the one preparation with a positive human sleep outcome remains uncosted; the melatonin delivered is a fraction of a microgram, and most of the effect probably comes from the polyphenol matrix and tryptophan availability. Cultivar swamps everything: Montmorency and Balaton are the same species and differ 6.5-fold. Two melatonin-rich botanicals bear on this list for context: Scutellaria (huang-qin) at about 7,110 ng/g dry weight and St John's wort at about 4,490 ng/g dry weight, the latter classified NOT_FOOD in its own entry while being among the richest melatonin-bearing plants on record. On the pistachio dispute: one 2014 spectrofluorimetric paper reported roughly 233 ug/g dry weight, about 89,300 times the LC-MS/MS value, and it carries a published Expression of Concern (original PMID 24878439; EoC Spectrochim Acta A 2019;217:322, PMID 31027610). At that disputed figure 4.3 g of pistachios, about seven kernels, would supply 1 mg, which is exactly why the number should be treated as unconfirmed rather than as a food-based melatonin strategy. The Expression of Concern record lists only the four original authors and states no replication failure, so the submission's attribution of it to a German federal risk-assessment body has been removed. On the supplement side, doses commonly sold at 3-10 mg are ten to thirty times a physiological replacement dose, independent testing of commercial products has repeatedly found large deviations from label content plus occasional serotonin contamination, and melatonin is a prescription-only medicine in the UK and much of the EU while sold freely as a supplement in the US.食物中的褪黑素并不等于一片药的缩小版。酸樱桃浓缩汁按每天 2 x 30 mL 服用，可测量地升高尿中 6-硫酸氧褪黑素，并改善了活动记录仪测得的睡眠效率（Howatson 等，Eur J Nutr 2012;51(8):909-916, PMID 22038497，已核实），但本次未能找到该浓缩汁的褪黑素含量数据，所以唯一在人体睡眠终点上取得阳性结果的制剂仍无法折算；它提供的褪黑素不足一微克，效应大部分可能来自多酚基质和色氨酸的可得性。品种差异盖过其他一切因素：Montmorency 和 Balaton 属同一物种，含量相差 6.5 倍。两种富含褪黑素的药用植物可作参照：黄芩约 7,110 ng/g 干重，圣约翰草约 4,490 ng/g 干重，后者在自己的条目中归为 NOT_FOOD，同时又属于已记录的褪黑素含量最高的植物之列。关于开心果的争议：2014 年一篇荧光分光法论文报告约 233 µg/g 干重，约为 LC-MS/MS 值的 89,300 倍，该文已被公开发表关注声明（原文 PMID 24878439；关注声明见 Spectrochim Acta A 2019;217:322, PMID 31027610）。按这个存疑数值，4.3 g 开心果（约七粒）就能提供 1 mg，正因如此，这个数字应被视为未经确认，不能当成靠食物补充褪黑素的方案。关注声明记录只列出四位原作者，也没有提到任何重复实验失败，因此原稿把它归因于德国联邦风险评估机构的说法已被删除。补充剂一侧：常见售卖的 3-10 mg 剂量是生理替代剂量的十到三十倍；对市售产品的独立检测多次发现含量与标签严重偏离，并偶有血清素污染；褪黑素在英国和欧盟大部分地区属处方药，在美国则作为补充剂自由销售。

Absorption吸收Absolute oral bioavailability of melatonin is low and highly variable, averaging about 15% (reported range roughly 9-33%, with individual values spanning a five-fold spread), because up to 85% is removed on first pass, mainly by hepatic CYP1A2. CYP1A2 modifiers therefore matter more than the source: caffeine raises plasma melatonin from a given dose, smoking lowers it. Nothing is known about whether the nanogram to low-microgram quantities in a food matrix follow the same kinetics, and at those quantities the question is close to academic. Anyone comparing natural melatonin in pistachios with a tablet is comparing a sub-microgram intake against a supra-physiological one.褪黑素的口服绝对生物利用度低且个体差异极大，平均约 15%（报告范围大致 9-33%，个体值相差可达五倍），原因是最多 85% 在首过过程中被清除，主要经肝脏 CYP1A2。因此影响 CYP1A2 的因素比来源更重要：咖啡因会提高同等剂量下的血浆褪黑素，吸烟则会降低。食物基质中纳克到低微克级的量是否遵循同样的动力学，目前一无所知，而在这个量级上该问题几乎只有学术意义。把开心果里的“天然褪黑素”和药片相比，等于拿亚微克级的摄入量去比一个超生理剂量。

Food data note食物数据说明The cherry values, the walnut value, the pistachio LC-MS/MS value, the milk value, the disputed 233 ug/g figure and the 89,300x ratio were all verified against primary sources, and the bioavailability figure matches the established literature. Against that, the entry's original anchor (goji) had to be replaced with a review value, the egg figure had to be re-based from dry solids to fresh weight, and the ten added rows all rest on a single compiled secondary review table (PMC5409706) whose primary measurements were not re-traced in this pass中。樱桃数值、核桃数值、开心果的 LC-MS/MS 数值、牛奶数值、存疑的 233 µg/g 数值以及 89,300 倍的比值均已对照原始文献核实，生物利用度数字也与既有文献一致。另一方面，本条目原来的锚点（枸杞）不得不换成综述值，鸡蛋数值不得不从干固形物基准改算为鲜重基准，而新增的十行全部依赖一份汇编性的二手综述表格（PMC5409706），本轮未回溯其原始测定。

Does the body make it身体是否自产The pineal gland makes melatonin from tryptophan through TPH1, aromatic L-amino acid decarboxylase, AANAT and ASMT, under suprachiasmatic nucleus control and suppressed by light, and nocturnal output is small. In a dose-ranging trial in adults over 50, 0.3 mg restored sleep efficiency and raised plasma melatonin to normal nocturnal levels, while 3.0 mg raised it above the physiological range, so common 3 to 10 mg capsules sit one to two orders of magnitude above the nightly physiological amount. There is no melatonin deficiency disease, so dose and timing are the whole discussion and repletion never enters into it.松果体以色氨酸为起点, 经 TPH1, aromatic L-amino acid decarboxylase, AANAT 和 ASMT 合成褪黑素, 受视交叉上核控制并被光抑制, 夜间产量很小。在一项针对 50 岁以上成人的剂量探索试验中, 0.3 mg 恢复了睡眠效率并把血浆褪黑素提高到正常夜间水平, 而 3.0 mg 把它推到生理范围之上, 因此常见的 3 到 10 mg 胶囊比夜间生理量高出一到两个数量级。褪黑素没有缺乏病, 所以剂量和给药时间就是全部讨论内容, 与补足短缺无关。

Pathway合成通路Tryptophan to 5-hydroxytryptophan by TPH1, to serotonin by aromatic L-amino acid decarboxylase (DDC), to N-acetylserotonin by AANAT (the rhythm-generating and light-suppressed step, driven by noradrenergic input from the suprachiasmatic nucleus via the superior cervical ganglion), then to melatonin by ASMT (HIOMT). Pinealocytes are the main source, with extrapineal synthesis in retina, gut and other tissues contributing little to circulating levels. Clearance is mainly hepatic CYP1A2 6-hydroxylation; receptors are MT1 and MT2.色氨酸由 TPH1 生成 5-hydroxytryptophan, 由 aromatic L-amino acid decarboxylase (DDC) 生成 serotonin, 由 AANAT 生成 N-acetylserotonin (产生节律并受光抑制的步骤, 由视交叉上核经颈上神经节的去甲肾上腺素输入驱动), 最后由 ASMT (HIOMT) 生成褪黑素。松果体细胞是主要来源, 视网膜, 肠道和其他组织的松果体外合成对循环水平贡献不大。清除主要经肝 CYP1A2 的 6 羟化; 受体为 MT1 和 MT2。

Amount made自产量The dedicated row records total endogenous nightly output as NOT ESTABLISHED as a verified figure in this pass, with the dose-response as the usable sourced anchor: 0.1, 0.3 and 3.0 mg given orally 30 minutes before bedtime in adults over 50, where 0.3 mg restored sleep efficiency and raised plasma melatonin to normal levels and 3.0 mg produced supraphysiological levels (PMID 11600532). The merged rows quote roughly 10 to 80 micrograms secreted per night in adults, falling with age, against supplement doses of 0.5 to 10 mg, and about 38.5 microg over a night for a 70 kg adult.专条把内源夜间总产量记为 NOT ESTABLISHED, 本轮没有经核对的数值, 可用的有来源参照是剂量反应: 在 50 岁以上成人中于睡前 30 分钟口服 0.1, 0.3 和 3.0 mg, 其中 0.3 mg 恢复了睡眠效率并把血浆褪黑素提高到正常水平, 而 3.0 mg 产生超生理水平 (PMID 11600532)。并入的条目给出成人每夜分泌约 10 到 80 micrograms 并随年龄下降, 补剂剂量为 0.5 到 10 mg, 70 kg 成人整夜约 38.5 microg。

Still matters when仍有意义的情形Circadian timing problems where melatonin acts as a chronobiotic: jet lag, delayed sleep-wake phase disorder, shift work, free-running or non-24-hour rhythms in some blind people, neurodevelopmental conditions in children under supervision, and older adults, where prolonged-release 2 mg is licensed in the EU and UK. All of these depend on low doses given at the right time, and none of it is repletion, since no deficiency state exists. Timing errors and self-selected multi-milligram doses are the two practical failure modes.褪黑素作为时相调节剂发挥作用的昼夜节律问题: 时差, 睡眠时相延迟障碍, 轮班工作, 部分盲人的自由运转或非 24 小时节律, 监督下的儿童神经发育疾病, 以及老年人 (欧盟和英国获批 2 mg 缓释)。这些都依赖在正确时间给予低剂量, 其中没有任何补足缺乏的成分, 因为不存在缺乏状态。给药时间错误和自行选择的毫克级大剂量是两种常见的实际失败方式。

Synthesis source合成来源PMID 11600532 (Zhdanova et al., J Clin Endocrinol Metab 2001;86:4727-4730); merged with the melatonin content of the combined endogenous-molecule rows (Klein DC, Arylalkylamine N-acetyltransferase: the timezyme, J Biol Chem 2007;282:4233-7)

Refs.文献 Burgess PMID 20410229; van Geijlswijk PMID 21120122; Ferracioli-Oda PMID 23691095; Cohen JAMA 2023 PMID 37097362; Erland & Saxena PMID 27855744; Sateia AASM PMID 27998379
CCBBFFDDBBXXProbiotics, named strain only益生菌，仅限指定菌株
Verdict结论Consider可以考虑
Evidence证据Grade BB 级
Dose tested已验证剂量Antibiotic-associated diarrhoea in children: at least 5 billion CFU/d. C. difficile prevention: 10-50 billion CFU/d. Infant colic: L. reuteri DSM 17938 at 100 million CFU/d.儿童抗生素相关腹泻：至少 50 亿 CFU/天。预防艰难梭菌：100 至 500 亿 CFU/天。婴儿肠绞痛：罗伊氏乳杆菌 DSM 17938，1 亿 CFU/天。
Who适用人群Children on a course of antibiotics, adults on antibiotics with elevated C. difficile risk, and exclusively breastfed infants with colic.正在用抗生素的儿童、艰难梭菌风险升高且在用抗生素的成人、以及纯母乳喂养的肠绞痛婴儿。
Pros优点
  • Paediatric antibiotic-associated diarrhoea: 8% versus 19%, RR 0.45 (0.36-0.56), NNT 9 at the higher dose. This is a genuinely useful number.儿童抗生素相关腹泻：8% 对 19%，RR 0.45（0.36-0.56），高剂量下 NNT 为 9。这是一个真正有用的数字。
  • C. difficile prevention during antibiotics: RR 0.50 (0.38-0.64), 1.6% versus 3.2%.抗生素期间预防艰难梭菌：RR 0.50（0.38-0.64），1.6% 对 3.2%。
  • Infant colic in exclusively breastfed babies: NNT 2.6 for treatment success at day 21, which is a striking number for a benign intervention with a defined stop point.纯母乳喂养婴儿的肠绞痛：第 21 天治疗成功的 NNT 为 2.6。对一个温和且有明确停用节点的干预来说，这个数字相当亮眼。
  • Pouchitis maintenance after antibiotic-induced remission has a real randomised result: remission maintained in 17 of 20 versus 1 of 16.抗生素诱导缓解后的贮袋炎维持治疗有实实在在的随机结果：20 人中 17 人维持缓解，对照组 16 人中仅 1 人。
Cons缺点
  • The category claim is unfalsifiable marketing. Evidence attaches to a named strain at a defined dose. Disaggregate 82 trials and 10,332 IBS patients by strain and GRADE certainty collapses to low or very low almost everywhere.品类式声称是无法证伪的营销话术。证据只依附于特定菌株在特定剂量下的表现。把 82 项试验、10332 名肠易激患者按菌株拆开，GRADE 确定性几乎处处塌到低或极低。
  • C. difficile prevention has NNT 65 at LOW certainty, so 64 of 65 people get nothing. The absolute benefit scales with baseline risk.预防艰难梭菌的 NNT 是 65，确定性为低，也就是 65 人中有 64 人什么也得不到。绝对获益随基线风险而变。
  • The largest trial ever run was null. PLACIDE randomised 2,981 hospitalised patients over 65 and found no effect on either antibiotic-associated diarrhoea (RR 1.04) or C. difficile.规模最大的试验是阴性的。PLACIDE 随机了 2981 名 65 岁以上住院患者，对抗生素相关腹泻（RR 1.04）和艰难梭菌均无效应。
  • The AGA recommends AGAINST probiotics for irritable bowel syndrome outside clinical trials.美国胃肠病学会建议，在临床试验之外不要用益生菌治疗肠易激综合征。
  • There is a real harm signal in the critically ill. In predicted severe acute pancreatitis, mortality was 16% versus 6% (RR 2.53) with 9 cases of bowel ischaemia, 8 fatal, versus zero on placebo. The FDA also warned providers after a preterm infant died of probiotic-associated sepsis.在危重患者中存在真实的危害信号。在预测为重症急性胰腺炎的患者中，死亡率 16% 对 6%（RR 2.53），并出现 9 例肠缺血、其中 8 例死亡，安慰剂组为零。此外，在一名早产儿死于益生菌相关脓毒症后，FDA 也向医疗机构发出了警示。
  • Absolute contraindications: central venous catheter, neutropenia, severe immunocompromise, critical illness, and preterm infants outside a supervised protocol.绝对禁忌：中心静脉置管、中性粒细胞减少、重度免疫抑制、危重症，以及未在监督方案内的早产儿。
What it does, and what happens without it它有什么作用，缺了会怎样

Live bacteria given in defined doses, where each named strain acts as its own drug.以确定剂量给予的活菌,每一个具名菌株都相当于其自身的一种药物。

No deficiency state exists不存在缺乏状态

In detail详细The accepted definition is live micro-organisms which, when administered in adequate amounts, confer a health benefit on the host, and the operative unit of evidence is the strain, written as genus, species and an alphanumeric designator (for example Lacticaseibacillus rhamnosus GG or Saccharomyces boulardii CNCM I-745). Strain-level genetics determine adhesion proteins, bacteriocin production, bile salt hydrolase activity and short-chain fatty acid output, so a trial result for one strain carries no information about a different strain of the same species. Most administered strains transit the gut without colonising, and the effect ceases when dosing stops. This is a therapeutic product class, not a nutrient class, so there is nothing a person can be short of.公认的定义是:以足够数量给予时能为宿主带来健康益处的活微生物,而证据的实际单位是菌株,写法为属名、种名加字母数字编号(例如鼠李糖乳酪杆菌Lacticaseibacillus rhamnosus GG,或布拉迪酵母菌Saccharomyces boulardii CNCM I-745)。菌株层面的遗传差异决定了黏附蛋白、细菌素(bacteriocin)产生、胆盐水解酶(bile salt hydrolase)活性和短链脂肪酸产量,因此某一菌株的试验结果对同一菌种的另一菌株没有任何提示意义。大多数给药菌株只是经过肠道而不定植,给药停止后作用也随之消失。这是一个治疗性产品类别,而不是营养素类别,因此不存在人可能短缺的东西。

There is no deficiency state for this. It is not an essential nutrient, so being short of it is not a thing that can happen.它不存在缺乏状态。它不是必需营养素，所以“缺了它”这件事本身并不成立。

Source来源DOI 10.1038/nrgastro.2014.66 (Hill et al., Nat Rev Gastroenterol Hepatol 2014;11:506-514, ISAPP consensus statement on the scope and appropriate use of the term probiotic)

Food and the body食物与身体
In food: None食物中：无 Dose from food: Out of reach靠吃达到剂量：达不到 Body makes it: n/a身体自产：不适用 Food data: High食物数据：高

SYNTHETIC here means no dietary source, not an artificial molecule: a named probiotic strain is a live organism, a single clonal isolate held in a culture bank, grown in industrial fermenters, freeze-dried and encapsulated. No food contains it. Fermented foods do carry large numbers of live lactic acid bacteria, but the species and strains present are whichever organisms grow in that food and its starter, never the deposited trial strain. Because probiotic efficacy is demonstrated strain by strain, a food supplying a different strain of the same species is a different product. Live-organism loads for fermented foods are given under the generic multi-strain entry.此处 SYNTHETIC 的含义是没有膳食来源。它并非人工合成的分子：一个指名益生菌菌株是活的生物体，是保藏在菌种库里的单一克隆分离株，在工业发酵罐中培养、冻干并装囊。没有任何食物含有它。发酵食品确实携带大量活的乳酸菌，但其中的菌种和菌株是能在该食物及其发酵剂中生长的那些微生物，从来不是保藏的试验菌株。由于益生菌的疗效是逐一菌株验证的，提供同一菌种不同菌株的食物属于另一种产品。发酵食品的活菌载量列在通用多菌株条目下。

No ordinary food supplies this in a meaningful amount.没有普通食物能提供有意义的量。

To match the dose要达到该剂量The gap is categorical and no quantity of food closes it. Named-strain doses in trials run from about 1x10^8 to 1x10^10 CFU/day; Bifidobacterium longum 35624 (formerly classified as infantis) was effective at 1x10^8, a figure the source trial expressed as CFU/mL rather than CFU/day (PMID 16863564). A single cup of kefir at 2.5x10^8 CFU/mL supplies roughly 6x10^10 live lactic acid bacteria (DOI 10.3390/foods15101616), so the raw CFU total is easily exceeded by food. The fraction of those cells belonging to the trialled strain is zero, which makes the CFU comparison meaningless for a strain-specific claim.这个差距是类别性的，任何食物量都无法弥合。试验中指名菌株的剂量大致为 1x10^8 至 1x10^10 CFU/day；Bifidobacterium longum 35624（原归类为 infantis）在 1x10^8 有效，而原始试验把这个数字表述为 CFU/mL 而非 CFU/day（PMID 16863564）。一杯 2.5x10^8 CFU/mL 的开菲尔提供约 6x10^10 个活乳酸菌（DOI 10.3390/foods15101616），所以单看 CFU 总数，食物轻松超过。这些菌体中属于受试菌株的比例为零，这使得 CFU 比较对于菌株特异性的主张毫无意义。

Food vs supplement食物与补充剂This is the most important form caveat in the group. Clinical evidence for probiotics is strain-specific, and often formulation-specific and indication-specific on top of that. Yoghurt, kefir, sauerkraut, kimchi, miso, natto and tempeh do not contain the strains tested in the trials, so evidence generated with a named strain does not transfer to any fermented food, and does not transfer to a different strain of the same species either. Eating fermented food is a reasonable dietary habit with its own emerging evidence base, and it is a separate thing from taking a named strain at a defined dose for a specific clinical effect. Two practical points: heat kills the organisms, so a pasteurised or cooked ferment (canned sauerkraut, miso stirred into boiling soup, baked tempeh) delivers no live cells; and species-level labelling on a supplement such as 'contains Lactobacillus acidophilus' without a strain designation carries no more transferable evidence than a food does.这是本组中最重要的剂型注意点。益生菌的临床证据是菌株特异的，往往还叠加配方特异和适应证特异。酸奶、开菲尔、德式酸菜、韩式泡菜、味噌、纳豆和天贝都不含试验所用的菌株，所以用指名菌株得到的证据无法转移到任何发酵食品，也无法转移到同一菌种的另一个菌株。吃发酵食品是合理的饮食习惯，本身有正在积累的证据基础，这与为特定临床效果按确定剂量服用指名菌株是两件事。两个实用要点：加热会杀死这些微生物，因此经巴氏杀菌或加热烹调的发酵物（罐装德式酸菜、拌入沸汤的味噌、烤过的天贝）不提供活菌；补充剂上只标到菌种层面，例如“含嗜酸乳杆菌（Lactobacillus acidophilus）”而无菌株编号，其证据可转移性与食物无异。

Absorption吸收Survival of gastric acid and bile is strain-dependent, and the delivery matrix changes it: the fat and buffering capacity of a dairy food improves survival relative to a bare capsule, while enteric coating or microencapsulation is used to achieve the same in supplements. Dose is not monotonic, which is the clearest evidence that formulation matters as much as CFU count. In a 362-patient dose-ranging trial in primary-care IBS, B. infantis 35624 at 1x10^8 was significantly superior to placebo and to all other doses, while 1x10^6 and 1x10^10 were not; the paper attributes the failure of the highest dose to significant formulation problems (Whorwell et al., Am J Gastroenterol 2006;101:1581-1590, PMID 16863564). Two generalisability caveats the submission omitted: the trial enrolled women only, and doses were expressed as CFU/mL in the paper rather than CFU/day. A higher label CFU is therefore not better, and label CFU at manufacture is not the same as viable CFU at end of shelf life.对胃酸和胆汁的存活取决于菌株，递送基质也会改变它：乳制品的脂肪和缓冲能力使存活率优于裸胶囊，补充剂则用肠溶包衣或微囊化达到同样目的。剂量效应并非单调递增，这是配方与 CFU 数同等重要的最清晰证据。在一项纳入 362 例基层医疗 IBS 患者的剂量探索试验中，B. infantis 35624 在 1x10^8 显著优于安慰剂及其他所有剂量，1x10^6 和 1x10^10 则没有；论文把最高剂量失效归因于明显的配方问题（Whorwell et al., Am J Gastroenterol 2006;101:1581-1590, PMID 16863564）。原稿漏掉了两条外推性注意点：试验只纳入女性，论文中的剂量以 CFU/mL 而非 CFU/day 表述。因此标签 CFU 越高并不意味着越好，出厂时的标签 CFU 也不等于保质期末的活菌 CFU。

Food data note食物数据说明The claim is categorical (no food contains a deposited trial strain) and the supporting trial was verified: 362 patients, doses 1x10^6, 1x10^8 and 1x10^10, with the 1x10^8 arm significantly superior to placebo and all other doses. The one detail that failed verification, the gelling mechanism for the top dose, has been removed and replaced with the paper's own wording高。该主张是类别性的（没有食物含有保藏的试验菌株），支持性试验已核实：362 例患者，剂量为 1x10^6、1x10^8 和 1x10^10，其中 1x10^8 组显著优于安慰剂和其他所有剂量。唯一未通过核实的细节，即最高剂量的成胶机制，已删除并改用论文自身的表述。

Does the body make it身体是否自产The synthesis axis does not fit here at all, because these are living organisms and not molecules, which is why the label is NA: forcing NONE would make a live organism look like a plant alkaloid on a screening table. Human cells cannot manufacture a bacterium, and the resident microbiome is acquired at birth and from the environment and then renews itself, so nobody is deficient in a strain the way someone is deficient in a vitamin. The honest test for a probiotic is strain-level trial evidence for a named indication, since effects do not transfer between strains, let alone between species.合成这条轴在这里完全不适用, 因为对象是活体生物, 不是分子, 所以标签用 NA: 硬套 NONE 会让活菌在筛查表上看起来像一种植物生物碱。人细胞无法制造细菌, 常驻菌群在出生时和从环境中获得, 之后自我更新, 所以没人会像缺某种维生素那样缺某一个菌株。对益生菌诚实的检验标准是针对具体适应症的菌株级试验证据, 因为效应在菌株之间不能移植, 跨物种更不行。

Pathway合成通路NOT APPLICABLE. Microorganisms are acquired, not synthesised. The resident microbiota is self-renewing and is defined by colonisation history rather than by any host biosynthetic capacity.NOT APPLICABLE。微生物靠获得, 不靠合成。常驻菌群自我更新, 由定植史决定, 与宿主的任何生物合成能力无关。

Amount made自产量0 (human cells cannot synthesise a microorganism). No daily requirement exists; the resident microbiota replaces itself.0 (人细胞无法合成微生物)。不存在每日需要量; 常驻菌群自我替换。

Still matters when仍有意义的情形Where a specific, fully identified strain has randomised evidence for a specific indication, and in settings of documented disruption such as after antibiotics. Ingested strains are generally transient passengers and are cleared within days to weeks of stopping, so any benefit lasts only as long as dosing.当某个完全鉴定到菌株水平的具体菌株对具体适应症有随机证据时, 以及在有明确菌群扰动的场景 (例如抗生素之后)。摄入的菌株一般只是过路乘客, 停用后数天到数周内被清除, 所以获益只维持在持续服用期间。

Synthesis source合成来源PMID 24912386 (Hill C, Nat Rev Gastroenterol Hepatol 2014;11:506-14, ISAPP consensus statement on the scope and appropriate use of the term probiotic)

Refs.文献 Cochrane Guo PMID 31039287; Cochrane CD006095.pub5 PMID 40931979; Sung PMID 29279326; PLACIDE PMID 23932219; Goodoory & Ford PMID 37541528; AGA PMID 32531291; PROPATRIA PMID 18279948
CCBBFFDDBBXXBerberine小檗碱
Verdict结论Consider可以考虑
Evidence证据Grade BB 级
Dose tested已验证剂量500 mg two or three times daily with meals. Note dihydroberberine and phytosome forms are more bioavailable and are not milligram-equivalent.500 毫克，每日 2 至 3 次，随餐服用。注意二氢小檗碱和植物体形式生物利用度更高，毫克数不能等同换算。
Who适用人群Adults with type 2 diabetes or prediabetes not reaching glycaemic targets, as an add-on, with a prescriber informed.2 型糖尿病或糖尿病前期、血糖未达标的成人，作为加用药物，且需告知处方医生。
Pros优点
  • The effect is real and clinically sized, which is unusual in this document: fasting glucose -0.82 mmol/L, HbA1c -0.63%, across 37 trials and 3,048 patients. That HbA1c reduction is in the range of a real drug.效应真实且具临床规模，这在本文中并不多见：空腹血糖降低 0.82 mmol/L，糖化血红蛋白降低 0.63%，来自 37 项试验、3048 名患者。这个糖化血红蛋白降幅已接近真正的药物。
  • Total adverse events were lower than comparators in the pooled analysis (RR 0.73), and it does not cause hypoglycaemia on its own.在合并分析中总不良事件低于对照药（RR 0.73），且单用不引起低血糖。
Cons缺点
  • The marketing understates the pharmacology rather than overstating it, and that is the danger. This behaves like a drug and should be treated as one.它的营销是低估而不是高估了其药理作用，危险恰恰在这里。它的行为像药，就应当被当作药来对待。
  • The most dangerous interaction in this document: 600 mg/d for three months raised ciclosporin trough concentrations by 88.9% in 52 renal transplant recipients. Note that this interaction dose is BELOW the typical glycaemic dose.本文中最危险的相互作用：52 名肾移植受者服用 600 毫克/天共三个月，环孢素谷浓度升高 88.9%。注意这个产生相互作用的剂量低于常规降糖剂量。
  • Berberine alone showed no statistical advantage over lifestyle change. The benefit appears as an add-on to an existing oral hypoglycaemic.单用小檗碱相对生活方式干预没有统计学优势。获益体现在与已有口服降糖药联用时。
  • The trial base is dominated by small Chinese trials that meta-analysts repeatedly describe as having low methodological quality.试验基础以小型中国试验为主，meta 分析作者反复指出其方法学质量偏低。
  • No upper limit exists. Toxicology review reports dose-dependent gastrointestinal ulceration, immunotoxicity, phototoxicity, neurotoxicity and cardiotoxicity. Contraindicated in pregnancy and in neonates (kernicterus risk).没有设定上限。毒理学综述报告了剂量依赖的胃肠道溃疡、免疫毒性、光毒性、神经毒性和心脏毒性。妊娠期和新生儿禁用（核黄疸风险）。
What it does, and what happens without it它有什么作用，缺了会怎样

A plant alkaloid that lowers blood sugar and cholesterol; the body has no need for it.一种降低血糖和胆固醇的植物生物碱,人体并不需要它。

No deficiency state exists不存在缺乏状态

In detail详细Berberine is an isoquinoline alkaloid extracted from Berberis, Coptis and Hydrastis species. Its metabolic effects are usually attributed to activation of AMP-activated protein kinase, and the upstream trigger appears to be mild inhibition of mitochondrial complex I that raises the cellular AMP to ATP ratio (Turner et al., Diabetes 2008;57:1414-1418), giving it a mechanistic family resemblance to metformin. AMPK is not the whole account: Xu et al. confirmed the complex I effect but concluded that berberine promotes glucose consumption independently of AMPK activation. Downstream it suppresses hepatic gluconeogenesis, and it upregulates hepatic LDL receptor expression through ERK-dependent stabilisation of LDL receptor mRNA rather than through AMPK (Kong et al., Nat Med 2004;10:1344-1351). Oral absorption is very poor, with absolute bioavailability under 1% in rats, so a substantial share of any effect is probably exerted in the gut lumen and on the microbiota. It is a xenobiotic: no human tissue synthesises it and no physiological process depends on its presence.小檗碱是从小檗属(Berberis)、黄连属(Coptis)和金印草属(Hydrastis)植物中提取的异喹啉类生物碱。其代谢作用通常归因于AMP活化蛋白激酶(AMPK)的激活,而上游触发机制似乎是对线粒体复合体I的轻度抑制,从而升高细胞内AMP与ATP的比值(Turner等,Diabetes 2008;57:1414-1418),这使其在机制上与二甲双胍有某种家族相似性。但AMPK并非全部机制:Xu等人证实了复合体I的这一效应,但得出的结论是小檗碱促进葡萄糖消耗的作用独立于AMPK激活。在下游,它抑制肝脏糖异生,并通过ERK依赖性的LDL受体mRNA稳定作用上调肝脏LDL受体表达,这一途径与AMPK无关(Kong等,Nat Med 2004;10:1344-1351)。口服吸收很差,在大鼠中绝对生物利用度低于1%,因此其作用很可能有相当一部分是在肠腔内及对肠道菌群发挥的。它是一种外源性化合物:人体组织不合成它,任何生理过程也不依赖它的存在。

There is no deficiency state for this. It is not an essential nutrient, so being short of it is not a thing that can happen.它不存在缺乏状态。它不是必需营养素，所以“缺了它”这件事本身并不成立。

Source来源DOI 10.1371/journal.pone.0103702 (Xu M, Xiao Y, Yin J, Hou W, Yu X, Shen L, Liu F, Wei L, Jia W, PLoS One 2014;9:e103702, berberine promotes glucose consumption independently of AMPK activation); Turner et al., Diabetes 2008;57:1414-1418 (berberine inhibits mitochondrial complex I and raises the cellular AMP:ATP ratio); Kong et al., Nat Med 2004;10:1344-1351 (berberine upregulates the hepatic LDL receptor by ERK-dependent mRNA stabilisation); DOI 10.1016/j.apsb.2012.06.003 (Yin, Ye & Jia, Acta Pharm Sin B 2012;2:327-334, effects and mechanisms of berberine in diabetes, oral bioavailability under 1%)

Food and the body食物与身体
In food: Not food食物中：非食物 Dose from food: Out of reach靠吃达到剂量：达不到 Body makes it: Cannot身体自产：不能 Food data: High食物数据：高

Berberine is an isoquinoline alkaloid from the roots, rhizomes and stem bark of medicinal plants: Berberis vulgaris (common barberry), B. aristata, B. asiatica and B. lycium, Coptis chinensis (huang lian) rhizome, Hydrastis canadensis (goldenseal), Mahonia aquifolium (Oregon grape) and Phellodendron amurense. None of these organs is eaten as food. Accumulation is highest in root tissue, 1.6-4.3% of dry weight across Berberis species, and B. vulgaris bark carries over 8% total alkaloids of which about 5% is berberine (Neag et al., Front Pharmacol 2018, PMC6111450, verified). Barberry fruit is the one part genuinely eaten, as zereshk in Iranian rice dishes, and it is the wrong organ: the whole-plant survey reporting up to 26,482 ug/g berberine in root and no detectable alkaloids in fruit pulp across 96 accessions was done on Berberis darwinii, the Chilean michay, which is a congener of the zereshk species rather than the same plant, and in that study leaves and seeds did carry detectable (lower) alkaloid levels, so only the pulp was non-detect (Molecules 2025;30(8):1849, PMID 40333914). The species question is closed by a separate group working directly on B. vulgaris fruit, which reports that the flowers, fruit pulp and seeds have little or no significant alkaloid content and describes their fruit extract as nearly devoid of berberine (Iran J Pharm Res 2011;10(1):97-104, PMID 24363687).小檗碱是一种异喹啉类生物碱，来自多种药用植物的根、根茎和茎皮：欧洲小檗（Berberis vulgaris，刺檗）、B. aristata、B. asiatica 和 B. lycium，黄连（Coptis chinensis）根茎，北美黄连（Hydrastis canadensis，goldenseal），俄勒冈葡萄（Mahonia aquifolium）以及黄檗（Phellodendron amurense）。这些器官都不作为食物食用。蓄积以根组织最高，小檗属各物种为干重的 1.6-4.3%，欧洲小檗树皮总生物碱超过 8%，其中约 5% 是小檗碱（Neag 等，Front Pharmacol 2018, PMC6111450，已核实）。小檗果实是真正被吃的部分，即伊朗米饭菜里的 zereshk（干酸浆果），而它属于另一个器官：那项在 96 个种质中报告根部小檗碱高达 26,482 µg/g、果肉未检出生物碱的全株调查，用的是达尔文小檗（Berberis darwinii，智利 michay），它是 zereshk 所属物种的同属近缘种，并非同一种植物；而且在该研究中叶和种子确实含有可检出的（较低的）生物碱水平，只有果肉为未检出（Molecules 2025;30(8):1849, PMID 40333914）。物种问题由另一组直接研究 B. vulgaris 果实的工作作了结：该研究报告花、果肉和种子几乎不含或不含有意义量的生物碱，并把其果实提取物描述为几乎不含小檗碱（Iran J Pharm Res 2011;10(1):97-104, PMID 24363687）。

No ordinary food supplies this in a meaningful amount.没有普通食物能提供有意义的量。

To match the dose要达到该剂量Trials use 500 mg two or three times daily, 1000-1500 mg/day. At the 5% berberine content of B. vulgaris root bark that is 20-30 g of dried root bark per day, which is a herbal decoction rather than a meal. Via the edible fruit the gap is not a large number, it is undefined: berberine is below the limit of detection in barberry pulp, so no portion size reaches the dose at all. A generous serving of zereshk polow uses perhaps 30-50 g of dried berries spread across several people and contributes no measurable berberine. Coptis rhizome and goldenseal root would need 1-3 g of dried herb and neither is eaten as food.试验用量为每次 500 mg、每天两到三次，即 1000-1500 mg/天。按欧洲小檗根皮 5% 的小檗碱含量计算，相当于每天 20-30 g 干根皮，这属于草药煎剂的范畴，不是一餐饭。走可食用果实这条路，差距无法用一个倍数表示，它是未定义的：小檗碱在小檗果肉中低于检出限，任何份量都达不到剂量。一份量足的 zereshk polow（酸浆果抓饭）大约用 30-50 g 干果，还要分给好几个人，提供的小檗碱不可测。黄连根茎和北美黄连根需要 1-3 g 干药材，而两者都不作为食物食用。

Food vs supplement食物与补充剂This is the clearest case in the set where a food and its supplement share only a plant name. Eating zereshk supplies vitamin C, anthocyanins and organic acids, with no pharmacological berberine effect. The isolated alkaloid at 1000-1500 mg/day behaves like a drug: it inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2D6 and is a P-glycoprotein substrate and inhibitor, so it can raise levels of co-administered medicines; it commonly causes constipation, cramping and diarrhoea; and it is contraindicated in pregnancy and in neonates because berberine displaces bilirubin from albumin and has been linked to kernicterus risk. Whole-plant root extracts also carry berbamine, palmatine and, in goldenseal, hydrastine, so a barberry root extract and a purified berberine HCl capsule are not the same product. Goldenseal is additionally a conservation concern and a frequent target of species adulteration.本组数据中，食物与其补充剂只共享一个植物名的情况，这一条最为典型。吃 zereshk 得到的是维生素 C、花青素和有机酸，没有小檗碱的药理作用。分离出的生物碱在 1000-1500 mg/天的用量下表现如同药物：它抑制 CYP3A4 和 CYP2D6，同时是 P-糖蛋白的底物和抑制剂，因而可能升高同服药物的浓度；常见不良反应为便秘、腹部绞痛和腹泻；孕妇和新生儿禁用，因为小檗碱会把胆红素从白蛋白上置换下来，并与核黄疸风险相关。全株根提取物还含小檗胺和巴马汀，北美黄连中另含北美黄连碱（hydrastine），所以小檗根提取物和纯化的盐酸小檗碱胶囊是两种不同产品。北美黄连另外还涉及物种保护问题，也是物种掺假的常见对象。

Absorption吸收Berberine's oral bioavailability is under 1%, measured at 0.36-0.68% in rats, with roughly 99.5% eliminated during gastrointestinal and hepatic first pass through poor solubility, self-aggregation in gastric acid, P-glycoprotein efflux and CYP-mediated intestinal metabolism (Expert Opin Drug Metab Toxicol 2023;19(3), PMID 37057922). Much of berberine's metabolic effect is thought to be exerted in the gut lumen and on the microbiome rather than systemically, so low bioavailability does not mean inactive. It does mean trace amounts from any food would be pharmacologically irrelevant, and it means formulation comparisons (plain salt, phytosome, micelle) can change exposure by an order of magnitude at the same labelled dose.小檗碱的口服生物利用度低于 1%，在大鼠中测得 0.36-0.68%，约 99.5% 在胃肠道和肝脏首过过程中被清除，机制包括溶解性差、在胃酸中自聚集、P-糖蛋白外排以及 CYP 介导的肠道代谢（Expert Opin Drug Metab Toxicol 2023;19(3), PMID 37057922）。一般认为小檗碱的代谢效应大部分发挥在肠腔内和对微生物组的作用上，而非全身性作用，所以生物利用度低并不等于没有活性。它确实意味着食物中的任何微量在药理上都无关紧要，也意味着剂型比较（普通盐、磷脂复合物、胶束）在同一标注剂量下可使暴露量相差一个数量级。

Food data note食物数据说明Every quantitative claim in this entry was checked and matched its source verbatim: the 1.6-4.3% root range, the 8% total alkaloid / 5% berberine figure for B. vulgaris bark, the 26,482 ug/g root maximum, the 96-accession pulp non-detect, and the 20-30 g root-bark dose equivalent. The NOT_FOOD classification was challenged and upheld高。本条目中每一项定量说法都经过核对并与来源逐字相符：1.6-4.3% 的根部含量范围、欧洲小檗树皮总生物碱 8% 与小檗碱约 5% 的数据、根部最高 26,482 µg/g、96 个种质的果肉未检出，以及 20-30 g 根皮的剂量等效量。NOT_FOOD 分类经过质疑后仍然维持。

Does the body make it身体是否自产Berberine is a protoberberine isoquinoline alkaloid made by plants such as Coptis chinensis, Berberis species and Hydrastis canadensis. Human cells do form the upstream benzylisoquinolines, since norlaudanosoline, 1(S)-reticuline and morphine were identified in human SH-SY5Y neuroblastoma and DAN-G pancreatic carcinoma cells and shown by labelled-precursor feeding to be of biosynthetic origin (PMID 15383669), but humans lack berberine bridge enzyme and the protoberberine steps beyond reticuline, so every milligram of berberine in the blood came from a plant or a factory. The endogenous axis can neither argue for nor against taking it, and the judgement falls to trial data, poor oral bioavailability and interaction burden.小檗碱是原小檗碱型异喹啉生物碱, 由 Coptis chinensis, Berberis 属和 Hydrastis canadensis 等植物合成。人细胞确实能生成上游的苄基异喹啉: 在人 SH-SY5Y 神经母细胞瘤细胞和 DAN-G 胰腺癌细胞中鉴定出 norlaudanosoline, 1(S)-reticuline 和吗啡, 并用标记前体喂养证明它们来自生物合成 (PMID 15383669), 但人缺 berberine bridge enzyme 以及 reticuline 之后的原小檗碱步骤, 所以血中每一毫克小檗碱都来自植物或工厂。因此内源合成这条轴既不能反对也不能支持它, 判断依据是试验数据, 很差的口服生物利用度和药物相互作用负担。

Pathway合成通路NOT APPLICABLE for berberine itself. The plant benzylisoquinoline route runs from L-tyrosine through (S)-norcoclaurine and (S)-reticuline, then berberine bridge enzyme to (S)-scoulerine and on to berberine. Humans reach reticuline as part of the endogenous morphine pathway (PMID 15383669) but have no berberine bridge enzyme and none of the protoberberine steps downstream of it.对小檗碱本身 NOT APPLICABLE。植物苄基异喹啉途径从 L-tyrosine 经 (S)-norcoclaurine 和 (S)-reticuline, 再由 berberine bridge enzyme 生成 (S)-scoulerine 并继续生成小檗碱。人能走到 reticuline (内源吗啡途径的一部分, PMID 15383669), 但没有 berberine bridge enzyme, 也没有其下游的原小檗碱步骤。

Amount made自产量0 (no human biosynthetic pathway for berberine)0 (人体没有小檗碱的生物合成途径)

Still matters when仍有意义的情形Every dose is exogenous by definition, so this axis is silent. Screen instead on clinical effect size, the low and variable oral bioavailability, and drug interactions through P-glycoprotein and CYP inhibition.按定义每一剂都是外源的, 所以这条轴没有发言权。改用临床效应量, 低且波动的口服生物利用度, 以及通过 P-glycoprotein 和 CYP 抑制产生的药物相互作用来筛查。

Synthesis source合成来源PMID 27671811 (Cicero AF, Adv Exp Med Biol 2016, Berberine and Its Role in Chronic Disease); PMID 15383669 (Poeaknapo C, PNAS 2004;101:14091-6, endogenous formation of morphine in human cells)

Refs.文献 Xie PMID 36467075; Lan PMID 25498346; Dong PMID 23118793; ciclosporin interaction PMID 16133554
CCCCFFDDBBXXVitamin C维生素 C
Verdict结论Consider可以考虑
Evidence证据Grade CC 级
Dose tested已验证剂量200 mg/d if taken regularly. Higher doses do not shorten colds further and cause osmotic diarrhoea.若规律服用，200 毫克/天。更高剂量并不能进一步缩短感冒，反而引起渗透性腹泻。
Who适用人群Smokers, heavy alcohol users, people on very restricted diets, and those under extreme physical stress such as marathon runners.吸烟者、大量饮酒者、饮食极度受限者，以及处于极端身体应激下的人，比如马拉松跑者。
Pros优点
  • It cures scurvy, which is an unambiguous deficiency disease, and scurvy still occurs in food-insecure and alcohol-dependent populations.它能治愈坏血病，这是一种毫不含糊的缺乏症，而坏血病在食物不安全和酒精依赖人群中至今仍会出现。
  • Under extreme physical stress such as marathons and sub-arctic exercise, prophylactic vitamin C halved cold incidence. That subgroup effect is real.在马拉松、亚寒带运动等极端身体应激下，预防性补充维生素 C 使感冒发生率减半。这个亚组效应是真实的。
  • Smokers genuinely need 35 mg/d more than non-smokers because of higher turnover.吸烟者由于周转率更高，确实比不吸烟者每天多需要 35 毫克。
Cons缺点
  • It does not prevent colds in the general population: RR 0.97 (0.94-1.00) across 29 comparisons and 11,306 people. This is the founding claim of the modern supplement industry and it is false.它不能预防普通人群的感冒：29 项比较、11306 人的数据是 RR 0.97（0.94-1.00）。这是现代补充剂行业的奠基性主张，而它是错的。
  • Duration falls only 8% in adults and 14% in children, which is roughly half a day.病程在成人中只缩短 8%，儿童 14%，大约是半天。
  • Intravenous vitamin C in sepsis is HARMFUL. The LOVIT trial (n=863) found more death or persistent organ dysfunction in the treatment arm.脓毒症静脉用维生素 C 是有害的。LOVIT 试验（n=863）发现治疗组死亡或持续器官功能障碍更多。
  • Avoid with a history of calcium oxalate kidney stones or hyperoxaluria, and in renal impairment, because ascorbate is metabolised to oxalate.有草酸钙肾结石史或高草酸尿者、以及肾功能不全者应避免，因为抗坏血酸会代谢为草酸。
  • Upper limit 2,000 mg/d, set on osmotic diarrhoea.上限 2000 毫克/天，依据是渗透性腹泻。
What it does, and what happens without it它有什么作用，缺了会怎样

Keeps collagen strong and wounds healing; without it blood vessels and gums break down.维持胶原蛋白强度和伤口愈合，缺乏时血管和牙龈会崩解。

Named deficiency disease有明确的缺乏症 Fully reversible完全可逆

In detail详细Ascorbate is the reducing cofactor that keeps the iron atom in a family of dioxygenases in its active state. The best known are prolyl-4-hydroxylase and lysyl hydroxylase, which hydroxylate collagen so the triple helix is stable and can be cross-linked; without them the collagen laid down is defective, which explains bleeding, poor wound healing and the reopening of old scars. The same chemistry serves dopamine beta-hydroxylase (noradrenaline synthesis), peptidylglycine alpha-amidating monooxygenase (peptide hormone amidation), two carnitine biosynthesis enzymes, and the HIF prolyl hydroxylases and TET and JmjC demethylases in gene regulation. Ascorbate also reduces dietary non-haem iron to the absorbable ferrous form. Humans cannot synthesise it because the gulonolactone oxidase gene is inactive.抗坏血酸是一种还原型辅因子，负责维持一类双加氧酶中铁原子的活性状态。其中最知名的是prolyl-4-hydroxylase和lysyl hydroxylase，二者对胶原蛋白进行羟基化，使三螺旋结构稳定并能够交联；缺乏这两种酶时合成的胶原蛋白存在缺陷，这也解释了出血、伤口愈合不良和陈旧瘢痕重新裂开的原因。同样的化学机制还服务于dopamine beta-hydroxylase（去甲肾上腺素合成）、peptidylglycine alpha-amidating monooxygenase（肽类激素酰胺化）、两种参与肉碱生物合成的酶，以及基因调控中的HIF prolyl hydroxylases和TET、JmjC demethylases。抗坏血酸还能将膳食中的非血红素铁还原为可吸收的亚铁形式。人类无法自行合成维生素C，因为gulonolactone oxidase基因失活。

Deficiency disease缺乏症Scurvy坏血病

First signs早期表现After roughly one to three months of intake below about 10 mg/day, plasma ascorbate falls and body stores drop under about 300 mg. The first phase is fatigue, irritability and diffuse aching in the legs, with nothing visible. Then come the specific skin signs: perifollicular hyperkeratosis with corkscrew-shaped body hairs on the thighs and shins, perifollicular haemorrhage, easy bruising, and swollen, spongy, bleeding gums in anyone who still has teeth.摄入量低于约10 mg/day持续大约一到三个月后，血浆抗坏血酸下降，体内储存量降至约300 mg以下。第一阶段表现为疲劳、易激惹和大腿及小腿弥漫性酸痛，外观上没有可见改变。随后出现特征性皮肤体征：毛囊周围角化过度，大腿和胫部体毛呈螺旋状，毛囊周围出血，容易瘀伤，牙齿尚存者会出现牙龈肿胀、松软、出血。

Untreated不治疗会怎样Bleeding into skin, muscle and joints, haemarthrosis, and subperiosteal haemorrhage, which in children causes severe limb pain and refusal to move (pseudoparalysis). Old wounds and scars break down, teeth loosen and are lost, anaemia and oedema develop. Untreated scurvy is fatal, usually from haemorrhage or cardiac failure, though it very rarely reaches that stage in current practice because treatment is trivially available.皮肤、肌肉和关节内出血，关节积血，以及骨膜下出血，后者在儿童中会引起严重肢体疼痛并拒绝活动（假性瘫痪）。陈旧的伤口和瘢痕会重新裂开，牙齿松动脱落，出现贫血和水肿。未经治疗的坏血病是致命的，通常死于出血或心力衰竭，不过在当前的医疗条件下，由于治疗极易获得，病情很少会发展到这一步。

Does it reverse补回来能修复吗Complete and unusually fast. Fatigue and pain begin improving within 24 to 48 hours of treatment, bleeding gums and bruising settle over one to two weeks, and full recovery takes around three months on 100 to 300 mg/day. No permanent deficit remains. The only exception is teeth already lost, which do not grow back.恢复完全且异常迅速。治疗开始后24至48小时内疲劳和疼痛就开始改善，牙龈出血和瘀伤在一到两周内消退，按每日100至300 mg补充，完全恢复大约需要三个月。不会遗留永久性缺陷，唯一的例外是已经脱落的牙齿，这不会再长回来。

Who becomes deficient谁会缺乏People whose diets contain almost no fruit or vegetables: highly restrictive or selective eaters including some autistic children, people living alone with severe mental illness or dementia, alcohol and drug dependence, homelessness and food insecurity. Also smokers (requirement about 35 mg/day higher), people on dialysis, malabsorption, and some patients after bariatric surgery. Scurvy is a disease of dietary pattern, not of insufficient supplementation; roughly 10 mg/day prevents it and a single orange comfortably exceeds that.饮食中几乎不含水果蔬菜的人群：高度限制性或挑食者，包括部分自闭症儿童，独居的重度精神疾病或痴呆患者，酒精和药物依赖者，无家可归和食物不安全人群。此外还有吸烟者（需要量比一般人约高出35 mg/day）、透析患者、吸收不良患者，以及部分减重手术后患者。坏血病是一种饮食模式性疾病，而非补充剂摄入不足的问题，大约每日10 mg即可预防，一个橙子就能轻松超过这一需要量。

How common有多常见7.1% (SE 0.9) of the US population aged 6 and over had serum ascorbate below 11.4 micromol/L in NHANES 2003 to 2004, down from about 13% in NHANES III, with the highest rates in smokers and low-income groups (PMID 19675106).在NHANES 2003至2004年调查中，美国6岁及以上人群有7.1%（标准误0.9）血清抗坏血酸低于11.4 micromol/L，低于NHANES III中约13%的水平，吸烟者和低收入群体的比例最高（PMID 19675106）。

Source来源PMID 19675106 (Schleicher et al., Am J Clin Nutr 2009, serum vitamin C and prevalence of deficiency in the United States, NHANES 2003 to 2004)

Food and the body食物与身体
In food: Rich食物中：丰富 Dose from food: Reachable靠吃达到剂量：可达到 Body makes it: Cannot身体自产：不能 Food data: High食物数据：高

Genuinely rich and cheap in ordinary food, and the verification pass challenged this classification and upheld it as the strongest in the set: one 119 g red pepper (152 mg) or one 55 g guava (125 mg) exceeds the 90 mg adult male RDA on its own, with no trace-amount inflation anywhere in the list. Synthetic ascorbic acid is manufactured (Reichstein or two-step fermentation from glucose), but it is the identical molecule, so the synthetic label carries no penalty here. Percentages below are given against both DRI values, since the RDA is 90 mg for men and 75 mg for women and quoting only the male figure understates every food's contribution for women by 20%. Rose hips, camu-camu, chilli peppers, papaya and Brussels sprouts are further rich sources for which no verified figure was available, so they get no row.在普通食物里真正丰富而且便宜。核查环节对这一分类提出质疑并予以确认，认定它是整组里最扎实的一项：一个 119 g 的红甜椒（152 mg）或一个 55 g 的番石榴（125 mg）单独就超过成人男性 90 mg 的 RDA，整份清单里没有任何靠痕量堆数字的地方。合成抗坏血酸是制造出来的（Reichstein 法，或以葡萄糖为原料的两步发酵法），但它是完全相同的分子，所以合成这个标签在这里不带任何折扣。下面的百分比同时给出两个 DRI 数值，因为 RDA 男性为 90 mg、女性为 75 mg，只引男性数字会把每种食物对女性的贡献低估 20%。玫瑰果、卡姆果（camu-camu）、辣椒、木瓜和抱子甘蓝也是富含来源，但没有可核实的数据，因此不单列。

To match the dose要达到该剂量This is the one item in the set where the supplement dose is physically reachable by eating. A 1,000 mg tablet equals 60 g of raw acerola, about 12 small fruits, or 439 g of guava (8 fruits), or 552 g of blackcurrants, or 781 g of raw red pepper (about 6.6 medium peppers), or 1.07 kg of raw kale, or 1.70 kg of strawberries, or 1.88 kg of orange (14 medium oranges), or 2.0 kg of fresh orange juice, which is about 1.9 litres (the submission's '2.0 litres' confused grams with litres). A 500 mg dose is 3.3 red peppers or 7 oranges. Eccentric for most of that list, and trivially easy through acerola, so a person genuinely could eat this dose. The real gap is that the dose above roughly 200 mg is pointless rather than unreachable. Levine et al. gave 30-2,500 mg/day under depletion-repletion control: bioavailability was complete at a single 200 mg dose and fell off at 500 mg and above with the absorbed excess appearing in urine, while leucocytes saturated at 100 mg/day and plasma at 1,000 mg/day (PNAS 1996;93:3704-9, PMID 8623000, DOI 10.1073/pnas.93.8.3704). Four or five servings of ordinary fruit and vegetables reach the physiologically useful plateau, and the 1,000 mg tablet mostly funds expensive urine. The number that should temper any composition table is what survives handling: see cooking and storage below.这是整组里唯一一个靠吃就能在物理上达到补充剂剂量的项目。1,000 mg 的片剂等于 60 g 生针叶樱桃，约 12 颗小果，或 439 g 番石榴（8 个），或 552 g 黑加仑，或 781 g 生红甜椒（约 6.6 个中等大小），或 1.07 kg 生羽衣甘蓝，或 1.70 kg 草莓，或 1.88 kg 橙子（14 个中等大小），或 2.0 kg 鲜榨橙汁，约合 1.9 升（原稿写的 2.0 升把克和升搞混了）。500 mg 的剂量是 3.3 个红甜椒或 7 个橙子。这份清单上大多数选项都很古怪，通过针叶樱桃则轻而易举，所以一个人确实吃得到这个剂量。真正的问题在别处：超过约 200 mg 的剂量吃得到，只是没有意义。Levine 等在耗竭-补足的对照条件下给予 30-2,500 mg/天：单次 200 mg 剂量的生物利用度是完全的，500 mg 及以上开始下降，吸收后多余的部分出现在尿中；白细胞在 100 mg/天饱和，血浆在 1,000 mg/天饱和（PNAS 1996;93:3704-9, PMID 8623000, DOI 10.1073/pnas.93.8.3704）。四到五份普通蔬果就能达到生理上有用的平台，1,000 mg 的片剂多半只是在为昂贵的尿液付钱。该给成分表打折的那个数字是经过处理后还剩下多少，见下面的烹饪与储存部分。

Food vs supplement食物与补充剂Effectively NONE on the molecule. Synthetic and food-derived vitamin C are chemically identical and all steady-state human comparative bioavailability studies show no difference, with some acute pharmacokinetic studies showing minor transient differences of no physiological consequence (Carr and Vissers, Nutrients 2013;5:4284-304, PMID 24169506, DOI 10.3390/nu5114284). That kills the claim that natural vitamin C is better absorbed, and it means acerola, camu-camu and rose hip products carry no absorption advantage; most such products are in any case standardised by adding synthetic ascorbic acid, so the buyer gets the synthetic molecule with fruit powder attached. Note that acerola still earns a food row on content alone, at 1,680 mg/100 g the richest verified source in the database, which is a separate matter from the debunked absorption claim. What the whole food genuinely adds is the rest of the matrix, potassium, folate, carotenoids, flavonoids and fibre, none of which is in the tablet and none of which the vitamin C evidence is about. Where a caveat does bite is the textbook recommendation to eat spinach: its vitamin C is modest at 28.1 mg/100 g, a realistic 30 g cup gives 8.4 mg, and boiling extracts most of what is there, moving 60% of the vitamin C and 50% of the flavonoids of fresh-cut spinach into the cooking water (Gil, Ferreres and Tomas-Barberan, J Agric Food Chem 1999;47:2213-7, PMID 10794612). Recommending boiled spinach for vitamin C comes close to recommending the cooking water. Raw kale at 93.4 mg/100 g is the green that actually delivers, three times the spinach figure.就分子本身而言基本没有。合成与来自食物的维生素 C 化学上完全相同，所有稳态条件下的人体比较生物利用度研究都显示没有差别，部分急性药代动力学研究显示的轻微短暂差异没有生理意义（Carr 与 Vissers, Nutrients 2013;5:4284-304, PMID 24169506, DOI 10.3390/nu5114284）。这否掉了天然维生素 C 吸收更好的说法，也意味着针叶樱桃、卡姆果和玫瑰果产品在吸收上没有优势；这类产品本来大多靠添加合成抗坏血酸来做标准化，买家拿到的是带着果粉的合成分子。要注意针叶樱桃仍然凭含量单独占一行，1,680 mg/100 g 是数据库中已核实的最富来源，这与被否掉的吸收说法是两件事。整个食物真正多给的是基质里的其余成分，钾、叶酸、类胡萝卜素、类黄酮和膳食纤维，片剂里都没有，而维生素 C 的证据讲的也不是这些。真正需要警告的是教科书式的吃菠菜补维生素 C 这条建议：菠菜的维生素 C 含量一般，28.1 mg/100 g，现实中一杯 30 g 只给 8.4 mg，而水煮会把里面的大部分萃取出去，鲜切菠菜有 60% 的维生素 C 和 50% 的类黄酮进了煮菜的水里（Gil、Ferreres 与 Tomas-Barberan, J Agric Food Chem 1999;47:2213-7, PMID 10794612）。推荐用水煮菠菜补维生素 C，差不多等于推荐那锅水。生羽衣甘蓝 93.4 mg/100 g 才是真正管用的绿叶菜，是菠菜数字的三倍。

Absorption吸收Absorption is near-complete up to about 200 mg per dose via the sodium-dependent transporter SVCT1, declines above 500 mg, and plasma saturates at 1,000 mg/day (PMID 8623000). Absorption is therefore not the variable that matters; retention before eating is. Cooking and storage losses, all from USDA Table of Nutrient Retention Factors Release 6 (2007), ascorbic acid column: greens boiled in water to cover and drained retain 55% (code 3005), greens boiled in a little water and drained 60% (3004), greens stir-fried 85% (3015), greens cooked from frozen and drained 60% (3019); other vegetables boiled in water to cover and drained 75% (3775), steamed 85% (3784); potatoes baked in the skin 80% (3301), boiled pared and drained 75% (3308), and only 25% when boiled after storage and browned (3311); canned fruit 50% (0154) and dried fruit 20% (0158). Steaming beats boiling and draining consistently: in broccoli every method except steaming caused significant loss of vitamin C and chlorophyll (Yuan et al., J Zhejiang Univ Sci B 2009;10:580-8, PMID 19650196, DOI 10.1631/jzus.b0920051). Storage compounds it: 15 days at 4 C across 19 fruits and vegetables lowered vitamin C and cut total phenolics by up to 29.67%, though total anthocyanins showed minimal change in that study despite the title (Galani et al., Antioxidants 2017;6(3):59, PMID 28737734). Practical upshot: a week-old boiled vegetable can deliver a quarter of its table value, so the 27% loss between raw broccoli at 89.2 mg/100 g and boiled broccoli at 64.9 mg/100 g is the optimistic case rather than the worst one.每次剂量约 200 mg 以内，经钠依赖性转运体 SVCT1 的吸收接近完全，超过 500 mg 后下降，血浆在 1,000 mg/天饱和（PMID 8623000）。决定实际摄入的是入口前还能保留多少，吸收本身不构成变量。烹饪与储存损失全部出自 USDA 营养素保留系数表（Table of Nutrient Retention Factors）第 6 版（2007）的抗坏血酸一栏：绿叶菜加水没过煮后沥干保留 55%（代码 3005），加少量水煮后沥干 60%（3004），快炒 85%（3015），从冷冻直接烹制后沥干 60%（3019）；其他蔬菜加水没过煮后沥干 75%（3775），蒸 85%（3784）；带皮烤马铃薯 80%（3301），削皮水煮沥干 75%（3308），储存后再水煮并褐变的只有 25%（3311）；罐装水果 50%（0154），干制水果 20%（0158）。蒸一贯优于水煮后沥干：在西兰花上，除蒸制以外的每一种方法都造成维生素 C 和叶绿素的显著损失（Yuan 等, J Zhejiang Univ Sci B 2009;10:580-8, PMID 19650196, DOI 10.1631/jzus.b0920051）。储存会叠加：19 种蔬果在 4 C 下放 15 天，维生素 C 下降，总酚类最多减少 29.67%，不过该研究中总花青素变化很小，与标题给人的印象不同（Galani 等, Antioxidants 2017;6(3):59, PMID 28737734）。实际结论：放了一周又水煮过的蔬菜可能只剩成分表数值的四分之一，所以生西兰花 89.2 mg/100 g 到水煮西兰花 64.9 mg/100 g 之间那 27% 的损失属于乐观情形，最坏的情况比这更糟。

Food data note食物数据说明All ten original per-100 g values and all gram weights matched named FoodData Central records exactly, including the raw and boiled broccoli split, and every per-portion figure recomputed. All five cited PMIDs resolve to the stated journal, volume and pages with findings matching the abstracts, and eleven retention factors were verified row by row against Release 6. Two smaller qualifications: the acerola and kale figures come from the verification report's own FDC lookups rather than the original submission, and the 100 g kale portion basis is stated by this dataset rather than taken from a USDA household measure高。原稿的十个每 100 g 数值和所有克重都与具名的 FoodData Central 记录完全吻合，包括生西兰花与水煮西兰花的拆分，每个每份数值都能重算得出。引用的五个 PMID 全部指向所述期刊、卷号和页码，结论与摘要一致，十一个保留系数逐行对照第 6 版核实。两点较小的限定：针叶樱桃和羽衣甘蓝的数据来自核查环节自行查询的 FDC 记录，并非原稿提供；羽衣甘蓝 100 g 的份量基准由本数据集给出，并非取自 USDA 的家庭常用量。

Does the body make it身体是否自产Humans carry the terminal enzyme L-gulonolactone oxidase (GULO) only as a non-functional pseudogene, so synthesis is zero and the loss is genetic in origin (PMID 8175804); rats and dogs, which retain GULO, do not develop scurvy and we do. This is the reference case for what NONE means, and here the endogenous axis argues for intake, because a deficiency disease exists with a defined clinical picture. Every milligram is dietary, so supplementation is never redundant on this axis, and the case for a given dose rests on intake, losses and the plateau of tissue saturation.人类的终末酶 L-gulonolactone oxidase (GULO) 只以无功能假基因形式存在, 因此合成量为零, 这一缺失来自遗传层面 (PMID 8175804); 保留 GULO 的大鼠和狗不会得坏血病, 人会。这是理解 NONE 到底意味着什么的标杆案例, 在这里内源性这一维度支持摄入, 因为存在具有明确临床表现的缺乏病。每一毫克抗坏血酸都来自膳食, 所以在这一维度上补充永远不算多余, 具体剂量的理由取决于摄入量, 损失量和组织饱和的平台。

Pathway合成通路NOT APPLICABLE in humans, because the terminal enzyme is a pseudogene. In species that retain it: glucose to UDP-glucuronate to D-glucuronate to L-gulonate to L-gulono-1,4-lactone, then GULO to L-ascorbate, hepatic in mammals and renal in birds and reptiles. Humans retain only downstream handling: SVCT1 (SLC23A1) for intestinal and renal uptake, SVCT2 (SLC23A2) for tissue uptake, with dehydroascorbate regenerated to ascorbate by glutathione and thioredoxin reductase. Ascorbate is the required reducing cofactor for the Fe(II)/2-oxoglutarate-dependent prolyl and lysyl hydroxylases of collagen maturation.在人体中 NOT APPLICABLE, 终末酶是假基因。在保留该酶的物种中: 葡萄糖到 UDP-glucuronate 到 D-glucuronate 到 L-gulonate 到 L-gulono-1,4-lactone, 再由 GULO 生成 L-ascorbate, 哺乳动物在肝, 鸟类和爬行类在肾。人体只保留下游处理: SVCT1 (SLC23A1) 负责肠道和肾脏摄取, SVCT2 (SLC23A2) 负责组织摄取, 脱氢抗坏血酸由谷胱甘肽和硫氧还蛋白还原酶再生为抗坏血酸。抗坏血酸是胶原成熟所需的 Fe(II)/2-oxoglutarate 依赖型脯氨酰羟化酶和赖氨酰羟化酶的必需还原辅因子。

Amount made自产量0 mg/day endogenous synthesis. Dietary requirement instead: scurvy is prevented by roughly 10 mg/d; RDA 90 mg/day for men and 75 mg/day for women, plus 35 mg/day for smokers; plasma and neutrophil pools approach saturation near 200 mg/d; UL 2,000 mg/day (IOM DRI 2000, vitamin C chapter).内源合成 0 mg/day。取而代之的是膳食需要量: 约 10 mg/d 即可预防坏血病; RDA 男性 90 mg/day, 女性 75 mg/day, 吸烟者再加 35 mg/day; 血浆和中性粒细胞池在约 200 mg/d 附近接近饱和; UL 2,000 mg/day (IOM DRI 2000, 维生素 C 章)。

Still matters when仍有意义的情形Scurvy and populations at risk of it: very low fruit and vegetable intake, alcohol use disorder, restrictive diets, institutionalised or isolated older people, smoking, haemodialysis and some malabsorption patients, where the response to repletion is rapid and unambiguous. Also relevant to collagen synthesis, which is why collagen peptide products depend on adequate vitamin C status. Gram doses for cold prevention in the general population are not requirement-based, and surplus is renally cleared with a rise in urinary oxalate; high-dose intravenous ascorbate in cancer treatment is a separate pharmacological question for the treating team.坏血病及其高危人群: 蔬果摄入极低, 酒精使用障碍, 限制性饮食, 被机构照护或独居的老年人, 吸烟, 血液透析和部分吸收不良患者, 这类情况下补足后的反应迅速且明确。它也与胶原合成相关, 因此胶原肽类产品依赖足够的维生素 C 营养状态。一般人群用克级剂量预防感冒并非以需要量为依据, 多余部分由肾脏清除, 同时尿草酸升高; 肿瘤治疗中的高剂量静脉抗坏血酸属于另一个药理学问题, 应交由主管治疗团队处理。

Synthesis source合成来源PMID 8175804 (Nishikimi et al., J Biol Chem 1994;269:13685-13688); GULO pseudogenisation (GULOP) and human dependence on dietary ascorbate: PMID 38683367 and PMID 40003647; Levine M, Conry-Cantilena C, Wang Y, et al.; IOM, Dietary Reference Intakes for Vitamin C, Vitamin E, Selenium, and Carotenoids (2000), vitamin C chapter. Merged from the recovered entries Vitamin C (ascorbic acid) and Vitamin C (ascorbate).

Dose tested已验证剂量100 mg three times daily, the Q-SYMBIO regimen. Ubiquinol is more bioavailable and doses do not transfer 1:1 from ubiquinone.100 毫克每日三次，即 Q-SYMBIO 方案。泛醇生物利用度更高，与泛醌之间剂量不能一比一换算。
Who适用人群Patients with heart failure with reduced ejection fraction, already on guideline therapy, with cardiology input.射血分数降低的心衰患者，且已在接受指南推荐治疗，需心内科参与决定。
Pros优点
  • Q-SYMBIO is the only clinical-endpoint result in the whole longevity and metabolic category: n=420, 2 years, major adverse cardiovascular events 15% versus 26%, HR 0.50 (0.32-0.80).Q-SYMBIO 是整个抗衰老与代谢品类中唯一有临床终点的结果：n=420，2 年，主要不良心血管事件 15% 对 26%，HR 0.50（0.32-0.80）。
  • Genuine primary CoQ10 deficiency is a real, rare condition where replacement is the treatment.真正的原发性辅酶 Q10 缺乏是一种真实存在的罕见病，替代治疗就是它的疗法。
Cons缺点
  • Q-SYMBIO is a single unreplicated trial. The NIHR health technology assessment covering 26 trials and 2,250 participants flagged important concerns about risk of bias, plausibility of effect sizes and applicability, and found all-cause mortality RR 0.68 (0.45-1.03), not significant.Q-SYMBIO 是一项未被重复验证的单一试验。NIHR 的卫生技术评估涵盖 26 项试验、2250 名受试者，对其偏倚风险、效应量的合理性和适用性提出重要质疑，并得出全因死亡 RR 0.68（0.45-1.03），不显著。
  • For statin-associated muscle symptoms, which is where most retail CoQ10 is actually sold, it does nothing: weighted mean difference -0.42 (-1.47 to 0.62) and adherence RR 0.99 across 7 trials.在他汀相关肌痛这个零售辅酶 Q10 的真正主销场景上，它毫无作用：7 项试验的加权均数差为 -0.42（-1.47 至 0.62），依从性 RR 0.99。
  • Warfarin interaction: CoQ10 is structurally similar to vitamin K, and one cross-sectional analysis of patients presenting with anticoagulant overdose found an association with bleeding.与华法林的相互作用：辅酶 Q10 结构上与维生素 K 相似，一项针对抗凝药过量就诊患者的横断面分析发现其与出血相关。
  • Expensive relative to everything else in this document, and the 1,200 mg observed safe level comes from a risk assessment whose authors were affiliated with an industry trade body.相对本文中其他产品价格昂贵，而 1200 毫克的“观察安全水平”出自一份作者与行业协会有关联的风险评估。
What it does, and what happens without it它有什么作用，缺了会怎样

Carries electrons in the mitochondrial energy chain and protects cell membranes from oxidation.在线粒体能量链中传递电子,并保护细胞膜免受氧化损伤。

No deficiency state exists不存在缺乏状态

In detail详细Coenzyme Q10 is a lipid-soluble benzoquinone with a ten-unit isoprenoid tail. In the inner mitochondrial membrane it shuttles electrons from complexes I and II to complex III, and it is also the electron acceptor for dihydroorotate dehydrogenase in pyrimidine synthesis and for fatty acid beta-oxidation through ETF-QO. Its reduced form, ubiquinol, is the main lipid-phase antioxidant of membranes and regenerates vitamin E. Humans synthesize it through the mevalonate pathway, the same pathway statins inhibit, and food contributes only a few milligrams a day. It is not a vitamin, there is no dietary requirement, and no dietary CoQ10 deficiency state exists. What does exist is primary coenzyme Q10 deficiency (COQ10D1 to COQ10D10), an autosomal recessive inborn error of CoQ10 biosynthesis caused by variants in PDSS1, PDSS2, COQ2, COQ4, COQ5, COQ6, COQ7, COQ8A, COQ8B or COQ9. That is a genetic disorder of synthesis, not a consequence of low dietary intake, and it is ultra-rare: GeneReviews notes that prevalence data are limited by the small number of affected individuals reported, ranging from 2 to just over 10 families per causative gene. Presentation spans the neonatal period to the seventh decade: steroid-resistant nephrotic syndrome with proteinuria, cerebellar ataxia, exercise intolerance and muscle weakness, or encephalopathy with seizures, and diagnosis rests on CoQ10 measurement in muscle or fibroblasts plus genetic testing. Severe neonatal-onset forms cause fatal multisystem disease with encephalopathy, hypertrophic cardiomyopathy and renal failure, while later-onset forms progress to cerebellar atrophy with disabling ataxia or to end-stage kidney disease. High-dose oral CoQ10 can block progression of the kidney disease and improve some myopathic and encephalopathic features, and works best when started before damage is established; established severe neurological or renal damage does not reverse, and neonatal-onset disease responds poorly, partly because CoQ10 penetrates the blood-brain barrier badly. Separately and far more commonly, statins lower circulating CoQ10. Marcoff and Thompson's narrative systematic review of 9 observational studies and 6 randomised trials reports reductions of 16 to 54 percent, with the largest single trial (n=1,049) finding 38 percent with atorvastatin and 27 percent with lovastatin; pooled meta-analysis puts the effect at a weighted mean difference of -0.44 micromol/L (95% CI -0.52 to -0.37). That is a change in a blood concentration, not the disease described above, and trials of CoQ10 for statin-associated muscle symptoms have given conflicting results.辅酶Q10是一种脂溶性苯醌,带有由十个异戊二烯单位组成的侧链。在线粒体内膜中,它将电子从复合体I和复合体II传递到复合体III,同时也是嘧啶合成中二氢乳清酸脱氢酶以及经ETF-QO途径进行脂肪酸β氧化时的电子受体。其还原型泛醇是细胞膜上主要的脂相抗氧化物质,并能再生维生素E。人体通过甲羟戊酸途径合成辅酶Q10,他汀类药物抑制的正是这一途径,食物每天仅贡献几毫克。它不是维生素,没有膳食摄入需求,也不存在膳食性辅酶Q10缺乏状态。真正存在的是原发性辅酶Q10缺乏症(COQ10D1至COQ10D10),这是一种由PDSS1、PDSS2、COQ2、COQ4、COQ5、COQ6、COQ7、COQ8A、COQ8B或COQ9基因变异引起的、辅酶Q10生物合成缺陷的常染色体隐性遗传病。这是一种合成通路的基因病,而非膳食摄入不足的后果,且极为罕见:GeneReviews指出,由于报告的患者数量很少,患病率数据有限,每个致病基因对应的家系报告数在2至略超10个之间。发病可见于新生儿期至70岁,表现为伴蛋白尿的激素抵抗型肾病综合征、小脑共济失调、运动不耐受和肌无力,或伴癫痫发作的脑病,诊断依赖肌肉或成纤维细胞中辅酶Q10测定加基因检测。重度新生儿起病型可导致致死性多系统疾病,伴脑病、肥厚型心肌病和肾衰竭,而较晚起病型则进展为小脑萎缩伴致残性共济失调,或进展为终末期肾病。大剂量口服辅酶Q10可阻止肾脏疾病进展,并改善部分肌病和脑病表现,在损伤尚未确立前开始治疗效果最佳;而一旦出现严重的神经系统或肾脏损伤则无法逆转,新生儿起病型的反应也较差,部分原因是辅酶Q10难以穿透血脑屏障。与此完全不同、也更为常见的是,他汀类药物会降低循环辅酶Q10水平。Marcoff和Thompson对9项观察性研究和6项随机试验的叙述性系统综述报告降幅为16%至54%,其中单项最大规模试验(n=1,049)发现阿托伐他汀降幅为38%,洛伐他汀为27%;汇总meta分析得出的加权均数差为-0.44微摩尔/升(95%置信区间-0.52至-0.37)。这是一种血液浓度的变化,而非上文所述的疾病,且辅酶Q10用于治疗他汀相关肌肉症状的试验结果并不一致。

There is no deficiency state for this. It is not an essential nutrient, so being short of it is not a thing that can happen.它不存在缺乏状态。它不是必需营养素，所以“缺了它”这件事本身并不成立。

Source来源GeneReviews, Primary Coenzyme Q10 Deficiency Overview, NCBI Bookshelf NBK410087; Marcoff & Thompson, J Am Coll Cardiol 2007;49:2231-2237 (16 to 54 percent statin-associated reduction in circulating CoQ10); Banach et al., Pharmacol Res 2015, PMID 26192349 (meta-analytic WMD -0.44 micromol/L)

Food and the body食物与身体
In food: Rich食物中：丰富 Dose from food: Out of reach靠吃达到剂量：达不到 Body makes it: Body makes it身体自产：身体自产 Food data: Medium食物数据：中

Organ meats and oily fish are genuine, substantial sources, so the substance question and the dose question separate cleanly here. Pork heart at 118.1-282 mg/kg is the richest food in the literature, beef heart is 113 mg/kg, chicken heart 92.3-192 mg/kg, chicken liver 116.2-132.2 mg/kg and mackerel dark flesh 43-67 mg/kg. Total habitual dietary intake is only 3.8 mg/day in women and 5.4 mg/day in men (Mattila & Kumpulainen 2001), so a single 100 g portion of heart is two to five days of ordinary intake. That is what RICH means in this dataset. It does not mean the supplement dose is reachable, which it is not. Supplement CoQ10 is produced by microbial fermentation or chemical synthesis, not extracted from beef.内脏和油性鱼类是真实且可观的来源，所以这里“物质是否存在”与“剂量能否达到”可以清楚分开。文献中最富含的食物是猪心，118.1-282 mg/kg；牛心 113 mg/kg，鸡心 92.3-192 mg/kg，鸡肝 116.2-132.2 mg/kg，鲭鱼暗色肉 43-67 mg/kg。膳食总习惯摄入量只有女性 3.8 mg/天、男性 5.4 mg/天（Mattila & Kumpulainen 2001），因此单独一份 100 g 心脏就等于两到五天的普通摄入量。这就是本数据集中 RICH（丰富）的含义。它并不意味着补剂剂量可以达到，那是达不到的。补剂辅酶 Q10 由微生物发酵或化学合成制得，不从牛肉中提取。

To match the dose要达到该剂量A 300 mg/day dose needs 1.06 kg of pork heart at its richest measured value, rising to 2.54 kg at its low end; 1.6 to 3.3 kg of chicken hearts; 2.65 kg of beef heart; or 4.7 kg of the very richest sardines, about 51 tins, rising past 60 kg if the tins sit at the low end of the measured range. The submission's '2.7 kg of beef heart' was presented as the floor only because pork heart, the richest source of all, was missing. Against a whole day's ordinary dietary CoQ10 of 3.8-5.4 mg, a 300 mg capsule is about 56 to 79 days of eating in one dose and a 100 mg capsule about 19 to 26 days. The one boundary case worth stating: 355 g of pork heart at its richest measured value does reach 100 mg, which is a real meal in some cuisines but not a diet anyone sustains. Anyone whose reason for taking CoQ10 is a claimed pharmacological effect at 100-300 mg cannot get there by eating; anyone whose reason is a low-CoQ10 diet can move the needle with a weekly portion of heart, liver or oily fish.300 mg/天 的剂量需要按最富实测值计的 1.06 kg 猪心，按其低值则升到 2.54 kg；或 1.6 到 3.3 kg 鸡心；或 2.65 kg 牛心；或最富含的沙丁鱼 4.7 kg，约 51 罐，若罐头处于实测区间低端则超过 60 kg。原提交稿的“2.7 kg 牛心”之所以被当作下限，只是因为漏掉了最富含的猪心。对照一整天普通膳食辅酶 Q10 的 3.8-5.4 mg，一粒 300 mg 胶囊约等于一次吃下 56 到 79 天的量，100 mg 胶囊约 19 到 26 天。有一个边界情形值得说明：按最富实测值，355 g 猪心确实能达到 100 mg，在某些饮食文化里这是一顿真实的饭，但没人会长期这样吃。凡是因为宣称的 100-300 mg 药理作用而服用辅酶 Q10 的人，靠吃达不到；凡是因为膳食辅酶 Q10 偏低而服用的人，每周一份心脏、肝脏或油性鱼就能改变局面。

Food vs supplement食物与补充剂Significant. CoQ10 is a large lipophilic quinone (MW 863) and crystalline ubiquinone powder in a dry tablet absorbs very poorly; commercial products use oil suspensions, solubilisates or reduced-form ubiquinol precisely because the raw molecule does not dissolve. Absorption is saturable, so a 300 mg dose does not deliver proportionally more than a 100 mg dose. Food has one genuine advantage: CoQ10 in meat and fish comes packaged with fat, and supplemental CoQ10 taken with a fatty meal absorbs materially better, so a capsule swallowed on an empty stomach may deliver less than the label implies. Cooking costs some of the food content, with reported losses of roughly 15-32% frying pork cutlets and about 15% grilling beef. Most body CoQ10 is made endogenously and the biosynthetic pathway shares its early steps with cholesterol synthesis, which is the basis of the statin argument; neither food nor supplement changes that pathway.显著。辅酶 Q10 是大分子亲脂性醌（MW 863），干片中的结晶泛醌粉末吸收极差；商品之所以采用油悬液、增溶体系或还原型泛醇，正是因为原始分子不溶。吸收是可饱和的，300 mg 剂量送达的量并不按比例高于 100 mg。食物有一个真实优势：肉和鱼里的辅酶 Q10 天然与脂肪一同包装，而补充的辅酶 Q10 随含脂餐服用吸收明显更好，所以空腹吞下的胶囊送达量可能低于标签所示。烹饪会损失一部分含量，已报告猪排油炸损失约 15-32%，牛肉烤制约 15%。体内辅酶 Q10 大部分为内源合成，其生物合成通路的早期步骤与胆固醇合成共用，这也是他汀相关论点的基础；食物和补剂都不改变这条通路。

Absorption吸收Low and formulation-dependent for the supplement, which is the honest headline. Ubiquinol (reduced) and solubilised formulations achieve higher plasma levels than plain crystalline ubiquinone, and all forms depend on dietary fat and bile for uptake. In the food matrix CoQ10 sits in mitochondrial membranes and is co-ingested with fat, so uptake per milligram is probably as good as or better than a dry capsule, but the milligram totals are 10 to 80 times too small: the richest single portion in the table is 28.2 mg against a 300 mg dose. The reduced-to-oxidised split also differs between foods: a Japanese survey of 70 food items found ubiquinol-10 above 20 ug/g in pork shoulder, bovine liver, chicken heart, horse mackerel, young yellowtail and soybean oil (Kubo H, Fujii K, Kawabe T, Matsumoto S, Kishida H, Hosoe K, 'Food content of ubiquinol-10 and ubiquinone-10 in the Japanese diet', J Food Compos Anal 2008;21(3):199-210, DOI 10.1016/j.jfca.2007.10.003), so ubiquinol is not an exclusively supplemental form.补剂的生物利用度低且高度依赖剂型，这是诚实的结论。还原型泛醇和增溶剂型达到的血药浓度高于普通结晶泛醌，所有形式的吸收都依赖膳食脂肪和胆汁。在食物基质中，辅酶 Q10 位于线粒体膜内并与脂肪同时摄入，每毫克的吸收大概不亚于甚至优于干粉胶囊，问题在于毫克总量小了 10 到 80 倍：表中最富的单份是 28.2 mg，对照 300 mg 剂量。还原型与氧化型的比例在不同食物间也不同：一项针对 70 种日本食品的调查发现，猪肩肉、牛肝、鸡心、竹荚鱼、小鰤鱼和大豆油中泛醇-10 高于 20 µg/g（Kubo H, Fujii K, Kawabe T, Matsumoto S, Kishida H, Hosoe K, 'Food content of ubiquinol-10 and ubiquinone-10 in the Japanese diet', J Food Compos Anal 2008;21(3):199-210, DOI 10.1016/j.jfca.2007.10.003），可见泛醇并非补剂独有的形式。

Food data note食物数据说明Eight of the Pravst table values were confirmed, along with the habitual intake figures and every per-portion conversion built on them, but the confirmation came from a reproduction of the table rather than the paywalled original. The two richest rows are weaker: pork heart's provenance was not pinned to a specific primary reference, and chicken heart comes from a secondary compilation after the submission's figure turned out to belong to chicken liver. The USDA FDC IDs are unconfirmed中。Pravst 表中的八个数值，以及习惯摄入量数据和基于它们的每份换算，全部得到确认，但确认依据是该表的复制版而非付费墙后的原文。最富的两条条目较弱：猪心的出处未能锁定到具体原始文献，鸡心来自二次汇编，起因是原提交稿的数字其实属于鸡肝。USDA FDC ID 未经确认。

Does the body make it身体是否自产Every human cell makes ubiquinone on the mevalonate pathway, attaching a decaprenyl tail made by PDSS1/PDSS2 to a 4-hydroxybenzoate ring via COQ2, then finishing the molecule with the COQ3 to COQ9 enzymes and reducing it to ubiquinol. Diet supplies only 3 to 5 mg a day, a small contribution next to the tissue pools that endogenous synthesis maintains, so a healthy person is not short of CoQ10 and this is the clearest case in the group of a supplement filling a gap that does not exist. The statin link is real at the level of plasma measurement, where CoQ10 falls by about 0.44 micromol/L on treatment, and its interpretation is limited because plasma CoQ10 is carried on LDL, so part of the fall simply tracks the lipoprotein concentration and tissue or muscle depletion has not been demonstrated; on the endogenous axis nothing here exposes a dietary deficiency to correct.人体每个细胞都通过 mevalonate 通路合成泛醌, 由 PDSS1/PDSS2 制造癸异戊烯基尾链, 经 COQ2 接到 4-hydroxybenzoate 环上, 再由 COQ3 至 COQ9 一系列酶完成分子并还原为泛醇。膳食每天只提供 3 到 5 mg, 相对于内源合成维持的组织池只是很小的一部分, 因此健康人并不缺 CoQ10, 在这一组条目中它最清楚地展示了一种补充剂在填补并不存在的缺口。他汀的关联在血浆测量层面确实存在, 治疗后 CoQ10 下降约 0.44 micromol/L, 但解读受限: 血浆 CoQ10 由 LDL 携带, 下降的一部分只是跟随载脂蛋白浓度, 组织或肌肉 CoQ10 耗竭尚未被证明; 就内源性这条轴而言, 这里没有暴露出任何需要纠正的膳食缺乏。

Pathway合成通路Acetyl-CoA to HMG-CoA to mevalonate to farnesyl-PP to decaprenyl-PP (PDSS1/PDSS2); condensation with 4-hydroxybenzoate derived from tyrosine/phenylalanine by COQ2, and the tyrosine-to-4-hydroxybenzoate transamination steps require pyridoxal 5'-phosphate, so vitamin B6 status feeds the ring supply; ring modification by COQ3, COQ5, COQ6, COQ7 and COQ9 with the COQ8A and COQ8B kinases at the inner mitochondrial membrane, then reduction to ubiquinol. HMG-CoA reductase, the statin target, sits upstream of the polyprenyl tail.Acetyl-CoA 到 HMG-CoA 到 mevalonate 到 farnesyl-PP 到 decaprenyl-PP (PDSS1/PDSS2); 由 COQ2 与来自 tyrosine/phenylalanine 的 4-hydroxybenzoate 缩合, 而 tyrosine 转成 4-hydroxybenzoate 的转氨步骤需要 pyridoxal 5'-phosphate, 因此维生素 B6 状态影响环结构的供给; 环修饰由 COQ3、COQ5、COQ6、COQ7 和 COQ9 连同 COQ8A、COQ8B 激酶在线粒体内膜完成, 最后还原为泛醇。他汀靶点 HMG-CoA reductase 位于多异戊烯尾链的上游。

Amount made自产量Endogenous synthesis rate in humans NOT ESTABLISHED, though it proceeds in all tissues and is highest in heart, kidney and liver. Sourced comparators: average dietary intake 3-5 mg/day, about 64% of it from meat and poultry, with 14-32% destroyed by frying and no detectable destruction by boiling; total body content of roughly 0.5 to 1.5 g and plasma of roughly 0.6 to 1.9 micromol/L; no RDA, AI or UL exists. Across 8 pooled placebo-controlled treatment arms, statin therapy lowered plasma CoQ10 by -0.44 micromol/L versus placebo. Supplement doses are 100-300 mg/day, and 5-50 mg/kg/d in primary CoQ10 deficiency.人体内源合成速率 NOT ESTABLISHED, 但所有组织都在进行, 心、肾、肝最高。有来源的对照数据: 膳食平均摄入 3-5 mg/day, 其中约 64% 来自肉类和禽类, 油炸破坏 14-32%, 水煮未检出破坏; 全身含量约 0.5 到 1.5 g, 血浆约 0.6 到 1.9 micromol/L; 没有 RDA、AI 或 UL。在 8 个汇总的安慰剂对照治疗组中, 他汀治疗使血浆 CoQ10 相对安慰剂降低 -0.44 micromol/L。补充剂量 100-300 mg/day, 原发性 CoQ10 缺乏症为 5-50 mg/kg/d。

Still matters when仍有意义的情形Primary CoQ10 deficiency caused by COQ2, COQ4, COQ6, COQ8A, COQ8B, COQ9, PDSS1 or PDSS2 variants, where high-dose supplementation is standard care, dosing is time-critical and early treatment changes outcome. Also specific secondary deficiencies in mitochondrial disease and mitochondrial myopathies, adjunctive use in heart failure (Q-SYMBIO), and clinician-supervised trials of statin-associated muscle symptoms, where results remain inconsistent and mostly negative. Absorption is poor and lipid-dependent, so any trial or personal trial should dose it with fat.由 COQ2、COQ4、COQ6、COQ8A、COQ8B、COQ9、PDSS1 或 PDSS2 变异引起的原发性 CoQ10 缺乏, 此时高剂量补充是标准治疗, 剂量有时间紧迫性, 早期治疗会改变结局。此外还包括线粒体病和线粒体肌病中的特定继发性缺乏、心力衰竭的辅助使用 (Q-SYMBIO), 以及在临床医生监督下针对他汀相关肌肉症状的试验, 这类结果仍不一致且多为阴性。吸收差且依赖脂质, 所以任何试用都应与脂肪同服。

Synthesis source合成来源PMID 20494114 (Bentinger, Tekle, Dallner, Biochem Biophys Res Commun 2010;396:74-79); PMID 9129255 (Weber et al., Int J Vitam Nutr Res 1997;67:123-129); PMID 27060254 (Acosta et al., Biochim Biophys Acta 2016;1857(8):1079-85); the pooled statin/plasma CoQ10 meta-analysis of 8 placebo-controlled arms cited in the recovered row (its PMID is cut off in the recovered source field). Verdict结论Consider可以考虑
Evidence证据Grade BB 级
Dose tested已验证剂量600 mg/d orally. The strong evidence is for the intravenous route at the same dose, which consumers cannot access.口服 600 毫克/天。强证据来自同剂量的静脉给药，而消费者无法使用这一途径。
Who适用人群People with symptomatic diabetic distal symmetric polyneuropathy, specifically positive sensory symptoms such as burning and paraesthesia.有症状的糖尿病远端对称性多发性神经病患者，特别是有烧灼感、感觉异常等阳性感觉症状者。
Pros优点
  • Licensed as a drug for diabetic polyneuropathy in Germany, which is a higher bar than any supplement in this document clears.在德国作为糖尿病多发性神经病的药物获批，这个门槛高于本文中任何一款补充剂。
  • The intravenous meta-analysis (4 trials, 1,258 patients) found consistent relief of positive neuropathic symptoms.静脉给药的 meta 分析（4 项试验、1258 名患者）发现对阳性神经病理性症状有一致的缓解。
  • Secondary endpoints in the long oral trial did improve, including neuropathy impairment scores.长期口服试验的次要终点确有改善，包括神经病变损害评分。
Cons缺点
  • The definitive oral trial failed. NATHAN 1 randomised 460 patients to 600 mg/d for 4 years and missed its primary endpoint (P=0.105).决定性的口服试验失败了。NATHAN 1 把 460 名患者随机到 600 毫克/天，持续 4 年，未达主要终点（P=0.105）。
  • Serious adverse events in that trial were 38.1% on alpha-lipoic acid versus 28.0% on placebo, an excess that is rarely mentioned in marketing.该试验中严重不良事件在硫辛酸组为 38.1%，安慰剂组为 28.0%，这个超出的部分在营销中几乎从不被提及。
  • It is a leading trigger of insulin autoimmune syndrome (Hirata disease) in people carrying HLA-DRB1*04 alleles, producing anti-insulin antibodies and severe hypoglycaemia in non-diabetics. Almost nobody knows their HLA status.在携带 HLA-DRB1*04 等位基因的人中，它是胰岛素自身免疫综合征（平田病）的主要诱因之一，可产生抗胰岛素抗体并在非糖尿病者中引起严重低血糖。几乎没有人知道自己的 HLA 型别。
  • No upper limit has been set by any authority.没有任何权威机构为其设定上限。
What it does, and what happens without it它有什么作用，缺了会怎样

A cofactor mitochondria build and clip onto the enzymes that burn carbohydrate and amino acids.线粒体自行合成并连接到多种分解碳水化合物和氨基酸的酶上的辅因子。

No deficiency state exists不存在缺乏状态

In detail详细Lipoic acid functions as a covalently bound prosthetic group (lipoamide) on the E2 subunits of pyruvate dehydrogenase, alpha-ketoglutarate dehydrogenase, branched-chain ketoacid dehydrogenase and the glycine cleavage system, where its dithiolane ring carries acyl groups and reducing equivalents. Humans make it de novo inside mitochondria via lipoic acid synthase and attach it enzymatically to apoproteins; free lipoate from food or capsules is never used for this. Rare biallelic LIAS, LIPT1 or LIPT2 variants cause a severe neonatal encephalopathy with lactic acidosis and hyperglycinaemia, and oral lipoic acid does not rescue the lipoylation defect in patients or in patient fibroblasts, which is precisely why that genetic disorder is not a deficiency of the supplement molecule. Supplemental alpha-lipoic acid therefore acts only as a free redox-active compound, unrelated to the cofactor role, and its best evidence is symptomatic relief in diabetic polyneuropathy.硫辛酸作为共价结合的辅基(硫辛酰胺)存在于丙酮酸脱氢酶、α-酮戊二酸脱氢酶、支链酮酸脱氢酶和甘氨酸裂解系统的E2亚基上,其二硫戊环结构负责传递酰基和还原当量。人体通过硫辛酸合成酶在线粒体内从头合成硫辛酸,并以酶促方式将其连接到脱辅基蛋白上;来自食物或胶囊的游离硫辛酸盐从不用于这一过程。罕见的LIAS、LIPT1或LIPT2双等位基因变异会导致伴乳酸酸中毒和高甘氨酸血症的严重新生儿脑病,口服硫辛酸无法在患者体内或患者成纤维细胞中挽救这一硫辛酰化缺陷,这正是该遗传病并非补充剂分子缺乏症的原因所在。因此,补充用α-硫辛酸只能作为一种游离的氧化还原活性化合物发挥作用,与其辅因子角色无关,其最佳证据体现在缓解糖尿病性多发性神经病变的症状方面。

There is no deficiency state for this. It is not an essential nutrient, so being short of it is not a thing that can happen.它不存在缺乏状态。它不是必需营养素，所以“缺了它”这件事本身并不成立。

Source来源DOI 10.1007/s10545-014-9705-8 (Mayr et al., Lipoic acid biosynthesis defects, J Inherit Metab Dis 2014); PMID 17065669 (Ziegler et al., SYDNEY 2 trial, Diabetes Care 2006)

Food and the body食物与身体
In food: Trace食物中：痕量 Dose from food: Out of reach靠吃达到剂量：达不到 Body makes it: Body makes it身体自产：身体自产 Food data: Low食物数据：低

TRACE was challenged and upheld, and the qualitative point matters more than the numbers: alpha-lipoic acid exists in food only as lipoyllysine, covalently attached to lysine residues in the E2 subunits of mitochondrial keto-acid dehydrogenases. Free racemic ALA, which is what a capsule contains, does not occur in food at all. The measured food quantities are in the range 0.003 to 0.40 mg per 100 g, four to five orders of magnitude below a 600 mg capsule. Supplemental ALA is chemically synthesised, so the supplement is best read as a synthetic compound with a bound, chemically different trace analogue in food.TRACE（痕量）曾被质疑，经复核维持，而且定性的一点比数字更要紧：α-硫辛酸在食物中只以硫辛酰赖氨酸的形式存在，共价连接在线粒体酮酸脱氢酶 E2 亚基的赖氨酸残基上。胶囊里装的游离消旋 ALA，在食物中完全不存在。实测的食物含量在每 100 g 0.003 到 0.40 mg 之间，比 600 mg 胶囊低四到五个数量级。补充用 ALA 为化学合成，因此这种补剂可以读作一种合成化合物，食物里对应的只是结合态、化学性质不同的痕量类似物。
