To match the dose要达到该剂量Using the confirmed plant figures, a 600 mg dose is about 2,143 kg of raw spinach a day, roughly 71,000 cups, and broccoli is similar. Using the richest meat value (turkey heart at 0.40 mg/100 g) it is 150 kg of heart a day, though that meat figure is itself unconfirmed. The arithmetic understates the problem. What food contains is lipoyllysine, lipoic acid amide-bonded to protein-bound lysine, and human lipoamidase activity releases very little free lipoic acid from that bond, so the free-ALA yield from eating spinach is close to unmeasurable rather than merely small. A 600 mg fasting capsule produces micromolar plasma peaks of free racemic lipoic acid; no quantity of food produces a detectable free-ALA peak at all. This is the clearest food-supplement discontinuity in the group.按已确认的植物数值，600 mg 剂量约合每天 2,143 kg 生菠菜，大约 71,000 杯，西兰花的量级相仿。按最富的肉类值（火鸡心 0.40 mg/100 g）是每天 150 kg 心脏，而这个肉类数值本身未经确认。这些算术还低估了问题。食物里含的是硫辛酰赖氨酸，硫辛酸以酰胺键连在蛋白结合的赖氨酸上，人体硫辛酰胺酶从这种键上释放出的游离硫辛酸极少，所以吃菠菜得到的游离 ALA 接近无法测出。600 mg 空腹胶囊能产生微摩尔级的游离消旋硫辛酸血药峰值；任何数量的食物都产生不出可检测的游离 ALA 峰。这是本组中食物与补剂断裂得最彻底的一条。

Food vs supplement食物与补充剂Large, and it cuts against the supplement. Supplemental ALA is chemically synthesised as a 50:50 racemate of R- and S-lipoic acid, while nature makes only the R enantiomer and only protein-bound, so the capsule contains a molecule (S-lipoic acid) that does not exist in food. Absorption differs by design as well: capsules are dosed fasting because food reduces ALA absorption by roughly 20-30%, whereas the trace food form is unavoidably eaten with food. On safety, the whole food is unremarkable and the concentrated free acid is not. High-dose free ALA has been linked to insulin autoimmune syndrome with severe hypoglycaemia in genetically susceptible people, and there is a paediatric accidental-overdose literature with seizures and death. Spinach has done none of that. If you want the antioxidant-vegetable benefit, eat the vegetables; if you want the 600 mg neuropathy dose from the ALADIN and SYDNEY trials, understand that it is a synthetic drug-dose racemate with its own risk profile.很大，而且不利于补剂。补充用 ALA 化学合成为 R- 与 S- 硫辛酸各占 50:50 的消旋体，自然界只造 R 型，且只以蛋白结合态存在，所以胶囊里含有一种食物中根本不存在的分子（S- 硫辛酸）。吸收方式也是设计上的差别：胶囊要求空腹服用，因为食物会把 ALA 吸收降低大约 20-30%，而食物中的痕量形式不可避免地是随餐吃下去的。安全性上，整体食物平平无奇，浓缩的游离酸则不然。高剂量游离 ALA 在遗传易感人群中与胰岛素自身免疫综合征和严重低血糖有关联，还有儿童意外过量导致惊厥和死亡的文献。菠菜从没造成过这些。想要抗氧化蔬菜的益处，就吃蔬菜；想要 ALADIN 和 SYDNEY 试验里 600 mg 的神经病变剂量，就要明白那是一种合成的药物剂量消旋体，带着自身的风险特征。

Absorption吸收Free supplemental ALA is absorbed reasonably well but cleared very fast, with a plasma half-life on the order of half an hour, and the R enantiomer reaches higher plasma levels than S. Food lipoyllysine is a different question: it is not a bioavailable source of free lipoic acid, because the lipoyl group stays bound to the enzyme protein and is largely digested along with it rather than released as the free dithiol. The measurement literature reflects this, noting that free lipoic acid in tissues is low if present at all and that essentially all of it is protein-bound. Spinach carries the usual oxalate caveat for other purposes, but oxalate is not why spinach fails as a lipoic acid source; it fails because there is almost none there and what is there is chemically locked up.游离的补充用 ALA 吸收尚可，清除极快，血浆半衰期约半小时，R 型达到的血药水平高于 S 型。食物中的硫辛酰赖氨酸是另一回事：它不构成游离硫辛酸的可利用来源，硫辛酰基仍然结合在酶蛋白上，多半随蛋白一起被消化，不会以游离二硫醇形式释放。测定文献也印证这点，指出组织中的游离硫辛酸即便存在也很低，几乎全部为蛋白结合态。菠菜在别的方面有草酸的常见告诫，但它作为硫辛酸来源之所以不行，原因是里面几乎没有，而且有的那点在化学上被锁住了，与草酸无关。

Food data note食物数据说明The three richest rows, which set the top of the ranking and the headline dose gap, come from a paper whose per-tissue table sits behind the ACS paywall and could not be traced past a method-validation abstract. They are also contradicted on rank order by the Lodge dataset, which puts kidney above heart. Only the Lodge plant values (spinach 3.15 and broccoli 0.94 ug/g dry weight) and their dry-to-fresh conversions were independently confirmed, and the tomato value was not. The qualitative conclusion is unaffected, since every candidate figure is four to five orders of magnitude below a 600 mg dose低。设定排序顶端和头条剂量差距的三条最富条目来自一篇论文，其分组织数据表在 ACS 付费墙之后，除方法验证摘要之外无法追溯。它们的排序还与 Lodge 数据集相矛盾，后者把肾排在心脏之上。只有 Lodge 的植物数值（菠菜 3.15、西兰花 0.94 µg/g 干重）及其干重到鲜重的换算得到独立确认，番茄值未获确认。定性结论不受影响，因为所有候选数字都比 600 mg 剂量低四到五个数量级。

Does the body make it身体是否自产Human mitochondria make lipoic acid de novo: an octanoyl chain from the mitochondrial fatty acid synthase route is transferred onto a lysine residue of the target protein, and lipoyl synthase (LIAS) then inserts two sulfur atoms while the chain is already attached. The functional cofactor pool is protein-bound R-lipoyllysine on pyruvate dehydrogenase, alpha-ketoglutarate dehydrogenase, BCKDH and the glycine cleavage H protein, and free lipoate is not a physiological cofactor form, although mammalian lipoamidase, the same protein as serum biotinidase, does hydrolyse lipoyl substrates (PMID 8484735, PMID 2225462), an activity present in human serum and milk (PMID 3168970, PMID 2127386). The FULL label applies to the endogenous cofactor and does not carry over to the capsule: swallowed free ALA is never loaded onto the dehydrogenase complexes, so a supplement works as a short-acting redox drug and not as repletion of a cofactor.人体线粒体能从头合成硫辛酸: 来自线粒体脂肪酸合成途径的辛酰基链先被转移到靶蛋白的赖氨酸残基上, 随后 lipoyl synthase (LIAS) 在链已连接的状态下插入两个硫原子。具有功能的辅因子池是结合在 pyruvate dehydrogenase、alpha-ketoglutarate dehydrogenase、BCKDH 和甘氨酸裂解系统 H 蛋白上的蛋白结合型 R-lipoyllysine, 游离硫辛酸并非生理性的辅因子形式; 不过哺乳动物 lipoamidase 与血清 biotinidase 是同一个蛋白, 能水解 lipoyl 底物 (PMID 8484735, PMID 2225462), 该活性存在于人血清和乳汁中 (PMID 3168970, PMID 2127386)。FULL 这个标签针对的是内源辅因子, 它不能套用到胶囊上: 口服的游离 ALA 不会被装载到脱氢酶复合体上, 所以补充剂起的是短效氧化还原药物的作用, 与补足辅因子无关。

Pathway合成通路Mitochondrial FAS II generates octanoyl-ACP; LIPT2 transfers the octanoyl group onto the H protein lysine; LIAS, a radical-SAM iron-sulfur enzyme, inserts sulfur at C6 and C8; LIPT1 then relays lipoyl groups to the E2 subunits of the 2-oxo acid dehydrogenase complexes. LIAS activity depends on iron-sulfur cluster assembly machinery (NFU1, BOLA3, GLRX5, ISCA2, IBA57), the commonest genetic cause of human lipoylation failure and usually omitted from supplement-side accounts. The reactions sit in the mitochondrial matrix and run in all tissues.线粒体 FAS II 生成 octanoyl-ACP; LIPT2 把辛酰基转移到 H 蛋白的赖氨酸上; LIAS 是一种 radical-SAM 铁硫酶, 在 C6 和 C8 位插入硫; 随后 LIPT1 把 lipoyl 基团转交给 2-氧代酸脱氢酶复合体的 E2 亚基。LIAS 活性依赖铁硫簇组装机器 (NFU1、BOLA3、GLRX5、ISCA2、IBA57), 这是人类脂酰化失败最常见的遗传原因, 在偏补充剂视角的叙述中通常被省略。反应位于线粒体基质, 存在于所有组织。

Amount made自产量NOT ESTABLISHED. No measured human de novo lipoate synthesis rate exists. Food provides only protein-bound lipoyllysine in trace amounts, orders of magnitude below the free ALA content of a typical 200-600 mg supplement.NOT ESTABLISHED。人体从头合成硫辛酸的速率没有测定值。食物只提供痕量的蛋白结合型 lipoyllysine, 比典型 200-600 mg 补充剂中的游离 ALA 含量低几个数量级。

Still matters when仍有意义的情形Diabetic peripheral neuropathy, where 600 mg oral or intravenous ALA has trial support of mixed quality; that is a pharmacological indication, unrelated to correcting a deficiency. Inherited LIAS, LIPT1 and LIPT2 defects, and the Fe-S cluster defects (NFU1, BOLA3, GLRX5) that cause the same lipoylation failure, produce severe multisystem disease; in patient fibroblasts, treatment with lipoate and with mitochondria-targeted lipoate failed to correct the defect (PMID 24334290), and no registered clinical trial of oral lipoate exists in these patients, so that evidence is cell-level. Watch for reports of insulin autoimmune syndrome in susceptible HLA genotypes.糖尿病周围神经病变, 该适应症下 600 mg 口服或静脉 ALA 有质量不一的试验支持, 这属于药理学适应症, 与纠正缺乏无关。遗传性 LIAS、LIPT1 和 LIPT2 缺陷, 以及导致同样脂酰化失败的铁硫簇缺陷 (NFU1、BOLA3、GLRX5), 都会造成严重的多系统疾病; 在患者成纤维细胞中, 用硫辛酸以及靶向线粒体的硫辛酸处理都未能纠正该缺陷 (PMID 24334290), 目前没有针对这些患者口服硫辛酸的收录临床试验, 因此证据停留在细胞层面。使用时注意易感 HLA 基因型中胰岛素自身免疫综合征的报告。

Synthesis source合成来源PMID 29191830 (Solmonson & DeBerardinis, J Biol Chem 2018;293:7522-7530); PMID 19664690 (Shay et al., Biochim Biophys Acta 2009;1790:1149-1160); PMID 24334290 (patient fibroblast treatment); PMID 8484735, PMID 2225462, PMID 3168970, PMID 2127386 (lipoamidase/biotinidase). Evidence证据Grade CC 级
Dose tested已验证剂量4-6 g/d for at least 2-4 weeks, split into doses of about 1.6 g to limit paraesthesia. Total accumulated dose matters more than daily dose.4 至 6 克/天，至少持续 2 至 4 周，分成每次约 1.6 克以减少刺痛感。累积总量比每日剂量更重要。
Who适用人群Athletes whose limiting factor is acidosis in the one to four minute window: middle distance, rowing, combat sports, high-repetition lifting.限制因素是 1 至 4 分钟区间酸中毒的运动员：中距离项目、赛艇、格斗类、高次数举重。
Pros优点
  • The mechanism is sound and confirmed: it raises intramuscular carnosine, which buffers protons.机制清楚且已被证实：它提高肌内肌肽含量，从而缓冲质子。
  • The IOC consensus statement places buffering agents on its short list of supplements with robust performance evidence.国际奥委会共识声明把缓冲类物质列入其“具备可靠成绩证据”的短名单。
  • Cheap, and paraesthesia aside, no established contraindication or drug interaction exists.便宜，而且除刺痛感外，没有已确立的禁忌或药物相互作用。
Cons缺点
  • The overall pooled effect is SMD 0.18 (0.08-0.28) across 40 studies and 1,461 people. Statistically significant and practically tiny.40 项研究、1461 人的总体合并效应是 SMD 0.18（0.08-0.28）。统计学显著，实际微乎其微。
  • In the 0.5 to 10 minute window where it should work best, exercise CAPACITY improved (SMD 0.50) but exercise PERFORMANCE did not (SMD 0.11, 95% CI -0.20 to 0.42, non-significant). Capacity is a laboratory measure; performance is what a race is.在本该最有效的 0.5 至 10 分钟区间，运动能力有改善（SMD 0.50），但运动成绩没有（SMD 0.11，95% CI -0.20 至 0.42，不显著）。能力是实验室指标，成绩才是比赛。
  • The meta-analysis is routinely quoted for the flattering subgroup and never for the null one.meta 分析被反复引用其好看的亚组，而从不引用阴性的那个。
  • No long-term safety data beyond a few months, and no upper limit set by any authority.没有超过数月的长期安全数据，也没有任何权威机构设定上限。
What it does, and what happens without it它有什么作用，缺了会怎样

The raw material for carnosine, which buffers acid build-up in muscle during hard efforts.作为合成肌肽的原料,肌肽能缓冲高强度运动中肌肉内的酸性物质堆积。

No deficiency state exists不存在缺乏状态

In detail详细Beta-alanine is the rate-limiting substrate for carnosine synthase, which joins it to histidine to form carnosine in skeletal muscle. Carnosine acts as an intracellular pH buffer across the physiological range and also chelates metals and scavenges reactive carbonyls. Supplementation raises muscle carnosine by up to 64 percent at 4 weeks and up to 80 percent at 10 weeks, and produces a small performance gain concentrated in efforts of roughly 0.5 to 10 minutes, with no benefit below 30 seconds and only a non-significant moderate effect beyond 10 minutes (Saunders et al. 2017, 40 studies, 1,461 subjects); the ISSN position stand places the most pronounced benefit in open end-point tasks and time trials lasting 1 to 4 minutes. The body forms beta-alanine from uracil degradation in the liver and also obtains it from meat-derived carnosine and anserine. It is a non-essential amino acid with no recommended intake.β-丙氨酸是肌肽合成酶的限速底物,该酶将其与组氨酸结合,在骨骼肌中生成肌肽。肌肽在生理pH范围内作为细胞内酸碱缓冲剂,同时还能螯合金属并清除活性羰基。补充可使肌肉肌肽在4周时提高多达64%,在10周时提高多达80%,并在约0.5至10分钟的运动中带来小幅的成绩提升,30秒以下无效,超过10分钟则仅有不显著的中等效应(Saunders等2017年,40项研究,1,461名受试者);ISSN立场声明将最明显的效益归于持续1至4分钟的开放式终点任务和计时赛。人体经肝脏中尿嘧啶降解生成β-丙氨酸,也从肉类中的肌肽和鹅肌肽获取。它是一种非必需氨基酸,没有推荐摄入量。

There is no deficiency state for this. It is not an essential nutrient, so being short of it is not a thing that can happen.它不存在缺乏状态。它不是必需营养素，所以“缺了它”这件事本身并不成立。

Source来源PMID 26175657 (Trexler et al., International Society of Sports Nutrition position stand: beta-alanine, J Int Soc Sports Nutr 2015, PMC4501114); Saunders et al., Br J Sports Med 2017;51:658-669

Food and the body食物与身体
In food: Rich食物中：丰富 Dose from food: Out of reach靠吃达到剂量：达不到 Body makes it: Partly身体自产：部分自产 Food data: High食物数据：高

Free beta-alanine, the molecule in the tub, is manufactured and no food supplies it in that form, which is a question about form rather than about dietary presence. What food supplies is beta-alanine bound into the histidine dipeptides carnosine and anserine, hydrolysed after ingestion, at hundreds of milligrams of beta-alanine equivalent per 100 g of white muscle: 346 mg/100 g in commercial broiler breast and 767 mg/100 g in the native Korean strain measured in the same study. Per portion that is 589 mg and 1,304 mg, 18% and 41% of a 3.2 g daily dose, at or above the per-portion contribution creatine makes, and isomolar oral L-carnosine raised muscle carnosine as much as free beta-alanine did (65.8% versus 64.2%), so the dietary route is biologically real. The earlier TRACE label was wrong by the dataset's own yardstick; poultry dark meat is the weak part of the picture, at 19.51-36.19 mg carnosine per 100 g.罐子里的游离 β-丙氨酸是工业合成的，没有任何食物以这种形式提供它，这属于形式问题，与膳食中是否存在无关。食物提供的是结合在组氨酸二肽（肌肽和鹅肌肽）中的 β-丙氨酸，摄入后水解释放，白肌每 100 g 可达数百毫克 β-丙氨酸当量：同一项研究中，商业肉鸡胸肉为 346 mg/100 g，韩国本土品系为 767 mg/100 g。折成每份分别是 589 mg 和 1,304 mg，相当于 3.2 g 每日剂量的 18% 和 41%，达到或超过肌酸的每份贡献；等摩尔口服 L-肌肽提升肌肉肌肽的幅度与游离 β-丙氨酸相当（65.8% 对 64.2%），所以膳食途径在生物学上是成立的。按本数据集自己的标准，此前的 TRACE（微量）标签给错了；这幅图景中薄弱的部分是禽类红肉，肌肽只有 19.51-36.19 mg/100 g。

To match the dose要达到该剂量Carnosine is 39.4% beta-alanine by mass (89.09/226.23) and anserine 37.1% (89.09/240.26). The lowest dose shown to work is 3.2 g/day for 4 weeks, which raised muscle carnosine 42.1%. From commercial broiler breast at 346 mg beta-alanine equivalent per 100 g, counting both dipeptides, that is 923 g of raw chicken breast every day for the whole loading month, roughly 210 g of protein from one food; counting carnosine alone it is 3.15 kg/day. The carnosine-dense native strain at 767 mg/100 g cuts the requirement to 417 g/day, a large but conceivable portion, except that the breed is not what a supermarket sells. Beef takes 3.8 kg of raw steak per day and chicken thigh over 20 kg. No food delivers free beta-alanine at all.肌肽按质量含 39.4% 的 β-丙氨酸（89.09/226.23），鹅肌肽含 37.1%（89.09/240.26）。已证实有效的最低剂量是 3.2 g/天、持续 4 周，可使肌肉肌肽提升 42.1%。以商业肉鸡胸肉每 100 g 含 346 mg β-丙氨酸当量（两种二肽合计）计算，整个装载月里每天要吃 923 g 生鸡胸，单一食物就带来约 210 g 蛋白质；若只计肌肽，则是 3.15 kg/天。肌肽含量高的本土品系为 767 mg/100 g，需求量降到 417 g/天，份量虽大但可以想象，问题是超市并不卖这个品种。牛肉需要每天 3.8 kg 生牛排，鸡腿肉超过 20 kg。没有任何食物提供游离 β-丙氨酸。

Food vs supplement食物与补充剂MAJOR, and it cuts both ways. Ingested carnosine does not reach muscle intact: after histidine dipeptides were given in chicken broth at 40 mg/kg beta-alanine equivalent, carnosine was undetectable in plasma while plasma beta-alanine peaked at 428 uM, because serum carnosinase hydrolyses the dipeptide. So the food form works by liberating beta-alanine, and it does so at roughly half the peak concentration of an equal weight of free beta-alanine (833 uM at the same 40 mg/kg dose). Isomolar oral L-carnosine nonetheless raised muscle carnosine as much as 6.4 g/day of beta-alanine (65.8% versus 64.2%), so the dipeptide route is biologically equivalent and only the volume of food is impossible (Harris RC et al., Amino Acids 2006;30(3):279-89, PMID 16554972, DOI 10.1007/s00726-006-0299-9, every figure confirmed). Two further points: cooking significantly reduces meat carnosine, measured in lamb longissimus and semimembranosus after 90 min at 70 C (Purchas RW et al., Meat Sci 2004;66(3):629-37, PMID 22060873), and the paraesthesia that makes people split beta-alanine doses is a property of a large free-amino-acid bolus that food never produces.重大，而且是双向的。摄入的肌肽不会完整到达肌肉：以鸡汤形式给予组氨酸二肽、剂量相当于 40 mg/kg β-丙氨酸当量后，血浆中检测不到肌肽，血浆 β-丙氨酸峰值为 428 uM，原因是血清肌肽酶会水解该二肽。所以食物形式是通过释放 β-丙氨酸起作用，峰值浓度约为同等重量游离 β-丙氨酸的一半（同样 40 mg/kg 剂量下为 833 uM）。即便如此，等摩尔口服 L-肌肽提升肌肉肌肽的幅度与 6.4 g/天 β-丙氨酸相当（65.8% 对 64.2%），可见二肽途径在生物学上等效，无法实现的只是食物的体积（Harris RC et al., Amino Acids 2006;30(3):279-89, PMID 16554972, DOI 10.1007/s00726-006-0299-9，每一个数字都已核实）。另有两点：烹饪会显著降低肉中的肌肽，该结果测自羔羊背最长肌和半膜肌在 70 C 加热 90 min 之后（Purchas RW et al., Meat Sci 2004;66(3):629-37, PMID 22060873）；而促使人们把 β-丙氨酸分次服用的皮肤刺痛感，来自大剂量游离氨基酸的一次性冲击，食物从不会产生这种情况。

Absorption吸收Quantified head to head. At 40 mg/kg body weight, plasma beta-alanine peaked at 833 uM from free beta-alanine and at 428 uM from an equivalent load of histidine dipeptides in chicken broth, with both returning to baseline by 2 h and urinary loss of beta-alanine under 5% (PMID 16554972). Muscle carnosine responses after 4 weeks: 42.1% at 3.2 g/day, 64.2% at 6.4 g/day, and 65.8% for isomolar L-carnosine. The food matrix costs about half the peak plasma concentration per gram and does not block the pathway; the binding constraint is that meat holds only 0.08-0.77% beta-alanine equivalent by weight. Content varies severalfold with muscle type and breed: carnosine across 21 beef muscles ranged 0.012-18.508 umol/g wet tissue, that is 0.27-418.7 mg/100 g (PMID 30811817), and glycolytic white muscle holds far more than red oxidative muscle, so 'chicken' is not one number.有直接的头对头定量数据。按体重 40 mg/kg 给药，游离 β-丙氨酸使血浆 β-丙氨酸峰值达 833 uM，鸡汤中等量组氨酸二肽为 428 uM，两者均在 2 h 内回到基线，β-丙氨酸的尿中损失低于 5%（PMID 16554972）。4 周后肌肉肌肽的反应：3.2 g/天为 42.1%，6.4 g/天为 64.2%，等摩尔 L-肌肽为 65.8%。食物基质的代价是每克损失约一半的血浆峰值浓度，通路本身没有被阻断；真正的约束是肉类按重量只含 0.08-0.77% 的 β-丙氨酸当量。含量随肌肉类型和品种相差数倍：21 块牛肌肉的肌肽为 0.012-18.508 umol/g 湿组织，即 0.27-418.7 mg/100 g（PMID 30811817），糖解型白肌远高于氧化型红肌，所以“鸡肉”并不对应单一数值。

Food data note食物数据说明for the values shown. Every dipeptide figure was checked against the full texts of Ali 2019, Khumpeerawat 2021, Mashima 2019 and Barido 2022, the 39.4%/37.1% mass fractions and the 346 mg conversion were re-derived, and all of Harris 2006 was confirmed figure for figure. One caveat on coverage rather than accuracy: pork loin, turkey breast, tuna and other pelagic fish and rabbit were never checked, so the claim that chicken breast is the richest ordinary source is untested所列数值为高。每个二肽数字都对照 Ali 2019、Khumpeerawat 2021、Mashima 2019 和 Barido 2022 的全文核对过，39.4%/37.1% 的质量分数和 346 mg 的换算重新推导，Harris 2006 的全部数字逐一确认。有一点属于覆盖面而非准确性的问题：猪里脊、火鸡胸、金枪鱼和其他中上层鱼类以及兔肉从未核查，所以“鸡胸肉是最丰富的普通食物来源”这一说法尚未验证。

Does the body make it身体是否自产Your liver does make beta-alanine as a by-product of breaking down the pyrimidine uracil (cytosine reaches the same route by deamination to uracil), and GADL1 makes some from aspartate in certain tissues, while the parallel thymine branch runs the same three enzymes and yields 3-aminoisobutyrate, so thymine contributes none. The amounts are small relative to what muscle could use, and beta-alanine availability is what limits muscle carnosine, since carnosine synthase (CARNS1) is not saturated at resting beta-alanine levels and the enzyme capacity is not the bottleneck. So this is a compound the body makes yet never accumulates to a functionally saturated level, which is why 4 to 6 g/day in divided doses raises muscle carnosine and why supplementing is not redundant.肝确实会生成 beta-alanine, 作为嘧啶 uracil 分解的副产物 (cytosine 经脱氨转为 uracil 后进入同一路线), 某些组织中 GADL1 也能由 aspartate 生成一部分; 并行的 thymine 分支用同样三个酶, 产物是 3-aminoisobutyrate, 对 beta-alanine 没有贡献。相对肌肉可用的量这些产量很小, 限制肌肉 carnosine 的是 beta-alanine 的可得量, 因为 carnosine synthase (CARNS1) 在静息 beta-alanine 水平下并未饱和, 酶活力并非瓶颈。所以这是一种身体会做却从不积累到功能饱和水平的物质, 4 到 6 g/day 分次服用能提高肌肉 carnosine, 补充并不多余。

Pathway合成通路Uracil (and cytosine via deamination to uracil) is reduced by dihydropyrimidine dehydrogenase (DPYD) to dihydrouracil, hydrolysed by dihydropyrimidinase (DPYS) to 3-ureidopropionate, then cleaved by beta-ureidopropionase (UPB1) to beta-alanine, mainly in liver; the parallel thymine branch uses the same three enzymes and ends at 3-aminoisobutyrate. Beta-alanine plus L-histidine is condensed to carnosine by carnosine synthase (CARNS1) in skeletal muscle, and ingested carnosine or anserine is hydrolysed first by serum carnosinase (CNDP1), which is why the effective oral form is beta-alanine itself. GADL1 supplies some beta-alanine from aspartate in certain tissues, and gut bacteria contribute part of the supply, which this dataset counts as exogenous.uracil (以及经脱氨转为 uracil 的 cytosine) 由 dihydropyrimidine dehydrogenase (DPYD) 还原为 dihydrouracil, 经 dihydropyrimidinase (DPYS) 水解为 3-ureidopropionate, 再由 beta-ureidopropionase (UPB1) 裂解生成 beta-alanine, 主要在肝; 并行的 thymine 分支用同样三个酶, 终点是 3-aminoisobutyrate。beta-alanine 与 L-histidine 在骨骼肌由 carnosine synthase (CARNS1) 缩合为 carnosine; 口服的 carnosine 与 anserine 会先被血清 carnosinase (CNDP1) 水解, 所以有效的口服形式是 beta-alanine 本身。某些组织中 GADL1 由 aspartate 提供一部分, 肠道细菌也贡献一部分, 本数据集把细菌产物计为外源供应。

Amount made自产量NOT ESTABLISHED. No validated figure exists for human daily endogenous beta-alanine production; the literature characterises it only as small relative to demand. The sourced comparison is on the intake side: 4 to 6 g/day in divided doses of no more than 2 g, for at least 2 to 4 weeks, reliably raises muscle carnosine, and 3.2 to 6.4 g/day raises muscle carnosine by 40 to 80 percent over 4 to 10 weeks.NOT ESTABLISHED (尚无确证数据)。人体每日内源 beta-alanine 生成量没有经过验证的数值, 文献只把它描述为相对需求很小。有出处的对照来自摄入侧: 4 到 6 g/day, 单次不超过 2 g 分次服用, 持续至少 2 到 4 周能可靠提升肌肉 carnosine; 3.2 到 6.4 g/day 可在 4 到 10 周内把肌肉 carnosine 提高 40% 到 80%。

Still matters when仍有意义的情形High-intensity efforts lasting more than about 60 s, with the clearest effects in the 1 to 4 min range and in open-end-point tasks, where intracellular buffering limits performance; vegetarians and vegans, who carry lower muscle carnosine; older adults, in whom muscle carnosine declines. Histidine availability can co-limit carnosine synthesis, so very low protein intake blunts the response, and paraesthesia is dose-related and controllable with divided or sustained-release dosing. Endogenous synthesis exists here but sits far below the buffering ceiling, so supplementation is not redundant.持续超过约 60 s 的高强度运动, 效应最清楚的是 1 到 4 min 区间和开放终点任务, 此时细胞内缓冲能力限制表现; 素食者和纯素者, 肌肉 carnosine 较低; 老年人, 肌肉 carnosine 随年龄下降。histidine 的可得量可能共同限制 carnosine 合成, 蛋白摄入极低会削弱反应; 感觉异常与剂量相关, 可通过分次或缓释给药控制。内源合成在这里存在, 但远低于缓冲能力上限, 所以补充并不多余。

CCCCFFDDBBXXDietary nitrate / beetroot膳食硝酸盐 / 甜菜根
Verdict结论Consider可以考虑
Evidence证据Grade CC 级
Dose tested已验证剂量At least 6 mmol/d (372 mg) of nitrate, taken for more than 3 days, 2-3 hours before exercise. Read the label in mmol, not millilitres.硝酸盐至少 6 mmol/天（372 毫克），连续服用 3 天以上，运动前 2 至 3 小时。看标签要看 mmol，不是毫升。
Who适用人群Recreationally active people rather than elite athletes, and separately anyone using it for blood pressure.休闲运动者而非精英运动员，此外还有把它用于降血压的人。
Pros优点
  • Time to exhaustion improves (SMD 0.33), as do total distance (0.42), muscular endurance (0.48) and peak power (0.25), across 180 primary studies and 2,672 participants.180 项原始研究、2672 名受试者的数据显示，力竭时间改善（SMD 0.33），总距离（0.42）、肌耐力（0.48）和峰值功率（0.25）同样改善。
  • The blood pressure effect is more consistent than the performance effect: systolic -3.55 mmHg (-4.55 to -2.54) across 22 controlled trials.降血压效应比成绩效应更一致：22 项对照试验中收缩压降低 3.55 mmHg（-4.55 至 -2.54）。
  • Non-athletes and recreationally active people benefit most, which is unusual and makes it accessible.非运动员和休闲运动者获益最大，这一点不寻常，也让它更适合普通人。
Cons缺点
  • Time trial performance, the one outcome that maps onto racing, is NULL. So is VO2max. The umbrella review is blunt about this.计时赛成绩，也就是唯一能对应到比赛的指标，是阴性的。最大摄氧量也是。伞式综述对此直言不讳。
  • Antibacterial mouthwash abolishes the effect entirely, because the pathway depends on commensal bacteria on the tongue.抗菌漱口水会完全消除这个效应，因为该通路依赖舌面上的共生细菌。
  • Ergogenic doses of 6-8 mmol exceed the EFSA and JECFA acceptable daily intake for nitrate of 3.7 mg/kg body weight per day in a single serving. That is a real regulatory tension, not a technicality.6 至 8 mmol 的增效剂量在单次服用中就超过了 EFSA 和 JECFA 对硝酸盐每日 3.7 毫克/公斤体重的可接受摄入量。这是实实在在的监管冲突，不是文字游戏。
  • Additive hypotension with organic nitrates such as glyceryl trinitrate and isosorbide mononitrate, and with PDE5 inhibitors such as sildenafil and tadalafil. Care with any antihypertensive.与硝酸甘油、单硝酸异山梨酯等有机硝酸酯，以及西地那非、他达拉非等 PDE5 抑制剂有叠加的降压作用。与任何降压药合用都需谨慎。
What it does, and what happens without it它有什么作用，缺了会怎样

Not a nutrient. Gut and mouth bacteria turn it into nitric oxide, which widens blood vessels.并非一种营养素。肠道和口腔中的细菌将其转化为一氧化氮,从而扩张血管。

No deficiency state exists不存在缺乏状态

In detail详细Inorganic nitrate from beetroot and leafy greens is absorbed in the proximal small intestine, and roughly a quarter of the circulating pool is actively concentrated by the salivary glands. Commensal bacteria on the posterior tongue reduce it to nitrite, and swallowed nitrite is further reduced to nitric oxide in the acidic stomach and in hypoxic tissue by deoxyhaemoglobin, deoxymyoglobin, xanthine oxidoreductase and other metalloproteins. This enterosalivary route is a supplementary supply line that runs in parallel with the body's own synthesis of nitric oxide from L-arginine by nitric oxide synthase, which is the primary and always-available pathway. That distinction is what makes nitrate a usable substrate rather than a required nutrient: NOS-derived nitric oxide continues normally on a nitrate-free diet. Measured effects are pharmacological and dose-dependent: vasodilation with a modest fall in blood pressure, and a reduced oxygen cost of submaximal exercise. Antibacterial mouthwash abolishes the effect entirely by killing the nitrate-reducing oral flora, which is the clearest demonstration that the mechanism is microbial rather than nutritional.来自甜菜根和绿叶蔬菜的无机硝酸盐在近端小肠被吸收,循环池中约四分之一会被唾液腺主动富集。舌背的共生细菌将其还原为亚硝酸盐,吞咽的亚硝酸盐在酸性胃环境及缺氧组织中,经脱氧血红蛋白、脱氧肌红蛋白、黄嘌呤氧化还原酶(xanthine oxidoreductase)及其他金属蛋白进一步还原为一氧化氮。这条肠道唾液循环通路是一条补充性供应线,与人体自身通过一氧化氮合酶(nitric oxide synthase, NOS)以L-精氨酸合成一氧化氮的主要且始终存在的通路并行运作。这一区别使硝酸盐成为可利用的底物,不是人体必需的营养素:即便饮食中不含硝酸盐,NOS来源的一氧化氮合成仍照常进行。已测得的效应是药理性的且呈剂量依赖:血管扩张伴血压轻度下降,以及次极量运动的耗氧量降低。抗菌漱口水通过杀灭还原硝酸盐的口腔菌群而完全消除这一效应,这清楚地表明该机制本质上是微生物性的,不是营养性的。

There is no deficiency state for this. It is not an essential nutrient, so being short of it is not a thing that can happen.它不存在缺乏状态。它不是必需营养素，所以“缺了它”这件事本身并不成立。

Food and the body食物与身体
In food: Rich食物中：丰富 Dose from food: Reachable靠吃达到剂量：可达到 Body makes it: Partly身体自产：部分自产 Food data: High食物数据：高

Vegetables are the dietary source and several reach supplement-level concentrations. EFSA pooled 25,306 leafy vegetable samples: rocket had the highest median nitrate of any vegetable at 4,800 mg/kg, with rhubarb at 2,808, amaranth 2,660, lamb's lettuce 2,130, mixed lettuce 1,878, beet leaves 1,770, curled lettuce 1,628, oak-leaf lettuce 1,553, chard 1,510, Belgian endive 1,475, white radish 1,256, black radish 1,245, beetroot root 1,100 and cos lettuce 1,097, ahead of spinach at 785. This is the one entry on the list where a normal portion of a normal food matches the dose used in trials.蔬菜是膳食来源，其中几种达到了补充剂级别的浓度。EFSA 汇总了 25,306 份叶菜样品：芝麻菜的硝酸盐中位数在所有蔬菜中最高，为 4,800 mg/kg，其后是大黄 2,808、苋菜 2,660、野苣（lamb's lettuce）2,130、混合生菜 1,878、甜菜叶 1,770、皱叶生菜 1,628、橡叶生菜 1,553、瑞士甜菜 1,510、比利时菊苣 1,475、白萝卜 1,256、黑萝卜 1,245、甜菜根 1,100、罗马生菜 1,097，都高于菠菜的 785。这是全表唯一一项普通食物的普通份量就能对上试验剂量的成分。

To match the dose要达到该剂量At 62 mg per mmol a 6 mmol target is 372 mg of nitrate. At EFSA median concentrations that is 78 g of rocket, 132 g of rhubarb, 140 g of amaranth or 175 g of lamb's lettuce, all portions a person would actually eat, or exactly 100 mL of concentrated beetroot shot, since 70 mL measured 4.2 mmol and 140 mL 8.4 mmol. Beetroot root itself takes 338 g, butterhead lettuce 188 g, iceberg 441 g, raw spinach 474 g and celery 537 g. Wylie's dose-response data put the useful target higher than 6 mmol: 4.2 mmol changed no exercise response, 8.4 mmol reduced steady-state oxygen uptake 1.7% and extended time to task failure 14%, and 16.8 mmol gave no further gain. An 8 mmol target is 496 mg of nitrate, which is about 103 g of rocket or 133 mL of concentrate.按每 mmol 折合 62 mg 计算，6 mmol 的目标是 372 mg 硝酸盐。按 EFSA 中位浓度，这相当于 78 g 芝麻菜、132 g 大黄、140 g 苋菜或 175 g 野苣，都是人真的会吃的份量；也正好等于 100 mL 浓缩甜菜根汁，因为实测 70 mL 为 4.2 mmol、140 mL 为 8.4 mmol。甜菜根本身需要 338 g，奶油生菜 188 g，冰山生菜 441 g，生菠菜 474 g，芹菜 537 g。Wylie 的剂量反应数据把有用的目标定在 6 mmol 以上：4.2 mmol 未改变任何运动反应，8.4 mmol 使稳态摄氧量下降 1.7%、力竭时间延长 14%，16.8 mmol 没有带来进一步收益。8 mmol 的目标是 496 mg 硝酸盐，约合 103 g 芝麻菜或 133 mL 浓缩汁。

Food vs supplement食物与补充剂SUBSTANTIAL, mostly about dose uncertainty and a regulatory conflict. Vegetable nitrate varies enormously: rocket ran from 1,528 mg/kg at the 5th percentile to 7,340 at the 95th, and the highest single leafy sample EFSA saw was 19,925 mg/kg in an oak-leaf lettuce grown under cover in Norway. Beetroot's mean (1,379 mg/kg) is well above its median (1,100) because of a long tail, so a salad or a home-pressed juice cannot be dosed. The regulatory tension is concrete: EFSA calculated that eating more than 47 g of rocket at the median nitrate concentration would on its own exceed the acceptable daily intake for nitrate, and a rocket-heavy salad pattern pushed modelled intake to 330 mg/person/day. So the food route to 6 mmol means routinely exceeding the nitrate ADI, which EFSA judged acceptable in the context of overall vegetable benefits and which is still not nothing. Processing matters too: nitrate in red beet and kohlrabi was reduced by up to 50% by fermentation, and boiling leaches nitrate into the water, so pickled beetroot and boiled-and-drained spinach are weaker than the raw figures suggest. The pathway also depends on oral bacteria reducing nitrate to nitrite, so antibacterial mouthwash blunts the effect regardless of source. Spinach is the classic textbook nitrate answer and a mediocre one: its median is six times lower than rocket, and it is separately a bad iron recommendation because its oxalate binds the iron.相当可观，主要涉及剂量不确定性和一处监管冲突。蔬菜硝酸盐含量差异极大：芝麻菜从第 5 百分位的 1,528 mg/kg 到第 95 百分位的 7,340，EFSA 见过的单个叶菜最高值是挪威一份保护地栽培橡叶生菜的 19,925 mg/kg。甜菜根的均值（1,379 mg/kg）明显高于中位数（1,100），因为存在长尾，所以一份沙拉或自家榨的汁无法定量给药。监管上的张力很具体：EFSA 计算过，按中位硝酸盐浓度，单靠吃超过 47 g 芝麻菜就会超出硝酸盐的每日可接受摄入量，而以芝麻菜为主的沙拉模式把模型估计的摄入量推到 330 mg/人/天。所以，靠食物达到 6 mmol 就意味着经常性超过硝酸盐 ADI，EFSA 在蔬菜整体益处的背景下判定这可以接受，这件事本身仍然不容忽视。加工同样重要：红甜菜和苤蓝中的硝酸盐经发酵可减少多达 50%，水煮会把硝酸盐浸出到水里，所以醋渍甜菜根和煮后沥干的菠菜都弱于生品数值。该通路还依赖口腔细菌把硝酸盐还原为亚硝酸盐，因此抗菌漱口水会削弱效果，与来源无关。菠菜是教科书上经典的硝酸盐答案，实际表现平庸：它的中位数比芝麻菜低六倍，而且它作为补铁推荐同样不合适，因为其草酸会结合铁。

Absorption吸收Nitrate from vegetables and from a juice concentrate behave the same because it is a small inorganic anion, absorbed essentially completely in the upper small intestine, then concentrated in saliva by the enterosalivary circulation and reduced to nitrite by oral bacteria before any nitric oxide is formed. Wylie's dose-response work showed plasma nitrite rising dose-dependently with peak change at 2-3 h after 4.2, 8.4 and 16.8 mmol, while the physiological response saturated: 8.4 and 16.8 mmol produced similar improvements, so more nitrate is not more effect. The practical differences are therefore in the food rather than the gut: concentration varies severalfold with species, season, greenhouse versus open-field growing and region (EFSA 2008), juice concentrates are standardised while salad is not, and cooking water discards nitrate. A whole-food route is entirely viable; it wants rocket, rhubarb or amaranth rather than beetroot to be efficient.来自蔬菜和来自浓缩果汁的硝酸盐表现相同，因为它是一个小的无机阴离子，在上段小肠几乎完全吸收，随后经肠涎循环在唾液中富集，由口腔细菌还原为亚硝酸盐，之后才生成一氧化氮。Wylie 的剂量反应研究显示，4.2、8.4 和 16.8 mmol 后血浆亚硝酸盐呈剂量依赖性升高，峰值变化出现在 2-3 h，而生理反应趋于饱和：8.4 与 16.8 mmol 带来的改善相近，硝酸盐加量并不等于效果加量。因此实际差别落在食物端，与肠道无关：浓度随物种、季节、温室或露地栽培以及地区相差数倍（EFSA 2008），浓缩汁经过标准化，沙拉没有，煮菜的水会把硝酸盐倒掉。整食路线完全可行；要做到高效，选芝麻菜、大黄或苋菜，甜菜根效率不高。

Food data note食物数据说明Roughly 25 EFSA statistics across Tables 7, 9 and 10 were queried against the document and matched exactly, as were five contextual claims verbatim and the whole Wylie dose-response set. All seven original per-portion conversions at 62 mg/mmol and all six whole-vegetable gram requirements were re-derived and held. The thirteen added vegetables come from the same EFSA tables as identified in the verification report; their medians were taken from that report and the individual table rows were not independently re-read here高。跨 Table 7、9、10 的约 25 项 EFSA 统计量已在原文档中查证并完全吻合，五条上下文陈述逐字核对，Wylie 的整套剂量反应数据同样确认。原有七项按 62 mg/mmol 的每份换算，以及六项整菜克数需求，全部重新推导并成立。新增的十三种蔬菜来自核查报告标明的同一批 EFSA 表格，其中位数取自该报告，本次未独立重读对应的表格行。

Does the body make it身体是否自产Humans do produce nitrate in quantity: about 1 mmol/day appears from the oxidation of NO, roughly 37 percent of the total body nitrate pool against a dietary intake of about 1700 micromol/day, and that output is no inert waste, since it re-enters the enterosalivary circuit, is concentrated in saliva and is reduced back to nitrite and NO by the same route a beetroot dose exploits. Two limits carry the practical conclusion: endogenous appearance cannot be up-regulated on demand, and raising plasma nitrite enough to lower the O2 cost of exercise needs dietary loading well above endogenous turnover. Keep the two routes separate as well, since NO made from arginine by nitric oxide synthase is independent of the dietary nitrate to nitrite to NO route, so on this axis a nitrate dose is not redundant.人体确实以可观的量生成 nitrate: NO 氧化每天产生约 1 mmol, 约占全身 nitrate 池的 37%, 而膳食摄入约 1700 micromol/day; 这部分产物也不是惰性废物, 它重新进入唾液肠循环, 在唾液中被浓缩, 再沿甜菜根剂量所利用的同一路线还原为 nitrite 和 NO。两条限制支撑实用结论: 内源生成无法按需上调, 而要把血浆 nitrite 提高到足以降低运动氧耗的程度, 需要的膳食负荷远高于内源周转量。两条路线也要分开看, arginine 经 nitric oxide synthase 生成 NO 与膳食 nitrate 到 nitrite 到 NO 的路线彼此独立, 所以在这条轴上补充并不多余。

Pathway合成通路Endogenous nitrate arises from oxidation of NOS-derived NO through nitrite, with essentially all NOS output ending as nitrate, which is why endogenous nitrate appearance and NOS-dependent NO production are the same order of magnitude. Nitrate, ingested or endogenous, is concentrated in saliva by sialin (SLC17A5), with roughly 25 percent of an ingested dose entering the enterosalivary circuit and being reduced to nitrite by oral bacterial nitrate reductase; nitrite is then reduced to NO in the acid stomach and in hypoxic tissue by deoxyhaemoglobin and other nitrite reductases. That first reduction step is bacterial, which this dataset counts as exogenous supply.内源 nitrate 来自 NOS 生成的 NO 经 nitrite 氧化, NOS 的产物几乎全部终结为 nitrate, 这就是内源 nitrate 出现量与 NOS 依赖的 NO 生成量处于同一数量级的原因。无论摄入的还是内源的 nitrate, 都由 sialin (SLC17A5) 浓缩进唾液, 摄入剂量约 25% 进入唾液肠循环, 由口腔细菌的 nitrate reductase 还原为 nitrite; nitrite 随后在胃酸环境和缺氧组织中由脱氧血红蛋白等亚硝酸还原途径转为 NO。第一步还原由细菌完成, 本数据集把它计为外源供应。

Amount made自产量Endogenous nitrate appearance from NO oxidation is about 1 mmol/day (900 to 1280 micromol/day, roughly 56 to 79 mg) in participants held below 180 micromol nitrate intake, about 37 percent of body nitrate against a dietary contribution of about 1700 micromol/day.在 nitrate 摄入控制在 180 micromol 以下的受试者中, NO 氧化带来的内源 nitrate 出现量约 1 mmol/day (900 到 1280 micromol/day, 约 56 到 79 mg), 约占全身 nitrate 的 37%, 膳食贡献约 1700 micromol/day。

Still matters when仍有意义的情形Endurance and repeated-sprint work at roughly 6 to 13 mmol nitrate (about 400 to 800 mg), lowering the O2 cost of exercise; hypoxia; blood pressure reduction; older adults and others with impaired NOS function. Antibacterial mouthwash blunts the effect because oral bacteria do the bulk of the first reduction. Nitrite is a separately supplemented species with different kinetics and a narrower margin (methaemoglobinaemia), so the two are not interchangeable, and despite the PARTIAL label supplementation is not redundant, because endogenous production cannot be raised on demand.耐力和反复冲刺项目, 剂量约 6 到 13 mmol nitrate (约 400 到 800 mg), 可降低运动氧耗; 缺氧; 降血压; NOS 功能受损的老年人及其他人群。抗菌漱口水会削弱效果, 因为第一步还原主要由口腔细菌完成。nitrite 是另一种可单独补充的物质, 动力学不同且安全边界更窄 (甲基血红蛋白症), 两者不可互换; 尽管标签为 PARTIAL, 补充仍不多余, 因为内源生成无法按需提高。

Synthesis source合成来源PMC8983853 (Ghasemi A, Quantitative aspects of nitric oxide production from nitrate and nitrite, EXCLI J 2022); PMID 18167491 (Lundberg JO, Weitzberg E, Gladwin MT). Recovered entry Dietary nitrate / beetroot.

Refs.文献 Poon umbrella review PMID 40085422; Bahadoran PMID 29141968; Govoni PMID 18793740
CCBBFFDDBBXXSt John's wort圣约翰草
Verdict结论Consider可以考虑
Evidence证据Grade BB 级
Dose tested已验证剂量900 mg/d of standardised extract, usually 300 mg three times daily. Trials ran 4-12 weeks.标准化提取物 900 毫克/天，通常 300 毫克每日三次。试验周期为 4 至 12 周。
Who适用人群Adults with mild to moderate unipolar depression who take NO other medication whatsoever and no hormonal contraception.轻中度单相抑郁的成人，且完全不服用任何其他药物，也不使用激素类避孕。
Pros优点
  • It genuinely works for mild to moderate depression. Cochrane pooled 29 trials and 5,489 patients: response-rate ratio 1.28 (1.10-1.49) in the 9 larger trials.它对轻中度抑郁确实有效。Cochrane 汇总 29 项试验、5489 名患者：9 项较大试验中应答率比为 1.28（1.10-1.49）。
  • Side-effect burden is lower than standard antidepressants in the trials, which is the main reason patients seek it out.在试验中其副作用负担低于标准抗抑郁药，这是患者选择它的主要原因。
  • In the EU it is handled as a herbal medicinal product rather than a food supplement, so product quality is better controlled than for most botanicals.在欧盟它按草药药品而非食品补充剂管理，因此产品质量控制优于多数植物类产品。
Cons缺点
  • This has the most dangerous interaction profile in this entire document. Hyperforin is a potent pregnane X receptor ligand and therefore a strong inducer of CYP3A4, CYP2C9, CYP1A2 and P-glycoprotein.它是本文中相互作用最危险的一个。贯叶金丝桃素是强效孕烷 X 受体配体，因而是 CYP3A4、CYP2C9、CYP1A2 和 P-糖蛋白的强诱导剂。
  • Documented consequences: oral contraceptive failure with breakthrough bleeding and unintended pregnancy; loss of ciclosporin and tacrolimus levels leading to transplant rejection; antiretroviral failure with indinavir; reduced digoxin and warfarin effect; and serotonin syndrome when combined with SSRIs.已记录的后果包括：口服避孕药失效，出现突破性出血和意外妊娠；环孢素和他克莫司血药浓度下降导致移植排斥；与茚地那韦合用导致抗逆转录病毒治疗失败；地高辛和华法林效果减弱；与 SSRI 合用引发 5-羟色胺综合征。
  • The efficacy estimate is unstable. The response-rate ratio was 1.28 in the 9 larger trials but 1.87 in the 9 smaller ones, and there is a strong country-of-origin effect concentrated in German-speaking countries.有效性估计并不稳定。9 项较大试验中应答率比为 1.28，9 项较小试验中却是 1.87，而且存在集中于德语国家的明显来源国效应。
  • Photosensitivity, and it should be stopped before elective surgery.有光敏性，择期手术前应当停用。
  • Practically speaking this is suitable for almost nobody, because almost everyone is on something.实际上它几乎不适合任何人，因为几乎每个人都在吃点什么药。
What it does, and what happens without it它有什么作用，缺了会怎样

A herbal antidepressant that also speeds up how the liver destroys many prescription drugs.一种草药抗抑郁剂,同时会加快肝脏清除许多处方药的速度。

No deficiency state exists不存在缺乏状态

In detail详细Hypericum perforatum extracts contain hypericin, pseudohypericin and hyperforin; hyperforin is the antidepressant-relevant constituent and inhibits reuptake of serotonin, noradrenaline and dopamine non-selectively. Hyperforin is also a potent ligand for the pregnane X receptor (Ki 27 nM), the nuclear receptor that drives transcription of CYP3A4 and P-glycoprotein, so the extract induces the clearance of a very wide range of co-administered drugs. Because CYP3A4 handles the oxidative metabolism of more than half of all medicines, this produces documented therapeutic failures with ciclosporin, tacrolimus, indinavir, warfarin and combined oral contraceptives, and serotonin toxicity when combined with SSRIs. Hypericin and hyperforin are plant products with no role in human physiology and no dietary requirement.贯叶连翘(Hypericum perforatum)提取物含有金丝桃素(hypericin)、伪金丝桃素(pseudohypericin)和贯叶金丝桃素(hyperforin),其中hyperforin是与抗抑郁作用相关的成分,能非选择性地抑制血清素、去甲肾上腺素和多巴胺的再摄取。hyperforin同时也是孕烷X受体的强效配体(Ki为27 nM),该核受体驱动CYP3A4和P-糖蛋白(P-glycoprotein)的转录,因此这种提取物会诱导广泛一类合并用药的清除。由于CYP3A4负责一半以上药物的氧化代谢,这会导致与环孢素(ciclosporin)、他克莫司(tacrolimus)、茚地那韦(indinavir)、华法林(warfarin)及复方口服避孕药合用时出现有据可查的治疗失败,并在与SSRI类药物合用时引发5-羟色胺毒性。金丝桃素和贯叶金丝桃素是植物产物,在人体生理中没有作用,也不存在膳食需求。

There is no deficiency state for this. It is not an essential nutrient, so being short of it is not a thing that can happen.它不存在缺乏状态。它不是必需营养素，所以“缺了它”这件事本身并不成立。

Source来源PMID 10852961 (Moore et al., Proc Natl Acad Sci USA 2000;97:7500-7502, St John's wort induces hepatic drug metabolism through activation of the pregnane X receptor)

Food and the body食物与身体
In food: Not food食物中：非食物 Dose from food: Out of reach靠吃达到剂量：达不到 Body makes it: Cannot身体自产：不能 Food data: Medium食物数据：中

St John's wort is the dried flowering aerial parts of Hypericum perforatum, a European meadow plant with no culinary use anywhere. It is consumed only as a medicine: tea, tincture, oil macerate or standardised dry extract. The two constituents that define it, hypericin (a naphthodianthrone) and hyperforin (a prenylated phloroglucinol), are confined to Hypericum species and are absent from the food supply, so there is no food route at any dose. Pharmacopoeial and commercial standards specify 0.3% hypericin, and the well-studied extract WS 5570 is an 80% ethanolic extract at a drug-to-extract ratio of 3:1 to 7:1 containing 0.12-0.28% hypericin and 5-6% hyperforin. One point worth carrying across from the melatonin entry: Hypericum perforatum is itself among the richest melatonin-bearing botanicals on record at roughly 4,490 ng/g dry weight, which is a curiosity about the plant rather than a reason to eat it.圣约翰草是贯叶连翘（Hypericum perforatum）的干燥开花地上部分，这是一种欧洲草地植物，任何地方都没有烹饪用途。它只作为药物使用：茶、酊剂、油浸剂或标准化干提取物。定义它的两个成分，金丝桃素（hypericin，一种双蒽酮）和贯叶金丝桃素（hyperforin，一种异戊烯基间苯三酚类化合物），只存在于金丝桃属物种，食物供应链中没有，所以任何剂量下都不存在食物途径。药典和商业标准规定 0.3% 金丝桃素，研究充分的提取物 WS 5570 是 80% 乙醇提取物，药材与提取物比为 3:1 至 7:1，含 0.12-0.28% 金丝桃素和 5-6% 贯叶金丝桃素。有一点可以从褪黑素条目带过来：贯叶连翘本身是已记录含褪黑素最丰富的植物之一，约 4,490 ng/g 干重，这属于关于这种植物的趣闻，不构成吃它的理由。

No ordinary food supplies this in a meaningful amount.没有普通食物能提供有意义的量。

To match the dose要达到该剂量Standard antidepressant dosing is 300 mg of standardised extract three times daily, 900 mg/day, delivering roughly 1.1-2.5 mg of hypericin (900 mg x 0.12-0.28%) and 45-54 mg of hyperforin. At a 3:1 to 7:1 drug-to-extract ratio that corresponds to about 2.7-6.3 g of dried herb per day. There is no food equivalent to compute at any portion size, because hypericin and hyperforin do not occur in foods. This is a complete absence rather than a large multiplier.标准抗抑郁用量为标准化提取物 300 mg、每天三次，即 900 mg/天，提供约 1.1-2.5 mg 金丝桃素（900 mg x 0.12-0.28%）和 45-54 mg 贯叶金丝桃素。按 3:1 至 7:1 的药材提取物比，相当于每天约 2.7-6.3 g 干药材。任何份量都没有食物等效量可算，因为金丝桃素和贯叶金丝桃素不存在于食物中。这是完全的缺失，不是一个大倍数。

Food vs supplement食物与补充剂The most consequential caveat in the whole set, and it runs opposite to the usual pattern: here the concentrated product is the dangerous one and there is no safe whole-food version to fall back on. Hyperforin is a potent activator of the pregnane X receptor and therefore a strong inducer of CYP3A4, CYP2C19 and P-glycoprotein. It lowers plasma levels of combined oral contraceptives (breakthrough bleeding and contraceptive failure are documented), ciclosporin and tacrolimus (with reported transplant rejection, including graft loss), warfarin, digoxin, HIV protease inhibitors and non-nucleoside reverse transcriptase inhibitors, irinotecan and imatinib, and several anticonvulsants. Combined with SSRIs, SNRIs, triptans or tramadol it can precipitate serotonin syndrome. Hypericin causes dose-dependent photosensitisation. Preparation type changes the risk profile substantially: hyperforin is lipophilic and unstable, so a water infusion delivers far less of it than an ethanolic extract, and low-hyperforin extracts were developed specifically to reduce interactions. A tea, a tincture and a capsule labelled with the same herb weight are not interchangeable, and treating this plant as a gentle food-adjacent botanical is the central error.这是整组数据中后果最严重的一条警告，而且方向与常见情况相反：这里危险的是浓缩产品，也没有安全的全食物版本可以退守。贯叶金丝桃素是孕烷 X 受体的强效激动剂，因此是 CYP3A4、CYP2C19 和 P-糖蛋白的强诱导剂。它会降低复方口服避孕药（已有突破性出血和避孕失败的记录）、环孢素和他克莫司（有移植排斥报告，包括移植物失功）、华法林、地高辛、HIV 蛋白酶抑制剂和非核苷类逆转录酶抑制剂、伊立替康和伊马替尼，以及若干抗惊厥药的血药浓度。与 SSRI、SNRI、曲普坦类或曲马多合用时，可诱发血清素综合征。金丝桃素会引起剂量依赖性光敏反应。制备类型对风险谱影响很大：贯叶金丝桃素亲脂且不稳定，水浸提液提供的量远低于乙醇提取物，低贯叶金丝桃素提取物就是专为减少相互作用而开发的。标注同样药材克数的茶、酊剂和胶囊不能互换，而把这种植物当成温和、接近食物的植物制品，正是核心错误。

Absorption吸收Hyperforin is well absorbed from oil-containing or ethanolic preparations, has a long elimination half-life on the order of nine hours and accumulates with three-times-daily dosing, which is why enzyme induction builds over one to two weeks and takes a similar period to wash out after stopping. Hypericin absorption is slow, low and variable, with a much longer half-life still. Both are lipophilic, so an aqueous tea extracts a small and inconsistent share, particularly of hyperforin, and hypericin is light-sensitive and degrades in poorly stored material. Since there is no food form, the practical absorption question is preparation rather than matrix, and the answer is that interaction risk tracks hyperforin exposure rather than the labelled hypericin percentage most products still advertise.贯叶金丝桃素在含油或乙醇制剂中吸收良好，消除半衰期约九小时，每天三次给药会累积，所以酶诱导在一到两周内逐步建立，停药后也需要相似时间才能消退。金丝桃素吸收缓慢、量低且波动大，半衰期更长得多。两者都亲脂，所以水煮的茶只提取出很小且不稳定的一部分，尤其是贯叶金丝桃素；金丝桃素对光敏感，在储存不当的材料中会降解。由于没有食物形式，实际的吸收问题是制备方式而非基质，答案是相互作用风险跟随贯叶金丝桃素暴露量，而不是跟随多数产品至今仍在宣传的金丝桃素百分比。

Food data note食物数据说明The NOT_FOOD classification was challenged and upheld, and the hyperforin dose (45-54 mg/day) and dried-herb equivalent (2.7-6.3 g/day) both recompute correctly. The hypericin figure had to be corrected by recomputation from the entry's own specification, and the only quantitative composition figure in the original entry carried no citation at all and has been withdrawn, so the entry now rests entirely on the extract specification rather than on any measured plant-material content中。NOT_FOOD 分类经质疑后维持，贯叶金丝桃素剂量（45-54 mg/天）和干药材等效量（2.7-6.3 g/天）重算均无误。金丝桃素数值需按本条目自身的规格重新计算才得到更正，而原条目中唯一的定量成分数据完全没有引文，已被撤回，所以本条目现在完全依赖提取物规格，不依赖任何实测的植物材料含量。

Does the body make it身体是否自产The relevant constituents are hypericin, a naphthodianthrone, and hyperforin, a prenylated phloroglucinol, both made only by Hypericum perforatum. Humans synthesise neither, so nothing here is replacement. On this one the axis being silent matters less than the interaction profile: hyperforin activates PXR and induces CYP3A4, which cuts blood levels of oral contraceptives, ciclosporin, warfarin and HIV protease inhibitors.相关成分是 hypericin (一种萘骈二蒽酮) 和 hyperforin (一种异戊烯化间苯三酚), 只由 Hypericum perforatum 合成。人两者都不合成, 所以这里谈不上替代。这一条上, 这条轴无话可说的意义远小于相互作用特征: hyperforin 激活 PXR 并诱导 CYP3A4, 会降低口服避孕药, 环孢素, 华法林和 HIV 蛋白酶抑制剂的血药水平。

Pathway合成通路NOT APPLICABLE. Plant polyketide and phloroglucinol pathways in Hypericum perforatum; no human homologue.NOT APPLICABLE。Hypericum perforatum 中的植物聚酮和间苯三酚途径; 人体没有同源途径。

Amount made自产量0 (no human biosynthetic pathway)0 (人体没有相应的生物合成途径)

Still matters when仍有意义的情形Nothing on this axis. The screening question is drug interaction, not deficiency: CYP3A4 induction by hyperforin plus serotonergic additivity with SSRIs and triptans. Also check hyperforin content, since low-hyperforin extracts induce far less.这条轴上没有理由。筛查要问药物相互作用, 与缺乏无关: hyperforin 诱导 CYP3A4, 加上与 SSRI 和曲普坦的血清素能叠加。还要看 hyperforin 含量, 低 hyperforin 提取物的诱导作用弱得多。

Synthesis source合成来源PMID 13129991 (Markowitz JS, JAMA 2003;290:1500-4, Effect of St John's wort on drug metabolism by induction of cytochrome P450 3A4 enzyme)

Refs.文献 Cochrane Linde PMID 18843608; Nicolussi PMID 31742659; Moore PNAS DOI 10.1073/pnas.130155097
CCCCFFDDBBXXLactase and pancreatic enzymes乳糖酶与胰酶
Verdict结论Consider可以考虑
Evidence证据Grade CC 级
Dose tested已验证剂量Lactase 3,000-9,000 FCC units with the first bite of dairy. Pancrelipase is prescribed in lipase units per meal and titrated.乳糖酶：随第一口乳制品服 3000 至 9000 FCC 单位。胰酶按每餐脂肪酶单位处方，并逐步调整。
Who适用人群Adults with hydrogen-breath-test-confirmed lactose maldigestion, and patients with objectively confirmed exocrine pancreatic insufficiency.经氢呼气试验确诊乳糖消化不良的成人，以及客观确诊外分泌胰腺功能不全的患者。
Pros优点
  • These are real enzymes replacing real deficiencies. Pancreatic enzyme replacement raises the coefficient of fat absorption from 63.1% to 83.7% in chronic pancreatitis, which is an objective physiological measurement rather than a symptom score.这是真正的酶在替代真正的缺乏。在慢性胰腺炎中，胰酶替代把脂肪吸收系数从 63.1% 提高到 83.7%，这是客观的生理测量，而不是症状评分。
  • Lactase lets people keep dairy in the diet rather than eliminating a whole food group.乳糖酶让人能继续吃乳制品，而不必整个食物类别都戒掉。
  • Pancrelipase is under-prescribed rather than over-sold, which is the opposite of the pattern in this document.胰酶是被开得太少而不是卖得太多，这与本文的普遍规律正好相反。
Cons缺点
  • Generic digestive enzyme complexes treat a condition that does not exist. There is no recognised syndrome of generalised enzyme insufficiency in healthy adults, and the pancreas has roughly 90% functional reserve before malabsorption appears.泛泛的“复合消化酶”治的是一个并不存在的病。健康成人不存在公认的“全面酶不足”综合征，而胰腺要损失约 90% 的功能才会出现吸收不良。
  • Using enzyme blends to self-treat undiagnosed persistent gut symptoms delays the diagnosis of coeliac disease, inflammatory bowel disease, pancreatic disease and colorectal cancer. That is the main harm.用复合酶自行处理未确诊的持续胃肠症状，会延误乳糜泻、炎症性肠病、胰腺疾病和结直肠癌的诊断。这才是主要危害。
  • Consumer enzyme products are dosed in non-comparable proprietary activity units by design, so cross-product comparison is impossible.消费级酶产品按互不可比的专有活性单位计量，这是设计如此，因此产品之间无法比较。
  • Pancrelipase is porcine-derived, which matters for observant Muslim and Jewish patients and for vegetarians, and cystic fibrosis patients must not exceed the weight-based ceiling because of fibrosing colonopathy risk.胰酶来源于猪，这对严格遵守教规的穆斯林和犹太患者以及素食者很重要；囊性纤维化患者不得超过按体重设定的上限，因为存在纤维化结肠病风险。
What it does, and what happens without it它有什么作用，缺了会怎样

Gut enzymes that split milk sugar and break down fat, protein and starch.分解乳糖以及分解脂肪、蛋白质和淀粉的肠道与胰腺酶。

Named deficiency disease有明确的缺乏症 Partly reversible部分可逆

In detail详细Lactase-phlorizin hydrolase sits in the small intestinal brush border and cleaves lactose into glucose and galactose; whatever escapes digestion reaches the colon, where bacteria ferment it into hydrogen, methane and short-chain fatty acids, producing the familiar symptoms. The exocrine pancreas secretes lipase and colipase, amylase, and the proteases trypsinogen and chymotrypsinogen, and lipase is the critical one because no other organ can substitute for it. The gland holds a large functional reserve: in the classic secretion studies, steatorrhoea did not appear until lipase output had fallen to 10% of normal or below, and creatorrhoea only below 10% of normal trypsin, which is why malabsorption in chronic pancreatitis declares itself late. The decline of intestinal lactase after weaning is the normal human developmental programme; retaining it into adulthood (lactase persistence) is the derived condition, driven chiefly by the LCT -13910C>T variant upstream of the lactase gene and selected for in dairying populations.乳糖酶-根皮苷水解酶(lactase-phlorizin hydrolase)位于小肠刷状缘,将乳糖分解为葡萄糖和半乳糖;未被消化的部分进入结肠,由细菌发酵产生氢气、甲烷和短链脂肪酸,从而引起常见症状。胰腺外分泌部分泌脂肪酶(lipase)和辅脂酶(colipase)、淀粉酶(amylase),以及蛋白酶胰蛋白酶原(trypsinogen)和糜蛋白酶原(chymotrypsinogen),其中脂肪酶是关键所在,因为没有其他器官能替代它的功能。胰腺具有很大的功能储备:在经典的分泌研究中,脂肪酶输出降至正常值的10%或以下时才出现脂肪泻(steatorrhoea),胰蛋白酶降至正常值10%以下时才出现肌酸泻(creatorrhoea),这正是慢性胰腺炎中的吸收不良往往迟迟才表现出来的原因。断奶后肠道乳糖酶活性下降是人类正常的发育程序;成年后仍保留乳糖酶活性(乳糖酶持续性)才是衍生出的状态,主要由乳糖酶基因(LCT)上游的-13910C>T变异驱动,并在从事乳制品生产的人群中受到选择。

Deficiency disease缺乏症Exocrine pancreatic insufficiency is the genuine clinical deficiency in this pairing. Congenital lactase deficiency is a separate, rare autosomal recessive disorder presenting in the newborn. Adult lactase non-persistence is NOT a deficiency disease: it is the ancestral and worldwide-majority human phenotype.胰腺外分泌功能不全(exocrine pancreatic insufficiency)是这一配对中真正的临床缺乏状态。先天性乳糖酶缺乏症是另一种独立、罕见的常染色体隐性遗传病,在新生儿期发病。成年乳糖酶非持续性(lactase non-persistence)不是一种缺乏性疾病:它是人类祖先型且在全球占多数的表型。

First signs早期表现Exocrine pancreatic insufficiency starts with bloating, flatulence, loose pale stools and unintended weight loss despite preserved appetite; a low faecal elastase-1 and falling fat-soluble vitamin levels (A, D, E, K) usually precede visible steatorrhoea by a long interval. Lactase non-persistence, being a physiological trait rather than a disease, shows only as dose-dependent bloating, cramps, audible bowel sounds and osmotic diarrhoea beginning 30 minutes to 2 hours after a lactose load, with most affected adults tolerating around 12 g of lactose (one glass of milk) without trouble.胰腺外分泌功能不全起初表现为腹胀、排气增多、大便稀软色浅,以及食欲未减却体重意外下降;粪便elastase-1水平降低及脂溶性维生素(A、D、E、K)水平下降通常比肉眼可见的脂肪泻(steatorrhoea)早出现很长一段时间。乳糖酶非持续性是一种生理特征而非疾病,表现仅为剂量依赖性的腹胀、痉挛、可闻及的肠鸣音,以及摄入乳糖后30分钟至2小时内出现的渗透性腹泻,大多数受影响的成年人可耐受约12 g乳糖(相当于一杯牛奶)而不出现症状。

Untreated不治疗会怎样Untreated exocrine pancreatic insufficiency causes overt steatorrhoea, progressive weight loss and sarcopenia, fat-soluble vitamin deficiency with osteopenia and osteoporosis, and in cystic fibrosis, failure to thrive in infancy; excess mortality in chronic pancreatitis is concentrated in those with untreated malabsorption. Lactase non-persistence has no severe clinical endpoint whatsoever. The only downstream risk is a calcium and vitamin D shortfall in people who eliminate dairy entirely without substituting an alternative source.未经治疗的胰腺外分泌功能不全会导致明显的脂肪泻(steatorrhoea)、进行性体重下降和肌少症(sarcopenia)、脂溶性维生素缺乏并伴骨量减少和骨质疏松,在囊性纤维化(cystic fibrosis)患儿则表现为婴儿期生长发育迟滞;慢性胰腺炎的超额死亡率主要集中在未经治疗、存在吸收不良的患者中。乳糖酶非持续性完全没有任何严重的临床终点。唯一的下游风险是,完全停用乳制品而未以其他来源替代的人可能出现钙和维生素D不足。

Does it reverse补回来能修复吗Pancreatic enzyme replacement restores fat and protein absorption, reverses weight loss and corrects fat-soluble vitamin levels while it is being taken, but destroyed acinar tissue does not regenerate, so treatment is lifelong and bone density already lost recovers only in part. Lactase non-persistence is permanent because it is the normal genetic programme rather than a lesion; symptoms resolve completely with lactose restriction, fermented dairy or exogenous lactase, and the underlying trait is not something to correct.胰酶替代治疗在持续用药期间可恢复脂肪和蛋白质的吸收、逆转体重下降并纠正脂溶性维生素水平,但已被破坏的腺泡组织不会再生,因此治疗需终身进行,已经丢失的骨密度也只能部分恢复。乳糖酶非持续性是永久性的,因为它是正常的基因程序而非病变;通过限制乳糖摄入、改用发酵乳制品或外源补充乳糖酶,症状可以完全消除,而这一潜在特征本身并不是需要纠正的对象。

Who becomes deficient谁会缺乏Exocrine pancreatic insufficiency: people with chronic pancreatitis (as many as 8 in 10 eventually), cystic fibrosis (the great majority, most within the first year of life), pancreatic cancer, and those after pancreatic resection or major gastric surgery. Lactase non-persistence: the global adult majority, with the highest frequencies in East and Southeast Asian, sub-Saharan African, Indigenous American and Middle Eastern populations, and the lowest in northern and northwestern Europeans and their descendants.胰腺外分泌功能不全的高危人群:慢性胰腺炎患者(最终10人中多达8人会出现)、囊性纤维化(cystic fibrosis)患者(绝大多数,多数在出生后第一年内出现)、胰腺癌患者,以及胰腺切除术或大型胃部手术后的患者。乳糖酶非持续性的高发人群:全球成年人中的多数,东亚和东南亚、撒哈拉以南非洲、美洲原住民及中东人群中的发生率最高,北欧和西北欧人群及其后裔中的发生率最低。

How common有多常见Roughly two-thirds of the world's adult population is lactase non-persistent, which is the normal phenotype rather than a disease prevalence (PMID 32899182). Exocrine pancreatic insufficiency prevalence is condition-dependent: up to about 80% of adults with chronic pancreatitis and close to 9 in 10 infants with cystic fibrosis within the first year.全球约三分之二的成年人口为乳糖酶非持续性,这是正常表型的比例,而非一种疾病患病率(PMID 32899182)。胰腺外分泌功能不全的患病率因基础疾病而异:慢性胰腺炎成年患者中高达约80%,囊性纤维化(cystic fibrosis)患儿在出生后第一年内接近10人中9人。

Source来源PMID 32899182 (Nutrients 2020;12:2689, genetics of lactose intolerance with interactive world maps of phenotype and genotype frequencies); PMID 11788828 (Enattah et al., Nat Genet 2002;30:233-237, LCT -13910C>T variant associated with adult-type hypolactasia); PMID 4693931, DOI 10.1056/NEJM197304192881603 (DiMagno, Go & Summerskill, N Engl J Med 1973;288:813-815, steatorrhoea below 10% of normal lipase output); StatPearls NBK555926 (exocrine pancreatic insufficiency)

Food and the body食物与身体
In food: None食物中：无 Dose from food: Out of reach靠吃达到剂量：达不到 Body makes it: Usually身体自产：通常够 Food data: Medium食物数据：中

This item bundles two manufactured preparations with different answers, and the single SYNTHETIC code fits the products rather than the activities. Lactase: graded on the product it is SYNTHETIC, a microbial beta-galactosidase produced by fermentation of Aspergillus oryzae, A. niger or the yeast Kluyveromyces lactis and then purified, and the mammalian brush-border lactase it substitutes for is a membrane enzyme of the small intestinal epithelium present in no food; graded on the enzyme activity it is TRACE, because live yoghurt and kefir cultures carry microbial beta-galactosidase into the gut, which is why lactase-non-persistent people tolerate fermented dairy better than milk. Pancreatic enzyme replacement: NOT_FOOD. Pancreatin and pancrelipase are extracts of porcine pancreas glands, and the source review states that the preparations with demonstrated efficacy are porcine-derived (de la Iglesia et al., eClinicalMedicine 2026;94:103880, PMID 42011215). The nearest food is pancreas eaten as offal (sweetbread), which is not a realistic route.本条把两种人工制备的产品打包在一起，而它们的答案不同，单一的 SYNTHETIC 代码适用于产品，不适用于酶活性。乳糖酶：按产品评级为 SYNTHETIC，它是由 Aspergillus oryzae、A. niger 或酵母 Kluyveromyces lactis 发酵生产并纯化的微生物 β-半乳糖苷酶，而它所替代的哺乳动物刷状缘乳糖酶是小肠上皮的膜酶，任何食物中都不存在；按酶活性评级则为 TRACE，因为活性酸奶和开菲尔的菌种会把微生物 β-半乳糖苷酶带入肠道，这也是乳糖酶非持续型人群对发酵乳制品的耐受优于牛奶的原因。胰酶替代治疗：NOT_FOOD。胰酶（pancreatin）和胰脂肪酶制剂（pancrelipase）是猪胰腺的提取物，原综述指出，已证实有效的制剂均为猪源（de la Iglesia et al., eClinicalMedicine 2026;94:103880, PMID 42011215）。最接近的食物是作为内脏食用的胰腺（sweetbread），这不是现实可行的途径。

No ordinary food supplies this in a meaningful amount.没有普通食物能提供有意义的量。

To match the dose要达到该剂量Pancreatic enzymes: absolute. Recommended dosing is a minimum of 40,000-50,000 units of lipase with main meals and 20,000-25,000 with snacks, taken with every meal for life (PMID 42011215). No food supplies active lipase in those quantities. Raw pancreas is the only tissue that contains the enzymes at all, it is not eaten raw in any normal diet, cooking denatures them, the delivered activity would be unmeasurable and uncontrolled, and without enteric protection gastric acid would destroy most of what survived. Lactase: there is one genuine partial route, since live yoghurt and kefir carry microbial beta-galactosidase into the gut, but that only handles the lactose in the fermented product itself and does not give a dose-adjustable enzyme to take with an arbitrary lactose-containing meal, which is the point of a lactase capsule. No peer-reviewed per-100 g beta-galactosidase activity figure for retail yoghurt was retrieved here, so no number is given; that is a sourcing gap in this dataset rather than an absence in the literature.胰酶：差距是绝对的。推荐剂量为主餐至少 40,000-50,000 单位脂肪酶，加餐 20,000-25,000 单位，终身随每餐服用（PMID 42011215）。没有任何食物能提供这个量级的活性脂肪酶。生胰腺是唯一含有这些酶的组织，正常饮食中没有人生吃，加热会使其变性，实际送达的活性无法测量也无法控制，而且没有肠溶保护，胃酸会摧毁存活下来的大部分。乳糖酶：确实存在一条部分可行的途径，活性酸奶和开菲尔会把微生物 β-半乳糖苷酶带入肠道，但那只能处理发酵产品自身所含的乳糖，无法提供一种可按剂量调整、随任意含乳糖餐食服用的酶，而后者正是乳糖酶胶囊的用途。此处没有检索到零售酸奶每 100 g β-半乳糖苷酶活性的同行评议数据，因此不给出数字；这是本数据集的取证缺口，并不代表文献中不存在。

Food vs supplement食物与补充剂For pancreatin the caveats are pharmaceutical rather than dietary. Dose must be titrated to steatorrhoea, meal fat content and disease severity; the enzymes must be enteric-coated to survive gastric acid; the capsules are taken during the meal rather than before or after; and the porcine origin is a real issue for vegetarian, vegan, Muslim and Jewish patients and should be disclosed. Nothing sold as a plant-based or vegan pancreatic enzyme has demonstrated equivalence for pancreatic exocrine insufficiency, and treating a diagnosed insufficiency with a supermarket digestive enzyme blend risks continued fat malabsorption, weight loss and fat-soluble vitamin deficiency. For lactase the honest framing is that this is a targeted, cheap, low-risk aid rather than a nutrient: the alternative food strategy of hard cheese, live yoghurt and small lactose doses spread through the day works for many people, and lactase capsules matter mainly when the meal is unavoidable and the lactose dose is large.对胰酶来说，注意点属于药学范畴，与膳食无关。剂量必须按脂肪泻程度、餐食脂肪含量和病情严重度滴定；酶必须做肠溶包衣才能在胃酸中存活；胶囊要在进餐过程中服用，不在餐前或餐后；猪源对素食者、纯素者、穆斯林和犹太患者是真实问题，应当披露。以植物基或纯素胰酶名义出售的产品，没有一种在胰腺外分泌不足上证明了等效性；用超市卖的消化酶复配产品去治疗已确诊的胰腺外分泌不足，可能导致脂肪吸收不良持续、体重下降和脂溶性维生素缺乏。对乳糖酶，诚实的定位是一种针对性强、便宜、低风险的辅助手段，它不构成营养素。替代的饮食策略（硬质奶酪、活性酸奶，把少量乳糖分散到一天里）对很多人有效，乳糖酶胶囊主要用在无法回避且乳糖负荷较大的那一餐。

Absorption吸收Both are enzymes, so bioavailability means surviving intact and active to the site of action rather than being absorbed. Lactase works in the lumen of the upper small intestine and is itself digested, so timing relative to the lactose load determines the effect. Pancreatic lipase is irreversibly denatured below about pH 4, which is why uncoated pancreatin is largely wasted, why the field has moved to pH-sensitive enteric microspheres, and why an emerging approach adds bicarbonate to raise local pH around the pancreatin. Coadministered acid suppression is sometimes needed to make the enzymes work at all. None of this can be replicated by eating anything.两者都是酶，因此生物利用度指的是完整且有活性地到达作用部位，与被吸收无关。乳糖酶在上段小肠腔内起作用，本身也会被消化，所以相对于乳糖负荷的服用时机决定效果。胰脂肪酶在约 pH 4 以下不可逆变性，这就是无包衣胰酶大部分被浪费的原因，也是这一领域转向 pH 敏感肠溶微球的原因，还是近年出现的在胰酶周围加碳酸氢盐以提高局部 pH 这一思路的原因。有时还需要同时使用抑酸药，酶才能起作用。这些都无法靠吃任何东西复现。

Food data note食物数据说明The PERT dosing figures and the porcine origin were confirmed against the cited review (PMID 42011215), and the manufacturing routes for microbial lactase are standard and uncontested. The lactase side is weaker: the fermented-dairy beta-galactosidase route is well established qualitatively but no per-100 g activity figure for retail yoghurt was retrieved, so the partial food route cannot be quantified or compared against a capsule dose中。PERT 剂量数据和猪源已对照所引综述确认（PMID 42011215），微生物乳糖酶的生产路线是标准且无争议的。乳糖酶一侧较弱：发酵乳制品的 β-半乳糖苷酶途径在定性上确立良好，但没有检索到零售酸奶的每 100 g 活性数据，因此这条部分可行的食物途径无法定量，也无法与胶囊剂量比较。

Does the body make it身体是否自产Both enzymes are made by the body, and both have named states in which that synthesis stops being sufficient, which is what makes them genuine replacement therapy. Lactase is made by small-intestinal enterocytes and its decline after weaning is the normal human pattern, with adult retention the derived trait set by regulatory variants upstream of the LCT gene; pancreatic enzymes are made by acinar cells, and replacement exists precisely because that synthesis fails in pancreatic disease. So these products are correct in the person with the named condition and pointless in everyone else.这两种酶身体都能合成, 而且都有明确的状态使合成不再够用, 这就是它们属于真正替代治疗的原因。乳糖酶由小肠上皮细胞合成, 断奶后活性下降是人类的常态, 成年后仍保留才是衍生性状, 由 LCT 基因上游的调控变异决定; 胰酶由腺泡细胞合成, 替代疗法之所以存在, 正因为胰腺疾病使这种合成失效。所以这些产品对有明确诊断的人是对的, 对其他所有人没有意义。

Pathway合成通路Lactase-phlorizin hydrolase (LCT) synthesised by enterocytes of the jejunal brush border; adult expression is controlled by MCM6 enhancer variants: -13910C>T in Europeans, -13915T>G in Arabian populations, and -13907C>G and -14010G>C in African populations, so genotyping -13910C>T alone misclassifies most lactase-persistent Africans and Middle Easterners. Pancreatic lipase, colipase, amylase, trypsinogen and chymotrypsinogen are synthesised by pancreatic acinar cells and secreted into the duodenum under CCK and secretin control.Lactase-phlorizin hydrolase (LCT) 由空肠刷状缘上皮细胞合成; 成年期表达由 MCM6 增强子变异决定: 欧洲人群为 -13910C>T, 阿拉伯人群为 -13915T>G, 非洲人群为 -13907C>G 和 -14010G>C, 所以只检测 -13910C>T 会把大多数乳糖酶持续的非洲和中东人误判为不持续。胰脂肪酶, 共脂肪酶, 淀粉酶, 胰蛋白酶原和胰凝乳蛋白酶原由胰腺腺泡细胞合成, 在 CCK 和 secretin 调控下分泌入十二指肠。

Amount made自产量Pancreatic lipase secreted in response to a test meal in healthy volunteers: 253.5 +/- 95.5 mg (liquid meal) and 202.9 +/- 96.1 mg (solid meal), against 21.6 +/- 14.5 mg and 15.2 +/- 5.1 mg respectively for gastric lipase (PMID 11040182). Lactase: NOT ESTABLISHED as a daily amount.健康志愿者对试验餐分泌的胰脂肪酶: 液体餐 253.5 +/- 95.5 mg, 固体餐 202.9 +/- 96.1 mg; 同条件下胃脂肪酶分别为 21.6 +/- 14.5 mg 和 15.2 +/- 5.1 mg (PMID 11040182)。乳糖酶: 作为每日量 NOT ESTABLISHED。

Still matters when仍有意义的情形Lactase tablets in lactase non-persistence, which is the majority phenotype worldwide. Pancreatic enzyme replacement in exocrine pancreatic insufficiency, where steatorrhoea appears only once enzyme secretion falls below roughly 10 percent of normal, with AGA advising at least 40,000 USP units of lipase with each meal, half that with snacks, and noting that doses above 120,000 units per meal are seldom needed. For a lactase-persistent person with a normal pancreas, NEVER ON THIS AXIS.乳糖酶片用于乳糖酶不持续者, 这在全球是多数表型。胰酶替代用于外分泌胰腺功能不足, 只有当酶分泌降到正常值约 10% 以下才出现脂肪泻; AGA 建议每餐至少 40,000 USP units 脂肪酶, 加餐用其一半, 并指出每餐超过 120,000 units 很少必要。对乳糖酶持续且胰腺功能正常的人, NEVER ON THIS AXIS。

Synthesis source合成来源PMID 11788828 (Enattah NS, Nat Genet 2002;30:233-7, Identification of a variant associated with adult-type hypolactasia); PMID 11040182 (Carriere F, Gastroenterology 2000;119:949-60); PMID 33887513 (Catanzaro R, Nutr Res)

Refs.文献 de la Iglesia-Garcia PMID 27941156; Gan PMID 29212278; de Vrese PMID 25042846; Munasinghe PMID 20204691

06Skip it不必买

No good evidence for the marketed claim. Where a genuine narrow signal exists it is listed under Pros, so you can see how thin it is.对其宣传的功效没有像样的证据。若确实存在一点狭窄的信号，会列在“优点”里，让你看清它有多薄。

SSAAFFDDBBXXMultivitamin / multimineral复合维生素与矿物质
Verdict结论Skip it不必买
Evidence证据Grade AA 级
Dose tested已验证剂量One tablet daily. There is no established effective dose because there is no established clinical effect in replete adults.每日一片。不存在“有效剂量”，因为在营养充足的成人中不存在已确立的临床效应。
Who适用人群Genuine deficiency or high-probability deficiency: post-bariatric, malabsorption, strict vegans, long-term metformin users, heavy alcohol use, the housebound.确有缺乏或高度可能缺乏的人：减重手术后、吸收不良、严格纯素、长期二甲双胍使用者、大量饮酒者、久不出门者。
Pros优点
  • For someone with a genuine deficiency it is a cheap way to cover several nutrients at once, and that is a real use.对确实存在缺乏的人来说，这是一次覆盖多种营养素的便宜办法，这个用途是真实的。
  • Doses are usually at reference-intake level, so a plain multivitamin rarely pushes any single nutrient near its upper limit on its own.其剂量通常在参考摄入量水平，所以单独吃一片普通复合维生素很少会把某一种营养素推到接近上限。
  • COSMOS-Web and COSMOS-Mind reported a memory signal, which is the only positive finding in this entry and is weak.COSMOS-Web 和 COSMOS-Mind 报告了记忆方面的信号，这是本条目里唯一的阳性发现，而且很弱。
Cons缺点
  • It does not prevent cardiovascular disease, cancer or death. Physicians Health Study II (n=14,641, 11.2 years): major cardiovascular events HR 1.01 (0.91-1.10).它不能预防心血管病、癌症或死亡。医师健康研究 II（n=14641，11.2 年）：主要心血管事件 HR 1.01（0.91-1.10）。
  • The largest dataset points the wrong way. Pooled US cohorts (n=390,124, up to 27 years, 164,762 deaths): daily multivitamin users had HIGHER all-cause mortality, HR 1.04 (1.02-1.07). This is observational and probably reflects sick people starting supplements, but it is not the direction the marketing implies.最大的数据集指向相反方向。美国多队列合并分析（n=390124，随访最长 27 年，164762 例死亡）：每日服用者全因死亡更高，HR 1.04（1.02-1.07）。这是观察性数据，很可能反映的是生病的人开始吃补充剂，但方向与营销暗示的相反。
  • The USPSTF gives it an I statement, meaning the evidence is insufficient to weigh benefits against harms. The industry reports this as vindication, which it is not.USPSTF 给它的是 I 级声明，意思是证据不足以权衡利弊。行业把这当成背书来引用，而它并不是。
  • The nutrient-gap argument has never converted into a clinical outcome in a healthy replete adult, and this is a roughly 8 billion US dollar per year category resting on it.“营养缺口”这个论点从未在健康且营养充足的成人中转化为临床结局，而一个每年约 80 亿美元的品类就建立在它之上。
  • Vitamin K content antagonises warfarin, so switching brands or starting and stopping the product shifts INR. Treat it as a dosing variable.其中的维生素 K 会拮抗华法林，因此换品牌或开始与停用都会改变 INR。要把它当作一个剂量变量。
  • Risk comes from stacking. A multivitamin plus a separate high-dose single nutrient is how people cross an upper limit without noticing.风险来自叠加。一片复合维生素再加一种单独的大剂量营养素，人们就是这样在不知不觉中越过上限的。
What it does, and what happens without it它有什么作用，缺了会怎样

A mixed low-dose top-up of many nutrients at once; it has no function of its own.多种营养素的低剂量混合补充；它本身没有独立的功能。

Mixed product复合产品

In detail详细A multivitamin/multimineral is a product category rather than a substance: a fixed combination typically supplying somewhere around the RDA for ten to thirty vitamins and minerals in a single daily dose. It has no physiology of its own, and whatever it does in the body is simply the sum of the individual nutrients, each acting through its own pathway. Formulations differ enormously in which nutrients are included, in what chemical form (iron as sulphate or bisglycinate, folate as folic acid or 5-MTHF, vitamin D as D2 or D3), and at what fraction or multiple of the RDA, so trial evidence about one product transfers poorly to another. Its coherent use is as insurance against gaps in an inadequate diet. A diagnosed deficiency is treated with the specific nutrient at a therapeutic dose, which a multivitamin does not supply.复合维生素/复合矿物质是一个产品类别，而非单一物质：通常是一种固定组合，每日一剂提供约十至三十种维生素和矿物质，剂量大致接近其RDA。它本身没有独立的生理作用，其在体内产生的任何效果，都只是各单独营养素作用的总和，每种营养素通过各自的途径发挥作用。不同配方在所含营养素种类、化学形式（铁为硫酸盐还是双甘氨酸螯合物，叶酸为folic acid还是5-MTHF，维生素D为D2还是D3）以及占RDA的比例或倍数上差异极大，因此针对某一产品的试验证据很难推及另一产品。其合理用途是作为膳食摄入不足的保险性补充。已确诊的缺乏症需以特定营养素的治疗剂量进行纠正，复合维生素无法提供这样的剂量。

There is no deficiency state for this. It is not an essential nutrient, so being short of it is not a thing that can happen.它不存在缺乏状态。它不是必需营养素，所以“缺了它”这件事本身并不成立。

Source来源PMID 35727271 (US Preventive Services Task Force Recommendation Statement, JAMA 2022;327(23):2326-2333, Vitamin, Mineral, and Multivitamin Supplementation to Prevent Cardiovascular Disease and Cancer)

Food and the body食物与身体
In food: Rich食物中：丰富 Dose from food: Partly靠吃达到剂量：部分 Body makes it: n/a身体自产：不适用 Food data: Medium食物数据：中

This is a product category rather than a molecule, and almost every nutrient inside it is abundant in ordinary food, which is why the US Preventive Services Task Force concluded in 2022 that the evidence is insufficient to recommend multivitamins for preventing cardiovascular disease or cancer, and recommended against beta-carotene and vitamin E supplements outright. The nutrients are food-abundant while the pill itself is manufactured: folic acid is not a natural food form, and cyanocobalamin occurs in food only in traces, so the accurate statement is that neither is the predominant natural form, and both are present in fortified foods, which this entry treats as a legitimate route for B12. Shortfalls that are real in populations are a short list: the 2020-2025 Dietary Guidelines for Americans name calcium, potassium, vitamin D and dietary fibre as nutrients of public health concern, with iron and folate added in pregnancy, and UK survey data adds magnesium, selenium and iron in younger women, though the specific NDNS below-LRNI percentages carried in the original submission (magnesium 9% of men and 13% of women, selenium 25.8% of males and 50.3% of females, iron about a quarter of younger women) could not be traced to a named survey round, age band or table and are indicative and unconfirmed here.这是一个产品类别，谈不上是单一分子，而其中几乎每一种营养素在普通食物里都很丰富，这也是美国预防服务工作组（USPSTF）在 2022 年得出结论的原因：证据不足以推荐用复合维生素预防心血管疾病或癌症，同时明确不推荐 β-胡萝卜素和维生素 E 补充剂。营养素本身在食物中很丰富，药片则是制造出来的：叶酸（folic acid）不是食物中的天然形式，氰钴胺在食物里只有痕量，因此准确的说法是这两者都不是占主导的天然形式，两者也都存在于强化食品中，本条把强化食品视为获取 B12 的正当途径。人群中真实存在的摄入不足只是一个短名单：2020-2025 年美国膳食指南把钙、钾、维生素 D 和膳食纤维列为公共健康关注营养素，孕期再加铁和叶酸；英国调查数据在年轻女性中补上镁、硒和铁。不过原稿携带的具体 NDNS 低于 LRNI 比例（镁为男性 9%、女性 13%，硒为男性 25.8%、女性 50.3%，铁约为四分之一的年轻女性）无法追溯到具体的调查轮次、年龄组或表格，在此仅作参考，未经确认。

Added on verification as the main UK non-fish vitamin D vehicle. The 14 g tablespoon is a conventional weight, so the per-portion figure is indicative
Egg, whole, hard-boiled (vitamin D)全蛋，煮熟（维生素 D） 2.2 ug vitamin D 1 large egg (50 g)1 个大鸡蛋（50 g） 1.1 ug 7% of the 15 ug RDA15 ug RDA 的 7% USDA FoodData Central FDC ID 173424. Eggs are also one of the four main iodine sources the NHS lists
Kombu (dried kelp), shown as a hazard rather than a source (iodine)昆布（干海带），列在这里是作为风险示例，不作为推荐来源（碘） 440,670 ug iodine 1 g of dried kombu1 g 干昆布 4,407 ug 3,148% of the 140 ug UK RNI from a single gram, a 31.5-fold overshoot单单 1 g 就相当于英国 140 ug RNI 的 3,148%，超出 31.5 倍 CoFID 13-339, the highest iodine value in the whole CoFID dataset. One gram clears the EFSA adult upper level of 600 ug/day several times over (that upper level matches the standard SCF 2002 figure but could not be confirmed from the source text during verification). Wakame is 16,830 ug/100 g and nori 1,470 ug/100 g (CoFID 13-341 and 13-340), a 300-fold spread across three seaweeds sold in the same shop, and kelp-induced thyroid dysfunction is documented.
