To match the dose要达到该剂量There is no single food equivalent of a multivitamin, because a multivitamin is not a nutrient: one tablet supplies roughly 100% of the reference intake for 20 or more nutrients at once, and the only thing matching that profile is a varied diet, which by definition already supplies them. So the answer has to be given per nutrient, and it splits. For most of the tablet (vitamin C, vitamin A, thiamine, riboflavin, niacin, B6, vitamin E, vitamin K, zinc, selenium, copper, iodine) the food gap for anyone eating a normal mixed diet is zero. Vitamin D is reachable but rarely reached: the original claim that UV-treated mushrooms are the only food to hit 15 ug in one portion is arithmetically false, because 3 oz of canned sockeye salmon gives 17.9 ug (119% of the 15 ug RDA), 3 oz of farmed rainbow trout 16.2 ug (108%), a USDA half-fillet (155 g) of cooked sockeye 25.9 ug (173%), and a teaspoon of cod liver oil 11.3 ug (75%), alongside a cup of UV portabella at 24.4 ug. Reaching 15 ug/day from food needs about 90 g of cooked sockeye every day, or 1.15 litres of fortified milk, or 14 large eggs; the UK 10 ug RNI needs about 60 g of oily fish daily or 770 ml of fortified milk. So the vitamin D case for supplementing is behavioural (few people at temperate latitudes eat oily fish daily through winter) rather than compositional, and it argues for vitamin D alone rather than a 25-ingredient tablet. Periconceptional folic acid is a genuine exception: 400 ug/day is food-achievable in bulk (about 220 g of cooked lentils daily) but the trial evidence for preventing neural tube defects is for supplemental folic acid, and food folate is both less bioavailable and more variable, so food substitution is not supported. B12 on a vegan diet is the second real exception, since there is no reliable unfortified plant source, so a supplement or fortified food is mandatory. Two mismatches run the other way: the potassium in a multivitamin is capped at about 99 mg against a 3,500 mg reference intake, and the calcium is typically 100-200 mg, so the tablet cannot address either of the shortfalls the guidelines name, and fibre, the fourth named shortfall, is absent from every tablet. Iodised salt, the global public-health iodine vehicle, belongs in this list as well; verification named it as a complete omission but supplied no composition figure, so no row is given for it.复合维生素没有单一食物的等价物，因为它本身并不是一种营养素：一片药同时提供 20 种以上营养素各约 100% 的参考摄入量，唯一符合这一构成的东西是多样化的膳食，而多样化膳食按定义已经在提供这些营养素。所以答案必须按营养素分别给出，结论也随之分开。药片里的大部分成分（维生素 C、维生素 A、硫胺素、核黄素、烟酸、B6、维生素 E、维生素 K、锌、硒、铜、碘），对任何吃正常混合膳食的人来说食物缺口为零。维生素 D 可以达到，却很少有人达到：原稿称经紫外线处理的蘑菇是唯一能在一份内达到 15 ug 的食物，这在算术上不成立，因为 3 oz 罐装红鲑给出 17.9 ug（15 ug RDA 的 119%），3 oz 养殖虹鳟 16.2 ug（108%），USDA 的半片（155 g）熟红鲑 25.9 ug（173%），一茶匙鱼肝油 11.3 ug（75%），此外一杯紫外线处理的褐菇为 24.4 ug。要从食物做到 15 ug/天，需要每天约 90 g 熟红鲑，或 1.15 litres 强化牛奶，或 14 个大鸡蛋；英国的 10 ug RNI 需要每天约 60 g 多脂鱼或 770 ml 强化牛奶。所以维生素 D 需要补充的理由在行为层面（温带纬度很少有人整个冬天每天吃多脂鱼），与食物成分无关，据此该补的是单独的维生素 D，一片含 25 种成分的药并无必要。孕前和孕早期的叶酸是真正的例外：400 ug/天 靠食物在数量上做得到（每天约 220 g 熟扁豆），但预防神经管缺陷的试验证据针对的是补充剂形式的叶酸，食物叶酸生物利用度更低且变化更大，因此用食物替代得不到支持。素食者的 B12 是第二个真正的例外，植物性食物中没有可靠的未强化来源，所以补充剂或强化食品是必需的。有两处不匹配方向相反：复合维生素中的钾被限制在约 99 mg，而参考摄入量是 3,500 mg；钙通常只有 100-200 mg，因此药片解决不了指南列出的这两项不足，而纤维这第四项不足在任何药片里都不存在。碘盐作为全球公共卫生的碘载体也属于这个名单；核查指出它被完全遗漏，但没有给出成分数值，因此这里不为它单列一行。

Food vs supplement食物与补充剂This category contains the clearest documented case of a whole food being safe while the isolated concentrate is harmful. Carotenoid-rich vegetables are consistently associated with lower lung cancer risk, while beta-carotene as a supplement increased lung cancer incidence in smokers and asbestos-exposed workers in the ATBC and CARET trials, and the USPSTF now recommends against it with moderate certainty that harms exceed benefits. Vitamin E supplements carry the same recommendation against. Preformed vitamin A as retinol in a tablet counts toward the 3,000 ug/day upper limit and is teratogenic at high intake, while beta-carotene in carrots does not convert quickly enough to reach toxicity. Two food rows on this list carry the same warning as the tablet: beef liver at 9,442 ug RAE/100 g and cod liver oil are both concentrated retinol sources, so neither is a free lunch. Folic acid in a tablet can partially mask the haematological signs of B12 deficiency while neurological damage continues, an effect food folate has not been shown to produce. Stacking is the underappreciated risk: a multivitamin alongside fortified breakfast cereal and a fortified plant drink can push folic acid, retinol, niacin and iron past their upper limits in someone who believes they are taking one tablet. Within the tablet itself, iron competes with zinc and copper for shared transporters and calcium interferes with iron uptake, so a combined product delivers less of each than the label states. And no tablet carries the fibre, the food-level potassium, or the polyphenols that account for much of the association between diet quality and outcomes, which is the structural reason a pill is not a diet.这个类别里有最清楚的记录：完整食物是安全的，分离出来的浓缩物有害。富含类胡萝卜素的蔬菜一贯与更低的肺癌风险相关，而 β-胡萝卜素作为补充剂在 ATBC 和 CARET 试验中增加了吸烟者和石棉暴露工人的肺癌发生率，USPSTF 现在不推荐使用它，并以中等确定性认为危害超过获益。维生素 E 补充剂同样被列为不推荐。药片中以视黄醇形式存在的预成型维生素 A 计入 3,000 ug/天 的上限，高摄入时具有致畸性；胡萝卜里的 β-胡萝卜素转化速度不足以达到中毒水平。本清单里有两行食物带着与药片相同的警告：牛肝为 9,442 ug RAE/100 g，鱼肝油同样是浓缩的视黄醇来源，两者都不是免费的午餐。药片里的叶酸可以部分掩盖 B12 缺乏的血液学表现，而神经损伤仍在继续，食物叶酸尚未显示有这种效应。叠加是被低估的风险：复合维生素加上强化早餐谷物再加强化植物饮料，可以把叶酸、视黄醇、烟酸和铁推过各自的上限，而当事人以为自己只吃了一片药。在药片内部，铁与锌和铜竞争同一批转运体，钙干扰铁的吸收，所以复合产品实际提供的每种成分都少于标签值。另外没有任何药片带来纤维、食物水平的钾或多酚，而这些占了膳食质量与结局之间关联的很大一部分，这是药片顶不上膳食的结构性原因。

Absorption吸收Form differences run in both directions, so blanket claims fail here. Iron: haem iron from meat and fish absorbs at roughly 15-35% and is largely insensitive to the rest of the meal, while non-haem iron from plants and from the ferrous salts in tablets ranges from about 2% to 20% depending on phytate, polyphenols, calcium and vitamin C eaten at the same time. Spinach iron sits at the bottom of that range because oxalate binds it, so the textbook answer is the wrong answer. Folate: folic acid from a supplement taken with food is roughly 85% bioavailable against about 50% for naturally occurring food folate, so here the synthetic form genuinely outperforms the food. Vitamin B12: food B12 is protein-bound and needs gastric acid and pepsin to release it, so older adults with atrophic gastritis and long-term proton pump inhibitor or metformin users often absorb crystalline B12 from a tablet better than B12 from a chop. Vitamin D: the D2 in UV-treated mushrooms raises and sustains serum 25(OH)D less efficiently than the D3 in oily fish and most supplements, so 24.4 ug from a cup of portabella is not equivalent to 24.4 ug from salmon, and the mushroom rows should not be read as interchangeable with the fish rows despite ranking near them. Vitamin K: the K1 in leafy greens is poorly released from the plant matrix and cleared fast, while the long-chain MK-7 in natto reaches higher and far longer-lasting serum concentrations, so a portion of natto and a portion of kale are not interchangeable despite sharing the label term. All four fat-soluble vitamins need fat in the same meal, which is why a multivitamin swallowed with black coffee delivers less than the panel claims.形式差异在两个方向上都存在，因此一刀切的说法在这里都不成立。铁：来自肉和鱼的血红素铁吸收率约 15-35%，且基本不受同餐其他成分影响；来自植物以及片剂中亚铁盐的非血红素铁则在约 2% 到 20% 之间，取决于同餐的植酸、多酚、钙和维生素 C。菠菜的铁处在这个区间的底部，因为草酸把它结合住了，所以教科书答案是错误答案。叶酸：随餐服用的补充剂叶酸生物利用度约 85%，天然食物叶酸约 50%，在这里合成形式确实更胜一筹。维生素 B12：食物中的 B12 与蛋白结合，需要胃酸和胃蛋白酶才能释放，因此患萎缩性胃炎的老年人以及长期使用质子泵抑制剂或二甲双胍者，往往从药片里的结晶 B12 吸收得比从一块肉里更好。维生素 D：紫外线处理蘑菇中的 D2 在提升和维持血清 25(OH)D 上不如多脂鱼和多数补充剂中的 D3 有效，所以一杯褐菇的 24.4 ug 不等于来自三文鱼的 24.4 ug，蘑菇那几行虽然排名相近，也不应读作能与鱼类互换。维生素 K：叶菜中的 K1 从植物基质中释放较差且清除很快，纳豆里的长链 MK-7 则达到更高、持续时间长得多的血清浓度，所以一份纳豆和一份羽衣甘蓝虽然共用同一个标签名称，也不能互换。四种脂溶性维生素都需要同餐有脂肪，这也是复合维生素配黑咖啡吞下去时实际提供量少于成分表所示的原因。

Food data note食物数据说明The composition data is HIGH quality: verification traced every cited FDC ID and CoFID code to the source datasets with exact matches on descriptions, per-100 g values and portion weights. Two things pull the item down. The UK NDNS below-LRNI percentages that motivate the whole shortfall argument are UNVERIFIABLE as cited, with no survey round, age band or table given, and figures quoted to one decimal place with no year attached are not checkable. The EFSA 600 ug/day iodine upper level is consistent with the standard SCF 2002 figure but its source text could not be extracted during verification. Several added rows also carry conventional rather than dataset portion weights (haddock, crab brown meat, salted mackerel, UV crimini, fortified fat spread), and each is flagged in place中。组成数据质量为高：核查把每个引用的 FDC ID 和 CoFID 代码都追溯到源数据集，描述、每 100 g 数值和分量重量精确吻合。有两点把本条拉低。支撑整个摄入不足论证的英国 NDNS 低于 LRNI 比例按引用方式无法核实，没有给出调查轮次、年龄组或表格，而写到小数点后一位却不带年份的数字是没法核对的。EFSA 的 600 ug/天 碘上限与通行的 SCF 2002 数字一致，但核查期间无法提取其原文。另有若干新增行采用惯例分量而非数据集分量（黑线鳕、蟹褐肉、盐渍鲭鱼、紫外线处理的褐色小蘑菇、强化涂抹油脂），每一处都已就地标注。

Does the body make it身体是否自产This is a product category rather than a defined substance, so the axis cannot return one biochemical answer for it and the roll-up is NA. The parts do have answers: every mineral element in the bottle is NONE without exception, because no biological process transmutes elements; vitamin C, B12, folate, thiamine, riboflavin, B6, biotin, pantothenate, vitamin E and preformed vitamin A are NONE because no human biosynthetic pathway exists for any of them; vitamin D3 is PARTIAL through UVB-dependent cutaneous synthesis, vitamin K is PARTIAL through UBIAD1 conversion of dietary K1 to MK-4, and niacin is PARTIAL through the tryptophan route at 60 mg tryptophan per 1 mg niacin equivalent. A multivitamin therefore has a real target for whichever components a given person is short of and no target for the rest, so it has to be judged component by component against the doses on the label.这是一个产品类别, 并非界定明确的物质, 所以这条轴无法给出单一的生化答案, 整体判为 NA。它的各个组成部分有答案: 瓶里的每一种矿物元素一律为 NONE, 因为没有任何生物过程能进行元素转变; 维生素 C, B12, 叶酸, thiamine, riboflavin, B6, biotin, pantothenate, 维生素 E 和预成型维生素 A 都是 NONE, 人体对它们都没有生物合成通路; 维生素 D3 因依赖 UVB 的皮肤合成而为 PARTIAL, 维生素 K 因 UBIAD1 把膳食 K1 转化为 MK-4 而为 PARTIAL, 烟酸因色氨酸路线 (60 mg tryptophan 折合 1 mg niacin equivalent) 而为 PARTIAL。因此复合维生素对使用者确实短缺的那些成分有真实目标, 对其余成分没有目标, 只能逐个成分对照标签剂量来判断。

Pathway合成通路NOT APPLICABLE as a product category. Component pathways belong in their own rows: for every element human enzymology handles uptake, transport, storage and excretion only, and for the vitamins with no human pathway it handles absorption, activation and transport only. The two components with a genuine human route are vitamin D3 (non-enzymatic UVB photolysis of 7-dehydrocholesterol, then CYP2R1 and CYP27B1) and vitamin K (UBIAD1 prenylation of menadione to MK-4).作为产品类别 NOT APPLICABLE。各成分的通路属于各自的条目: 对每一种元素, 人体酶学只负责摄取, 转运, 储存和排出; 对没有人体通路的那些维生素, 只负责吸收, 活化和转运。真正拥有人体路线的两个成分是维生素 D3 (7-dehydrocholesterol 经非酶 UVB 光解, 随后 CYP2R1 与 CYP27B1) 和维生素 K (UBIAD1 把 menadione 异戊烯化为 MK-4)。

Amount made自产量NOT APPLICABLE for the product as a whole. Component reference points recovered in this dataset: vitamin C RDA 90 mg/day men and 75 mg/day women with UL 2,000 mg/day; folate RDA 400 µg DFE/d; vitamin B12 RDA 2.4 µg/d; biotin AI 30 µg/d; vitamin K AI 120 micrograms/day men and 90 micrograms/day women with no UL; vitamin D RDA 600 IU (15 micrograms)/day for ages 1 to 70 and 800 IU/day above 70 with UL 4,000 IU/day; niacin RDA 16 mg NE/day men and 14 mg NE/day women with UL 35 mg/day for supplemental forms; zinc 11 mg/day men and 8 mg/day women; magnesium 400 to 420 mg/day men and 310 to 320 mg/day women; copper RDA 900 µg/d with UL 10 mg/d.作为整体产品 NOT APPLICABLE。本数据集中恢复到的各成分参照点: 维生素 C RDA 男性 90 mg/day, 女性 75 mg/day, UL 2,000 mg/day; 叶酸 RDA 400 µg DFE/d; 维生素 B12 RDA 2.4 µg/d; biotin AI 30 µg/d; 维生素 K AI 男性 120 micrograms/day, 女性 90 micrograms/day, 未设 UL; 维生素 D RDA 1 至 70 岁 600 IU (15 micrograms)/day, 70 岁以上 800 IU/day, UL 4,000 IU/day; 烟酸 RDA 男性 16 mg NE/day, 女性 14 mg NE/day, 补充形式 UL 35 mg/day; zinc 男 11 mg/day, 女 8 mg/day; magnesium 男 400 到 420 mg/day, 女 310 到 320 mg/day; copper RDA 900 µg/d, UL 10 mg/d。

Still matters when仍有意义的情形Where a named component has a documented shortfall or a defined loss: preconception and pregnancy (folic acid 400 micrograms/day), vegan diets and absorptive failure (B12), low UVB exposure (vitamin D), malabsorption, bariatric surgery, dialysis, restrictive diets and refeeding. Above requirement the direction reverses for several components, since zinc over 40 mg a day induces copper deficiency, selenium over 400 micrograms a day is toxic, iron is harmful in men who are not iron deficient, and preformed vitamin A carries teratogenic risk in pregnancy.某个具体成分存在有记录的不足或明确损失时: 孕前和妊娠期 (叶酸 400 micrograms/day), 纯素饮食和吸收失效 (B12), UVB 暴露不足 (维生素 D), 吸收不良, 减重手术, 透析, 限制性饮食和再喂养。超过需求后, 若干成分的方向反转: zinc 每天超过 40 mg 会诱发 copper 缺乏, selenium 每天超过 400 micrograms 有毒, 本不缺铁的男性补铁有害, 预成型维生素 A 在妊娠期有致畸风险。

Synthesis source合成来源Assembled under this dataset's rule that mixed commercial products whose contents are not a defined substance sit off the axis, from the recovered entries Classification rules for this dataset (definitions row, not a supplement), Mineral and element supplements (magnesium, zinc, iron, selenium, iodine, calcium, potassium and others), Zinc, magnesium and other mineral elements, Other mineral elements sold as supplements, BCAAs sold separately, and B12, folate, thiamine, riboflavin, B6, biotin, pantothenate and vitamin E, Nutrients made by colonic bacteria, Vitamin D3 (cholecalciferol), Vitamin K2 (menaquinone / MK-4, MK-7), Vitamin C (ascorbate), Niacin (vitamin B3, niacin equivalents) and Cod liver oil.

SSBBFFDDBBXXCollagen peptides胶原蛋白肽
Verdict结论Skip it不必买
Evidence证据Grade BB 级
Dose tested已验证剂量2.5-10 g/d of hydrolysed collagen for skin trials. UC-II is a different molecule dosed at about 40 mg/d and is not interchangeable.皮肤类试验用水解胶原 2.5 至 10 克/天。UC-II 是另一种分子，剂量约 40 毫克/天，两者不可互换。
Who适用人群Nobody, on the best available analysis.按目前最好的分析，没有适用人群。
Pros优点
  • There is a weak, moderate-certainty signal for knee osteoarthritis pain: SMD -0.58 (-0.98 to -0.18) across 4 trials and 507 patients. All included trials had high risk of bias.在膝骨关节炎疼痛上有一个弱的、中等确定性的信号：4 项试验、507 名患者，SMD -0.58（-0.98 至 -0.18）。所有纳入试验偏倚风险都高。
  • Safety is benign. The problem with collagen is efficacy, not harm.安全性良好。胶原的问题在于有效性，不在于危害。
Cons缺点
  • This is the cleanest documented case of funding bias in the supplement literature. Myung and Park pooled 23 trials and 1,474 participants. Headline: collagen improved skin hydration, elasticity and wrinkles. Subgroup analysis: studies WITHOUT pharmaceutical-company funding showed no effect on any of the three, and high-quality studies showed no effect. The effect exists only in industry-funded, lower-quality trials.这是补充剂文献中资助偏倚被记录得最干净的案例。Myung 与 Park 汇总 23 项试验、1474 名受试者。头条结论：胶原改善皮肤含水量、弹性和皱纹。亚组分析：没有药企资助的研究，这三项全都没有效应；高质量研究同样没有效应。效应只存在于行业资助的低质量试验里。
  • Collagen is a poor-quality protein. It lacks tryptophan and is a poor source of essential amino acids, so it displaces better protein in the diet.胶原是低质量蛋白。它不含色氨酸，必需氨基酸来源也差，因此会挤占饮食中更好的蛋白。
  • Marine collagen in fish allergy; bovine sourcing matters for religious dietary restriction and BSE-region concerns.鱼类过敏者注意海洋胶原；牛源对宗教饮食限制和疯牛病疫区来源问题也很要紧。
What it does, and what happens without it它有什么作用，缺了会怎样

Hydrolysed animal collagen eaten as protein; the body builds its own collagen from ordinary amino acids.作为蛋白质摄入的水解动物胶原蛋白,而人体自身的胶原蛋白是由普通氨基酸构建的。

No deficiency state exists不存在缺乏状态

In detail详细Collagen is the most abundant protein in the body, roughly a third of total body protein, forming the tensile framework of skin, tendon, ligament, bone matrix, cartilage and vessel wall. The body synthesises it from ordinary amino acids as a repeating Gly-X-Y sequence rich in proline; the post-translational hydroxylation that stabilises the triple helix is carried out by prolyl and lysyl hydroxylases, which require vitamin C, iron and 2-oxoglutarate. Ingested collagen is digested like any other protein, though some di- and tripeptides such as prolyl-hydroxyproline do reach the bloodstream intact, which is the proposed mechanism for any effect beyond amino acid supply. As a protein source collagen is nutritionally incomplete: it contains no tryptophan and is low in several other indispensable amino acids.胶原蛋白是人体中含量最丰富的蛋白质,约占全身蛋白质总量的三分之一,构成皮肤、肌腱、韧带、骨基质、软骨和血管壁的抗张骨架。人体由普通氨基酸合成胶原蛋白,形成富含脯氨酸的重复Gly-X-Y序列,稳定三螺旋结构的翻译后羟基化由prolyl and lysyl hydroxylases完成,该过程需要维生素C、铁和2-氧戊二酸。摄入的胶原蛋白像其他蛋白质一样被消化,不过部分二肽和三肽,如脯氨酰羟脯氨酸,确实能完整进入血液,这被提出作为超出单纯氨基酸供给之外任何效应的机制。作为蛋白质来源,胶原蛋白在营养上并不完整:它不含色氨酸,其他几种必需氨基酸含量也偏低。

There is no deficiency state for this. It is not an essential nutrient, so being short of it is not a thing that can happen.它不存在缺乏状态。它不是必需营养素，所以“缺了它”这件事本身并不成立。

Source来源PMID 20093739 (Melendez-Hevia E et al. J Biosci. 2009;34:853-72); NCBI Bookshelf NBK507709 (Biochemistry, Collagen Synthesis, StatPearls)

Food and the body食物与身体
In food: Rich食物中：丰富 Dose from food: Reachable靠吃达到剂量：可达到 Body makes it: Body makes it身体自产：身体自产 Food data: High食物数据：高

RICH was challenged and upheld, and this is the one entry whose trial dose is genuinely reachable by eating, because the supplement is simply hydrolysed collagen and several ordinary foods are almost pure collagen. Gelatine is thermally hydrolysed collagen at 85.6 g protein per 100 g with tryptophan recorded as 0.000 g. Plain pork crackling is 61.3 g protein per 100 g with an unmistakable collagen amino-acid signature (glycine 11.9 g, proline 7.3 g per 100 g). Trial doses are 2.5 to 15 g/day over 3 to 18 months (Paul, Leser & Oesser 2019, confirmed). Chicken skin, beef tendon, chicken feet and tinned fish eaten with skin and soft bones all add collagen; chicken feet and cartilage now have published GAG and collagen assays, but none of those sources yields a per-100 g collagen figure I can quote here, so they are named without numbers. Bone broth is the popular food answer and the unreliable one.RICH（丰富）曾被质疑，经复核维持。这是唯一一条试验剂量真能靠吃达到的条目，因为这种补剂就是水解胶原蛋白，而好几种普通食物几乎是纯胶原。明胶是热水解的胶原蛋白，每 100 g 含 85.6 g 蛋白，色氨酸记录为 0.000 g。原味猪皮脆（pork crackling）每 100 g 含 61.3 g 蛋白，氨基酸特征明确指向胶原（每 100 g 甘氨酸 11.9 g、脯氨酸 7.3 g）。试验剂量为 2.5 到 15 g/天，持续 3 到 18 个月（Paul, Leser & Oesser 2019，已确认）。鸡皮、牛筋、鸡爪，以及连皮带软骨一起吃的鱼罐头都能增加胶原摄入；鸡爪和软骨现在有已发表的 GAG 和胶原测定，但这些来源都没有可在此引用的每 100 g 胶原数值，所以只列名不给数字。骨汤是流行的食物答案，也是最不可靠的那个。

Scale it to whatever ratio you actually use

To match the dose要达到该剂量There is essentially no gap. One 7 g sachet of ordinary supermarket gelatine delivers about 6.0 g of collagen protein, which is 60 per cent of a 10 g dose and 240 per cent of the 2.5 g low-end trial dose; two sachets sit squarely inside the 2.5 to 15 g/day range used in the research. A 28 g bag of plain pork crackling delivers about 15 g of collagen-type protein, matching the top-end trial dose at a fraction of the price of branded peptides. Bone broth is the one route that fails: amino acid content of broths made to a standardised recipe was significantly lower than a 20 g reference collagen dose for hydroxyproline, glycine and proline, and non-standardised preparations varied enormously, with commercially available broths lower than self-prepared ones (Alcock, Shaw & Burke 2019). If you want a defined collagen dose from food, weigh out gelatine rather than simmering bones.基本没有差距。一小袋 7 g 的普通超市明胶提供约 6.0 g 胶原蛋白，是 10 g 剂量的 60%，是 2.5 g 低端试验剂量的 240%；两袋就稳稳落在研究所用的 2.5 到 15 g/天 区间内。一袋 28 g 的原味猪皮脆提供约 15 g 胶原类蛋白，达到试验剂量上限，价格只是品牌肽的一小部分。骨汤是唯一失败的路线：按标准化配方制作的骨汤，其羟脯氨酸、甘氨酸和脯氨酸含量显著低于 20 g 的参比胶原剂量，非标准化做法之间差异极大，市售骨汤低于自制骨汤（Alcock, Shaw & Burke 2019）。想从食物里得到确定的胶原剂量，称明胶比熬骨头可靠。

Food vs supplement食物与补充剂Moderate, and worth stating precisely. Collagen contains no tryptophan at all (USDA records gelatine tryptophan as 0.000 g/100 g) and is low in cysteine, methionine and histidine, so it is an incomplete protein with a PDCAAS effectively at zero and must not be counted as general protein intake; modelling suggests up to about 36 per cent of total daily protein can be collagen before indispensable amino acid balance suffers (Paul et al. 2019, PMID 31096622, confirmed). Hydrolysis is a real difference: collagen peptides are enzymatically cut to 2-5 kDa fragments that dissolve in cold liquid and are absorbed partly as di- and tripeptides, whereas gelatine gels and must be dissolved hot, and native collagen in skin and tendon must first be cooked and digested. On the food side, pork crackling brings a large load of saturated fat and salt with its collagen, which a sachet of gelatine does not, so swapping crackling for collagen powder is a trade-off rather than a free win.中等，值得说准确。胶原完全不含色氨酸（USDA 记录明胶色氨酸为 0.000 g/100 g），半胱氨酸、甲硫氨酸和组氨酸也低，所以它是一种不完全蛋白，PDCAAS 实际上为零，绝不能计入一般蛋白质摄入；建模提示每日总蛋白中最多约 36% 可以是胶原，再高必需氨基酸平衡就会受影响（Paul 等 2019, PMID 31096622，已确认）。水解是真实的差别：胶原蛋白肽经酶切成 2-5 kDa 片段，可溶于冷液体，部分以二肽和三肽形式吸收；明胶会凝胶，必须热溶；皮和筋里的天然胶原则要先煮熟再消化。食物一侧，猪皮脆连同胶原带来大量饱和脂肪和盐，一袋明胶不会，所以用猪皮脆换胶原粉是一种取舍。

Absorption吸收Genuinely different by form, and here the supplement has a defensible argument. Hydrolysed collagen peptides are absorbed rapidly and hydroxyproline-containing dipeptides such as prolyl-hydroxyproline appear intact in plasma, which is the mechanistic basis of the collagen-peptide literature; plasma amino acid comparisons of dairy against collagen protein confirm the distinctive glycine, proline and hydroxyproline signature of collagen ingestion. Gelatine, already partly hydrolysed, behaves similarly, and a 7 g sachet delivers 6.0 g of that same protein. Native collagen in skin, tendon and bone requires prolonged moist cooking to become digestible at all, which is exactly why bone broth quantities are unpredictable and why standardised broths fell significantly short of a 20 g reference collagen dose. Vitamin C is required for the hydroxylation step in endogenous collagen synthesis, so collagen intake without adequate vitamin C is pointless, and eating hydroxyproline does not bypass that requirement.确实因形式而异，这里补剂有站得住的论点。水解胶原蛋白肽吸收快，含羟脯氨酸的二肽如脯氨酰-羟脯氨酸能以完整形式出现在血浆中，这是胶原肽文献的机制基础；把乳蛋白与胶原蛋白作血浆氨基酸对比，也确认了摄入胶原后甘氨酸、脯氨酸和羟脯氨酸的特征性升高。明胶本身已部分水解，表现类似，一小袋 7 g 就提供 6.0 g 同样的蛋白。皮、筋和骨中的天然胶原需要长时间湿热烹煮才谈得上可消化，这正是骨汤的量不可预测的原因，也是标准化骨汤显著低于 20 g 参比胶原剂量的原因。内源胶原合成的羟化步骤需要维生素 C，所以维生素 C 不足时补胶原没有意义，吃下羟脯氨酸也绕不过这个要求。

Food data note食物数据说明Both principal food rows are USDA SR Legacy entries that were checked against the source to the decimal for protein, glycine, proline and tryptophan, and the 7 g sachet and 28 g bag arithmetic recomputes correctly. The trial dose range (2.5-15 g/day over 3-18 months) and the 36 per cent protein-substitution ceiling were both confirmed in Paul et al. 2019, and the Alcock bone broth citation and its 20 g reference dose were confirmed. The one derived row (aspic) is labelled as derived高。两条主要食物条目都是 USDA SR Legacy 记录，蛋白、甘氨酸、脯氨酸和色氨酸均逐位小数对照来源核对，7 g 小袋和 28 g 袋装的算术也重算无误。试验剂量区间（2.5-15 g/天，持续 3-18 个月）和 36% 的蛋白替代上限都在 Paul 等 2019 中得到确认，Alcock 的骨汤引用及其 20 g 参比剂量也已确认。唯一一条推导条目（肉冻）已标注为推导所得。

Does the body make it身体是否自产The roll-up is FULL: you build every collagen fibril in your body yourself, from glycine, proline and lysine, with vitamin C and copper as cofactors, and there is no dietary requirement for collagen as a molecule. Nothing you swallow is installed intact, since ingested collagen is digested to amino acids and short peptides before absorption, which makes oral collagen a weak premise as replacement therapy for a molecule you are not short of. The exception sits on the precursor side and carries a contested CONDITIONAL label: if the Melendez-Hevia calculation of a roughly 10 g/day glycine shortfall holds, precursor supply is conditional, and demand for glycine and proline rises in burns, major surgery and wound healing, the same structure that makes glutamine conditional. Two defensible mechanisms remain, supplying amino acids, where plain gelatine or glycine is cheaper, and signalling by absorbed Pro-Hyp and other hydroxyproline-containing dipeptides, which are measurable in plasma after a dose.汇总为 FULL: 体内每一根胶原纤维都由你自己用 glycine, proline 和 lysine 造出, vitamin C 和 copper 作辅因子, 作为分子的 collagen 没有膳食需求。吞下去的东西不会原样装上, 摄入的胶原在吸收前已被消化为氨基酸和短肽, 把口服胶原当作补充一种你并不缺的分子, 这个前提很弱。例外在前体一侧, 情况确实未定, 标签为有争议的 CONDITIONAL: 如果 Melendez-Hevia 关于每天约 10 g glycine 缺口的计算成立, 前体供应就属条件性, 而烧伤, 大手术和创伤愈合中 glycine 与 proline 需求上升, 结构与 glutamine 被列为条件性的情形相同。站得住的机制有两个, 一是提供氨基酸, 而普通明胶或 glycine 更便宜, 二是吸收的 Pro-Hyp 及其他含羟脯氨酸二肽对成纤维细胞的信号作用, 这类二肽在摄入后确实能在血浆中测到。

Pathway合成通路Fibroblasts, chondrocytes and osteoblasts assemble procollagen alpha chains at the rough ER from glycine (from serine via SHMT, which supplies more than 85 percent of glycine production), proline (from glutamate or ornithine) and lysine. Prolyl-4-hydroxylase (P4HA1-3), prolyl-3-hydroxylase (P3H1) and the lysyl hydroxylases (PLOD1-3) all require Fe2+, ascorbate and 2-oxoglutarate, and are followed by glycosylation, triple-helix assembly, secretion, propeptide cleavage and copper-dependent lysyl oxidase cross-linking. Ingested collagen is digested to amino acids and di- and tripeptides such as prolyl-hydroxyproline.成纤维细胞, 软骨细胞和成骨细胞在粗面内质网上用 glycine (由 serine 经 SHMT 提供, 占 glycine 生成量的 85% 以上), proline (来自 glutamate 或 ornithine) 和 lysine 组装前胶原 alpha 链。prolyl-4-hydroxylase (P4HA1-3), prolyl-3-hydroxylase (P3H1) 和 lysyl hydroxylase (PLOD1-3) 都需要 Fe2+, 抗坏血酸和 2-氧化戊二酸; 之后进行糖基化, 三螺旋组装, 分泌, 前肽切除, 以及依赖 copper 的 lysyl oxidase 交联。摄入的胶原被消化为氨基酸和二肽三肽, 例如 prolyl-hydroxyproline。

Amount made自产量NOT ESTABLISHED for whole-body collagen synthesis in g/day; collagen is roughly a quarter to a third of total body protein and skin and bone turnover proceed continuously. The nearest quantified constraint concerns a precursor: Melendez-Hevia and colleagues calculate that synthesis supplies about 3 g/day of glycine in a 70 kg adult and a typical diet 1.5 to 3.0 g/day, against a total demand including collagen synthesis that leaves the roughly 10 g/day shortfall their paper reports.全身胶原合成的 g/day 数值 NOT ESTABLISHED (尚无确证数据), 胶原约占全身蛋白的四分之一到三分之一, 皮肤和骨的周转持续进行。最接近的定量约束在前体一侧: Melendez-Hevia 等人计算, 70 kg 成人每天由合成提供约 3 g glycine, 典型饮食提供 1.5 到 3.0 g/day, 与包括胶原合成在内的总需求相比, 该文给出约 10 g/day 的缺口。

Still matters when仍有意义的情形Vitamin C deficiency, where hydroxylation genuinely fails (scurvy, and humans depend on dietary ascorbate because GULO is a pseudogene); copper deficiency, where lysyl oxidase cross-linking fails; low total protein or a glycine-poor diet; wound healing, burns and major surgery, when demand for glycine and proline rises; and possibly as a cheap glycine and proline source if the Melendez-Hevia shortfall holds. What the axis rules out is the marketing premise that you are short of collagen itself. If a collagen peptide product is used, judge it on the specific hydrolysate and dose the trials used (2.5 to 10 g/day for skin and joint endpoints) and on how independent those trials were.vitamin C 缺乏, 此时羟化确实失败 (坏血病, 而人类依赖膳食抗坏血酸是因为 GULO 是假基因); copper 缺乏, 此时 lysyl oxidase 交联失败; 总蛋白摄入低或 glycine 贫乏的饮食; 创伤愈合, 烧伤和大手术, 此时 glycine 和 proline 需求上升; 如果 Melendez-Hevia 的缺口成立, 它也可能作为便宜的 glycine 和 proline 来源。这条轴否掉的是营销前提, 即你缺胶原本身。若使用胶原肽产品, 应按试验用过的具体水解物和剂量判断 (皮肤和关节终点常用 2.5 到 10 g/day), 并看这些试验的独立性。

SSBBFFDDBBXXGlucosamine and chondroitin氨基葡萄糖与软骨素
Verdict结论Skip it不必买
Evidence证据Grade BB 级
Dose tested已验证剂量Glucosamine 1,500 mg/d plus chondroitin 1,200 mg/d, the GAIT regimen. Form matters and is routinely ignored.氨基葡萄糖 1500 毫克/天加软骨素 1200 毫克/天，即 GAIT 方案。盐型很重要，却常被忽略。
Who适用人群At most, people with moderate to severe knee osteoarthritis pain, on subgroup data only.最多只适用于中重度膝骨关节炎疼痛者，且仅依据亚组数据。
Pros优点
  • In the GAIT moderate-to-severe pain stratum the combination beat placebo, 79.2% versus 54.3% response (P=0.002). This was pre-specified but underpowered, and the authors themselves cautioned against over-reading it.在 GAIT 的中重度疼痛分层中，联用优于安慰剂，应答率 79.2% 对 54.3%（P=0.002）。该分层是预先设定的，但把握度不足，作者本人也提醒不要过度解读。
  • Cochrane found a short-term chondroitin benefit: 10% absolute pain improvement, NNT 5, at low to moderate quality.Cochrane 发现软骨素有短期获益：疼痛绝对改善 10%，NNT 5，质量为低至中等。
  • As safe as placebo in the trials.在试验中安全性与安慰剂相当。
Cons缺点
  • The definitive trial was null. GAIT was NIH-funded, n=1,583, 24 weeks, with a celecoxib active control, designed specifically to remove industry influence. Glucosamine +3.9 percentage points over placebo (P=0.30), chondroitin +5.3 (P=0.17), combination +6.5 (P=0.09). Celecoxib worked; the supplements did not.决定性试验是阴性的。GAIT 由 NIH 资助，n=1583，24 周，设塞来昔布阳性对照，专为排除行业影响而设计。氨基葡萄糖比安慰剂高 3.9 个百分点（P=0.30），软骨素高 5.3（P=0.17），联用高 6.5（P=0.09）。塞来昔布有效，补充剂无效。
  • Cochrane found glucosamine benefit ONLY for the Rotta-brand crystalline glucosamine sulfate preparation. Pooled non-Rotta preparations failed to show any pain benefit. Almost nothing sold in shops is the Rotta preparation.Cochrane 发现氨基葡萄糖的获益只出现在 Rotta 品牌的结晶型硫酸氨基葡萄糖制剂上。非 Rotta 制剂合并后在疼痛上没有任何获益。而商店里卖的几乎都不是 Rotta 制剂。
  • The industry sells cartilage regeneration. No trial has shown cartilage regeneration.行业卖的是“软骨再生”。没有任何试验显示过软骨再生。
  • This is the best-documented supplement-anticoagulant interaction in this document: 20 FDA MedWatch reports linking glucosamine plus chondroitin to raised INR, bruising and bleeding on warfarin, plus 21 WHO database reports of raised INR.这是本文中记录最充分的补充剂与抗凝药相互作用：FDA MedWatch 有 20 份报告将氨基葡萄糖加软骨素与华法林使用者的 INR 升高、瘀伤和出血联系起来，WHO 数据库另有 21 份 INR 升高报告。
  • Shellfish-derived glucosamine matters in shellfish allergy.甲壳类来源的氨基葡萄糖对甲壳类过敏者很要紧。
What it does, and what happens without it它有什么作用，缺了会怎样

Cartilage building blocks your own cells make from glucose, so eating them is not required.软骨的组成原料,人体细胞自行由葡萄糖合成,因此并非必须通过饮食摄入。

No deficiency state exists不存在缺乏状态

In detail详细Glucosamine is an amino sugar produced in every cell from fructose-6-phosphate by glutamine-fructose-6-phosphate amidotransferase, the entry step of the hexosamine biosynthetic pathway that supplies UDP-N-acetylglucosamine for glycosaminoglycans, proteoglycans and O-GlcNAc signalling. Chondroitin sulfate is a sulfated glycosaminoglycan chain assembled on proteoglycan core proteins in the Golgi. Both are made on demand from glucose and glutamine, so neither is a required dietary component and neither has a recommended intake. Orally administered chondroitin is a large polysaccharide with low and variable absorption, and oral glucosamine does not raise synovial fluid concentrations anywhere near those used in cartilage cell experiments. The real question is efficacy rather than nutritional need: the NIH GAIT trial found no significant benefit over placebo for knee osteoarthritis pain in the overall study population.氨基葡萄糖是一种氨基糖,由每个细胞内的谷氨酰胺果糖-6-磷酸酰胺转移酶从果糖-6-磷酸生成,这是己糖胺生物合成途径的起始步骤,该途径为糖胺聚糖、蛋白聚糖和O-GlcNAc信号传导提供UDP-N-乙酰氨基葡萄糖。硫酸软骨素是在高尔基体中于蛋白聚糖核心蛋白上组装而成的一种硫酸化糖胺聚糖链。两者均按需由葡萄糖和谷氨酰胺合成,因此都不是必需的膳食成分,也没有推荐摄入量。口服的硫酸软骨素是一种大分子多糖,吸收率低且变异大;口服氨基葡萄糖也无法使滑液浓度达到接近软骨细胞实验所用浓度的水平。真正的问题在于疗效而非营养需求:NIH的GAIT试验发现,在整体研究人群中,对膝骨关节炎疼痛并无显著优于安慰剂的效果。

There is no deficiency state for this. It is not an essential nutrient, so being short of it is not a thing that can happen.它不存在缺乏状态。它不是必需营养素，所以“缺了它”这件事本身并不成立。

Source来源PMID 16495392 (Clegg et al., Glucosamine, chondroitin sulfate, and the two in combination for painful knee osteoarthritis, N Engl J Med 2006)

Food and the body食物与身体
In food: Mixed食物中：视形式 Dose from food: Partly靠吃达到剂量：部分 Body makes it: Body makes it身体自产：身体自产 Food data: Low食物数据：低

The two compounds have different answers and must not share one label. Glucosamine is SYNTHETIC: no ordinary food contains free glucosamine, and glucosamine hydrochloride is manufactured by hydrolysing chitin from crustacean shell or Aspergillus niger fermentation biomass with food-grade concentrated hydrochloric acid at 100 C, then filtering, crystallising, washing and flash-drying. Shell and fungal mycelium are neither digestible nor eaten, so the feedstock is not a food route. Chondroitin is a different case, and the submission's SYNTHETIC label was wrong for it by its own admission that chondroitin sulfate is extracted from cartilage. Chondroitin sulfate in edible chicken keel cartilage has been quantified at 189 +/- 33 mg per gram of cartilage, and GAG content has been quantified in chicken feet and in traditionally stewed pig trotters. Chicken cartilage (yakitori nankotsu), chicken feet, pig trotters and shark fin are ordinary foods in Chinese, Japanese and Korean cuisine, so for chondroitin the honest answer is rich in a small set of real but culturally specific foods.两种化合物答案不同，不能共用一个标签。氨基葡萄糖属于 SYNTHETIC（合成）：没有普通食物含有游离氨基葡萄糖，盐酸氨基葡萄糖的做法是用食品级浓盐酸在 100 C 下水解甲壳类外壳或黑曲霉（Aspergillus niger）发酵菌体中的甲壳素，再过滤、结晶、洗涤、闪蒸干燥。外壳和真菌菌丝既不可消化也没人吃，所以这种原料不构成食物途径。软骨素是另一种情况，原提交稿给它贴 SYNTHETIC 的标签是错的，它自己也承认硫酸软骨素是从软骨中提取的。可食用鸡龙骨软骨中的硫酸软骨素已被定量为每克软骨 189 ± 33 mg，鸡爪和传统炖制猪蹄的 GAG 含量也已定量。鸡软骨（日式烤串 nankotsu）、鸡爪、猪蹄和鱼翅在中式、日式和韩式饮食中都是普通食物，所以对软骨素而言，诚实的答案是它在一小类真实但带有文化特定性的食物中含量丰富。

Chicken keel / soft cartilage (yakitori nankotsu) - CHONDROITIN only鸡龙骨/软骨（日式烤串 nankotsu），仅软骨素 15.6-22.2 g chondroitin sulfate (189 +/- 33 mg per gram of cartilage) 2 yakitori nankotsu skewers (about 30 g cartilage)2 串烤鸡软骨（约 30 g 软骨） 4.7-6.7 g chondroitin sulfate as stated; about 1.4-2.3 g if the source figure is per gram of DRIED cartilage and the portion is fresh 390-555% of a 1,200 mg chondroitin dose as stated; still 117-194% on the more conservative fresh-weight reading. Zero per cent of any glucosamine dose按原文数值为 1,200 mg 软骨素剂量的 390-555%；按更保守的鲜重读法仍有 117-194%。对任何氨基葡萄糖剂量都是 0% Br Poult Sci 2014, chicken keel cartilage chondroitin sulfate extraction (189 +/- 33 mg CS per g cartilage), cited via the verification review rather than read directly. To match the dose要达到该剂量Split by compound. Chondroitin: a 1,200 mg daily dose corresponds to roughly 5.4 to 7.7 g of chicken keel cartilage at 189 +/- 33 mg/g, about 6 g at the central value, so two yakitori nankotsu skewers already exceed it several times over. Even if that figure turns out to be per gram of dried cartilage, a 30 g fresh portion would still carry roughly 1.4 to 2.3 g, which is 117 to 194 per cent of the dose, so the conclusion holds on either moisture basis. Glucosamine: there is no food quantity at all, and the informative comparison is endogenous. Human endogenous glucosamine production is 4 to 20 g/day with a median around 14 g/day, so the standard GAIT-trial 1,500 mg adds about 10.7 per cent on top of the median, or 7.5 to 37.5 per cent across the range. Prawn and crab shells are the industrial feedstock but shell is indigestible and not eaten, so eating prawns delivers no useful glucosamine.按化合物分开说。软骨素：按每克 189 ± 33 mg 计，1,200 mg 的每日剂量相当于大约 5.4 到 7.7 g 鸡龙骨软骨，取中心值约 6 g，所以两串烤鸡软骨已经数倍于该剂量。即便这个数值实际是每克干软骨，30 g 鲜重的一份仍会含大约 1.4 到 2.3 g，也就是剂量的 117 到 194 个百分点，所以无论按哪种水分基准，结论都成立。氨基葡萄糖：食物层面根本没有量，有参考价值的比较是内源合成。人体内源氨基葡萄糖生成量为 4 到 20 g/天，中位数约 14 g/天，所以 GAIT 试验标准的 1,500 mg 只在中位数之上增加约 10.7%，按全区间算是 7.5 到 37.5%。虾壳和蟹壳是工业原料，但壳不可消化也没人吃，所以吃虾并不提供有用的氨基葡萄糖。

Food vs supplement食物与补充剂Several that matter, and they differ by compound. Chemical form is not interchangeable in the trial literature: the European positive trials used a specific patented crystalline glucosamine SULFATE while the large NIH GAIT trial used glucosamine HYDROCHLORIDE, and the results differ, so a shelf product labelled simply 'glucosamine' is not evidence-matched to any particular result. Vegetarian or shellfish-free glucosamine from Aspergillus niger fermentation is the same manufactured molecule from a different feedstock, not a food-derived alternative; EFSA's opinion on the fungal route states that the process is the same as the shellfish process except for the raw material. Shellfish-derived glucosamine is a purified sugar rather than shellfish protein, so it is not the classic tropomyosin allergen route, though labels warn and cautious avoidance is reasonable. Chondroitin product content notoriously deviates from label claim because it is an extracted polydisperse polysaccharide from a bovine or shark by-product, which raises quality-control and sourcing questions. On the food side, cartilage-containing dishes carry chondroitin in a cooked matrix at a concentration that varies with cut and preparation, so a nankotsu skewer is a real chondroitin source rather than a measured dose.有几点重要，而且因化合物而异。化学形式在试验文献中不可互换：欧洲的阳性试验用的是一种特定的专利结晶硫酸氨基葡萄糖，美国 NIH 的大型 GAIT 试验用的是盐酸氨基葡萄糖，结果不同，所以货架上只标“氨基葡萄糖”的产品与任何一项特定结果的证据并不对应。来自黑曲霉发酵的素食或无贝类氨基葡萄糖，是同一个人工制造的分子换了原料，构不成来自食物的替代品；EFSA 关于真菌路线的意见指出，除原料不同外工艺与贝类路线相同。来自贝类的氨基葡萄糖是提纯的糖类（而非贝类蛋白），因此不走经典的原肌球蛋白过敏原路径，不过标签仍会警示，谨慎回避也说得过去。软骨素产品的实际含量常与标签声称不符，因为它是从牛或鲨鱼副产品中提取的多分散多糖，这带来质量控制和来源方面的问题。食物一侧，含软骨的菜品把软骨素放在熟制基质中，浓度随部位和做法变化，所以一串鸡软骨算是真实的软骨素来源，谈不上一个测定过的剂量。

Absorption吸收Poor and first-pass-limited for glucosamine: oral glucosamine is largely metabolised on first pass and plasma concentrations reach only low micromolar, far below the millimolar concentrations at which glucosamine affects chondrocytes in cell culture, which is the central pharmacological criticism of the category. Absorbed glucosamine enters cells through glucose transporters, a process facilitated by insulin, and is phosphorylated to glucosamine-6-phosphate, the same intermediate the body already makes at 4 to 20 g/day (median about 14 g/day, EFSA ANS Panel 2013 opinion on (6S)-5-methyltetrahydrofolic acid, glucosamine salt; the frequently quoted 230 mg/kg body weight per day is a back-calculation from that median for a 60 kg adult, 14,000/60 = 233, not an EFSA-quoted value). Chondroitin sulfate is a large sulfated polysaccharide of tens of kDa and is absorbed mainly after depolymerisation into smaller fragments and constituent sugars, so what reaches the circulation is not the intact molecule from the capsule. Food-borne chondroitin faces the same depolymerisation step plus the need to liberate the glycosaminoglycan from a cooked cartilage matrix, so a cartilage portion that exceeds the dose on paper is not equivalent to a measured dose in effect.氨基葡萄糖吸收差且受首过效应限制：口服氨基葡萄糖大部分在首过代谢中被处理掉，血药浓度只到低微摩尔级，远低于细胞培养中影响软骨细胞所需的毫摩尔浓度，这是对该类补剂的核心药理学批评。被吸收的氨基葡萄糖通过葡萄糖转运体进入细胞，胰岛素可促进这一过程，随后磷酸化为氨基葡萄糖-6-磷酸，与人体本来就以 4 到 20 g/天（中位数约 14 g/天）产生的中间体相同（EFSA ANS Panel 2013 关于 (6S)-5-甲基四氢叶酸氨基葡萄糖盐的意见；常被引用的每千克体重每天 230 mg 是按该中位数为 60 kg 成人反推的结果，14,000/60 = 233，并非 EFSA 给出的数值）。硫酸软骨素是几十 kDa 的大分子硫酸化多糖，主要在解聚为较小片段和组成糖之后才被吸收，所以进入循环的并非胶囊中的完整分子。食物中的软骨素同样要经过这一解聚步骤，还要先把糖胺聚糖从熟制的软骨基质中释放出来，所以纸面上超过剂量的一份软骨，在效果上不等于一个测定过的剂量。

Food data note食物数据说明The single numeric food row rests on one 2014 poultry-science paper reached through the verification review rather than read directly, and its moisture basis is unstated, which is why the per-portion figure is given on two readings. The chicken feet and pig trotter assays exist but are expressed per gram of total collagen and cannot be converted to a portion. Glucosamine has no food data at all, by nature rather than by omission. The endogenous 4-20 g/day figure is quoted verbatim in the literature but its primary EFSA opinion could not be opened this session低。唯一一条带数字的食物条目依赖 2014 年一篇家禽科学论文，且是通过核查综述转引而非直接阅读，其水分基准未说明，这也是每份数值给出两种读法的原因。鸡爪和猪蹄的测定确实存在，但以每克总胶原的量表示，无法换算成每份。氨基葡萄糖根本没有食物数据，这由其性质决定，与遗漏无关。内源 4-20 g/天 的数值在文献中被逐字引用，但本次会话无法打开其原始 EFSA 意见。

Does the body make it身体是否自产Cartilage manufactures both of these on site from glucose and glutamine: glucosamine-6-phosphate comes off the hexosamine branch of glycolysis, and chondroitin sulfate chains are polymerised and sulfated inside the chondrocyte Golgi, so chondroitin sulfate is FULL in the ordinary sense and glucosamine is FULL by substrate sufficiency. The glucosamine label needs one qualification, since what the pathway makes is glucosamine-6-phosphate committed to UDP-GlcNAc and the free glucosamine measurable in fasting plasma is spillover plus lysosomal salvage, so nobody has established what an adequate quantity of free glucosamine would be; the sufficient and correct version is that the chondrocyte is never short of substrate. Neither is a nutrient, neither has a deficiency state, and absorbed material joins the whole-body amino sugar pool instead of being directed to a particular knee, which makes this the clearest case on the axis of a premise that fails at the substrate step.软骨在原位用葡萄糖和 glutamine 制造这两种分子: glucosamine-6-phosphate 来自糖酵解的己糖胺分支, chondroitin sulfate 链在软骨细胞高尔基体内聚合并硫酸化, 所以 chondroitin sulfate 在通常意义上是 FULL, glucosamine 则按底物充足判为 FULL。glucosamine 这一侧要加一句限定: 通路产生的是定向进入 UDP-GlcNAc 的 glucosamine-6-phosphate, 空腹血浆中可测到的游离 glucosamine 属溢出加溶酶体回收, 没人确定过游离 glucosamine 的充足量是多少, 充分且正确的说法是软骨细胞从不缺底物。两者都不是营养素, 不存在缺乏状态, 吸收进来的物质并入全身氨基糖池, 不会被定向送到某个膝关节, 这是整条轴上前提失效最清楚的一例, 失效点在底物一侧。

Pathway合成通路Glucosamine: fructose-6-phosphate plus glutamine gives glucosamine-6-phosphate via GFAT (GFPT1/2), the rate-limiting step of the hexosamine biosynthetic pathway, then N-acetylation and UTP addition to UDP-GlcNAc; a second, GFAT-independent source is lysosomal salvage, where NAGK phosphorylates recovered GlcNAc straight back into the pathway. Chondroitin: UDP-glucose is oxidised by UGDH to UDP-glucuronate, and chondroitin sulfate chains are polymerised and sulfated inside the chondrocyte Golgi.glucosamine: fructose-6-phosphate 加 glutamine 经 GFAT (GFPT1/2) 生成 glucosamine-6-phosphate, 这是己糖胺生物合成通路的限速步骤, 随后 N 乙酰化并加 UTP 生成 UDP-GlcNAc; 另一条不依赖 GFAT 的来源是溶酶体回收, NAGK 把回收的 GlcNAc 磷酸化后直接送回通路。chondroitin: UDP-glucose 由 UGDH 氧化为 UDP-glucuronate, chondroitin sulfate 链在软骨细胞高尔基体内聚合并硫酸化。

Amount made自产量NOT ESTABLISHED as a g/day synthesis figure for either molecule. Sourced anchors instead: the hexosamine pathway diverts roughly 2 to 5 percent of glucose-derived fructose-6-phosphate to UDP-GlcNAc (PMC12847842), endogenous free glucosamine is present in fasting human plasma (PMID 16168682), whole-body hexosamine flux is on the order of grams per day, and the usual oral dose of 1500 mg/day reaches synovial fluid only at low micromolar levels.两种分子都 NOT ESTABLISHED (尚无确证的 g/day 合成数值)。可用参照: 己糖胺通路把葡萄糖来源的 fructose-6-phosphate 约 2% 到 5% 分流到 UDP-GlcNAc (PMC12847842); 空腹人血浆中存在内源游离 glucosamine (PMID 16168682); 全身己糖胺通量为每天克级; 常用口服剂量 1500 mg/day 在滑液中只达到低微摩尔级浓度。

Still matters when仍有意义的情形Very little on the substrate axis, since any real effect has to be pharmacological rather than nutritional. The largest independent trial (GAIT) found no benefit over placebo across the overall knee osteoarthritis population, with a signal for the glucosamine plus chondroitin combination in its prespecified moderate-to-severe pain subgroup that was exploratory and unconfirmed (PMID 16495392); GAIT used glucosamine hydrochloride while most positive European trials used crystalline glucosamine sulfate, which is the main explanation for the heterogeneity and the reason the two salts cannot be treated as equivalent. What remains defensible is a time-limited personal trial with a defined stopping point in a symptomatic individual, judged on 3 month symptom response, with attention to shellfish sourcing and to blood glucose at high doses.在底物这条轴上几乎没有, 任何真实效应只能是药理性的, 与营养无关。规模最大的独立试验 (GAIT) 在膝骨关节炎总体人群中未发现优于安慰剂的获益, 其预设的中重度疼痛亚组中 glucosamine 加 chondroitin 联合出现了信号, 属探索性且未被验证 (PMID 16495392); GAIT 用的是 glucosamine hydrochloride, 而多数阳性结果的欧洲试验用结晶 glucosamine sulfate, 这是异质性的主要解释, 也是两种盐不能当作等价物的理由。仍说得过去的用法, 是在有症状个体身上做有明确终止点的限期个人试用, 看 3 个月的症状反应, 并注意贝类来源和大剂量时对血糖的影响。

Evidence证据Grade DD 级
Dose tested已验证剂量250-2,000 mg/d in trials, most commonly 250 mg/d for 12 weeks. No dose has improved a clinical outcome.试验剂量 250 至 2000 毫克/天，最常见为 250 毫克/天持续 12 周。没有任何剂量改善过临床结局。
Who适用人群Nobody demonstrably.没有可证实的适用人群。
Pros优点
  • It reliably raises blood NAD+ two to threefold, so the pill is absorbed and metabolised as claimed.它能稳定地把血中 NAD+ 提高 2 至 3 倍，说明药片确如所称被吸收和代谢了。
  • One 60-person trial in older adults with impaired physical function reported maintained walking speed and improved subjective sleep at 250 mg/d for 12 weeks. Single small trial.一项 60 人的试验在身体功能受损的老年人中报告，250 毫克/天持续 12 周可维持步速并改善主观睡眠。单项小试验。
Cons缺点
  • This is the purest biomarker-for-outcome substitution in the supplement market. Raising NAD+ is not a health outcome.这是补充剂市场上最纯粹的“用生物标志物冒充结局”的例子。把 NAD+ 提上去本身不是一个健康结局。
  • Two independent meta-analyses found nothing. Eight randomised trials in 342 people, and separately 12 studies in 513 people: no effect on fasting glucose, fasting insulin, HbA1c, HOMA-IR or any lipid fraction.两项独立 meta 分析什么也没发现。8 项随机试验、342 人，以及另外 12 项研究、513 人：对空腹血糖、空腹胰岛素、糖化血红蛋白、HOMA-IR 及各项血脂均无效应。
  • A systematic review of 10 trials in 437 people found grip strength 29.9 kg before and 30.5 kg after, with skeletal muscle mass index unchanged. Non-significant.一项纳入 10 项试验、437 人的系统综述显示握力从 29.9 公斤到 30.5 公斤，骨骼肌质量指数不变。不显著。
  • No contraindications are characterised because no adequately powered safety population exists. No upper limit has been set and EFSA has not authorised it as a novel food.没有明确的禁忌，因为不存在样本量足够的安全性人群。没有设定上限，EFSA 也未批准其为新型食品。
  • Avoid in pregnancy, lactation and active malignancy. NAD+ is a substrate for tumour metabolism and no oncology safety data exist.妊娠期、哺乳期和活动性恶性肿瘤者应避免。NAD+ 是肿瘤代谢的底物，且没有肿瘤学安全数据。
What it does, and what happens without it它有什么作用，缺了会怎样

A building block cells use to make NAD+, the coenzyme that keeps energy metabolism running.细胞用来合成NAD+的原料之一,NAD+是维持能量代谢运转的辅酶。

No deficiency state exists不存在缺乏状态

In detail详细Nicotinamide mononucleotide is an intermediate in the NAD+ salvage pathway, formed when nicotinamide phosphoribosyltransferase attaches nicotinamide to phosphoribosyl pyrophosphate, then converted to NAD+ by NMN adenylyltransferases. NAD+ is the electron carrier for hundreds of dehydrogenases and the consumed substrate for sirtuins, PARPs and CD38. NMN is thought to be dephosphorylated to nicotinamide riboside before cellular uptake, though the human intestinal route is not established and the proposed direct NMN transporter is contested: Slc12a8-mediated uptake was reported in mouse small intestine (Grozio et al. 2019) and then disputed on methodological grounds (Shats et al. 2020), and no human transporter has been demonstrated in either direction. NMN itself is not an essential nutrient and has no recommended intake. The essential nutrient in this pathway is niacin (vitamin B3), whose deficiency causes pellagra, a real and severe disease that has nothing to do with NMN intake.烟酰胺单核苷酸是NAD+补救合成途径中的中间产物,由烟酰胺磷酸核糖转移酶将烟酰胺连接到磷酸核糖焦磷酸上生成,随后经NMN腺苷酰转移酶转化为NAD+。NAD+是数百种脱氢酶的电子载体,也是sirtuin、PARP和CD38消耗的底物。目前认为NMN在被细胞摄取之前会先脱磷酸化为烟酰胺核糖,不过人体肠道内的具体途径尚未确立,而所提出的直接NMN转运体也存在争议:Slc12a8介导的摄取曾在小鼠小肠中被报道(Grozio等2019年),随后又因方法学问题受到质疑(Shats等2020年),目前尚无论证表明人体存在这种方向上的转运体。NMN本身并非必需营养素,也没有推荐摄入量。这一通路中真正的必需营养素是烟酸(维生素B3),其缺乏会导致糙皮病,这是一种真实存在的严重疾病,与NMN摄入与否无关。

There is no deficiency state for this. It is not an essential nutrient, so being short of it is not a thing that can happen.它不存在缺乏状态。它不是必需营养素，所以“缺了它”这件事本身并不成立。

Source来源PMID 29514064 (Rajman, Chwalek & Sinclair, Cell Metab 2018); Grozio et al., Nat Metab 2019;1:47-57; Shats et al., Nat Metab 2020;2:1200-1203; NIH Office of Dietary Supplements, Niacin Fact Sheet for Health Professionals (pellagra)

Food and the body食物与身体
In food: Trace食物中：痕量 Dose from food: Out of reach靠吃达到剂量：达不到 Body makes it: Body makes it身体自产：身体自产 Food data: Medium食物数据：中

NMN really is present in ordinary plant and animal foods. Mills et al. 2016 Table 1, confirmed row by row against the primary source, puts every food it measured between 0 and 1.88 mg/100 g, and a 2025 HPLC-DAD/LC-MS-MS plant survey spans 40 to 13,000 ug/100 g, richest in broccoli and green beans. The submission's framing of 'sub-milligram-per-100 g levels, roughly 100 to 1,000 times below a single capsule' is withdrawn as self-contradicting: at the 2025 survey ceiling of 13 mg/100 g one 100 g portion sits about 19 times below a 250 mg capsule, and it is not sub-milligram. TRACE still holds against a 250 to 1,000 mg dose. Cow milk is not a meaningful NMN source, since its NAD+ precursor pool is dominated by nicotinamide and nicotinamide riboside (Trammell et al. 2016). Supplement NMN is manufactured by microbial fermentation or enzymatic/chemical synthesis and is never extracted from broccoli or edamame.NMN 确实存在于普通植物性和动物性食物中。Mills 等 2016 的 Table 1 经逐行对照原始文献核对，所测的每一种食物都落在 0 到 1.88 mg/100 g 之间；2025 年一项 HPLC-DAD/LC-MS-MS 植物调查跨度为 40 到 13,000 µg/100 g，以西兰花和四季豆含量最高。原提交稿“每 100 g 只有亚毫克水平，比一粒胶囊低约 100 到 1,000 倍”的表述自相矛盾，已撤回：按 2025 年调查的上限 13 mg/100 g，一份 100 g 大约只比 250 mg 胶囊低 19 倍，也谈不上亚毫克。对照 250 到 1,000 mg 的剂量，TRACE（痕量）这一判定依然成立。牛奶不算有意义的 NMN 来源，它的 NAD+ 前体池以烟酰胺和烟酰胺核苷为主（Trammell 等 2016）。补剂用 NMN 由微生物发酵或酶法/化学合成制得，从不从西兰花或毛豆中提取。

To match the dose要达到该剂量A 250 mg dose is 13.3 kg of edamame a day at its richest measured value (1.88 mg/100 g) and 53 kg at the low end of the same food (0.47 mg/100 g); a 1,000 mg dose is 53 to 213 kg. Broccoli has to be quoted across both sources: at the 2025 plant survey's 13 mg/100 g ceiling a 250 mg dose is 1.9 kg, about 21 cups, while at Mills' 0.25 to 1.12 mg/100 g it is 22 to 100 kg. The honest span is therefore 1.9 to 100 kg, and the submission's flat '22 to 100 kg' overstated the gap by up to about elevenfold at the high-value end. Avocado: 104 to 463 whole avocados a day. Cucumber peel, the most quoted NMN food, is the least useful of all: 1,282 cucumbers pared, corrected from the 1,250 originally stated. No one eats any of this, and even the corrected best case rests on a survey ceiling that cannot be pinned to broccoli specifically.按毛豆实测最高值（1.88 mg/100 g）计算，250 mg 剂量相当于每天 13.3 kg 毛豆；按同一食物的低值（0.47 mg/100 g）则是 53 kg；1,000 mg 剂量为 53 到 213 kg。西兰花必须同时引用两个来源：按 2025 年植物调查的上限 13 mg/100 g，250 mg 剂量约 1.9 kg，大约 21 杯；按 Mills 的 0.25 到 1.12 mg/100 g，则是 22 到 100 kg。诚实的跨度因此是 1.9 到 100 kg，原提交稿一律写“22 到 100 kg”，在高值端把差距夸大了最多约 11 倍。牛油果：每天 104 到 463 整只。黄瓜皮是被引用最多的 NMN 食物，实际最没用：要削 1,282 根黄瓜的皮，原文写的 1,250 已更正。没人会这样吃，而且即便是更正后的最好情形，也建立在一个无法确切归到西兰花身上的调查上限之上。

Food vs supplement食物与补充剂Substantial. NMN is a phosphorylated nucleotide and is not absorbed intact in any large quantity: it is dephosphorylated in the gut to nicotinamide riboside and then to nicotinamide before or during absorption, so an oral NMN capsule is partly a nicotinamide delivery system. Food NMN arrives as a minor component of a mixed NAD+ vitamer pool (nicotinamide, nicotinic acid, NR, NAD+ itself) inside intact cells and is measured after extraction, which is not the same as being released by chewing and digestion. Supplement material is manufactured by fermentation or enzymatic synthesis, never extracted from broccoli or edamame despite the marketing imagery. Regulatory status differs too: the FDA has taken the position that NMN is precluded from being marketed as a US dietary supplement, while it is sold freely elsewhere, so 'food-derived' framing on a label carries no compositional meaning.很大。NMN 是磷酸化的核苷酸，不会有大量以完整形式被吸收：它在肠道内先去磷酸化为烟酰胺核苷，再转为烟酰胺，这一过程发生在吸收之前或吸收之中，所以口服 NMN 胶囊有一部分实际上是烟酰胺的递送系统。食物中的 NMN 是混合 NAD+ 维生素原池（烟酰胺、烟酸、NR、NAD+ 本身）里的次要成分，位于完整细胞内部，测定值是提取之后得到的，与咀嚼和消化能释放出来的量不是一回事。补剂原料由发酵或酶法合成制得，营销图片再怎么摆西兰花和毛豆，也从不从中提取。监管状态同样不同：FDA 已表态 NMN 不得作为美国膳食补充剂销售，而在其他地区可自由销售，因此标签上的“来自食物”并无成分层面的含义。

Absorption吸收Food NMN quantities are too small for bioavailability to matter. For the supplement form, human and mouse tracer work shows the oral route delivers NAD+ precursors largely after conversion to nicotinamide riboside and nicotinamide rather than as intact NMN (Trammell et al. 2016, Nat Commun 7:12948, DOI 10.1038/ncomms12948, for the NR side of the same pathway). Ordinary diets already supply 15-20 mg/day of niacin equivalents feeding the same NAD+ pathway, thousands of times more molar precursor than the NMN in any vegetable portion, so the scarcity premise behind NMN supplementation is not a dietary-shortfall argument.食物中的 NMN 量太小，生物利用度无关紧要。就补剂形式而言，人体和小鼠示踪研究显示口服途径主要在转化为烟酰胺核苷和烟酰胺之后才把 NAD+ 前体送达，以完整 NMN 形式送达的比例很低（Trammell 等 2016, Nat Commun 7:12948, DOI 10.1038/ncomms12948，针对同一通路的 NR 一侧）。普通饮食本身每天已提供 15-20 mg 烟酸当量进入同一 NAD+ 通路，摩尔量比任何一份蔬菜里的 NMN 多出数千倍，所以 NMN 补充背后的稀缺前提并非膳食缺口论证。

Food data note食物数据说明Every Mills Table 1 value and per-portion conversion was confirmed against the primary table, and the PMID and DOI both resolve correctly. The upper end of the picture, and therefore the corrected best-case dose gap, rests on the Alegre & Pastore 2025 abstract alone, whose per-food values could not be retrieved (full text 403). The eight USDA FDC IDs used for food identity could not be checked because the FDC API rate-limited the session中。Mills Table 1 的每一个数值以及每份换算都已对照原表核实，PMID 与 DOI 均可正确解析。整体图景的上限，以及由此得出的更正后最好情形剂量差距，只依赖 Alegre & Pastore 2025 的摘要，其分食物数值无法获取（全文 403）。用于食物身份识别的八个 USDA FDC ID 无法核对，因为本次会话被 FDC API 限流。

Does the body make it身体是否自产Cells make NMN every day as the middle step of the NAD+ salvage pathway: NAMPT joins nicotinamide to 5-phosphoribosyl-1-pyrophosphate to form NMN, and NMNAT enzymes then convert NMN into NAD+. There is no dietary requirement for NMN at any intake, and NAMPT is feedback inhibited by nicotinamide, NAD+ and ATP (PMID 36746631), so the supplement targets the exact step the body already regulates. Buying NMN means adding an internal intermediate to a self-regulating pathway, and the only genuine dietary need upstream of it is the ordinary niacin requirement of 14 to 16 mg NE/day, which a normal diet covers, so the case for supplementing has to rest on outcome trials and not on repletion.细胞每天自己合成 NMN, 它是 NAD+ 补救合成通路的中间步骤: NAMPT 把 nicotinamide 与 5-phosphoribosyl-1-pyrophosphate 连接成 NMN, 再由 NMNAT 系列酶把 NMN 转成 NAD+。任何摄入水平下都不存在 NMN 的膳食需要量, 而 NAMPT 受 nicotinamide、NAD+ 和 ATP 的反馈抑制 (PMID 36746631), 补充剂瞄准的正是这个被主动调控的步骤。买 NMN 等于往一条自我调节的通路里补它自己的中间物, 上游唯一真实的膳食需求是每日 14 到 16 mg NE 的常规烟酸需要量 (仅靠色氨酸提供 16 mg NE 需要约 960 mg 色氨酸, 而每日 60 到 80 g 蛋白质的摄入能提供数倍于此), 普通饮食已经覆盖, 所以补充的理由只能来自结局试验, 与补足缺乏无关。

Pathway合成通路Nicotinamide + 5-phosphoribosyl-1-pyrophosphate to NMN by NAMPT (rate-limiting; feedback inhibited by nicotinamide, NAD+ and ATP, PMID 36746631); nicotinamide riboside to NMN by NRK1/NRK2 (NMRK1/2); NMN to NAD+ by NMNAT1 (nucleus), NMNAT2 (cytosol/Golgi) and NMNAT3, whose textbook assignment to mitochondria is disputed. Two further routes feed the same NAD pool: de novo from tryptophan through the kynurenine pathway (TDO2 or IDO1, KMO, KYNU, HAAO) to quinolinate, then QPRT to nicotinic acid mononucleotide and NMNAT1-3 to NAD; and the Preiss-Handler route from nicotinic acid through NAPRT.Nicotinamide + 5-phosphoribosyl-1-pyrophosphate 由 NAMPT 生成 NMN (限速步骤, 受 nicotinamide、NAD+ 和 ATP 反馈抑制, PMID 36746631); nicotinamide riboside 由 NRK1/NRK2 (NMRK1/2) 生成 NMN; NMN 由 NMNAT1 (细胞核)、NMNAT2 (胞质和高尔基体) 以及 NMNAT3 转成 NAD+, NMNAT3 归入线粒体的教科书说法存在争议。另有两条通路汇入同一个 NAD 池: 色氨酸经 kynurenine 通路 (TDO2 或 IDO1、KMO、KYNU、HAAO) 生成喹啉酸, 再由 QPRT 生成烟酸单核苷酸, 经 NMNAT1-3 生成 NAD; 以及 nicotinic acid 经 NAPRT 的 Preiss-Handler 通路。

Amount made自产量NOT ESTABLISHED for endogenous NMN production itself, and no human whole-body NAD synthesis rate exists, partly because supply is only interpretable against consumption by PARPs, sirtuins, CD38 and SARM1. Sourced anchors: niacin RDA 16 mg NE/day for men and 14 mg NE/day for women, with dietary tryptophan converting at about 60 mg tryptophan per 1 mg niacin equivalent (IOM 1998). Supplement doses of 250 to 1000 mg/day sit one to two orders of magnitude above that vitamin requirement.内源性 NMN 自身的生成速率 NOT ESTABLISHED, 人体全身 NAD 合成速率也没有测定值, 部分原因在于供给只有对照 PARPs、sirtuins、CD38 和 SARM1 的消耗才有意义。有来源的参照值: 烟酸 RDA 男性 16 mg NE/day, 女性 14 mg NE/day, 膳食色氨酸按约 60 mg 色氨酸折算 1 mg 烟酸当量 (IOM 1998)。补充剂 250 到 1000 mg/day 的剂量比这一维生素需要量高出一到两个数量级。

Still matters when仍有意义的情形Genuine niacin deficiency states (pellagra, chronic alcohol use, isoniazid therapy, Hartnup disease, carcinoid), where plain nicotinamide or nicotinic acid at vitamin doses is the established and far cheaper correction. Inborn errors of NAD synthesis (HAAO, KYNU, NADSYN1) are a separate clinical situation. Pharmacological NAD raising in ageing or metabolic disease remains experimental and cannot be justified as correcting a deficiency.真正的烟酸缺乏状态 (pellagra、长期饮酒、isoniazid 治疗、Hartnup 病、类癌), 此时用维生素剂量的 nicotinamide 或 nicotinic acid 是既成熟又便宜得多的纠正办法。NAD 合成的先天性缺陷 (HAAO、KYNU、NADSYN1) 属于另一类临床情形。在衰老或代谢病中用药理手段提升 NAD 仍属实验性质, 不能作为补足缺乏的理由。

Synthesis source合成来源PMID 29685734 (Liu et al., Cell Metab 2018;27:1067-1080.e5; in vivo arm in C57BL/6 mice); PMID 36746631 (NAMPT feedback inhibition); IOM, Dietary Reference Intakes for Thiamin, Riboflavin, Niacin, Vitamin B6, Folate, Vitamin B12, Pantothenic Acid, Biotin, and Choline (1998). Verdict结论Skip it不必买
Evidence证据Grade CC 级
Dose tested已验证剂量250-1,000 mg/d commercially. EFSA assessed 300 mg/d as safe. Trials used up to 2,000 mg/d.市售 250 至 1000 毫克/天。EFSA 评估 300 毫克/天为安全。试验用到 2000 毫克/天。
Who适用人群People with peripheral artery disease have the single best-supported claim, and it is thin.外周动脉疾病患者的证据是其中最好的，而这已经很薄了。
Pros优点
  • The NICE trial (n=90, 6 months) improved 6-minute walk distance by 17.6 m versus placebo, and by 31.0 m in those taking at least 75% of pills.NICE 试验（n=90，6 个月）使 6 分钟步行距离比安慰剂多 17.6 米，在服药依从性至少 75% 的人中多 31.0 米。
  • More human trial data exist than for NMN, and EFSA has actually assessed its safety, which is more than most items here can say.它的人体试验数据比 NMN 多，而且 EFSA 确实评估过其安全性，这一点本文多数条目都做不到。
Cons缺点
  • More trials than NMN and a worse hit rate, which is informative. The pattern is consistent: NAD+ rises two to threefold, the clinical endpoint does not move.试验比 NMN 多，命中率反而更低，这本身很说明问题。规律是一致的：NAD+ 升高 2 至 3 倍，临床终点不动。
  • Long COVID (n=58, 2,000 mg/d, 20 weeks): NAD+ up 2.6 to 3.1-fold, no significant improvement in cognition, fatigue, sleep or mood.长新冠（n=58，2000 毫克/天，20 周）：NAD+ 升高 2.6 至 3.1 倍，认知、疲劳、睡眠、情绪均无显著改善。
  • Obese insulin-resistant men (n=40, 2,000 mg/d, 12 weeks): insulin sensitivity, endogenous glucose production, glucose disposal and oxidation were all unimproved, in the authors own words.肥胖胰岛素抵抗男性（n=40，2000 毫克/天，12 周）：用作者原话，胰岛素敏感性、内源性葡萄糖生成、葡萄糖处置与氧化全部未改善。
  • Mild cognitive impairment trials at 1,000 mg/d were null.1000 毫克/天治疗轻度认知障碍的试验为阴性。
  • EFSA caps pregnancy and lactation at 230 mg/d. Sum total nicotinamide exposure if also taking prescription niacin. As with NMN, no oncology safety data exist.EFSA 把妊娠期和哺乳期上限定在 230 毫克/天。若同时服用处方烟酸，需合计烟酰胺总暴露量。与 NMN 一样，没有肿瘤学安全数据。
What it does, and what happens without it它有什么作用，缺了会怎样

A form of vitamin B3 that cells convert into NAD+, the energy metabolism coenzyme.维生素B3的一种形式,细胞将其转化为NAD+,即能量代谢辅酶。

No deficiency state exists不存在缺乏状态

In detail详细Nicotinamide riboside is the riboside of nicotinamide, phosphorylated by nicotinamide riboside kinases to NMN and then to NAD+, bypassing the NAMPT step. It occurs naturally in trace amounts in milk. Single oral doses raise whole-blood NAD+ dose-dependently in humans, which is the basis for marketing it as an NAD+ booster; whether raising NAD+ produces clinical benefit in healthy people remains unsettled. NR is a minor chemical form of vitamin B3 rather than a separate essential nutrient. Vitamin B3 deficiency does exist and is called pellagra (dermatitis, diarrhoea, dementia), but it results from lack of dietary niacin and tryptophan and is treated with nicotinamide or nicotinic acid, not with NR.烟酰胺核糖是烟酰胺的核糖苷,经烟酰胺核糖激酶磷酸化为NMN,再进一步转化为NAD+,绕过了NAMPT这一步骤。它天然微量存在于牛奶中。单次口服可剂量依赖性地升高人体全血NAD+水平,这是将其作为NAD+助推剂进行营销的依据;但升高NAD+是否能给健康人带来临床获益仍未确定。NR是维生素B3的一种次要化学形式,而非独立的必需营养素。维生素B3缺乏确实存在,称为糙皮病(皮炎、腹泻、痴呆),但其成因是膳食烟酸和色氨酸摄入不足,治疗用烟酰胺或烟酸,而非NR。

There is no deficiency state for this. It is not an essential nutrient, so being short of it is not a thing that can happen.它不存在缺乏状态。它不是必需营养素，所以“缺了它”这件事本身并不成立。

Source来源PMID 27721479 (Trammell et al., Nat Commun 2016, oral bioavailability of nicotinamide riboside); NIH Office of Dietary Supplements, Niacin Fact Sheet for Health Professionals

Food and the body食物与身体

TRACE was challenged and upheld. NR is a real dietary vitamer, best characterised in cow milk, where Trammell et al. 2016 measured 4.3 +/- 2.6 umol/L across 18 raw samples (5.1 +/- 2.6 umol/L in the subset free of S. aureus, against nicotinamide at 7.3 +/- 1.5 umol/L). That is 1.1 to 1.3 mg per litre. Plant foods carry 62 to 1,600 ug per 100 g, with wild chicory, banana and orange named the highest (Alegre & Pastore 2025). Every one of these is three orders of magnitude below a 250 to 1,000 mg capsule. Commercial NR chloride is synthesised, not extracted from milk.TRACE（痕量）曾被质疑，经复核维持。NR 是真实的膳食维生素原形式，在牛奶中研究得最充分：Trammell 等 2016 在 18 个生奶样本中测得 4.3 ± 2.6 µmol/L（不含金黄色葡萄球菌（S. aureus）的子集为 5.1 ± 2.6 µmol/L，同批烟酰胺为 7.3 ± 1.5 µmol/L）。折合每升 1.1 到 1.3 mg。植物性食物含 62 到 1,600 µg/100 g，其中野生菊苣、香蕉和橙子被点名为最高（Alegre & Pastore 2025）。这些数值全部比 250 到 1,000 mg 的胶囊低三个数量级。商品化的 NR 氯化物为合成品，不从牛奶中提取。

Rows tagged unconfirmed carry a figure the checking pass could not trace back to its cited source. Hover the tag for the reason.标记未核实的行，其数值在核查中无法追溯到所引来源。把鼠标移到标记上可看原因。

To match the dose要达到该剂量A 300 mg dose is 231 to 273 litres of milk a day, roughly 970 to 1,150 cups, and a 1,000 mg dose is 769 to 909 litres. One 250 mg capsule holds as much NR as 192 to 227 litres of milk. The submission quoted only the single lowest concentration (1.1 mg/L), which inflated each of these figures by 15 to 20 per cent; the range above spans Trammell's 4.3 umol/L mean and his bacteria-free 5.1 umol/L subset. From the richest plant value in the 2025 survey (1.6 mg/100 g) a 300 mg dose is about 19 kg a day. Milk is genuinely the best dietary source of NR and it is still useless as a route to a trial dose.300 mg 剂量对应每天 231 到 273 升牛奶，大约 970 到 1,150 杯；1,000 mg 剂量为 769 到 909 升。一粒 250 mg 胶囊所含 NR 相当于 192 到 227 升牛奶。原提交稿只引用了最低浓度（1.1 mg/L），把上述每个数字都抬高了 15 到 20 个百分点；这里的区间覆盖 Trammell 的 4.3 µmol/L 均值和他那个不含该细菌的 5.1 µmol/L 子集。按 2025 年调查中最高的植物值（1.6 mg/100 g），300 mg 剂量约为每天 19 kg。牛奶确实是 NR 最好的膳食来源，作为达到试验剂量的途径依然没用。

Food vs supplement食物与补充剂Important. Commercial NR is nicotinamide riboside chloride, a synthesised salt, while the NR in milk is a fragile glycosidic nucleoside that degrades on storage and is reduced in milk from mastitic (S. aureus positive) cows; Trammell also found conventional milk carried more NR than organic. The food number is a moving target for that reason. More significant, the whole diet already supplies plenty of the pathway's dominant precursor, nicotinamide, at 15-20 mg/day of niacin equivalents, so NR supplementation is not correcting a dietary gap in NAD+ precursors, it is a pharmacological attempt at a different pharmacokinetic profile. High-dose nicotinamide-family precursors also carry methyl-group and flushing or hepatic considerations at gram level that a glass of milk does not.重要。商品 NR 是烟酰胺核苷氯化物，一种合成的盐；牛奶中的 NR 是脆弱的糖苷核苷，储存过程中会降解，来自患乳腺炎（金黄色葡萄球菌阳性）奶牛的牛奶含量更低；Trammell 还发现常规牛奶的 NR 高于有机牛奶。食物数值因此是个移动的靶子。更实质的问题在于，整体饮食已经提供了充足的通路主导前体烟酰胺，每天 15-20 mg 烟酸当量，所以 NR 补充与 NAD+ 前体的膳食缺口无关，它是为了取得另一种药代动力学曲线所做的药理学尝试。克级的高剂量烟酰胺族前体还牵涉甲基供体消耗以及潮红或肝脏方面的考量，一杯牛奶不涉及这些。

Absorption吸收NR is absorbed orally and raises blood NAD+ in humans, which was the point of the original demonstration (Trammell et al. 2016, Nat Commun 7:12948, DOI 10.1038/ncomms12948). Absorption is not the constraint; food quantities are microgram-scale, at 0.26-0.31 mg per cup of milk against a 250-1,000 mg capsule. There is a route difference too: much oral NR is cleaved to nicotinamide in the gut and liver, so a fraction of any dose acts as plain vitamin B3, which is abundant in food. The submission's claim that milk NR is 'free in solution and not bound to milk proteins' inverts the source and has been removed: Trammell's WaterLOGSY NMR gave positive signals from the four aromatic protons of the nicotinamide moiety consistent with association with a skim-milk protein fraction, with stronger binding in conventional than organic milk.NR 口服可吸收，并能提高人体血液 NAD+ 水平，这正是最初那项验证的要点（Trammell 等 2016, Nat Commun 7:12948, DOI 10.1038/ncomms12948）。吸收不是制约因素；食物中的量只有微克级，每杯牛奶 0.26-0.31 mg，对照 250-1,000 mg 的胶囊。途径上也有差别：口服 NR 有相当一部分在肠道和肝脏被裂解为烟酰胺，因此任何剂量都有一部分是以普通维生素 B3 起作用，而维生素 B3 在食物中很充足。原提交稿称牛奶中的 NR“游离于溶液中，不与乳蛋白结合”，把原始文献说反了，已删除：Trammell 的 WaterLOGSY 核磁共振从烟酰胺部分的四个芳香质子得到正信号，与其同脱脂乳蛋白组分相结合一致，且常规牛奶中的结合强于有机牛奶。

Food data note食物数据说明The milk figure is traceable to the primary full text and the micromolar-to-mg/L conversion was independently recomputed, but all three plant rows rest on a paywalled paper whose per-food values are not retrievable, so their content and their rank order are unconfirmed中。牛奶数值可追溯到原始全文，微摩尔到 mg/L 的换算也已独立重算，但三条植物条目全部依赖一篇付费墙论文，其分食物数值无法获取，因此它们的含量和排序都未经确认。

Does the body make it身体是否自产NR is also an internal NAD intermediate: the body generates it by stripping the phosphate off NMN using CD73 and alkaline phosphatases, and it circulates in human blood and appears in milk without anyone supplementing. The first-pass finding that oral NR is mostly broken down to nicotinamide in the liver comes from mouse tracer work (PMID 27721479 mouse arm; PMID 29685734 in C57BL/6 mice), so the species label matters, and the human evidence is pharmacokinetic. Supplementing does raise blood NAD metabolites measurably, which makes NR a real pharmacological agent, and it still corrects no deficiency in a person eating normally, since NR, NMN, nicotinamide and nicotinic acid all feed the same NAD pool and the two vitamin forms cost a fraction of the price.NR 同样是体内的 NAD 中间物: 机体通过 CD73 和碱性磷酸酶把 NMN 上的磷酸去掉来生成它, 在无人补充的情况下它也存在于人血液循环并出现在乳汁中。口服 NR 在肝脏首过时大部分被降解为 nicotinamide, 这一结论来自小鼠示踪研究 (PMID 27721479 的小鼠部分; PMID 29685734 使用 C57BL/6 小鼠), 因此物种标注很重要, 人体证据属于药代动力学层面。补充确实能可测量地提高血中 NAD 代谢物, 这使 NR 成为一种真实的药理制剂, 但对饮食正常的人它并不纠正任何缺乏: NR、NMN、nicotinamide 和 nicotinic acid 都汇入同一个 NAD 池, 其中两种维生素形式的价格只有它的零头。

Pathway合成通路NR to NMN by nicotinamide riboside kinases NRK1/NRK2 (NMRK1/2), then NMN to NAD+ by NMNAT1-3. NR is formed endogenously by dephosphorylation of NMN (NT5E/CD73, alkaline phosphatases) and degraded to nicotinamide by purine nucleoside phosphorylase. The Preiss-Handler route runs in parallel, with nicotinic acid entering through NAPRT to nicotinic acid mononucleotide and then the shared terminal steps, which is what governs how NAD metabolite biomarkers in trials should be read; the de novo kynurenine route from tryptophan feeds the same pool.NR 由 nicotinamide riboside kinases NRK1/NRK2 (NMRK1/2) 转成 NMN, 再由 NMNAT1-3 把 NMN 转成 NAD+。NR 在体内由 NMN 去磷酸化生成 (NT5E/CD73、碱性磷酸酶), 并由 purine nucleoside phosphorylase 降解为 nicotinamide。Preiss-Handler 通路并行运行, nicotinic acid 经 NAPRT 生成烟酸单核苷酸后进入相同的末端步骤, 这决定了试验中 NAD 代谢物生物标志物该如何解读; 色氨酸经 kynurenine 的从头合成通路汇入同一个池。

Amount made自产量NOT ESTABLISHED for endogenous NR turnover. Sourced anchors: niacin requirement 14 to 16 mg NE/day (IOM 1998); in human dosing, a single-subject pilot showed blood NAD+ rising up to 2.7-fold after one oral NR dose, and the first formal pharmacokinetic trial (100, 300 and 1,000 mg) showed dose-dependent rises in blood NAD metabolites. Marketed doses of 250 to 1000 mg/day are one to two orders of magnitude above the vitamin requirement.内源性 NR 周转量 NOT ESTABLISHED。有来源的参照值: 烟酸需要量 14 到 16 mg NE/day (IOM 1998); 在人体给药中, 一项单个受试者的先导研究显示单次口服 NR 后血 NAD+ 最高升高 2.7 倍, 首个正式药代动力学试验 (100、300 和 1,000 mg) 显示血中 NAD 代谢物随剂量升高。市售 250 到 1000 mg/day 的剂量比维生素需要量高出一到两个数量级。

Still matters when仍有意义的情形The same niacin deficiency and inborn-error settings listed for NMN, where vitamin-dose nicotinamide is the standard fix. Beyond that, use rests on clinical trial endpoints for a named condition, since there is no NR deficiency state to treat.与 NMN 条目所列相同的烟酸缺乏和先天性缺陷情形, 此时维生素剂量的 nicotinamide 是标准处理。除此之外, 使用只能依据针对具体疾病的临床试验终点, 因为并不存在需要治疗的 NR 缺乏状态。

SSDDFFDDBBXXResveratrol白藜芦醇
Verdict结论Skip it不必买
Evidence证据Grade DD 级
Dose tested已验证剂量Trials span 150 mg/d to gram doses. The EU caps synthetic trans-resveratrol at 150 mg/d in supplements, adults only.试验剂量从 150 毫克/天到克级。欧盟把合成反式白藜芦醇在补充剂中的上限定为 150 毫克/天，且仅限成人。
Who适用人群Possibly people who already have type 2 diabetes. The healthy-ageing consumer is in the null subgroup.可能适用于已患 2 型糖尿病的人。以“健康抗老”为目的的消费者正处在无效的那个亚组里。
Pros优点
  • An 11-trial meta-analysis found significant improvement in glucose control and insulin sensitivity in people who already had diabetes, and explicitly no effect in non-diabetic people.一项 11 项试验的 meta 分析发现，在已患糖尿病的人中血糖控制和胰岛素敏感性显著改善，并明确指出在非糖尿病者中无效应。
Cons缺点
  • It is the cautionary tale the rest of this category has not learned from. Sirtris was acquired by GSK for 720 million US dollars and the development programme was discontinued.它是这个品类其余成员没有从中学到教训的警示故事。Sirtris 被 GSK 以 7.2 亿美元收购，随后开发项目终止。
  • The best-designed human trial was null: 150 mg/d for 6 months in overweight adults, no effect on insulin sensitivity (adjusted Matsuda index 5.18 versus 5.50 on placebo).设计最好的人体试验是阴性的：超重成人服用 150 毫克/天共 6 个月，对胰岛素敏感性无效（校正 Matsuda 指数 5.18，安慰剂 5.50）。
  • It can make exercise worse. In aged men undergoing training, resveratrol BLUNTED the training-induced cardiovascular improvements, the opposite of the marketed exercise-mimetic claim.它可能让运动效果变差。在接受训练的老年男性中，白藜芦醇削弱了训练带来的心血管改善，与其宣传的“运动模拟剂”正好相反。
  • Antiplatelet activity, so care with warfarin and antiplatelets. Oestrogen-sensitive conditions warrant caution. Gram doses cause gastrointestinal intolerance, and the oncology programme saw renal adverse events.有抗血小板活性，与华法林和抗血小板药合用需谨慎。雌激素敏感性疾病也需谨慎。克级剂量引起胃肠不耐受，肿瘤学项目中还出现过肾脏不良事件。
What it does, and what happens without it它有什么作用，缺了会怎样

A stress compound made by grapevines. It has no established job in human physiology.一种由葡萄藤在受胁迫时产生的化合物,在人体生理中没有已确立的作用。

No deficiency state exists不存在缺乏状态

In detail详细Resveratrol is a stilbene phytoalexin produced by grapevines, Japanese knotweed and peanuts in response to injury and fungal attack. In cell and yeast systems it appears to activate SIRT1, an effect later shown to depend substantially on the fluorophore-tagged assay substrate rather than on the enzyme, and it activates AMPK at high concentrations. In humans absorption is good but bioavailability is very low: it is almost completely converted to sulfate and glucuronide conjugates on first pass, leaving free plasma resveratrol far below the concentrations used in cell experiments. It is a plant secondary metabolite. No human transporter, receptor or enzyme requires it, and nothing in the body fails in its absence.白藜芦醇是一种茋类植物抗毒素,由葡萄藤、虎杖和花生在受到损伤或真菌侵袭时产生。在细胞和酵母系统中,它似乎能激活SIRT1,但后续研究表明这一效应在很大程度上取决于所用荧光标记检测底物,而非对该酶的真实作用;在高浓度下它还能激活AMPK。在人体内它吸收良好,但生物利用度很低:首过代谢中几乎完全被转化为硫酸盐和葡萄糖醛酸盐结合物,使血浆中游离白藜芦醇浓度远低于细胞实验所用的浓度。它是一种植物次生代谢物。没有任何人体转运体、受体或酶需要它,缺乏它也不会导致人体任何功能失常。

There is no deficiency state for this. It is not an essential nutrient, so being short of it is not a thing that can happen.它不存在缺乏状态。它不是必需营养素，所以“缺了它”这件事本身并不成立。

Source来源PMID 15333514 (Walle et al., high absorption but very low bioavailability of oral resveratrol in humans, Drug Metab Dispos 2004); Linus Pauling Institute Micronutrient Information Center, Resveratrol

Food and the body食物与身体
In food: Trace食物中：痕量 Dose from food: Out of reach靠吃达到剂量：达不到 Body makes it: Cannot身体自产：不能 Food data: Medium食物数据：中

Resveratrol occurs in red wine, grapes, peanuts and some berries, at concentrations three to five orders of magnitude below trial doses; red wine averages 1.9 mg trans-resveratrol per litre, so a whole litre holds less than one capsule. Supplement resveratrol is not grape-derived: it is made synthetically or extracted from Japanese knotweed root (Polygonum cuspidatum). Knotweed is not entirely inedible, since young itadori shoots are eaten as a spring vegetable in Japan and foraged in the UK and North America and itadori tea is made from the plant, so the accurate statement is that it is not a food in Western diets, has no composition-table entry, and the root used for extraction is not the part anyone eats. Three sources that belong in the food picture carry no verified figure here and so get no row: peanut skins (the redskin testa, the richest stilbene fraction of the peanut, which is why the roasted-kernel value is explicitly for peanuts without seed coats), red and purple grape juice (the non-alcoholic route the ethanol argument implies), and the wider stilbene foods (muscadine grapes, bilberries, blueberries, cranberries, pistachios, cocoa), so the roughly 5 mg/day dietary ceiling rests on population intake studies rather than on rows built here.白藜芦醇存在于红葡萄酒、葡萄、花生和部分浆果中，浓度比试验剂量低三到五个数量级；红葡萄酒的反式白藜芦醇平均为每升 1.9 mg，整整一升所含的量还不到一粒胶囊。补充剂中的白藜芦醇与葡萄无关：它由化学合成，或从虎杖根（Polygonum cuspidatum）中提取。虎杖并非完全不可食用，日本会把嫩芽（itadori，虎杖嫩茎）当作春季蔬菜食用，英国和北美也有人采集，还有用该植物制成的虎杖茶（itadori tea）。因此准确的说法是：它在西方饮食中不是食物，没有成分表条目，用于提取的根部也不是任何人会吃的部位。另有三类本应进入食物图景的来源，此处没有经核实的数值，故不单列：花生红衣（种皮，花生中芪类含量最高的部分，这也是烤花生数值明确标注为去种皮花生的原因）、红葡萄汁和紫葡萄汁（乙醇论点所隐含的无醇路径），以及范围更广的芪类食物（马斯卡丁葡萄、越橘、蓝莓、蔓越莓、开心果、可可）。每天约 5 mg 的膳食上限因此来自人群摄入量研究，此处建立的数据行并未提供支撑。

To match the dose要达到该剂量A 150 mg resveratrol dose equals 79 litres of average red wine (150 divided by 1.9 mg/L), about 105 standard 750 mL bottles or roughly 450 glasses, every day. Even at the top of the corroborated sample spread of 0.361 to 1.972 mg/L it is still 76 litres a day. From grapes it is 30 kg daily; from boiled peanuts 29 kg, and from roasted peanuts 2.7 tonnes. Trials commonly use 150 to 1,000 mg/day and the SRT501 cancer studies used up to 5 g/day, all of it manufactured. Measured population intakes sit far lower again (a Spanish study found a median of 100 ug/day and a mean of 933 ug/day for resveratrol plus piceid, and French wine consumption yields about 0.2 mg/day), and no plausible diet gets past about 5 mg/day.150 mg 白藜芦醇的剂量相当于每天 79 升平均含量的红葡萄酒（150 除以 1.9 mg/L），约 105 瓶 750 mL 标准装，或大约 450 杯。即便取已获旁证的样本区间 0.361 至 1.972 mg/L 的上限，也仍需每天 76 升。换成葡萄是每天 30 kg；水煮花生 29 kg；烤花生 2.7 吨。试验常用剂量为每天 150 至 1,000 mg，SRT501 的肿瘤研究用到每天 5 g，全部为人工制造。实测的人群摄入量远低于此（西班牙一项研究得出白藜芦醇加虎杖苷（piceid）的中位数为每天 100 ug、均值为每天 933 ug；法国的葡萄酒消费约折合每天 0.2 mg），任何合理的饮食都超不过每天约 5 mg。

Food vs supplement食物与补充剂Three separate mismatches. First, the supplement is not a food extract: commercial resveratrol is synthetic or comes from Polygonum cuspidatum root, which is not a Western food and not a composition-table food, so the grape imagery on the label is marketing rather than sourcing. Second, wine's stilbenes are mostly the glucoside trans-piceid, at about three times the aglycone concentration, arriving inside a large mixed polyphenol and ethanol matrix, so wine does not behave as a dilute resveratrol capsule. Third, and decisive: recommending wine as a resveratrol source is a bad recommendation regardless of dose, because ethanol is a Group 1 carcinogen and the alcohol harm arrives at one glass while the resveratrol dose would require a hundred bottles. Separately, high-dose resveratrol (2.5 to 5 g/day) causes diarrhoea and nausea and inhibits CYP3A4, CYP2C9 and sulfotransferases, giving it real interaction potential (warfarin, for example) that a glass of wine does not have.三处彼此独立的错配。第一，这种补充剂并非食物提取物：市售白藜芦醇为合成品，或来自虎杖根，后者在西方不是食物，也没有成分表条目，所以标签上的葡萄形象属于营销手法，与原料来源无关。第二，葡萄酒中的芪类以糖苷形式的反式虎杖苷为主，浓度约为苷元的三倍，且处在成分复杂的多酚与乙醇基质之中，葡萄酒的表现与一粒稀释版白藜芦醇胶囊完全不同。第三点最关键：把葡萄酒当作白藜芦醇来源来推荐，无论剂量如何都是糟糕的建议，因为乙醇是 1 类致癌物，酒精的危害从第一杯就开始，而要达到白藜芦醇的剂量需要上百瓶。另外，高剂量白藜芦醇（每天 2.5 至 5 g）会引起腹泻和恶心，并抑制 CYP3A4、CYP2C9 和硫酸转移酶，具有实际的相互作用风险（例如华法林），一杯葡萄酒不具备这种风险。

Absorption吸收Oral resveratrol is well absorbed (about 70% of the dose crosses the enterocyte) but systemic bioavailability of the unchanged aglycone is under 1 to 2% because of near-immediate intestinal and hepatic glucuronidation and sulfation; plasma peaks from dietary quantities sit in the low nanomolar range, while in vitro activity is generally demonstrated at micromolar concentrations. Piceid, the form dominant in grapes and much of wine, must be deglycosylated before absorption, adding another step. Gram doses are needed to reach micromolar plasma levels, which is precisely why the food route is closed.口服白藜芦醇吸收良好（约 70% 的剂量可通过肠上皮细胞），但由于肠道和肝脏几乎即刻发生葡萄糖苷酸化与硫酸化，未变化苷元的全身生物利用度低于 1 至 2%；膳食量所产生的血浆峰值处于低纳摩尔级，而体外活性通常要在微摩尔浓度下才能显现。葡萄和大部分葡萄酒中占主导的虎杖苷必须先脱糖才能吸收，又多一道步骤。要让血浆达到微摩尔水平需要克级剂量，食物路径正因此被彻底堵死。

Food data note食物数据说明The wine mean (1.9 +/- 1.7 mg/L), the Napoleon grape figures, the roasted-peanut corroborating range and the roughly 5 mg/day dietary ceiling were all verified or independently corroborated, and about a dozen unit conversions recompute correctly. The boiled peanut and peanut butter values sit behind a paywall and are indicative, and the wine maximum of 14.3 mg/L had to be removed as untraceable中。葡萄酒均值（1.9 +/- 1.7 mg/L）、Napoleon 葡萄的数值、烤花生的旁证区间以及每天约 5 mg 的膳食上限均已核实或获得独立旁证，约十余项单位换算重算无误。水煮花生和花生酱的数值处于付费墙之后，属参考性数据；葡萄酒 14.3 mg/L 的最高值因无法追溯而删除。

Does the body make it身体是否自产Resveratrol is a plant stress compound, a stilbene assembled by stilbene synthase from 4-coumaroyl-CoA and malonyl-CoA in grapevine, peanut and Polygonum. Humans have no stilbene synthase and no phenylpropanoid pathway at all, so every molecule in the body arrived from food or a capsule. The endogenous axis therefore gives resveratrol no free pass and no handicap: the whole case has to rest on clinical outcomes, and the practical obstacle is that absorbed resveratrol is conjugated almost immediately.白藜芦醇是植物的应激化合物, 属于芪类, 在葡萄藤、花生和 Polygonum 中由 stilbene synthase 以 4-coumaroyl-CoA 和 malonyl-CoA 为底物组装而成。人体既没有 stilbene synthase, 也完全没有 phenylpropanoid 通路, 所以体内的每一个分子都来自食物或胶囊。内源性这一维度对它既不加分也不减分: 全部论证只能落在临床结局上, 而现实障碍是被吸收的白藜芦醇几乎立刻被结合代谢。

Pathway合成通路NOT APPLICABLE. Plant route only: phenylalanine to 4-coumaroyl-CoA via phenylalanine ammonia-lyase and downstream enzymes, then condensation with three malonyl-CoA by stilbene synthase. No human homologue of any step exists; human handling is limited to UGT and SULT conjugation and colonic microbial degradation.NOT APPLICABLE。只有植物途径: 苯丙氨酸经 phenylalanine ammonia-lyase 及下游酶生成 4-coumaroyl-CoA, 再由 stilbene synthase 与三个 malonyl-CoA 缩合。上述任何步骤在人体内都没有同源物; 人体的处理仅限于 UGT 和 SULT 结合以及结肠微生物降解。

Amount made自产量0 mg/day. Humans possess no biosynthetic route to resveratrol.0 mg/day。人体没有合成白藜芦醇的途径。

Still matters when仍有意义的情形Only where trial evidence supports a defined endpoint, and the published trials are mostly small with surrogate endpoints. Bioavailability is the binding constraint: absorption of a dietary-relevant 25 mg oral dose was at least 70% in 6 volunteers, with peak plasma resveratrol plus metabolites at 491 +/- 90 ng/mL (about 2 micromol/L), yet only trace unchanged resveratrol was detectable (under 5 ng/mL) because of rapid glucuronidation and sulfation. Typical supplement doses are 100 to 500 mg, and the absorbed fraction at those doses has not been established.仅在有试验证据支持某个明确终点时才有意义, 而已发表的试验多为小样本和替代终点。生物利用度是决定性约束: 在 6 名志愿者中, 与膳食水平相当的 25 mg 口服剂量吸收率至少为 70%, 血浆中白藜芦醇及其代谢物峰值为 491 +/- 90 ng/mL (约 2 micromol/L), 但由于快速葡糖醛酸化和硫酸化, 只能检出痕量的未变化白藜芦醇 (低于 5 ng/mL)。常见补充剂剂量为 100 到 500 mg, 该剂量下的吸收比例尚未确立。

Synthesis source合成来源PMID 15333514 (Walle et al., Drug Metab Dispos 2004;32:1377-1382; 25 mg dose, n=6). Merged with the recovered row 'Adaptogens, medicinal mushrooms and high-volume polyphenols' for the first-pass conjugation and trial-quality points.
