SSDDFFDDBBXXSpermidine亚精胺
Verdict结论Skip it不必买
Evidence证据Grade DD 级
Dose tested已验证剂量0.9 mg/d was the dose in the definitive trial. Commercial products supply roughly 1-6 mg/d.决定性试验用的是 0.9 毫克/天。市售产品约提供 1 至 6 毫克/天。
Who适用人群Nobody demonstrably.没有可证实的适用人群。
Pros优点
  • The autophagy mechanism is genuine in yeast, flies, worms and mice, and lifespan is extended in those organisms.自噬机制在酵母、果蝇、线虫和小鼠中是真实的，这些生物的寿命确实被延长了。
Cons缺点
  • The one well-conducted human test failed in exactly the target population. SmartAge was 12 months, double-masked, placebo-controlled, in 100 adults aged 60-90 with subjective cognitive decline. Primary outcome difference -0.03 (95% CI -0.11 to 0.05), P=0.47, against a pre-registered primary endpoint.唯一一项做得规范的人体试验，在完全对口的目标人群中失败了。SmartAge 为 12 个月、双盲、安慰剂对照，纳入 100 名 60 至 90 岁有主观认知下降的成人。针对预先注册的主要终点，组间差异为 -0.03（95% CI -0.11 至 0.05），P=0.47。
  • The observational case rests on dietary intake epidemiology, and spermidine-rich foods are wheat germ, legumes, mushrooms and aged cheese. That is a dietary pattern, not a molecule.观察性依据来自膳食摄入流行病学，而富含亚精胺的食物是麦胚、豆类、蘑菇和陈年奶酪。那是一种饮食模式，不是一个分子。
  • Dietary intake from food is typically several-fold higher than most supplements provide, which by itself undermines the supplement premise.从食物中摄入的量通常比多数补充剂提供的高出数倍，这一点本身就削弱了补充剂存在的前提。
  • Wheat-germ-derived products are unsuitable in coeliac disease and wheat allergy. Polyamines are growth-supporting and elevated in many tumours, and polyamine depletion is an active oncology strategy, so avoid during active malignancy.麦胚来源的产品不适合乳糜泻和小麦过敏者。多胺具有促生长作用，在许多肿瘤中升高，而多胺耗竭正是当前肿瘤治疗的一种策略，因此活动性恶性肿瘤期间应避免。
What it does, and what happens without it它有什么作用，缺了会怎样

A polyamine your own cells make, needed to activate a key protein-building factor.一种由自身细胞合成的多胺,是激活某个关键蛋白质合成因子所必需的。

No deficiency state exists不存在缺乏状态

In detail详细Spermidine is a polyamine synthesized from putrescine by spermidine synthase using decarboxylated S-adenosylmethionine. Its one indispensable and unique function is donating the aminobutyl group for hypusination of eukaryotic translation initiation factor 5A, a modification required to translate polyproline-containing proteins. It also stabilises nucleic acids and induces autophagy in model organisms, which is the basis of the longevity marketing. Humans get it from three simultaneous sources: de novo synthesis in essentially every cell, gut bacterial production, and food such as wheat germ, aged cheese, soy and mushrooms. Because synthesis is ubiquitous and tightly regulated, dietary intake is never limiting and no deficiency state exists.亚精胺是一种多胺,由腐胺经亚精胺合酶利用脱羧S-腺苷甲硫氨酸合成而来。它唯一不可替代且独特的功能是为真核翻译起始因子5A的亚精胺化(hypusination)提供氨丁基基团,这一修饰是翻译含多聚脯氨酸蛋白质所必需的。它还能稳定核酸,并在模式生物中诱导自噬,这正是其长寿营销概念的依据。人体同时从三个来源获得亚精胺:几乎所有细胞的从头合成、肠道细菌的产生,以及小麦胚芽、熟成奶酪、大豆和蘑菇等食物。由于合成过程普遍存在且受到严格调控,膳食摄入从不构成限制因素,也不存在任何缺乏状态。

There is no deficiency state for this. It is not an essential nutrient, so being short of it is not a thing that can happen.它不存在缺乏状态。它不是必需营养素，所以“缺了它”这件事本身并不成立。

Source来源DOI 10.1126/science.aan2788 (Madeo, Eisenberg, Pietrocola & Kroemer, Spermidine in health and disease, Science 2018)

Food and the body食物与身体
In food: Rich食物中：丰富 Dose from food: Reachable靠吃达到剂量：可达到 Body makes it: Body makes it身体自产：身体自产 Food data: Medium食物数据：中

RICH was challenged and upheld. This is the one entry where ordinary food beats the supplement outright: wheat germ, dried soybeans, mushrooms, green peas, fermented soy and some aged cheeses all carry milligram-per-portion quantities. Measured intakes tabulated by Munoz-Esparza et al. 2019 run from 33.1 umol/day in Turkey to 103.1 umol/day in Spain, with Western populations at 54.7 to 103.1 umol/day, which is 7.9 to 15.0 mg/day. Trial capsules delivered 0.9 mg/day in the 12-month SmartAge trial. The diet supplies roughly ten times the capsule. Atiya Ali et al. 2011 also names chicken liver, corn and shellfish among its high-spermidine foods, and chicken liver in particular would be a useful non-wheat source, but no per-food figure for them could be sourced here, so they are not given rows.RICH（丰富）曾被质疑，经复核维持。这是唯一一条普通食物完全胜过补剂的条目：小麦胚芽、干黄豆、蘑菇、青豌豆、发酵豆制品和部分陈年干酪，每份都能提供毫克级的量。Munoz-Esparza 等 2019 汇总的实测摄入量从土耳其的 33.1 µmol/天 到西班牙的 103.1 µmol/天，西方人群处于 54.7 到 103.1 µmol/天，也就是 7.9 到 15.0 mg/天。为期 12 个月的 SmartAge 试验中，胶囊每天提供 0.9 mg。饮食供给量大约是胶囊的十倍。Atiya Ali 等 2011 还把鸡肝、玉米和贝类列入高亚精胺食物，其中鸡肝会是有用的非小麦来源，但这里查不到它们的分食物数值，所以未单列条目。

To match the dose要达到该剂量The gap runs backwards. Two tablespoons of wheat germ (14 g) supply 3.1 to 5.0 mg, three to five times the 0.9 mg/day dose used in the SmartAge trial. A cup of cooked green peas supplies about 8.7 mg and a cup of sliced mushrooms 6.2 to 7.6 mg, each close to an entire ordinary day's intake. Against habitual intakes of 7.9 to 15.0 mg/day, a typical 1 mg capsule adds 6.7 to 12.7 per cent on top of what the person already eats, which is inside the day-to-day variation of a normal diet, and matching a day's dietary spermidine from capsules would take 8 to 15 of them. Anyone who wants more spermidine should buy wheat germ, which costs a fraction of the capsules and delivers several times the dose.差距是反向的。两大勺小麦胚芽（14 g）提供 3.1 到 5.0 mg，是 SmartAge 试验所用 0.9 mg/天 剂量的三到五倍。一杯煮熟的青豌豆提供约 8.7 mg，一杯切片蘑菇 6.2 到 7.6 mg，各自都接近普通人一整天的摄入量。对照 7.9 到 15.0 mg/天 的习惯摄入量，一粒常见的 1 mg 胶囊只在既有饮食之上增加 6.7 到 12.7 个百分点，落在正常饮食的日常波动范围内；要用胶囊凑够一天的膳食亚精胺，需要 8 到 15 粒。想多摄入亚精胺的人应该去买小麦胚芽，价格只是胶囊的一小部分，提供的量却是数倍。

Food vs supplement食物与补充剂Real, in both directions. Most 'spermidine' products are wheat germ extracts standardised to about 1 mg rather than purified spermidine, so the label compound is the same molecule as in the food and there is no extraction advantage. Against that, aged cheese and natto carry biogenic amines (histamine, tyramine, putrescine) that matter for people on MAO inhibitors or with histamine intolerance, so the richest fermented sources are not risk-free foods even though they are ordinary ones. Polyamines are proliferative signalling molecules and concentrated long-term supplementation lacks the observational safety record that food-level intake has. The Bruneck cohort (Kiechl et al. 2018, Am J Clin Nutr 108(2):371-380, PMID 29955838) supports dietary intake, reporting mortality by intake thirds of 40.5, 23.7 and 15.1 deaths per 1,000 person-years; the 9 to 11.5 mg/day figures the submission attributed to it are not retrievable from the paper and have been dropped. Wheat germ also goes rancid quickly, so buy small and refrigerate.真实存在，而且两个方向都有。多数“亚精胺”产品其实是标准化到约 1 mg 的小麦胚芽提取物（而非纯化亚精胺），标签上的化合物与食物中的是同一个分子，提取并不带来优势。另一面，陈年干酪和纳豆携带生物胺（组胺、酪胺、腐胺），对服用单胺氧化酶抑制剂或有组胺不耐受的人有影响，因此最富含的发酵来源虽然都是普通食物，却算不上没有风险。多胺是促增殖的信号分子，长期高浓度补充缺少食物水平摄入所具备的观察性安全记录。Bruneck 队列（Kiechl 等 2018, Am J Clin Nutr 108(2):371-380, PMID 29955838）支持膳食摄入，按摄入量三分位报告的死亡率为每 1,000 人年 40.5、23.7 和 15.1 例；原提交稿归到该研究名下的 9 至 11.5 mg/天 数值在论文中查不到，已删除。小麦胚芽也很快酸败，少量购买并冷藏。

Absorption吸收Dietary polyamines are absorbed readily in the upper small intestine, gut bacteria synthesise more, and circulating levels are homeostatically buffered, so intake is not the only input. A triple-blind randomised placebo-controlled crossover trial gave 12 healthy volunteers 15 mg/day of spermidine in two 5-day phases, about 15 times a typical capsule and 1.0 to 1.9 times a rich day's diet; plasma spermine rose significantly while spermidine and putrescine did not change, which the authors read as presystemic conversion of spermidine to spermine (Senekowitsch et al. 2023, Nutrients, PMID 37111071). Either way, dosing well above dietary levels did not raise circulating spermidine. Processing of the food matters more than any supplement choice: commercially germinated wheat grain measured 19.22-24.25 mg/kg spermidine against 220.65-337.2 mg/kg for industrially separated wheat germ. Those ranges imply an 89 to 94 per cent drop, about 92 per cent mean to mean, and the paper's own headline figure of 85.52 per cent is inconsistent with its own data.膳食多胺在小肠上段吸收良好，肠道细菌还会额外合成，循环水平受体内稳态缓冲，所以摄入量并非唯一输入。一项三盲随机安慰剂对照交叉试验给 12 名健康志愿者每天 15 mg 亚精胺，分两个 5 天阶段，约为典型胶囊的 15 倍、富含亚精胺一天饮食的 1.0 到 1.9 倍；血浆精胺显著升高，亚精胺和腐胺没有变化，作者解读为亚精胺在进入体循环前转化成了精胺（Senekowitsch 等 2023, Nutrients, PMID 37111071）。无论如何，剂量远高于膳食水平也没有提高循环中的亚精胺。食物的加工方式比选哪种补剂更要紧：商业发芽小麦粒实测亚精胺 19.22-24.25 mg/kg，工业分离的小麦胚芽为 220.65-337.2 mg/kg。这两个区间意味着 89 到 94 个百分点的下降，均值对均值约 92%，论文自己给出的 85.52% 与其自身数据不符。

Food data note食物数据说明The wheat germ, green pea, natto and cheddar figures were all confirmed against their primary sources, including the nmol/g conversions and the cross-checks. Two rows are less settled because two cited sources disagree by 3-6x (soybeans) or because the submission's fresh-weight figure exceeded the source's own ceiling (mushrooms), and both are now presented as ranges. Two claims were dropped as unverifiable: the Bruneck mg/day intakes and a supposed 3.3 mg/day follow-up trial dose中。小麦胚芽、青豌豆、纳豆和切达干酪的数值全部对照原始来源核实，包括 nmol/g 换算和交叉核对。两条条目仍不确定：黄豆的两个引用来源相差 3-6 倍，蘑菇则是原提交稿的鲜重值超过了来源自身的上限，两者现在都以区间给出。两项主张因无法验证被删除：Bruneck 的 mg/天 摄入量，以及所谓 3.3 mg/天 的后续试验剂量。

Does the body make it身体是否自产Spermidine synthase builds spermidine from putrescine plus an aminopropyl group donated by decarboxylated S-adenosylmethionine, with ornithine decarboxylase as the tightly regulated rate-limiting entry step, while arginine decarboxylase plus agmatinase (AGMAT) provide a second, agmatine-derived route into the putrescine pool. Cells hold polyamines at high micromolar to millimolar concentrations, recycle them continuously through SSAT and polyamine oxidases, and also absorb polyamines produced by gut bacteria, and how that supply splits between host synthesis, diet and microbiota has never been quantified in humans. The FULL label covers the host pathway only, and the practical reading is that a fixed daily dose is an awkward intervention against a homeostatic system the body makes on demand and regulates in both directions.Spermidine synthase 以 putrescine 加上由脱羧 S-adenosylmethionine 提供的氨丙基合成亚精胺, ornithine decarboxylase 是受严格调控的限速起始步骤, arginine decarboxylase 加 agmatinase (AGMAT) 构成另一条经 agmatine 进入 putrescine 池的途径。细胞把多胺维持在高微摩尔到毫摩尔浓度, 通过 SSAT 和多胺氧化酶持续回收, 也吸收肠道细菌产生的多胺, 这一供给在宿主合成、膳食和菌群之间如何分配, 在人体中从未被定量。FULL 标签只针对宿主通路, 微生物来源单独计算; 实际含义是机体按需制造并双向调节这类物质, 对这样一个稳态系统施加固定日剂量属于别扭的干预。

Pathway合成通路Ornithine to putrescine by ODC1 (antizyme/AZIN regulated); arginine to agmatine by arginine decarboxylase, then agmatine to putrescine by agmatinase (AGMAT), a real human input the standard scheme omits; methionine to SAM to decarboxylated SAM by AMD1; putrescine + dcSAM to spermidine by spermidine synthase (SRM), then to spermine by spermine synthase. Recycling runs through SSAT acetylation and the polyamine oxidases, and gut bacterial polyamines are absorbed as an additional exogenous input.Ornithine 由 ODC1 生成 putrescine (受 antizyme/AZIN 调控); arginine 由 arginine decarboxylase 生成 agmatine, 再由 agmatinase (AGMAT) 生成 putrescine, 这条人体确实存在的输入常被标准图示遗漏; methionine 生成 SAM, 再由 AMD1 生成脱羧 SAM; putrescine 与 dcSAM 由 spermidine synthase (SRM) 生成亚精胺, 再由 spermine synthase 生成精胺。回收依靠 SSAT 乙酰化和多胺氧化酶, 肠道细菌产生的多胺作为额外的外源输入被吸收。

Amount made自产量NOT ESTABLISHED. No human whole-body de novo polyamine synthesis rate has been measured by tracer methods. The usable exposure anchor is cohort intake: dietary spermidine ran at roughly 10 to 12 mg/day across the Bruneck cohort tertiles (PMID 29955838), and food-composition data come from Swedish dairy analyses, where mature cheese contained 1.2 mg/kg spermidine (PMID 21249159).NOT ESTABLISHED。人体全身多胺从头合成速率尚无示踪法测定值。可用的暴露参照来自队列摄入量: 在 Bruneck 队列的三分位中, 膳食亚精胺约为 10 到 12 mg/day (PMID 29955838); 食物含量数据来自瑞典乳制品分析, 其中成熟干酪的亚精胺为 1.2 mg/kg (PMID 21249159)。

Still matters when仍有意义的情形Inherited polyamine pathway disorders such as spermine synthase loss in Snyder-Robinson syndrome, which oral polyamines do not correct. Otherwise only trial-supported endpoints, and the human data are observational: all-cause mortality fell across thirds of increasing dietary spermidine, fully adjusted HR 0.76 per 1-SD, 95% CI 0.67 to 0.86, P < 0.001, and the paper translated top versus bottom third as equivalent to an age difference of 5.7 years, 3.6 to 8.1 years. Note also that the opposite strategy is under study, since polyamine depletion is a cancer chemoprevention approach, so more is not automatically better.遗传性多胺通路疾病, 例如 Snyder-Robinson 综合征中的 spermine synthase 缺失, 口服多胺并不能纠正。除此之外只看试验支持的终点, 而现有人体数据是观察性的: 随膳食亚精胺三分位升高, 全因死亡率下降, 完全校正后每 1-SD 的 HR 为 0.76, 95% CI 0.67 到 0.86, P < 0.001; 该论文把最高与最低三分位之间的差异折算为相当于 5.7 年, 3.6 到 8.1 年的年龄差。也要注意相反的策略同样在研究中, 多胺耗竭是一种癌症化学预防思路, 因此摄入越多并不自动越好。

Verdict结论Skip it不必买
Evidence证据Grade CC 级
Dose tested已验证剂量About 1,000 mg/d of curcuminoids in the knee osteoarthritis trials. Culinary turmeric is a different exposure entirely.膝骨关节炎试验中约为姜黄素类 1000 毫克/天。烹饪用姜黄的暴露量完全是另一回事。
Who适用人群At most, people with symptomatic knee osteoarthritis, if the meta-analytic signal survives the bias problem.最多适用于有症状的膝骨关节炎患者，前提是那个 meta 分析信号能扛过偏倚问题。
Pros优点
  • A Bayesian network meta-analysis of 23 studies and 2,175 knee osteoarthritis patients found pain on a visual analogue scale -1.63 (-2.91 to -0.45) and total WOMAC -18.85.一项贝叶斯网络 meta 分析纳入 23 项研究、2175 名膝骨关节炎患者，视觉模拟疼痛评分为 -1.63（-2.91 至 -0.45），WOMAC 总分为 -18.85。
  • Culinary use in food is entirely reasonable and carries no established risk.作为食物调味完全合理，没有已确立的风险。
Cons缺点
  • It was classified in the Journal of Medicinal Chemistry as both a PAINS (pan-assay interference compound) and an invalid metabolic panacea: an unstable, reactive, nonbioavailable compound and therefore a highly improbable lead. That is a formal medicinal-chemistry verdict, not an opinion.《药物化学杂志》把它同时归类为 PAINS（泛测定干扰化合物）和“无效的代谢万灵药”：一个不稳定、易反应、生物利用度极低的化合物，因此几乎不可能成为先导物。这是药物化学领域的正式判定，不是个人看法。
  • The dose on the label is disconnected from systemic exposure. Unconjugated plasma curcumin stays below 2 nM even at high dose with piperine, against the 1-100 micromolar concentrations used in the in-vitro work that generated the claims. Adding piperine does not raise unconjugated plasma curcumin.标签上的剂量与体内暴露量脱钩。即便高剂量并加胡椒碱，血浆游离姜黄素仍低于 2 nM，而产生这些说法的体外实验用的是 1 至 100 微摩尔。加胡椒碱并不能提高血浆游离姜黄素。
  • The osteoarthritis trials are mostly industry-funded with high heterogeneity.骨关节炎试验多为行业资助，异质性高。
  • Turmeric is the most commonly used of the six botanicals linked to liver injury in US survey data (236 of 9,685 respondents), and 10 DILIN cases published in 2023 included five hospitalisations and one death from acute liver failure. Seven of ten carried HLA-B*35:01.在美国调查数据中，姜黄是六种与肝损伤相关的植物里使用最多的一种（9685 名受访者中有 236 人），2023 年发表的 10 例 DILIN 病例中有 5 例住院、1 例死于急性肝衰竭。10 人中有 7 人携带 HLA-B*35:01。
  • Antiplatelet activity raises bleeding risk with warfarin and antiplatelets. Piperine inhibits CYP3A4 broadly, so herb-drug interaction risk with cytotoxics and targeted agents is real.抗血小板活性会增加与华法林和抗血小板药合用时的出血风险。胡椒碱广泛抑制 CYP3A4，因此与细胞毒药物和靶向药之间的相互作用风险是真实的。
What it does, and what happens without it它有什么作用，缺了会怎样

The yellow pigment of turmeric. A spice compound, with no role in human physiology.姜黄的黄色色素成分。一种香料化合物,在人体生理中没有作用。

No deficiency state exists不存在缺乏状态

In detail详细Curcumin is a diarylheptanoid pigment making up roughly 2 to 5 percent of turmeric rhizome. It binds and weakly inhibits a very large number of unrelated proteins in vitro, which is why it appears in thousands of papers; medicinal chemists classify it as a pan-assay interference compound, since its chemical reactivity, aggregation and fluorescence generate false positives across screening assays. Unformulated curcumin is poorly absorbed, rapidly glucuronidated and sulfated, and essentially undetectable as the free compound in plasma even after gram doses, though piperine, phospholipid and nanoparticle formulations raise exposure. It is a plant secondary metabolite with no physiological role in humans and no requirement.姜黄素是一种二芳基庚烷类色素,约占姜黄根茎的2%至5%。它在体外能与大量互不相关的蛋白质结合并弱抑制其活性,这也是它在数千篇论文中出现的原因;药物化学家将其归类为泛测定干扰化合物(PAINS),因为其化学反应活性、聚集性和荧光特性会在各类筛选测定中产生假阳性。未经处理的姜黄素吸收很差,会被迅速葡萄糖醛酸化和硫酸化,即使服用克级剂量,血浆中游离化合物也基本检测不到,不过胡椒碱、磷脂或纳米颗粒制剂可提高其暴露量。它是一种植物次生代谢物,在人体内没有生理作用,也没有摄入需求。

There is no deficiency state for this. It is not an essential nutrient, so being short of it is not a thing that can happen.它不存在缺乏状态。它不是必需营养素，所以“缺了它”这件事本身并不成立。

Source来源PMID 28074653 (Nelson et al., The Essential Medicinal Chemistry of Curcumin, J Med Chem 2017)

Food and the body食物与身体
In food: Rich食物中：丰富 Dose from food: Out of reach靠吃达到剂量：达不到 Body makes it: Cannot身体自产：不能 Food data: Medium食物数据：中

Turmeric is an ordinary culinary spice, the dried ground rhizome of Curcuma longa, and it carries curcumin at 3.14% by weight, so one level teaspoon delivers 94 mg. Measured against the JECFA/EFSA acceptable daily intake for curcumin of 3 mg/kg body weight (210 mg for a 70 kg adult), a single teaspoon supplies 45% of the ADI, which is a rich dietary source on any normal reading; the earlier TRACE label came from scoring food against a 1,000 mg capsule, which is the dose question and is answered separately below. Turmeric is effectively the only meaningful food source, and commercial curry powder is much weaker. Fresh turmeric rhizome is the same food in unprocessed form and is increasingly sold in UK and US supermarkets, but no verified composition figure for it is available here, so it gets no row.姜黄就是普通的厨房香料，即 Curcuma longa 干燥根茎磨成的粉，其姜黄素含量按重量计为 3.14%，因此一平茶匙可提供 94 mg。以 JECFA/EFSA 为姜黄素设定的每日允许摄入量 3 mg/kg 体重（70 kg 成人为 210 mg）衡量，一茶匙即达到 ADI 的 45%，按任何常规标准都算得上富含来源；此前标为 TRACE，是因为拿食物去对标 1,000 mg 的胶囊剂量，那属于剂量问题，下文单独回答。姜黄实际上是唯一有意义的食物来源，市售咖喱粉的含量要低得多。新鲜姜黄根茎是同一种食物的未加工形态，在英美超市越来越常见，但此处没有经核实的成分数据，故不单列一行。

Turmeric, ground (dried rhizome powder, as sold as a spice)姜黄粉（干燥根茎粉末，即作为香料出售的形态）unconfirmed未核实 3.14 g curcumin per 100 g (3.14% w/w, the mean for pure turmeric powder and the highest concentration measured across the 28 spice products analysed, which spanned both turmeric and curry powders). Rows tagged unconfirmed carry a figure the checking pass could not trace back to its cited source. Hover the tag for the reason.标记未核实的行，其数值在核查中无法追溯到所引来源。把鼠标移到标记上可看原因。

To match the dose要达到该剂量A 1,000 mg curcuminoid capsule equals about 21 to 32 g of turmeric powder every day: 32 g counting curcumin only at 3.14% w/w, about 21 g counting all three curcuminoids at roughly 4.7% (a conventional ratio the cited source does not establish). That is 7 to 11 level teaspoons, close to a third of a supermarket spice jar per day, and nobody eats that. A generous curry portion carries 1 to 2 g of turmeric, or 30 to 60 mg of curcumin, and a heavy South Asian intake of 2 to 2.5 g turmeric per day yields 63 to 79 mg of curcumin, so the capsule is about 13 to 16 times a heavy dietary intake on a curcumin basis, and about 8.5 to 11 times if the comparison is made on total curcuminoids. There is no eating route to the dose.一粒 1,000 mg 姜黄素类化合物胶囊相当于每天约 21 至 32 g 姜黄粉：只按 3.14% w/w 的姜黄素计算是 32 g，按三种姜黄素类化合物合计约 4.7% 计算约为 21 g（这个换算比例属惯用值，所引来源并未确立）。折合 7 至 11 平茶匙，接近每天吃掉三分之一瓶超市香料罐，没有人会这么吃。一份量足的咖喱含 1 至 2 g 姜黄，即 30 至 60 mg 姜黄素；南亚地区偏高的摄入量为每天 2 至 2.5 g 姜黄，可得 63 至 79 mg 姜黄素。按姜黄素计，胶囊约为高膳食摄入量的 13 至 16 倍；若按总姜黄素类化合物比较，约为 8.5 至 11 倍。靠吃东西达不到这个剂量。

Food vs supplement食物与补充剂This is the single most important form gap in the whole list. Culinary turmeric has no liver-injury signal; 95% curcuminoid extracts, especially those boosted with piperine or reformulated as phytosomes, micelles or nanoparticles, are now a leading identified botanical cause of drug-induced liver injury in US and Australian case series, with a reported HLA-B*35:01 association. The EFSA/JECFA acceptable daily intake for curcumin (E 100) is 3 mg/kg body weight per day, 210 mg for a 70 kg adult: one teaspoon of turmeric in food (94 mg curcumin) sits at 45% of it, while a single 1,000 mg curcuminoid capsule is about five times over it. Concentrated extracts also inhibit CYP3A4 and UGT enzymes and interact with anticoagulants, which food-level turmeric does not. Second caveat cutting the other way: scaling up culinary turmeric is not a safe workaround either, because turmeric powder in some supply chains has been adulterated with lead chromate for colour (well documented in Bangladeshi turmeric), and gram-level daily dosing of spice-grade powder magnifies that exposure.这是整份清单中最重要的形态差异。食用姜黄没有肝损伤信号；95% 姜黄素类提取物，尤其是加胡椒碱增效或改造为植物体（phytosome）、胶束、纳米颗粒的产品，如今在美国和澳大利亚的病例系列中已成为药物性肝损伤的首要已确认植物性病因，并报告与 HLA-B*35:01 相关。EFSA/JECFA 为姜黄素（E 100）设定的每日允许摄入量是每天 3 mg/kg 体重，70 kg 成人为 210 mg：食物中一茶匙姜黄（94 mg 姜黄素）占其 45%，而单粒 1,000 mg 姜黄素类化合物胶囊约为该限值的五倍。浓缩提取物还会抑制 CYP3A4 和 UGT 酶，并与抗凝药发生相互作用，食物剂量的姜黄没有这些问题。反向的第二条提示：把食用姜黄的量放大同样不是安全的替代做法，因为部分供应链的姜黄粉曾被掺入铬酸铅以增色（孟加拉国姜黄有充分记录），每天以克为单位服用香料级粉末会放大这类暴露。

Absorption吸收Curcumin is close to a worst case for oral absorption: poor solubility, extensive intestinal and hepatic glucuronidation and sulfation, and rapid biliary excretion leave systemic exposure at or below detection limits after dietary amounts. Co-administered piperine 20 mg raised curcumin bioavailability roughly 20-fold in humans (Shoba et al. 1998, PMID 9619120, verified as a 2000% increase), and modern phytosome, micellar and nanoparticle formulations claim 10 to 185-fold increases over unformulated powder. The practical consequence is that milligram equivalence between spice and supplement misleads in both directions: a formulated 500 mg extract can deliver more systemic curcumin than 30 g of raw powder, and the traditional practice of blooming turmeric in hot oil with black pepper is a crude version of the same trick.姜黄素在口服吸收上接近最差情形：溶解度低，在肠道和肝脏大量发生葡萄糖苷酸化与硫酸化，胆汁排泄迅速，摄入膳食量后全身暴露处于或低于检测限。人体试验中同服 20 mg 胡椒碱可使姜黄素生物利用度提高约 20 倍（Shoba 等 1998，PMID 9619120，核实为提高 2000%）；现代植物体、胶束和纳米颗粒制剂声称比未制剂化的粉末高出 10 至 185 倍。实际后果是，香料与补充剂之间按毫克对等的比较在两个方向上都会误导：一份制剂化的 500 mg 提取物进入体循环的姜黄素可能多于 30 g 生粉，而传统上把姜黄与黑胡椒一起在热油中炝香，其实是同一套技巧的粗糙版本。

Food data note食物数据说明The headline 3.14% curcumin figure, the two USDA portion weights, the per-teaspoon and per-tablespoon arithmetic, the 210 mg ADI and Shoba's 20-fold piperine effect all verified exactly. The curry powder range, the curcumin-to-total-curcuminoid ratio and the FDC ID could not be traced to their cited sources中。核心的 3.14% 姜黄素数值、两个 USDA 分量重量、每茶匙和每汤匙的换算、210 mg ADI 以及 Shoba 的胡椒碱 20 倍效应，全部逐项核实无误。咖喱粉的含量区间、姜黄素与总姜黄素类化合物的比例以及 FDC ID 无法追溯到所引来源。

Does the body make it身体是否自产Curcuminoids are plant polyketides: Curcuma longa builds them from feruloyl-CoA and malonyl-CoA using two type III polyketide synthases, diketide-CoA synthase and curcumin synthase. Humans have no phenylpropanoid pathway and no type III polyketide synthase, so curcumin is a xenobiotic the body can only absorb, conjugate and clear. Endogenous synthesis is irrelevant to the buying decision here, and the operative limit is pharmacokinetic: oral curcumin is glucuronidated and sulfated so fast that free plasma concentrations stay very low, which is why any case for it rests on trial evidence for a named indication and on the specific formulation used.姜黄素类是植物聚酮化合物: Curcuma longa 以 feruloyl-CoA 和 malonyl-CoA 为底物, 通过两种 III 型聚酮合酶 (diketide-CoA synthase 和 curcumin synthase) 合成。人体没有 phenylpropanoid 通路, 也没有 III 型聚酮合酶, 因此姜黄素是一种外源物, 机体只能吸收、结合和清除。内源合成与这里的购买决策无关, 真正起作用的限制是药代动力学: 口服姜黄素被葡糖醛酸化和硫酸化的速度极快, 游离血浆浓度始终很低, 所以任何理由都必须来自针对具体适应症的试验证据以及所用的具体制剂。

Pathway合成通路NOT APPLICABLE. Plant route only: phenylalanine through phenylalanine ammonia-lyase to feruloyl-CoA, then DCS and CURS type III polyketide synthases in Curcuma longa rhizome. Human handling is limited to UGT and SULT conjugation and colonic microbial degradation.NOT APPLICABLE。只有植物途径: 苯丙氨酸经 phenylalanine ammonia-lyase 生成 feruloyl-CoA, 随后在 Curcuma longa 根茎中由 DCS 和 CURS 两种 III 型聚酮合酶完成合成。人体的处理仅限于 UGT 和 SULT 结合以及结肠微生物降解。

Amount made自产量0 mg/day. Humans have no biosynthetic route to curcuminoids.0 mg/day。人体没有合成姜黄素类的途径。

Still matters when仍有意义的情形Only on trial evidence for a specific indication, with attention to the formulation used in that trial, since plain extract is poorly bioavailable, and to interactions through CYP and UGT pathways for anyone on prescription medicines. Safety screening also covers herb-induced liver injury with high-dose enhanced-absorption curcumin, associated with HLA-B*35:01, and piperine co-formulation, which raises exposure to other drugs.只能依据针对具体适应症的试验证据, 同时要注意该试验所用的制剂形式 (普通提取物生物利用度很低), 以及对正在服用处方药的人经 CYP 和 UGT 通路产生的相互作用。安全性方面还要考虑高剂量强化吸收型姜黄素引起的草本性肝损伤 (与 HLA-B*35:01 相关), 以及与胡椒碱共配方会提高其他药物的暴露。

Synthesis source合成来源PMID 19258320 (Katsuyama et al., J Biol Chem 2009;284:11160-11170). Merged with the recovered row 'Adaptogens, medicinal mushrooms and high-volume polyphenols' for the HLA-B*35:01 liver injury and piperine interaction points.

Refs.文献 Nelson J Med Chem 2017 PMID 28074653; iScience 2025 PMC12144411; Zhao PMID 38036015; Halegoua-DeMarzio PMID 36252717; Likhitsup PMID 39102266
SSDDFFDDBBXXMSM (methylsulfonylmethane)MSM（二甲基砜）
Verdict结论Skip it不必买
Evidence证据Grade DD 级
Dose tested已验证剂量Trials used 2 g/d (the 2023 trial) up to 6 g/d (the 2006 pilot). No effective dose is established.试验用量从 2 克/天（2023 年试验）到 6 克/天（2006 年预试验）。没有确立的有效剂量。
Who适用人群No population has a defensible claim.没有任何人群有站得住的理由。
Pros优点
  • A single 88-person trial reported a significant between-group difference in a knee quality-of-life composite score at 12 weeks.一项 88 人的试验报告，12 周时膝关节生活质量综合评分的组间差异显著。
  • Very low toxicity signal at the doses used.在所用剂量下毒性信号极低。
Cons缺点
  • The meta-analysis found 3 randomised trials and 326 patients, of which only ONE studied MSM at all. The other two studied DMSO. Reported pain reduction was a non-significant 6.34 mm on a visual analogue scale.meta 分析共找到 3 项随机试验、326 名患者，其中只有一项真正研究了 MSM，另外两项研究的是 DMSO。报告的疼痛下降为视觉模拟评分 6.34 毫米，不显著。
  • The 2008 systematic review covering 6 studies and 681 osteoarthritis patients found only 52 had ever received MSM in a controlled trial. That is the entire human evidence base.2008 年那篇系统综述涵盖 6 项研究、681 名骨关节炎患者，其中只有 52 人曾在对照试验中接受过 MSM。这就是全部的人体证据基础。
  • It is present in a large share of joint supplements, which inflates the price of combination products for no measured benefit.它出现在相当大比例的关节类产品中，抬高了复方产品的价格，却没有可测量的收益。
  • No characterised drug interactions, largely because almost nobody has looked. No pregnancy or lactation data.没有明确的药物相互作用，主要是因为几乎没有人研究过。没有妊娠和哺乳期数据。
What it does, and what happens without it它有什么作用，缺了会怎样

A small sulfur molecule sold for joint pain; no body process is known to need it.一种用于关节疼痛的小分子含硫化合物;目前未知有任何身体过程需要它。

No deficiency state exists不存在缺乏状态

In detail详细Methylsulfonylmethane is dimethyl sulfone, the oxidised metabolite of dimethyl sulfoxide, present in trace amounts in some foods and in the marine sulfur cycle. It is well absorbed and distributes widely, including into cerebrospinal fluid, and a fraction of its sulfur can enter the methionine and cysteine pools. That contribution is trivial next to dietary protein, which supplies all the sulfur amino acid a person needs. Proposed anti-inflammatory effects via NF-kB inhibition come from cell and animal work, and human osteoarthritis trials are small and short. Sulfur as an element is essential; MSM as a molecule is not, and no human enzyme or structure uses it.甲基磺酰基甲烷即二甲基砜,是二甲亚砜的氧化代谢产物,微量存在于部分食物和海洋硫循环中。它吸收良好,可广泛分布,包括进入脑脊液,其中一部分硫可进入蛋氨酸和半胱氨酸池。相较于提供人体所需全部含硫氨基酸的膳食蛋白质而言,这一贡献微不足道。所提出的通过NF-kB抑制发挥抗炎作用的证据来自细胞和动物实验,人体骨关节炎试验规模小且时间短。硫作为一种元素是必需的;MSM作为一种分子则不是,没有任何人体酶或结构需要它。

There is no deficiency state for this. It is not an essential nutrient, so being short of it is not a thing that can happen.它不存在缺乏状态。它不是必需营养素，所以“缺了它”这件事本身并不成立。

Source来源PMID 28300758 (Butawan, Benjamin & Bloomer, Methylsulfonylmethane: applications and safety of a novel dietary supplement, Nutrients 2017, DOI 10.3390/nu9030290)

Food and the body食物与身体
In food: Trace食物中：痕量 Dose from food: Out of reach靠吃达到剂量：达不到 Body makes it: Partly身体自产：部分自产 Food data: Low食物数据：低

TRACE survives as a label, since nobody claims food delivers grams of MSM, but the evidence behind it is void and the entry's food table has been withdrawn in full. Every number in the widely circulated MSM food table (cow's milk 3.30 mg/kg, coffee 1.60, tomato 0.86, alfalfa 0.77, tea 0.30, beer 0.18, Swiss chard 0.18, corn 0.11) comes from Pearson, Dawson & Lackey 1981, which is titled 'Naturally occurring levels of dimethyl sulfoxide in selected fruits, vegetables, grains, and beverages'. It measured DMSO, a different compound; a 2026 review reproduced those eight values under an MSM heading, and the mislabelling has propagated from there. The accurate statement is that the MSM content of ordinary foods is essentially unquantified in the accessible literature. Bulk supplement MSM is manufactured by oxidising DMSO with hydrogen peroxide or nitrogen dioxide and purifying by distillation or crystallisation, so this is functionally a synthetic bulk chemical with an unmeasured natural presence.TRACE（痕量）作为标签仍然成立，没人主张食物能提供克级的 MSM，但支撑它的证据已归零，本条目的食物表整体撤回。广为流传的 MSM 食物表里每一个数字（牛奶 3.30 mg/kg、咖啡 1.60、番茄 0.86、紫花苜蓿 0.77、茶 0.30、啤酒 0.18、瑞士甜菜 0.18、玉米 0.11）都来自 Pearson, Dawson & Lackey 1981，那篇论文的标题是“Naturally occurring levels of dimethyl sulfoxide in selected fruits, vegetables, grains, and beverages”。它测的是 DMSO，一种不同的化合物；2026 年一篇综述把那八个数值搬到了 MSM 的标题下，错误从此扩散。准确的说法是：在可获取的文献中，普通食物的 MSM 含量基本未经定量。散装补剂 MSM 由过氧化氢或二氧化氮氧化 DMSO 制得，再经蒸馏或结晶提纯，所以这实质上是一种散装合成化学品，其天然存在量未被测定。

No ordinary food supplies this in a meaningful amount.没有普通食物能提供有意义的量。

To match the dose要达到该剂量The gap cannot be computed, and the submission's figures (909 kg of milk for a 3 g dose, 1,875 litres of coffee, 450 kg of milk for the 1.5 g low end) are withdrawn because every one of them was built on DMSO measurements. Qualitatively the answer is still no: supplement doses are 1.5 to 6 g/day, no food has been shown to contain MSM at anything approaching that, and no MSM deficiency has ever been described. Anyone quoting a per-cup or per-kilogram MSM figure is quoting a mislabelled DMSO table.差距无法计算，原提交稿的数字（3 g 剂量需 909 kg 牛奶、1,875 升咖啡，1.5 g 低端需 450 kg 牛奶）全部撤回，因为它们都建立在 DMSO 的测定值上。定性的答案依然是否：补剂剂量为 1.5 到 6 g/天，没有任何食物被证明含有接近这一水平的 MSM，也从未有人描述过 MSM 缺乏。凡是引用每杯或每公斤 MSM 数字的人，引用的都是一张贴错标签的 DMSO 表。

Food vs supplement食物与补充剂Yes, and it is mostly about honesty in marketing. Commercial MSM is made by oxidising DMSO, so it is chemically identical to whatever trace natural molecule exists but industrially produced; purity grades differ (distilled versus crystallised) and residual DMSO or solvent is a real quality variable between brands. The common marketing move of pointing at garlic, onions and brassicas as natural MSM foods is wrong: those foods are rich in allicin, thiosulfinates and glucosinolates, which are different sulfur chemistries, and eating them does not deliver MSM. Dietary sulfur adequacy comes from methionine and cysteine in protein, a separate question entirely. No whole food substitutes for an MSM capsule, and equally there is no evidence anyone is MSM-deficient.有，而且主要关乎营销是否诚实。商品 MSM 由氧化 DMSO 制得，与任何微量天然分子在化学上完全相同，只是工业生产的；纯度等级有差别（蒸馏与结晶），残留 DMSO 或溶剂是品牌之间真实存在的质量变量。常见的营销做法是指着大蒜、洋葱和十字花科蔬菜说它们是天然 MSM 食物，这是错的：那些食物富含大蒜素、硫代亚磺酸酯和硫代葡萄糖苷，属于不同的硫化学，吃它们并不带来 MSM。膳食硫的充足性来自蛋白质中的甲硫氨酸和半胱氨酸，那是另一个问题。没有哪种完整食物能替代一粒 MSM 胶囊，同样也没有证据表明有人缺乏 MSM。

Absorption吸收Absorption is not the limiting factor. MSM is a small (94 Da), highly water-soluble, uncharged molecule, absorbed close to completely after oral dosing and distributed widely including across the blood-brain barrier, which is why it is detectable in cerebrospinal fluid. Circulating MSM in people who take no supplements comes partly from diet and partly from bacterial and endogenous metabolism of other sulfur compounds. Because uptake is near-complete either way, the food-versus-supplement comparison reduces entirely to dose, and the dose cannot currently be stated for food: the ratios the submission gave (about 1:3,700 per cup of milk, which it rounded to 1:4,000) rest on a DMSO measurement and are withdrawn.吸收不是限制因素。MSM 是小分子（94 Da），水溶性极强且不带电，口服后接近完全吸收并广泛分布，包括跨过血脑屏障，所以在脑脊液中可检出。不服用补剂的人循环中的 MSM，一部分来自饮食，一部分来自细菌和内源对其他硫化合物的代谢。由于两条途径的吸收都接近完全，食物与补剂的比较完全归结为剂量，而食物的剂量目前无法给出：原提交稿给的比例（每杯牛奶约 1:3,700，它四舍五入成 1:4,000）依赖的是 DMSO 的测定值，已撤回。

Food data note食物数据说明The entire food dataset for this entry was traced to a paper that measured dimethyl sulfoxide rather than dimethyl sulfone, so all seven food rows, all per-portion figures, all percentages of dose and both dose-gap calculations have been removed rather than corrected. The secondary review that relabelled the table is real and correctly cited (PMC13071705), which is precisely how the error travels. No verified quantification of MSM in any ordinary food is available to put in its place低。本条目的整个食物数据集被追溯到一篇测定二甲基亚砜而非二甲基砜的论文，因此七条食物条目、所有每份数值、所有占剂量百分比以及两项剂量差距计算全部删除而非更正。把该表重新贴标的二次综述真实存在且引用正确（PMC13071705），错误恰恰就是这样传播的。目前没有任何经核实的普通食物 MSM 定量数据可以补上。

Does the body make it身体是否自产Dimethyl sulfone is a normal trace constituent of human blood and cerebrospinal fluid in people taking no supplement, measured at 0 to 25 micromol/L, and host enzymes do produce it: thiol S-methyltransferase methylates methanethiol to dimethyl sulfide, and flavin-containing monooxygenases oxidise that to DMSO and then to dimethyl sulfone. What is not endogenous is the precursor supply, which comes mostly from bacterial methionine catabolism in the gut and from diet, and no human enzyme has MSM as its designated end product. There is no requirement, no deficiency state and no known physiological function, so the endogenous axis offers no repletion rationale at all and any claim has to stand on symptom trials.二甲基砜是未服用任何补充剂的人血液和脑脊液中的正常微量成分, 实测浓度为 0 到 25 micromol/L, 宿主的酶确实会生成它: thiol S-methyltransferase 把甲硫醇甲基化为二甲基硫, flavin-containing monooxygenases 再把它氧化为 DMSO, 进而氧化为二甲基砜。不属于内源的是前体供给, 它主要来自肠道细菌的 methionine 分解代谢和膳食, 而且没有任何人体酶以 MSM 作为其指定终产物。它没有需要量, 没有缺乏状态, 也没有已知生理功能, 所以内源性这一维度提供不了补足缺乏的理由, 任何主张只能依靠症状学试验。

Pathway合成通路No dedicated human biosynthetic pathway, though the terminal oxidation steps are host-catalysed. Methanethiol comes mainly from bacterial methionine catabolism in the gut and from the methionine transamination route; host thiol S-methyltransferase activity yields dimethyl sulfide, and further oxidation by flavin-containing monooxygenases gives DMSO and then dimethyl sulfone. Diet is a further source. A dimethyl sulfone finding was reported in 3 of 4 patients with severe methionine adenosyltransferase I/III deficiency (PMID 15996001), which is the human link between the pool and methionine handling.人体没有专门的生物合成通路, 不过最后的氧化步骤由宿主酶催化。甲硫醇主要来自肠道细菌的 methionine 分解代谢和 methionine 转氨途径; 宿主 thiol S-methyltransferase 活性生成二甲基硫, 再经 flavin-containing monooxygenases 进一步氧化为 DMSO, 随后为二甲基砜。膳食是另一个来源。在 4 名重度 methionine adenosyltransferase I/III 缺乏症患者中有 3 名报告了二甲基砜相关发现 (PMID 15996001), 这是这一物质池与 methionine 代谢之间的人体证据。

Amount made自产量NOT ESTABLISHED. Only circulating concentrations are documented: 0 to 25 micromol/L in plasma and CSF of healthy unsupplemented controls, against gram-scale supplement doses.NOT ESTABLISHED。已记录的只有循环浓度: 未补充的健康对照者血浆和脑脊液为 0 到 25 micromol/L, 而补充剂剂量在克级。

Still matters when仍有意义的情形Nothing on a repletion basis, because no requirement or deficiency exists. Use would have to rest on trial evidence for a specific symptom, and the usual claim (osteoarthritis pain) comes from small short trials.从补足缺乏的角度没有任何适用情形, 因为既无需要量也无缺乏状态。使用只能依据针对具体症状的试验证据, 而常见的主张 (骨关节炎疼痛) 来自规模小、周期短的试验。

Synthesis source合成来源PMID 15996001 (Engelke et al., NMR Biomed 2005;18:331-336; MAT I/III finding in 3 of 4 patients).

Refs.文献 Brien PMID 19474240; Brien PMID 18417375; Toguchi PMID 37447322
SSDDFFDDBBXXAstaxanthin虾青素
Verdict结论Skip it不必买
Evidence证据Grade DD 级
Dose tested已验证剂量4-12 mg/d in skin trials. EFSA acceptable daily intake is 0.2 mg/kg body weight, so 14 mg/d for a 70 kg adult.皮肤类试验为 4 至 12 毫克/天。EFSA 的每日允许摄入量为 0.2 毫克/公斤体重，70 公斤成人即 14 毫克/天。
Who适用人群Nobody with a demonstrated clinical outcome.没有任何人群有已证实的临床结局获益。
Pros优点
  • Small improvements in skin moisture (ES 0.53) and elasticity (ES 0.77) across 9 oral randomised trials.9 项口服随机试验显示皮肤含水量（ES 0.53）和弹性（ES 0.77）有小幅改善。
  • One oxidative-stress marker, advanced oxidation protein products, fell significantly after exercise.一个氧化应激指标，即晚期氧化蛋白产物，在运动后显著下降。
Cons缺点
  • The core selling point is a test-tube potency ratio, often quoted as 1,000 times coenzyme Q10 at quenching singlet oxygen. That is an in-vitro number with no demonstrated clinical consequence, and it is exactly the kind of assay-derived claim the PAINS critique warns about.它的核心卖点是一个试管里的效力倍数，常被引用为“淬灭单线态氧的能力是辅酶 Q10 的 1000 倍”。那是一个体外数字，没有证明出任何临床后果，而这正是 PAINS 批评所警告的那类由测定衍生出来的说法。
  • Wrinkle depth, the outcome consumers actually buy it for, was NOT significant (-0.26, 95% CI -0.58 to 0.06).皱纹深度，也就是消费者真正为之买单的指标，并不显著（-0.26，95% CI -0.58 至 0.06）。
  • In exercise trials MDA, TBARS, superoxide dismutase, sulfhydryls, creatine kinase and IL-6 were all non-significant, directly contradicting the antioxidant marketing.在运动试验中，MDA、TBARS、超氧化物歧化酶、巯基、肌酸激酶和 IL-6 全部不显著，与其抗氧化营销直接冲突。
  • EFSA noted that children exceed the acceptable daily intake with 8 mg/d supplements, so the common commercial 12 mg dose exceeds the safe intake for a 40 kg adolescent.EFSA 指出，8 毫克/天的补充剂就会让儿童超过每日允许摄入量，因此常见的 12 毫克商业剂量已超过 40 公斤青少年的安全摄入水平。
  • Krill-derived astaxanthin in shellfish allergy. Reported 5-alpha-reductase inhibition is poorly characterised and matters in hormone-sensitive conditions.甲壳类过敏者注意磷虾来源的虾青素。有报告称其抑制 5α-还原酶，特性不明，对激素敏感性疾病有影响。
What it does, and what happens without it它有什么作用，缺了会怎样

A red algal pigment that sits inside cell membranes. Humans have no requirement for it.一种存在于细胞膜内的红色藻类色素。人体对它没有摄入需求。

No deficiency state exists不存在缺乏状态

In detail详细Astaxanthin is a xanthophyll carotenoid produced by the microalga Haematococcus pluvialis and concentrated up the food chain into salmon, trout, shrimp and flamingo feathers. Polar keto and hydroxyl groups on both ionone rings let the molecule span the lipid bilayer, which underlies claims that it quenches singlet oxygen and lipid radicals more efficiently than beta-carotene. Unlike beta-carotene it has no provitamin A activity in humans: it is not cleaved to retinal and cannot contribute to vitamin A status. Humans cannot synthesize it and have no need to, since no metabolic process requires it and no intake recommendation exists.虾青素是由雨生红球藻产生的一种叶黄素类类胡萝卜素,经食物链富集进入鲑鱼、鳟鱼、虾以及火烈鸟羽毛。其两个紫罗兰酮环上的极性酮基和羟基使该分子能够横跨脂质双分子层,这也是它被认为比β-胡萝卜素更有效地淬灭单线态氧和脂质自由基的依据。与β-胡萝卜素不同,它在人体内没有维生素A原活性:它不会被裂解为视黄醛,也不能对维生素A状态有所贡献。人体无法合成它,也没有合成它的需要,因为没有任何代谢过程需要它,也不存在摄入推荐量。

There is no deficiency state for this. It is not an essential nutrient, so being short of it is not a thing that can happen.它不存在缺乏状态。它不是必需营养素，所以“缺了它”这件事本身并不成立。

Source来源PMID 7562082 (Jyonouchi H, Sun S, Tomita Y, Gross MD, astaxanthin, a carotenoid without vitamin A activity, augments antibody responses in cultures including T-helper cell clones and suboptimal doses of antigen, J Nutr 1995;125(10):2483-92); EFSA Panel opinion on the safety of astaxanthin, EFSA Journal 2019

Food and the body食物与身体
In food: Rich食物中：丰富 Dose from food: Partly靠吃达到剂量：部分 Body makes it: Cannot身体自产：不能 Food data: Medium食物数据：中

Astaxanthin is genuinely present at milligram levels in ordinary seafood, so this is the strongest food case in the set. Wild sockeye salmon carries 26 to 38 mg per kg of flesh, meaning one 140 g fillet supplies 3.6 to 5.3 mg, the same order of magnitude as a capsule. Several standard sources in the same literature carry no verified figure here and so get no row: salmon roe (ikura and sujiko), wild chinook, pink and chum salmon, Arctic char, red sea bream, and the shell-on preparations (crayfish, small crab, head-on prawns) where the pigment actually concentrates.虾青素确实以毫克级存在于常见海产中，这是本组里食物依据最强的一项。野生红鲑（sockeye）鱼肉含 26 至 38 mg/kg，一片 140 g 的鱼柳可提供 3.6 至 5.3 mg，与一粒胶囊同一数量级。同一批文献中还有若干标准来源此处没有经核实的数值，故不单列：鲑鱼卵（ikura 咸鲑鱼子和 sujiko 筋子）、野生大鳞大麻哈鱼（chinook）、粉鲑（pink salmon）和大麻哈鱼（chum salmon）、北极红点鲑（Arctic char）、真鲷，以及色素实际富集其中的带壳做法（小龙虾、小蟹、带头虾）。

To match the dose要达到该剂量A 12 mg daily dose, the commonest in the clinical literature, equals 315 to 460 g of wild sockeye salmon every day at 26 to 38 mg/kg, or about 550 g using the cited review's own dietary anchor of 3.6 mg per 165 g portion. From farmed Atlantic salmon it is 1.5 to 2.0 kg per day, from peeled shrimp meat about 1.4 kg, and from whole wet krill 1.2 to 1.5 kg. A single 140 g sockeye fillet already covers 30 to 44% of the dose, which no other entry here manages, so a meaningful fraction is reachable by eating while the full dose is not: sustaining 350 to 500 g of oily fish daily would push past standard advice on methylmercury and persistent organic pollutants.临床文献中最常见的每天 12 mg 剂量，按 26 至 38 mg/kg 计相当于每天吃 315 至 460 g 野生红鲑，若按所引综述自身的膳食参照（每 165 g 一份含 3.6 mg）计算则约为 550 g。换成养殖大西洋鲑是每天 1.5 至 2.0 kg，去壳虾肉约 1.4 kg，整只湿重磷虾 1.2 至 1.5 kg。单是一片 140 g 的红鲑鱼柳就已覆盖该剂量的 30 至 44%，这是此处其他条目都做不到的，所以靠吃可以拿到相当一部分，全量则不行：每天持续吃 350 至 500 g 多脂鱼会突破关于甲基汞和持久性有机污染物的常规建议。

Food vs supplement食物与补充剂Chemical form differs by source. Salmon astaxanthin is largely free or protein-bound; krill and Haematococcus astaxanthin is esterified with fatty acids; and much supplement and feed astaxanthin is synthetic astaxanthin dimethyldisuccinate, a different stereoisomer mixture from the natural 3S,3'S form. This matters for the safety arithmetic: EFSA's acceptable daily intake of 0.2 mg/kg body weight per day (14 mg for a 70 kg adult, established by the FEEDAP Panel in 2019 and replacing the earlier 0.034 mg/kg) was derived from a rat carcinogenicity study on the synthetic material and then applied to the algal form. On that ADI, a 12 mg capsule is 86% of the limit and sits just under it, doses of about 14 mg and above exceed it, and a 24 mg capsule is roughly 1.7 times over, while a salmon fillet stays well below. A safety review of 87 human studies, including 35 at 12 mg/day or more, found no safety concerns with natural astaxanthin and argues the synthetic-derived ADI should not govern it (Brendler & Williamson, Phytother Res 2019;33(12):3090-3111, PMID 31788888, DOI 10.1002/ptr.6514). One honest twist: the astaxanthin in farmed salmon is itself an added feed pigment, so eating farmed salmon for astaxanthin means eating a supplemented animal.化学形态因来源而异。鲑鱼中的虾青素以游离型或与蛋白结合的形式为主；磷虾和雨生红球藻（Haematococcus）的虾青素与脂肪酸成酯；补充剂和饲料中大量使用的是合成虾青素二甲基二琥珀酸酯，其立体异构体组成与天然的 3S,3'S 型不同。这影响安全性的算法：EFSA 的每日允许摄入量为每天 0.2 mg/kg 体重（70 kg 成人为 14 mg，由 FEEDAP 专家组于 2019 年确定，取代此前的 0.034 mg/kg），该值源自对合成品的大鼠致癌性研究，随后被套用到藻源形态上。按此 ADI，12 mg 胶囊占限值的 86%，略低于限值；约 14 mg 及以上的剂量超出限值；24 mg 胶囊约为限值的 1.7 倍；一片鲑鱼柳则远低于限值。一项覆盖 87 项人体研究（其中 35 项剂量为每天 12 mg 及以上）的安全性综述未发现天然虾青素存在安全性问题，并认为由合成品推导出的 ADI 不应适用于它（Brendler & Williamson, Phytother Res 2019;33(12):3090-3111, PMID 31788888, DOI 10.1002/ptr.6514）。还有一处需要如实指出：养殖鲑鱼里的虾青素本身就是饲料中添加的色素，为了虾青素而吃养殖鲑鱼，等于吃一条已经补充过的动物。

Absorption吸收Astaxanthin is a lipophilic xanthophyll and absorption depends on fat and micelle formation: uptake from a lipid-based formulation or a fatty meal is severalfold higher than from a dry powder taken fasted, and esterified forms must first be hydrolysed by pancreatic lipase. Overall human bioavailability is low and highly variable (single-digit percentages), which cuts in favour of the food: salmon arrives pre-packaged with its own lipid and a food matrix, so the plasma difference between a 4 mg fillet and a 12 mg dry capsule is smaller than the milligram gap implies.虾青素是亲脂性的叶黄素类色素，吸收依赖脂肪和胶束形成：脂质基质制剂或高脂餐条件下的吸收比空腹服用干粉高数倍，成酯形态还须先由胰脂肪酶水解。人体总体生物利用度低且个体差异很大（个位数百分比），这一点对食物有利：鲑鱼自带脂质和食物基质，所以一片含 4 mg 的鱼柳与一粒 12 mg 干粉胶囊之间的血浆差距，小于毫克数所暗示的差距。

Food data note食物数据说明Every salmonid figure verified exactly against its source (sockeye 26 to 38 mg/kg, Atlantic 6 to 8, trout 6 and 25, the 165 g / 3.6 mg anchor, retail sockeye 14.2 and coho 7.0 mg/kg), as did the EFSA ADI and the Brendler review. The salmonid values still rest on a compiled review figure, the shrimp span is paywalled and indicative, and the krill row is a wet-weight reconstruction rather than a measured food value中。所有鲑科鱼类的数值都已逐项对照来源核实（红鲑 26 至 38 mg/kg，大西洋鲑 6 至 8，虹鳟 6 和 25，165 g / 3.6 mg 参照，零售红鲑 14.2、银鲑 7.0 mg/kg），EFSA 的 ADI 和 Brendler 综述同样核实无误。鲑科数值仍建立在一份汇编综述的图表数据上，虾的区间在付费墙之后属参考性数据，磷虾那一行是按湿重推算的重建值，并非实测的食物数值。

Does the body make it身体是否自产Astaxanthin is a ketocarotenoid produced by microalgae such as Haematococcus pluvialis and by some bacteria and yeasts, using a beta-carotene ketolase (BKT/CrtW) plus a hydroxylase (CrtZ). Humans synthesise no carotenoids whatsoever and cannot convert beta-carotene into astaxanthin, and salmon and shrimp are pink from the astaxanthin in their food rather than from their own synthesis. Everything in a human body reflects intake, there is no deficiency state to correct and no provitamin A activity to fall back on, so the supplement stands or falls on trial results.虾青素是一种酮式类胡萝卜素, 由 Haematococcus pluvialis 等微藻以及部分细菌和酵母利用 beta-carotene ketolase (BKT/CrtW) 加羟化酶 (CrtZ) 生成。人体完全不合成任何类胡萝卜素, 也无法把 beta-carotene 转成虾青素; 三文鱼和虾呈粉色来自其食物中的虾青素, 它们自己也不合成。人体内的全部虾青素都反映摄入量, 没有需要纠正的缺乏状态, 也没有维生素 A 原活性可以退守, 因此这种补充剂的成败完全取决于试验结果。

Pathway合成通路NOT APPLICABLE. Algal and microbial route: beta-carotene to echinenone to canthaxanthin by BKT/CrtW ketolase, with CrtZ/CrtR-b hydroxylation to adonirubin and astaxanthin. No human homologue of any step.NOT APPLICABLE。藻类和微生物途径: beta-carotene 经 BKT/CrtW 酮化酶生成 echinenone, 再生成 canthaxanthin, 并由 CrtZ/CrtR-b 羟化生成 adonirubin 和虾青素。上述任何步骤在人体内都没有同源物。

Amount made自产量0 mg/day. Humans have no carotenoid biosynthetic pathway.0 mg/day。人体没有类胡萝卜素生物合成通路。

Still matters when仍有意义的情形Only where trial evidence supports a defined endpoint. With no requirement and no deficiency state, dose selection is entirely empirical.仅在有试验证据支持某个明确终点时才有意义。既没有需要量也没有缺乏状态, 剂量选择完全是经验性的。

Verdict结论Skip it不必买
Evidence证据Grade DD 级
Dose tested已验证剂量3 g/d, usually as three 1 g doses. No dose or duration rescues the result in trained people.3 克/天，通常分三次每次 1 克。在训练有素者身上，任何剂量或时长都救不回这个结果。
Who适用人群On the balance of umbrella reviews, at most untrained beginners or clinically muscle-wasting populations.综合伞式综述来看，最多适用于未受训练的初学者，或有临床肌肉消耗的人群。
Pros优点
  • An umbrella review of 11 studies and 41 datasets found small but significant pooled effects on muscle mass (ES 0.21), muscle strength index (0.27) and fat-free mass (0.22).一项涵盖 11 项研究、41 个数据集的伞式综述发现，肌肉质量（ES 0.21）、肌力指数（0.27）和去脂体重（0.22）有小但显著的合并效应。
  • No established contraindication, no drug interaction and not a doping risk.没有已确立的禁忌，没有药物相互作用，也不构成兴奋剂风险。
Cons缺点
  • In trained and competitive athletes it is a flat null across every endpoint. Six randomised trials, n=193: bench press effect size 0.00, leg press 0.09, body mass -0.01, fat-free mass 0.16, fat mass -0.20, all non-significant and described by the authors as trivial. Results were unchanged by dose, duration, training level or dietary co-intervention.在训练有素和竞技运动员中，所有终点上都是彻底的阴性。6 项随机试验，n=193：卧推效应量 0.00，腿举 0.09，体重 -0.01，去脂体重 0.16，脂肪量 -0.20，全部不显著，作者形容为微不足道。剂量、时长、训练水平或饮食联合干预都不改变结果。
  • An umbrella review of 15 systematic reviews found only 5 favoured HMB for lean soft-tissue mass; 10 reported no difference or insufficient evidence.一项涵盖 15 篇系统综述的伞式综述发现，只有 5 篇支持 HMB 对瘦软组织质量有益，10 篇报告无差异或证据不足。
  • Its reputation was built on a handful of early trials from a small number of affiliated laboratories and never replicated independently in trained athletes.它的声誉建立在少数几家关联实验室的早期试验之上，从未在训练有素的运动员中被独立重复。
  • One of the more expensive ingredients per gram, so it displaces spend from protein and creatine, which work.按克计是较贵的成分之一，因此挤占了本可用于蛋白和肌酸这两样真正有效东西的预算。
What it does, and what happens without it它有什么作用，缺了会怎样

A leucine metabolite that slows muscle protein loss during illness, bed rest or ageing.亮氨酸的一种代谢产物,可减缓疾病、卧床或衰老期间肌肉蛋白的流失。

No deficiency state exists不存在缺乏状态

In detail详细Beta-hydroxy-beta-methylbutyrate is a downstream metabolite of the amino acid leucine. About 5 percent of leucine catabolism proceeds through ketoisocaproate to HMB, so at ordinary protein intakes the body produces only about 0.2 to 0.4 g a day from dietary leucine, and preformed HMB in food (grapefruit, catfish, alfalfa, corn silage) is present in milligram quantities and contributes essentially nothing. The scale is easier to see from the other direction: obtaining a typical 3 g supplemental dose from food would require the 60 g of leucine contained in over 600 g of high quality protein. Its main described action is suppression of muscle proteolysis through the ubiquitin-proteasome pathway, with a weaker effect on mTOR-mediated protein synthesis than leucine itself. Clinical interest sits in muscle-wasting settings such as bed rest, older adults and cancer cachexia. It is a metabolite of an essential amino acid, not an essential nutrient in its own right.β-羟基-β-甲基丁酸是氨基酸亮氨酸的下游代谢产物。亮氨酸分解代谢中约5%经α-酮异己酸途径生成HMB,因此在通常的蛋白质摄入水平下,人体每天仅由膳食亮氨酸生成约0.2至0.4 g HMB,而食物(西柚、鲶鱼、苜蓿、青贮玉米)中天然存在的HMB仅为毫克级,贡献基本可以忽略。从另一个角度更容易看出其量级:要从食物中获得典型的3 g补充剂量,需要摄入600多克优质蛋白质中所含的60 g亮氨酸。其已知的主要作用是通过泛素蛋白酶体途径抑制肌肉蛋白水解,对mTOR介导的蛋白质合成的促进作用则弱于亮氨酸本身。临床关注点在于肌肉消耗相关情境,如卧床、老年人和癌症恶病质。它是一种必需氨基酸的代谢产物,本身并非必需营养素。

There is no deficiency state for this. It is not an essential nutrient, so being short of it is not a thing that can happen.它不存在缺乏状态。它不是必需营养素，所以“缺了它”这件事本身并不成立。

Source来源PMID 23374455 (Wilson et al., International Society of Sports Nutrition position stand: beta-hydroxy-beta-methylbutyrate, J Int Soc Sports Nutr 2013, PMC3568064)

Food and the body食物与身体
In food: None食物中：无 Dose from food: Out of reach靠吃达到剂量：达不到 Body makes it: Partly身体自产：部分自产 Food data: High食物数据：高

HMB (beta-hydroxy-beta-methylbutyrate) is manufactured, by halogenation of diacetone alcohol with sodium hypobromite or by esterification routes from diacetone alcohol and acetic acid derivatives, at plant scales around 1.5 tonnes per month, with microbial routes emerging (Galactomyces reessii 29.0 g/L, engineered E. coli 17.7 g/L). No food composition database carries an HMB value, and the frequently repeated claim that it occurs in catfish, grapefruit and alfalfa has no quantified composition analysis behind it; an independent literature query returned five papers, none with a food figure. Endogenous production of 0.3-0.4 g/day in healthy adults is metabolism rather than a dietary source, so the earlier TRACE label overstated the dietary presence.HMB（β-羟基-β-甲基丁酸）是工业合成的，路线包括用次溴酸钠对双丙酮醇进行卤化，或由双丙酮醇与乙酸衍生物经酯化制得，工厂规模约每月 1.5 吨，微生物路线正在兴起（Galactomyces reessii 29.0 g/L，工程化 E. coli 17.7 g/L）。没有任何食物成分数据库收录 HMB 数值，而反复流传的“存在于鲶鱼、葡萄柚和紫花苜蓿中”的说法背后没有定量成分分析；一次独立的文献检索返回五篇论文，均无食物数值。健康成年人每天 0.3-0.4 g 的内源生成属于代谢过程，算不上膳食来源，所以此前的 TRACE（微量）标签高估了它在膳食中的存在。

No ordinary food supplies this in a meaningful amount.没有普通食物能提供有意义的量。

To match the dose要达到该剂量There is no food HMB figure to work from, so the gap has to be argued through the precursor. About 80% of leucine is directed to protein synthesis, and approximately 5-10% of alpha-ketoisocaproate, the leucine transamination product, is converted to HMB; treating that 5-10% as a leucine-to-HMB yield is generous, so the arithmetic below is a ceiling. Even on that generous reading, 3 g of HMB implies about 60 g of leucine per day, which is 2.6 kg of cooked chicken breast at 2.33 g leucine per 100 g, carrying roughly 800 g of protein. At the optimistic 10% figure it is 30 g of leucine, about 1.3 kg of cooked breast and 400 g of protein. Measured endogenous output in healthy adults is only 0.3-0.4 g/day, 8 to 20 times below the 3-6 g/day used in trials, and eating more protein or leucine does not move it, because the bottleneck is the branched-chain pathway rather than the intake.没有食物 HMB 数值可用，只能通过前体来论证这个差距。约 80% 的亮氨酸被导向蛋白质合成，亮氨酸转氨产物 α-酮异己酸中大约 5-10% 转化为 HMB；把这 5-10% 当作亮氨酸到 HMB 的产率已经很宽松，所以下面的算术是一个上限。即便按这种宽松读法，3 g HMB 也意味着每天约 60 g 亮氨酸，按熟鸡胸每 100 g 含 2.33 g 亮氨酸计算是 2.6 kg 熟鸡胸，随之带来约 800 g 蛋白质。按乐观的 10% 计算是 30 g 亮氨酸，约 1.3 kg 熟鸡胸和 400 g 蛋白质。健康成年人实测的内源产量只有 0.3-0.4 g/天，比试验所用的 3-6 g/天低 8 到 20 倍，多吃蛋白质或亮氨酸也无法提高，因为瓶颈是支链氨基酸通路的容量，摄入量本身并不构成限制。

Food vs supplement食物与补充剂The supplement is a manufactured molecule and not a food extract, so there is no whole-food-versus-extract comparison to make and no reason to describe HMB as something a diet can supply. Regulatory reviews treat 3-6 g/day as generally safe while noting that no international consensus on an optimal dose exists. The one form question that matters commercially is calcium HMB monohydrate versus free-acid HMB, which differ in absorption kinetics rather than in origin. Primary source for the manufacturing, endogenous production and conversion figures: Zhou S, Liu G, Wang Z, Lei Z, Chen W, Wang C, Foods 2025;14(8):1294, PMID 40282696, DOI 10.3390/foods14081294.这种补充剂是工业合成的分子，并非食物提取物，因此没有整食与提取物的比较可做，也没有理由把 HMB 描述成饮食能够提供的东西。监管评审把 3-6 g/天视为总体安全，同时指出最佳剂量尚无国际共识。商业上唯一有意义的形式问题是一水 HMB 钙与游离酸型 HMB 之别，两者的差异在吸收动力学上，来源相同。制造工艺、内源生成和转化率数据的原始来源：Zhou S, Liu G, Wang Z, Lei Z, Chen W, Wang C, Foods 2025;14(8):1294, PMID 40282696, DOI 10.3390/foods14081294。

Absorption吸收There is no food form whose absorption can be compared, so the only meaningful statement is about the pathway. Dietary leucine is not a usable precursor at supplement scale: about 80% of leucine goes to protein synthesis, and roughly 5-10% of alpha-ketoisocaproate, the leucine transamination product, is converted to HMB, which is why raising protein or leucine intake lifts endogenous HMB only marginally and total endogenous output stays at 0.3-0.4 g/day (DOI 10.3390/foods14081294). Between the two supplement forms, free-acid HMB is reported to reach peak plasma concentration faster and higher than calcium HMB monohydrate, which is the main practical bioavailability distinction; both bypass the leucine pathway entirely, which is precisely why the supplement exists.不存在可供比较吸收的食物形式，所以唯一有意义的说法关于通路本身。在补充剂的量级上，膳食亮氨酸不是可用的前体：约 80% 的亮氨酸走向蛋白质合成，亮氨酸转氨产物 α-酮异己酸中约 5-10% 转化为 HMB，这就是提高蛋白质或亮氨酸摄入只能让内源 HMB 略有上升、内源总产量始终停在 0.3-0.4 g/天的原因（DOI 10.3390/foods14081294）。两种补充剂形式之间，据报告游离酸型 HMB 比一水 HMB 钙达峰更快、峰值更高，这是实际中主要的生物利用度区别；两者都完全绕开亮氨酸通路，这正是这类补充剂存在的理由。

Food data note食物数据说明All five manufacturing and endogenous production figures were confirmed verbatim against Foods 2025;14(8):1294, the leucine-route arithmetic was re-derived and held, and the negative claim that no database carries an HMB value and that the catfish/grapefruit/alfalfa story has no quantified backing survived independent adversarial checking. The item has no food rows because no defensible food figure exists高。五项制造与内源生成数据全部对照 Foods 2025;14(8):1294 逐字确认，亮氨酸路线的算术重新推导并成立，而“没有数据库收录 HMB 数值”以及“鲶鱼、葡萄柚、紫花苜蓿的说法缺乏定量依据”这两条否定性论断经过独立的对抗式检验仍然站得住。本项没有食物行，因为不存在站得住脚的食物数值。

Does the body make it身体是否自产HMB is a normal human metabolite of leucine, made whenever leucine is metabolised, but only about 5 percent of whole-body leucine flux takes that branch, which comes to roughly 0.2 to 0.4 g/day in a 70 kg adult. The studied dose is 3 g/day, and reaching that from food would take about 60 g of leucine, over 600 g of high quality protein, so endogenous production is real yet roughly a tenth of the dose being tested. That makes supplementation a coherent premise on this axis and hardly a duplication, while whether 3 g/day does anything useful in healthy trained people is a separate and much weaker question, and the form matters, since the free acid and the calcium salt differ in absorption rate and peak plasma concentration.HMB 是 leucine 的正常人体代谢产物, leucine 被代谢时就会生成, 但只有全身 leucine 通量的约 5% 走这个分支, 在 70 kg 成人相当于每天约 0.2 到 0.4 g。被研究的剂量是 3 g/day, 靠食物达到需要约 60 g leucine, 即超过 600 g 优质蛋白, 所以内源生成真实存在, 却只有受试剂量的十分之一左右。这使补充在这条轴上成为自洽的前提, 谈不上重复; 3 g/day 在健康训练人群里是否有用是另一个证据弱得多的问题, 剂型也有影响, 游离酸与钙盐在吸收速率和血浆峰浓度上不同。

Pathway合成通路Leucine is reversibly transaminated to alpha-ketoisocaproate (KIC) by mitochondrial branched-chain aminotransferase (BCAT2) in muscle. A minority of KIC is oxidised in the cytosol, largely in liver, to HMB by the enzyme identified as 4-hydroxyphenylpyruvate dioxygenase (HPD), so HMB production is a side activity of a tyrosine-catabolism enzyme. HMB is partly converted to HMG-CoA and enters cholesterol synthesis inside the myocyte.leucine 在肌肉中由线粒体 branched-chain aminotransferase (BCAT2) 可逆转氨为 alpha-ketoisocaproate (KIC)。少部分 KIC 在胞质中被氧化为 HMB, 主要在肝, 催化该反应的酶已鉴定为 4-hydroxyphenylpyruvate dioxygenase (HPD), 因此 HMB 的生成是一个 tyrosine 分解酶的副反应。HMB 部分转化为 HMG-CoA, 在肌细胞内进入胆固醇合成。

Amount made自产量About 0.2 to 0.4 g/day in a 70 kg adult, varying with dietary leucine (Nissen S, Abumrad NN, J Nutr Biochem 1997;8:300-11; reviewed PMID 28493406). Roughly 5 percent of whole-body leucine flux is converted to HMB (PMID 28493406), against a studied dose of 3 g/day.70 kg 成人每天约 0.2 到 0.4 g, 随膳食 leucine 变化 (Nissen S, Abumrad NN, J Nutr Biochem 1997;8:300-11; 综述见 PMID 28493406)。全身 leucine 通量的约 5% 转化为 HMB (PMID 28493406), 而受试剂量为 3 g/day。

Still matters when仍有意义的情形Catabolic and disuse states where the muscle-sparing data are strongest: bed rest, immobilisation, sarcopenia, cachexia, hypocaloric dieting and clinical recovery. In trained, well-fed lifters the effect sizes are small and contested. The axis does not rule HMB out, because supplemental doses are an order of magnitude above endogenous output.肌肉保护数据最强的分解代谢和失用状态: 卧床, 制动, 肌少症, 恶病质, 低热量饮食和临床康复期。在训练有素, 营养充足的举重者中, 效应量小且有争议。这条轴并不排除 HMB, 因为补充剂量比内源产量高出一个数量级。

Synthesis source合成来源PMID 1733247 (Van Koevering M, Nissen S, Am J Physiol 1992;262:E27-31, HMB derived from leucine via KIC); PMC3568064 (Wilson JM et al., ISSN position stand: HMB); PMID 28493406. Merged from the recovered entries HMB and Inositol, glucosamine, beta-alanine and HMB.

Refs.文献 Sanchez-Martinez PMID 29249685; Phillips PMID 35818771; Bideshki PMID 39797501
SSAAFFDDBBXXGinkgo biloba银杏叶
Verdict结论Skip it不必买
Evidence证据Grade AA 级
Dose tested已验证剂量240 mg/d of EGb 761, which is the dose that failed in both prevention trials.EGb 761 240 毫克/天，这正是两项预防试验中失败的剂量。
Who适用人群Nobody, for preventing dementia. Possibly people with established dementia, on low-certainty evidence.在预防痴呆上没有适用人群。可能适用于已确诊痴呆者，但证据确定性低。
Pros优点
  • The 2026 Cochrane review of 82 studies and 10,613 participants found uncertain benefit for global clinical status at 6 months in people with cognitive complaints, at low certainty.2026 年 Cochrane 综述纳入 82 项研究、10613 名受试者，发现有认知主诉者在 6 个月时整体临床状态可能获益，确定性为低。
  • Unusually good long-term human safety data for a botanical: 240 mg/d for about 6 years in GEM without a safety signal.对一款植物类产品而言，长期人体安全数据异常充分：GEM 试验中 240 毫克/天用了约 6 年，未见安全信号。
Cons缺点
  • It is the strongest example in this document of a product that survived its own definitive trials. GEM randomised 3,069 older adults to 240 mg/d for a median 6.1 years: all-cause dementia HR 1.12 (0.94-1.33), Alzheimer disease HR 1.16 (0.97-1.39). The point estimates are above 1.它是本文中“在自己的决定性试验之后依然活着”的最强例子。GEM 把 3069 名老年人随机到 240 毫克/天，中位随访 6.1 年：全因痴呆 HR 1.12（0.94-1.33），阿尔茨海默病 HR 1.16（0.97-1.39）。点估计值都在 1 以上。
  • GuidAge replicated the null in 2,854 adults over 5 years.GuidAge 在 2854 名成人中随访 5 年，重复了这个阴性结果。
  • The bleeding question is genuinely contested rather than settled. A meta-analysis of 18 trials in 1,985 adults found no significant effect on platelet aggregation or coagulation parameters, but case reports of bleeding exist and stopping before elective surgery is prudent.出血的问题确实存在争议，而非已有定论。一项 18 项试验、1985 名成人的 meta 分析未发现对血小板聚集或凝血指标有显著影响，但出血的个案报告确实存在，择期手术前停用是稳妥做法。
  • Only standardised extracts have any data behind them. Unstandardised leaf products have none.只有标准化提取物背后有数据。非标准化的叶类产品没有任何数据。
What it does, and what happens without it它有什么作用，缺了会怎样

A leaf extract sold for memory; it is not a nutrient and nothing requires it.一种用于改善记忆的叶片提取物,它不是营养素,人体也不需要它。

No deficiency state exists不存在缺乏状态

In detail详细Standardised extracts such as EGb 761 contain about 24% flavone glycosides and 6% terpene lactones, the latter comprising ginkgolides A, B and C plus bilobalide, with ginkgolide B acting as a platelet-activating factor antagonist. The largest prevention trial, the Ginkgo Evaluation of Memory study, randomised 3069 community volunteers aged 75 and over and followed them for a median 6.1 years, finding no reduction in all-cause dementia or Alzheimer disease. Ginkgolides and bilobalide are plant terpenoids absent from human metabolism, so no shortfall is possible from not taking them. The clinically relevant issue is the opposite direction: antiplatelet effect layered onto anticoagulants or aspirin.标准化提取物如EGb 761含约24%黄酮苷及6%萜内酯,后者包括银杏内酯A、B、C(ginkgolides A、B、C)和白果内酯(bilobalide),其中银杏内酯B是血小板活化因子的拮抗剂。规模最大的预防性试验,即银杏记忆评估研究,纳入3069名75岁及以上的社区志愿者,中位随访6.1年,结果显示对全因痴呆或阿尔茨海默病(Alzheimer disease)没有降低作用。银杏内酯和白果内酯是植物萜类化合物,人体代谢中不存在,因此不摄入它们不会造成任何短缺。真正具有临床意义的问题方向恰恰相反:抗血小板作用叠加在抗凝药或阿司匹林之上。

There is no deficiency state for this. It is not an essential nutrient, so being short of it is not a thing that can happen.它不存在缺乏状态。它不是必需营养素，所以“缺了它”这件事本身并不成立。

Source来源PMID 19017911 (DeKosky et al., JAMA 2008;300:2253-2262, Ginkgo biloba for prevention of dementia, GEM trial)

Food and the body食物与身体
In food: Not food食物中：非食物 Dose from food: Out of reach靠吃达到剂量：达不到 Body makes it: Cannot身体自产：不能 Food data: Medium食物数据：中

The supplement is a concentrated leaf extract, and ginkgo leaf is not a food: it is processed with acetone-water into a standardised extract, of which EGb 761 is the reference, at a drug-to-extract ratio of 35-67:1 containing 22-27% flavone glycosides and 5-7% terpene lactones (2.8-3.4% ginkgolides A, B and C plus 2.6-3.2% bilobalide) with ginkgolic acids held below 5 ppm. The same species does have a real food form, and this is what a flat NOT_FOOD label conceals: ginkgo NUTS are eaten in Japanese chawanmushi, Chinese congee and Korean dishes, and they are chemically a different proposition from the leaf. Seeds carry ginkgotoxin (4'-O-methylpyridoxine and its 5'-glucoside), a vitamin B6 antagonist, at total mature-stage contents of 249-296 ug/g measured across three Chinese samples (249.30, 295.62 and 267.85 ug/g; Gong H et al., J Agric Food Chem 2018;66(30):7916-7922, PMID 29975518). Seeds do contain flavonoids and terpene trilactones occur in several tissues, but nothing in the seed approaches the 24%/6% standardised profile of a 50:1 leaf extract, so the edible organ does not supply the medicinal one.补充剂是浓缩的叶提取物，而银杏叶不是食物：它用丙酮-水体系加工成标准化提取物，EGb 761 是其参照品，药材与提取物比为 35-67:1，含 22-27% 黄酮苷和 5-7% 萜类内酯（2.8-3.4% 银杏内酯 A、B、C 加 2.6-3.2% 白果内酯），银杏酸控制在 5 ppm 以下。同一物种确实有真实的食物形式，这也是笼统的 NOT_FOOD 标签会掩盖的事情：白果（银杏种子）出现在日本茶碗蒸、中国粥品和韩国菜里，它在化学上与叶完全是另一回事。种子含银杏毒素（ginkgotoxin，即 4'-O-甲基吡哆醇及其 5'-葡萄糖苷），一种维生素 B6 拮抗剂，三份中国样品在成熟期测得的总含量为 249-296 µg/g（249.30、295.62 和 267.85 µg/g；Gong H 等，J Agric Food Chem 2018;66(30):7916-7922, PMID 29975518）。种子确实含黄酮类，萜类三内酯也存在于多个组织中，但种子里没有任何成分接近 50:1 叶提取物 24%/6% 的标准化谱型，所以可食的器官无法提供药用的那个器官。

No ordinary food supplies this in a meaningful amount.没有普通食物能提供有意义的量。

To match the dose要达到该剂量Clinical dosing is 120-240 mg/day of EGb 761. At a 35-67:1 drug-to-extract ratio that corresponds to 4.2-16 g of dried ginkgo leaf per day, and dried leaf is not something people eat; a leaf tea extracts only part of the terpene lactones and none of the concentration. Via the edible nut the gap cannot be closed at all, because the nut does not carry the leaf profile, and attempting it would be dangerous rather than merely futile: acute poisoning has been reported after 10-50 cooked seeds at one sitting, Hong Kong's Centre for Food Safety advises no more than 10 kernels a day for adults and three for children, and cooking does not destroy ginkgotoxin because it is heat-stable. Adult intoxication with seizures is documented (PMC7007935).临床用量为 EGb 761 120-240 mg/天。按 35-67:1 的药材提取物比，相当于每天 4.2-16 g 干银杏叶，而干叶不是人们会吃的东西；叶茶只能提取出一部分萜类内酯，也完全没有浓缩效果。走可食用的白果这条路，差距根本无法弥补，因为白果不含叶的成分谱，而且尝试这么做是危险的，并非只是徒劳：一次吃 10-50 颗熟白果已有急性中毒报告，香港食物安全中心建议成人每天不超过 10 颗、儿童不超过 3 颗，而烹煮不能破坏银杏毒素，因为它耐热。成人中毒伴惊厥已有记录（PMC7007935）。

Food vs supplement食物与补充剂Two separate caveats, and both cut against food substitution. First, the safe food (the nut) and the studied medicine (the leaf extract) share no active profile; a bowl of ginkgo-nut congee is not a low dose of EGb 761. Second, the food itself has a hard ceiling: ginkgotoxin blocks pyridoxal-5'-phosphate-dependent enzymes including glutamate decarboxylase, so excess intake causes vomiting, irritability and convulsions, with children at much higher risk. Ginkgotoxin is present in leaf tissue as well, at far lower levels than in seed, and in a typical standardised leaf extract it sits below a 9 ppm limit of detection (Planta Med 2009, PMID 19288402; Toxicon 2021, PMID 34425140; J Nat Prod 2014, PMID 24432981); that 9 ppm figure supports the manufacturing argument better than the false absence claim it replaces. On the extract side, the concentration step is what makes standardisation possible and also what concentrates the hazards manufacturers must strip out: ginkgolic acids are strongly allergenic and are capped at 5 ppm, and unstandardised or adulterated ginkgo products (rutin or quercetin spiking to hit a flavonoid assay) are a recurring market problem. Ginkgo extract also inhibits platelet aggregation and interacts with anticoagulants, and lowers efavirenz and some other drug levels through CYP induction.这里有两条独立的警告，都不利于用食物替代。第一，安全的食物（白果）和被研究的药物（叶提取物）没有共同的活性谱；一碗白果粥不是小剂量的 EGb 761。第二，这个食物本身有硬性上限：银杏毒素会阻断依赖 5'-磷酸吡哆醛的酶，包括谷氨酸脱羧酶，因此摄入过量会引起呕吐、易激惹和抽搐，儿童风险高得多。银杏毒素在叶组织中同样存在，水平远低于种子，在典型的标准化叶提取物中低于 9 ppm 的检出限（Planta Med 2009, PMID 19288402；Toxicon 2021, PMID 34425140；J Nat Prod 2014, PMID 24432981）；这个 9 ppm 的数字比它所取代的“叶中不含”的错误说法更能支持工艺层面的论证。提取物一侧，浓缩这一步既让标准化成为可能，也把厂家必须去除的危害一起浓缩了：银杏酸致敏性强，限量为 5 ppm，而未标准化或掺假的银杏产品（用芦丁或槲皮素掺入以凑够黄酮测定值）是市场上反复出现的问题。银杏提取物还抑制血小板聚集，与抗凝药有相互作用，并通过诱导 CYP 降低依非韦伦等一些药物的血药浓度。

Absorption吸收The two marker classes behave completely differently. Terpene lactones (ginkgolides A and B, bilobalide) are small, reasonably lipophilic and well absorbed after oral dosing of the standardised extract. The flavonol glycosides are not absorbed intact: gut microbiota hydrolyse them to quercetin, kaempferol and isorhamnetin aglycones, which are then heavily glucuronidated and sulfated, so plasma concentrations of the labelled compounds are very low and highly variable between people. This is the practical reason a leaf infusion is not a weak extract: hot water recovers a modest and inconsistent share of the terpene lactones, and the flavonoid fraction ends up as conjugated metabolites regardless. For the nut, the compound with real oral kinetics is ginkgotoxin, which is absorbed efficiently and has been measured in the serum of poisoning patients.两类标志物的行为完全不同。萜类内酯（银杏内酯 A 和 B、白果内酯）分子小、亲脂性适中，口服标准化提取物后吸收良好。黄酮醇糖苷不会以原形吸收：肠道菌群把它们水解为槲皮素、山奈酚和异鼠李素苷元，随后大量葡萄糖醛酸化和硫酸化，所以标签成分的血浆浓度很低且个体间差异很大。这正是叶泡水不能算作弱提取物的实际原因：热水只回收出一部分萜类内酯，比例还不稳定，而黄酮组分无论如何最终都变成结合型代谢物。对白果来说，真正有口服动力学意义的化合物是银杏毒素，它吸收效率高，并已在中毒患者血清中被测出。

Food data note食物数据说明The EGb 761 specification and the derived 4.2-16 g/day dried-leaf equivalent were verified, as was the ginkgotoxin poisoning literature. Two of the entry's original factual claims failed verification and were corrected: the seed ginkgotoxin lower bound and the assertion that ginkgotoxin is absent from the leaf. A separate seed range of 170-404 ug/g could not be traced to the cited source and has been dropped rather than restated中。EGb 761 的规格及由此推出的 4.2-16 g/天干叶等效量均已核实，银杏毒素中毒文献同样核实。本条目原有的两项事实性说法未通过核查并已更正：种子银杏毒素的下限，以及银杏毒素不存在于叶中的断言。另一个 170-404 µg/g 的种子范围无法追溯到所引来源，已删除而未重述。

Does the body make it身体是否自产Standardised extracts contain flavonol glycosides of quercetin and kaempferol plus the terpene trilactones ginkgolide A, B, C, J and bilobalide, a group of molecules found only in Ginkgo biloba. No human tissue produces flavonoids or ginkgolides, so intake is entirely exogenous. That removes any deficiency-correction claim and leaves the outcome trials, which have been largely negative for preventing cognitive decline.标准化提取物含槲皮素和山奈酚的黄酮醇糖苷, 以及萜类三内酯 ginkgolide A, B, C, J 和 bilobalide, 这组分子只见于 Ginkgo biloba。人体任何组织都不产生类黄酮或银杏内酯, 所以摄入完全是外源的。这样一来纠正缺乏的说法就不成立, 只剩结局试验, 而这些试验在预防认知衰退上大体为阴性。

Pathway合成通路NOT APPLICABLE. Flavonoids arise from the plant phenylpropanoid pathway and the terpene trilactones from plant terpenoid biosynthesis unique to Ginkgo biloba; neither pathway exists in humans.NOT APPLICABLE。类黄酮来自植物苯丙烷类途径, 萜类三内酯来自 Ginkgo biloba 特有的植物萜类生物合成; 这两条途径人体都没有。

Amount made自产量0 (no human biosynthetic pathway)0 (人体没有相应的生物合成途径)

Still matters when仍有意义的情形Nothing on this axis. Screen on the negative large prevention trials, extract standardisation (EGb 761 type: 24 percent flavone glycosides, 6 percent terpene lactones), and bleeding risk with antiplatelet and anticoagulant drugs.这条轴上没有理由。改用大型预防试验的阴性结果, 提取物标准化 (EGb 761 型: 24% 黄酮糖苷, 6% 萜内酯), 以及与抗血小板和抗凝药合用的出血风险来筛查。

Synthesis source合成来源PMID 26604665 (Nash KM, Integr Med Insights 2015, Current Perspectives on the Beneficial Role of Ginkgo biloba in Neurological and Cerebrovascular Disorders)

Refs.文献 GEM DeKosky PMID 19017911; GuidAge Vellas PMID 22959217; Cochrane Wieland PMID 41641880
SSDDFFDDBBXXValerian缬草
Verdict结论Skip it不必买
Evidence证据Grade DD 级
Dose tested已验证剂量Roughly 300-600 mg of extract 30-120 minutes before bed. No effective dose is established.睡前 30 至 120 分钟服提取物约 300 至 600 毫克。没有确立的有效剂量。
Who适用人群On present evidence, nobody reliably.按现有证据，没有可靠的适用人群。
Pros优点
  • The umbrella review characterises it as having a good safety profile, which is the strongest positive statement the evidence supports.伞式综述认为它安全性良好，这是现有证据能支持的最积极的说法。
  • The 2006 review found a statistically significant benefit on a dichotomous improved-sleep outcome, relative risk 1.8 (1.2-2.9).2006 年那篇综述在“睡眠改善”这个二分类结局上发现统计学显著获益，相对风险 1.8（1.2-2.9）。
Cons缺点
  • The 2006 authors reported publication bias, considerable heterogeneity and variable preparations in the same paper that produced the positive number. The positive number does not survive its own caveats.2006 年的作者在得出那个阳性数字的同一篇论文里，报告了发表偏倚、相当大的异质性和制剂不一致。那个阳性数字扛不住它自己的限定条件。
  • The 2024 umbrella review of 8 systematic reviews concluded there is NO evidence of efficacy for the treatment of insomnia, with subjective improvements not corroborated by objective measures.2024 年那篇涵盖 8 篇系统综述的伞式综述结论是：没有证据表明它对失眠有效，主观改善没有被客观指标印证。
  • The AASM guideline suggests clinicians NOT use valerian for sleep-onset or sleep-maintenance insomnia.美国睡眠医学会指南建议临床不要用缬草治疗入睡困难或睡眠维持障碍。
  • Additive sedation with benzodiazepines, Z-drugs, barbiturates, opioids, antihistamines and alcohol. Case reports of hepatotoxicity exist, mostly with multi-herb combination products.与苯二氮类、Z 类药物、巴比妥类、阿片类、抗组胺药和酒精有叠加的镇静作用。有肝毒性个案报告，多见于多草药复方产品。
What it does, and what happens without it它有什么作用，缺了会怎样

A sedative root preparation; nothing in the body is built from it or needs it.一种镇静用根部制剂,人体内没有任何东西由它构成,也不需要它。

No deficiency state exists不存在缺乏状态

In detail详细Valeriana officinalis root yields valerenic acid, valerenol and a variable mixture of valepotriates whose content differs widely between commercial products and degrades on storage. Valerenic acid binds a distinct site on GABA-A receptors that depends on the beta2 and beta3 subunits: the N265M point mutation in those subunits abolishes the drug response, and valerenic acid and valerenol are anxiolytic in mouse elevated plus-maze and light/dark tests. Human sleep trials are small, short and inconsistent, in part because extracts are not standardised to any single constituent. No human pathway synthesises or consumes these compounds, so there is no requirement for them.缬草(Valeriana officinalis)根产生缬草酸(valerenic acid)、缬草醇(valerenol),以及组成比例不定的缬草烯酸酯(valepotriates)混合物,不同商业产品间含量差异很大,且储存过程中会降解。缬草酸结合于GABA-A受体上一个依赖beta2和beta3亚基的特定位点:这些亚基上的N265M点突变会消除该药物反应,而缬草酸和缬草醇在小鼠高架十字迷宫和明暗箱试验中均表现出抗焦虑作用。人体睡眠试验规模小、时程短且结果不一致,部分原因是提取物并未按任何单一成分进行标准化。人体没有代谢通路合成或消耗这些化合物,因此对它们不存在需求。

There is no deficiency state for this. It is not an essential nutrient, so being short of it is not a thing that can happen.它不存在缺乏状态。它不是必需营养素，所以“缺了它”这件事本身并不成立。

Source来源PMID 18602406 (Benke et al., Neuropharmacology 2009;56:174-181, GABA-A receptors as in vivo substrate for the anxiolytic action of valerenic acid)

Food and the body食物与身体
In food: Not food食物中：非食物 Dose from food: Out of reach靠吃达到剂量：达不到 Body makes it: Cannot身体自产：不能 Food data: Medium食物数据：中

Valerian is the root and rhizome of Valeriana officinalis, a European perennial. It is not a food in any cuisine; it is a bitter, strongly odorous drug taken as a tea, tincture or dried-extract capsule. The constituents credited with the sedative effect, valerenic acid and its relatives plus the flavonoids 6-methylapigenin, hesperidin and linarin, are found in Valeriana species and nowhere in the food supply. Valerian root has been used at low levels as a flavouring in some beverages, which puts trace amounts into a few products, and those are flavour levels, orders of magnitude below anything sedative. Nothing you would call a food supplies valerenic acid.缬草是欧洲多年生植物 Valeriana officinalis 的根和根茎。它在任何菜系里都不是食物；它是一种味苦、气味强烈的药材，以茶、酊剂或干提取物胶囊的形式服用。被认为产生镇静作用的成分，缬草酸（valerenic acid）及其同系物，加上黄酮类 6-methylapigenin、橙皮苷（hesperidin）和 linarin，只见于缬草属植物，在食物供应链中没有。缬草根曾以低水平用作某些饮料的香味成分，这让少数产品中含有微量，那属于香料级用量，比任何有镇静作用的量低几个数量级。称得上食物的东西没有一种能提供缬草酸。

No ordinary food supplies this in a meaningful amount.没有普通食物能提供有意义的量。

To match the dose要达到该剂量Typical use is 400-900 mg of dried root extract before bed, or 2-3 g of dried root as an infusion. A quality target of at least 3 mg/g valerenic acid in the dried root has been recommended for commercial material and marketed extracts are sold around 0.8% valerenic acid, so a night's dose is roughly 3-8 mg of valerenic acid. No food at any portion size supplies measurable valerenic acid, so there is no achievable eating quantity to compute. The gap is total rather than large.典型用法是睡前 400-900 mg 干根提取物，或 2-3 g 干根泡饮。商业原料的质量目标建议干根中缬草酸不低于 3 mg/g，市售提取物按约 0.8% 缬草酸销售，所以一晚的剂量大致相当于 3-8 mg 缬草酸。任何份量的食物都不能提供可测量的缬草酸，所以没有可以计算的进食量。这里的差距是彻底的缺失，不是一个大倍数。

Food vs supplement食物与补充剂Valerian is the textbook example of a herb where the preparation determines the chemistry. Valerenic acid concentrations fall significantly during storage, with the greatest loss at 30 C in low humidity (Food Chemistry 2009, changes in valerenic acid content of valerian root during long-term storage), so an old capsule and a fresh one are different products. Valepotriates present in some preparations are unstable and degrade to baldrinals, and aqueous versus ethanolic extraction recovers quite different fractions, which is one reason valerian trials are so inconsistent. Practical cautions: additive sedation with alcohol, benzodiazepines and antihistamines; occasional paradoxical stimulation; rare hepatotoxicity reports, usually in multi-herb products. A valerian tea and a standardised extract capsule are not interchangeable at the same nominal gram amount.缬草是“制备方式决定化学成分”的教科书式例子。缬草酸浓度在储存期间明显下降，在 30 C 低湿条件下损失最大（Food Chemistry 2009, changes in valerenic acid content of valerian root during long-term storage），所以一瓶放久的胶囊和一瓶新的是不同的产品。某些制剂中的缬草素（valepotriates）不稳定，会降解为 baldrinals；水提和乙醇提取回收的组分差别很大，这也是缬草临床试验结果如此不一致的原因之一。实用注意事项：与酒精、苯二氮类和抗组胺药有叠加镇静作用；偶见反常性兴奋；有罕见的肝毒性报告，通常出现在多草药复方产品中。同样标注克数的缬草茶和标准化提取物胶囊并不能互换。

Absorption吸收Human data are limited. Valerenic acid is detectable in plasma after oral dosing with a short half-life of roughly one to two hours, which fits its use as a bedtime agent rather than a daytime one, and the flavonoid constituents undergo extensive glucuronidation. Because there is no food form there is no food-matrix comparison; the meaningful variable is extraction, since valerenic acid is lipophilic and is recovered far better by ethanol than by a water infusion, so a tea delivers a small and poorly characterised fraction of what a labelled milligram amount of extract implies.人体数据有限。口服后血浆中可检出缬草酸，半衰期约一到两小时，这符合它作为睡前用药而非日间用药的定位；黄酮类成分会经历大量葡萄糖醛酸化。由于没有食物形式，也就没有食物基质的比较可做；有意义的变量是提取方式，缬草酸亲脂，乙醇的回收率远高于水浸，所以一杯茶提供的量只是标注毫克数的提取物所暗示量的一小部分，而且难以表征。

Food data note食物数据说明The NOT_FOOD classification was challenged and upheld and the valerenic-acid dose arithmetic (3-8 mg per night) was verified as correct. The 3 mg/g quality target and the 0.8% extract figure each rest on a single secondary citation, and the storage-stability claim was not individually verified in the numeric pass中。NOT_FOOD 分类经质疑后维持，缬草酸剂量的算术（每晚 3-8 mg）核实无误。3 mg/g 的质量目标和 0.8% 的提取物含量各自只有一条二手引用支撑，储存稳定性的说法在数值核查中未逐项验证。

Does the body make it身体是否自产Valerian's activity is attributed to valerenic acid and the valepotriates, sesquiterpenes whose carbon skeleton is built by a plant terpene synthase (valerenadiene synthase) found in Valeriana officinalis roots. Humans use farnesyl diphosphate for sterols, dolichol, the polyprenyl side chain of ubiquinone (CoQ10), the farnesyl group of heme A and protein farnesylation and geranylgeranylation, and have no sesquiterpene cyclase to close a valerenane ring. So nothing in a valerian capsule is endogenous, a deficiency framing is unavailable, and the modest and inconsistent insomnia evidence has to stand on its own.缬草的作用被归于 valerenic acid 和 valepotriates, 这些倍半萜的碳骨架由 Valeriana officinalis 根中的植物萜类合成酶 (valerenadiene synthase) 构建。人把 farnesyl diphosphate 用于甾醇, dolichol, 泛醌 (CoQ10) 的多聚异戊烯侧链, heme A 的法尼基基团以及蛋白的法尼基化和香叶基香叶基化, 但没有能闭合 valerenane 环的倍半萜环化酶。所以缬草胶囊里没有任何内源成分, 缺乏这套说法用不上, 有限且不一致的失眠证据只能自己站住。

Pathway合成通路NOT APPLICABLE. Farnesyl diphosphate is cyclised by the plant sesquiterpene synthase valerenadiene synthase in Valeriana officinalis, then oxidised to valerenic acid. Human farnesyl diphosphate goes to sterols, dolichol, ubiquinone, heme A and prenylated proteins; there is no human sesquiterpene cyclase.NOT APPLICABLE。在 Valeriana officinalis 中, farnesyl diphosphate 由植物倍半萜合成酶 valerenadiene synthase 环化, 再氧化为 valerenic acid。人的 farnesyl diphosphate 去向是甾醇, dolichol, 泛醌, heme A 和异戊烯化蛋白; 人体没有倍半萜环化酶。

Amount made自产量0 (no human biosynthetic pathway)0 (人体没有相应的生物合成途径)

Still matters when仍有意义的情形Nothing on this axis. Screen on the weak and heterogeneous insomnia trial data, wide variation in valerenic acid content between products, and additive sedation with alcohol and benzodiazepines.这条轴上没有理由。改用薄弱且异质的失眠试验数据, 不同产品间 valerenic acid 含量的巨大差异, 以及与酒精和苯二氮类的镇静叠加来筛查。

Synthesis source合成来源PMID 34898176 (Zinck GE, Biochemistry 2021, Structurally Guided Reprogramming of Valerenadiene Synthase)

SSDDFFDDBBXXRhodiola rosea红景天

Evidence证据Grade DD 级
Dose tested已验证剂量Commercial convention is 200-600 mg/d of extract standardised to about 3% rosavins. There is no evidence-based dose.市售惯例是标准化至约 3% 红景天苷的提取物 200 至 600 毫克/天。不存在基于证据的剂量。
Who适用人群Possibly people with subjective mental fatigue, on evidence too weak to justify confidence.可能适用于有主观精神疲劳的人，但证据弱到不足以让人有信心。
Pros优点
  • Three of five randomised trials on mental fatigue were positive, so there is a signal, however unreliable.五项关于精神疲劳的随机试验中有三项阳性，所以存在信号，尽管不可靠。
Cons缺点
