No two studies reported the same outcome, so meta-analysis was impossible.那篇系统综述筛查了 206 篇文章，纳入 11 项试验，发现全部试验都存在高偏倚风险，或存在妨碍评估其真实效应的报告缺陷。没有任何两项研究报告了相同的结局，因此无法做 meta 分析。
  • Only 2 of 6 physical-fatigue trials were positive.六项体力疲劳试验中只有两项阳性。
  • The premium adaptogen positioning has essentially no regulatory-grade support. EFSA has authorised no health claim.高价的“适应原”定位基本没有监管级别的支持。EFSA 没有批准任何健康声称。
  • No upper limit can be stated because dose-ranging and toxicity data do not exist. Theoretical additive serotonergic effects with SSRIs, SNRIs and MAOIs, and activation risk in bipolar disorder.无法给出上限，因为剂量探索和毒性数据都不存在。理论上与 SSRI、SNRI 和 MAOI 有叠加的 5-羟色胺效应，双相障碍者有躁狂激活风险。
What it does, and what happens without it它有什么作用，缺了会怎样

An Arctic root extract sold for fatigue; the body neither makes nor requires it.一种用于缓解疲劳的北极根部提取物,人体既不合成也不需要它。

No deficiency state exists不存在缺乏状态

In detail详细Rhodiola rosea rhizome supplies the rosavins (rosavin, rosin, rosarin) and salidroside, and the best studied preparation, SHR-5, is standardised to roughly 3% rosavins and 1% salidroside. Proposed actions include weak monoamine oxidase inhibition and blunting of stress-induced cortisol responses, neither well characterised in humans. A 2021 systematic review of 39 randomised trials spanning four Rhodiola species (23 of R. rosea, 8 of R. crenulata, 8 of R. wallichiana and 1 of R. sacra, the last excluded from quality assessment) found that no study met all CONSORT criteria, so reporting quality is too poor to support firm efficacy conclusions and trials of different species are routinely conflated. An earlier review restricted to 11 placebo-controlled trials of R. rosea alone judged methodological quality moderate or good (5 of 10 scored above 3 on Jadad) and concluded the species may benefit physical performance, mental performance and certain mental-health conditions, its stated limitation being the absence of independent replication. These are plant secondary metabolites with no endogenous counterpart and no dietary requirement.红景天(Rhodiola rosea)根茎提供玫瑰苷类成分(rosavin、rosin、rosarin)及红景天苷(salidroside),研究最充分的制剂SHR-5标准化含量约为3%玫瑰苷和1%红景天苷。提出的作用机制包括较弱的单胺氧化酶抑制以及减弱应激诱导的皮质醇反应,但两者在人体中都未得到充分表征。一项2021年的系统评价纳入了39项随机试验,涵盖四个红景天属物种(23项为红景天Rhodiola rosea,8项为Rhodiola crenulata,8项为Rhodiola wallichiana,1项为Rhodiola sacra,后者未纳入质量评估),发现没有一项研究完全符合CONSORT标准,说明报告质量差到不足以支持确凿的疗效结论,而且不同物种的试验经常被混为一谈。另一篇早期综述仅纳入11项红景天(单一物种)的安慰剂对照试验,评定其方法学质量为中等或良好(10项中有5项Jadad评分高于3分),结论认为该物种可能对体能表现、脑力表现及某些精神健康状况有益,其自述的局限性是缺乏独立重复验证。这些都是植物次生代谢物,人体内没有内源性对应物,也不存在膳食需求。

There is no deficiency state for this. It is not an essential nutrient, so being short of it is not a thing that can happen.它不存在缺乏状态。它不是必需营养素，所以“缺了它”这件事本身并不成立。

Source来源DOI 10.1155/2021/9989546, PMC8266448 (Li et al., Evid Based Complement Alternat Med 2021;2021:9989546, quality evaluation of randomised controlled trials of Rhodiola species, 39 RCTs across four species); PMID 21036578 (Hung, Perry & Ernst, Phytomedicine 2011;18:235-244, systematic review of 11 placebo-controlled trials of Rhodiola rosea)

Food and the body食物与身体
In food: Not food食物中：非食物 Dose from food: Out of reach靠吃达到剂量：达不到 Body makes it: Cannot身体自产：不能 Food data: Medium食物数据：中

The supplement is the rhizome and root of Rhodiola rosea (roseroot), an arctic-alpine succulent in the Crassulaceae, standardised on rosavins (rosavin, rosin, rosarin) and salidroside. The rhizome is a folk-medicine drug of Scandinavia and Russia and is not eaten as food. The plant is not entirely outside the food record: young leaves and shoots have been eaten raw or cooked like spinach and stems cooked like asparagus in Greenland, Alaska and northern North America, and Inuit use mixed leaves and buds with marine fat. That food use involves the aerial parts while rosavins are rhizome constituents, and composition data for the edible shoots are sparse, so the culinary history does not translate into a dietary source of the marker compounds. Rosavins are also close to unique to R. rosea, which is why species substitution is such a persistent problem.补充剂用的是红景天（Rhodiola rosea，roseroot）的根茎和根，它是景天科的一种北极高山肉质植物，以 rosavins（rosavin、rosin、rosarin）和红景天苷（salidroside）为标准化指标。这个根茎是斯堪的纳维亚和俄罗斯的民间药材，不作为食物食用。这种植物并非完全不见于食物记录：在格陵兰、阿拉斯加和北美北部，嫩叶和嫩芽被生食或像菠菜一样煮食，茎则像芦笋一样烹煮，因纽特人会把叶和芽混着海生动物脂肪一起吃。那种食用涉及的是地上部分，而 rosavins 是根茎成分，加上可食嫩芽的成分数据很少，所以这段饮食史无法转化为标志物成分的膳食来源。rosavins 还几乎只见于 R. rosea，这正是物种替代问题长期存在的原因。

No ordinary food supplies this in a meaningful amount.没有普通食物能提供有意义的量。

To match the dose要达到该剂量Typical dosing is 200-600 mg/day of extract standardised to 3% rosavins and 1% salidroside (the SHR-5 pattern), roughly 6-18 mg rosavins and 2-6 mg salidroside per day. The dried-rhizome equivalent depends entirely on the content assumed, and the 0.01-3.08% rosavin / 0.07-2.91% salidroside range cited here is COMMERCIAL PRODUCT content rather than measured rhizome, so raw-material content is not established from that source. Stating the assumption explicitly: at 1-3% rosavins, 0.2-1.8 g of dried rhizome carries a daily dose; at 0.1-0.5%, 1.2-18 g; at the 0.01% floor of the cited range, 60-180 g. The submission's flat 0.5-2 g figure silently assumed the top of the range and is optimistic by up to two orders of magnitude. On any assumption this is a herbal dose of a root and no food supplies it, and the edible young shoots cannot be costed at all because the composition work is on rhizome material.典型用量为 200-600 mg/天的提取物，标准化到 3% rosavins 和 1% salidroside（SHR-5 模式），约合每天 6-18 mg rosavins 和 2-6 mg salidroside。干根茎的等效量完全取决于假定的含量，而这里引用的 0.01-3.08% rosavin 与 0.07-2.91% salidroside 范围是市售成品的含量，不是实测的根茎含量，因此原料含量无法由该来源确定。把假定明确写出来：按 1-3% rosavins 计，0.2-1.8 g 干根茎含一日剂量；按 0.1-0.5% 计为 1.2-18 g；按所引范围的下限 0.01% 计为 60-180 g。原稿一律给 0.5-2 g，暗中采用了范围上限，乐观程度最多达两个数量级。无论采用哪个假定，这都是一种根类草药的剂量，没有食物能提供；可食的嫩芽则根本无法折算，因为成分研究做的是根茎材料。

Food vs supplement食物与补充剂Rhodiola has an unusually bad identity record. An analysis of US-market Rhodiola supplements found rosavin and salidroside contents ranging from 0.01% to 3.08% and 0.07% to 2.91% respectively, with substantial departures from label claims, alongside heavy metal and pesticide residue screening (The quality and safety of Rhodiola rosea supplements on the U.S. market, PLoS One 2026, PMC12810810, verified). Those are finished-product figures, not raw-material figures, a distinction the submission blurred. Rhodiola crenulata is a common substitute; it contains salidroside but little or no rosavin, so a product standardised only on salidroside can be a different species. Wild R. rosea is under harvesting pressure and CITES-listed in Appendix II. Field material varies enormously by clone and site, with inter-clonal variation of 92.8% reported for salidroside in Norwegian collections, so growing region and harvest season change the product more than the label does.红景天的品种真实性记录尤其糟糕。一项对美国市场红景天补充剂的分析发现，rosavin 含量在 0.01% 到 3.08% 之间，salidroside 在 0.07% 到 2.91% 之间，与标签声称有很大偏差，同时还做了重金属和农药残留筛查（The quality and safety of Rhodiola rosea supplements on the U.S. market, PLoS One 2026, PMC12810810，已核实）。这些是成品数据，不是原料数据，原稿把这一区别模糊掉了。Rhodiola crenulata（大花红景天）是常见的替代品，它含 salidroside 但几乎不含 rosavin，所以只按 salidroside 标准化的产品可能是另一个物种。野生 R. rosea 面临采挖压力，已列入 CITES 附录二。田间材料随克隆株和产地差异极大，挪威采集材料中 salidroside 的克隆间变异达到 92.8%，因此产地和采收季节对产品的影响比标签更大。

Absorption吸收Salidroside is absorbed rapidly and hydrolysed to tyrosol, and rosavins are cinnamyl glycosides subject to gut microbial deglycosylation, so plasma exposure reflects metabolites rather than the labelled markers; controlled human pharmacokinetic data are limited and no reliable percentage figure can be given. Because there is no food form, the practical absorption question is the extraction solvent: hydroalcoholic extracts recover both rosavins and salidroside, while water infusions of the root recover the glycosides preferentially. Chewing raw shoots, the only genuinely food-like route, has never been characterised.salidroside 吸收迅速并水解为酪醇（tyrosol），rosavins 属肉桂醇糖苷，会被肠道菌群脱糖基，所以血浆暴露反映的是代谢产物，而不是标签上的标志物；受控的人体药代动力学数据有限，无法给出可靠的百分比数值。由于没有食物形式，实际的吸收问题变成了提取溶剂：水醇提取物能同时回收 rosavins 和 salidroside，而根的水浸提液优先回收糖苷。咀嚼生嫩芽是唯一真正接近食物的途径，它从未被表征过。

Food data note食物数据说明The NOT_FOOD classification was challenged and upheld and the cited biomarker ranges were verified as real and on-topic, but those ranges are commercial-product contents that the submission reused as raw-material contents, so the dried-rhizome dose equivalent is now given as a wide assumption-dependent range rather than a figure. No composition data exist for the edible aerial shoots, so that route cannot be quantified at all中。NOT_FOOD 分类经质疑后维持，所引的标志物含量范围也核实为真实且切题，但那些范围是市售成品的含量，原稿把它们当成了原料含量，因此干根茎的剂量等效量现在给出的是一个依赖假定的宽区间，不再是一个确定数字。可食用的地上嫩芽没有成分数据，这条途径完全无法量化。

Does the body make it身体是否自产The marker compounds are salidroside, a tyrosol glucoside, plus the cinnamyl glycosides rosavin, rosin and rosarin, all made in the rhizome. Tyrosol itself occurs endogenously in humans as a metabolite of tyramine (tyramine to 4-hydroxyphenylacetaldehyde to tyrosol), and hydroxytyrosol arises the same way from dopamine, so the aglycone is present in humans; what is missing is the specific UDP-glucosyltransferase that forms the salidroside O-glucoside, since human phase II conjugation of phenols runs to glucuronides and sulfates, and there is no route to the cinnamyl glycosides. NONE stands for salidroside and the rosavins, so the axis gives neither a reason to take it nor a reason to reject it and the judgement falls entirely to clinical evidence.标志物是 salidroside (酪醇葡糖苷) 以及 cinnamyl 糖苷 rosavin, rosin 和 rosarin, 都在根茎中合成。酪醇本身在人体内源存在, 由 tyramine 代谢而来 (tyramine 经 4-hydroxyphenylacetaldehyde 生成酪醇), 羟基酪醇同样由多巴胺经这条路生成, 所以苷元在人体中是有的; 缺的是形成 salidroside O-葡糖苷的那个特定 UDP-glucosyltransferase, 因为人对酚类的二相结合走葡糖醛酸化和硫酸化, 而且也没有生成 cinnamyl 糖苷的途径。对 salidroside 和 rosavins 而言 NONE 成立, 所以这条轴既不给出服用的理由, 也不给出否定的理由, 判断完全落到临床证据上。

Pathway合成通路NOT APPLICABLE for salidroside and the rosavins. Plant phenylpropanoid and shikimate routes in Rhodiola rosea rhizome produce tyrosol, salidroside and the rosavins. Tyrosol is endogenous in humans via tyramine, but no human glucosyltransferase forms the salidroside O-glucoside and no human enzyme assembles the cinnamyl glycosides.对 salidroside 和 rosavins 为 NOT APPLICABLE。Rhodiola rosea 根茎中的植物苯丙烷类和莽草酸途径生成酪醇, salidroside 和 rosavins。酪醇在人体经 tyramine 内源生成, 但没有人类 glucosyltransferase 形成 salidroside 的 O-葡糖苷, 也没有人类酶组装 cinnamyl 糖苷。

Amount made自产量0 (no human biosynthetic pathway for salidroside or the rosavins)0 (人体没有合成 salidroside 或 rosavins 的途径)

Still matters when仍有意义的情形Nothing on this axis. Screen on standardisation (typically 3 percent rosavins and 1 percent salidroside), frequent species substitution in commerce, and the modest and inconsistent trial evidence for fatigue and exercise performance.这条轴上没有理由。改用标准化 (通常 3% rosavins 和 1% salidroside), 商业上常见的物种冒充, 以及在疲劳和运动表现方面有限且不一致的试验证据来筛查。

Synthesis source合成来源PMID 37641937 (Tinsley GM, Br J Nutr 2024, Rhodiola rosea as an adaptogen to enhance exercise performance)

Refs.文献 Ishaque BMC Complement Altern Med PMID 22643043
SSCCFFDDBBXXLion's mane (Hericium erinaceus)猴头菇
Verdict结论Skip it不必买
Evidence证据Grade CC 级
Dose tested已验证剂量3,000 mg/d of dried fruiting body for 16 weeks in the pivotal trial. Fruiting body and mycelium contain different compounds and are not interchangeable.关键试验为干燥子实体 3000 毫克/天、持续 16 周。子实体与菌丝体所含成分不同，不可互换。
Who适用人群Possibly older adults with mild cognitive impairment, on the basis of a single 30-person trial.可能适用于轻度认知障碍的老年人，依据是一项 30 人的试验。
Pros优点
  • It is a food mushroom with a long history of dietary use, so the baseline safety expectation is reasonable.它是一种食用菌，有长期的食用历史，因此对其基础安全性的预期是合理的。
  • In the pivotal trial, dementia screening scores improved at weeks 8, 12 and 16.在关键试验中，痴呆筛查评分在第 8、12 和 16 周有所改善。
Cons缺点
  • The pivotal trial randomised 30 Japanese adults, 15 per arm, to a dementia SCREENING scale. Scores then fell significantly 4 weeks after stopping. There is no meta-analysis and no trial with a hard endpoint.关键试验把 30 名日本成人随机分为每组 15 人，用的是痴呆筛查量表。停药 4 周后评分显著回落。没有 meta 分析，也没有任何硬终点试验。
  • The only other cited trial is explicitly self-described as a pilot.另一项被引用的试验，作者自己明确称之为预试验。
  • This is one of the largest gaps between marketing volume and evidence volume in the entire document. The neurogenesis claim rests on in-vitro nerve growth factor stimulation.这是全文中营销声量与证据体量差距最大的条目之一。所谓“促进神经再生”建立在体外刺激神经生长因子的基础上。
  • Most retail products do not disclose whether they contain fruiting body or mycelium, so you cannot match the product to the trial.多数零售产品不披露所用是子实体还是菌丝体，因此你无法把手上的产品对应到试验里。
  • Mushroom allergy is a real contraindication. Theoretical antiplatelet effects are uncharacterised in humans.蘑菇过敏是真实的禁忌。理论上的抗血小板作用在人体中未被表征。
What it does, and what happens without it它有什么作用，缺了会怎样

An edible mushroom studied for nerve growth effects; no bodily process depends on it.一种因促进神经生长作用而被研究的食用菌,人体没有任何过程依赖它。

No deficiency state exists不存在缺乏状态

In detail详细Hericium erinaceus fruiting bodies contain hericenones and the mycelium contains erinacines, both of which stimulate nerve growth factor synthesis in cultured cells, with erinacine A shown to cross the blood-brain barrier in animals. The main human trial randomised 30 Japanese adults aged 50 to 80 with mild cognitive impairment to 3 g/day of dried powder or placebo for 16 weeks; cognitive scores improved on treatment and drifted back towards baseline during washout. As a culinary mushroom it contributes ordinary food nutrients such as beta-glucans, potassium and B vitamins, in the same way any mushroom does. The hericenones and erinacines themselves are not nutrients, are not made by human tissue, and no physiological process requires them.猴头菇(Hericium erinaceus)子实体含有hericenones,菌丝体含有erinacines,两者在培养细胞中均能刺激神经生长因子合成,其中erinacine A已在动物实验中证实可穿过血脑屏障。主要的人体试验将30名50至80岁、患轻度认知障碍的日本成年人随机分组,每日服用3 g干燥粉末或安慰剂,持续16周,结果显示治疗组认知评分改善,而在洗脱期又逐渐回到基线水平。作为一种食用菌,它像任何蘑菇一样提供普通的食物营养素,如β-葡聚糖、钾和B族维生素。hericenones和erinacines本身并非营养素,人体组织不会合成它们,也没有生理过程需要它们。

There is no deficiency state for this. It is not an essential nutrient, so being short of it is not a thing that can happen.它不存在缺乏状态。它不是必需营养素，所以“缺了它”这件事本身并不成立。

Source来源PMID 18844328 (Mori et al., Phytother Res 2009;23:367-372, double-blind placebo-controlled trial in mild cognitive impairment)

Food and the body食物与身体
In food: Rich食物中：丰富 Dose from food: Reachable靠吃达到剂量：可达到 Body makes it: Cannot身体自产：不能 Food data: Low食物数据：低

This is the one entry whose supplement organism is an ordinary culinary food. Hericium erinaceus is sold fresh in Asian markets and increasingly in Western ones, cooked like scallops or shredded into stir-fries, and it is the same organism used to make the fruiting-body supplement. The best-known human trial used no exotic extract: Mori and colleagues gave 3 g/day of dried Hericium powder, four 250 mg tablets containing 96% dry powder three times daily, to older adults with mild cognitive impairment (Phytother Res 2009;23(3):367-372, PMID 18844328, verified). RICH describes this one species in its several presentations (fresh, dried powder, dried slices), which are one food rather than several independent sources. The important limit is by tissue: the newer and more mechanistically interesting trials use erinacine-A-enriched MYCELIUM, and no amount of the edible fruiting body supplies erinacines. Other edible Hericium species exist, notably H. coralloides and H. americanum, which matters here because the composition paper the submission cited was about H. coralloides rather than H. erinaceus.这是唯一一条补充剂原生物本身就是普通食用食材的条目。Hericium erinaceus（猴头菇）在亚洲市场有鲜品出售，西方市场也越来越多，做法像干贝一样烹调或撕成丝炒菜，它与制作子实体补充剂用的是同一种生物。最著名的人体试验没有用什么特殊提取物：Mori 等人给轻度认知障碍的老年人每天 3 g 猴头菇干粉，即每次四片 250 mg（含 96% 干粉）、每天三次（Phytother Res 2009;23(3):367-372, PMID 18844328，已核实）。RICH 描述的是这一个物种的几种形态（鲜品、干粉、干片），它们属于同一种食物，并非几个独立来源。重要的限制按组织划分：更新、机制上更有意思的那些试验用的是富含 erinacine A 的菌丝体，而供食用的子实体无论吃多少都不含 erinacines。还存在其他可食的猴头菌属物种，尤其是 H. coralloides 和 H. americanum，这一点在此很重要，因为原稿引用的成分论文研究的是 H. coralloides，并非 H. erinaceus。

To match the dose要达到该剂量For the fruiting-body dose there is essentially no gap. At 8-11% dry matter, the 3 g/day of dried powder used in the Mori trial is about 27-38 g of fresh lion's mane, a small side portion, or 3 g of dried slices, or a rounded half-tablespoon of powder. A 100 g fresh portion supplies 8-11 g of dry matter, roughly 270-370% of that dose. The gap reappears with a concentrated extract: 3 g/day of a nominal 8:1 hot-water extract corresponds to about 24 g of dried mushroom, roughly 218-300 g of fresh mushroom a day, which is a lot of mushroom and still not absurd. For erinacine-A products the answer is NO at any portion size, because erinacines are mycelial and the fruiting body sold for cooking does not contain them at meaningful levels.就子实体剂量而言基本没有差距。按 8-11% 干物质计，Mori 试验用的 3 g/天干粉相当于约 27-38 g 鲜猴头菇，一小份配菜的量，或 3 g 干片，或略满的半汤匙干粉。100 g 鲜品提供 8-11 g 干物质，约为该剂量的 270-370%。换成浓缩提取物，差距就回来了：标称 8:1 的热水提取物 3 g/天相当于约 24 g 干菇，即每天约 218-300 g 鲜菇，量不小但仍不算荒唐。对于 erinacine A 类产品，答案在任何份量下都是 NO，因为 erinacines 存在于菌丝体，供烹调出售的子实体不含有意义量的 erinacines。

Food vs supplement食物与补充剂The compound classes split cleanly by tissue and by solvent, and this is where most consumer confusion lives. Hericenones C-H occur in the fruiting body; erinacines A-I occur in the mycelium, with erinacine biosynthesis genes consistently downregulated in fruiting-body tissue and no detectable erinacine production there (Fungal Biol Biotechnol 2025, PMC11969743, verified). The Taiwanese trials in early Alzheimer's disease and in depression used erinacine-A-enriched mycelium capsules at around 5 mg/g erinacine A, three 350 mg capsules a day giving 1,050 mg mycelia and about 5.25 mg erinacine A over 49 weeks (PMC7283924, verified), so their results cannot be transferred to eating the mushroom, and equally the Mori fruiting-body result cannot be transferred to a mycelium product. Solvent matters as much as tissue: hericenones are lipophilic and are recovered by ethanol while hot-water extraction recovers polysaccharides, so a dual extract and a hot-water extract deliver different chemistry at the same milligram figure. The specific polysaccharide numbers the submission used to make that point (4.85-5.68% of dry weight for the fruiting body and 3.62% beta-glucan for a hot-water extract) are withdrawn here, because neither is present in the paper cited for them. Many cheap US supplements are mycelium grown on grain and sold with the substrate included, so a large fraction of the capsule weight is starch; a starch assay or a low beta-glucan number relative to labelled polysaccharide is the tell. Safety is good for a food, with occasional contact dermatitis and respiratory allergy reports, and scattered case reports of skin reactions with supplement use.化合物类别按组织和溶剂清晰分开，消费者的困惑大多出在这里。Hericenones C-H 存在于子实体；erinacines A-I 存在于菌丝体，erinacine 生物合成基因在子实体组织中一致下调，该组织中检测不到 erinacine 生成（Fungal Biol Biotechnol 2025, PMC11969743，已核实）。台湾在早期阿尔茨海默病和抑郁症中的试验用的是富含 erinacine A 的菌丝体胶囊，erinacine A 约 5 mg/g，每天三粒 350 mg 胶囊，即 1,050 mg 菌丝体、约 5.25 mg erinacine A，持续 49 周（PMC7283924，已核实），所以它们的结果不能转用到吃这种菇上；同样，Mori 的子实体结果也不能转用到菌丝体产品上。溶剂和组织同等重要：hericenones 亲脂，靠乙醇回收，而热水提取回收的是多糖，所以在相同毫克数下，双提取物和热水提取物提供的化学成分不同。原稿用来支持这一点的具体多糖数值（子实体干重的 4.85-5.68%，以及热水提取物 3.62% 的 β-葡聚糖）在此撤回，因为所引论文中没有这两个数据。美国许多便宜补充剂是在谷物上培养的菌丝体，连培养基一起出售，所以胶囊重量里有很大一部分是淀粉；淀粉检测，或 β-葡聚糖数值相对标注多糖含量偏低，都是识别线索。作为食物，它的安全性良好，偶有接触性皮炎和呼吸道过敏报告，服用补充剂后也有零星皮肤反应的个案报告。

Absorption吸收The fungal beta-glucans are not absorbed intact; a water-soluble 1-3/1-6 beta-glucan of about 13.3 kDa has been characterised from the fruiting body, and such polymers act on gut and gut-associated immune receptors rather than entering circulation, so how much reaches the blood is the wrong question for the polysaccharide fraction. The small molecules are the ones with systemic potential: erinacine A is lipophilic, crosses the blood-brain barrier in rodents and is the compound behind the neurotrophic claims, while hericenones are also lipophilic and their human absorption is poorly characterised. Practically, fat in the pan helps the hericenone fraction, a water-based soup extracts the polysaccharides, and the raw mushroom is not the right comparator for either since chitinous cell walls need heat to break down. The relevant food-versus-supplement difference here is which molecules are present at all rather than absorption efficiency.真菌 β-葡聚糖不会以原形吸收；已从子实体中表征出一种约 13.3 kDa 的水溶性 1-3/1-6 β-葡聚糖，这类聚合物作用于肠道及肠道相关免疫受体，并不进入循环，所以对多糖组分来说，“有多少进入血液”是个提错的问题。有全身作用潜力的是小分子：erinacine A 亲脂，在啮齿类中可穿过血脑屏障，是神经营养相关说法背后的化合物；hericenones 也亲脂，其人体吸收情况表征很差。实际操作上，锅里的油脂有助于 hericenone 组分，水基汤品提取的是多糖，而生菇对两者都不是合适的参照，因为几丁质细胞壁需要加热才能破坏。这里食物与补充剂的真正差别是哪些分子存在，吸收效率是次要问题。

Food data note食物数据说明Every composition figure in this entry traces to one paper that turned out to be about a different species: J Fungi 2025;11(11):785 analysed only Hericium coralloides, and the submission truncated its title to Hericium. The 91.68% moisture that generated every dose-gap number was an H. coralloides measurement, the H. erinaceus proximate values appear in that paper only as an untraced quotation from its reference [29], and the 4.85-5.68% polysaccharide range is absent from the paper altogether. The replacement moisture figure used here is the published 89-92% band rather than a specific re-traced H. erinaceus measurement. What is solid is the dose side: the Mori 3 g/day protocol, the 4 x 250 mg x 3 arithmetic, the 5 mg/g erinacine A figure and the tissue-partition claim were all verified低。本条目的每个成分数值都追溯到同一篇论文，而那篇论文研究的是另一个物种：J Fungi 2025;11(11):785 只分析了 Hericium coralloides，原稿把它的标题截短成了 Hericium。生成全部剂量差距数字的 91.68% 水分是 H. coralloides 的测定值；H. erinaceus 的常规成分值在该论文中只是引自其参考文献 [29] 的未追溯引用；4.85-5.68% 的多糖范围在该论文中完全不存在。这里采用的替代水分数值是已发表的 89-92% 区间，并非重新追溯的某个 H. erinaceus 具体测定值。可靠的是剂量一侧：Mori 的 3 g/天方案、4 x 250 mg x 3 的算术、5 mg/g erinacine A 的数据以及组织分布的说法均已核实。

Does the body make it身体是否自产The compounds of interest are hericenones from the fruiting body, polyketide-terpenoid hybrids (meroterpenoids) built on a polyketide-derived resorcinol or benzaldehyde core carrying an added prenyl or geranyl chain and a fatty acyl group, and erinacines, cyathane diterpenoids, from the mycelium. These are fungal metabolites; human cells produce neither, and human cells also do not need them for anything. Any benefit has to come from the pharmacology of an ingested fungal compound, and the human evidence is one small trial in mild cognitive impairment (30 subjects, 16 weeks of dosing) with scores falling back 4 weeks after stopping.受关注的成分是子实体中的 hericenones, 属聚酮与萜类的杂合分子 (meroterpenoids), 核心是聚酮来源的间苯二酚或苯甲醛结构, 上面带异戊烯或香叶基链和脂肪酰基; 以及菌丝体中的 erinacines, 属 cyathane 二萜。这些都是真菌代谢物; 人细胞既不产生它们, 也不需要它们做任何事。任何益处只能来自摄入真菌化合物的药理作用, 而人体证据是一项轻度认知障碍的小型试验 (30 名受试者, 给药 16 周), 停药 4 周后评分回落。

Pathway合成通路NOT APPLICABLE. Hericenones are fungal polyketide-terpenoid hybrids (meroterpenoids) and erinacines are cyathane diterpenoids, both made in Hericium erinaceus; no human pathway to either.NOT APPLICABLE。Hericenones 是真菌聚酮萜类杂合物 (meroterpenoids), erinacines 是 cyathane 二萜, 两者都在 Hericium erinaceus 中生成; 人体对两者都没有合成途径。

Amount made自产量0 (no human biosynthetic pathway)0 (人体没有相应的生物合成途径)

Still matters when仍有意义的情形Nothing on this axis. Screen on the thin human evidence base (30 subjects, 16 weeks, benefit lost 4 weeks after cessation), whether a product is fruiting body or grain-based mycelium, and the fact that nerve growth factor induction is a cell and rodent finding rather than a human one.这条轴上没有理由。改用人体证据之薄 (30 名受试者, 16 周, 停药 4 周后获益消失), 产品是子实体还是谷物基菌丝体, 以及神经生长因子诱导只是细胞和啮齿类的发现, 尚无人体证据, 来筛查。

Refs.文献 Mori PMID 18844328; Li PMID 32581767
SSCCFFDDBBXXBacopa monnieri假马齿苋（婆罗米）
Verdict结论Skip it不必买
Evidence证据Grade CC 级
Dose tested已验证剂量300-320 mg/d of extract standardised to 50-55% bacosides, for at least 12 weeks. It is not an acute agent.标准化至 50 至 55% 假马齿苋皂苷的提取物 300 至 320 毫克/天，至少 12 周。它不是急性起效的东西。
Who适用人群Healthy adults willing to take it daily for 12 weeks for a modest change in processing speed.愿意连续服用 12 周、以换取加工速度小幅变化的健康成人。
Pros优点
  • The meta-analysis restricted inclusion to chronic dosing of 12 weeks or more, which is methodologically sound, and found two statistically significant results.meta 分析把纳入范围限定为 12 周以上的长期给药，方法上是站得住的，并得到两个统计学显著的结果。
Cons缺点
  • Read the actual endpoints. The two significant results across 9 trials and 437 analysable subjects were a Trail Making Test B change of -17.9 MILLISECONDS and a choice reaction time change of about 10 ms. Millisecond-scale processing speed is being sold as memory and learning.要看真正的终点。9 项试验、437 名可分析受试者中，两个显著结果分别是连线测验 B 型缩短 17.9 毫秒，以及选择反应时缩短约 10 毫秒。毫秒级的加工速度变化，被当作记忆力和学习能力在卖。
  • The meta-analysis authors explicitly said larger comparative trials are needed before any recommendation.meta 分析作者明确表示，在提出任何建议之前需要更大规模的对照试验。
  • Nothing supports a memory or dementia effect.没有任何证据支持它对记忆或痴呆有作用。
  • Gastrointestinal adverse effects (nausea, cramping, increased stool frequency) are the commonest problem. Cholinergic activity means caution with donepezil, rivastigmine and galantamine, and with anticholinergics. Animal work suggests thyroid hormone effects, so care with levothyroxine.胃肠道不良反应（恶心、腹部绞痛、排便次数增多）是最常见的问题。它具胆碱能活性，与多奈哌齐、利伐斯的明、加兰他敏以及抗胆碱药合用需谨慎。动物研究提示其影响甲状腺激素，因此与左甲状腺素合用需注意。
What it does, and what happens without it它有什么作用，缺了会怎样

A herb used for memory; the body makes no use of its active compounds.一种用于改善记忆的草药,人体不会利用其活性成分。

No deficiency state exists不存在缺乏状态

In detail详细Bacopa monnieri contains triterpenoid saponins known as bacosides, and extracts are standardised to bacoside content, typically 20 to 55%. A systematic review of randomised placebo-controlled trials, all of which ran for 12 weeks, found the most consistent signal in delayed word recall, with attention, working memory and other domains inconsistent across studies. Proposed mechanisms include cholinergic modulation, dendritic branching and antioxidant activity in hippocampus, drawn largely from rodent work. Bacosides are plant secondary metabolites: they are absent from human tissue, no enzyme system requires them, and gastrointestinal upset is the common practical limitation on dosing.假马齿苋(Bacopa monnieri)含有称为bacosides的三萜皂苷类成分,提取物通常按bacoside含量标准化,一般为20%至55%。一项针对随机安慰剂对照试验的系统评价发现,所有纳入试验疗程均为12周,其中最一致的信号出现在延迟词语回忆上,而注意力、工作记忆等其他认知领域在各研究间结果并不一致。所提出的机制包括胆碱能调节、海马树突分支增加及抗氧化作用,这些主要来自啮齿动物研究。bacosides是植物次生代谢物:人体组织中不存在它们,也没有酶系统需要它们,胃肠道不适是限制其实际用量的常见因素。

There is no deficiency state for this. It is not an essential nutrient, so being short of it is not a thing that can happen.它不存在缺乏状态。它不是必需营养素，所以“缺了它”这件事本身并不成立。

Source来源PMID 22747190 (Pase et al., J Altern Complement Med 2012;18:647-652, systematic review of randomised controlled Bacopa trials)

Food and the body食物与身体
In food: Rich食物中：丰富 Dose from food: Partly靠吃达到剂量：部分 Body makes it: Cannot身体自产：不能 Food data: High食物数据：高

Bacopa monnieri (brahmi, water hyssop) is a real leafy vegetable in parts of India, which makes it the exception among the herbal entries here. Ethnobotanical surveys in West Bengal's Terai-Dooars, Maharashtra, Assam and northeast India record it among wild edible greens gathered and cooked, with tender shoots and leaves eaten fresh, cooked as a green, or made into chutneys and raita, so bacosides genuinely enter the food supply in a way withanolides and valerenic acid do not. RICH here describes concentration, since a culinary serving reaches a fifth to a half of the clinical dose, and it is worth being explicit that this is one regional green rather than several ordinary foods: the availability is narrow and geographically limited, which is a different axis from concentration and is where the submission's TRACE label went wrong. Note the naming trap: in parts of India brahmi refers to Centella asiatica, a different plant with different actives (asiaticosides), and market material is frequently mixed.Bacopa monnieri（brahmi，假马齿苋）在印度部分地区是真正的叶菜，这让它成为本组草药条目中的例外。西孟加拉 Terai-Dooars 地区、马哈拉施特拉、阿萨姆和印度东北部的民族植物学调查记录它属于采集后烹食的野生食用绿叶菜，嫩梢和叶被鲜食、当青菜炒煮，或做成酸辣酱（chutney）和 raita，所以假马齿苋皂苷（bacosides）确实以睡茄内酯和缬草酸做不到的方式进入了食物供应。这里的 RICH 描述的是浓度，因为一份普通菜量就能达到临床剂量的五分之一到一半；有必要明确的是，这只是一种地方性绿叶菜，而非若干常见食物：可获得性狭窄且地域受限，那是与浓度不同的另一个维度，也正是原稿 TRACE 标签出错的地方。注意名称陷阱：在印度部分地区，brahmi 指的是积雪草（Centella asiatica），那是另一种植物，活性成分不同（积雪草苷类，asiaticosides），市场上的原料经常混用。

Food食物 Per 100 g每 100 克 Portion一份 Per portion每份 Share占比 Source来源
Bacopa monnieri (brahmi) dried aerial herb / churna powder, elite cultivar DBM-4假马齿苋（brahmi）干地上部药材 / churna 药粉，优良品种 DBM-4 654 mg of bacoside A3 plus bacopaside II (1.57 mg/g bacoside A3 and 4.97 mg/g bacopaside II in dry herbage) 1 teaspoon dried powder (2 g)1 茶匙干粉（2 g） 13.1 mg bacosides about 9% of the roughly 150 mg of bacosides in a standard 300 mg dose of a 50-55% bacoside extract约为标准剂量（50-55% bacoside 提取物 300 mg 中约 150 mg bacosides）的 9% ICAR-Directorate of Medicinal and Aromatic Plants Research, Anand, variety release note for Bacopa monnieri DBM-4 (2020), https://icar.org.in/node/13442. Both figures, the DBM-4 designation and the CIM-Jagriti comparison were verified exactly; the verification pass called this the best-sourced food figure in the submission. Accession-level bacoside A survey in Industrial Crops and Products, PII S0926669021011134, gives the surrounding variation.

To match the dose要达到该剂量Trials use 300 mg/day of extract standardised to 50-55% bacosides, roughly 150-165 mg of bacosides. At the measured 6.54 mg/g for the two quantified bacoside constituents, that is about 23 g of dried brahmi herb per day, roughly eleven teaspoons of churna, which nobody eats in a day. A 2 g teaspoon of dried powder supplies 13.1 mg, about 9% of the dose. Converting to fresh greens requires a fresh-to-dry ratio the cited sources do not give, so only the dried figure is quoted: a realistic culinary serving of the fresh green, the quantity that goes into a thoran or a chutney, corresponds to single-digit grams of dry matter and therefore to a few tens of milligrams of bacosides, a fifth to a half of the trial dose. Eating brahmi as a vegetable is on the same scale as supplementing it without matching it, which is not true of anything else in this list except lion's mane. Total bacoside A also includes bacopasaponin C and a jujubogenin isomer that the cited analysis does not quantify, so the real herb content is somewhat higher than 6.54 mg/g and the gap correspondingly smaller.试验用量为 300 mg/天、标准化到 50-55% bacosides 的提取物，约合 150-165 mg bacosides。按实测的两种 bacoside 成分合计 6.54 mg/g 计算，相当于每天约 23 g 干 brahmi 药材，约合十一茶匙 churna 药粉，没有人一天吃这么多。一茶匙 2 g 干粉提供 13.1 mg，约为剂量的 9%。换算成新鲜绿叶需要所引来源没有给出的鲜干比，所以这里只列干重数据：一份现实的鲜菜量，也就是做 thoran 或 chutney 会用的分量，对应个位数克的干物质，因而是几十毫克的 bacosides，即试验剂量的五分之一到一半。把 brahmi 当菜吃，量级上与吃补充剂接近，只是达不到同等水平，这在本列表中除猴头菇外没有别的例子。此外，bacoside A 总量还包括所引分析未定量的 bacopasaponin C 和一个 jujubogenin 异构体，所以药材的真实含量比 6.54 mg/g 更高一些，差距也相应更小。

Food vs supplement食物与补充剂Bacoside content in the herb varies several-fold with accession, season and harvest, which is exactly why breeding programmes select elite lines such as DBM-4, so a wild-gathered green is an unpredictable dose. Extraction matters too: bacosides are saponins recovered by hydroalcoholic extraction, and boiling a green in water for a curry leaches an unknown fraction into cooking liquid that may be discarded. The best-studied products (CDRI-08, BacoMind) are specific standardised extracts and their cognitive trial results should not be read across to eating the plant. Bacopa also has real dose-dependent gastrointestinal effects, cramping, nausea and loose stools, more prominent with the concentrated extract than with the vegetable, and it has cholinergic activity that could matter alongside cholinesterase inhibitors. Watch for Centella asiatica sold as brahmi, and for heavy metal accumulation, since Bacopa is a wetland plant with documented capacity to take up metals from sediment.药材中的 bacoside 含量随种质、季节和采收期变化数倍，这正是育种项目要选育 DBM-4 这类优良品系的原因，所以野采的绿叶菜是一个不可预测的剂量。提取方式同样重要：bacosides 是皂苷，靠水醇提取回收，而把青菜在水里煮成菜肴时，会有不确定比例浸入可能被倒掉的汤汁。研究最充分的产品（CDRI-08、BacoMind）是特定的标准化提取物，其认知功能试验结果不应照搬到吃这种植物上。假马齿苋还有明确的剂量依赖性胃肠道反应，绞痛、恶心和稀便，浓缩提取物比蔬菜更明显；它具有胆碱能活性，与胆碱酯酶抑制剂同用时可能需要注意。要留意积雪草被当作 brahmi 出售，也要留意重金属蓄积，因为假马齿苋是湿地植物，有从底泥中吸收金属的明确能力。

Absorption吸收Bacosides are large triterpenoid saponin glycosides with poor membrane permeability and low oral bioavailability; the pharmacologically relevant species are thought to be the deglycosylated sapogenins (jujubogenin and pseudojujubogenin derivatives) generated by gut hydrolysis, which is why supplement makers push phospholipid-complex and nanoparticle formulations. Eating the whole green delivers the same glycosides embedded in a fibrous matrix with fat from the cooking medium, and it has never been compared head to head with an extract in humans, so the fresh-vegetable route is plausible and uncharacterised. The saponins themselves also have surfactant behaviour in the gut, which is part of why higher doses cause GI upset.bacosides 是大分子三萜皂苷糖苷，膜通透性差，口服生物利用度低；一般认为具药理意义的形式是肠道水解生成的脱糖基皂苷元（jujubogenin 和 pseudojujubogenin 衍生物），这也是补充剂厂家推磷脂复合物和纳米制剂的原因。整棵菜吃下去，提供的是同样的糖苷，只是嵌在纤维基质中并伴随烹调油脂，而它从未在人体上与提取物做过头对头比较，所以鲜菜途径可行但未被表征。皂苷本身在肠道内还有表面活性行为，这也是高剂量引起胃肠不适的部分原因。

Food data note食物数据说明The ICAR DBM-4 bacoside figures were verified exactly against the cited release note, including the variety designation, and every derived step recomputed correctly (654 mg per 100 g, 13.1 mg per 2 g teaspoon, about 9% of dose, 23 g and about eleven teaspoons for 150 mg). The one soft spot is that no fresh-to-dry ratio is available in the cited sources, so the fresh-green serving is described qualitatively rather than given a number高。ICAR 的 DBM-4 bacoside 数据已逐项对照所引品种发布说明核实，包括品种名称，各步推导也重算无误（每 100 g 654 mg、每 2 g 茶匙 13.1 mg、约为剂量的 9%、150 mg 需 23 g 和约十一茶匙）。唯一的薄弱处是所引来源没有鲜干比，所以鲜菜份量只作定性描述，没有给出数字。

Does the body make it身体是否自产The active fraction is the bacosides, dammarane-type triterpenoid saponins from the plant. Humans cyclise 2,3-oxidosqualene through the protosteryl cation to lanosterol and then to cholesterol and have no dammarenediol synthase, so the dammarane skeleton is never formed at all, and no human glycosyltransferase attaches the bacoside sugar chains. There is no endogenous pool to top up, so the case rests on the cognition trials, which show a small effect on memory acquisition after weeks of dosing.活性组分是 bacosides, 属植物来源的达玛烷型三萜皂苷。人把 2,3-oxidosqualene 经原甾醇正离子环化为 lanosterol 再到胆固醇, 没有 dammarenediol synthase, 所以达玛烷骨架在人体中根本不会形成, 也没有人类 glycosyltransferase 接上 bacoside 的糖链。没有内源池可补, 所以判断靠认知试验, 而这些试验显示连续给药数周后对记忆获得有小幅作用。

Pathway合成通路NOT APPLICABLE. Plant triterpenoid saponin biosynthesis in Bacopa monnieri routes 2,3-oxidosqualene through the dammarenyl cation via dammarenediol synthase, then glycosyltransferases. Human oxidosqualene cyclase routes the same substrate through the protosteryl cation to lanosterol, so no dammarane intermediate exists in humans.NOT APPLICABLE。Bacopa monnieri 的植物三萜皂苷合成把 2,3-oxidosqualene 经达玛烯基正离子由 dammarenediol synthase 处理, 再经 glycosyltransferases 糖基化。人的 oxidosqualene cyclase 把同一底物经原甾醇正离子导向 lanosterol, 所以人体中不存在达玛烷中间体。

Amount made自产量0 (no human biosynthetic pathway)0 (人体没有相应的生物合成途径)

  • The eosinophilia-myalgia syndrome question is unresolved. The 1989 outbreak was linked to contaminated L-tryptophan and Cochrane flagged that the possibility of a similar contaminant in 5-HTP products has not been excluded.嗜酸性粒细胞增多-肌痛综合征的问题至今未解决。1989 年的疫情与污染的 L-色氨酸有关，Cochrane 指出，5-HTP 产品中存在类似污染物的可能性尚未被排除。

This is a direct serotonin precursor, so the risk is mechanistic rather than theoretical.与 SSRI、SNRI、包括不可逆型在内的 MAOI、三环类、曲马多、曲普坦类、利奈唑胺、锂盐和右美沙芬合用有 5-羟色胺综合征风险。它是直接的 5-羟色胺前体，所以这个风险是机制性的，不是理论上的。
What it does, and what happens without it它有什么作用，缺了会怎样

The chemical step between tryptophan and serotonin; the body makes its own supply.色氨酸转化为血清素过程中的中间产物,人体自身即可合成所需的量。

No deficiency state exists不存在缺乏状态

In detail详细5-hydroxytryptophan is the intermediate between the essential amino acid tryptophan and serotonin: tryptophan hydroxylase produces it, and aromatic L-amino acid decarboxylase converts it onward to serotonin. Supplemental 5-HTP bypasses the rate-limiting hydroxylation step and escapes diversion into the kynurenine pathway, which is why it raises serotonin synthesis more directly than tryptophan does, including in peripheral tissues where that is not wanted. Ordinary food supplies essentially none of it; the dietary requirement is for tryptophan, and that is where any nutritional argument belongs. Impaired central serotonin synthesis in tetrahydrobiopterin disorders and in aromatic L-amino acid decarboxylase deficiency is an inborn error of metabolism, entirely separate from intake, and 5-HTP is prescribed or withheld in those conditions on genetic grounds.5-羟色氨酸(5-HTP)是必需氨基酸色氨酸(tryptophan)与血清素之间的中间产物:由色氨酸羟化酶(tryptophan hydroxylase)生成,再由芳香族L-氨基酸脱羧酶(aromatic L-amino acid decarboxylase)进一步转化为血清素。补充的5-HTP绕过了限速的羟化步骤,并避开了向犬尿氨酸通路的分流,这就是它比色氨酸更直接地提高血清素合成的原因,包括在不希望发生此事的外周组织中。普通食物基本不提供5-HTP,膳食需求针对的是色氨酸,任何营养学论证都应落在色氨酸上。四氢生物蝶呤(tetrahydrobiopterin)代谢障碍及芳香族L-氨基酸脱羧酶缺乏症中出现的中枢血清素合成受损,是一种先天性代谢缺陷,与摄入量完全无关,在这些情况下是否使用5-HTP是基于遗传学理由决定的。

There is no deficiency state for this. It is not an essential nutrient, so being short of it is not a thing that can happen.它不存在缺乏状态。它不是必需营养素，所以“缺了它”这件事本身并不成立。

Source来源PMID 11869656 (Shaw, Turner & Del Mar, Cochrane Database Syst Rev 2002;(1):CD003198, tryptophan and 5-hydroxytryptophan for depression); PMID 10721089 (Klarskov K, Johnson KL, Benson LM, Gleich GJ, Naylor S, Adv Exp Med Biol 1999;467:461-468, eosinophilia-myalgia syndrome case-associated contaminants in commercially available 5-hydroxytryptophan)

Food and the body食物与身体
In food: None食物中：无 Dose from food: Out of reach靠吃达到剂量：达不到 Body makes it: Body makes it身体自产：身体自产 Food data: High食物数据：高

5-hydroxytryptophan is not a dietary constituent. In living tissue it exists only as a transient intracellular intermediate between tryptophan and serotonin, immediately decarboxylated by aromatic L-amino acid decarboxylase, so it does not accumulate in any food at measurable levels. The commercial article is a purified single molecule, either extracted from the seeds of Griffonia simplicifolia, a West African climbing shrub whose seeds are an unusual botanical accumulator at 156 mg/g dry weight (about 16%) in a chemically characterised reference sample against literature concentrations of 10-20%, or, increasingly, produced by microbial or enzymatic biosynthesis. Griffonia seed is a pharmaceutical raw material rather than a food, which is why SYNTHETIC fits better than the NOT_FOOD label used for botanical drugs such as valerian or ashwagandha. The foods listed below are tryptophan sources, a different molecule one step upstream, scored against the WHO/FAO/UNU 2007 adult requirement of 4 mg tryptophan per kg per day (280 mg/day for a 70 kg adult) rather than against any 5-HTP dose.5-羟基色氨酸不是膳食成分。在活体组织中，它只作为色氨酸到血清素之间的瞬时细胞内中间体存在，会被芳香族 L-氨基酸脱羧酶立即脱羧，因此不会在任何食物中蓄积到可测量的水平。市售产品是纯化的单一分子，或从 Griffonia simplicifolia（西非一种攀缘灌木）的种子中提取，该种子是不寻常的植物蓄积体，一份经化学表征的参照样品达 156 mg/g 干重（约 16%），文献浓度为 10-20%；或者越来越多地由微生物或酶法生物合成得到。Griffonia 种子是药用原料，不是食物，这就是 SYNTHETIC 比用于缬草、南非醉茄这类植物药的 NOT_FOOD 标签更贴合的原因。下面列出的食物是色氨酸来源，那是上游一步的另一个分子，评分依据是 WHO/FAO/UNU 2007 年成人需要量每公斤体重每天 4 mg 色氨酸（70 kg 成人 280 mg/天），而非任何 5-HTP 剂量。

To match the dose要达到该剂量For 5-HTP itself the gap is absolute: no food contains it in measurable quantity, so no eating quantity reproduces the 50-300 mg/day used in trials. From the manufacturing raw material, 100 mg of 5-HTP sits in about 0.64 g of Griffonia seed at 156 mg/g, a striking number and irrelevant to eating, since Griffonia seed is not a food and carries other constituents. Via the dietary precursor the arithmetic runs deceptively the other way. An ordinary mixed diet supplies roughly 900-1000 mg of tryptophan a day, three to twenty times a 5-HTP dose by mass, and a single chicken breast supplies 434 mg, yet that intake does not act like 5-HTP for three reasons. Over 95% of tryptophan is degraded down the kynurenine pathway by TDO and IDO, with only about 1-2% passing through tryptophan hydroxylase to serotonin (PMC5398323; PMC9292703). Tryptophan competes with the other large neutral amino acids, leucine, isoleucine, valine, phenylalanine and tyrosine, for the LAT1 transporter at the blood-brain barrier, and every protein food raises tryptophan and its competitors together, so a high-protein meal can leave the brain tryptophan ratio flat or lower. And tryptophan hydroxylase is the regulated rate-limiting step, so raising substrate does little. 5-HTP sidesteps all three: it is past the rate-limiting hydroxylation and is decarboxylated by ubiquitous AADC. Adding 300 mg of tryptophan to a meal is therefore not equivalent to 300 mg of 5-HTP, and no realistic quantity of food makes it so.就 5-HTP 本身而言，差距是绝对的：没有食物含有可测量的量，所以没有任何进食量能重现试验所用的 50-300 mg/天。从生产原料看，按 156 mg/g 计算，100 mg 5-HTP 存在于约 0.64 g Griffonia 种子中，这个数字很惊人，与吃东西无关，因为 Griffonia 种子不是食物，还含有其他成分。走膳食前体这条路，算术的方向反而具有欺骗性。普通混合膳食每天提供约 900-1000 mg 色氨酸，按质量计是 5-HTP 剂量的三到二十倍，单块鸡胸肉就提供 434 mg，但这种摄入不会像 5-HTP 那样起作用，原因有三。超过 95% 的色氨酸经 TDO 和 IDO 沿犬尿氨酸通路降解，只有约 1-2% 经色氨酸羟化酶转向血清素（PMC5398323；PMC9292703）。色氨酸要与其他大分子中性氨基酸（亮氨酸、异亮氨酸、缬氨酸、苯丙氨酸和酪氨酸）竞争血脑屏障上的 LAT1 转运体，而每种蛋白质食物都会同时提高色氨酸和它的竞争者，所以一顿高蛋白餐可能让脑内色氨酸比值持平甚至下降。而色氨酸羟化酶是受调控的限速步骤，提高底物作用很小。5-HTP 绕开了这三点：它已越过限速的羟化步骤，并由普遍存在的 AADC 脱羧。因此在一餐中加 300 mg 色氨酸并不等于 300 mg 5-HTP，任何现实的食物量都做不到这一点。

Food vs supplement食物与补充剂Bypassing the pathway's regulation is what makes 5-HTP a drug rather than a nutrient. AADC is present throughout peripheral tissues, so much of an oral 5-HTP dose is converted to serotonin outside the central nervous system, which produces the characteristic nausea and is why clinical protocols historically paired 5-HTP with a peripheral decarboxylase inhibitor such as carbidopa. Combined with SSRIs, SNRIs, MAOIs, tramadol, triptans or linezolid, 5-HTP carries a genuine serotonin syndrome risk that no amount of dietary tryptophan does. There is also a contamination history worth naming: the 1989 eosinophilia-myalgia syndrome epidemic was traced to a contaminant in bacterially produced L-tryptophan, and a related peak X impurity has been detected in some 5-HTP preparations, so purity of a purified plant extract or fermentation product is not a given. Note also that commercial 98% 5-HTP claims are computed on identified compounds rather than on seed weight, and one commercial extract labelled 95% assayed at about 65%. Griffonia seed should not be eaten as a food substitute; the whole seed carries other constituents and is not characterised for dietary safety. Nothing about the tryptophan-rich foods above raises comparable concerns; they are food, and the warm-milk folklore is folklore. Separately, the food table here is narrower than it should be: it contains no legume, no plant-protein concentrate and no cheese richer than cheddar, and dried spirulina, soybeans and soy protein isolate, Parmesan, sesame seeds, turkey, tuna, oats and peanuts are all absent. No figures for them could be verified in this pass, so they are named rather than tabulated, but their absence makes the requirement look harder to meet than it is.绕过该通路的调控，正是 5-HTP 成为药物而非营养素的原因。AADC 遍布外周组织，所以口服 5-HTP 的很大一部分在中枢神经系统之外被转化为血清素，这产生了典型的恶心反应，也是临床方案历来把 5-HTP 与卡比多巴等外周脱羧酶抑制剂配伍使用的原因。与 SSRI、SNRI、MAOI、曲马多、曲普坦类或利奈唑胺合用时，5-HTP 有真实的血清素综合征风险，而膳食色氨酸无论多少都没有这种风险。还有一段值得点明的污染史：1989 年嗜酸性粒细胞增多-肌痛综合征的暴发被追溯到细菌法生产的 L-色氨酸中的一种污染物，某些 5-HTP 制剂中也检出过相关的 peak X 杂质，所以纯化植物提取物或发酵产品的纯度并非理所当然。另外，市售 98% 5-HTP 的说法是按已鉴定化合物计算的，不按种子重量计算；一份标称 95% 的市售提取物实测约 65%。Griffonia 种子不应当作食物替代品食用；整粒种子含有其他成分，膳食安全性未经表征。上面那些富含色氨酸的食物没有类似问题，它们就是食物，而睡前热牛奶的说法只是民间说法。还有一点：这里的食物表比应有的范围窄，其中没有豆类、没有植物蛋白浓缩物，也没有比切达更高的奶酪，干螺旋藻、大豆和大豆分离蛋白、帕玛森奶酪、芝麻、火鸡肉、金枪鱼、燕麦和花生全部缺失。本轮无法核实它们的数据，因此只点名不入表，但它们的缺席让需要量看起来比实际更难达到。

Absorption吸收The whole point of 5-HTP is that its absorption route differs from its precursor's. 5-HTP is absorbed from the small intestine and crosses the blood-brain barrier without competing significantly for the LAT1 large-neutral-amino-acid carrier, so plasma and brain 5-HTP rise roughly in proportion to dose, unlike tryptophan whose brain entry depends on the tryptophan-to-LNAA ratio rather than on absolute intake. Dietary tryptophan absorption from protein foods is efficient at the gut level, over 90%, and the losses that matter are metabolic rather than absorptive: hepatic TDO is induced by cortisol and by tryptophan itself, and IDO is induced by inflammation, so illness, stress and high-protein intake all divert precursor toward kynurenine. This is why the classic dietary manoeuvre for raising brain tryptophan is a carbohydrate load with little protein, using an insulin-driven fall in circulating branched-chain amino acids to improve the ratio, an effect measured in single-digit percentage changes and nothing like a 100 mg 5-HTP capsule.5-HTP 的关键在于它的吸收路径与前体不同。5-HTP 在小肠吸收，穿过血脑屏障时不与 LAT1 大分子中性氨基酸载体发生显著竞争，所以血浆和脑内 5-HTP 大致随剂量成比例上升；色氨酸进入脑内则取决于色氨酸与其他大分子中性氨基酸的比值，与绝对摄入量无关。蛋白质食物中的膳食色氨酸在肠道层面吸收效率高，超过 90%，真正重要的损失是代谢性的：肝脏 TDO 受皮质醇和色氨酸自身诱导，IDO 受炎症诱导，所以疾病、应激和高蛋白摄入都会把前体转向犬尿氨酸。这就是提高脑内色氨酸的经典膳食手段是低蛋白的高碳水负荷的原因，它借助胰岛素引起的循环支链氨基酸下降来改善比值，效应量以个位数百分比计，与一粒 100 mg 5-HTP 胶囊完全不在同一量级。

Food data note食物数据说明for what remains. All six USDA tryptophan values were confirmed against SR Legacy with no errors, all six per-portion and percent-of-requirement figures recompute correctly against the verified WHO/FAO/UNU denominator of 280 mg/day, and the Griffonia 156 mg/g figure and the 0.64 g per 100 mg calculation were verified against full text. Two Griffonia figures that could not be found in their cited source have been withdrawn rather than restated, and the cheddar value carries the verifier's caveat that the USDA number is probably an imputation artefact就保留下来的内容而言为高。六项 USDA 色氨酸数值全部对照 SR Legacy 确认无误，六个每份含量和占需要量百分比的数字按核实过的 WHO/FAO/UNU 分母 280 mg/天重算均正确，Griffonia 的 156 mg/g 数据和 100 mg 对应 0.64 g 的计算已对照全文核实。两个在所引来源中找不到的 Griffonia 数据已撤回而未重述，切达奶酪数值带有核查者的提示，即该 USDA 数字很可能是插补产物。

Does the body make it身体是否自产Every serotonin-producing cell makes its own 5-HTP continuously from dietary tryptophan, and none of it accumulates because aromatic L-amino acid decarboxylase converts it straight to serotonin. The recovered row labelled it INTERMEDIATE because 5-HTP is an obligate transient intermediate with no storage pool, no dietary requirement and no measurable body pool; on this enum it rolls up to FULL, since the human pathway is complete and covers basal need in health. Tryptophan hydroxylase is the rate-limiting and regulated step, and swallowing 5-HTP forces the pathway past that control point, producing serotonin wherever aromatic L-amino acid decarboxylase sits, mainly the gut, where most body serotonin already is.每个产血清素的细胞都在用膳食色氨酸持续生成自己的 5-HTP, 而且不会积累, 因为 aromatic L-amino acid decarboxylase 立刻把它转成血清素。原条目标为 INTERMEDIATE, 理由是 5-HTP 是必经的瞬时中间体, 没有储存池, 没有膳食需要量, 也没有可测的体内池; 在本枚举下归入 FULL, 因为人体通路完整且健康时覆盖基础需要。tryptophan hydroxylase 是限速且受调控的一步, 口服 5-HTP 会把途径推过这个控制点, 在任何有 aromatic L-amino acid decarboxylase 的地方生成血清素, 主要是肠道, 而全身大部分血清素本来就在那里。

Pathway合成通路L-tryptophan to 5-HTP by tryptophan hydroxylase (TPH1 in gut and pancreatic enterochromaffin cells, pinealocytes, mast cells, mononuclear leukocytes, spleen, thymus, pancreatic beta cells and peripheral tissues including heart, lung, kidney, duodenum, adrenal and female reproductive tract; TPH2 in raphe neurons), then 5-HTP to serotonin by aromatic L-amino acid decarboxylase. TPH is rate-limiting and subsaturated, because its Km for tryptophan is near or above actual tissue tryptophan concentrations. The liver is not a TPH1 site: hepatic serotonin comes from platelets and gut.L-tryptophan 经 tryptophan hydroxylase 生成 5-HTP (TPH1 分布于肠道和胰腺的嗜铬细胞, 松果体细胞, 肥大细胞, 单核白细胞, 脾, 胸腺, 胰腺 beta 细胞, 以及心, 肺, 肾, 十二指肠, 肾上腺和女性生殖道等外周组织; TPH2 在中缝核神经元), 再由 aromatic L-amino acid decarboxylase 生成血清素。TPH 限速并处于亚饱和状态, 因为它对色氨酸的 Km 接近或高于组织中实际的色氨酸浓度。肝不是 TPH1 的部位: 肝内血清素来自血小板和肠道。

Amount made自产量NOT ESTABLISHED. 5-HTP is an obligate transient intermediate with no storage pool, and whole-body synthesis flux has not been quantified in humans. Flux anchor for scale: only about 1 to 2 percent of tryptophan flux enters the hydroxylase branch and over 90 percent goes down the kynurenine pathway, so a 100 mg oral dose sits far above the physiological branch it feeds.NOT ESTABLISHED。5-HTP 是必经的瞬时中间体, 没有储存池, 全身合成通量在人体中未被定量。用于把握量级的通量参照: 色氨酸通量只有约 1% 至 2% 进入羟化酶这条支路, 超过 90% 走 kynurenine 途径, 所以 100 mg 的口服剂量远高于它所进入的那条生理支路。

Still matters when仍有意义的情形Only where bypassing tryptophan hydroxylase regulation is the deliberate aim, and preferably with a peripheral decarboxylase inhibitor such as carbidopa to steer conversion centrally, as used in research settings. Otherwise NEVER ON THIS AXIS: tryptophan intake is the physiological lever, and unopposed 5-HTP alongside an SSRI or MAOI is a serotonin toxicity risk.只在刻意要绕过 tryptophan hydroxylase 调控时才有意义, 并且最好像研究场景那样合用外周脱羧酶抑制剂 (例如 carbidopa) 把转化引向中枢。其他情况 NEVER ON THIS AXIS: 色氨酸摄入才是生理杠杆, 而在使用 SSRI 或 MAOI 时单独加 5-HTP 有血清素毒性风险。

Synthesis source合成来源PMID 16023217 (Turner EH, Pharmacol Ther 2006;109:325-38, Serotonin a la carte: supplementation with the serotonin precursor 5-hydroxytryptophan). Enum note: the recovered label INTERMEDIATE was mapped to FULL under the dataset's four-label definitions row.

Refs.文献 Cochrane Shaw PMID 11687048
SSCCFFDDBBXXVitamin K2 (MK-7 and MK-4)维生素 K2（MK-7 与 MK-4）
Verdict结论Skip it不必买
Evidence证据Grade CC 级
Dose tested已验证剂量MK-7 180-720 µg/d in trials. MK-4 45 mg/d in the Japanese fracture trial, roughly 250 times the MK-7 dose.试验中 MK-7 为 180 至 720 微克/天。日本骨折试验中 MK-4 为 45 毫克/天，约为 MK-7 剂量的 250 倍。
Who适用人群Nobody with solid evidence of clinical benefit.没有任何人群有确凿的临床获益证据。
Pros优点
  • The carboxylation mechanism is real: MK-7 does carboxylate osteocalcin and matrix Gla protein, and the biomarkers move.羧化机制是真实的：MK-7 确实会羧化骨钙素和基质 Gla 蛋白，生物标志物也确实变化。
  • Knapen 2013 (n=244 healthy postmenopausal women, 180 µg/d for 3 years) significantly slowed the age-related decline in bone mineral content and density at lumbar spine and femoral neck. Surrogate endpoint, and not at the total hip.Knapen 2013（244 名健康绝经后女性，180 微克/天服 3 年）显著减缓了腰椎和股骨颈骨矿含量与骨密度的随龄下降。这是替代终点，且全髋部位没有效果。
  • No adverse effect level has been identified, so no upper limit exists.未发现不良作用水平，因此没有设定上限。
Cons缺点
  • The core sales pitch, that D3 without K2 calcifies your arteries, is a marketing construct. No randomised trial has ever shown that vitamin D supplementation causes vascular calcification which K2 then prevents.核心卖点，也就是“只补 D3 不补 K2 会让血管钙化”，是一个营销构造。没有任何随机试验显示过维生素 D 补充会导致血管钙化、而 K2 能加以阻止。
  • The calcification claim has been tested and failed twice. AVADEC: 720 µg MK-7 plus vitamin D for 24 months in 365 men with aortic valve calcification, progression 275 versus 292 AU, no difference. VitaK-CAC: 360 µg MK-7 for 2 years in 167 coronary patients, coronary calcium rose from 135 to 184 AU on MK-7 anyway.钙化方面的说法已被检验两次并失败。AVADEC：365 名主动脉瓣钙化男性服用 720 微克 MK-7 加维生素 D 共 24 个月，进展为 275 对 292 AU，无差异。VitaK-CAC：167 名冠心病患者服用 360 微克 MK-7 共 2 年，MK-7 组冠脉钙化照样从 135 升到 184 AU。
  • MK-4 is worse. The impressive vertebral-fracture odds ratios in K2 marketing trace to small Japanese menatetrenone trials, and when the hypothesis was tested properly the OF study (n=4,378, 45 mg/d, 36-48 months) was NULL on new vertebral fractures. One frequently cited supporting paper has been RETRACTED for research misconduct.MK-4 更糟。K2 营销中那些漂亮的椎体骨折比值比源自小型日本甲基萘醌试验，而当这个假说被正规检验时，OF 研究（n=4378，45 毫克/天，36 至 48 个月）在新发椎体骨折上是阴性的。一篇常被引用的支持性论文已因科研不端被撤稿。
  • MK-4 has essentially no oral bioavailability at supplement doses. A single 420 µg dose of MK-4 was not detectable in the serum of any subject at any time point, while the same dose of MK-7 peaked at 6 hours and stayed detectable for 48 hours.在补充剂剂量下 MK-4 基本没有口服生物利用度。单次 420 微克 MK-4 在任何受试者的任何时间点都检测不到，而同剂量的 MK-7 在 6 小时达峰并可检测 48 小时。
  • Absolute practical contraindication with warfarin and other vitamin K antagonists. MK-7 has a long half-life, so even modest doses destabilise INR for days to weeks.与华法林及其他维生素 K 拮抗剂在实际使用中属绝对禁忌。MK-7 半衰期长，即便中等剂量也会让 INR 在数天到数周内不稳定。
What it does, and what happens without it它有什么作用，缺了会怎样

Activates proteins that clot blood and that steer calcium into bone rather than artery walls.激活促使血液凝固的蛋白，以及引导钙沉积于骨骼而非动脉壁的蛋白。

Named deficiency disease有明确的缺乏症 Partly reversible部分可逆

In detail详细Every form of vitamin K works as the cofactor for gamma-glutamyl carboxylase, the enzyme that converts specific glutamate residues into gamma-carboxyglutamate (Gla), giving those proteins the ability to bind calcium and function. In the liver this activates clotting factors II, VII, IX and X together with the anticoagulant proteins C, S and Z, which is the function the dietary requirement is set on. Outside the liver the same reaction activates osteocalcin in bone and matrix Gla protein in vascular smooth muscle, matrix Gla protein being a local inhibitor of arterial calcification. MK-7 differs from phylloquinone (K1) mainly in pharmacokinetics: a long isoprenoid side chain gives it a circulating half-life of days rather than hours, so it reaches extrahepatic tissue more consistently. MK-4 is the form tissues synthesise for themselves from K1 or menadione via UBIAD1, and as a supplement it clears within hours. Whether raising menaquinone intake above the amount that maintains normal carboxylation changes bone or vascular outcomes is a question about supplementation, separate from the vitamin's essential role.各种形式的维生素K都作为γ-谷氨酰羧化酶（gamma-glutamyl carboxylase）的辅因子发挥作用，该酶将特定谷氨酸残基转化为γ-羧基谷氨酸（Gla），使相关蛋白获得结合钙并发挥功能的能力。在肝脏中，这一反应激活凝血因子II、VII、IX和X，以及抗凝蛋白C、S和Z，这也是膳食需求量所依据的功能。在肝脏之外，同样的反应激活骨骼中的骨钙素（osteocalcin）及血管平滑肌中的基质Gla蛋白（matrix Gla protein），后者是动脉钙化的局部抑制因子。MK-7与叶绿醌（phylloquinone，K1）的主要区别在于药代动力学：其较长的异戊二烯侧链使其循环半衰期为数天而非数小时，因而能更稳定地到达肝外组织。MK-4是组织通过UBIAD1由K1或甲萘醌自行合成的形式，作为补充剂时其清除时间为数小时。将甲萘醌摄入量提高到超过维持正常羧化所需水平是否会改变骨骼或血管相关结局，属于补充剂层面的问题，不同于该维生素本身的必需作用。

Deficiency disease缺乏症Vitamin K deficiency bleeding (VKDB), historically called haemorrhagic disease of the newborn. No deficiency disease is attributed to menaquinones specifically: intake recommendations are set for total vitamin K and are based on phylloquinone, and no separate K2 requirement has been established.维生素K缺乏性出血（vitamin K deficiency bleeding, VKDB），历史上称为新生儿出血病。没有专门归因于甲萘醌类（menaquinones）的缺乏性疾病：摄入推荐量是针对总维生素K制定的，且以叶绿醌为基础，尚未确立单独的K2需求量。

First signs早期表现A rising PIVKA-II (undercarboxylated prothrombin) is the earliest coagulation marker, followed by a prolonged prothrombin time and raised INR. Clinically, easy bruising, oozing from puncture or venepuncture sites, nosebleeds, bleeding gums or heavy menstrual loss. Undercarboxylated osteocalcin rises before any of the clotting markers, but on its own it is a biochemical finding whose clinical significance is unsettled.PIVKA-II（羧化不足的凝血酶原）升高是最早的凝血指标，随后出现凝血酶原时间延长及INR升高。临床上表现为易出现瘀斑、穿刺或静脉穿刺部位渗血、鼻出血、牙龈出血或月经过多。羧化不足的骨钙素升高早于任何凝血指标，但其单独出现只是一项生化发现，临床意义尚无定论。

Untreated不治疗会怎样In newborns, classic VKDB appears in the first week as bleeding from the umbilical stump, gastrointestinal tract, circumcision site or puncture wounds. Late VKDB appears at 2 to 12 weeks and is the dangerous form: roughly half of cases present with intracranial haemorrhage, causing death or lasting neurological injury. In adults with severe malabsorption, cholestasis or prolonged broad-spectrum antibiotics plus poor intake, deficiency produces spontaneous gastrointestinal, retroperitoneal or intracranial bleeding.新生儿中，经典型VKDB在出生第一周内出现，表现为脐残端、消化道、包皮环切部位或穿刺伤口出血。迟发型VKDB出现于出生后2至12周，是危险性更高的类型：约半数病例表现为颅内出血，导致死亡或永久性神经损伤。成人中，若存在严重吸收不良、胆汁淤积，或长期使用广谱抗生素合并摄入不足，缺乏可导致自发性消化道、腹膜后或颅内出血。

Does it reverse补回来能修复吗The coagulopathy itself corrects completely and quickly: parenteral vitamin K restores clotting factor activity within hours, and prothrombin complex concentrate acts immediately. What does not reverse is the injury from a bleed that has already happened, and intracranial haemorrhage in late VKDB leaves permanent neurological deficit or death in a substantial proportion of affected infants. This is why prophylaxis at birth matters more than treatment.凝血功能障碍本身可完全且迅速纠正：肠外途径给予维生素K可在数小时内恢复凝血因子活性，凝血酶原复合物浓缩剂则可立即起效。无法逆转的是已经发生的出血所造成的损伤，迟发型VKDB中的颅内出血会使相当一部分患儿遗留永久性神经损害或死亡。这正是出生时预防性用药比事后治疗更重要的原因。

Who becomes deficient谁会缺乏Newborns above all, who are born with low stores, receive little vitamin K in breast milk and have an immature gut flora. Intramuscular vitamin K at birth prevents this, and declining or omitting that injection is the main cause of late VKDB in high-income countries today. Beyond infancy: fat malabsorption, cholestasis and biliary obstruction, cystic fibrosis, extensive small bowel resection, and people on vitamin K antagonists such as warfarin, in whom the deficiency is induced on purpose. Dietary vitamin K deficiency in a healthy adult is rare, because phylloquinone is abundant in green vegetables and the liver recycles it efficiently.首要的高危人群是新生儿，出生时储备低，母乳中维生素K含量少，肠道菌群尚未成熟。出生时肌注维生素K可预防这一情况，如今在高收入国家，迟发型VKDB的主要原因正是拒绝或漏打这一针剂。婴儿期之外的高危人群包括：脂肪吸收不良、胆汁淤积及胆道梗阻、囊性纤维化、广泛小肠切除，以及服用华法林等维生素K拮抗剂者（这类患者的缺乏是有意诱导产生的）。健康成人的膳食性维生素K缺乏罕见，因为叶绿醌广泛存在于绿叶蔬菜中，且肝脏能高效地将其循环利用。

How common有多常见Without prophylaxis, classic VKDB affects an estimated 0.25% to 1.7% of newborns and late VKDB occurs at roughly 4.4 to 7.2 per 100,000 births, the figures used by CDC and the AAP (PMID 24226627). Shearer's surveillance review gives 4 to 7 cases per 100,000 births for Europe and separately reports substantially higher rates from Southeast Asia (PMID 18804903). No population prevalence figure is established for clinical vitamin K deficiency in healthy adults, where it is rare. Undercarboxylated osteocalcin and inactive matrix Gla protein are detectable in a large share of adults, but that is a biomarker observation with no defined clinical deficiency threshold.在未预防的情况下，经典型VKDB估计影响0.25%至1.7%的新生儿，迟发型VKDB发生率约为每100,000活产4.4至7.2例，这是CDC和AAP采用的数据（PMID 24226627）。Shearer的监测综述给出欧洲每100,000活产4至7例的数据，并另外报告东南亚地区的发生率明显更高（PMID 18804903）。健康成人临床维生素K缺乏症尚无确立的人群患病率数据，该情况在成人中较为罕见。羧化不足的骨钙素及无活性的基质Gla蛋白在很大一部分成人中均可检出，但这只是一项生物标志物观察结果，没有明确的临床缺乏阈值。

Source来源PMID 24226627 (MMWR 2013, Late Vitamin K Deficiency Bleeding in Infants Whose Parents Declined Vitamin K Prophylaxis, Tennessee), source of the 0.25-1.7% classic and 4.4-7.2 per 100,000 late VKDB figures; PMID 18804903 (Shearer MJ, Blood Rev 2009, Vitamin K deficiency bleeding in early infancy), source of the European 4-7 per 100,000 rate and of the higher Southeast Asian rates; doi:10.1146/annurev-nutr-080508-141217 (Booth SL, Annu Rev Nutr 2009;29:89-110, Roles for vitamin K beyond coagulation)

Food and the body食物与身体
In food: Mixed食物中：视形式 Dose from food: Partly靠吃达到剂量：部分 Body makes it: Partly身体自产：部分自产 Food data: Low食物数据：低

The two menaquinones need separate answers, because one merged label buries the whole point. MK-7 is genuinely rich in food, at 939 µg/100 g in natto, and that richness rests on exactly one food that most of the target population never eats; every other measured MK-7 source is trace, with cheddar at 2.7 and butter at 4.2 µg/100 g. MK-4 is trace in food across the board, at roughly 1 to 22 µg/100 g in chicken, egg yolk, full-fat dairy and meat, with goose liver paste as the one outlier at about 369 µg/100 g, while the 45 mg clinical dose is synthetic-only, since MK-4 supplements are manufactured from menadione because no food is or could be concentrated to 45 mg per dose.两种甲基萘醌需要分开作答，合成一个标签会把要点全部埋掉。MK-7 在食物中确实丰富，纳豆达 939 µg/100 g，但这份丰富只落在唯一一种食物上，而目标人群多数人从不吃它；其他所有实测的 MK-7 来源都只是痕量，切达奶酪 2.7 µg/100 g，黄油 4.2 µg/100 g。MK-4 在各类食物中普遍只是痕量，鸡肉、蛋黄、全脂乳制品和肉类大致为 1 至 22 µg/100 g，唯一的异常值是鹅肝酱约 369 µg/100 g；而 45 mg 的临床剂量只能来自合成，MK-4 补充剂由甲萘醌制造，因为没有任何食物浓缩到、也不可能浓缩到每剂 45 mg。

To match the dose要达到该剂量MK-7 and MK-4 give opposite answers. MK-7 at supplement and trial doses of 90 to 180 µg/day is fully covered by food: one 50 g pack of natto carries 470 µg, so a pack every second or third day matches a 180 µg capsule. Nothing else comes close, since 180 µg/day from cheddar at 2.7 µg MK-7 per 100 g would take 6.7 kg of cheese daily and from butter about 4.3 kg. MK-4 is the reverse. The Japanese clinical dose, menatetrenone for osteoporosis, is 45 mg/day (45,000 µg), usually 15 mg three times daily. At the richest food value in the composition literature, goose liver paste at about 369 µg/100 g, that is 12.2 kg per day, and at barbecue chicken's 22.1 µg/100 g it is about 204 kg. Even a modest 1.5 mg consumer MK-4 pill needs 407 g of goose liver paste, 6.8 kg of chicken, or 150 kg of whole milk. Measured whole-diet MK-4 intake sits around 17 µg/day (7.3% of a mean total vitamin K intake of about 230 µg/day in Japanese women, Kamao 2007), roughly one 2,600th of the pharmacological dose. MK-4 at supplement strength is unreachable by eating.MK-7 和 MK-4 给出相反的答案。MK-7 在 90 至 180 µg/天 的补充剂和试验剂量上完全能由食物覆盖：一盒 50 g 纳豆含 470 µg，每两三天吃一盒就相当于一粒 180 µg 胶囊。别的食物都远远不及，按切达奶酪 2.7 µg MK-7/100 g 计算，每天 180 µg 需要 6.7 kg 奶酪，用黄油则约 4.3 kg。MK-4 的情况相反。日本用于骨质疏松的临床剂量，四烯甲萘醌，为 45 mg/天（45,000 µg），通常一日三次、每次 15 mg。按成分文献中最高的食物数值，鹅肝酱约 369 µg/100 g，这相当于每天 12.2 kg；按烧烤鸡肉 22.1 µg/100 g 计算约为 204 kg。哪怕是一粒普通消费级 1.5 mg 的 MK-4 药片，也需要 407 g 鹅肝酱、6.8 kg 鸡肉，或 150 kg 全脂牛奶。实测整膳食 MK-4 摄入量约为 17 µg/天（日本女性维生素 K 总摄入量约 230 µg/天，MK-4 占 7.3%，Kamao 2007），大约是药理剂量的 1/2,600。补充剂强度的 MK-4 靠吃达不到。

Food vs supplement食物与补充剂MK-7 supplements are made by Bacillus subtilis natto fermentation, the same organism that makes natto, or synthesised; the active species is all-trans MK-7, and cis-isomer contamination is a documented quality problem in commercial products that the fermented food does not have. MK-4 supplements are wholly synthetic, derived from menadione, because no food is or could be concentrated to 45 mg per dose. That said, one framing in the original entry was wrong and has to go: goose liver paste at about 369 µg/100 g puts 100 g of food within roughly 2.1 orders of magnitude of the 45 mg dose (1/122 of it), so the claim that no food comes within three orders of magnitude fails, even though the dose stays unreachable at 12.2 kg/day. Natto also brings the fermentation matrix, fibre and nattokinase, and circulating K2 after eating natto is around ten times circulating K1 after eating spinach, a comparison made with 200 g of natto against 400 g of spinach rather than gram for gram (Schurgers LJ, Vermeer C, Haemostasis 2000;30:298-307, PMID 11356998). The 'cheese is a K2 food' claim needs unpicking: cheese total vitamin K is genuinely high, at 282 ± 5.0 µg/100 g for hard cheese, 289 ± 38 for semi-soft, 440 ± 41 for blue and 506 ± 63 for soft, but roughly 90% of it is MK-9, MK-10 and MK-11 from starter bacteria (Fu et al. 2017, PMID 29955705), forms no clinical trial has tested, while the MK-7 fraction is a few µg/100 g. Cheddar is the weak exemplar for that argument, and the long-ripened Dutch and Norwegian cheeses (Gouda, Edam, Jarlsberg) are the canonical MK-9-rich ones that would test it properly; curd cheese and quark appear as K2 sources in the Schurgers and Vermeer paper itself, and tempeh, fermented soy pastes, Korean cheonggukjang, sauerkraut and fermented salami would show whether natto is uniquely high or simply the best measured. None of those could be tabulated for want of a figure. Animal MK-4 also tracks the animal's feed, since menadione is a routine poultry feed additive and Elder et al. attribute poultry MK-4 to alkylation of it, so brand, country and production system shift the numbers, and the chicken hot dog and chicken broth samples in the same study contained no detectable MK-4 at all.MK-7 补充剂由纳豆枯草杆菌（Bacillus subtilis natto）发酵制得，与做纳豆的是同一种菌，也有化学合成的；活性种类是全反式 MK-7，顺式异构体污染是商业产品中有记录的质量问题，发酵食物没有这个问题。MK-4 补充剂完全是合成的，来自甲萘醌，因为没有任何食物浓缩到、也不可能浓缩到每剂 45 mg。不过原条目里有一个说法是错的，必须去掉：鹅肝酱约 369 µg/100 g，使 100 g 食物与 45 mg 剂量之间只差约 2.1 个数量级（为其 1/122），所以“没有食物能进入三个数量级之内”这一断言不成立，尽管 12.2 kg/天 这个剂量依然达不到。纳豆还带来发酵基质、纤维和纳豆激酶，吃纳豆后循环中的 K2 约为吃菠菜后循环中 K1 的十倍，这一比较用的是 200 g 纳豆对 400 g 菠菜，并非等重比较（Schurgers LJ，Vermeer C，Haemostasis 2000;30:298-307，PMID 11356998）。“奶酪是 K2 食物”这个说法需要拆开看：奶酪的维生素 K 总量确实高，硬质奶酪 282 ± 5.0 µg/100 g，半软质 289 ± 38，蓝纹 440 ± 41，软质 506 ± 63，但其中约 90% 是发酵剂细菌产生的 MK-9、MK-10 和 MK-11（Fu 等 2017，PMID 29955705），这些形式没有任何临床试验测试过，而 MK-7 部分只有每 100 g 几 µg。切达奶酪是支撑该论点的弱例子，长期成熟的荷兰和挪威奶酪（高达 Gouda、埃丹 Edam、亚尔斯堡 Jarlsberg）才是典型的富含 MK-9 品种，用它们才能真正检验；凝乳奶酪和夸克（quark）本身就出现在 Schurgers 与 Vermeer 的论文里，被列为 K2 来源；天贝、发酵豆酱、韩国清麴酱（cheonggukjang）、德式酸菜和发酵萨拉米则可以显示纳豆究竟是独一无二地高，还是仅仅测得最充分的一个。这些都因缺少数据而无法列表。动物性 MK-4 还随动物饲料变化，甲萘醌是家禽饲料的常规添加剂，Elder 等把家禽 MK-4 归因于它的烷基化，所以品牌、国家和生产体系都会改变数字；同一研究中的鸡肉热狗和鸡汤样品完全检不出 MK-4。

Absorption吸收MK-4 and MK-7 behave so differently that microgram-for-microgram comparison is meaningless. A single 420 µg dose of MK-7 was well absorbed, peaked at 6 hours and remained detectable in serum for 48 hours, while the identical 420 µg dose of MK-4 was undetectable in the serum of all subjects at every time point, and seven consecutive days at 60 µg/day raised only MK-7 (Sato T et al., Nutr J 2012;11:93, PMID 23140417, DOI 10.1186/1475-2891-11-93, every element confirmed). MK-7's long half-life comes from its extended isoprenoid side chain and tight lipoprotein binding. That is the mechanistic reason MK-4 is dosed in milligrams while MK-7 works in micrograms, and it means the 1 to 22 µg/100 g of MK-4 in butter, egg yolk, cheese and chicken contributes almost nothing to circulating vitamin K2 even though it is real and measurable. All menaquinones need dietary fat for absorption, which is why they sit in and are absorbed from the fat phase of dairy and eggs, and the reduced-fat versions lose most of it, with reduced-fat cheddar at 1.8 µg MK-4 per 100 g against 9.5 µg for full fat (PMID 29955705, whose fat-dependence finding was confirmed).MK-4 和 MK-7 的表现差别之大，按微克对微克比较毫无意义。单次 420 µg 的 MK-7 吸收良好，6 小时达峰，血清中 48 小时仍可检出；同样 420 µg 的 MK-4 在所有受试者的各个时间点血清中都检不出，连续七天每天 60 µg 也只升高 MK-7（Sato T 等，Nutr J 2012;11:93，PMID 23140417，DOI 10.1186/1475-2891-11-93，各项要素均已确认）。MK-7 半衰期长，来自它较长的类异戊二烯侧链和与脂蛋白的紧密结合。这正是 MK-4 以毫克计量而 MK-7 以微克起效的机理原因，也意味着黄油、蛋黄、奶酪和鸡肉中那 1 至 22 µg/100 g 的 MK-4 虽然真实可测，对循环维生素 K2 的贡献几乎为零。所有甲基萘醌的吸收都需要膳食脂肪，因此它们存在于乳制品和鸡蛋的脂肪相中并从那里被吸收，减脂版本会失去其中大部分：减脂切达奶酪每 100 g 含 1.8 µg MK-4，全脂为 9.5 µg（PMID 29955705，其脂肪依赖性发现已确认）。

Food data note食物数据说明The literature layer is strong and fully verified: Kamao 2007 (natto 939 µg/100 g, 230 µg/day total K, MK-4 at 7.3%), Fu 2017 (cheese totals and fat dependence), Sato 2012 (420 µg MK-4 undetectable) and Schurgers 2000 all confirmed exactly against PubMed, so the MK-7 side of the item rests on a confirmed number. The food-composition layer does not. Six MK-4 food values come from Elder et al. Table 1 and 2, which is a confirmed citation with paywalled tables that could not be opened, the butter and cheddar MK-7 values come from a paper whose DOI does not resolve and whose calibration the submission itself questions at about 27x the US values, and the goose liver paste figure that now anchors the MK-4 dose gap is a widely cited table value that could not be confirmed from its source低。文献层面很扎实且全部经过核验：Kamao 2007（纳豆 939 µg/100 g，维生素 K 总摄入 230 µg/天，MK-4 占 7.3%）、Fu 2017（奶酪总量和脂肪依赖性）、Sato 2012（420 µg MK-4 检不出）和 Schurgers 2000 都与 PubMed 逐项精确核对无误，所以本条目 MK-7 一侧建立在一个已确认的数字上。食物成分层面则不然。六个 MK-4 食物数值出自 Elder 等的表 1 和表 2，引文本身已确认，但表格在付费墙后无法打开；黄油和切达奶酪的 MK-7 数值来自一篇 DOI 无法解析的论文，提交材料自己也质疑其校准，约为美国数值的 27 倍；而现在支撑 MK-4 剂量缺口的鹅肝酱数字，是一个被广泛引用的表格值，无法从其源头确认。

Does the body make it身体是否自产Humans cannot make the naphthoquinone ring, so vitamin K itself is strictly dietary, while UBIAD1 prenylates menadione derived from dietary phylloquinone (K1) to MK-4 in most tissues, which means the MK-4 in artery wall, bone and brain is already partly endogenous. MK-7 and the longer chains MK-7 to MK-13 are bacterial products that humans do not synthesise, and the colonic contribution is modest and hard to quantify because much of it stays unabsorbed. PARTIAL is the roll-up for the pair: supplementing MK-4 duplicates a conversion the body already runs on ordinary K1 intake, and the honest case for an MK-7 product is pharmacokinetic (a much longer half-life than K1) and dietary, for people eating little natto, cheese or leafy greens.人体无法合成萘醌环, 所以维生素 K 本身严格依赖膳食; 而 UBIAD1 在多数组织中把源自膳食 phylloquinone (K1) 的 menadione 异戊烯化为 MK-4, 因此动脉壁, 骨与脑中的 MK-4 已经部分是内源的。MK-7 以及 MK-7 至 MK-13 的长链形式是细菌产物, 人体不合成, 结肠的贡献不大且难以量化, 因为其中很大一部分留在结肠未被吸收。两者合起来的标签是 PARTIAL: 补充 MK-4 重复了身体在普通 K1 摄入下本就在做的转化, 而支持 MK-7 产品的合理理由在于药代动力学 (半衰期远长于 K1) 和膳食 (纳豆, 干酪或深色叶菜吃得很少的人)。

Pathway合成通路NOT APPLICABLE for the ring, since humans have no de novo vitamin K pathway. Conversion only: dietary phylloquinone K1 or menadione plus geranylgeranyl-PP to MK-4 by UBIAD1 in most tissues, after side-chain removal from phylloquinone. Function runs through the vitamin K cycle, where GGCX gamma-carboxylates glutamate residues in prothrombin and factors VII, IX, X, in osteocalcin and in matrix Gla protein, and VKORC1, the warfarin target, regenerates the hydroquinone form. Long-chain menaquinones MK-7 to MK-13 are made by colonic bacteria.对萘醌环 NOT APPLICABLE, 人体没有维生素 K 的从头合成通路。只有转化: 在多数组织中, 膳食 phylloquinone K1 或 menadione 加 geranylgeranyl-PP 经 UBIAD1 生成 MK-4, phylloquinone 需先脱去侧链。功能通过维生素 K 循环实现: GGCX 对 prothrombin 与因子 VII, IX, X, 对 osteocalcin 以及 matrix Gla protein 中的 glutamate 残基进行 gamma 羧化, warfarin 的靶点 VKORC1 再生氢醌形式。MK-7 至 MK-13 的长链 menaquinones 由结肠细菌合成。

Amount made自产量MK-4 formed endogenously in mg/d: NOT ESTABLISHED, and no established figure exists for the microbial contribution either. Vitamin K AI 120 micrograms/day for men and 90 micrograms/day for women as phylloquinone, with no UL set (IOM 2001). Typical supplement doses MK-4 1.5-45 mg/d and MK-7 90-360 µg/d, with common MK-7 products providing 90 to 180 micrograms/day.内源生成的 MK-4 (mg/d): NOT ESTABLISHED, 微生物贡献同样没有既定数值。以 phylloquinone 计的维生素 K AI 为男性 120 micrograms/day, 女性 90 micrograms/day, 未设 UL (IOM 2001)。常见补充剂量为 MK-4 1.5-45 mg/d, MK-7 90-360 µg/d, 常见 MK-7 产品提供 90 至 180 micrograms/day。

Still matters when仍有意义的情形Newborns, who receive prophylactic vitamin K (K1 by injection) to prevent haemorrhagic disease of the newborn, and documented deficiency from fat malabsorption, cholestasis, cystic fibrosis, coeliac disease or bariatric surgery. Also prolonged broad-spectrum antibiotics with poor intake, and VKORC1 or GGCX defects. Bone and vascular calcification protocols exist but the trial evidence is mixed, and anyone on warfarin must not change vitamin K intake without clinician input, because the vitamin directly opposes the drug. Redundant as a way of obtaining MK-4 in anyone with adequate K1 intake and functioning UBIAD1.新生儿需接受预防性维生素 K (注射 K1) 以防新生儿出血症; 以及胆汁淤积, 囊性纤维化, 乳糜泻或减重手术导致的脂肪吸收不良所致的确诊缺乏。还包括长期广谱抗生素合并摄入不足, 以及 VKORC1 或 GGCX 缺陷。骨骼和血管钙化方面有相关方案, 但试验证据不一; 使用 warfarin 者不得在没有临床医生意见的情况下改变维生素 K 摄入, 因为该维生素与药物直接拮抗。对 K1 摄入充足且 UBIAD1 功能正常的人, 靠补充获得 MK-4 是多余的。

SSBBFFDDBBXXGeneric multi-strain probiotic blends泛泛的复合菌株益生菌
Verdict结论Skip it不必买
Evidence证据Grade BB 级
Dose tested已验证剂量Marketed as 50 billion CFU and similar. The dose threshold that matters is at least 5 billion CFU/d, but only for the two specific indications.常以“500 亿 CFU”之类标示。真正有意义的剂量门槛是至少 50 亿 CFU/天，但只对那两个特定适应证有效。
Who适用人群See the strain-specific entry in the Consider tier. A blend with no strain designators has nothing behind it.见“可以考虑”一档中的菌株特异性条目。不标菌株编号的复方产品背后没有任何依据。
Pros优点
  • If a blend happens to contain a strain with evidence at an adequate dose, it will work for that indication. The problem is you cannot tell from the label.如果某款复方恰好含有一种有证据的菌株且剂量足够，它对那个适应证会有效。问题是你从标签上看不出来。
Cons缺点
  • The category claim is unfalsifiable marketing. Probiotic describes a delivery concept, not an active ingredient. NCCIH states the point plainly: if one Lactobacillus helps prevent an illness, that does not necessarily mean another kind of Lactobacillus will.品类式声称是无法证伪的营销话术。“益生菌”描述的是一种投递概念，不是一种活性成分。NCCIH 说得很直白：如果某种乳杆菌有助于预防某种疾病，这并不必然意味着另一种乳杆菌也能。
  • Disaggregate 82 randomised trials and 10,332 irritable bowel syndrome patients by strain, and GRADE certainty collapses to low or very low almost everywhere. Only 24 of the 82 trials were at low risk of bias.把 82 项随机试验、10332 名肠易激患者按菌株拆开，GRADE 确定性几乎处处塌到低或极低。82 项试验中只有 24 项属低偏倚风险。
  • Raw CFU counts are close to meaningless divorced from strain. The infant colic strain works at 100 million CFU/d, which is 100 to 1,000 times LOWER than the counts marketed on adult tubs.脱离菌株，单看 CFU 数字几近毫无意义。婴儿肠绞痛那个菌株在 1 亿 CFU/天下有效，比成人罐装上标的数字低 100 至 1000 倍。
  • The same contraindications apply as for any live organism: central venous catheter, neutropenia, severe immunocompromise, critical illness, preterm infants.与任何活菌一样的禁忌同样适用：中心静脉置管、中性粒细胞减少、重度免疫抑制、危重症、早产儿。
What it does, and what happens without it它有什么作用，缺了会怎样

Mixed bacteria sold without strain identification, so no trial evidence attaches to the contents.未标明菌株的混合菌种产品,因此没有任何试验证据能对应到其内容物。

No deficiency state exists不存在缺乏状态

In detail详细These products name only genus and species (Lactobacillus acidophilus, Bifidobacterium bifidum and similar) and omit the alphanumeric strain designation on which the entire clinical evidence base is built, so no published result can legitimately be attributed to what is in the capsule. Independent testing repeatedly finds discrepancies between labelled and actual colony-forming units, species misidentification, and organisms no longer viable at the end of shelf life. Adding more strains does not sum their individual effects; strains can antagonise one another through bacteriocins and niche competition, and mixtures are rarely tested as mixtures. Because this is a commercial product category rather than a nutrient, no requirement and no deficiency state exists.这类产品只标注属名和种名(如嗜酸乳杆菌Lactobacillus acidophilus、两歧双歧杆菌Bifidobacterium bifidum等),省略了整个临床证据基础所依赖的字母数字菌株编号,因此已发表的任何结果都不能合理归因于胶囊中的实际内容物。独立检测反复发现标签菌落形成单位(CFU)与实际含量不符、菌种鉴定错误,以及在保质期结束时已不再存活的菌体。增加菌株种类并不等于各菌株效果的叠加,菌株之间可通过细菌素和生态位竞争相互拮抗,而混合制剂很少作为整体进行测试。由于这是一个商业产品类别而非营养素,因此不存在需求,也不存在缺乏状态。

There is no deficiency state for this. It is not an essential nutrient, so being short of it is not a thing that can happen.它不存在缺乏状态。它不是必需营养素，所以“缺了它”这件事本身并不成立。

Source来源DOI 10.1038/nrgastro.2014.66 (Hill et al., Nat Rev Gastroenterol Hepatol 2014;11:506-514, strain specificity requirement); DOI 10.1080/03007995.2017.1322571 (Curr Med Res Opin 2017, strain specificity, symptoms and mechanisms in IBS probiotics)

Food and the body食物与身体
In food: Rich食物中：丰富 Dose from food: Reachable靠吃达到剂量：可达到 Body makes it: n/a身体自产：不适用 Food data: Medium食物数据：中

RICH applies to one endpoint only, and it is a redefined one: live lactic acid bacteria of common genera. On that endpoint several ordinary fermented foods match or exceed supplement label doses, with yoghurt surveyed at up to 10^9 CFU/g, kefir at 2.5x10^8 CFU/mL, unpasteurised sauerkraut at about 2x10^8 CFU/g, kimchi at 10^7.14 to 10^9.23 CFU/g and natto reported at roughly 10^8-10^9 CFU/g. On the endpoint that matters for a product claim, a defined blend of characterised strains at a stated dose, no food supplies it and the honest grade would be a flat no. A reader scanning this field should not read RICH as 'food replaces this product'. The named-strain entry in this same group states that a CFU comparison is meaningless for a strain-specific claim, and that remains true here.RICH 只针对一个终点，而且是被重新定义过的终点：常见属的活乳酸菌。在这个终点上，若干普通发酵食品达到或超过补充剂的标签剂量，调查中酸奶最高达 10^9 CFU/g，开菲尔 2.5x10^8 CFU/mL，未经巴氏杀菌的德式酸菜约 2x10^8 CFU/g，韩式泡菜 10^7.14 至 10^9.23 CFU/g，纳豆据报约 10^8-10^9 CFU/g。而对产品主张真正重要的终点，即以确定剂量提供一组已表征菌株的确定配方，没有任何食物能提供，诚实的评级应当是明确的否。浏览本字段的读者不应把 RICH 读成食物可以替代这个产品。同一组中的指名菌株条目已指出，CFU 比较对菌株特异性主张毫无意义，这一点在此同样成立。
