Rows tagged unconfirmed carry a figure the checking pass could not trace back to its cited source. Hover the tag for the reason.标记未核实的行，其数值在核查中无法追溯到所引来源。把鼠标移到标记上可看原因。

To match the dose要达到该剂量For total live cells there is no gap. The source review calculates that about 10^10 cells is the intake likely needed to affect the microbiota and that this is met by 100 g of a food carrying 10^8 cells/g (PMID 30197628). One cup of kefir, one cup of yoghurt, about 120 g of raw sauerkraut, a cup of kimchi or a cup of natto each clear that bar, and kimchi at the top of its measured range delivers more live organisms in one serving than most 50-billion-CFU capsules. The gap is qualitative: identity, characterisation and consistency. Fermented food counts vary across four to six orders of magnitude between products and batches (yoghurt below 10^4 to 10^9 CFU/g), the organisms are usually not identified to strain, and none of them are the strains on the label of the blend.就活菌总数而言不存在差距。原综述估算，可能影响菌群所需的摄入量约为 10^10 个菌体，而 100 g 含 10^8 菌体/g 的食物即可达到（PMID 30197628）。一杯开菲尔、一杯酸奶、约 120 g 生德式酸菜、一杯韩式泡菜或一杯纳豆都能越过这条线，处于实测区间上端的韩式泡菜一份提供的活菌数超过大多数标称 50 billion CFU 的胶囊。差距是定性的：身份、表征和一致性。发酵食品的菌数在不同产品和批次之间跨越四到六个数量级（酸奶从低于 10^4 到 10^9 CFU/g），其中的微生物通常没有鉴定到菌株层面，而且没有一个是复配产品标签上的菌株。

Food vs supplement食物与补充剂Fermented food is a reasonable dietary habit and a different proposition from a named strain at a defined dose. Even a generic blend tells you which species you are getting and roughly how many; a jar of sauerkraut tells you neither, and a pasteurised jar contains no live cells. The practical points that decide whether a food delivers anything: it must be labelled raw, unpasteurised or 'live cultures' and kept refrigerated; heat destroys the organisms, so miso added to boiling soup, cooked kimchi and baked tempeh contribute essentially nothing; and long-aged cheeses can be several orders of magnitude lower than young ones. Water kefir, kombucha, brine-fermented unpasteurised pickles, kvass, skyr, traditional buttermilk and young raw-milk cheeses belong on the same list, though no confirmed counts for them were available here. Conversely, a supplement claim of 50 billion CFU means little if the strains are unnamed, because probiotic effects are demonstrated strain by strain, and CFU counts on labels refer to manufacture rather than end of shelf life.吃发酵食品是合理的饮食习惯，与按确定剂量服用指名菌株是两个不同的命题。即便是通用复配产品，也会告诉你拿到的是哪些菌种、大致多少数量；一罐德式酸菜两者都不告诉你，而经巴氏杀菌的罐装品根本没有活菌。决定一种食物是否真能提供活菌的实用要点：标签必须写生、未经巴氏杀菌或含活性菌种，并且全程冷藏；加热会破坏这些微生物，因此加进沸汤的味噌、炒熟的韩式泡菜和烤过的天贝基本没有贡献；长期陈化的奶酪可能比年轻奶酪低几个数量级。水开菲尔、康普茶、盐水发酵未杀菌腌菜、kvass 酸面包饮、skyr 酸奶、传统白脱牛奶和年轻生乳奶酪属于同一清单，但此处没有它们的可确认菌数。反过来说，如果菌株没有具名，补充剂标称 50 billion CFU 也说明不了什么，因为益生菌效应是逐一菌株验证的，而标签上的 CFU 数指的是出厂时而非保质期末。

Absorption吸收Gastric and bile survival is strain-dependent and matrix-dependent. Fermented dairy foods buffer stomach acid and their fat content improves transit survival, a genuine advantage of the food route over an uncoated capsule; supplements compensate with enteric coating or microencapsulation. Almost none of these organisms colonise permanently, so the effect is dose-dependent and ceases when intake stops, which applies equally to food and to capsules. The source review notes that many fermentation microbes are closely related to probiotic organisms and can share mechanisms, which is the honest basis for recommending fermented food, but relatedness is not equivalence and it does not license transferring a strain-specific trial result onto a jar of kimchi.在胃酸和胆汁中的存活既取决于菌株，也取决于基质。发酵乳制品能缓冲胃酸，其脂肪含量提高通过消化道的存活率，这是食物途径相对无包衣胶囊的真实优势；补充剂则用肠溶包衣或微囊化来弥补。这些微生物几乎都不会长期定植，所以效应是剂量依赖的，停止摄入即终止，这一点对食物和胶囊同样适用。原综述指出，许多发酵微生物与益生菌生物在亲缘上很近，可能共享作用机制，这是推荐发酵食品的诚实依据，但亲缘接近并不等于等效，也不允许把菌株特异的试验结果搬到一罐韩式泡菜上。

Food data note食物数据说明The Rezac counts for kimchi, sauerkraut, yoghurt, miso and tempeh were verified against Tables 5 and 6, as were the kefir counts and the 10^10-cells threshold. Two soft spots remain: the tempeh 9 log ceiling could not be sourced and has been removed, and the natto count is a literature range supplied by the verification report without a retrievable citation中。Rezac 关于韩式泡菜、德式酸菜、酸奶、味噌和天贝的菌数已对照表 5 和表 6 核实，开菲尔菌数和 10^10 菌体阈值同样已核实。仍有两处软点：天贝 9 log 的上限找不到来源，已删除；纳豆菌数是核查报告给出的文献范围，没有可调取的引文。

Does the body make it身体是否自产Same axis mismatch as any probiotic, since these are living organisms, with an additional problem specific to blends: labels that name only genus and species carry no evidence, because probiotic effects are strain-specific. Laboratory checking of commercial products supports that concern, though the cited evidence is one survey: Kesavelu 2020 tested 20 products sold in India (8 single-strain, 12 multi-strain) and reported poor correlation between label and laboratory values for viable count, genus and species identification and contaminants, without giving a numeric mismatch rate. A blend cannot inherit the trial record of a product it does not actually contain, so more strains on the label does not mean more evidence.与任何益生菌一样存在轴不匹配的问题, 因为对象是活体生物; 复方还多一层麻烦: 只写属和种的标签不带任何证据, 因为益生菌效应是菌株特异的。对市售产品的实验室检测支持这一担忧, 但所引证据只有一项调查: Kesavelu 2020 检测了在印度销售的 20 个产品 (8 个单菌株, 12 个复方), 报告标签值与实验室值在活菌数, 属种鉴定和污染物方面相关性差, 未给出量化的不符率。复方不能继承一个它实际并不含有的产品的试验记录, 标签上菌株更多也不等于证据更多。

Pathway合成通路NOT APPLICABLE. Microorganisms are acquired, not synthesised.NOT APPLICABLE。微生物靠获得, 不靠合成。

Amount made自产量0 (human cells cannot synthesise a microorganism)0 (人细胞无法合成微生物)

Still matters when仍有意义的情形Nothing on this axis. Screen on strain-level identification with deposited strain designations, independent verification of viable counts at end of shelf life, and whether any trial used the exact formulation being sold.这条轴上没有理由。改用是否有保藏编号的菌株级鉴定, 保质期末活菌数的独立验证, 以及是否有试验用的正是在售的这个配方来筛查。

Synthesis source合成来源PMID 33173652 (Kesavelu D, Cureus 2020;12:e11334, Composition and Laboratory Correlation of Commercial Probiotics in India; single-country 20-product survey)

Refs.文献 Goodoory & Ford PMID 37541528; NCCIH; Cochrane CD006095.pub5 PMID 40931979
SSDDFFDDBBXXB. infantis 35624 (single strain)B. infantis 35624（单一菌株）
Verdict结论Skip it不必买
Evidence证据Grade DD 级
Dose tested已验证剂量1 billion CFU/d, one capsule, assessed at 4 weeks. This is the trialled dose, not a dose shown to work.10 亿 CFU/天，每日一粒，4 周后评估。这是试验用的剂量，不是被证明有效的剂量。
Who适用人群On current evidence, no clearly identifiable group.按现有证据，没有可清楚界定的适用人群。
Pros优点
  • Composite probiotic products containing B. infantis showed small effects on abdominal pain (SMD 0.22) and bloating (SMD 0.30). Those effects belong to the composite, not to this strain.含 B. infantis 的复方益生菌产品对腹痛（SMD 0.22）和腹胀（SMD 0.30）有小幅效应。那些效应属于复方，不属于这个菌株。
Cons缺点
  • This is the clearest case of the strain-specificity argument cutting AGAINST the industry. It is the product that taught consumers to look for a strain number, and the dedicated meta-analysis of 5 studies found the SINGLE strain had no effect on abdominal pain, bloating or bowel habit satisfaction.这是“菌株特异性”这个论点反过来对行业不利的最清楚案例。正是这个产品教会消费者去看菌株编号，而一项针对 5 项研究的专门 meta 分析发现，单一菌株对腹痛、腹胀和排便满意度都没有效应。
  • The whole reputation rests on one 2006 trial plus an anti-inflammatory mechanism story about the IL-10 to IL-12 ratio.它的全部声誉建立在 2006 年的一项试验，加上一个关于 IL-10 与 IL-12 比值的抗炎机制叙事之上。
  • The AGA recommends against probiotics for irritable bowel syndrome outside clinical trials, which is this product primary market.美国胃肠病学会建议在临床试验之外不要用益生菌治疗肠易激，而那正是这个产品的主要市场。
  • Bifidobacterium species specifically have caused whole-genome-sequencing-confirmed bacteraemia in preterm infants.双歧杆菌属确实在早产儿中造成过经全基因组测序确认的菌血症。
What it does, and what happens without it它有什么作用，缺了会怎样

A single gut bacterium with its own trial evidence in irritable bowel syndrome.一种拥有自身肠易激综合征试验证据的单一肠道菌株。

No deficiency state exists不存在缺乏状态

In detail详细Bifidobacterium longum subsp. infantis 35624, still widely labelled Bifidobacterium infantis 35624, was isolated from healthy human gut mucosa and is one of the few probiotic strains tested at a defined dose in a trial large enough to matter. In 362 primary care women with irritable bowel syndrome of any bowel habit subtype, 1 x 10^8 cfu daily for 4 weeks was superior to placebo for abdominal pain and for a composite of bloating, bowel dysfunction, incomplete evacuation, straining and passage of gas, with global symptom improvement exceeding placebo by more than 20%; higher and lower doses did not work, which is itself informative about formulation. Proposed mechanisms include induction of regulatory T cells and reduction in circulating pro-inflammatory cytokines. It is a live organism administered as a therapy, so nobody is short of it and there is no deficiency state to describe.长双歧杆菌婴儿亚种35624(Bifidobacterium longum subsp. infantis 35624),目前仍广泛标注为Bifidobacterium infantis 35624,分离自健康人体肠道黏膜,是少数在足够规模的试验中以确定剂量测试过的益生菌菌株之一。在362名任意肠道习惯亚型的肠易激综合征初级保健女性患者中,每日1×10^8 cfu、持续4周,在腹痛以及由腹胀、排便功能障碍、排便不尽感、用力排便和排气组成的综合评分方面均优于安慰剂,总体症状改善超出安慰剂组20%以上;更高或更低剂量均无效,这一点本身也提示了配方的重要性。所提出的机制包括诱导调节性T细胞及降低循环促炎细胞因子水平。它是作为一种疗法给予的活微生物,因此没有人会短缺它,也不存在需要描述的缺乏状态。

There is no deficiency state for this. It is not an essential nutrient, so being short of it is not a thing that can happen.它不存在缺乏状态。它不是必需营养素，所以“缺了它”这件事本身并不成立。

Source来源PMID 16863564 (Whorwell et al., Am J Gastroenterol 2006;101:1581-1590, encapsulated Bifidobacterium infantis 35624 in women with IBS)

Food and the body食物与身体
In food: None食物中：无 Dose from food: Out of reach靠吃达到剂量：达不到 Body makes it: n/a身体自产：不适用 Food data: High食物数据：高

SYNTHETIC here means no dietary source, not an artificial molecule. The strain is a live organism isolated from the ileal mucosa of a healthy human donor and has since been reclassified from Bifidobacterium longum subsp. infantis to B. longum subsp. longum 35624 (PLOS One 2016;11:e0162983, PMC5033381). It is propagated industrially from a proprietary strain bank and freeze-dried. It is present in no food, no fermented food and no other supplement brand. Comparative genome analysis identified a 35624-specific gene cluster encoding biosynthesis of its exopolysaccharide EPS624, the kind of strain-level distinction that makes substitution unsound.此处 SYNTHETIC 的含义是没有膳食来源，它并非人工合成的分子。该菌株是活的生物体，分离自一名健康人类供体的回肠黏膜，此后已从 Bifidobacterium longum subsp. infantis 重新归类为 B. longum subsp. longum 35624（PLOS One 2016;11:e0162983, PMC5033381）。它从专有菌种库出发进行工业扩繁并冻干。任何食物、任何发酵食品、任何其他品牌的补充剂中都不存在它。比较基因组分析发现了一个 35624 特有的基因簇，编码其胞外多糖 EPS624 的生物合成，这类菌株层面的差异使替换缺乏依据。

No ordinary food supplies this in a meaningful amount.没有普通食物能提供有意义的量。

To match the dose要达到该剂量No quantity of any food supplies this strain. The trial dose is small in absolute terms, 1x10^8 CFU, which is roughly the number of live bacteria in half a gram of unpasteurised sauerkraut at 8.3 log CFU/g, so the dose is not the obstacle and the identity is. Fermented foods can supply a thousand times more live cells than the effective dose of 35624 while supplying none of it. Note that the source trial expressed its doses as CFU/mL rather than CFU/day.任何食物的任何摄入量都无法提供这个菌株。试验剂量在绝对值上很小，1x10^8 CFU，大致相当于 8.3 log CFU/g 的未杀菌德式酸菜半克中的活菌数，所以障碍与剂量无关，障碍在于身份。发酵食品能提供比 35624 有效剂量多一千倍的活菌，却一个 35624 都提供不了。请注意，原始试验把剂量表述为 CFU/mL 而非 CFU/day。

Food vs supplement食物与补充剂The dose-response data make the point better than any argument about food. In the 362-patient dose-ranging trial, 1x10^8 of B. infantis 35624 was significantly superior to placebo for abdominal pain, the composite score, bloating, bowel dysfunction and incomplete evacuation, while 1x10^6 and 1x10^10 were not, the paper attributing the highest dose's failure to significant formulation problems (Whorwell et al., Am J Gastroenterol 2006;101:1581-1590, PMID 16863564). The trial enrolled women only, which limits generalisation and which the submission did not state. If a tenfold change in dose of the same strain in the same capsule abolishes the effect, swapping the strain for a different Bifidobacterium in a yoghurt cannot be assumed to preserve it. Anyone advised to take 35624 should be told plainly that no diet reproduces it and that a generic bifidobacterium supplement is a different product.剂量反应数据比任何关于食物的论证都更能说明问题。在那项 362 例的剂量探索试验中，1x10^8 的 B. infantis 35624 在腹痛、复合评分、腹胀、排便功能障碍和排便不尽感上显著优于安慰剂，1x10^6 和 1x10^10 则没有，论文把最高剂量失效归因于明显的配方问题（Whorwell et al., Am J Gastroenterol 2006;101:1581-1590, PMID 16863564）。试验只纳入女性，这限制了外推，原稿没有说明。既然同一胶囊中同一菌株的剂量变动十倍就能让效应消失，那么把菌株换成酸奶里的另一种双歧杆菌，就不能假定效应还在。凡被建议服用 35624 的人都应被明确告知：没有任何饮食能复制它，通用双歧杆菌补充剂是另一种产品。

Absorption吸收The strain was selected partly for surviving gastrointestinal transit, and its documented actions are immunoregulatory and barrier-related rather than nutritional: enhanced gut barrier function, accelerated intestinal transit and reduced visceral hypersensitivity. It does not permanently colonise, so the effect depends on continued daily intake. Formulation dominates delivery: the failure of the 1x10^10 arm was a formulation problem rather than evidence against high cell numbers, and it illustrates that CFU on a label is not the active variable on its own. The specific gelling mechanism the submission gave for that failure is not in the source and has been removed.选择该菌株的部分理由是它能在胃肠道转运中存活，其有记录的作用属于免疫调节和屏障相关，与营养无关：增强肠道屏障功能、加快肠道转运、降低内脏高敏感性。它不会长期定植，所以效应依赖每天持续摄入。配方主导递送：1x10^10 组的失败是配方问题，并不构成反对高菌数的证据，它说明标签上的 CFU 单独并不是起作用的变量。原稿给出的那个具体成胶机制在来源文献中没有，已删除。

Food data note食物数据说明The strain's origin, reclassification, exopolysaccharide gene cluster and the dose-ranging trial results were all confirmed. The only failed detail was the gelling mechanism, now replaced with the paper's own wording, and the only additions are the women-only enrolment and the CFU/mL unit高。菌株来源、重新归类、胞外多糖基因簇和剂量探索试验结果均已确认。唯一未通过核实的细节是成胶机制，现已改用论文自身的表述；唯一的新增内容是只纳入女性这一点和 CFU/mL 单位。

Does the body make it身体是否自产This is a live organism, so the synthesis axis does not apply and the body never makes bacteria under any circumstances. Whole-genome sequencing and core-genome phylogenetic taxon assignment reclassified the strain from Bifidobacterium infantis to Bifidobacterium longum subsp. longum 35624, a common adult coloniser, so the infant-coloniser and adult colonisation-gap argument built on the old name does not apply and has been dropped. What distinguishes 35624 is the trial record: a fully identified single strain tested against placebo at a stated dose, which is the standard the rest of the category should be held to, and the reclassification does not affect those strain-specific results.这是活体生物, 合成这条轴不适用, 人体在任何情况下都不制造细菌。全基因组测序和核心基因组系统发生分类把该菌株从 Bifidobacterium infantis 重新归类为 Bifidobacterium longum subsp. longum 35624, 这是成人常见的定植菌, 所以建立在旧名称上的婴儿定植菌和成人定植缺口论证不成立, 已删除。35624 的特点在于试验记录: 一个完全鉴定的单一菌株在明确剂量下与安慰剂对照, 这正是这一类别其余产品应达到的标准; 重新分类不影响这些菌株特异的结果。

Pathway合成通路NOT APPLICABLE. Acquired by colonisation or ingested as a live product; not synthesised by host tissue. Taxonomy: Bifidobacterium longum subsp. longum by whole-genome core-genome phylogeny, revised from the earlier subsp. infantis assignment.NOT APPLICABLE。通过定植获得或作为活菌产品摄入; 宿主组织不合成。分类学: 按全基因组核心基因组系统发生分析为 Bifidobacterium longum subsp. longum, 由早先的 subsp. infantis 归类修订而来。

Amount made自产量0 (human cells cannot synthesise a microorganism)0 (人细胞无法合成微生物)

Still matters when仍有意义的情形IBS symptom relief on the strength of a randomised trial in 362 primary care IBS patients, all of them women, where 1 x 10^8 cfu/mL for 4 weeks was significantly superior to placebo for abdominal pain and the composite symptom score and exceeded placebo by more than 20 percent on global assessment (P<0.02), while 1 x 10^6 and 1 x 10^10 cfu/mL were not. The 10^10 arm's failure is generally attributed to formulation problems (capsule agglomeration and gelling), so part of that dose conclusion is a formulation conclusion. The effect depends on continued dosing.用于 IBS 症状缓解, 依据是一项纳入 362 名基层医疗 IBS 患者 (全部为女性) 的随机试验: 1 x 10^8 cfu/mL 服用 4 周在腹痛和综合症状评分上显著优于安慰剂, 总体评估上超过安慰剂 20% 以上 (P<0.02), 而 1 x 10^6 和 1 x 10^10 cfu/mL 没有。10^10 组失败通常被归因于配方问题 (胶囊团聚和胶凝), 所以这个剂量结论有一部分是配方结论。效果依赖持续服用。

Synthesis source合成来源PMID 16863564 (Whorwell PJ, Am J Gastroenterol 2006;101:1581-90, Efficacy of an encapsulated probiotic Bifidobacterium infantis 35624 in women with irritable bowel syndrome); PMID 27656878 and Altmann, PLOS One 2016, PMC5033381 (reclassification to B. longum subsp. longum)

Refs.文献 Yuan PMID 28166427; Goodoory & Ford PMID 37541528; AGA PMID 32531291
SSCCFFDDBBXXKrill oil磷虾油
Verdict结论Skip it不必买
Evidence证据Grade CC 级
Dose tested已验证剂量2 g/d for 24 weeks in the knee osteoarthritis trial. Bioavailability trials used about 1.1 g/d of actual omega-3.膝骨关节炎试验为 2 克/天、持续 24 周。生物利用度试验用的是实际 omega-3 约 1.1 克/天。
Who适用人群At most, people wanting a given rise in omega-3 index from a smaller dose. That is a biomarker advantage.最多适用于希望用更小剂量把 omega-3 指数提上去的人。那是生物标志物层面的优势。
Pros优点
  • The absorption argument has support. A 72-person trial at matched 1.1 g/d found krill oil produced about 1.5-fold higher increments in plasma EPA and DHA than fish oil.吸收方面的论点有支持。一项 72 人的试验在同为 1.1 克/天的条件下发现，磷虾油使血浆 EPA 和 DHA 的升幅比鱼油高约 1.5 倍。
  • Contains astaxanthin, which is why it does not oxidise as readily as bulk fish oil.含虾青素，这也是它不像散装鱼油那样容易氧化的原因。
Cons缺点
  • The joint claim collapsed under proper testing. The largest randomised trial (JAMA, n=262 with knee osteoarthritis and effusion-synovitis, 2 g/d for 24 weeks) found mean pain change -19.9 with krill oil versus -20.2 with placebo. A trial-sequential-analysis review across 5 trials and 700 patients found no significant improvement in knee pain, stiffness or lipid profile.关节方面的说法在正规检验下崩塌。规模最大的随机试验（JAMA，262 名膝骨关节炎伴积液滑膜炎患者，2 克/天服 24 周）显示磷虾油组疼痛平均变化 -19.9，安慰剂组 -20.2。一项含试验序贯分析、涵盖 5 项试验 700 名患者的综述发现，膝痛、僵硬和血脂均无显著改善。
  • It is priced as a premium product on the strength of a biomarker advantage, and delivers far less EPA and DHA per capsule than a concentrate.它凭一个生物标志物优势按高端产品定价，而每粒提供的 EPA 和 DHA 远少于浓缩型产品。
  • Crustacean and shellfish allergy is a genuine and under-warned contraindication.甲壳类和贝类过敏是真实存在却警示不足的禁忌。
  • Same anticoagulant, antiplatelet and atrial fibrillation cautions as any omega-3 source once dose rises.一旦剂量上升，与任何 omega-3 来源一样，需注意抗凝、抗血小板和房颤方面的问题。
What it does, and what happens without it它有什么作用，缺了会怎样

Oil from Antarctic krill delivering EPA and DHA largely bound to phospholipids, plus some astaxanthin.来自南极磷虾的油脂,其中EPA和DHA大多以磷脂形式结合,还含有少量虾青素。

No deficiency state exists不存在缺乏状态

In detail详细Krill oil is extracted from Euphausia superba. Its distinguishing feature is chemical form: a large share of the EPA and DHA is esterified to phospholipid, mainly phosphatidylcholine, with some present as free fatty acid, whereas fish oil carries them as triglycerides or ethyl esters. This alters absorption kinetics. It also contains small amounts of astaxanthin, a carotenoid acting as an antioxidant within the oil. EPA plus DHA content per capsule is typically lower than in fish oil, so dose comparisons need to be made per milligram of omega-3. Acute crossover studies find equal or modestly higher plasma phospholipid incorporation from krill per unit EPA plus DHA (PMID 21854650), but a reanalysis of these studies concluded the acute differences have not translated reliably into different long-term omega-3 status (PMID 25156381).磷虾油提取自南极磷虾(Euphausia superba)。其显著特点在于化学形式:相当一部分EPA和DHA以磷脂形式酯化,主要是磷脂酰胆碱,部分以游离脂肪酸形式存在,而鱼油中这些成分则以甘油三酯或乙酯形式存在。这会改变吸收动力学。磷虾油还含有少量虾青素,一种在油脂中起抗氧化作用的类胡萝卜素。每粒胶囊所含的EPA加DHA通常低于鱼油,因此剂量比较需按每毫克omega-3计算。急性交叉研究发现,按每单位EPA加DHA计算,磷虾来源的血浆磷脂掺入量相等或略高(PMID 21854650),但一项对这些研究的再分析认为,这种急性差异并未可靠地转化为长期omega-3水平的差异(PMID 25156381)。

There is no deficiency state for this. It is not an essential nutrient, so being short of it is not a thing that can happen.它不存在缺乏状态。它不是必需营养素，所以“缺了它”这件事本身并不成立。

Source来源PMID 21854650 (Schuchardt JP et al. Lipids Health Dis. 2011); PMID 25156381 (Salem N Jr, Kuratko CN. Lipids Health Dis. 2014)

Food and the body食物与身体
In food: Rich食物中：丰富 Dose from food: Reachable靠吃达到剂量：可达到 Body makes it: Partly身体自产：部分自产 Food data: Medium食物数据：中

The molecules krill oil delivers, EPA and DHA, are abundant in ordinary oily fish, and a 1-2 g/day krill oil dose is smaller than what a single tin of sardines provides. The phospholipid delivery form is also obtainable from food, which the earlier draft got wrong: fish roe and caviar are membrane-lipid tissues in which a large share of the EPA and DHA is phospholipid-bound, and in lean white fish such as cod most of the (small) EPA+DHA pool sits in phospholipid rather than triglyceride. The triglyceride generalisation holds for fatty fish flesh only. One tablespoon of caviar (16 g, 1,046 mg EPA+DHA) beats a 2 g krill oil dose on both quantity and form. Krill itself is close to a non-food: Antarctic krill (Euphausia superba) is eaten as okiami in Japan and to a small extent in Russia and the Philippines, but the global catch is largely rendered into meal and oil, and the shell carries a heavy fluoride load that has to be stripped before human consumption. Nobody reaches a krill oil dose by eating krill; they reach it by eating fish or roe, or by taking capsules.磷虾油提供的分子（EPA 和 DHA）在普通多脂鱼中很丰富，1-2 g/day 的磷虾油剂量还不及一罐沙丁鱼提供的量。磷虾油的磷脂递送形式同样可以从食物中获得，这一点早前的草稿弄错了：鱼卵和鱼子酱属于膜脂组织，其中很大一部分 EPA 和 DHA 以磷脂形式结合；在鳕鱼这类少脂白肉鱼中，本就不多的 EPA+DHA 大部分存在于磷脂中，甘油三酯里很少。甘油三酯的通则只适用于多脂鱼的肌肉。一汤匙鱼子酱（16 g，1,046 mg EPA+DHA）在数量和形式上都胜过 2 g 磷虾油剂量。磷虾本身几乎算不上食物：南极磷虾（Euphausia superba）在日本作为 okiami 食用，在俄罗斯和菲律宾也有少量食用，但全球渔获大多被加工成粉和油，虾壳带有很重的氟负荷，供人食用前必须去除。没有人靠吃磷虾达到磷虾油的剂量；达到该剂量靠的是吃鱼或鱼卵，或者服用胶囊。

To match the dose要达到该剂量There is effectively no gap, which is the useful finding. Measured EPA plus DHA in 20 commercial krill oils from the Korean market spanned 14.2-34.8% of total fatty acids (Lee 2024, PMID 39233519, DOI 10.4014/jmb.2406.06026, range confirmed; the sampling is one national market). Converting that percentage to capsule mass overstates the content, because total fatty acids are less than capsule mass once phospholipid head groups, free sterols, astaxanthin and excipients are counted, so every figure that follows is a ceiling rather than a point estimate. A 1 g capsule carries at most roughly 140-350 mg EPA+DHA. Two capsules (2 g) deliver at most about 280-700 mg, which is matched or beaten by one 92 g tin of sardines (903 mg), one 45 g tin of anchovies (924 mg), one mackerel fillet (1,059 mg) or one tablespoon of caviar (1,046 mg). At the top of the trial range, 4 g/day of krill oil supplies at most roughly 570-1,400 mg, equal to at most 0.6-1.5 tins of sardines. Because these are ceilings, the real gap runs further in favour of fish than the raw numbers suggest. Going the other way, matching a krill oil dose by eating krill is not a real option: the catch is not sold as food outside a small Japanese and Russian market, and the shell must be removed for fluoride reasons.实际上不存在差距，这本身就是有用的结论。对韩国市场 20 种商品磷虾油的实测显示，EPA 加 DHA 占总脂肪酸的 14.2-34.8%（Lee 2024, PMID 39233519, DOI 10.4014/jmb.2406.06026，区间已确认；取样限于一个国家的市场）。把这个百分比直接换算成胶囊质量会高估含量，因为计入磷脂头基、游离甾醇、虾青素和辅料后，总脂肪酸低于胶囊质量，所以下面每个数字都是上限，不能当作点估计。一粒 1 g 胶囊最多含约 140-350 mg EPA+DHA。两粒（2 g）最多提供约 280-700 mg，一罐 92 g 沙丁鱼（903 mg）、一罐 45 g 凤尾鱼（924 mg）、一片鲭鱼柳（1,059 mg）或一汤匙鱼子酱（1,046 mg）都能与之相当或超过。取试验剂量范围的上端，4 g/day 磷虾油最多提供约 570-1,400 mg，最多相当于 0.6-1.5 罐沙丁鱼。由于这些都是上限，真实差距比原始数字显示的更偏向鱼类。反过来看，靠吃磷虾来匹配磷虾油剂量并不现实：除了日本和俄罗斯的小规模市场，渔获并不作为食品销售，而且出于氟的原因必须去壳。

Food vs supplement食物与补充剂Two things were previously claimed to separate krill oil from food, and both claims are weaker than stated. The phospholipid form is the product claim, and fish roe and caviar supply phospholipid-bound EPA and DHA in ordinary food, so the honest version is that krill oil offers a high phospholipid share conveniently, not uniquely. Krill oil is reported at roughly 39-81% phospholipid (Xie 2019, DOI 10.1111/1541-4337.12427); the citation is real and topically correct, but the range could not be traced to a page or table in the review, so treat it as indicative and unconfirmed, and do not read the original two-decimal precision as measured. Astaxanthin is the second claim, and 'no oily fish portion supplies it in comparable concentration' should not stand: wild sockeye and other red-fleshed Pacific salmon carry astaxanthin in flesh at roughly 25-40 mg/kg, so a 130 g portion supplies about 3-5 mg against the 0.1-1.5 mg per gram of oil typical of krill capsules. That concentration could not be re-verified, so it is a challenge to the claim rather than a settled figure, but the flat denial is gone. Neither the phospholipid form nor the astaxanthin has been shown to produce a clinical outcome that fish or fish oil does not. Against that, krill oil is the most expensive way to buy EPA and DHA per milligram, capsule doses are small enough that many products deliver less omega-3 than one tin of fish, it is a crustacean allergen, and whole krill or poorly processed krill meal carries the fluoride load of the exoskeleton. The fluoride figures usually quoted are about 4,260 mg F/kg fat-free dry matter in the carapace against 570 mg/kg in raw muscle; neither full text was retrievable, so both values are unconfirmed and should be attributed to whichever paper actually reports them (Soevik & Braekkan, Journal of the Fisheries Research Board of Canada 1979;36(11):1414-1416, DOI 10.1139/f79-204, which was not yet called the Canadian Journal of Fisheries and Aquatic Sciences in 1979; and Tou 2007, PMID 17345959). Sustainability is a genuine consideration given that Antarctic krill is the base of the Southern Ocean food web.此前有两点被说成是磷虾油区别于食物之处，两种说法都比原本的表述要弱。磷脂形式是产品主张，而鱼卵和鱼子酱在普通食物中就能提供以磷脂结合的 EPA 和 DHA，因此诚实的说法是：磷虾油方便地提供了较高的磷脂比例，这种能力并非它独有。磷虾油的磷脂含量据报道约为 39-81%（Xie 2019, DOI 10.1111/1541-4337.12427）；该引文真实且主题相符，但这个区间无法追溯到该综述中的具体页面或表格，因此应视为参考性且未经确认，原文两位小数的精度也不能当成实测值来读。第二点是虾青素，“没有任何多脂鱼份量能提供可比浓度”这一说法站不住：野生红鲑及其他红肉太平洋鲑的鱼肉中虾青素约为 25-40 mg/kg，一份 130 g 大约提供 3-5 mg，而磷虾胶囊的典型水平是每克油 0.1-1.5 mg。该浓度未能重新核实，所以它目前只是对原说法的质疑，尚未成为定论，但那种一概否认已经不成立。无论磷脂形式还是虾青素，都没有被证明能带来鱼类或鱼油所不能带来的临床结果。与此相对，按每毫克 EPA 和 DHA 计，磷虾油是最贵的购买方式；胶囊剂量之小，使许多产品提供的欧米伽-3 少于一罐鱼；它属于甲壳类过敏原；整只磷虾或加工不当的磷虾粉还带有外壳的氟负荷。常被引用的氟数值是甲壳中约 4,260 mg F/kg 脱脂干物质，对应生肌肉 570 mg/kg；两篇全文都无法获取，因此两个数值均未确认，应归属于真正报告它们的论文（Soevik & Braekkan, Journal of the Fisheries Research Board of Canada 1979;36(11):1414-1416, DOI 10.1139/f79-204，该刊在 1979 年还不叫 Canadian Journal of Fisheries and Aquatic Sciences；以及 Tou 2007, PMID 17345959）。考虑到南极磷虾是南大洋食物网的基础，可持续性是一个实实在在的考量。

Absorption吸收The phospholipid form does appear to be absorbed at least as well as triglyceride and better than ethyl ester. In a crossover trial in 12 healthy men at a matched 1,680 mg EPA+DHA dose, incorporation into plasma phospholipids by area under the curve over 0-72 h was 80.03 +/- 34.71 %*h for krill oil, 59.78 +/- 36.75 %*h for re-esterified triglyceride fish oil and 47.53 +/- 38.42 %*h for ethyl ester fish oil, with no statistically significant difference (EPA p = 0.057, DHA p = 0.246, EPA+DHA p = 0.119) (Schuchardt 2011, Lipids Health Dis, PMC3168413, all figures confirmed). Attributing that result to the phospholipid form is not the only reading: the same paper notes that 22% of the krill oil's EPA and 21% of its DHA were present as free fatty acids, which absorb readily and offer a plausible alternative explanation. The practical implication is modest either way, since a krill capsule contains so much less EPA and DHA than a portion of fish that absorption efficiency does not close the gap.磷脂形式的吸收看来至少与甘油三酯相当，并优于乙酯。在 12 名健康男性的交叉试验中，以匹配的 1,680 mg EPA+DHA 剂量给药，按 0-72 h 曲线下面积计的血浆磷脂掺入量为：磷虾油 80.03 +/- 34.71 %*h，重新酯化甘油三酯型鱼油 59.78 +/- 36.75 %*h，乙酯型鱼油 47.53 +/- 38.42 %*h，差异无统计学意义（EPA p = 0.057，DHA p = 0.246，EPA+DHA p = 0.119）（Schuchardt 2011, Lipids Health Dis, PMC3168413，所有数字均已确认）。把这一结果归因于磷脂形式并非唯一解读：同一篇论文指出磷虾油中 22% 的 EPA 和 21% 的 DHA 以游离脂肪酸形式存在，这类形式容易吸收，提供了另一个合理解释。无论采用哪种解读，实际意义都有限，因为一粒磷虾胶囊所含的 EPA 和 DHA 远少于一份鱼，吸收效率无法弥补这一差距。

Food data note食物数据说明The comparator fish and roe composition is all traced to USDA records and the two human trials (Lee 2024, Schuchardt 2011) checked out exactly. The krill-specific claims are the weak part: the phospholipid percentage range, both fluoride values and the sockeye astaxanthin concentration are all unverified, and two of the three factual claims that justified the original classification turned out to be false中。作为对照的鱼类和鱼卵成分全部可追溯到 USDA 记录，两项人体试验（Lee 2024、Schuchardt 2011）核对完全一致。薄弱之处在磷虾自身的相关说法：磷脂百分比区间、两个氟数值和红鲑虾青素浓度都未经核实，而支撑原有分类的三项事实性说法中有两项被证明是错的。

Does the body make it身体是否自产Taken as a product the roll-up is PARTIAL, because its main actives are the same EPA and DHA the body can only build partially from dietary ALA, with limited EPA synthesis and DHA synthesis that is undetectable in young men. The exception is astaxanthin, which is NONE: vertebrates including humans have no carotenoid biosynthetic pathway and can only cleave or modify what they eat, unlike aphids, spider mites and some other arthropods that synthesise carotenoids using horizontally transferred genes. Nothing in the product duplicates something the body already makes in quantity, so the real caveat is dose rather than redundancy, since krill oil carries less EPA and DHA per gram than concentrated fish or algal oil and the milligrams on the label matter more than the phospholipid-form claim.作为产品整体判为 PARTIAL，因为它的主要活性成分就是身体只能从膳食 ALA 部分合成的 EPA 和 DHA：EPA 合成有限，DHA 合成在年轻男性中检测不到。例外是虾青素，它属于 NONE，脊椎动物（包括人）不具备类胡萝卜素生物合成通路，只能对吃进来的类胡萝卜素做裂解或修饰，而蚜虫、叶螨和另一些节肢动物则通过横向转移获得的基因能够从头合成。产品中没有任何成分重复身体已能充分制造的物质，所以真正需要提醒的是剂量而非冗余：磷虾油每克所含的 EPA 和 DHA 少于浓缩鱼油或藻油，标签上的毫克数比磷脂形式这套说法更重要。

Pathway合成通路For EPA and DHA, the same hepatic cascade as any omega-3: ALA → FADS2 (delta-6) → ELOVL5 → FADS1 (delta-5) → EPA → ELOVL5 and ELOVL2 → DPA → ELOVL2 → 24:5n-3 → FADS2 (delta-6) → 24:6n-3 → peroxisomal beta-oxidation → DHA. The Sprecher C24 route is the principal and rate-limiting mammalian pathway; a direct delta-4 desaturase activity of the FADS2 product has been demonstrated in human cells, with its in vivo contribution not established. For astaxanthin: NOT APPLICABLE, humans have no carotenoid biosynthetic pathway and only cleave or modify dietary carotenoids.EPA 和 DHA 走与其他 omega-3 相同的肝内级联：ALA → FADS2（delta-6）→ ELOVL5 → FADS1（delta-5）→ EPA → ELOVL5 和 ELOVL2 → DPA → ELOVL2 → 24:5n-3 → FADS2（delta-6）→ 24:6n-3 → 过氧化物酶体 beta 氧化 → DHA。Sprecher 的 C24 路线是哺乳动物的主要限速通路；FADS2 产物在人细胞中已被证实具有直接的 delta-4 去饱和酶活性，其体内定量贡献尚未确立。虾青素：NOT APPLICABLE（不适用），人体没有类胡萝卜素生物合成通路，只能裂解或修饰膳食中的类胡萝卜素。

Amount made自产量Same conversion figures as for preformed EPA and DHA, with the same denominator caveat: EPA 21% and DHA 9% of ingested ALA as net fractional interconversion in the plasma tracer pool in young women, DHA undetectable in young men over 21 days, while studies expressing product formation as a proportion of total dietary ALA report DHA under 0.1% and under 0.01%. Endogenous astaxanthin 0 mg/d, and it has no reference intake.转化数值与现成 EPA 和 DHA 相同，分母提醒也相同：在年轻女性血浆示踪池中，摄入 ALA 的净分数转化为 EPA 21%、DHA 9%；年轻男性 21 天内检测不到 DHA；而以占膳食 ALA 总量比例表达产物生成的研究给出 DHA 低于 0.1% 和低于 0.01%。内源虾青素 0 mg/d，它也没有参考摄入量。

Still matters when仍有意义的情形The same situations as preformed EPA and DHA: low or no oily fish intake, pregnancy and lactation, and adult men targeting DHA status. Astaxanthin has no established human requirement, so on this axis it is an added antioxidant claim rather than the correction of any deficit.适用情形与现成 EPA 和 DHA 相同：多脂鱼摄入很少或没有、妊娠与哺乳、以 DHA 水平为目标的成年男性。虾青素没有已确立的人体需要量，在这一维度上它属于附加的抗氧化宣称，谈不上纠正任何不足。

Synthesis source合成来源Conversion data: PMID 12323090, DOI 10.1079/BJN2002689 and PMID 12323085, DOI 10.1079/BJN2002662. Absence of vertebrate carotenoid biosynthesis, cleavage-only metabolism in humans, and horizontally transferred carotenoid genes in aphids and spider mites. Mapped from the recovered entry Krill oil; the multi-part verdict in that entry is rolled up to PARTIAL here and the astaxanthin exception is stated in the note.

Refs.文献 Laslett JAMA 2024 PMID 38776073; Pimentel PMID 39126570; Loukil PMID 42144109
SSDDFFDDBBXXCod liver oil鱼肝油
Verdict结论Skip it不必买
Evidence证据Grade DD 级
Dose tested已验证剂量No established effective dose for any endpoint. The binding constraint is retinol, not omega-3.对任何终点都没有确立的有效剂量。真正的限制因素是视黄醇，不是 omega-3。
Who适用人群Arguably nobody, given modern alternatives.考虑到现代替代品，可以说没有适用人群。
Pros优点
  • Historically it was an effective vitamin D and vitamin A vehicle in populations with little sun and poor diets, and that history is real.在缺少日照、饮食贫乏的人群中，它历史上确实是有效的维生素 D 和维生素 A 载体，这段历史是真实的。
  • Natural triglyceride oils absorb well.天然甘油三酯型油脂吸收良好。
Cons缺点
  • You cannot increase the omega-3 dose without simultaneously increasing preformed vitamin A, which has a real toxicity ceiling of 3,000 µg/d and is teratogenic. That is a dose-limiting design flaw, not a feature.你无法在不同时增加预成型维生素 A 的情况下提高 omega-3 剂量，而前者有 3000 微克/天的真实毒性上限，并且致畸。这是限制剂量的设计缺陷，不是特色。
  • As an omega-3 source it is dilute, so reaching a therapeutic dose requires a large volume of oil and therefore a large retinol load.作为 omega-3 来源它很稀，要达到治疗剂量需要很大体积的油，也就意味着很大的视黄醇负荷。
  • Standard obstetric advice in several countries is to avoid liver and liver-oil supplements in pregnancy.若干国家的标准产科建议是妊娠期避免肝脏和肝油类补充剂。
  • Typically sold as a bulk, often flavoured liquid, which is the format that performed worst in oxidation surveys. Fermented cod liver oil has no quality advantage.通常以散装、常带调味的液体形式出售，而这正是在氧化调查中表现最差的形式。“发酵鱼肝油”没有质量优势。
What it does, and what happens without it它有什么作用，缺了会怎样

A fish-liver oil supplying vitamin D, preformed vitamin A and omega-3 fats together.一种鱼肝来源的油，同时提供维生素D、预成型维生素A及omega-3脂肪。

Mixed product复合产品

In detail详细Cod liver oil is a food product, oil rendered from the livers of Gadus species, carrying three active constituents in one dose: vitamin D3, preformed vitamin A as retinyl esters, and the long-chain omega-3 fatty acids EPA and DHA. Each has its own physiology (see the vitamin D3 and preformed vitamin A entries; EPA and DHA are incorporated into membrane phospholipids and serve as precursors to eicosanoids and specialised pro-resolving mediators, with DHA concentrated in retinal photoreceptor and neuronal membranes). It has historical standing because it was the agent that treated and then largely eliminated rickets in the polluted industrial cities of the early twentieth century, before vitamin D itself had been identified. Modern products vary widely in content depending on whether the natural vitamins were stripped during refining and re-added, so the label matters. The practical constraint on dosing is the preformed retinol: an amount large enough to deliver a meaningful EPA and DHA intake can push vitamin A toward or past the tolerable upper limit, and the vitamin A here is retinol, not beta-carotene.鱼肝油是一种食品，由鳕属（Gadus）鱼类的肝脏炼制而成，一次服用即含三种活性成分：维生素D3、以视黄酯形式存在的预成型维生素A，以及长链omega-3脂肪酸EPA和DHA。三者各有其自身的生理作用（参见维生素D3及预成型维生素A条目；EPA和DHA被纳入膜磷脂，并作为类花生酸及特化促消退介质的前体，其中DHA集中于视网膜光感受器和神经元膜中）。鱼肝油具有历史地位，因为在维生素D本身被鉴定出来之前，它正是在20世纪初污染严重的工业城市中用于治疗并进而大幅消除佝偻病的制剂。现代产品含量差异很大，取决于精炼过程中是否去除了天然维生素并重新添加，因此标签内容很重要。剂量的实际限制因素是其中的预成型视黄醇：足以提供有意义EPA和DHA摄入量的剂量，可能使维生素A摄入逼近或超过可耐受最高摄入量，且这里的维生素A是视黄醇，不是β-胡萝卜素。

There is no deficiency state for this. It is not an essential nutrient, so being short of it is not a thing that can happen.它不存在缺乏状态。它不是必需营养素，所以“缺了它”这件事本身并不成立。

Source来源PMID 12897318 (Rajakumar K, Pediatrics 2003;112:e132-5, Vitamin D, cod-liver oil, sunlight, and rickets: a historical perspective)

Food and the body食物与身体
In food: Rich食物中：丰富 Dose from food: Reachable靠吃达到剂量：可达到 Body makes it: Partly身体自产：部分自产 Food data: High食物数据：高

Everything cod liver oil supplies is available from ordinary food: EPA and DHA from oily fish and roe, vitamin D from oily fish, vitamin A from any liver. Cod liver oil is itself a traditional food-grade oil with its own USDA composition entry, which is why it appears in the list below, and it is included as the reference product rather than as an alternative to itself. What makes it distinctive is concentration: one teaspoon (4.5 g) carries 806 mg EPA+DHA, 1,350 ug RAE of preformed vitamin A (4,500 IU) and 11.2 ug of vitamin D (450 IU). Two genuine food alternatives are named without figures because no authoritative per-portion composition value could be obtained in this pass: tinned cod liver, eaten in Nordic, Baltic and Russian cuisine, and liver as a vitamin A source. Rather than estimate them, no row is given.鳕鱼肝油提供的每一种成分都能从普通食物中获得：EPA 和 DHA 来自多脂鱼和鱼卵，维生素 D 来自多脂鱼，维生素 A 来自任何动物肝脏。鳕鱼肝油本身就是一种传统食用级油脂，在 USDA 有自己的成分条目，这也是它出现在下表中的原因，它在表中的身份是参照产品，并不充当自身的替代品。它的特点在于浓度：一茶匙（4.5 g）含 806 mg EPA+DHA、1,350 ug RAE 的预形成维生素 A（4,500 IU）和 11.2 ug 维生素 D（450 IU）。有两种真正的食物替代只点名而不给数值，因为本轮无法获得权威的每份成分值：北欧、波罗的海和俄罗斯饮食中食用的罐装鳕鱼肝，以及作为维生素 A 来源的肝脏。与其估算，这里干脆不列出对应行。

To match the dose要达到该剂量For the EPA and DHA at a traditional teaspoon dose there is no gap, and food matches it easily: 806 mg per teaspoon is a little under one 92 g tin of sardines (903 mg) and about a quarter of a herring fillet (2,873 mg). Cod liver oil is also efficient in the other direction: 250-500 mg/day of EPA+DHA needs only 1.4-2.8 g of oil, a third to two thirds of a teaspoon, carrying 419-838 ug RAE of vitamin A, comfortably inside the 3,000 ug/day UL. The gap that opens at pharmacological doses is a toxicity gap rather than a volume one. Reaching 4 g/day of EPA+DHA takes 22.3 g of cod liver oil, about 1.6 tablespoons, delivering 6,704 ug RAE of preformed vitamin A every day, 2.2 times the EFSA adult UL. Traditional cod liver oil therefore cannot be dose-escalated to the level used in triglyceride-lowering trials, and food cannot reach 4 g/day either (see the Omega-3 entry). That is what plain fish oil and purified concentrates exist for.在传统的一茶匙剂量上，EPA 和 DHA 不存在差距，食物很容易匹配：每茶匙 806 mg，略低于一罐 92 g 沙丁鱼（903 mg），约为一片鲱鱼柳（2,873 mg）的四分之一。反过来看鳕鱼肝油也很高效：250-500 mg/day 的 EPA+DHA 只需 1.4-2.8 g 油，即三分之一到三分之二茶匙，随之摄入 419-838 ug RAE 维生素 A，稳稳低于 3,000 ug/day 的 UL。药理剂量下出现的差距是毒性上的差距，与吃得下多少无关。达到 4 g/day 的 EPA+DHA 需要 22.3 g 鳕鱼肝油，约 1.6 汤匙，每天随之摄入 6,704 ug RAE 预形成维生素 A，为 EFSA 成人 UL 的 2.2 倍。因此传统鳕鱼肝油无法加量到降甘油三酯试验所用的水平，食物同样达不到 4 g/day（见欧米伽-3 条目）。这正是普通鱼油和纯化浓缩物存在的理由。

Food vs supplement食物与补充剂This is the clearest case in this group where the concentrated product is hazardous in a way the food behaviour does not suggest. The vitamin A is preformed retinol, so it accumulates and is teratogenic. Anyone already taking a multivitamin, or pregnant, can exceed the 3,000 ug RAE/day UL on one tablespoon alone (4,080 ug). Doubling up cod liver oil with a separate vitamin D supplement is the other common stacking error. Many modern products labelled cod liver oil are refined with the vitamin A and D partly stripped and re-standardised, so the USDA generic entry above describes traditional oil and not necessarily what is in a given bottle: the label governs. Contaminants concentrate in liver, which is why the EU sets a separate limit for fish liver and derived products (20.0 pg WHO-TEQ/g wet weight) alongside the 1.75 pg/g fat dioxin and 6.0 pg/g fat dioxin plus dioxin-like PCB limits for marine oils under Regulation (EU) 2023/915. Those limit values were not re-verified in this pass. Commercial cod liver oil is refined to meet them; home-rendered or artisanal liver oil is not.这是本组中最清楚的一例：浓缩产品的危害方式，从食物本身的表现里看不出来。其中的维生素 A 是预形成的视黄醇，会蓄积并有致畸性。已经在服用复合维生素的人，或孕妇，仅一汤匙（4,080 ug）就可能超过 3,000 ug RAE/day 的 UL。另一个常见的叠加错误是鳕鱼肝油再加单独的维生素 D 补充剂。许多现代标称鳕鱼肝油的产品经过精炼，维生素 A 和 D 被部分去除并重新标准化，所以上面 USDA 的通用条目描述的是传统油品，未必等于某一瓶里的东西，以标签为准。污染物在肝脏中富集，这也是欧盟在 Regulation (EU) 2023/915 中除了对海洋油脂设定二噁英 1.75 pg/g 脂肪、二噁英加类二噁英 PCB 6.0 pg/g 脂肪的限值之外，另为鱼肝及其衍生产品设定单独限值（20.0 pg WHO-TEQ/g 湿重）的原因。这些限值在本轮未重新核实。商品化鳕鱼肝油经过精炼以符合限值；自家熬制或手作肝油不符合。

Absorption吸收Cod liver oil is a natural triglyceride and was one of the natural-triglyceride comparators assigned the 100% reference index in the Dyerberg comparison, against 124% for re-esterified triglyceride and 73% for ethyl ester (PMID 20638827, both comparator values confirmed). Its fat-soluble vitamins come dissolved in the oil, which is the ideal vehicle, and that is precisely why the vitamin A is so efficiently absorbed and why overdose is easy. There is no absorption advantage over eating oily fish for the EPA and DHA.鳕鱼肝油是天然甘油三酯，在 Dyerberg 的比较中属于被赋予 100% 参照指数的天然甘油三酯对照之一，相对的重新酯化甘油三酯为 124%，乙酯为 73%（PMID 20638827，两个对照数值均已确认）。它的脂溶性维生素溶解在油中，这是理想的载体，也正因如此维生素 A 吸收极其高效，过量也容易发生。就 EPA 和 DHA 而言，它相对于吃多脂鱼没有吸收优势。

Food data note食物数据说明The USDA cod liver oil record matched on every value including both household measures and both vitamin unit conversions, and the whole arithmetic block recomputed exactly (806 mg and 2,434 mg per portion, 322% of the AI, 45% and 136% of the vitamin A UL, 1.4-2.8 g for 250-500 mg carrying 419-838 ug RAE, 22.3 g for 4 g/day carrying 6,704 ug RAE). The EFSA vitamin A and D ULs and the EU 2023/915 limits are widely cited but were not confirmed in this pass, and they are load-bearing for the toxicity conclusion高。USDA 鳕鱼肝油记录在每一个数值上都吻合，包括两种家庭常用量和两项维生素单位换算，整个算术部分复算完全一致（每份 806 mg 和 2,434 mg，AI 的 322%，维生素 A UL 的 45% 和 136%，250-500 mg 需 1.4-2.8 g 并随之摄入 419-838 ug RAE，4 g/day 需 22.3 g 并随之摄入 6,704 ug RAE）。EFSA 的维生素 A 和 D UL 以及 EU 2023/915 限值被广泛引用，但本轮未予确认，而它们对毒性结论起支撑作用。

Does the body make it身体是否自产As a product the roll-up is PARTIAL, since cod liver oil bundles three actives with three different verdicts and the body covers only part of what is in the bottle. Its EPA and DHA are partly synthesisable from dietary ALA (PARTIAL), its vitamin D3 is genuinely manufactured in your own skin from 7-dehydrocholesterol whenever UVB reaches it, with cutaneous synthesis alone able to meet requirement and no risk of toxicity because previtamin D3 photodegrades and CYP24A1 clears the active hormone (FULL, conditional on exposure), and its retinol cannot be built at all because human cells only cleave dietary provitamin A carotenoids (NONE). For anyone with real sun exposure the redundant part is the vitamin D, and the retinol load makes this a poor carrier, since plain D3 plus fish or algal oil gives the same benefit without pushing retinol towards the upper limit.作为产品整体判为 PARTIAL：鱼肝油把三种活性成分捆在一起，三者的结论各不相同，身体只能覆盖瓶子里的一部分。它的 EPA 和 DHA 只能从膳食 ALA 部分合成（PARTIAL）；它的维生素D3 确实由自己的皮肤用 7-脱氢胆固醇制造，只要 UVB 照到皮肤，单靠皮肤合成就能满足需要量，而且不会中毒，因为前维生素D3 会光降解，CYP24A1 会清除活性激素（FULL，以有日照为条件）；它的视黄醇则完全无法从头合成，人体细胞只能裂解膳食中的维生素A原类胡萝卜素（NONE）。因此对真正有日照的人来说，多余的那部分是维生素D，而视黄醇负荷让鱼肝油成为一个糟糕的载体：单纯的 D3 加鱼油或藻油能提供同样的好处，又不会把视黄醇推向上限。

Pathway合成通路EPA and DHA: FADS2 (delta-6) → ELOVL5 → FADS1 (delta-5) → EPA → ELOVL2 → 24:5n-3 → FADS2 (delta-6) → 24:6n-3 → peroxisomal beta-oxidation → DHA, in hepatocytes; the Sprecher C24 route is the principal and rate-limiting mammalian pathway, and a direct delta-4 desaturase activity of the FADS2 product has been demonstrated in human cells with the in vivo contribution not established. Vitamin D3: epidermal 7-dehydrocholesterol → UVB photolysis → previtamin D3 → thermal isomerisation to vitamin D3 → hepatic 25-hydroxylation (CYP2R1) → renal 1-alpha-hydroxylation (CYP27B1) to calcitriol, with CYP24A1 as the clearance route. Retinol: NOT APPLICABLE, human cells only cleave dietary provitamin A carotenoids (BCO1).EPA 和 DHA：在肝细胞内 FADS2（delta-6）→ ELOVL5 → FADS1（delta-5）→ EPA → ELOVL2 → 24:5n-3 → FADS2（delta-6）→ 24:6n-3 → 过氧化物酶体 beta 氧化 → DHA；Sprecher 的 C24 路线是哺乳动物的主要限速通路，FADS2 产物在人细胞中已被证实有直接的 delta-4 去饱和酶活性，体内定量贡献尚未确立。维生素D3：表皮 7-脱氢胆固醇 → UVB 光解 → 前维生素D3 → 热异构化为维生素D3 → 肝脏 25-羟化（CYP2R1）→ 肾脏 1-alpha-羟化（CYP27B1）生成骨化三醇，CYP24A1 负责清除。视黄醇：NOT APPLICABLE（不适用），人体细胞只能裂解膳食中的维生素A原类胡萝卜素（BCO1）。

Amount made自产量Cutaneous vitamin D3 output varies with latitude, season, time of day, skin pigmentation and exposed surface area, so no single figure applies, but figures do exist: whole-body exposure to one minimal erythemal dose of UVB is equivalent to roughly 10,000-25,000 IU (250-625 µg) vitamin D3. Endogenous retinol 0 µg/d. EPA and DHA are conversion rather than synthesis: EPA 21% and DHA 9% of ingested ALA in young women, DHA undetectable in young men over 21 days; absolute mg/d NOT ESTABLISHED.皮肤维生素D3 产量随纬度、季节、时段、皮肤色素和暴露面积变化，没有单一数值适用于所有情况，但确实存在可用数字：全身暴露于一个最小红斑剂量的 UVB 相当于大约 10,000-25,000 IU（250-625 µg）维生素D3。内源视黄醇 0 µg/d。EPA 和 DHA 是转化而非合成：年轻女性摄入 ALA 的 21% 到达 EPA，9% 到达 DHA，年轻男性 21 天内检测不到 DHA；绝对量（mg/d）NOT ESTABLISHED（未确立）。

Still matters when仍有意义的情形Justified where sun exposure is genuinely low (winter at high latitude, covered skin, housebound or institutionalised, darker skin at high latitude) together with low fish intake. Not justified as a routine high-dose vitamin A source, and specifically to be avoided at high retinol doses in pregnancy because of teratogenicity, where separate D3 plus fish or algal oil is the cleaner choice.日照确实很少（高纬度冬季、皮肤被遮盖、居家不出或住在机构、高纬度地区深色皮肤）并且鱼类摄入很低时才有理由使用。把它当作常规高剂量维生素A来源没有依据；妊娠期尤其要避免高剂量视黄醇，因为有致畸性，此时分开使用 D3 加鱼油或藻油是更干净的选择。

Synthesis source合成来源Holick MF. Vitamin D deficiency. N Engl J Med. 2007;357(3):266-81. PMID 17634462, DOI 10.1056/NEJMra070553 (cutaneous synthesis, hydroxylation steps, roughly 10,000-25,000 IU per minimal erythemal dose); conversion data PMID 12323090, DOI 10.1079/BJN2002689 and PMID 12323085, DOI 10.1079/BJN2002662; IOM, Dietary Reference Intakes for Calcium and Vitamin D (2011). SSCCFFDDBBXXALA from flaxseed, chia or walnut oil亚麻籽、奇亚籽或核桃油中的 ALA
Verdict结论Skip it不必买
Evidence证据Grade CC 级
Dose tested已验证剂量Adequate intake 1.6 g/d for men and 1.1 g/d for women. No upper limit; the practical constraint is calories from oil.适宜摄入量：男性 1.6 克/天，女性 1.1 克/天。没有上限；实际限制是油带来的热量。
Who适用人群People who eat no marine products at all and will not take algal oil. It at least maintains essential fatty acid status.完全不吃海产、也不愿吃藻油的人。它至少能维持必需脂肪酸的状态。
Pros优点
  • It is a genuinely essential fatty acid, so adequate intake matters.它确实是必需脂肪酸，所以摄入足量是有意义的。
  • The Cochrane review found a signal for arrhythmia reduction, RR 0.73 (0.55-0.97) at moderate certainty. Note that rests on just 2 trials, 4,912 participants and 173 events.Cochrane 综述发现心律失常减少的信号，RR 0.73（0.55-0.97），确定性中等。注意这只建立在 2 项试验、4912 名受试者和 173 个事件之上。
Cons缺点
  • The plant-based omega-3, same benefits claim is the core deception. Conversion of ALA to EPA is a few percent and to DHA is well under one percent in adults, and it is further suppressed by high dietary linoleic acid. A flaxseed capsule does not deliver what a fish oil or algal oil capsule delivers.“植物来源的 omega-3，同样的好处”是核心误导。成人体内 ALA 转化为 EPA 只有百分之几，转化为 DHA 远低于百分之一，而且会被膳食中较高的亚油酸进一步压制。一粒亚麻籽胶囊提供不了鱼油或藻油胶囊提供的东西。
  • Cochrane found increased ALA probably makes little or no difference to all-cause mortality, RR 1.01 (0.84-1.20).Cochrane 发现增加 ALA 对全因死亡可能几乎没有影响，RR 1.01（0.84-1.20）。
  • Anyone relying on it to achieve DHA status is making a mistake, and that includes pregnant women and vegans wanting fetal DHA supply. Algal DHA is the correct product there.任何指望靠它达到 DHA 水平的人都做错了，这包括希望为胎儿提供 DHA 的孕妇和纯素者。那种情况下正确的产品是藻油 DHA。
  • Note the arrhythmia finding for ALA points the opposite way to the atrial fibrillation excess seen with marine omega-3 (HR 1.25), so the two should not be treated as interchangeable in either direction.注意 ALA 的心律失常结果与海洋 omega-3 观察到的房颤增多（HR 1.25）方向相反，因此两者在任何方向上都不应被当作可以互换。
What it does, and what happens without it它有什么作用，缺了会怎样

The one omega-3 fat the body cannot make; the raw material for EPA and DHA.人体唯一无法自行合成的omega-3脂肪,是EPA和DHA的原料。

Named deficiency disease有明确的缺乏症 Fully reversible完全可逆

In detail详细Alpha-linolenic acid (18:3n-3) is a genuine essential nutrient. Humans lack the desaturase that places a double bond at the n-3 position of a fatty acid, so every omega-3 molecule in the body traces back to dietary ALA or to preformed EPA and DHA. ALA is incorporated into membrane phospholipids, is a substantial oxidative fuel (a large share of an ingested dose is simply burned), and is the substrate for the elongation and desaturation pathway producing EPA, DPA and DHA. Stable-isotope tracer work puts net conversion to EPA at about 8% in young men and 21% in young women, with DHA formation around 9% in women and undetectable in men (PMID 12323085, PMID 12323090). The US Adequate Intake is 1.6 g/day for men and 1.1 g/day for women.α-亚麻酸(18:3n-3)是真正意义上的必需营养素。人体缺乏能在脂肪酸n-3位置引入双键的desaturase,因此体内每一个omega-3分子都来自膳食ALA或预成的EPA和DHA。ALA被掺入膜磷脂,也是重要的氧化燃料(摄入剂量中相当大一部分直接被氧化供能),同时是生成EPA、DPA和DHA的延长去饱和途径的底物。稳定同位素示踪研究显示,年轻男性向EPA的净转化率约为8%,年轻女性约为21%,DHA生成率女性约为9%,男性检测不到(PMID 12323085, PMID 12323090)。美国的适宜摄入量男性为1.6 g/day,女性为1.1 g/day。

Deficiency disease缺乏症Alpha-linolenic acid deficiency, the n-3 form of essential fatty acid deficiency (EFAD). It is a recognised clinical entity but carries no eponym comparable to scurvy or rickets.α-亚麻酸缺乏症,即必需脂肪酸缺乏症(EFAD)的n-3形式。这是公认的临床实体,但没有类似坏血病或佝偻病那样的专有病名。

First signs早期表现Biochemically, a rising ratio of n-6 to n-3 fatty acids in plasma and red cell phospholipids with falling 22:6n-3, detectable before any symptom. Clinically, the first reported signs in humans were sensory: intermittent numbness and paraesthesia in the limbs, and blurring of vision.生化上表现为血浆和红细胞磷脂中n-6与n-3脂肪酸比值升高,22:6n-3下降,这在出现任何症状之前即可检测到。临床上,人体首次报告的体征属于感觉方面:间歇性肢体麻木和感觉异常,以及视物模糊。

Untreated不治疗会怎样In the index case, a six-year-old girl maintained on parenteral nutrition rich in linoleate but nearly devoid of linolenate developed, after five months, episodes of numbness, paraesthesia, leg pain, weakness, inability to walk and blurred vision (Holman et al., PMID 6801965). Patients on long-term gastric-tube feeding with n-3-poor formulas developed scaly dermatitis and a haemorrhagic folliculitis (Bjerve et al.). Deficiency of this severity effectively arises only when the entire fat supply is medically controlled.在首例报告中,一名6岁女孩接受富含亚油酸盐但几乎不含亚麻酸盐的肠外营养,五个月后出现发作性麻木、感觉异常、腿痛、乏力、无法行走及视物模糊(Holman等,PMID 6801965)。长期使用贫n-3配方经胃管喂养的患者出现鳞屑性皮炎和出血性毛囊炎(Bjerve等)。这种严重程度的缺乏实际上只发生在全部脂肪供给都由医疗手段控制的情况下。

Does it reverse补回来能修复吗In every documented human case, neurological symptoms disappeared and skin lesions resolved once an n-3-containing lipid source was substituted, with plasma fatty acid profiles normalising alongside. No residual deficit was reported. The honest caveat is that all reported cases were identified within months; the consequences of much longer deprivation in humans are unknown.在所有已记录的人体病例中,一旦改用含n-3的脂质来源,神经系统症状即消失,皮肤病变随之消退,血浆脂肪酸谱同步恢复正常,未见报告有残留缺陷。需要如实说明的是,所有报告病例均在数月内被发现,人体长期缺乏的后果尚不清楚。

Who becomes deficient谁会缺乏Patients on long-term parenteral nutrition or tube feeding with lipid sources low in n-3, historically safflower-based emulsions. Essentially nobody eating ordinary food, since ALA is widespread in vegetable oils, nuts, seeds and green leaves. Extremely low-fat diets sustained for years are a theoretical risk with no case series behind it.长期接受肠外营养或管饲、且脂质来源n-3含量低(历史上多为红花籽油基乳剂)的患者。正常饮食的人群基本不会出现风险,因为ALA广泛存在于植物油、坚果、种子和绿叶蔬菜中。持续多年的极低脂饮食是一种理论上的风险,尚无病例系列支持。

How common有多常见NOT ESTABLISHED. Clinical ALA deficiency exists only in case reports and small series of parenteral and tube-fed patients. No population prevalence figure exists because the condition does not occur in free-living people eating normal diets.无确切数据。临床ALA缺乏症仅见于肠外营养和管饲患者的病例报告及小样本系列。由于该病不会发生在正常饮食的普通人群中,没有人群患病率数据。

Source来源PMID 6801965 (Holman RT, Johnson SB, Hatch TF. Am J Clin Nutr. 1982;35:617-23); PMID 12323085 and PMID 12323090 (Burdge GC et al. Br J Nutr. 2002); Institute of Medicine DRI for Macronutrients 2005, doi:10.17226/10490

Food and the body食物与身体
In food: Rich食物中：丰富 Dose from food: Reachable靠吃达到剂量：可达到 Body makes it: Cannot身体自产：不能 Food data: High食物数据：高

ALA is one of the easiest nutrients in this reference to obtain from food. EFSA sets the Adequate Intake at 0.5% of energy, about 1.1-1.4 g/day for a 2,000-2,500 kcal diet (EFSA Journal 2010;8(3):1461, DOI 10.2903/j.efsa.2010.1461; the 0.5%-of-energy conversion checks arithmetically at 10 kcal/9 = 1.11 g and 12.5/9 = 1.39 g). A single tablespoon of ground flaxseed exceeds it. The supplement-shaped foods are not even the main dietary route in the UK and Northern Europe, where rapeseed oil supplies more ALA than flaxseed, chia and walnuts combined, and perilla oil is a higher-ALA culinary oil than flaxseed oil. The real question is not whether you can eat ALA but whether ALA becomes EPA and DHA in the body, and for DHA the answer is largely no.ALA 是本参考资料中最容易从食物获得的营养素之一。EFSA 将适宜摄入量定为能量的 0.5%，对 2,000-2,500 kcal 的膳食约为 1.1-1.4 g/day（EFSA Journal 2010;8(3):1461, DOI 10.2903/j.efsa.2010.1461；能量 0.5% 的换算在算术上核对无误：10 kcal/9 = 1.11 g，12.5/9 = 1.39 g）。一汤匙亚麻籽粉就超过了这个量。在英国和北欧，这些被做成补充剂形态的食物甚至不是主要的膳食途径：菜籽油提供的 ALA 超过亚麻籽、奇亚籽和核桃之和，而紫苏油的 ALA 含量还高于亚麻籽油。真正要问的是 ALA 在体内能否变成 EPA 和 DHA；吃够 ALA 本身毫无难度，而就 DHA 而言，答案基本是否定的。

To match the dose要达到该剂量For ALA itself there is zero gap: one tablespoon of ground flaxseed (1.60 g), one ounce of walnuts (2.57 g), one ounce of hulled hemp seed (2.46 g), one tablespoon of walnut oil (1.41 g) or one tablespoon of rapeseed oil (about 1.2 g) each meet or exceed the 1.1-1.4 g/day AI, and one tablespoon of flaxseed oil supplies 7.26 g. The gap appears only when ALA is sold as a substitute for EPA and DHA, and the two substances need separate answers. For EPA, substitution is plausible at modest intakes: Burdge and Wootton 2002 measured 21% net fractional conversion of labelled ALA to EPA in young women (PMID 12323090, DOI 10.1079/BJN2002689), so a 250 mg/day EPA target needs 1.19 g ALA/day, which is about 0.7 tablespoons of ground flaxseed. For DHA, substitution fails at any realistic intake. The same paper gives 9% conversion to DHA and 6% to DPA in women, while in young men roughly 33% of the dose was oxidised within 24 hours, EPA and DPA were the only meaningful products, and no labelled DHA was detectable in plasma at any point over 21 days (PMID 12323085, DOI 10.1079/bjn2002662). Whole-body estimates are lower still, commonly 0.1-0.5% for DHA. At 0.5% you need 50 g ALA/day, which is 219 g of flaxseed or roughly 100 mL of flaxseed oil daily; at 0.1% you need 250 g ALA/day, over a kilogram of seed. No one eats that. Feeding trials agree, with plasma DHA unchanged after a month of flaxseed in any form (Austria 2008, PMID 18689552). State it plainly: flaxseed, chia and walnut oil can substitute for EPA at modest intakes and cannot supply DHA at any realistic intake. Express any of these requirements in milled seed rather than whole, since whole flaxseed produced no significant plasma ALA rise in that trial.就 ALA 本身而言差距为零：一汤匙亚麻籽粉（1.60 g）、一盎司核桃（2.57 g）、一盎司去壳大麻籽（2.46 g）、一汤匙核桃油（1.41 g）或一汤匙菜籽油（约 1.2 g），都达到或超过 1.1-1.4 g/day 的 AI，而一汤匙亚麻籽油提供 7.26 g。差距只在把 ALA 当作 EPA 和 DHA 的替代品出售时才出现，这两种物质需要分开回答。对 EPA，在中等摄入量下替代是可行的：Burdge 与 Wootton 2002 在年轻女性中测得标记 ALA 转化为 EPA 的净分数转化率为 21%（PMID 12323090, DOI 10.1079/BJN2002689），因此 250 mg/day 的 EPA 目标需要 1.19 g ALA/day，约合 0.7 汤匙亚麻籽粉。对 DHA，在任何现实摄入量下替代都行不通。同一篇论文给出女性向 DHA 的转化率为 9%、向 DPA 为 6%；而在年轻男性中，约 33% 的剂量在 24 小时内被氧化，EPA 和 DPA 是唯一有意义的产物，21 天内任何时间点血浆中都检测不到标记 DHA（PMID 12323085, DOI 10.1079/bjn2002662）。全身水平的估计更低，DHA 常见为 0.1-0.5%。按 0.5% 计需要 50 g ALA/day，即每天 219 g 亚麻籽或约 100 mL 亚麻籽油；按 0.1% 计需要 250 g ALA/day，超过一公斤籽。没有人这么吃。喂养试验的结果一致：食用任何形式的亚麻籽一个月后血浆 DHA 均无变化（Austria 2008, PMID 18689552）。直说结论：亚麻籽、奇亚籽和核桃油在中等摄入量下可以替代 EPA，在任何现实摄入量下都无法提供 DHA。上述需求量都应以研磨后的籽来表述，整粒籽不适用，因为该试验中整粒亚麻籽未使血浆 ALA 显著升高。

Food vs supplement食物与补充剂Form determines whether the ALA is absorbed at all, which is unusual among plant supplements. Over one month at matched ALA doses, flaxseed oil and milled flaxseed both raised plasma ALA significantly (oil higher than milled, P=0.004), while whole flaxseed produced no significant rise, and no group raised EPA or DHA (Austria 2008, PMID 18689552, DOI 10.1080/07315724.2008.10719693). Sprinkling whole seeds on food is close to decorative. Practical consequences: grind flaxseed, store it cold and use it quickly, because ALA at 53% of an oil is highly oxidisable and rancid flax oil is a pro-oxidant load rather than a benefit; flaxseed oil supplies ALA with none of the fibre or lignans of the seed; and conversion to EPA is suppressed by high dietary linoleic acid, so an ALA supplement taken alongside a diet heavy in sunflower or corn oil performs worse than the tracer figures suggest. Milled seed was also the best-tolerated form, with the oil and whole seed both causing gastrointestinal discomfort in that trial.形式决定 ALA 究竟能否被吸收，这在植物类补充剂中并不常见。在为期一个月的匹配 ALA 剂量试验中，亚麻籽油和研磨亚麻籽都显著提高了血浆 ALA（油高于研磨，P=0.004），整粒亚麻籽未带来显著升高，而没有任何一组提高了 EPA 或 DHA（Austria 2008, PMID 18689552, DOI 10.1080/07315724.2008.10719693）。把整粒籽撒在食物上，作用接近装饰。实际含义有几点：亚麻籽要现磨、冷藏并尽快用完，因为占油脂 53% 的 ALA 极易氧化，酸败的亚麻油带来的是促氧化负荷，谈不上益处；亚麻籽油只提供 ALA，不含籽中的膳食纤维和木酚素；膳食中亚油酸过高会抑制向 EPA 的转化，因此在大量食用葵花籽油或玉米油的膳食下服用 ALA 补充剂，效果比示踪剂数字所显示的更差。研磨籽也是耐受性最好的形式，该试验中油和整粒籽都引起了胃肠不适。

Absorption吸收Two sequential losses. First, absorption and delivery: oil beats milled seed beats whole seed, with whole seed showing no measurable plasma ALA response (Austria 2008). Second, metabolic conversion, where the same enzyme chain (delta-6 desaturase, elongase, delta-5 desaturase, then peroxisomal beta-oxidation for DHA) is shared with linoleic acid and is the real bottleneck. Conversion rates differ by product and must not be interchanged: EPA 21% and DPA 6% in the tracer study in women, DHA 9% at best in the same study and undetectable in men over 21 days, with whole-body estimates commonly 0.1-0.5% for DHA. Women convert better than men, which is thought to reflect the demands of pregnancy and lactation. A third of an oral ALA dose is simply burned for energy within 24 hours.有两道先后损失。第一道是吸收和递送：油优于研磨籽，研磨籽优于整粒籽，整粒籽没有可测的血浆 ALA 反应（Austria 2008）。第二道是代谢转化，同一条酶链（delta-6 去饱和酶、延长酶、delta-5 去饱和酶，生成 DHA 还需过氧化物酶体 beta-氧化）与亚油酸共用，这才是真正的瓶颈。不同产物的转化率不同，不可互换使用：女性示踪研究中 EPA 为 21%、DPA 为 6%；同一研究中 DHA 最高 9%，而男性在 21 天内检测不到；全身水平的估计对 DHA 常见为 0.1-0.5%。女性的转化优于男性，一般认为这反映了妊娠和哺乳的需求。口服 ALA 剂量的三分之一在 24 小时内直接被燃烧供能。

Food data note食物数据说明for the five USDA rows, which all resolved to the described food with the stated ALA values and USDA's own household measures, and for every per-portion and percent-of-AI figure, all of which recomputed exactly. MEDIUM overall because two added rows, perilla oil and rapeseed oil, rest on figures the verification pass could not trace and are labelled indicative, and because the hemp seed portion uses an ounce conversion rather than a USDA household measure五行 USDA 数据为高：它们都对应所描述的食物、所列 ALA 数值以及 USDA 自带的家庭常用量，每一项每份含量和占 AI 百分比也都复算无误。整体为中，因为新增的两行（紫苏油和菜籽油）依据的数字本轮无法追溯，已标为参考性；大麻籽的份量用的是盎司换算，并非 USDA 家庭常用量。

Does the body make it身体是否自产The verdict for the substance actually in the bottle is NONE: humans lack the omega-3 (delta-15) desaturase that plants have, so ALA synthesis is zero, exactly as it is for the chemical elements. The exception is downstream, where the products people buy flax, chia or walnut oil for are PARTIAL: 21% of a labelled ALA dose reaches EPA and 9% reaches DHA in young women, while in young men EPA and DPA appear and DHA stays undetectable for 21 days, and most of the dose is simply burned as fuel. A precursor the body cannot make plus a conversion step that mostly fails means these oils are a defensible source of ALA itself and an unreliable route to DHA.瓶子里那种物质的结论是 NONE：人体缺少植物拥有的 omega-3（delta-15）去饱和酶，ALA 合成为零，与化学元素的判定一致。例外在下游，人们买亚麻籽油、奇亚籽油或核桃油真正想要的产物属于 PARTIAL：年轻女性中标记 ALA 剂量的 21% 到达 EPA，9% 到达 DHA；年轻男性中出现 EPA 和 DPA，21 天内检测不到 DHA，而大部分剂量直接被当燃料烧掉。前体身体无法合成，转化步骤又大半落空，所以这类油作为 ALA 本身的来源站得住，作为 DHA 的途径并不可靠。

Pathway合成通路ALA 18:3n-3 → FADS2 (delta-6) → 18:4n-3 → ELOVL5 → 20:4n-3 → FADS1 (delta-5) → EPA 20:5n-3 → ELOVL5 and ELOVL2 → DPA 22:5n-3 → ELOVL2 → 24:5n-3 → FADS2 again (delta-6) → 24:6n-3 → peroxisomal beta-oxidation → DHA 22:6n-3, mainly in hepatocyte ER and peroxisome. The Sprecher C24 route is the principal and rate-limiting mammalian pathway. For ALA itself: NOT APPLICABLE, humans have no omega-3 (delta-15) desaturase, so the 18-carbon precursor is strictly dietary.ALA 18:3n-3 → FADS2（delta-6）→ 18:4n-3 → ELOVL5 → 20:4n-3 → FADS1（delta-5）→ EPA 20:5n-3 → ELOVL5 和 ELOVL2 → DPA 22:5n-3 → ELOVL2 → 24:5n-3 → 再次用 FADS2（delta-6）→ 24:6n-3 → 过氧化物酶体 beta 氧化 → DHA 22:6n-3，主要发生在肝细胞内质网和过氧化物酶体。Sprecher 的 C24 路线是哺乳动物的主要限速通路。ALA 本身：NOT APPLICABLE（不适用），人体没有 omega-3（delta-15）去饱和酶，这个 18 碳前体只能来自膳食。

Amount made自产量Endogenous synthesis of ALA itself: 0 mg/d. Net fractional conversion of ingested ALA within the plasma tracer pool over 21 days, young women: EPA 21%, DPA 6%, DHA 9%; in young men EPA and DPA only, with DHA undetectable to 21 days. Studies using total dietary ALA as the denominator report DHA under 0.1% (controlled-diet tracer study) and under 0.01% (hyperlipidaemic men), which is not the same measurement as the 9%. About 33% of the tracer appears as breath 13CO2 within 24 hours in men and about 22% in women; doubling dietary linoleic acid from 15 g/d to 30 g/d lowers conversion of the labelled 18:3n-3 and 18:2n-6 tracers by 40 to 54%.ALA 本身的内源合成量：0 mg/d。摄入 ALA 在血浆示踪池中 21 天内的净分数转化，年轻女性：EPA 21%，DPA 6%，DHA 9%；年轻男性只有 EPA 和 DPA，21 天内检测不到 DHA。以膳食 ALA 总量作分母的研究报告 DHA 低于 0.1%（受控膳食示踪研究）和低于 0.01%（高脂血症男性），这与 9% 测的不是同一件事。男性 24 小时内约 33% 的示踪剂以呼气 13CO2 形式出现，女性约 22%；把膳食亚油酸从 15 g/d 加倍到 30 g/d，会使标记的 18:3n-3 和 18:2n-6 示踪剂转化下降 40 至 54%。

Still matters when仍有意义的情形Justified as a source of the essential fatty acid ALA itself, which the body cannot make at all, as a plant n-3 baseline for vegans without access to algal oil, and where EPA rather than DHA is the target. Not adequate as the DHA source in pregnancy, lactation, infancy or for adult men, and its already small effect shrinks further as linoleic acid intake rises.作为必需脂肪酸 ALA 本身的来源是成立的，身体完全无法合成它；对拿不到藻油的纯素者，它可以作为植物性 n-3 的基础供给；目标是 EPA 而非 DHA 时也成立。在妊娠、哺乳、婴儿期或对成年男性，它不足以充当 DHA 来源；随着亚油酸摄入升高，它本来就不大的作用还会进一步缩小。

Br J Nutr. 2002;88(4):355-63. PMID 12323085, DOI 10.1079/BJN2002662 (men, 33% breath 13CO2, DHA undetectable). Mapped from the recovered entry of the same name; its two-part verdict is rolled up to NONE for the substance supplied, with the PARTIAL downstream arm named in the note.

Refs.文献 Cochrane PMID 32114706; Gencer PMID 34612056; NASEM DRI
SSCCFFDDBBXXAlgal oil (vegan DHA and EPA)藻油（纯素 DHA 与 EPA）
Verdict结论Skip it不必买
Evidence证据Grade CC 级
Dose tested已验证剂量Matched to fish oil equivalents. For pregnancy the tested DHA doses are the same as fish-derived, 200-1,000 mg/d.按鱼油等效量给药。妊娠期已验证的 DHA 剂量与鱼源相同，为 200 至 1000 毫克/天。
Who适用人群Vegans and vegetarians, people avoiding fish contaminants, and people with fish or shellfish allergy.纯素者与素食者、想避开鱼类污染物的人、以及鱼类或贝类过敏者。
Pros优点
  • It is the correct product for vegans, who cannot obtain preformed EPA and DHA any other way, and for whom ALA conversion is inadequate.对纯素者而言这是正确的产品，他们无法通过其他途径获得预成型的 EPA 和 DHA，而 ALA 转化又不足。
  • Statistically non-inferior to fish oil for plasma phospholipid DHA and EPA in a 74-person trial over 6 to 14 weeks.在一项 74 人、持续 6 至 14 周的试验中，血浆磷脂 DHA 和 EPA 在统计学上不劣于鱼油。
  • Avoids methylmercury, dioxins and PCBs, which is a legitimate reason to choose it in pregnancy.可避开甲基汞、二噁英和多氯联苯，这是妊娠期选择它的正当理由。
Cons缺点
  • There is no clinical outcome trial of algal oil for any endpoint. The only evidence is a 74-person biomarker study, and the credibility it borrows comes from the fish oil outcome trials, which were largely null.藻油在任何终点上都没有临床结局试验。唯一的证据是一项 74 人的生物标志物研究，而它借来的可信度出自鱼油的结局试验，那些试验大体上是阴性的。
  • Non-inferiority on a biomarker is not superiority, and marketing implying algal DHA is cleaner therefore better conflates contaminant avoidance with efficacy.在生物标志物上不劣于并不等于优于，而暗示“藻油 DHA 更干净所以更好”的营销，把避开污染物和有效性混为一谈。
  • Cost per milligram of DHA is usually higher than fish oil.每毫克 DHA 的成本通常高于鱼油。
  • Products are DHA-dominant, and DHA raises LDL more than EPA does (+6.9% versus +2.2% in a head-to-head crossover), which matters if LDL is your limiting problem.这类产品以 DHA 为主，而 DHA 升高低密度脂蛋白的幅度大于 EPA（头对头交叉试验中为 +6.9% 对 +2.2%），如果低密度脂蛋白是你的主要问题，这一点很要紧。
What it does, and what happens without it它有什么作用，缺了会怎样

Oil from marine microalgae that supplies ready-made DHA, and in some products EPA, without fish.来自海洋微藻的油脂,可在不吃鱼的情况下提供现成的DHA,部分产品还含EPA。

No deficiency state exists不存在缺乏状态

In detail详细Algal oil is extracted from cultured heterotrophic microalgae, chiefly Schizochytrium species and Crypthecodinium cohnii. These are the organisms at the base of the marine food chain that actually synthesise DHA; fish accumulate it by eating them. Crypthecodinium products supply DHA only, while Schizochytrium products supply DHA plus a smaller amount of EPA. Physiologically the oil does nothing that DHA and EPA do not do, so the mechanism sits in the Omega-3 (EPA and DHA) entry. Controlled feeding work found algal-oil capsules and cooked salmon to be nutritionally equivalent sources of DHA in terms of plasma incorporation (PMID 18589030), which is why algal DHA has been the standard source in infant formula for decades.藻油提取自培养的异养微藻,主要是裂殖壶菌属(Schizochytrium)物种和寇氏隐甲藻(Crypthecodinium cohnii)。这些是海洋食物链底端真正合成DHA的生物,鱼类是通过摄食它们而积累DHA。寇氏隐甲藻产品只提供DHA,裂殖壶菌产品则提供DHA外加少量EPA。从生理学角度看,该油脂的作用不超出DHA和EPA本身的作用范围,其机制见Omega-3(EPA和DHA)词条。对照喂养研究发现,就血浆掺入而言,藻油胶囊和熟三文鱼是营养上等效的DHA来源(PMID 18589030),这也是藻源DHA数十年来一直是婴儿配方奶粉标准来源的原因。

There is no deficiency state for this. It is not an essential nutrient, so being short of it is not a thing that can happen.它不存在缺乏状态。它不是必需营养素，所以“缺了它”这件事本身并不成立。

Source来源PMID 18589030 (Arterburn LM et al. J Am Diet Assoc. 2008;108:1204-9)

Food and the body食物与身体
In food: Trace食物中：痕量 Dose from food: Out of reach靠吃达到剂量：达不到 Body makes it: Partly身体自产：部分自产 Food data: Medium食物数据：中

The classification depends entirely on who is eating, so it has to be stated by population. For an omnivore EPA and DHA are RICH in food: one herring fillet supplies 2,873 mg, one tablespoon of caviar 1,046 mg (see the Omega-3 entry). For a strict vegan the answer is TRACE, and that is the population this product exists for: raw laver (nori) has 80 mg EPA per 100 g and zero DHA, which is 2 mg of EPA per standard sheet, and dried spirulina, routinely marketed as a vegan omega-3 food, contains 0.000 g of both EPA and DHA (it does carry 823 mg/100 g of ALA, 58 mg per 7 g tablespoon, which is not the same nutrient). For a lacto-ovo vegetarian the honest answer sits between the two, because eggs supply preformed DHA at 58 mg/100 g, about 29 mg per large 50 g egg, and DHA-enriched eggs several times that. The earlier draft elided vegan and vegetarian and so overstated the case. The production organism is not a food either: Schizochytrium sp. is a single-cell marine microalga cultured in fermenters and authorised in the EU as a novel food.这个分类完全取决于食用者是谁，因此必须按人群分别陈述。对杂食者来说，食物中的 EPA 和 DHA 属于 RICH（丰富）：一片鲱鱼柳提供 2,873 mg，一汤匙鱼子酱 1,046 mg（见欧米伽-3 条目）。对严格素食者（vegan）来说答案是 TRACE（微量），而这类产品正是为这一人群而存在的：生紫菜（nori）每 100 g 含 80 mg EPA，DHA 为零，折合每标准张 2 mg EPA；常被当作纯素欧米伽-3 食品营销的干螺旋藻，EPA 和 DHA 含量均为 0.000 g（它确实含 823 mg/100 g 的 ALA，每 7 g 汤匙 58 mg，这是另一种营养素）。对蛋奶素食者来说，诚实的答案介于两者之间，因为鸡蛋提供预形成的 DHA，含量为 58 mg/100 g，一枚 50 g 大鸡蛋约 29 mg，而 DHA 强化蛋是这个量的数倍。早前的草稿把纯素和素食混为一谈，因而夸大了结论。生产藻种本身也不是食物：Schizochytrium sp. 是在发酵罐中培养的单细胞海洋微藻，在欧盟按新型食品获得批准。

To match the dose要达到该剂量For a strict vegan the gap is unbridgeable for DHA and absurd for EPA. Typical algal oil products sit at 250 mg/day of DHA for general adult use and 450 mg/day for pregnancy and lactation. Matching 250 mg of EPA from nori would take 312 g of raw laver, about 120 sheets a day. Matching any amount of DHA from nori is impossible, since the USDA value is 0.000 g, and spirulina supplies zero of both. No seaweed portion, no fermented food and no oilseed closes this gap, which is why algal oil is one of the few supplements in this reference with a real and unavoidable role. For a lacto-ovo vegetarian eggs get partway and no further: 250 mg of DHA is about nine large eggs a day, so two eggs (58 mg) cover 23% of the target and one covers 12%. DHA-enriched eggs shorten that considerably. For an omnivore the same 250 mg of DHA is one 45 g tin of anchovies (580 mg DHA) or half a tin of sardines.对严格素食者来说，DHA 的差距无法弥合，EPA 的差距则荒谬。典型藻油产品对一般成人为 250 mg/day DHA，孕期和哺乳期为 450 mg/day。用紫菜凑足 250 mg EPA 需要 312 g 生紫菜，约每天 120 张。用紫菜凑任何数量的 DHA 都不可能，因为 USDA 数值为 0.000 g，而螺旋藻两者都是零。没有任何一份海藻、任何发酵食品或任何油料籽能填上这个缺口，这也是藻油成为本参考资料中少数具有真实且不可回避作用的补充剂的原因。对蛋奶素食者，鸡蛋只能补上一段：250 mg DHA 约相当于每天九枚大鸡蛋，因此两枚（58 mg）覆盖目标的 23%，一枚覆盖 12%。DHA 强化蛋能把这个数字大幅缩短。对杂食者，同样的 250 mg DHA 等于一罐 45 g 凤尾鱼（580 mg DHA）或半罐沙丁鱼。

Food vs supplement食物与补充剂The strain determines what you get, and the earlier generalisation was too broad. EFSA's assessment of strain WZU477 specifies DHA at 32.0% of total fatty acids or above, with batches measured at 40.5-46.3%, and EPA at a single value of about 0.56% (EFSA Journal 2020;18(10):6242, DOI 10.2903/j.efsa.2020.6242). That is one strain, and the same opinion explicitly contrasts it with other authorised Schizochytrium strains carrying 1.3-6% EPA. So a DHA-dominant oil from this strain is not an EPA supplement, but 'a product labelled vegan omega-3 may supply almost no EPA' does not follow for the category: check the strain and the declared EPA content. On the positive side, this is one case where the concentrated product is cleaner than the food, because the algae are grown in closed fermenters rather than harvested from the sea, so algal oil avoids the methylmercury of predatory fish and the dioxin and PCB burden that makes fatty fish a leading dietary contributor to European dioxin exposure (EFSA Journal 2018;16(11):5333, document confirmed). The usual oxidation caveat applies, since a highly unsaturated oil in a clear bottle or an old capsule degrades, and a fishy aftertaste is the tell. Do not substitute algae biomass powders (spirulina, chlorella) for algal oil; they are different organisms with no DHA.藻株决定你得到什么，早前的概括过于笼统。EFSA 对 WZU477 藻株的评估规定 DHA 占总脂肪酸 32.0% 及以上，实测批次为 40.5-46.3%，EPA 为约 0.56% 的单一数值（EFSA Journal 2020;18(10):6242, DOI 10.2903/j.efsa.2020.6242）。这只是一个藻株，同一份意见还明确将其与其他获批的 Schizochytrium 藻株（EPA 为 1.3-6%）作了对比。因此，来自该藻株的 DHA 主导型油不能当作 EPA 补充剂，但“标称纯素欧米伽-3 的产品可能几乎不含 EPA”这一推论对整个类别并不成立：请核对藻株和声称的 EPA 含量。从积极面看，这是浓缩产品比食物更洁净的一个例子，因为藻类是在封闭发酵罐中培养的，没有从海里捕捞，所以藻油避开了掠食性鱼类的甲基汞，也避开了使多脂鱼成为欧洲膳食二噁英暴露主要来源的二噁英和 PCB 负荷（EFSA Journal 2018;16(11):5333，文件已确认）。通常的氧化提醒同样适用：高度不饱和的油放在透明瓶中，或存放过久的胶囊，都会降解，鱼腥的余味就是信号。不要用藻类生物量粉（螺旋藻、小球藻）替代藻油，它们是不同的生物，不含 DHA。

Absorption吸收Algal oil DHA is nutritionally equivalent to DHA from fish. A randomised trial comparing algal-oil capsules with cooked salmon found the two equivalent as DHA sources by blood incorporation (Arterburn 2008, PMID 18589030, DOI 10.1016/j.jada.2008.04.020). Absorption follows the same rules as other marine oils, so triglyceride forms behave like natural fish oil and take-with-a-meal advice applies. Some DHA retroconverts to EPA in the body, which partly offsets the low EPA content of DHA-dominant algal oils, though not reliably enough to treat a DHA-only product as an EPA source.藻油 DHA 在营养上与鱼类来源的 DHA 等效。一项将藻油胶囊与熟三文鱼作比较的随机试验发现，按血液掺入衡量，两者作为 DHA 来源等效（Arterburn 2008, PMID 18589030, DOI 10.1016/j.jada.2008.04.020）。吸收遵循与其他海洋油脂相同的规律，甘油三酯形式的表现与天然鱼油一致，随餐服用的建议同样适用。体内有部分 DHA 会逆转化为 EPA，这在一定程度上弥补了 DHA 主导型藻油 EPA 含量低的问题，但可靠性不足以把只含 DHA 的产品当作 EPA 来源。

Food data note食物数据说明The three composition rows are all traced to USDA records and confirmed, including the two zero values that carry the debunking point, and the nori arithmetic (2 mg per sheet, 0.8% of a 250 mg dose, 312 g or about 120 sheets) recomputes exactly. The dose figures are the weak part: the 250 mg/day and 450 mg/day conditions were attributed to an EFSA opinion that contains neither, and the correct source, the Union list of novel foods under Regulation (EU) 2017/2470, was not verified in this pass. The population framing also had to be rebuilt, since the original TRACE label was applied to vegans and vegetarians together中。三行成分数据全部可追溯到 USDA 记录并已确认，包括承载纠错要点的两个零值；紫菜的算术（每张 2 mg，占 250 mg 剂量的 0.8%，312 g 约 120 张）复算完全一致。薄弱之处是剂量数字：250 mg/day 和 450 mg/day 的使用条件被归到一份并不含这两个数值的 EFSA 意见上，而正确来源即 Regulation (EU) 2017/2470 下的新型食品联盟清单，本轮未予核实。人群框架也必须重建，因为原来的 TRACE 标签把纯素者和素食者一并套用了。

Does the body make it身体是否自产Algal oil delivers preformed DHA, and in newer products EPA as well, which is precisely the step human metabolism cannot deliver: the ELOVL2 elongation and second FADS2 desaturation that carry EPA through to DHA are the rate-limiting stretch, yielding 9% conversion in young women and nothing measurable in young men. Plasma and tissue DHA rise dose-dependently with preformed DHA and hardly at all with ALA, so taking DHA directly bypasses the bottleneck instead of duplicating something the body already does well. That makes algal oil a defensible supplement for anyone off oily fish, with plasma DHA approaching a maximum response at about 2 g/d.藻油提供现成 DHA，新一代产品还含 EPA，而这恰好是人体代谢无法完成的那一步：把 EPA 推到 DHA 的 ELOVL2 延长和第二次 FADS2 去饱和是限速段，年轻女性的转化率为 9%，年轻男性测不到。血浆和组织 DHA 随现成 DHA 剂量上升，对 ALA 几乎没有反应，所以直接补 DHA 是绕过瓶颈，并没有重复身体本来就做得好的事情。因此对不吃多脂鱼的人，藻油是站得住的补充剂，血浆 DHA 在约 2 g/d 附近接近最大反应。

Pathway合成通路The endogenous route the product bypasses: ALA → FADS2 (delta-6) → 18:4n-3 → ELOVL5 → 20:4n-3 → FADS1 (delta-5) → EPA → ELOVL5 and ELOVL2 → DPA → ELOVL2 → 24:5n-3 → FADS2 (delta-6) → 24:6n-3 → peroxisomal beta-oxidation → DHA, in hepatocytes. The Sprecher C24 route is the principal and rate-limiting mammalian pathway; a direct delta-4 desaturase activity of the FADS2 product has been demonstrated in human cells, with the in vivo contribution not established.产品绕过的内源途径：在肝细胞内 ALA → FADS2（delta-6）→ 18:4n-3 → ELOVL5 → 20:4n-3 → FADS1（delta-5）→ EPA → ELOVL5 和 ELOVL2 → DPA → ELOVL2 → 24:5n-3 → FADS2（delta-6）→ 24:6n-3 → 过氧化物酶体 beta 氧化 → DHA。Sprecher 的 C24 路线是哺乳动物的主要限速通路；FADS2 产物在人细胞中已被证实具有直接的 delta-4 去饱和酶活性，体内定量贡献尚未确立。

Amount made自产量Endogenous DHA from ALA: 9% net fractional conversion in the plasma tracer pool in young women, undetectable in young men over 21 days; studies using total dietary ALA as the denominator report under 0.1% in controlled-diet tracer studies, and the two numbers answer different questions. Plasma DHA response approaches maximum at a DHA dose of about 2 g/d. Absolute mg/d of endogenous DHA synthesis in adults: NOT ESTABLISHED.由 ALA 生成的内源 DHA：年轻女性血浆示踪池净分数转化 9%，年轻男性 21 天内检测不到；以膳食 ALA 总量作分母的受控膳食示踪研究报告低于 0.1%，两个数字回答的是不同问题。血浆 DHA 反应在约 2 g/d 的 DHA 剂量下接近最大。成人内源 DHA 合成的绝对量（mg/d）：NOT ESTABLISHED（未确立）。

Still matters when仍有意义的情形Justified for vegans and vegetarians, fish allergy or aversion, pregnancy and lactation on plant-based diets, and adult men, whose measured ALA to DHA conversion is effectively zero. This is the clearest case in the omega-3 group where partial synthesis fails to meet requirement, so the supplement is not redundant with anything the body makes. One practical note for DHA-only products: supplemental DHA also raises EPA levels, which recent tracer work attributes to a slower rate of EPA elongation rather than the long-assumed retroconversion.适用于纯素和素食者、鱼类过敏或抗拒鱼类者、采用植物性膳食的妊娠和哺乳期，以及成年男性，后者实测的 ALA 转 DHA 基本为零。这是 omega-3 这组中部分合成最明显无法满足需要量的一例，补充剂与身体自制的任何东西都不重复。对只含 DHA 的产品还有一点实用提醒：补 DHA 同时会提高 EPA 水平，近期示踪研究把这一现象归因于 EPA 延长速率减慢，而长期以来被假定的逆转化并非主因。

PMID 12323085, DOI 10.1079/BJN2002662. Mapped from the recovered entry Algal oil (vegan DHA and EPA), with the men's citation completed from the parallel recovered omega-3 rows.

SSDDFFDDBBXXWheat bran and insoluble fibre supplements for IBS麦麸与不溶性纤维补充剂用于肠易激
Verdict结论Skip it不必买
Evidence证据Grade DD 级
Dose tested已验证剂量10 g/d was the comparator dose in the head-to-head primary care trial. No effective dose exists for IBS.在基层医疗的头对头试验中，对照剂量为 10 克/天。对肠易激不存在有效剂量。
Who适用人群Nobody with irritable bowel syndrome.没有任何肠易激综合征患者适用。
Pros优点
  • As a food it contributes to total dietary fibre intake, and total fibre intake is associated with 15 to 30% reductions in all-cause and cardiovascular mortality.作为食物它计入总膳食纤维摄入，而总纤维摄入与全因和心血管死亡降低 15 至 30% 相关。
Cons缺点
  • It is the clearest case in this document of a refuted product still sold into the exact indication where it failed. Pooled bran trials: relative risk of persistent IBS symptoms 0.90 (0.79-1.03), null. Soluble fibre by contrast gave 0.83 (0.73-0.94), NNT 7.这是本文中最清楚的一个例子：一个已被推翻的产品，仍然被卖进它恰恰失败的那个适应证。合并的麦麸试验：肠易激症状持续的相对风险 0.90（0.79-1.03），阴性。相比之下可溶性纤维为 0.83（0.73-0.94），NNT 7。
  • In the three-arm primary care trial, bran at 10 g/d for 12 weeks did not beat placebo on symptom severity at 3 months (-58 versus -49 points, P=0.61) while psyllium did (-90 points, P=0.03). Bran also had the lowest completion rate of the three arms at 56%.在三臂基层医疗试验中，麦麸 10 克/天服 12 周，在 3 个月时的症状严重度上未超过安慰剂（-58 对 -49 分，P=0.61），而洋车前子做到了（-90 分，P=0.03）。麦麸组的完成率也是三组中最低的，为 56%。
  • Bran is the fibre most consistently reported to WORSEN abdominal pain and distension.麦麸是最常被报告会加重腹痛和腹胀的纤维。
  • Contraindicated with strictures, adhesions or a history of obstruction, and unsuitable in coeliac disease and non-coeliac gluten sensitivity.肠狭窄、粘连或有梗阻史者禁用，乳糜泻和非乳糜泻性麸质敏感者不适用。
What it does, and what happens without it它有什么作用，缺了会怎样

Coarse insoluble fibre that adds stool bulk mechanically; in IBS it often makes symptoms worse.一种粗糙的不溶性纤维,通过机械作用增加粪便体积,在IBS患者中常使症状加重。

No deficiency state exists不存在缺乏状态

In detail详细Wheat bran is the outer layer of the wheat kernel, composed mainly of insoluble arabinoxylan, cellulose and lignin. It acts through particle bulk and mechanical stimulation of the mucosa rather than by forming a gel: coarse particles increase stool mass and provoke secretion and peristalsis, whereas finely ground bran loses this effect and can slow transit. It holds far less water than psyllium and is partly fermented, generating gas. In IBS these properties work against the patient, since mechanical stimulation acts on a hypersensitive gut and bran also carries fructans, making it high-FODMAP. Meta-analysis found no significant benefit of bran for global IBS symptoms (relative risk of not improving 0.90, 95% CI 0.79 to 1.03), in contrast to ispaghula (NNT 7), and the ACG guideline recommends soluble fibre for IBS (PMID 33315591).小麦麸皮是小麦籽粒的外层,主要由不溶性阿拉伯木聚糖、纤维素和木质素组成。它的作用方式是颗粒体积和对黏膜的机械刺激,而不是成胶:粗颗粒能增加粪便质量并促进分泌和蠕动,而磨得很细的麸皮会失去这种效果,甚至可能减慢转运。它保水能力远低于车前子壳,且部分被发酵而产气。在IBS患者中,这些特性反而不利,因为机械刺激作用于本已过度敏感的肠道,而且麸皮还含有果聚糖,属于高FODMAP食物。荟萃分析未发现麸皮对IBS整体症状有显著获益(未改善的相对风险为0.90,95% CI 0.79至1.03),与洋车前子(NNT为7)形成对比,ACG指南推荐IBS患者使用可溶性纤维(PMID 33315591)。

There is no deficiency state for this. It is not an essential nutrient, so being short of it is not a thing that can happen.它不存在缺乏状态。它不是必需营养素，所以“缺了它”这件事本身并不成立。

Am J Gastroenterol. 2021;116:17-44); Quagliani D, Felt-Gunderson P. Food and the body食物与身体
In food: Rich食物中：丰富 Dose from food: Reachable靠吃达到剂量：可达到 Body makes it: Cannot身体自产：不能 Food data: Medium食物数据：中

Wheat bran is a food, sold as a plain milled cereal fraction, and at 42.8 g total dietary fibre per 100 g (USDA FDC 169722) it is one of the most fibre-dense ordinary cereal fractions. The submission's claim that it is among the most fibre-dense foods in any composition table is false and has been removed: corn bran at 79 g/100 g ranks first among roughly 4,000 USDA foods, nearly double wheat bran, and psyllium husk is about 78 g/100 g. RICH is demonstrated for the cereal-bran supplements specifically, which is where food comparators exist: wheat bran, corn bran, rice bran. The other common insoluble-fibre supplement base, powdered or microcrystalline cellulose and methylcellulose, is a manufactured material with no dietary equivalent, so the RICH grade does not extend to it. Availability is not the problem with this product category; the indication is.小麦麸是食物，作为普通研磨谷物分层出售，每 100 g 含总膳食纤维 42.8 g（USDA FDC 169722），属于纤维密度最高的普通谷物分层之一。原稿称它是任何成分表中纤维最密集的食物之一，这一说法不成立，已删除：玉米麸 79 g/100 g 在约 4,000 种 USDA 食物中排第一，接近小麦麸的两倍，洋车前子壳约为 78 g/100 g。RICH 的判定专门适用于谷物麸皮类补充剂，因为只有这一类存在食物对照：小麦麸、玉米麸、米糠。另一类常见的不可溶性纤维补充剂基料，即粉状或微晶纤维素与甲基纤维素，属于人造材料，没有膳食对应物，RICH 等级不延伸到它们。这一产品类别的问题与可得性无关，问题出在适应证上。
