To match the dose要达到该剂量The 10 g/day of bran tested against psyllium and placebo in IBS (PMID 19713235) is about 3 heaped tablespoons of plain wheat bran, which carries 4.28 g of dietary fibre. Matched on fibre, that is about 1 serving of bran flakes, not the 2 the submission claimed: one 29 g serving supplies 4.90 g, so two servings deliver more than double the fibre in the trial dose. A single cup of crude bran (58 g) is 5.8x the trial dose by mass. No supplement is needed to reach it. What the trial found is that reaching it does not help: bran was no better than placebo in months one and two, its month-three advantage did not survive worst-case analysis, and early dropout was highest in the bran arm because IBS symptoms worsened. A review of the wheat bran literature reaches the same conclusion and quotes official guidance that wheat bran should not be recommended to people with IBS (DOI 10.3109/09637486.2012.687366).在 IBS 中与洋车前子和安慰剂对照的 10 g/day 麸皮（PMID 19713235）大约是 3 满汤匙普通小麦麸，含 4.28 g 膳食纤维。按纤维匹配，这相当于约 1 份麸皮薄片，原稿说的 2 份是错的：一份 29 g 提供 4.90 g，两份的纤维量超过试验剂量的两倍。一杯粗麸皮（58 g）按质量计是试验剂量的 5.8 倍。达到这个量不需要任何补充剂。试验的发现是达到了也没用：第一、二个月麸皮不优于安慰剂，第三个月的优势在最差情况分析下不成立，而且麸皮组的早期退出率最高，原因是 IBS 症状加重。一篇小麦麸文献综述得出同样结论，并引用官方指南指出不应向 IBS 患者推荐小麦麸（DOI 10.3109/09637486.2012.687366）。

Food vs supplement食物与补充剂The food is safe and useful; the supplement indication is the problem. Wheat bran is a genuinely effective faecal bulking agent, increasing stool by roughly 5 g per 1 g of bran consumed, at the top of the accepted 3-5.4 g range (DOI 10.3109/09637486.2012.687366), and it is a reasonable food for ordinary constipation and general fibre intake. In IBS it commonly worsens bloating, distension and pain, and it was the arm patients dropped out of. A less obvious caveat: wheat bran carries fructan (white wheat flour measures 0.75 g fructan/100 g, DOI 10.3389/fnut.2024.1446771), so bran-loading also raises FODMAP intake in exactly the patients least able to tolerate it. Insoluble-fibre supplements sold as 'IBS fibre' are marketing the wrong fibre class; the evidence in IBS favours the viscous, poorly fermented kind.食物本身安全且有用，问题在于补充剂的适应证。小麦麸确实是有效的粪便增容剂，每摄入 1 g 麸皮可使粪便增加约 5 g，处于公认 3-5.4 g 区间的上端（DOI 10.3109/09637486.2012.687366），对普通便秘和整体纤维摄入是合理的食物。在 IBS 中它常加重胀气、腹胀和疼痛，患者退出最多的正是这一组。一个不太明显的注意点：小麦麸带有果聚糖（白小麦面粉测得 0.75 g 果聚糖/100 g，DOI 10.3389/fnut.2024.1446771），所以加大麸皮摄入也会在最难耐受的那部分患者身上提高 FODMAP 摄入量。以“IBS 纤维”名义出售的不可溶性纤维补充剂推销的是错误的纤维类别，IBS 的证据支持的是黏性、难发酵的那一类。

Absorption吸收Not absorbed. The mechanism is mechanical bulking plus water-holding by arabinoxylan and cellulose, and the non-starch polysaccharide of the bran is 70% arabinoxylan, 24% cellulose and 6% beta-glucan (Stevenson et al., PMID 22716911, quotation verified). Bran accelerates small bowel transit and increases faecal weight dose-dependently. Particle size matters more than gram total, because coarse bran bulks and irritates while finely milled bran loses much of the effect, so two products with the same fibre label are not interchangeable. Only 1.5-4.0 g per 100 g is soluble, so bran contributes almost nothing to the viscous-gel effects on cholesterol, glycaemia and stool consistency that people often assume fibre delivers.不被吸收。机制是机械增容加上阿拉伯木聚糖与纤维素的持水作用，麸皮的非淀粉多糖组成为 70% 阿拉伯木聚糖、24% 纤维素和 6% β-葡聚糖（beta-glucan）（Stevenson et al., PMID 22716911，引文已核实）。麸皮加快小肠通过速度，并以剂量依赖方式增加粪便重量。颗粒大小比总克数更重要，粗麸皮既增容也造成刺激，细磨麸皮则丧失大部分效果，所以纤维标签相同的两种产品并不能互换。每 100 g 中只有 1.5-4.0 g 是可溶的，所以人们常以为纤维能带来的降胆固醇、控血糖和改善粪便质地的黏胶效应，麸皮几乎没有贡献。

Food data note食物数据说明The core wheat values were confirmed against USDA legacy records (wheat bran 42.8, whole-wheat bread 6.0, whole-grain flour 10.7), as were the Stevenson NSP split and the Bijkerk trial narrative. Weaknesses: the bran flakes FDC ID could not be resolved, the whole-wheat bread slice weight is unconfirmed, and the corn bran, rice bran and all-bran figures come from the verification report's compiled values with conventional rather than sourced portion weights中。小麦相关的核心数值已对照 USDA legacy 记录确认（小麦麸 42.8，全麦面包 6.0，全麦面粉 10.7），Stevenson 的 NSP 组成拆分和 Bijkerk 试验叙述同样已确认。薄弱处：麸皮薄片的 FDC ID 无法确定，全麦面包的每片重量未获确认，玉米麸、米糠和全麸谷物的数字来自核查报告汇编的数值，份量重量为常规值而非取自来源记录。

Does the body make it身体是否自产Insoluble bran is non-digestible by definition, so nothing about it is endogenous and every gram is eaten. Here the axis being silent is no licence, and the trial record has to be reported in full: in the same primary care trial that supported psyllium, 10 g/day bran beat placebo at month 3 in the primary analysis (adequate relief 57 percent versus 32 percent, RR 1.70, 95 percent CI 1.12 to 2.57) but not in the worst-case sensitivity analysis of that same result (RR 1.45, 95 percent CI 0.97 to 2.16), and it reduced symptom severity by only 58 points versus 49 for placebo (P=0.61), with symptoms often worse in the first weeks and the highest dropout of the three arms (completion: psyllium 64 percent, bran 56 percent, placebo 60 percent). Coarse natural fibre is not a reason in itself, and the bran signal is weaker and less stable than psyllium's.不可溶麦麸按定义不可消化, 所以其中没有内源成分, 每一克都靠吃。这里这条轴无话可说并不等于放行, 而试验结果要完整报告: 在支持车前子的同一项基层医疗试验中, 10 g/day 麦麸在第 3 个月的主分析里优于安慰剂 (充分缓解 57% 对 32%, RR 1.70, 95% CI 1.12 至 2.57), 但在同一结果的最差情形敏感性分析中不显著 (RR 1.45, 95% CI 0.97 至 2.16); 症状严重度只下降 58 分, 安慰剂为 49 分 (P=0.61), 头几周症状常加重, 三组中脱落最多 (完成率: 车前子 64%, 麦麸 56%, 安慰剂 60%)。天然粗纤维本身仍不构成理由, 麦麸的信号比车前子更弱也更不稳定。

Pathway合成通路NOT APPLICABLE. Insoluble cellulose, hemicellulose and lignin resist human digestive enzymes; no human synthesis and no human requirement for this specific material.NOT APPLICABLE。不可溶的纤维素, 半纤维素和木质素耐受人体消化酶; 人体不合成它, 对这类具体材料也没有需要量。

Amount made自产量0 (no human biosynthetic pathway)0 (人体没有相应的生物合成途径)

Still matters when仍有意义的情形Nothing on this axis, and the trial evidence for bran in IBS is inconsistent: significant at month 3 in the primary analysis, null in the worst-case analysis, no effect on symptom severity, early worsening and the highest dropout. Insoluble fibre still has a role in ordinary constipation and general diet quality; in IBS, prefer a soluble gel-forming fibre.这条轴上没有理由, 而麦麸在 IBS 中的试验证据不一致: 第 3 个月主分析显著, 最差情形分析为阴性, 对症状严重度无效, 早期加重, 脱落率最高。不可溶纤维在普通便秘和整体膳食质量上仍有作用; 在 IBS 中优先选可溶性成胶纤维。

Who适用人群No identified group. Use a matched single enzyme for a diagnosed deficiency instead.没有确定的适用人群。确诊缺乏某种酶时，应使用对应的单一酶。
Pros优点
  • One 120-participant double-blind placebo-controlled trial of a fungal multi-enzyme blend reported improvement in functional dyspepsia symptom and quality-of-life scores. Single centre, proprietary product, symptom-scale endpoints.一项 120 人的双盲安慰剂对照试验，用真菌来源的复合酶，报告功能性消化不良症状和生活质量评分改善。单中心、专有产品、症状量表终点。
Cons缺点
  • The category is built on a fabricated disease. There is no recognised syndrome of generalised digestive enzyme insufficiency in healthy adults, and clinically meaningful malabsorption does not appear until roughly 90% of exocrine pancreatic function is lost.这个品类建立在一个被制造出来的疾病之上。健康成人不存在公认的“全面消化酶不足”综合征，而要出现有临床意义的吸收不良，需要外分泌胰腺功能损失约 90%。
  • It borrows credibility from prescription pancreatic enzyme replacement, which treats a real, objectively diagnosable condition.它从处方胰酶替代治疗那里借来了可信度，而后者治疗的是一种真实、可客观诊断的疾病。
  • The main harm is diagnostic delay. Self-treating undiagnosed persistent gut symptoms delays diagnosis of coeliac disease, inflammatory bowel disease, pancreatic disease and colorectal cancer.主要危害是延误诊断。自行处理未确诊的持续胃肠症状，会延误乳糜泻、炎症性肠病、胰腺疾病和结直肠癌的诊断。
  • A properly controlled trial in autism (43 children, double-blind crossover) found no clinically significant improvement, in a population where these products were heavily promoted.一项在孤独症人群中设计规范的试验（43 名儿童，双盲交叉）未发现有临床意义的改善，而这些产品曾在该人群中被大力推销。
What it does, and what happens without it它有什么作用，缺了会怎样

Mixed plant and fungal enzymes sold for bloating; prescription pancreatic enzymes are a different product.用于缓解腹胀的混合植物与真菌来源酶,处方级胰酶是不同的产品。

No deficiency state exists不存在缺乏状态

In detail详细These blends typically combine fungal amylase and protease, cellulase, bromelain, papain and sometimes lipase, at doses and in formulations that are not designed to survive gastric acid or to be matched to a meal's fat content. Prescription pancrelipase is a different class of product: enteric-coated, dosed in thousands of lipase units per gram of dietary fat, and regulated in the US as a drug requiring an approved application since 2010. Two components have a defined use in people who need them, lactase for lactose intolerance and alpha-galactosidase for gas from raffinose-family oligosaccharides in legumes; the broad multi-enzyme blends have no established indication in anyone with a normal pancreas, since a healthy gland already secretes roughly ten times the lipase needed. This is a commercial product category rather than a nutrient, so no requirement and no deficiency state applies.这类复合制剂通常混合真菌来源的淀粉酶(amylase)和蛋白酶(protease)、纤维素酶(cellulase)、菠萝蛋白酶(bromelain)、木瓜蛋白酶(papain),有时还含脂肪酶(lipase),其剂量和剂型并非为耐受胃酸或与某一餐脂肪含量相匹配而设计。处方级胰脂酶制剂(pancrelipase)属于不同类别的产品:采用肠溶包衣,按每克膳食脂肪所需的千单位脂肪酶计量,自2010年起在美国被作为需持有批准申请的药品监管。有两种成分在确有需要的人群中有明确用途,即用于乳糖不耐受的乳糖酶(lactase),以及用于缓解豆类中棉子糖家族低聚糖所致胀气的α-半乳糖苷酶(alpha-galactosidase);而广谱多酶复合制剂在胰腺功能正常者中没有确立的适应证,因为健康的胰腺本身分泌的脂肪酶量已是所需量的约十倍。这是一个商业产品类别而非营养素,因此不存在需求,也不适用缺乏状态。

There is no deficiency state for this. It is not an essential nutrient, so being short of it is not a thing that can happen.它不存在缺乏状态。它不是必需营养素，所以“缺了它”这件事本身并不成立。

Food and the body食物与身体
In food: Trace食物中：痕量 Dose from food: Out of reach靠吃达到剂量：达不到 Body makes it: n/a身体自产：不适用 Food data: Low食物数据：低

Reclassified from NOT_FOOD, which was too strong and was contradicted by this entry's own form caveat. The plant proteases do occur in ordinary food: fruit bromelain is present in edible pineapple flesh and juice with real proteolytic activity, which is exactly why fresh pineapple stops gelatin setting and canned does not; papain occurs in unripe papaya flesh as well as in the latex that is the commercial source; and actinidin, a cysteine protease, is present in ordinary edible ripe green kiwifruit, with human data comparing green (actinidin-containing) against gold (actinidin-free) kiwifruit for gastric protein digestion. Ginger (zingibain), fig latex (ficin), malted barley (diastatic amylase) and raw honey (diastase) are further real dietary enzyme sources. What remains genuinely NOT_FOOD is the other half of these blends: the amylase, protease, lipase and lactase components are Aspergillus or yeast fermentation products with no dietary presence. TRACE rather than PARTIAL because the activity in edible flesh is present without any confirmed quantification, and the parts carrying the measured activity are not eaten.原为 NOT_FOOD，判定过重，且与本条自己的剂型注意点自相矛盾，故重新分级。植物蛋白酶确实存在于普通食物中：果实菠萝蛋白酶存在于可食的菠萝果肉和果汁中，具有真实的蛋白水解活性，这正是新鲜菠萝会让明胶无法凝固而罐装菠萝不会的原因；木瓜蛋白酶除存在于作为商业来源的乳汁中，也存在于未熟木瓜的果肉里；猕猴桃蛋白酶（actinidin）是一种半胱氨酸蛋白酶，存在于普通可食的成熟绿肉猕猴桃中，并有人体数据用绿肉（含 actinidin）与金果（不含 actinidin）猕猴桃比较胃内蛋白消化。姜（zingibain）、无花果乳汁（ficin）、麦芽大麦（麦芽淀粉酶）和生蜂蜜（diastase）是另外几种真实的膳食酶来源。真正仍属 NOT_FOOD 的是这些复配产品的另一半：其中的淀粉酶、蛋白酶、脂肪酶和乳糖酶组分是 Aspergillus 或酵母发酵产物，在膳食中不存在。评为 TRACE 而未评 PARTIAL，原因是可食果肉中的活性虽然存在却没有任何经确认的定量，而携带已测活性的部位并不被食用。

Food食物 Per 100 g每 100 克 Portion一份 Per portion每份 Share占比 Source来源
Kiwifruit, green, ripe, raw猕猴桃，绿肉，成熟，生 contains actinidin, a cysteine protease; no per-100 g activity figure was retrieved in this pass 1 fruit (about 75 g), conventional portion1 个（约 75 g），常规份量 proteolytic activity present but unquantified here not expressible against a GDU-standardised bromelain dose; the units and the enzyme differ and no activity value for the flesh was confirmed无法与按 GDU 标准化的菠萝蛋白酶剂量对表；单位不同、酶也不同，且果肉活性值未获确认 Human crossover data in healthy older adults compared green (actinidin-containing) against gold (actinidin-free) kiwifruit with beef meals for gastric protein digestion, with supporting in vitro work at gastric pH, as summarised in the verification report; no specific citation or activity value retrieved here, so the row is qualitative. This is the clearest food route for a swallowed protease and it is why the NOT_FOOD grade was withdrawn.
Pineapple, raw flesh菠萝，生果肉 contains fruit bromelain (pI 4.6, distinct from stem bromelain at pI 9.5); no proteolytic activity value for the eaten flesh was retrieved in this pass 1 cup chunks (about 165 g), conventional portion1 杯块状（约 165 g），常规份量 proteolytic activity present but unquantified here not expressible; the measured GDU/g values in the literature belong to basal stem, peel and core rather than to flesh无法表达；文献中实测的 GDU/g 数值属于茎基部、果皮和果心，不属于果肉 USDA FDC 169124 records the edible fruit but carries no enzyme activity value. Isoform distinction from the bromelain literature (DOI 10.3390/foods13040589). The absence of a flesh activity figure is a sourcing gap here rather than an absence in the literature.

To match the dose要达到该剂量Bromelain supplements are dosed by activity, typically 500-2,000 mg of a preparation standardised to around 2,400 GDU/g, giving roughly 1,200-4,800 GDU per dose. On the activities reported for pineapple by-products, that is equivalent to about 0.41-1.65 g of basal stem or about 1.0-4.1 g of peel, and neither the basal stem nor the peel is eaten (those per-gram activity values are from a genuine, on-topic paper whose individual figures could not be retrieved, so treat them as unconfirmed). Expressed against food you would actually put in your mouth, the dose cannot be matched: the crown has no detectable activity, the core is usually discarded, and no sourced activity figure exists for the ripe flesh. Fresh pineapple and green kiwifruit do deliver active protease into the stomach, so the effect is not zero, but with no confirmed activity value for edible flesh there is no way to express a food equivalent of a GDU dose. For papain the source material is the latex of the unripe fruit, which is irritant and is not food. For the fungal amylase, protease and lipase components there is no food source at all.菠萝蛋白酶补充剂按活性给药，典型为 500-2,000 mg 标准化到约 2,400 GDU/g 的制剂，每次剂量约 1,200-4,800 GDU。按菠萝副产物报告的活性折算，这相当于约 0.41-1.65 g 茎基部或约 1.0-4.1 g 果皮，而茎基部和果皮都不会被吃掉（这些每克活性值出自一篇真实且切题的论文，其中的单项数字无法调取，应视为未确认）。若换成真正会放进嘴里的食物来表达，这个剂量无法匹配：冠芽检测不到活性，果心通常被丢弃，成熟果肉则没有有据可查的活性数据。新鲜菠萝和绿肉猕猴桃确实会把有活性的蛋白酶送进胃里，所以效果不为零，但在缺少可食果肉活性确认值的情况下，没有办法把 GDU 剂量换算成食物当量。木瓜蛋白酶的原料是未熟果实的乳汁，有刺激性，不属于食物。至于真菌来源的淀粉酶、蛋白酶和脂肪酶组分，根本没有食物来源。

Food vs supplement食物与补充剂The whole food is safe and the concentrate is not always. Fresh pineapple and papaya are ordinary fruit; concentrated bromelain has anticoagulant and antiplatelet activity and interacts with warfarin and antiplatelet drugs, and papain and chymopapain are recognised respiratory and contact allergens, which EFSA flags in its allergenicity assessments of the food enzyme (the specific identifier cited in the submission, DOI 10.2903/j.efsa.2026.9950, could not be confirmed; EFSA does publish opinions on papain from papaya latex, so the substance of the point stands while that reference does not). The matrix also destroys the premise: these are proteins, so heat and gastric acid inactivate them. Canned and cooked pineapple has no meaningful proteolytic activity left, which is why canned pineapple does not stop gelatin setting while fresh pineapple does, and any orally swallowed enzyme without enteric protection meets pepsin and pH 2 before reaching the small intestine. The most important caveat is scope: these blends are not equivalent to pancreatic enzyme replacement and must not be substituted for it in diagnosed pancreatic exocrine insufficiency, where the requirement is 40,000-50,000 lipase units per meal in an enteric-coated porcine preparation (PMID 42011215). Nor is the plant-derived lactase in a blend interchangeable with a dose-standardised lactase product.整食是安全的，浓缩物未必。新鲜菠萝和木瓜是普通水果；浓缩菠萝蛋白酶有抗凝和抗血小板活性，与华法林及抗血小板药物存在相互作用，木瓜蛋白酶和木瓜凝乳蛋白酶（chymopapain）是公认的呼吸道和接触性致敏物，EFSA 在对该食品酶的致敏性评估中已提示这一点（原稿引用的具体标识 DOI 10.2903/j.efsa.2026.9950 无法确认；EFSA 确实发布过关于木瓜乳汁来源木瓜蛋白酶的意见，因此论点本身成立，那个引用不成立）。基质本身也推翻了前提：这些是蛋白质，加热和胃酸会使其失活。罐装和加热过的菠萝已没有有意义的蛋白水解活性，这正是罐装菠萝不会阻止明胶凝固而新鲜菠萝会的原因；任何口服吞下且无肠溶保护的酶，在到达小肠之前都会遇到胃蛋白酶和 pH 2。最重要的注意点是适用范围：这些复配产品不等同于胰酶替代治疗，在已确诊的胰腺外分泌不足中绝不能用来替代，那里的要求是每餐 40,000-50,000 单位脂肪酶的肠溶包衣猪源制剂（PMID 42011215）。复配产品中植物来源的乳糖酶也不能与剂量标准化的乳糖酶产品互换。

Absorption吸收Enzymes are not absorbed and do not need to be; they act in the lumen, so what matters is surviving to the right pH and place. Stem bromelain and fruit bromelain differ even in isoelectric point (pI 9.5 against 4.6), which is why extraction pH determines which enzyme you actually get and why 'bromelain' on a label does not identify a single molecule. Activity rather than milligrams is the meaningful unit, and GDU, CDU, FIP and USP units are not interconvertible, so a milligram figure on a bottle says almost nothing about what it will do. Both bromelain and papain are irreversibly denatured by cooking and largely by gastric acid unless enterically protected, so an uncoated capsule and a bowl of fresh pineapple share the same delivery problem.酶不被吸收，也不需要被吸收；它们在肠腔内起作用，所以关键是能否在合适的 pH 和部位存活下来。茎菠萝蛋白酶与果实菠萝蛋白酶连等电点都不同（pI 9.5 对 4.6），这就是提取 pH 决定你实际拿到哪种酶的原因，也是标签上写菠萝蛋白酶并不指向单一分子的原因。有意义的单位是活性。GDU、CDU、FIP 和 USP 单位之间无法互换，所以瓶子上的毫克数几乎说明不了它能做什么。菠萝蛋白酶和木瓜蛋白酶都会因加热而不可逆变性，若无肠溶保护也大多被胃酸破坏，所以无包衣胶囊和一碗新鲜菠萝面对的是同一个递送问题。

Food data note食物数据说明The quantitative core of this entry could not be verified. The pineapple by-product activities (2,909 GDU/g basal stem, 1,179 GDU/g peel, 694 GDU/g core, crown below detection) come from a genuine and on-topic paper (PMID 38397568) whose individual values were not retrieved, and every dose equivalence derives from them. The EFSA papain identifier could not be confirmed. The two food rows are qualitative because no activity figure for edible pineapple flesh or kiwifruit was retrieved. Only the supplement-side arithmetic (1,200-4,800 GDU per dose) and the bromelain isoform biochemistry check out低。本条的定量核心无法核实。菠萝副产物活性（茎基部 2,909 GDU/g，果皮 1,179 GDU/g，果心 694 GDU/g，冠芽低于检出限）出自一篇真实且切题的论文（PMID 38397568），但其中的单项数值未被调取，而所有剂量当量都由它们推导而来。EFSA 木瓜蛋白酶的标识无法确认。两个食物行只能定性，因为没有检索到可食菠萝果肉或猕猴桃的活性数据。只有补充剂一侧的算术（每次剂量 1,200-4,800 GDU）和菠萝蛋白酶同工型的生化特性经得起核对。

Does the body make it身体是否自产This is a product category rather than a defined substance, so the axis label is NA and the split has to be read ingredient by ingredient. The amylase, protease and lipase in these blends duplicate what a working pancreas already secretes in large excess, so for those three the axis reads FULL and the capsule is redundant; the same capsule usually also carries enzyme functions the human gut lumen does not perform, namely fungal alpha-galactosidase for raffinose-family oligosaccharides, fungal cellulase, and the plant proteases bromelain and papain, which read NONE. Humans do make an alpha-galactosidase, the lysosomal alpha-galactosidase A encoded by GLA whose deficiency causes Fabry disease, plus alpha-N-acetylgalactosaminidase (NAGA), and what is missing is a luminal or brush-border alpha-galactosidase, so a blend has no coherent target in a person with a normal pancreas.这是产品类别, 不是一种确定的物质, 所以轴标签为 NA, 拆分要按成分逐项读。复方里的淀粉酶, 蛋白酶和脂肪酶重复了功能正常的胰腺本已大量过剩分泌的东西, 这三者在这条轴上读作 FULL, 胶囊是多余的; 同一个胶囊通常还含人肠腔并不执行的酶功能, 即用于棉子糖族寡糖的真菌 alpha-galactosidase, 真菌纤维素酶, 以及植物蛋白酶菠萝蛋白酶和木瓜蛋白酶, 这些读作 NONE。人确实合成一种 alpha-galactosidase, 即由 GLA 编码的溶酶体 alpha-galactosidase A (其缺陷导致 Fabry 病), 另有 alpha-N-acetylgalactosaminidase (NAGA); 缺的是肠腔或刷状缘的 alpha-galactosidase, 所以对胰腺功能正常的人, 这类复方没有连贯的作用靶点。

Pathway合成通路Pancreatic amylase, proteases and lipase are synthesised in pancreatic acinar cells and secreted into the duodenum, as in the lactase and pancreatic enzyme row. Alpha-galactosidase: humans have the lysosomal GLA enzyme and NAGA but no luminal digestive alpha-galactosidase, and the supplement enzyme is Aspergillus niger derived. Cellulase: fungal, with no human enzyme at all. Bromelain and papain: plant cysteine proteases, absent as such from humans, who nonetheless express papain-family (clan CA) cathepsins.胰淀粉酶, 胰蛋白酶类和胰脂肪酶由胰腺腺泡细胞合成并分泌入十二指肠, 与乳糖酶和胰酶那一行相同。Alpha-galactosidase: 人有溶酶体 GLA 酶和 NAGA, 但没有肠腔消化用的 alpha-galactosidase, 补充剂中的酶来自 Aspergillus niger。纤维素酶: 真菌来源, 人体完全没有对应酶。菠萝蛋白酶和木瓜蛋白酶: 植物半胱氨酸蛋白酶, 人体没有这两种酶本身, 但表达木瓜蛋白酶家族 (clan CA) 的组织蛋白酶。

Amount made自产量Pancreatic lipase output 253.5 +/- 95.5 mg per liquid test meal and 202.9 +/- 96.1 mg per solid test meal in healthy volunteers (PMID 11040182). Do not compare that mass against a capsule's labelled activity units, because they are different quantities; use the specific activities given in the same paper for the conversion (43 to 47 micromol/min/mg for the liquid meal, 12 to 15 micromol/min/mg for the solid meal). For the fungal and plant enzymes in the blend, 0 (no human synthesis).健康志愿者的胰脂肪酶输出为液体试验餐 253.5 +/- 95.5 mg, 固体试验餐 202.9 +/- 96.1 mg (PMID 11040182)。不要把这个质量与胶囊标注的活性单位相比, 两者是不同的量; 用同一篇论文给出的比活性换算 (液体餐 43 至 47 micromol/min/mg, 固体餐 12 至 15 micromol/min/mg)。复方中的真菌酶和植物酶为 0 (人体不合成)。

Still matters when仍有意义的情形Documented exocrine pancreatic insufficiency, where a prescription enteric-coated product dosed from at least 40,000 USP units of lipase per meal (half with snacks, above 120,000 units per meal seldom needed) is the right answer and an unregulated OTC blend is not. Lactase for lactase non-persistence, and fungal alpha-galactosidase for legume-related gas, are separate non-endogenous cases with a real target. For bloating in someone with a normal pancreas, NEVER ON THIS AXIS.有明确诊断的外分泌胰腺功能不足, 正确做法是处方肠溶制剂, 每餐从至少 40,000 USP units 脂肪酶起 (加餐用一半, 每餐超过 120,000 units 很少必要), 不受监管的 OTC 复方不是答案。乳糖酶用于乳糖酶不持续, 真菌 alpha-galactosidase 用于豆类相关胀气, 这是两种另有真实靶点的非内源情形。对胰腺功能正常者的腹胀, NEVER ON THIS AXIS。

Synthesis source合成来源PMID 11040182 (Carriere F, Gastroenterology 2000;119:949-60, including the lipase specific activities used for the unit conversion); PMID 37737818 (Whitcomb DC, AGA guidance on exocrine pancreatic insufficiency). Enum note: the recovered label MIXED was mapped to NA as a blended product category.

Refs.文献 Ullah PMID 37976892; Munasinghe PMID 20204691; de la Iglesia-Garcia PMID 27941156
SSCCFFDDBBXXL-glutamine for gut repairL-谷氨酰胺用于修复肠道
Verdict结论Skip it不必买
Evidence证据Grade CC 级
Dose tested已验证剂量15 g/d as 5 g three times daily for 8 weeks in the only supportive gut trial.唯一一项支持性肠道试验为 15 克/天，即 5 克每日三次、持续 8 周。
Who适用人群Narrowly, post-infectious diarrhoea-predominant IBS with objectively documented increased intestinal permeability.严格来说，仅限感染后腹泻型肠易激且已客观证实肠道通透性增加者。
Pros优点
  • The one supportive trial is genuinely striking: 106 patients, 79.6% versus 5.8% achieved a 50-point reduction in IBS severity score over 8 weeks, with normalisation of intestinal permeability.唯一那项支持性试验的结果确实惊人：106 名患者，8 周内肠易激严重度评分下降 50 分的比例为 79.6% 对 5.8%，且肠道通透性恢复正常。
  • It has a licensed pharmaceutical use in sickle cell disease, where a phase 3 trial reduced median pain crises from 4.0 to 3.0.它在镰状细胞病中有获批的药用，一项三期试验把疼痛危机中位数从 4.0 降到 3.0。
Cons缺点
  • A 14-fold difference in response rate is an effect size almost never seen in functional gastrointestinal disease, and the 5.8% placebo response is far below the 30 to 40% typical of IBS trials. That combination demands scepticism, not enthusiasm. It is a single-centre, unreplicated result.应答率相差 14 倍，这种效应量在功能性胃肠病中几乎从未出现，而 5.8% 的安慰剂应答率远低于肠易激试验典型的 30 至 40%。这两点合在一起要求的是怀疑，不是兴奋。它是一项单中心、未被重复的结果。
  • There is a mortality signal in the critically ill. In the REDOXS trial, high-dose glutamine given to 1,223 critically ill adults with multi-organ failure raised 28-day mortality to 32.4% versus 27.2%, adjusted OR 1.28.在危重患者中存在死亡信号。REDOXS 试验中，对 1223 名多器官功能衰竭的危重成人给予高剂量谷氨酰胺，28 天死亡率升至 32.4%，对照为 27.2%，校正 OR 1.28。
  • Contraindicated in hepatic impairment, cirrhosis and any history of hepatic encephalopathy, because glutamine is metabolised to glutamate and ammonia.肝功能不全、肝硬化和有肝性脑病史者禁用，因为谷氨酰胺会代谢为谷氨酸和氨。
  • It is the chemical anchor of the entire leaky gut supplement economy, and the gap between that market and the evidence is enormous.它是整个“肠漏”补充剂经济的化学支点，而那个市场与证据之间的差距极大。
What it does, and what happens without it它有什么作用，缺了会怎样

An amino acid the body makes itself; a preferred fuel for gut lining and immune cells.一种人体自身可以合成的氨基酸,是肠壁和免疫细胞偏好使用的燃料。

No deficiency state exists不存在缺乏状态

In detail详细Glutamine is the most abundant free amino acid in plasma and skeletal muscle. Muscle synthesises and exports it continuously via glutamine synthetase, so supply is normally set by endogenous production rather than by diet. Enterocytes and rapidly dividing immune cells use it as a preferred respiratory fuel and as the nitrogen donor for purine, pyrimidine and glutathione synthesis, which is the biochemistry behind the gut-repair claim. It is classed as non-essential in health and conditionally essential in severe catabolic states, where muscle export cannot keep pace with consumption. Human trials of oral glutamine for intestinal permeability, IBS and inflammatory bowel disease have been small and inconsistent, and the strongest evidence is in specific clinical contexts rather than in healthy people.谷氨酰胺是血浆和骨骼肌中含量最丰富的游离氨基酸。肌肉通过glutamine synthetase持续合成并输出谷氨酰胺,因此其供给通常由内源性生成决定,而非由饮食决定。肠上皮细胞和快速分裂的免疫细胞将其作为首选的呼吸燃料,并作为嘌呤、嘧啶和谷胱甘肽合成的氮供体,这正是肠道修复说法背后的生化基础。健康状态下它被归为非必需氨基酸,在严重分解代谢状态下(此时肌肉输出跟不上消耗)则为条件必需氨基酸。关于口服谷氨酰胺用于肠道通透性、肠易激综合征和炎症性肠病的人体试验规模小且结果不一致,最强的证据出现在特定临床情境中,而非健康人群中。

There is no deficiency state for this. It is not an essential nutrient, so being short of it is not a thing that can happen.它不存在缺乏状态。它不是必需营养素，所以“缺了它”这件事本身并不成立。

Source来源PMID 11280678 (Oudemans-van Straaten HM et al. Intensive Care Med. 2001;27:84-90); PMID 23594003 (Heyland D et al. N Engl J Med. 2013;368:1489-97)

Food and the body食物与身体
In food: Rich食物中：丰富 Dose from food: Partly靠吃达到剂量：部分 Body makes it: Usually身体自产：通常够 Food data: Medium食物数据：中

Glutamine is one of the most abundant amino acids in ordinary dietary protein, so any protein-containing meal supplies it. One caveat governs every number below: USDA composition tables report 'glutamic acid', which after the acid hydrolysis used in amino acid analysis is the sum of glutamate and glutamine, because glutamine is converted to glutamate during hydrolysis. The figures are therefore the combined Glu plus Gln pool, and the glutamine share of that pool is roughly half in most animal proteins. Treat the values as an upper bound on glutamine content.谷氨酰胺是普通膳食蛋白中含量最高的氨基酸之一，任何含蛋白的一餐都能提供。下面每一个数字都受一条限定条件约束：USDA 成分表报告的是“谷氨酸”，在氨基酸分析所用的酸水解之后，这个值是谷氨酸与谷氨酰胺之和，因为谷氨酰胺在水解过程中被转化为谷氨酸。因此这些数字是 Glu 加 Gln 的合并池，在多数动物蛋白中谷氨酰胺约占该池的一半。请把这些数值当作谷氨酰胺含量的上限。

To match the dose要达到该剂量The trial dose is 5 g three times daily, 15 g/day for 8 weeks, in post-infectious diarrhoea-predominant IBS with increased intestinal permeability (Zhou et al., Gut 2019;68:996-1002, PMID 30108163). On the combined Glu plus Gln figures, 15 g comes from about 50-60 g of vital wheat gluten, about 79-88 g of soy protein isolate, about 183 g of parmesan, about 323 g of cooked chicken breast, about 440 g of cod (about 2.5 fillets), about 450 g of natto (corrected from the submission's 865 g, which was wrong by 1.9x) or roughly 1.1 kg of cooked lentils. Correcting for the fact that only about half that pool is glutamine, matching 15 g of glutamine specifically needs roughly double: about 100-120 g of vital wheat gluten a day, or 600-700 g of cooked chicken breast. The baseline matters more than the ceiling. Glutamine is roughly 4-8% of food protein, so a diet supplying 80-100 g of protein delivers about 4-7 g/day, consistent with the conventional 3-6 g/day estimate. A 15 g/day supplement is therefore a three- to four-fold increase over habitual intake, not the doubling the submission claimed, which makes this a moderate gap rather than a small one. It is still nothing like creatine or NMN, where food cannot get close.试验剂量为每次 5 g、每天三次，即 15 g/day，持续 8 周，用于伴肠道通透性升高的感染后腹泻型 IBS（Zhou et al., Gut 2019;68:996-1002, PMID 30108163）。按 Glu 加 Gln 合并值计算，15 g 来自约 50-60 g 谷朊粉（活性小麦面筋）、约 79-88 g 大豆分离蛋白、约 183 g 帕玛森奶酪、约 323 g 熟鸡胸肉、约 440 g 鳕鱼（约 2.5 片鱼柳）、约 450 g 纳豆（原稿写 865 g，偏差 1.9 倍，已更正），或约 1.1 kg 熟扁豆。考虑到该池中只有约一半是谷氨酰胺，要专门凑够 15 g 谷氨酰胺需要大约翻倍：每天约 100-120 g 谷朊粉，或 600-700 g 熟鸡胸肉。基线比上限更值得关注。谷氨酰胺约占食物蛋白的 4-8%，因此提供 80-100 g 蛋白的饮食可提供约 4-7 g/day，与常规估计的 3-6 g/day 一致。这样看，15 g/day 的补充剂相当于把习惯摄入量提高三到四倍，原稿说的翻倍并不成立，本条的差距因此从很小改判为中等。它仍然完全不同于肌酸或 NMN，那两者靠食物根本接近不了。

Food vs supplement食物与补充剂The difference is in the delivery rather than the amount. The trial gave 5 g of free crystalline L-glutamine three times a day on an empty-stomach schedule, producing a sharp luminal and plasma bolus; dietary glutamine arrives protein-bound, released slowly by digestion, and a large fraction is consumed by the enterocytes themselves on first pass. Whether the clinical effect depends on that bolus pattern has not been tested against a food-protein comparator, so 'just eat more protein' remains plausible and unproven. Two practical points: free glutamine is heat-labile and degrades in aqueous solution, so cooking and storage reduce free glutamine in food while leaving protein-bound glutamine intact; and glutamine supplementation is not risk-free in everyone, since it is a nitrogen donor and high doses warrant caution in hepatic or renal impairment, whereas the same amount arriving as ordinary food protein raises no comparable concern.差别出在递送方式上，与总量无关。试验按空腹方案每天三次给予 5 g 游离结晶 L-谷氨酰胺，在肠腔和血浆中形成陡峭的冲击峰；膳食谷氨酰胺以蛋白结合形式进入，经消化缓慢释放，其中很大一部分在首过时就被肠上皮细胞自身消耗。临床效应是否依赖这种冲击式模式，尚未用食物蛋白作对照来检验，所以“多吃点蛋白就行”这种说法仍然只是合理推测，未被证实。两个实用要点：游离谷氨酰胺不耐热，在水溶液中会降解，因此烹调和储藏会减少食物中的游离谷氨酰胺，蛋白结合的谷氨酰胺不受影响；谷氨酰胺补充并非对所有人都没有风险，它是氮供体，肝功能或肾功能受损者用高剂量需谨慎，而同样的量以普通食物蛋白形式摄入则不引起可比的担忧。

Absorption吸收Absorbed as free amino acid and as di- and tripeptides, then extensively extracted by the small intestinal mucosa on first pass, which is the mechanistic argument for a gut-directed effect and also the reason plasma appearance underestimates delivery to the target tissue. Because USDA reports Glu and Gln as one pooled value, no composition table can give the true glutamine content of a food, and any per-food glutamine figure quoted to two decimal places should be treated with suspicion. In the trial, the measured mechanism was normalisation of an elevated urinary lactulose/mannitol ratio, so the endpoint was permeability rather than amino acid status; a food equivalent would have to reproduce the permeability effect, which has not been shown.以游离氨基酸以及二肽和三肽形式被吸收，随后在首过时被小肠黏膜大量摄取，这既是肠道定向效应的机制论据，也是血浆出现量低估靶组织递送量的原因。由于 USDA 把 Glu 和 Gln 报告为一个合并值，没有任何成分表能给出食物真实的谷氨酰胺含量，凡是精确到小数点后两位的单食物谷氨酰胺数字都应存疑。在该试验中，实测的机制是尿乳果糖/甘露醇比值升高后恢复正常，所以终点是通透性，与氨基酸营养状态无关；食物等效方案必须复现这个通透性效应，而这一点尚未被证明。

Food data note食物数据说明Every USDA per-100 g glutamic acid value and every per-portion calculation in the original list was re-verified and stands. The weaknesses are structural and additive: the Glu plus Gln pooling means no table reports glutamine itself, the two densest rows (vital wheat gluten, soy protein isolate) are calculations from protein content and a literature glutamate fraction rather than direct composition records, and the corrected habitual baseline of 4-7 g/day rests on the conventional 3-6 g/day estimate rather than a measured survey中。原清单中每一个 USDA 每 100 g 谷氨酸值和每一项每份计算都已重新核实并成立。薄弱之处是结构性和新增性的：Glu 加 Gln 合并意味着没有任何表格报告谷氨酰胺本身；密度最高的两行（谷朊粉、大豆分离蛋白）是由蛋白含量与文献谷氨酸占比推算的，并非直接的成分记录；更正后的习惯摄入基线 4-7 g/day 依据的是常规估计 3-6 g/day，而非实测调查。

Does the body make it身体是否自产Glutamine is the most abundant free amino acid in the body, about 20 percent of the free amino acid pool in blood and 40 to 60 percent in muscle and liver, and whole-body endogenous production is 40 to 80 g/day, with skeletal muscle the dominant synthetic site and net exporter to enterocytes and immune cells while lung, liver, brain and adipose also contribute. A healthy adult eating normally is nowhere near short, so a 5 g scoop for leaky gut is a rounding error against the flux already arriving at the gut wall, and leaky gut is not a validated clinical entity in the first place, so the scoop has no defined target. Severe catabolic illness is where this changes, with demand exceeding synthesis and plasma glutamine falling, which is what CONDITIONAL means: self-sufficient in health and insufficient in named states.glutamine 是体内含量最高的游离氨基酸, 约占血中游离氨基酸池的 20%, 在肌肉和肝占 40% 到 60%, 全身内源生成 40 到 80 g/day, 骨骼肌是主要合成部位和净输出者, 向肠上皮细胞和免疫细胞输送, 肺, 肝, 脑和脂肪组织也有贡献。正常进食的健康成人远谈不上缺乏, 为肠漏而吃的 5 g 一勺, 相对已抵达肠壁的通量只是舍入误差, 而肠漏本身也不是经过验证的临床实体, 这一勺没有明确的作用目标。严重分解代谢疾病中情况确实变化, 需求超过合成, 血浆 glutamine 下降, 这就是 CONDITIONAL 的含义: 健康时自给, 在点名的状态下不足。

Pathway合成通路Glutamate plus ammonia gives glutamine via ATP-dependent glutamine synthetase (GLUL), predominantly in skeletal muscle and also in liver, lung, brain and adipose tissue. Muscle holds about 80 percent of body glutamine and releases it to plasma, while enterocytes and lymphocytes consume it via glutaminase (GLS) as fuel and nitrogen donor. Two roles the gut-repair pitch ignores: glutamine is the body's ammonia shuttle, carrying nitrogen from peripheral tissue to the liver for urea synthesis, and to the kidney, where renal glutaminase releases ammonia for acid-base handling.glutamate 加氨在依赖 ATP 的 glutamine synthetase (GLUL) 作用下生成 glutamine, 主要在骨骼肌, 也在肝, 肺, 脑和脂肪组织。肌肉持有全身 glutamine 的约 80% 并向血浆释放; 肠上皮细胞和淋巴细胞通过 glutaminase (GLS) 把它当燃料和氮供体消耗。肠修复宣传忽略了两项功能: glutamine 是体内的氨穿梭载体, 把外周组织的氮送到肝进行尿素合成, 也送到肾, 肾 glutaminase 在此释放氨参与酸碱调节。

Amount made自产量Whole-body endogenous production is 40 to 80 g/day by isotopic and pharmacokinetic estimates, with muscle the dominant site rather than the sole one (PMC6266414, Cruzat V et al., Nutrients 2018;10:1564).根据同位素和药代动力学估算, 全身内源生成 40 到 80 g/day, 肌肉是主要部位, 并非唯一部位 (PMC6266414, Cruzat V et al., Nutrients 2018;10:1564)。

Still matters when仍有意义的情形Burns, major trauma, major surgery, sepsis, short bowel syndrome and long-term parenteral nutrition; sickle cell disease, where oral glutamine has a licensed indication. Dose and route are not neutral: high-dose glutamine given to unselected critically ill patients with multiorgan failure increased mortality in the REDOXS trial (PMID 23594003). For a healthy adult with digestive complaints, the 40 to 80 g/day figure is the reason not to buy it.烧伤, 严重创伤, 大手术, 脓毒症, 短肠综合征和长期肠外营养; 镰状细胞病, 口服 glutamine 在该病有获批适应症。剂量和给药途径并不中性: 在合并多器官功能衰竭的未筛选重症患者中, 高剂量 glutamine 在 REDOXS 试验中增加了死亡率 (PMID 23594003)。对有消化道不适的健康成人来说, 40 到 80 g/day 这个数字就是不必买的理由。

Synthesis source合成来源PMC6266414 (Cruzat V, Macedo Rogero M, Noel Keane K, Curi R, Newsholme P, Nutrients 2018;10:1564); PMID 23594003 (Heyland D et al., REDOXS, N Engl J Med 2013). Recovered entry L-glutamine for gut repair.

Refs.文献 Zhou Gut 2019 PMID 30108163; REDOXS PMID 23594003; Niihara NEJM PMID 30021096
SSCCFFDDBBXXPrebiotics: inulin, FOS, GOS益生元：菊粉、FOS、GOS
Verdict结论Skip it不必买
Evidence证据Grade CC 级
Dose tested已验证剂量5-15 g/d of inulin-type fructans, clustering around 10-12 g/d in constipation trials. Tolerance is the binding constraint above 10-15 g/d.菊粉型果聚糖 5 至 15 克/天，便秘试验多集中在 10 至 12 克/天。超过 10 至 15 克/天后，限制因素是耐受性。
Who适用人群Adults with chronic constipation and habitually low fibre intake who tolerate fermentation.慢性便秘、平时纤维摄入偏低、且能耐受发酵的成人。
Pros优点
  • Inulin does something measurable for constipation: stool frequency SMD 0.69 and Bristol stool consistency SMD 1.07 across 5 trials and 252 subjects.菊粉对便秘确有可测量的作用：5 项试验、252 名受试者中，排便频率 SMD 0.69，Bristol 大便性状 SMD 1.07。
  • It reliably increases faecal bifidobacteria, and it is cheap.它能稳定增加粪便中的双歧杆菌，而且便宜。
  • EFSA has an authorised claim for native chicory inulin at 12 g/d for maintenance of normal defecation, which is more regulatory support than most items here have.EFSA 批准了天然菊苣菊粉在 12 克/天下“维持正常排便”的健康声称，这比本文多数条目获得的监管支持都多。
Cons缺点
  • Feed your good bacteria is the current premium reframing of what used to be sold as roughage, at roughly ten times the price per gram of fibre.“喂养你的好细菌”是把过去当作粗纤维卖的东西重新包装成高端品，而每克纤维的价格约为过去的十倍。
  • The endpoint switch is the specific dishonesty: marketing leans on the reliable rise in faecal bifidobacteria, which is a microbiological measurement, and lets the consumer infer a clinical benefit.具体的不诚实之处在于偷换终点：营销依赖的是粪便双歧杆菌可靠上升这个微生物学指标，却让消费者自行推断出临床获益。
  • The inulin meta-analysis states explicitly that pain and bloating do NOT improve. The largest systematic review of prebiotics in IBS found the data sparse and insufficient to establish efficacy.菊粉的 meta 分析明确写道，疼痛和腹胀并未改善。关于益生元治疗肠易激的最大系统综述认为数据稀少，不足以确立有效性。
  • Self-defeating for IBS patients on or considering a low-FODMAP diet, because inulin, FOS and GOS ARE the fermentable oligosaccharides that diet removes. Anyone whose dominant symptom is bloating or flatulence should not take these.对正在或考虑低 FODMAP 饮食的肠易激患者来说，这么做是自相矛盾的，因为菊粉、FOS 和 GOS 正是那种饮食要去掉的可发酵低聚糖。任何以腹胀或排气为主要症状的人都不应服用。
What it does, and what happens without it它有什么作用，缺了会怎样

Fibres your gut bacteria feed on, boosting bifidobacteria and producing short-chain fatty acids in the colon.肠道细菌的食物来源纤维,可增加双歧杆菌数量,并在结肠中产生短链脂肪酸。

No deficiency state exists不存在缺乏状态

In detail详细Inulin and fructo-oligosaccharides are fructose polymers from chicory root, Jerusalem artichoke, onion, garlic and wheat, differing mainly in chain length: FOS has a degree of polymerisation below about 9, inulin extends to 60. GOS are galactose oligomers produced enzymatically from lactose and are structural analogues of human milk oligosaccharides. All three resist human digestive enzymes, reach the colon intact and are selectively fermented, reproducibly raising Bifidobacterium abundance, which is the basis of the ISAPP definition of a prebiotic as a substrate selectively used by host microorganisms to confer a health benefit (PMID 28611480). Fermentation yields acetate, propionate and butyrate; butyrate is the primary respiratory fuel of the colonocyte, and the short-chain fatty acid pool lowers luminal pH and supports barrier function. That same fermentability produces the gas and bloating these compounds are known for, and is why they are classed as high-FODMAP.菊粉和低聚果糖是来自菊苣根、菊芋、洋葱、大蒜和小麦的果糖聚合物,两者主要区别在于链长:FOS的聚合度低于约9,菊粉可延伸到60。GOS是由乳糖经酶促反应生成的半乳糖寡糖,是人乳低聚糖的结构类似物。这三者都能抵抗人体消化酶,完整到达结肠并被选择性发酵,可重复性地提高双歧杆菌丰度,这也是ISAPP将益生元定义为被宿主微生物选择性利用、能带来健康益处的底物这一定义的依据(PMID 28611480)。发酵产生乙酸、丙酸和丁酸,丁酸是结肠上皮细胞的主要呼吸燃料,短链脂肪酸池能降低肠腔pH并支持屏障功能。正是这种可发酵性也造成了这些化合物以产气和腹胀著称,因而被归为高FODMAP食物。

There is no deficiency state for this. It is not an essential nutrient, so being short of it is not a thing that can happen.它不存在缺乏状态。它不是必需营养素，所以“缺了它”这件事本身并不成立。

Source来源PMID 28611480 (Gibson GR et al. ISAPP consensus statement on prebiotics. Nat Rev Gastroenterol Hepatol. 2017;14:491-502); PMID 27863247 (Desai MS et al. Cell. 2016;167:1339-53)

Food and the body食物与身体
In food: Rich食物中：丰富 Dose from food: Partly靠吃达到剂量：部分 Body makes it: Cannot身体自产：不能 Food data: Medium食物数据：中

This item bundles three substances with two different answers. Inulin and fructo-oligosaccharide (FOS) are RICH: chicory root at 15-20 g per 100 g fresh weight, Jerusalem artichoke at roughly 8-22 g, garlic at about 9-16 g, onion at about 2 g, with smaller amounts in globe artichoke, shallot, salsify, leek, asparagus, banana, wheat and rye. Beta-galacto-oligosaccharide (GOS) is SYNTHETIC and should not be carried under the same heading: the beta-GOS used in trials is manufactured enzymatically by transgalactosylation of lactose and has no meaningful presence in ordinary food. The galacto-oligosaccharides that do occur in legumes are alpha-galactosides (raffinose, stachyose, verbascose), a chemically different family with different bacterial targets. Habitual dietary intake of the fructan class is low: mean 1.6-1.7 g/day in a Slovenian survey (DOI 10.3389/fnut.2024.1446771) and median inulin 1.3 g/day in UK schoolchildren (PMID 40808333).本条把三种物质打包在一起，而答案有两种。菊粉和低聚果糖（FOS）为 RICH：菊苣根按鲜重 15-20 g/100 g，洋姜约 8-22 g，蒜约 9-16 g，洋葱约 2 g，朝鲜蓟、红葱头、婆罗门参（salsify）、韭葱、芦笋、香蕉、小麦和黑麦中含量较少。β-低聚半乳糖（GOS）属于 SYNTHETIC，不应归在同一标题下：试验所用的 beta-GOS 由乳糖经酶法转半乳糖苷化制造，在普通食物中没有实质存在。豆类中确实存在的半乳寡糖是 α-半乳糖苷（棉子糖、水苏糖、毛蕊花糖），化学上属于另一族，作用的细菌靶标也不同。果聚糖这一类的习惯膳食摄入量偏低：斯洛文尼亚一项调查的均值为 1.6-1.7 g/day（DOI 10.3389/fnut.2024.1446771），英国学龄儿童菊粉摄入中位数为 1.3 g/day（PMID 40808333）。

Rows tagged unconfirmed carry a figure the checking pass could not trace back to its cited source. Hover the tag for the reason.标记未核实的行，其数值在核查中无法追溯到所引来源。把鼠标移到标记上可看原因。

To match the dose要达到该剂量For inulin and FOS the answer depends on which food. A 5 g/day dose is reachable from about 250 g of raw onion (two to three medium onions), about 10-19 cloves of garlic on the corrected 9-16 g/100 g range (the submission's 30 cloves was wrong by roughly 3x and contradicted its own food row), about 23-63 g of Jerusalem artichoke, or about 30 g of salsify on an unconfirmed figure. It is out of reach from banana (about 4.5 kg), leek (about 2.1 kg) and asparagus (roughly 1-5 kg, the range reflecting a fivefold uncertainty in the fresh-weight figure; the submission's flat 5 kg used the low end only). The tolerance ceiling is the more useful number than the dose: up to 10 g/day of native inulin and up to 5 g/day of oligofructose were well tolerated in a randomised crossover trial, while 10 g of oligofructose substantially increased symptoms, chiefly flatulence then bloating (Bonnema et al., PMID 20497775). One 150 g cup of Jerusalem artichoke delivers roughly 12-33 g of inulin, so between one and three times the tolerated daily ceiling in a single sitting. For GOS the answer is a flat no: the beta-GOS doses used in trials are made industrially and no ordinary food supplies them.对菊粉和 FOS 来说，答案取决于选哪种食物。5 g/day 的剂量可以由约 250 g 生洋葱（两到三个中等大小洋葱）、按更正后的 9-16 g/100 g 范围计约 10-19 瓣蒜（原稿的 30 瓣偏差约 3 倍，并与其自己的食物行自相矛盾）、约 23-63 g 洋姜，或按一个未确认数值计约 30 g 婆罗门参达到。靠香蕉（约 4.5 kg）、韭葱（约 2.1 kg）和芦笋（约 1-5 kg，区间反映鲜重数值存在五倍不确定性；原稿写死 5 kg，只用了低端值）则达不到。比剂量更有用的数字是耐受上限：一项随机交叉试验中，天然菊粉每天最多 10 g、低聚果糖每天最多 5 g 耐受良好，而 10 g 低聚果糖显著加重症状，主要是排气，其次是腹胀（Bonnema et al., PMID 20497775）。一杯 150 g 洋姜提供约 12-33 g 菊粉，一顿就相当于每日耐受上限的一到三倍。对 GOS 的答案是明确的否：试验所用的 beta-GOS 剂量由工业制造，没有任何普通食物能提供。

Food vs supplement食物与补充剂Chicory root is the classic textbook answer and a poor recommendation: it is the industrial source of inulin and is roasted as a coffee substitute rather than eaten as a vegetable, so its 15-20 g/100 g headline is not a dietary route. Dandelion greens, which are eaten as a vegetable, and burdock root and yacon are recognised high-inulin foods that answer that objection, though no confirmed figures for them were available here. Chicory also illustrates why fibre tables and fructan assays disagree, since USDA lists chicory root at only 1.5 g total dietary fibre per 100 g (FDC 169993). Purified inulin and oligofructose are safe as food ingredients, and concentration is what causes symptoms: the same molecule that is unremarkable spread across a day's vegetables provokes flatulence and bloating as a single 10 g bolus (PMID 20497775). Briet et al. (PMID 7588500) reported a symptom ladder for FOS (excess flatus above 30 g/day, borborygmi and bloating above 40 g, cramps and diarrhoea at 50 g, with no tolerance developing on chronic dosing); the citation is correct and on topic, but those specific thresholds could not be retrieved from the full text and are unconfirmed. The reverse caveat matters clinically: the 'eat more prebiotic vegetables' list (onion, garlic, leek, globe artichoke, Jerusalem artichoke, wheat, rye) is precisely the list a low-FODMAP diet removes, so in IBS the food route and the supplement route can both make things worse. Finally, do not treat legume alpha-GOS as a food form of supplemental beta-GOS; the reported contents in Phaseolus vulgaris (raffinose 0.8-7.4 mg/g, stachyose 20.0-30.9 mg/g, verbascose 0.3-1.3 mg/g, DOI 10.3390/foods15020391) come from a genuine and on-topic paper whose individual values could not be confirmed, and they are different molecules with a flatulence profile of their own.菊苣根是教科书式的经典答案，也是个糟糕的推荐：它是菊粉的工业来源，通常烘烤后当咖啡替代品，并不作蔬菜食用，因此 15-20 g/100 g 这个亮眼数字不构成膳食途径。作为蔬菜食用的蒲公英叶，以及牛蒡根和雪莲果，是公认的高菊粉食物，可以回应这一质疑，但此处没有它们的可确认数据。菊苣还说明了纤维表与果聚糖测定为何会互相矛盾：USDA 把菊苣根列为每 100 g 仅 1.5 g 总膳食纤维（FDC 169993）。纯化菊粉和低聚果糖作为食品配料是安全的，引起症状的是浓度：同一种分子分散在一天的蔬菜里毫不起眼，一次性 10 g 冲击剂量却会引发排气和腹胀（PMID 20497775）。Briet et al.（PMID 7588500）报告了 FOS 的症状阶梯（每天超过 30 g 出现排气过多，超过 40 g 出现肠鸣和腹胀，50 g 时出现痉挛和腹泻，长期给药不产生耐受）；该引文本身正确且切题，但这些具体阈值无法从全文中调取，属未确认。反向的注意点具有临床意义：多吃益生元蔬菜的清单（洋葱、蒜、韭葱、朝鲜蓟、洋姜、小麦、黑麦）正是低 FODMAP 饮食要剔除的清单，所以在 IBS 中，食物途径和补充剂途径都有可能让情况变糟。最后，不要把豆类的 α-GOS 当作补充剂 beta-GOS 的食物形式；已报道的 Phaseolus vulgaris 含量（棉子糖 0.8-7.4 mg/g，水苏糖 20.0-30.9 mg/g，毛蕊花糖 0.3-1.3 mg/g，DOI 10.3390/foods15020391）出自一篇真实且切题的论文，但其中的单项数值无法确认，而且它们是不同的分子，有自己的产气特征。

Absorption吸收Fructans are not absorbed at all, so the variable is where and how fast they ferment, and chain length decides that. Oligofructose (DP 2-8) ferments proximally and quickly, which is why its tolerated dose was half that of long-chain native inulin in the same trial, 5 g against 10 g (PMID 20497775). Assay and plant part also drive the numbers: onion measured 1.97 g/100 g and leek 0.24 g/100 g by AOAC 999.03 in one national survey (DOI 10.3389/fnut.2024.1446771), while an Australian survey using the Megazyme assay reported 1.2-17.4 g/100 g across high-fructan alliums including leek bulb (PMID 17625872). Storage matters too, since fructan is depolymerised during onion storage. Single figures should be read as indicative rather than exact. GOS is fermented similarly but is a distinct substrate: beta-GOS and legume alpha-galactosides are not interchangeable.果聚糖完全不被吸收，因此变量是在哪里发酵、发酵有多快，而这由链长决定。低聚果糖（DP 2-8）在近端快速发酵，这是它在同一试验中耐受剂量只有长链天然菊粉一半的原因，5 g 对 10 g（PMID 20497775）。测定方法和植物部位同样左右数字：某国家级调查用 AOAC 999.03 测得洋葱 1.97 g/100 g、韭葱 0.24 g/100 g（DOI 10.3389/fnut.2024.1446771），而澳大利亚一项使用 Megazyme 测定法的调查报告，包括韭葱鳞茎在内的高果聚糖葱属食物为 1.2-17.4 g/100 g（PMID 17625872）。储藏也有影响，洋葱储藏期间果聚糖会解聚。单一数字应当读作指示性数值，而非精确值。GOS 的发酵方式类似，但它是另一种底物：beta-GOS 与豆类 α-半乳糖苷不能互换。

Food data note食物数据说明The Ferjancic fructan values (onion, leek, banana, bread, flour) and the Bonnema tolerance thresholds were verified verbatim, and the chicory contrast between 15-20 g inulin and a 1.5 g USDA fibre record holds. Against that: the garlic figure was a source misreading now corrected to a wide 9-16 g/100 g range, Jerusalem artichoke spans 8-22 g/100 g, the asparagus fresh-weight value is uncertain by fivefold, the Briet symptom ladder and the Phaseolus oligosaccharide values could not be confirmed, and the three added foods (salsify, globe artichoke, shallot) rest on group-level ranges rather than food-specific measurements中。Ferjancic 的果聚糖数值（洋葱、韭葱、香蕉、面包、面粉）和 Bonnema 的耐受阈值已逐字核实，菊苣 15-20 g 菊粉与 USDA 1.5 g 纤维记录之间的反差也成立。另一面：蒜的数字原为来源误读，现更正为较宽的 9-16 g/100 g 范围；洋姜跨 8-22 g/100 g；芦笋鲜重值存在五倍不确定性；Briet 的症状阶梯和 Phaseolus 寡糖数值无法确认；新增的三种食物（婆罗门参、朝鲜蓟、红葱头）依据的是类别层面的范围，而非单一食物的实测值。

Does the body make it身体是否自产Inulin and fructo-oligosaccharides are beta(2->1) fructans, and commercial galacto-oligosaccharides are galactose oligomers of DP2 to DP6 usually carrying a terminal glucose, produced by beta-galactosidase transgalactosylation of lactose. The 2017 ISAPP consensus defines a prebiotic as a substrate selectively utilized by host microorganisms conferring a health benefit, and imposes no non-digestibility requirement, so the operative criteria are selective utilisation plus a demonstrated benefit; non-digestibility remains a practical property of the common fructans and of GOS at DP3 and above, which is why they reach the colon to be fermented. Nothing here is endogenous, so the real question is dose tolerance, because the fermentation that produces the benefit also produces gas.菊粉和低聚果糖是 beta(2->1) 果聚糖, 商品化的低聚半乳糖是 DP2 至 DP6 的半乳糖寡聚物, 末端通常带一个葡萄糖, 由 beta-galactosidase 对乳糖进行转半乳糖基化制得。2017 年 ISAPP 共识把益生元定义为被宿主微生物选择性利用并带来健康益处的底物, 并未要求不可消化, 所以实际判据是选择性利用加上已证实的健康益处; 不可消化性仍然是常见果聚糖和 DP3 及以上 GOS 的实际性质, 也是它们能到结肠被发酵的原因。这里没有内源成分, 所以真正的问题是剂量耐受性, 因为产生益处的发酵同时产生气体。

Pathway合成通路NOT APPLICABLE, with a degree-of-polymerisation caveat. Humans lack inulinase and beta-fructofuranosidase, and 96 +/- 25 percent of FOS with DP>=2 is recovered intact at the distal ileum. GOS at DP3 to DP6 also passes unchanged, but most GOS DP2 is hydrolysed by host brush-border enzymes in a linkage-dependent way, roughly 77 to 81 percent for beta(1<->1), beta(1->2) and beta(1->3) and roughly 32 to 56 percent for beta(1->4) and beta(1->6).NOT APPLICABLE, 但要按聚合度加限定。人缺 inulinase 和 beta-fructofuranosidase, DP>=2 的 FOS 有 96 +/- 25% 在远端回肠被完整回收。DP3 至 DP6 的 GOS 也原样通过, 但大部分 DP2 的 GOS 被宿主刷状缘酶按键型差异水解, beta(1<->1), beta(1->2) 和 beta(1->3) 约 77% 至 81%, beta(1->4) 和 beta(1->6) 约 32% 至 56%。

Amount made自产量0 (no human biosynthetic pathway; intake is the only variable). Note that the ISAPP 2017 definition imposes no non-digestibility requirement, so the axis argument here rests on the measured ileal recovery figures rather than on the definition itself.0 (人体没有生物合成途径; 摄入量是唯一变量)。注意 ISAPP 2017 定义并未要求不可消化, 所以这条轴上的论证依据是实测的回肠回收率, 而非定义本身。

Still matters when仍有意义的情形All intake is dietary, so dose is the lever. Reasonable where the aim is to shift colonic fermentation, discounting the GOS DP2 fraction as host-digested, with the caveat that fermentable oligosaccharides are the F in FODMAP and often provoke bloating and pain in IBS at the doses used in studies.全部摄入来自膳食, 所以剂量是杠杆。若目标是改变结肠发酵, 使用是合理的, 计算时要把被宿主消化的 GOS DP2 部分扣掉; 需注意可发酵寡糖正是 FODMAP 里的 F, 在研究所用剂量下常在 IBS 中引起腹胀和腹痛。

Synthesis source合成来源PMID 28611480 (Gibson GR, Nat Rev Gastroenterol Hepatol 2017;14:491-502, ISAPP consensus statement on the definition and scope of prebiotics); PMC11440495 (GOS digestibility by linkage and degree of polymerisation)

Refs.文献 Ford PMID 30294792; Collado Yurrita PMID 25208775; Reynolds Lancet 2019 PMID 30638909
SSCCFFDDBBXXSaffron, SAMe and other mood botanicals藏红花、SAMe 及其他情绪类植物制剂
Verdict结论Skip it不必买
Evidence证据Grade CC 级
Dose tested已验证剂量Saffron 30 mg/d of standardised extract. SAMe 1,600-3,200 mg/d as an adjunct.藏红花：标准化提取物 30 毫克/天。SAMe：1600 至 3200 毫克/天作为辅助用药。
Who适用人群At most, adults with mild to moderate depression taking no serotonergic medication, and only with a clinician involved.最多适用于轻中度抑郁、未服用任何 5-羟色胺能药物的成人，且必须有临床医生参与。
Pros优点
  • Saffron: 21 randomised trials found Beck Depression Inventory -4.86 (-6.58 to -3.14) and Beck Anxiety Inventory -5.29.藏红花：21 项随机试验显示 Beck 抑郁量表 -4.86（-6.58 至 -3.14），Beck 焦虑量表 -5.29。
  • SAMe: one 2024 meta-analysis of 23 trials and 2,183 participants found monotherapy better than placebo, SMD -0.58 (-0.93 to -0.23), at moderate certainty.SAMe：2024 年一项纳入 23 项试验、2183 名受试者的 meta 分析发现单药优于安慰剂，SMD -0.58（-0.93 至 -0.23），确定性中等。
Cons缺点
  • Saffron effect sizes are implausibly large for the trial size. One meta-analysis reported SMD -1.22 versus placebo, which is better than licensed antidepressants achieve. Effect sizes that large in small short trials usually indicate small-study effects and a narrow research base, so treat it as a red flag rather than a selling point.藏红花的效应量相对试验规模大得不合常理。一项 meta 分析报告相对安慰剂 SMD 为 -1.22，好过获批抗抑郁药能达到的水平。小样本短周期试验出现这么大的效应量，通常说明存在小研究效应和研究基础狭窄，因此应视为警示信号而非卖点。
  • Self-report instruments move while clinician-rated instruments do not, which is the classic pattern of an unblinded expectancy effect.自评量表在动，而临床医生评定的量表不动，这正是未盲化预期效应的典型形态。
  • SAMe has directly conflicting meta-analyses published in the same year. A second 2024 analysis of 14 trials and 1,522 participants found NO significant difference versus placebo, versus imipramine or versus escitalopram. Report both.SAMe 在同一年有两篇结论直接冲突的 meta 分析。2024 年另一项涵盖 14 项试验、1522 名受试者的分析发现，相对安慰剂、丙咪嗪和艾司西酞普兰均无显著差异。两篇都要报告。
  • SAMe is associated with switching into mania or hypomania in bipolar disorder, and homocysteine can rise on it. Both saffron and SAMe carry serotonin syndrome risk with serotonergic medication. Saffron should be avoided in pregnancy on the basis of traditional emmenagogue use.SAMe 在双相障碍中与转为躁狂或轻躁狂有关，服用期间同型半胱氨酸可能升高。藏红花和 SAMe 与 5-羟色胺能药物合用都有 5-羟色胺综合征风险。基于传统上的通经用途，藏红花在妊娠期应当避免。
  • Depression is a condition where delaying effective treatment carries real risk. Neither of these should displace a clinical assessment.抑郁是一种延误有效治疗会带来真实风险的疾病。这两样都不应取代临床评估。
What it does, and what happens without it它有什么作用，缺了会怎样

Mood supplements of different chemistry; none is a nutrient the body must obtain.化学性质各不相同的情绪类补充剂,均非人体必须获取的营养素。

No deficiency state exists不存在缺乏状态

In detail详细Saffron supplies crocin, crocetin and safranal from Crocus sativus stigmas, and trials of about 30 mg/day over 6 to 8 weeks report antidepressant effects, though most are small, brief and concentrated in a narrow set of centres, which limits confidence. SAMe is chemically different in kind: the body synthesises it from methionine and ATP through methionine adenosyltransferase, and it serves as the universal methyl donor for DNA, phospholipid, catecholamine and creatine methylation. A Cochrane review of 8 trials and 934 participants found no clear difference between SAMe and imipramine or escitalopram used alone, and only low-quality evidence favouring SAMe added to an SSRI. Neither category is an essential nutrient: saffron constituents are plant secondary metabolites, and SAMe is made endogenously, with low tissue SAMe appearing only as a downstream consequence of folate or vitamin B12 deficiency or of the inborn error MAT1A deficiency.藏红花(Crocus sativus)柱头提供藏红花素(crocin)、藏红花酸(crocetin)和藏红花醛(safranal),每日约30 mg、持续6至8周的试验报告显示有抗抑郁效果,但多数研究规模小、时程短且集中在少数几个中心,这限制了结果的可信度。SAMe在化学性质上完全不同:人体通过甲硫氨酸腺苷转移酶(methionine adenosyltransferase)由甲硫氨酸和ATP合成SAMe,它是DNA、磷脂、儿茶酚胺和肌酸甲基化反应的通用甲基供体。一项纳入8项试验、934名受试者的Cochrane系统评价发现,单独使用时SAMe与丙咪嗪(imipramine)或艾司西酞普兰(escitalopram)之间没有明显差异,而SAMe加用于SSRI类药物的证据质量较低,仅有限地支持其有效。这两类都不是必需营养素:藏红花成分是植物次生代谢物,而SAMe由人体内源合成,组织内SAMe水平偏低只是叶酸或维生素B12缺乏、或先天性代谢缺陷MAT1A基因缺乏的下游后果。

There is no deficiency state for this. It is not an essential nutrient, so being short of it is not a thing that can happen.它不存在缺乏状态。它不是必需营养素，所以“缺了它”这件事本身并不成立。

Source来源PMID 25384672 (Lopresti & Drummond, Hum Psychopharmacol 2014;29:517-527, saffron for depression systematic review); DOI 10.1002/14651858.CD011286.pub2 (Galizia et al., Cochrane Database Syst Rev 2016, SAMe for depression in adults)

Food and the body食物与身体
In food: Rich食物中：丰富 Dose from food: Reachable靠吃达到剂量：可达到 Body makes it: Partly身体自产：部分自产 Food data: Medium食物数据：中

This item bundles three different answers, so each gets its own sentence. Saffron is RICH: it is a supermarket spice with USDA composition and portion entries, its clinical dose is a cooking quantity, and it is listed under foods below, which is why the previous NOT_FOOD label on the group was the clearest error in the submission. SAMe has no dietary source: there is no meaningful preformed SAMe in food and no composition-table entry, the body synthesises it continuously from methionine and ATP by methionine adenosyltransferase, and the commercial material is made by Saccharomyces cerevisiae fermentation and stabilised as the tosylate disulfate or 1,4-butanedisulfonate salt, so it is biosynthetic in origin and the SYNTHETIC label holds in the sense of 'no dietary source' rather than 'chemically synthesised'. St John's wort aerial parts, rhodiola root, ashwagandha root and Griffonia simplicifolia seed (the source of 5-HTP) are NOT_FOOD: nobody eats them in any normal diet, they have no composition-table entry, and they have no portion size.这一条打包了三个不同的答案，各自单独说明。藏红花属于 RICH：它是超市里的香料，有 USDA 成分和分量条目，其临床剂量就是一个烹饪用量，并已列入下方的食物行，这也是原提交把整组标为 NOT_FOOD 成为最明显错误的原因。SAMe 没有膳食来源：食物中没有有意义的预成型 SAMe，也没有成分表条目，人体通过甲硫氨酸腺苷转移酶由甲硫氨酸和 ATP 持续合成，商品原料由酿酒酵母（Saccharomyces cerevisiae）发酵制成，并以对甲苯磺酸二硫酸盐或 1,4-丁二磺酸盐形式稳定，所以它在来源上属于生物合成，SYNTHETIC 这个标签成立的含义是没有膳食来源，它并不表示化学合成。贯叶连翘地上部分、红景天根、南非醉茄（ashwagandha）根和 Griffonia simplicifolia 种子（5-HTP 的来源）属于 NOT_FOOD：正常饮食中没有人吃它们，它们没有成分表条目，也没有分量大小。

Saffron, dried stigmas (Crocus sativus)藏红花干柱头（Crocus sativus） 100 g of saffron is 3,333 clinical doses of 30 mg. No apocarotenoid percentage is stated here: the previously cited '8% of dry weight' for crocins, picrocrocin, safranal and crocetin combined and the 'roughly 3.4 mg of crocins per 30 mg dose' could not be confirmed against any source reached, and they contradict each other, since 3.4 mg in 30 mg is 11.3% crocins alone, above the claimed 8% ceiling for all apocarotenoids 1 teaspoon (0.7 g)1 茶匙（0.7 g） 700 mg of saffron, 23 times the 30 mg dose used in depression RCTs 2,300% of a 30 mg trial dose相当于 30 mg 试验剂量的 2,300% USDA portion weights for Spices, saffron (1 tbsp = 2.1 g, so 1 tsp = 0.7 g) independently confirmed; the FDC ID 170934 previously cited could not be confirmed against a live lookup. Saffron, culinary pinch as used to season a dish藏红花，烹饪中为一道菜调味用的一小撮 as above a generous pinch, about 0.1 g, seasoning a dish for four (roughly 50 threads at published thread weights near 2 mg; the commonly quoted 20 to 30 threads per 0.1 g would imply a heavier 3 to 5 mg thread). For reference the FDA reference amount customarily consumed for saffron is 0.125 g满满一小撮，约 0.1 g，为四人份的一道菜调味（按已发表的每根约 2 mg 计约 50 根；常被引用的每 0.1 g 有 20 至 30 根则意味着每根更重，为 3 至 5 mg）。作为参照，FDA 为藏红花设定的习惯消费参考量为 0.125 g about 25 mg of saffron per person from a dish for four; 125 mg for a single 0.125 g reference serving 83% of the 30 mg trial dose per serving of the dish; over 400% for one 0.125 g reference serving该菜每份相当于 30 mg 试验剂量的 83%；按 0.125 g 一份参考量计则超过 400% USDA portion and reference-serving figures for Spices, saffron (portion weights confirmed, FDC ID unconfirmed); trial dose PMID 15852492 (placebo-controlled)

To match the dose要达到该剂量For saffron the gap is zero or negative, which is the most useful finding in the set: the 30 mg/day used in the depression RCTs is about 15 threads at published thread weights near 2 mg, or about 6 to 9 threads if a thread weighs the 3 to 5 mg implied by the commonly quoted 20 to 30 threads per 0.1 g, which is under a generous culinary pinch, and one teaspoon of saffron in a paella is over twenty doses. The barrier is cost rather than physiology. For SAMe there is nothing to compute, because there is no food source: trials use 400 to 1,600 mg/day of a manufactured molecule, while the body's own SAMe turnover (on the order of grams per day) is fed by roughly 1 g/day of dietary methionine from protein foods, which is a different intervention from swallowing SAMe. For the remaining botanicals (St John's wort typically 300 mg three times daily of a 0.3% hypericin extract, rhodiola 200 to 600 mg, ashwagandha 300 to 600 mg root extract, 5-HTP 100 to 300 mg) the food gap is undefined because the source plants are not foods at any quantity.藏红花的差距为零甚至为负，这是本组中最有用的发现：抑郁症 RCT 使用的每天 30 mg，按已发表的每根柱头约 2 mg 计约为 15 根；若按常被引用的每 0.1 g 有 20 至 30 根（即每根 3 至 5 mg）推算，则约为 6 至 9 根，都不到烹饪中一小撮的量，而西班牙海鲜饭里放一茶匙藏红花就超过二十个剂量。障碍在于成本，与生理无关。SAMe 无从计算，因为它没有食物来源：试验使用每天 400 至 1,600 mg 的人工制造分子，而人体自身的 SAMe 周转（每天以克计）靠蛋白质食物提供的每天约 1 g 膳食甲硫氨酸来支撑，这与直接口服 SAMe 属于两种不同的干预。至于其余植物制剂（贯叶连翘通常为 0.3% 金丝桃素提取物每次 300 mg、每天三次，红景天 200 至 600 mg，南非醉茄根提取物 300 至 600 mg，5-HTP 100 至 300 mg），食物差距无从界定，因为这些原植物在任何用量下都不是食物。

Food vs supplement食物与补充剂Saffron is the mildest food-versus-extract case in this whole set, since trials use either powdered stigma or a hydroalcoholic extract standardised to crocins and safranal, so kitchen saffron is close to the trial material. The caveat is at the top end: saffron is toxic at gram doses, with roughly 5 g reported as a toxic dose and 12 to 20 g as potentially lethal, and it is a traditional abortifacient, so scaling from a pinch to a spoonful is genuinely hazardous. Standardised extracts also concentrate crocins, so milligram for milligram an extract is not the spice. For the rest of the group the form gap is total: St John's wort is a potent CYP3A4 and P-glycoprotein inducer that has caused transplant rejection, contraceptive failure and serotonin syndrome with SSRIs; ashwagandha root extracts have accumulated a documented cluster of hepatotoxicity case reports, including in regulatory reviews, while traditional use was of small amounts of root powder in milk as medicine and never as a food; purified 5-HTP bypasses the rate-limiting tryptophan hydroxylase step that normally regulates serotonin synthesis, which is exactly why it carries serotonin syndrome risk with serotonergic drugs and why no food behaves like it.藏红花是整组中食物与提取物差别最小的一例，试验使用的是柱头粉末，或按藏红花素（crocins）和藏红花醛（safranal）标准化的醇水提取物，因此厨房里的藏红花与试验材料很接近。需要提示的是高端剂量：藏红花在克级剂量下有毒性，报告约 5 g 为中毒剂量，12 至 20 g 可能致死，它还是传统的堕胎药，所以从一小撮放大到一勺确实危险。标准化提取物还会富集藏红花素，按毫克对等来看，提取物与香料并不等同。这一组其余成分的形态差距是彻底的：贯叶连翘是强效的 CYP3A4 和 P-糖蛋白诱导剂，曾导致移植排斥、避孕失败以及与 SSRI 合用时的血清素综合征；南非醉茄根提取物已积累一批有记录的肝毒性病例报告，包括监管审评中的病例，而传统用法是把少量根粉加进牛奶作药用，从未当作食物；纯化 5-HTP 绕过了正常调控血清素合成的限速步骤色氨酸羟化酶，这正是它与血清素能药物合用会带来血清素综合征风险的原因，也是没有任何食物具有类似作用的原因。

Absorption吸收Saffron's crocins are poorly absorbed intact and are hydrolysed in the gut to crocetin, which is what appears in plasma; safranal is volatile and is partly lost in long simmering, so a slow-cooked dish delivers a different apocarotenoid profile than a capsule taken cold, and blooming saffron in warm liquid before adding it is the culinary analogue of extraction. SAMe is chemically unstable and is degraded in gastric acid unless enterically coated, and oral bioavailability is only about 1% because of extensive first-pass metabolism, which is why oral doses are 400 to 1,600 mg while parenteral doses are far smaller. The classic bad recommendation in this space is 'eat turkey or eggs for 5-HTP': food supplies tryptophan, and dietary tryptophan competes with the other large neutral amino acids in the same protein meal for LAT1 transport across the blood-brain barrier, so a high-protein meal can lower rather than raise brain tryptophan availability. Food is a poor delivery route for this entire group.藏红花中的藏红花素以完整形式吸收很差，在肠道内水解为藏红花酸（crocetin），进入血浆的是后者；藏红花醛易挥发，长时间炖煮会部分损失，因此慢炖菜品提供的脱降类胡萝卜素谱与冷服胶囊不同，而下锅前先用温液体把藏红花泡开，相当于烹饪版的提取。SAMe 化学性质不稳定，未做肠溶包衣就会在胃酸中降解，由于首过代谢强，口服生物利用度仅约 1%，这也是口服剂量为 400 至 1,600 mg 而注射剂量小得多的原因。这一领域的经典错误建议是为了 5-HTP 去吃火鸡或鸡蛋：食物提供的是色氨酸，而同一顿蛋白质餐中的膳食色氨酸要与其他大分子中性氨基酸争夺 LAT1 转运体穿过血脑屏障，因此高蛋白餐可能反而降低脑内色氨酸的可得量。对整组成分而言，食物都是很差的给药途径。

Food data note食物数据说明The saffron portion weights, the 3,333-doses arithmetic and the trial's 30 mg/day for 6 weeks all verified exactly, and the trial's design has been corrected against the abstract. The apocarotenoid content figures could not be confirmed anywhere and have been removed, the thread-weight basis remains unsettled between two mutually inconsistent conventions, and the FDC ID is unconfirmed中。藏红花的分量重量、3,333 个剂量的换算以及试验的每天 30 mg 持续 6 周均已逐项核实无误，试验设计也已对照摘要更正。脱降类胡萝卜素含量数值在任何地方都无法确认，已删除；每根柱头重量的基准在两套互相矛盾的惯例之间仍未定论；FDC ID 未获确认。

Does the body make it身体是否自产Saffron's constituents are apocarotenoids, the crocins plus crocetin, picrocrocin and safranal, cleaved from zeaxanthin in Crocus sativus stigmas, and human tissue makes no part of them, which holds for the other plant members of this group too, so the roll-up for the bundle is NONE. The one member at the opposite end of the axis is SAMe, which is FULL: the body's universal methyl donor, made in every cell from methionine and ATP and most heavily in the liver, with a CONDITIONAL carve-out in chronic liver disease and cholestasis where MAT1A activity and hepatic SAMe fall. For the botanicals the axis is silent and the case rests on trial evidence; for SAMe an oral dose is pharmacology, since a healthy person eating normal protein cannot be deficient.藏红花的成分是脱辅基类胡萝卜素, 即 crocins 以及 crocetin, picrocrocin 和 safranal, 由 Crocus sativus 柱头中的玉米黄质裂解而来, 人体组织不合成其中任何部分, 本组其他植物成分同理, 所以整条的汇总标签是 NONE。处在这条轴另一端的成员只有 SAMe, 它是 FULL: 全身通用的甲基供体, 每个细胞都能用 methionine 和 ATP 合成, 肝脏合成量最大; 有一个 CONDITIONAL 的例外, 慢性肝病和胆汁淤积时 MAT1A 活性和肝内 SAMe 下降。对植物成分这条轴无话可说, 判断依赖试验证据; 对 SAMe, 口服属药理剂量, 因为蛋白摄入正常的健康人不会缺它。

Pathway合成通路NOT APPLICABLE for saffron and the other botanicals: apocarotenoids are cleaved from zeaxanthin by carotenoid cleavage dioxygenase (CCD2) in Crocus sativus stigmas and then glycosylated to crocins, with no human counterpart. SAMe: L-methionine plus ATP, catalysed by methionine adenosyltransferase (MAT1A in liver, MAT2A in other tissues); the liver metabolises about 50 percent of dietary methionine and hosts up to 85 percent of all transmethylation reactions. SAMe donates its methyl group to give S-adenosylhomocysteine, hydrolysed by AHCY to homocysteine, which is either remethylated by MTR with 5-methyl-THF and vitamin B12 or by BHMT with betaine, or committed to transsulfuration by CBS with vitamin B6.对藏红花和其他植物成分为 NOT APPLICABLE: 在 Crocus sativus 柱头中由 carotenoid cleavage dioxygenase (CCD2) 从玉米黄质裂解出脱辅基类胡萝卜素, 再糖苷化为 crocins, 人体没有对应通路。SAMe: L-methionine 加 ATP, 由 methionine adenosyltransferase 催化 (肝为 MAT1A, 其他组织为 MAT2A); 肝代谢约 50% 的膳食 methionine, 并承担全身多达 85% 的转甲基反应。SAMe 交出甲基后生成 S-adenosylhomocysteine, 由 AHCY 水解为同型半胱氨酸, 后者或由 MTR 用 5-methyl-THF 和 vitamin B12 再甲基化, 或由 BHMT 用甜菜碱再甲基化, 或由 CBS 在 vitamin B6 参与下进入转硫途径。

Amount made自产量0 for saffron and the other botanicals (no human biosynthetic pathway). SAMe is not directly measured as a synthesis rate; it is bounded by measured whole-body methionine transmethylation flux, which stable-isotope tracer work puts on the order of several grams of SAM turnover per day in adults with hepatic synthesis dominant, and no single consensus figure is established. Supplement doses are 400 to 1,600 mg/day.藏红花和其他植物成分为 0 (人体没有生物合成途径)。SAMe 没有作为合成速率被直接测定, 可由已测得的全身 methionine 转甲基通量给出上界, 稳定同位素示踪研究对应成人每日 SAMe 周转量在数克量级, 以肝内合成为主, 尚无统一共识数值。补充剂量为 400 到 1,600 mg/day。

Still matters when仍有意义的情形Nothing on this axis for the botanicals: screen saffron on trial size and independence (small trials, several from the same groups), on adulteration of one of the world's most expensive spices with dyed safflower, turmeric or other Crocus material, on the 28 to 30 mg/day extract dose used in trials, and on serotonergic additivity. For SAMe, chronic liver disease and cholestasis, where MAT activity and hepatic SAMe are genuinely reduced, is the one setting with a mechanistic replacement case; the mood indication is pharmacological, with caution in bipolar disorder because of switch to mania and with serotonergic drugs.就植物成分而言这条轴上没有理由: 藏红花改用试验规模和独立性 (样本小, 多项出自同一批研究者), 这种世界上最贵香料被染色红花, 姜黄或其他 Crocus 材料掺假的情况, 试验所用 28 至 30 mg/day 的提取物剂量, 以及血清素能叠加来筛查。对 SAMe, 慢性肝病和胆汁淤积中 MAT 活性和肝内 SAMe 确实降低, 这是唯一有机制依据的替代场景; 情绪适应症属药理用途, 双相障碍者要防转躁, 与血清素能药物合用要谨慎。

Synthesis source合成来源Merged from the saffron rows and the SAMe row: PMID 25384672 (Lopresti AL & Drummond PD, Hum Psychopharmacol 2014, Saffron for depression); PMID 23073625 (Lu SC & Mato JM, Physiol Rev 2012;92:1515-42, DOI 10.1152/physrev.00047.2011); PMID 23396728 (Mato JM, Ann Hepatol 2013;12:183-9)

Refs.文献 Yang PMID 29849461; Ghaderi PMID 31987241; Limveeraprajak PMID 38423354; Peng PMID 38199136
SSCCFFDDBBXXQuercetin and taurine槲皮素与牛磺酸
Verdict结论Skip it不必买
Evidence证据Grade CC 级
Dose tested已验证剂量Quercetin at least 500 mg/d for the blood pressure effect. Taurine 0.5-6 g/d.槲皮素：要产生降压效应需至少 500 毫克/天。牛磺酸：0.5 至 6 克/天。
Who适用人群At most, people with elevated blood pressure or components of metabolic syndrome, for a small surrogate effect.最多适用于血压偏高或有代谢综合征组分的人，且只是一个小的替代终点效应。
Pros优点
  • Taurine has the strongest human surrogate data of any longevity compound here: 25 trials, 1,024 participants, systolic -4.0 mmHg (-7.29 to -0.71), diastolic -1.51 mmHg, fasting glucose -5.9 mg/dL, all dose-dependent.在本文所有抗衰老类化合物中，牛磺酸的人体替代终点数据最强：25 项试验、1024 名受试者，收缩压 -4.0 mmHg（-7.29 至 -0.71），舒张压 -1.51 mmHg，空腹血糖 -5.9 mg/dL，均呈剂量依赖。
  • Quercetin at 500 mg/d or more gave systolic -4.45 mmHg and diastolic -2.98 mmHg in the dose-stratified analysis.在按剂量分层的分析中，槲皮素 500 毫克/天及以上使收缩压降低 4.45 mmHg，舒张压降低 2.98 mmHg。
Cons缺点
  • The taurine longevity story was directly refuted in humans in 2025. The 2023 Science paper showed taurine declines with age in mice, monkeys and humans and extends lifespan in mice. A 2025 Aging Cell paper found circulating taurine is NOT associated with age, muscle mass, strength, physical performance or mitochondrial function in humans.牛磺酸与长寿的故事在 2025 年已被人体研究直接推翻。2023 年《科学》那篇论文显示牛磺酸在小鼠、猴和人体内随年龄下降，并延长小鼠寿命。2025 年《Aging Cell》一篇论文发现，在人体中循环牛磺酸与年龄、肌肉质量、力量、体能表现或线粒体功能都无关联。
  • Quercetin effect sizes are shrinking as the evidence matures. The 2016 meta-analysis gave systolic -3.04 mmHg; the 2023 umbrella review of meta-analyses found only -1.9 mmHg with heterogeneity of 88%, and nothing else significant, at very low certainty.随着证据成熟，槲皮素的效应量在缩小。2016 年的 meta 分析给出收缩压 -3.04 mmHg；2023 年针对 meta 分析的伞式综述只得到 -1.9 mmHg，异质性 88%，其余指标均不显著，确定性极低。
  • A 2 to 4 mmHg systolic reduction is small next to any antihypertensive drug or to sodium reduction.收缩压降低 2 至 4 mmHg，相比任何降压药或减少钠摄入都很小。
  • Quercetin inhibits CYP3A4 and P-glycoprotein, so treat it as an interaction risk with ciclosporin, tacrolimus, CYP3A4-metabolised statins, warfarin and many chemotherapeutics. It is also a topoisomerase inhibitor in vitro, which is a specific reason not to combine it with chemotherapy.槲皮素抑制 CYP3A4 和 P-糖蛋白，因此与环孢素、他克莫司、经 CYP3A4 代谢的他汀、华法林以及许多化疗药合用都应视为相互作用风险。它在体外还是拓扑异构酶抑制剂，这是不要与化疗联用的具体理由。
  • Taurine effects are additive with antihypertensives, insulin and sulfonylureas.牛磺酸的效应与降压药、胰岛素和磺脲类叠加。
What it does, and what happens without it它有什么作用，缺了会怎样

Quercetin is a plant pigment with no bodily role; taurine supports bile, heart and retina.槲皮素是一种在人体内无生理作用的植物色素;牛磺酸支持胆汁、心脏和视网膜功能。

No deficiency state exists不存在缺乏状态

In detail详细These are two unrelated molecules sold together for convenience. Quercetin is a plant flavonol from onions, capers, apples and tea; it is heavily glucuronidated and sulfated on first pass, so free aglycone concentrations in plasma stay in the nanomolar range and most antioxidant actions demonstrated in cell culture cannot occur at achievable oral doses. It has no physiological role in humans and no deficiency state of any kind. Taurine is a sulfur-containing beta-amino acid, the most abundant free amino acid in heart, retina and leukocytes. It conjugates bile acids, stabilises membranes, modulates calcium handling and cell volume, and is required for the mitochondrial tRNA modification that supports respiratory chain protein synthesis. Adults synthesize taurine from cysteine via cysteine sulfinic acid decarboxylase and obtain roughly 40 to 400 mg a day from meat and seafood, so nobody eating ordinary food becomes taurine depleted. Taurine is classified as conditionally essential, and the one documented human depletion is iatrogenic rather than dietary: in children fed long-term on taurine-free parenteral nutrition, plasma taurine ran about 26 plus or minus 13 versus 57 plus or minus 16 micromol/L in controls, and all 8 children tested had abnormal electroretinograms with delayed rod and cone implicit times, detectable before any visual problem was noticed. Taurine depletion also contributes to parenteral-nutrition-associated cholestasis in infants. Adding taurine to the intravenous solution restored plasma taurine in 4 supplemented children and normalised the electroretinogram in 3 of those 4, though plasma taurine relapsed in 2 of those 3 within a year of intravenous taurine being stopped, and the whole evidence base is a small 1985 case series. Paediatric parenteral amino acid solutions now routinely contain taurine, which prevents the problem at source.这是两种为方便合并销售的不相关分子。槲皮素是一种来自洋葱、刺山柑、苹果和茶的植物黄酮醇;它在首过代谢中被大量葡萄糖醛酸化和硫酸化,因此血浆中游离苷元浓度维持在纳摩尔范围,细胞培养中展示的大多数抗氧化作用在可达到的口服剂量下都无法实现。它在人体内没有生理作用,也不存在任何形式的缺乏状态。牛磺酸是一种含硫β-氨基酸,是心脏、视网膜和白细胞中含量最高的游离氨基酸。它结合胆汁酸、稳定细胞膜、调节钙处理和细胞体积,并且是支持呼吸链蛋白合成的线粒体tRNA修饰所必需的。成人通过半胱氨酸亚磺酸脱羧酶由半胱氨酸合成牛磺酸,并从肉类和海鲜中获得每日约40至400 mg,因此正常饮食的人不会出现牛磺酸缺乏。牛磺酸被归类为条件必需营养素,而目前唯一有记录的人体缺乏是医源性而非饮食性的:在长期接受不含牛磺酸的肠外营养的儿童中,血浆牛磺酸约为26加减13,而对照组为57加减16微摩尔/升,受检测的8名儿童全部出现视网膜电图异常,表现为视杆和视锥内隐含时延长,且在出现任何视觉问题之前即可检出。牛磺酸缺乏还与婴儿肠外营养相关性胆汁淤积有关。在静脉输液中添加牛磺酸使4名接受补充的儿童血浆牛磺酸恢复正常,其中3名的视网膜电图恢复正常,不过这3名中有2名在停用静脉牛磺酸后一年内血浆牛磺酸出现反弹,而且整个证据基础仅来自1985年的一项小型病例系列。目前儿科肠外氨基酸溶液已常规含有牛磺酸,从源头上预防了这一问题。

There is no deficiency state for this. It is not an essential nutrient, so being short of it is not a thing that can happen.它不存在缺乏状态。它不是必需营养素，所以“缺了它”这件事本身并不成立。

Source来源PMID 3917547 (Geggel et al., nutritional requirement for taurine in long-term parenteral nutrition, N Engl J Med 1985); PMID 2122712 (visual function in patients on long-term total parenteral nutrition)

Food and the body食物与身体
In food: Rich食物中：丰富 Dose from food: Out of reach靠吃达到剂量：达不到 Body makes it: Partly身体自产：部分自产 Food data: Medium食物数据：中

Quercetin is present across ordinary plant food: raw capers 233.84 mg/100 g, lovage leaves 170.00, dock (Rumex) 86.20, radish leaves 70.37, wild rocket 66.19, fresh dill 55.15, coriander leaves 52.90, yellow wax hot peppers 50.63, fennel leaves 48.80 and red onion 39.21, against habitual intakes of tens of milligrams a day, so naming capers as the only rich source overstated how narrow the food route is. Taurine is present in animal food only, richest in shellfish, with beef muscle at 61.1 mg/100 g wet weight and chicken thigh at 47.34 mg/100 g; it was undetectable in all 48 plant foods Laidlaw analysed, so a vegan diet supplies none, while quercetin intake is unaffected by avoiding animal food. The two compounds are RICH for opposite populations, which is why they are described separately throughout this entry.槲皮素广泛存在于普通植物性食物中：生刺山柑（capers）233.84 mg/100 g、圆叶当归叶 170.00、酸模（Rumex）86.20、萝卜叶 70.37、野生芝麻菜 66.19、新鲜莳萝 55.15、香菜叶 52.90、黄蜡质辣椒 50.63、茴香叶 48.80、红洋葱 39.21，而习惯摄入量只有每天几十毫克，因此把刺山柑说成唯一的丰富来源，夸大了食物路线的狭窄程度。牛磺酸只存在于动物性食物中，贝类最丰富，牛肌肉按湿重为 61.1 mg/100 g，鸡腿肉为 47.34 mg/100 g；Laidlaw 分析的 48 种植物性食物中全部检测不到，所以纯素饮食提供不了牛磺酸，而槲皮素的摄入不受回避动物性食物的影响。这两种化合物的“丰富”针对的是相反的人群，本条目因此始终把它们分开描述。
