To match the dose要达到该剂量QUERCETIN: trials use 500-1,000 mg/day. From raw capers at 233.84 mg/100 g that is 214-428 g per day, 14 to 29 tablespoons of a salt-cured condiment and a salt load nobody should take; from dock leaves at 86.20 mg/100 g it is 580 g to 1.16 kg; from wild rocket at 66.19 mg/100 g it is 756 g to 1.51 kg; from raw red onion at 39.21 mg/100 g it is 1.28-2.55 kg; from apples with skin at 4.01 mg/100 g it is 12.5-25 kg, about 70 to 140 apples. A 500 mg capsule is roughly 25 to 50 times what a diet delivers. TAURINE: trials use 1-6 g/day, commonly 3 g. From beef at 61.1 mg/100 g that is 4.9 kg of raw steak per day, from chicken thigh at 47.34 mg/100 g it is 6.3 kg, and from clam meat at roughly 450 mg/100 g as eaten it is about 670 g of clam meat daily, the only route within an order of magnitude of feasible and still nothing a person eats. Neither dose is reachable by eating normally.槲皮素：试验剂量为 500-1,000 mg/天。按生刺山柑 233.84 mg/100 g 计算，每天要 214-428 g，也就是 14 到 29 汤匙盐渍调味小菜，那样的钠负荷谁都不该承受；按酸模叶 86.20 mg/100 g 计算是 580 g 到 1.16 kg；按野生芝麻菜 66.19 mg/100 g 计算是 756 g 到 1.51 kg；按生红洋葱 39.21 mg/100 g 计算是 1.28-2.55 kg；按带皮苹果 4.01 mg/100 g 计算是 12.5-25 kg，约 70 到 140 个苹果。一粒 500 mg 胶囊大致相当于膳食供给量的 25 到 50 倍。牛磺酸：试验剂量为 1-6 g/天，常用 3 g。按牛肉 61.1 mg/100 g 计算，每天要 4.9 kg 生牛排；按鸡腿肉 47.34 mg/100 g 计算是 6.3 kg；按可食状态下蛤肉约 450 mg/100 g 计算，每天约 670 g 蛤肉，这是唯一在可行性一个数量级之内的路径，仍然不是人的日常吃法。两种剂量都无法靠正常饮食达到。

Food vs supplement食物与补充剂QUERCETIN, MAJOR. Supplements are almost always the aglycone, extracted from Sophora japonica flower buds or Dimorphandra mollis pods, which are not foods anyone eats; food quercetin is glycosides (glucosides in onions, rutin in tea and apples). The forms are not interchangeable in the gut, and a 500-1,000 mg aglycone dose is a pharmacological exposure that inhibits drug-metabolising enzymes and transporters, whereas 10-30 mg/day from onions and apples never approaches it. Capers are the richest source per 100 g and the worst practical recommendation, since the value is for a salt-cured condiment eaten a tablespoon at a time and the canned figure ranges 45.05-519.85 mg/100 g across 20 samples, an elevenfold spread; fresh herbs, dock, radish leaves and wild rocket at 48-86 mg/100 g are the more usable everyday sources. Apples with skin are the classic textbook answer and are roughly 60 times too dilute; peeling drops them from 4.01 to 1.05 mg/100 g. TAURINE, MODERATE. The supplement is synthetic and chemically identical to food taurine, so there is no extract-versus-food problem here. The two real caveats are analytical and culinary. Shellfish taurine numbers in circulation are often dry-weight figures presented as if they were per 100 g of food, which inflates them four- to sixfold; the three bivalve rows above are dry-weight values from an umami study, converted with an assumed 80-83% moisture that is labelled as an assumption in each row. And taurine is a free amino acid rather than protein-bound, so it leaches: taurine and creatine were the compounds most reduced by cooking beef, partly into the cooking juices (Purchas RW, Rutherfurd SM, Pearce PD, Vather R, Wilkinson BHP, Meat Sci 2004;68(2):201-7, PMID 22062229; the companion 90 min at 70 C result is from lamb muscle, Purchas RW et al., Meat Sci 2004;66(3):629-37, PMID 22060873). A stew keeps its taurine in the broth; a grilled steak with the juices discarded does not.槲皮素：重大。补充剂几乎都是苷元，从槐（Sophora japonica）花蕾或 Dimorphandra mollis 豆荚中提取，这两种都不是人吃的食物；食物中的槲皮素是糖苷（洋葱中是葡糖苷，茶和苹果中是芦丁）。这些形式在肠道中不可互换，500-1,000 mg 苷元剂量属于药理学暴露，会抑制药物代谢酶和转运体，而洋葱和苹果提供的 10-30 mg/天永远达不到这个水平。刺山柑每 100 g 含量最高，同时是最糟糕的实用建议，因为这个数值属于一次只吃一汤匙的盐渍调味小菜，罐装样品 20 份的范围是 45.05-519.85 mg/100 g，相差十一倍；48-86 mg/100 g 的新鲜香草、酸模、萝卜叶和野生芝麻菜才是日常更可用的来源。带皮苹果是教科书上的经典答案，浓度大约稀了 60 倍；削皮后从 4.01 降到 1.05 mg/100 g。牛磺酸：中等。补充剂是合成的，与食物中的牛磺酸化学上完全相同，所以这里没有提取物与食物之争。真正的两点提醒在分析层面和烹饪层面。流传的贝类牛磺酸数字往往是干重值，却被当作每 100 g 食物来引用，从而虚高四到六倍；上面三行贝类数据是取自一项鲜味研究的干重值，按假定的 80-83% 水分换算，每一行都已标明这属于假设。另外，牛磺酸是游离氨基酸，并未结合在蛋白质中，因此容易流失：牛肉烹饪中减少最多的化合物就是牛磺酸和肌酸，一部分进了肉汁（Purchas RW, Rutherfurd SM, Pearce PD, Vather R, Wilkinson BHP, Meat Sci 2004;68(2):201-7, PMID 22062229；配套的 70 C 加热 90 min 结果来自羔羊肌肉，Purchas RW et al., Meat Sci 2004;66(3):629-37, PMID 22060873）。炖菜的牛磺酸留在汤里，把肉汁丢掉的烤牛排留不住。

Absorption吸收QUERCETIN, quantified and decisive. In healthy ileostomy volunteers absorption was 52 plus or minus 15% for quercetin glucosides from fried onions, 17 plus or minus 15% for quercetin rutinoside (the main form in tea and apples) and 24 plus or minus 9% for pure quercetin aglycone, the form used in supplements; conjugation with glucose enhances absorption (Hollman PC, de Vries JH, van Leeuwen SD, Mengelers MJ, Katan MB, Am J Clin Nutr 1995;62(6):1276-82, PMID 7491892, citation and values confirmed). So per milligram, onion quercetin is roughly twice as absorbable as the capsule and three times as absorbable as tea or apple rutin, which narrows the effective gap a little and nowhere near enough to close it, since urinary recovery was only 0.5% of the amount absorbed. TAURINE. It is present in food as the free amino acid rather than bound in protein, absorbed by the TauT transporter with high oral bioavailability, and the supplement form is identical, so absorption is not where food loses. Food loses on concentration and on cooking: the content of a portion depends heavily on whether the cooking liquid is consumed, and reported values vary severalfold with muscle type (beef taurine ranged 0.552 to 23.861 umol/g across 21 muscles, PMID 30811817) and with breed in poultry (39.29-47.34 mg/100 g, PMID 36230082). Reading dry-weight shellfish values as wet-weight is the single commonest error in this literature, and it is the weak point of the shellfish rows here.槲皮素：有定量数据，结论明确。在健康的回肠造口志愿者中，来自油煎洋葱的槲皮素葡糖苷吸收率为 52 加减 15%，槲皮素芦丁苷（茶和苹果中的主要形式）为 17 加减 15%，补充剂所用的纯槲皮素苷元为 24 加减 9%；与葡萄糖结合可提高吸收（Hollman PC, de Vries JH, van Leeuwen SD, Mengelers MJ, Katan MB, Am J Clin Nutr 1995;62(6):1276-82, PMID 7491892，引文和数值均已确认）。因此按毫克计，洋葱槲皮素的可吸收程度约为胶囊的两倍、茶或苹果芦丁的三倍，这让实际差距缩小了一点，远不足以抹平，因为尿中回收量只占已吸收量的 0.5%。牛磺酸：它在食物中以游离氨基酸形式存在，未结合在蛋白质里，由 TauT 转运体吸收，口服生物利用度高，补充剂形式完全相同，吸收环节没有差距。食物的劣势在浓度和烹饪上：一份的含量很大程度取决于烹饪汤汁是否一起吃掉，而报告值随肌肉类型相差数倍（21 块牛肌肉的牛磺酸为 0.552 至 23.861 umol/g，PMID 30811817），禽类还随品种变化（39.29-47.34 mg/100 g，PMID 36230082）。把贝类的干重值当作湿重来读，是这一文献中最常见的单一错误，也是这里贝类各行的薄弱之处。

Food data note食物数据说明overall, and the two halves differ. The quercetin block is the most thoroughly verified material in the submission: all eight original values, their sample counts, min-max ranges and NDB numbers matched Flavonoid Release 3.3 exactly, and Hollman 1995 and the 74% peeling loss were confirmed. The taurine rows are weaker. The three bivalve figures are dry-weight values from an umami and taste-compound study, located in Figure 1B rather than the cited Table 3, converted to as-eaten values with a self-supplied 80-83% moisture assumption, and one of them (Kumamoto oyster) was wrong at source by about 11%. Laidlaw 1990, which analysed 29 meats on an as-eaten basis, was cited only for the negative plant finding, so no wet-weight primary source backs any shellfish row总体为中，两个部分情况不同。槲皮素部分是本次提交材料中核实得最彻底的：原有八个数值及其样本数、最小最大范围和 NDB 编号全部与 Flavonoid Release 3.3 完全吻合，Hollman 1995 和 74% 的削皮损失也已确认。牛磺酸各行较弱。三个双壳贝数值来自一项鲜味与风味物质研究的干重值，位于 Figure 1B 而非所引的 Table 3，用自行设定的 80-83% 水分假设换算为可食状态值，其中熊本牡蛎一项在原始来源处就错了约 11%。Laidlaw 1990 按可食状态分析了 29 种肉类，本数据集只引用了它关于植物的阴性发现，因此没有任何湿重原始来源支持贝类各行。

Does the body make it身体是否自产Two different verdicts in one row, so the roll-up is PARTIAL and the split has to be named. Quercetin scores NONE: it is a plant flavonol, no animal synthesises flavonoids at all because the pathway requires chalcone synthase, which humans lack, so every microgram is dietary and there is no requirement and no deficiency state. Taurine scores PARTIAL: you make it from cysteine by three routes, CSAD, which has low activity in humans, GADL1, which decarboxylates cysteine sulfinate to hypotaurine, and the cysteamine route where cysteamine from coenzyme A degradation is oxidised to hypotaurine by cysteamine dioxygenase (ADO), and that limited overall capacity is why tissue and plasma taurine track intake of meat, fish and shellfish. So any case for quercetin has to be pharmacological and runs into poor bioavailability and heavy conjugation, while taurine has a genuine dietary contribution and a short list of states where it matters.一行里两个不同判断, 汇总为 PARTIAL, 并要说明拆分: quercetin 为 NONE, taurine 为 PARTIAL。quercetin 是植物黄酮醇, 任何动物都不合成类黄酮, 因为该通路需要人类没有的 chalcone synthase, 每一微克都来自饮食, 既无需求也无缺乏状态。taurine 由 cysteine 合成, 有三条路线: 人体活性偏低的 CSAD, 把 cysteine sulfinate 脱羧为 hypotaurine 的 GADL1, 以及辅酶 A 降解产生的 cysteamine 由 cysteamine dioxygenase (ADO) 氧化为 hypotaurine 的路线; 总体能力仍然有限, 所以组织和血浆 taurine 随肉, 鱼, 贝类的摄入而变化。因此 quercetin 的任何理由都只能是药理性的, 且会撞上生物利用度差和大量结合代谢, 而 taurine 有真实的膳食贡献和一份明确的适用状态清单。

Pathway合成通路Quercetin: NOT APPLICABLE in humans. Plants build it from phenylalanine via PAL, 4-coumaroyl-CoA, chalcone synthase, flavanone 3-hydroxylase and flavonol synthase; human enzymology is limited to conjugation and degradation (intestinal and hepatic UGT, SULT and COMT, plus gut microbial ring fission). Taurine: cysteine is oxidised by cysteine dioxygenase (CDO1) to cysteine sulfinate, decarboxylated by CSAD or GADL1 to hypotaurine and oxidised to taurine, with a parallel cysteamine route through ADO; liver is the main site, taurine is conjugated to bile acids by BAAT and held in tissue by the transporter SLC6A6 (TauT), which the kidney upregulates on low intake.quercetin: 在人体 NOT APPLICABLE。植物由 phenylalanine 经 PAL, 4-coumaroyl-CoA, chalcone synthase, flavanone 3-hydroxylase 和 flavonol synthase 合成; 人体酶学只限于结合与降解 (肠道和肝的 UGT, SULT, COMT, 以及肠道菌的环裂解)。taurine: cysteine 由 cysteine dioxygenase (CDO1) 氧化为 cysteine sulfinate, 经 CSAD 或 GADL1 脱羧为 hypotaurine, 再氧化为 taurine, 另有经 ADO 的 cysteamine 平行路线; 主要合成部位是肝, taurine 由 BAAT 与胆汁酸结合, 由转运体 SLC6A6 (TauT) 在组织中保留, 摄入低时肾脏上调该转运体。

Amount made自产量Quercetin: 0 mg/day, no human synthesis. Taurine: NOT ESTABLISHED, there is no validated human de novo synthesis rate, and the evidence for the limitation is enzymatic, with CSAD the rate-limiting step and very low in activity in humans (PMC8153620). Intake-side reference points: roughly 40 to 400 mg/day in omnivores, close to zero on a strict vegan diet, supplement doses of 500 to 3,000 mg/day, and about 1,000 mg in a can of energy drink.quercetin: 0 mg/day, 人体不合成。taurine: NOT ESTABLISHED (尚无确证数据), 没有经过验证的人体从头合成速率, 支持其受限的证据来自酶学, CSAD 是限速步骤且在人体活性很低 (PMC8153620)。摄入侧参照: 杂食者约 40 到 400 mg/day, 严格纯素接近零, 补充剂量 500 到 3,000 mg/day, 一罐能量饮料约含 1,000 mg。

Still matters when仍有意义的情形Taurine: vegans and vegetarians with near-zero intake, preterm infants and long-term parenteral nutrition (which is why formula and PN solutions are taurine-fortified), SLC6A6 mutations causing retinal degeneration and cardiomyopathy, where it is treatment, and supervised clinical use in heart failure or hepatic disease; the CSAD-independent routes plus efficient renal reabsorption through TauT are why no deficiency syndrome appears in healthy omnivores. Quercetin: NEVER ON THIS AXIS, since there is no requirement and no deficiency, and at ordinary oral doses free aglycone barely reaches plasma.taurine: 摄入接近零的纯素者和素食者, 早产儿, 长期肠外营养 (这也是配方奶和 PN 溶液强化 taurine 的原因), SLC6A6 突变导致的视网膜退化与心肌病 (此时补充属于治疗), 以及心力衰竭或肝病中的临床监督使用; 不依赖 CSAD 的路线加上经 TauT 的高效肾重吸收, 是健康杂食者不出现缺乏综合征的原因。quercetin: NEVER ON THIS AXIS (这条轴上永不适用), 既无需求也无缺乏, 常规口服剂量下游离苷元几乎进不了血浆。

Skip does not mean dangerous“不必买”不等于“危险”

Everything in this section is a money problem rather than a safety one, with three exceptions flagged in their Cons: curcumin and green tea extract appear on liver-injury registries, and L-glutamine carries a mortality signal in the critically ill.本节内容基本是花钱的问题，不是安全的问题，但有三个例外已在其“缺点”中标出：姜黄素和绿茶提取物出现在肝损伤登记中，L-谷氨酰胺在危重患者中带有死亡信号。

07Avoid it不要吃

Published evidence of harm from randomised trials, registries or national surveillance. Where a legitimate narrow medical indication exists it is stated, because the harm attaches to consumer self-dosing rather than supervised use.来自随机试验、登记或全国性监测的公开致害证据。若存在正当而狭窄的医疗适应证，文中会写明，因为危害针对的是消费者自行服用，而不是医疗监督下的使用。

What it does, and what happens without it它有什么作用，缺了会怎样

A plant pigment the body can turn into vitamin A; nothing in the body needs it directly.一种植物色素，人体可将其转化为维生素A；人体没有任何过程直接需要它本身。

No deficiency state exists不存在缺乏状态

In detail详细Beta-carotene is a provitamin A carotenoid, the orange pigment of carrots, sweet potato, pumpkin and dark green leaves. In the intestinal mucosa, beta-carotene 15,15'-oxygenase (BCO1) cleaves it to retinal, which is reduced to retinol and esterified for storage. The conversion is feedback-regulated and inefficient: the Institute of Medicine assigns 12 micrograms of dietary beta-carotene the vitamin A activity of 1 microgram of retinol. Purified beta-carotene in an oil matrix, the form in a capsule, bypasses the food-matrix release step and carries a separate and much more favourable ratio of 2 micrograms per 1 microgram retinol activity equivalent, so a supplement delivers roughly six times the retinol activity of the same weight eaten in food. Common BCO1 variants reduce conversion markedly in a substantial minority of people. Uncleaved beta-carotene acts as a lipid-phase antioxidant and singlet oxygen quencher in laboratory systems, but no human physiological process depends on the intact molecule, and every requirement it can meet is a vitamin A requirement that preformed retinol meets directly.β-胡萝卜素是一种维生素A原类胡萝卜素，是胡萝卜、红薯、南瓜及深绿色叶菜中的橙色色素。在肠黏膜中，β-胡萝卜素15,15'-加氧酶（beta-carotene 15,15'-oxygenase, BCO1）将其裂解为视黄醛，后者被还原为视黄醇并酯化储存。这一转化受反馈调节且效率不高：美国医学研究所（Institute of Medicine）将12 micrograms膳食β-胡萝卜素的维生素A活性定为等同于1 microgram视黄醇。以油基质形式存在的纯化β-胡萝卜素，即胶囊中的形式，绕过了食物基质的释放步骤，其换算比例更有利，为2 micrograms对应1 microgram视黄醇活性当量，因此补充剂提供的视黄醇活性约为同等重量食物摄入的六倍。常见的BCO1基因变异会使相当一部分人群的转化效率显著降低。未被裂解的β-胡萝卜素在实验体系中可作为脂相抗氧化剂及单线态氧猝灭剂，但人体没有任何生理过程依赖完整分子本身，而它所能满足的一切需求，都是预成型视黄醇可以直接满足的维生素A需求。

There is no deficiency state for this. It is not an essential nutrient, so being short of it is not a thing that can happen.它不存在缺乏状态。它不是必需营养素，所以“缺了它”这件事本身并不成立。

Source来源Institute of Medicine, Dietary Reference Intakes for Vitamin A, Vitamin K, Arsenic, Boron, Chromium, Copper, Iodine, Iron, Manganese, Molybdenum, Nickel, Silicon, Vanadium and Zinc (National Academies Press, 2001), which sets no requirement for beta-carotene and defines both the 12:1 dietary and 2:1 supplemental RAE ratios; PMID 8127329 (ATBC Study Group, N Engl J Med 1994;330:1029-35); PMID 8602180 (Omenn GS et al., CARET, N Engl J Med 1996;334:1150-5); PMID 35727271 (USPSTF Recommendation Statement, JAMA 2022, D recommendation against beta-carotene)

Food and the body食物与身体
In food: Rich食物中：丰富 Dose from food: Partly靠吃达到剂量：部分 Body makes it: Cannot身体自产：不能 Food data: Medium食物数据：中

Carrots, carrot juice, sweet potato, squash and dark leafy greens are dense, ordinary sources: baked sweet potato flesh carries 11,509 µg beta-carotene per 100 g, carrot juice about 9,300 and raw carrot 8,285. Red palm oil is denser again at roughly 20,000 to 40,000 µg total carotenes per 100 g. By mass the 20 to 30 mg doses used in the intervention trials sit within reach of a few large portions, which makes this the one case where food and supplement look superficially comparable and behave completely differently.胡萝卜、胡萝卜汁、红薯、南瓜类和深色叶菜都是含量高的普通来源：烤红薯果肉每 100 g 含 11,509 µg β-胡萝卜素，胡萝卜汁约 9,300，生胡萝卜 8,285。红棕油浓度更高，每 100 g 总类胡萝卜素约 20,000 至 40,000 µg。按质量算，干预试验所用的 20 至 30 mg 剂量，几大份食物就够得着，这使本条成为食物与补充剂表面看来可比、实际行为完全不同的唯一一例。

To match the dose要达到该剂量By label mass the trial doses are reachable: 20 mg/day is about 241 g of raw carrot (four medium carrots), 174 g of baked sweet potato, or 215 g of carrot juice, and 30 mg/day is about 362 g of raw carrot. Carrot juice is the case that really tests this, because it is the one form anyone actually consumes in the volume required. By absorbed dose the answer flips. The Dietary Reference Intake conversion factors treat 12 µg of food beta-carotene as equivalent to 1 µg retinol activity against 2 µg for supplemental beta-carotene in oil, implying the supplement form is about six times more available (Institute of Medicine, DRIs for Vitamin A and related micronutrients, 2001, DOI 10.17226/10026). Matching the absorbed exposure of a 20 mg capsule therefore takes on the order of 120 mg of food beta-carotene, roughly 1.45 kg of raw carrots daily, which nobody eats and the gut would not absorb anyway. Food matches the label number and does not match the plasma exposure that produced the trial results.按标签质量算，试验剂量是够得着的：20 mg/天 约等于 241 g 生胡萝卜（四根中等大小），或 174 g 烤红薯，或 215 g 胡萝卜汁；30 mg/天 约为 362 g 生胡萝卜。真正检验这一点的是胡萝卜汁，因为它是唯一一种人们确实会按所需体积喝下去的形式。按吸收剂量算，答案就翻转了。膳食参考摄入量的换算系数把 12 µg 食物来源 β-胡萝卜素算作 1 µg 视黄醇活性当量，油溶补充剂形式的 β-胡萝卜素则是 2 µg，意味着补充剂形式的可利用度约高六倍（Institute of Medicine，DRIs for Vitamin A and related micronutrients，2001，DOI 10.17226/10026）。因此要在吸收暴露上匹配一粒 20 mg 胶囊，需要约 120 mg 食物来源 β-胡萝卜素，大致相当于每天 1.45 kg 生胡萝卜，没有人这么吃，肠道也吸收不了。食物能对上标签上的数字，对不上产生试验结果的那个血浆暴露水平。

Food vs supplement食物与补充剂This is the clearest food-versus-extract case in the set. Supplement beta-carotene is synthetic all-trans-beta-carotene or algal/fungal beta-carotene, formulated in oil or water-dispersible beadlets specifically to defeat the poor bioavailability of the food form, so it is engineered to do what a carrot cannot. Food never delivers beta-carotene alone: the same carrot supplies 3,477 µg/100 g of alpha-carotene, red palm oil is roughly a third alpha-carotene, and dark greens supply lutein with less beta-carotene. Dietary carotenoids carry none of the supplement harm for three reasons. First, uptake and cleavage are feedback-regulated, since absorbed beta-carotene raises intracellular retinoic acid, which induces ISX, which represses SR-B1 and BCO1 in the enterocyte, so absorption falls as vitamin A status rises (Reboul E, Nutrients 2019;11(4):838, PMID 31013870; the ISX loop itself traces to Lobo et al. and Widjaja-Adhi et al.). A capsule of purified beta-carotene in oil pushes plasma concentrations well past anything food produces, and the IOM 2:1 factor strictly applies to purified beta-carotene in oil, so applying it to beadlet formulations is an approximation. Second, the harm signals came from isolated high doses in high-risk groups: 20 mg/day raised lung cancer incidence by 18% in male smokers (ATBC, N Engl J Med 1994;330:1029-35, PMID 8127329) and 30 mg/day plus 25,000 IU retinyl palmitate produced about 28% more lung cancers, weighted incidence RR 1.36 (95% CI 1.07 to 1.73, P = .01) with mortality RR 1.59, in smokers and asbestos-exposed workers (CARET, Omenn et al., J Natl Cancer Inst 1996;88:1550-9, PMID 8901853). CARET cannot be attributed to beta-carotene alone, since it co-administered a large preformed retinol dose. Third, overloading on carrots produces carotenodermia, a harmless orange discolouration, rather than hypervitaminosis A, because the conversion step is regulated. Eating carrots and taking 20 mg of beta-carotene are two different interventions. Several everyday sources are absent from the table only because no figure was available to tabulate: dried parsley, basil and coriander, paprika, fresh apricots, persimmon, papaya, sweet red pepper, spring greens and collards, watercress, Swiss chard and romaine lettuce, all of which outrank the baby spinach originally chosen as the green exemplar.这是全组中食物与提取物对比最清楚的一例。补充剂里的 β-胡萝卜素是合成的全反式 β-胡萝卜素，或藻类、真菌来源的 β-胡萝卜素，配制成油溶剂型或水分散微丸，目的正是绕过食物形式吸收差的问题，它被设计出来做胡萝卜做不到的事。食物从不单独提供 β-胡萝卜素：同一根胡萝卜还提供 3,477 µg/100 g 的 α-胡萝卜素，红棕油约三分之一是 α-胡萝卜素，深色叶菜提供叶黄素而 β-胡萝卜素较少。膳食类胡萝卜素不带补充剂的那些危害，有三个原因。第一，摄取和裂解受反馈调节：吸收的 β-胡萝卜素提高细胞内视黄酸，视黄酸诱导 ISX，ISX 抑制肠上皮细胞中的 SR-B1 和 BCO1，因此维生素 A 状态升高时吸收下降（Reboul E，Nutrients 2019;11(4):838，PMID 31013870；ISX 环路本身可追溯到 Lobo 等和 Widjaja-Adhi 等）。一粒油溶纯化 β-胡萝卜素胶囊把血浆浓度推到食物远达不到的水平，而 IOM 的 2:1 系数严格来说只适用于油溶纯化 β-胡萝卜素，用在微丸剂型上只是近似。第二，危害信号来自高危人群中的孤立大剂量：每天 20 mg 使男性吸烟者的肺癌发病率上升 18%（ATBC，N Engl J Med 1994;330:1029-35，PMID 8127329）；每天 30 mg 加 25,000 IU 视黄醇棕榈酸酯，在吸烟者和石棉暴露工人中多出约 28% 的肺癌，加权发病率 RR 1.36（95% CI 1.07 至 1.73，P = .01），死亡率 RR 1.59（CARET，Omenn 等，J Natl Cancer Inst 1996;88:1550-9，PMID 8901853）。CARET 的结果不能只归因于 β-胡萝卜素，因为试验同时给了大剂量预制型视黄醇。第三，胡萝卜吃过量产生的是胡萝卜素性皮肤黄染，一种无害的橙色变色，不会造成维生素 A 中毒，因为转化步骤受调节。吃胡萝卜和服用 20 mg β-胡萝卜素是两种不同的干预。还有几种日常来源没有列入表中，仅因为找不到可以填表的数据：干欧芹、干罗勒和干香菜、红椒粉、新鲜杏、柿子、番木瓜、甜红椒、春季甘蓝（spring greens）和宽叶羽衣甘蓝（collards）、西洋菜、瑞士甜菜和罗马生菜，它们都排在最初被选作叶菜代表的嫩菠菜之前。

Absorption吸收Beta-carotene in raw carrot and raw spinach is locked in chromoplasts behind intact plant cell walls, so absorption from raw vegetables is low; chopping, pureeing, juicing, cooking and eating with fat all raise it, and cooking does not destroy it. The formal expression of this is the 12:1 food against 2:1 supplement-in-oil conversion factor (IOM 2001, DOI 10.17226/10026). One retention argument from the original entry has to be withdrawn: boiled carrot at 9,616 µg/100 g against raw carrot at 8,285 now compares a CoFID value with a USDA one, so it cannot be read as a within-dataset cooking effect. Conversion efficiency varies substantially between individuals through BCO1 genotype and vitamin A status, which is why plasma responses to the same carrot intake differ several-fold between people (PMID 31013870, a review stretched somewhat to cover the genotype point). Spinach needs its own correction: it is not the weak green the submission made it, since USDA raw spinach at 5,626 µg/100 g is about two thirds of raw carrot rather than under a fifth, and the honest caution about it is the oxalate load for people managing kidney stones.生胡萝卜和生菠菜中的 β-胡萝卜素被锁在完整植物细胞壁之后的有色体里，所以生蔬菜的吸收率低；切碎、打泥、榨汁、加热以及与脂肪同食都会提高吸收，加热也不会破坏它。这一点的正式表达就是食物 12:1 与油溶补充剂 2:1 的换算系数（IOM 2001，DOI 10.17226/10026）。原条目里有一条关于保留率的论证必须撤回：水煮胡萝卜 9,616 µg/100 g 对生胡萝卜 8,285，如今是拿 CoFID 数值与 USDA 数值相比，因此不能当作同一数据集内的烹饪效应来读。转化效率在个体之间差别很大，取决于 BCO1 基因型和维生素 A 状态，这也是同样的胡萝卜摄入量在不同人身上血浆反应相差数倍的原因（PMID 31013870，该综述用来支撑基因型这一点略有拉伸）。菠菜需要单独更正：提交材料把它写成弱势叶菜，USDA 生菠菜 5,626 µg/100 g 约为生胡萝卜的三分之二，远高于不足五分之一的说法；对它诚实的提醒是草酸负荷，关系到需要控制肾结石的人。

Food data note食物数据说明The load-bearing values are now USDA-anchored, since five food figures were checkable and have been replaced (raw carrot, baked sweet potato, raw and cooked spinach, dried apricots, butter beta-carotene), and the two OK values (kale, mango) were within 9% of USDA. The dose arithmetic and the IOM conversion factors are confirmed. What holds confidence down is that four remaining rows are unconfirmed CoFID codes, two of which now sit oddly against USDA values for the same vegetable (boiled sweet potato at about half the USDA baked figure), the published range for kale is unusually wide, and the four added foods rest on single indicative figures中。承重的数值现在以 USDA 为锚：五个食物数字可核对并已替换（生胡萝卜、烤红薯、生菠菜和熟菠菜、杏干、黄油 β-胡萝卜素），两个通过检验的数值（羽衣甘蓝、芒果）与 USDA 相差在 9% 以内。剂量算术和 IOM 换算系数均已确认。压低置信度的是：仍有四行是未证实的 CoFID 编码，其中两行与同一蔬菜的 USDA 数值对不上（水煮红薯约为 USDA 烤制值的一半），羽衣甘蓝已发表数值的范围异常宽，四种新增食物依赖单一指示性数字。

Does the body make it身体是否自产Humans synthesise no carotenoids whatsoever, so everything in the body reflects intake and there is no deficiency state for beta-carotene as such. The recovered set also carries a PARTIAL label for vitamin A from beta-carotene, and that PARTIAL describes the conversion of dietary beta-carotene into retinol rather than any synthesis of the carotenoid, so the two labels sit on different things and do not conflict. On this axis a beta-carotene supplement has no shortfall to correct, and it stands or falls on trial results for whatever endpoint is claimed.人体完全不合成任何类胡萝卜素, 所以体内的全部 beta-carotene 都反映摄入量, 也不存在针对 beta-carotene 本身的缺乏状态。恢复条目中还有一个标签把由 beta-carotene 得到的维生素 A 记为 PARTIAL, 那个 PARTIAL 说的是膳食 beta-carotene 向视黄醇的转化, 与类胡萝卜素本身的合成无关, 两个标签指向不同的东西, 并不冲突。在这条轴上, beta-carotene 补充剂没有可补的缺口, 成败完全取决于它所宣称终点的试验结果。

Pathway合成通路NOT APPLICABLE. Humans have no carotenoid biosynthetic pathway and no homologue of any step in the algal, plant and microbial routes. Human enzymology is cleavage only, converting dietary provitamin A carotenoids into retinoids.NOT APPLICABLE。人体没有类胡萝卜素生物合成通路, 藻类, 植物和微生物路线中的任何步骤在人体内都没有同源物。人体酶学只做裂解, 把膳食中的维生素 A 原类胡萝卜素转为类视黄醇。

Amount made自产量0 mg/day. Humans have no carotenoid biosynthetic pathway.0 mg/day。人体没有类胡萝卜素生物合成通路。

Still matters when仍有意义的情形As a provitamin A source where vitamin A intake is low, which is a dietary argument rather than a synthesis one. High-dose beta-carotene sits in the carotenoid class the recovered prose says to hold during active cytotoxic therapy: in SWOG S0221, antioxidant supplement use (vitamins A, C, E, carotenoids, CoQ10) before and during treatment was associated with higher recurrence (adjusted HR 1.41, 95% CI 0.98 to 2.04). Otherwise NEVER ON THIS AXIS, since with no requirement and no deficiency state, dose selection is entirely empirical.作为维生素 A 摄入偏低时的维生素 A 原来源, 这属于膳食层面的理由, 与合成无关。高剂量 beta-carotene 属于恢复文本要求在细胞毒治疗期间暂停的类胡萝卜素一类: 在 SWOG S0221 中, 治疗前和治疗期间使用抗氧化补充剂 (维生素 A, C, E, 类胡萝卜素, CoQ10) 与更高复发率相关 (校正 HR 1.41, 95% CI 0.98 到 2.04)。除此之外 NEVER ON THIS AXIS, 既没有需要量也没有缺乏状态, 剂量选择完全是经验性的。

Synthesis source合成来源Derived using this dataset's classification rules from the recovered entry Astaxanthin (PMID 24402174, Ambati et al., Mar Drugs 2014;12:128-152), which states that humans synthesise no carotenoids whatsoever and gives 0 mg/day; the conversion side from Niacin, choline, omega-3 EPA and DHA, vitamin A from beta-carotene, vitamin K2 (MK-4), inositol and from Cod liver oil; the chemotherapy caution and SWOG S0221 figures from Antioxidants during chemotherapy.

Refs.文献 ATBC PMID 8127329; CARET PMID 8602180; Cochrane Bjelakovic PMID 22419320; USPSTF PMID 35727271

Verdict结论Avoid不要吃
Evidence证据Grade AA 级
Dose tested已验证剂量No effective preventive dose exists. 400 IU/d was the harmful dose. ATBC low-dose 50 mg/d produced neither benefit nor lung cancer harm.不存在有效的预防剂量。400 IU/天是有害剂量。ATBC 中 50 毫克/天的低剂量既无获益也未增加肺癌。
Who适用人群Documented deficiency, which in practice means fat malabsorption: abetalipoproteinaemia, cholestatic liver disease, cystic fibrosis, short bowel.已证实的缺乏，实际上指脂肪吸收不良：无β脂蛋白血症、胆汁淤积性肝病、囊性纤维化、短肠。
Pros优点
  • Ataxia with vitamin E deficiency requires high-dose replacement, and that is a genuine indication.维生素 E 缺乏性共济失调需要大剂量替代治疗，这是一个真实的适应证。
  • There is a narrow niche in biopsy-proven non-diabetic non-alcoholic steatohepatitis, where 800 IU/d improved histology in the PIVENS trial. That is a hepatology decision, not a self-care one.在活检证实的非糖尿病性非酒精性脂肪性肝炎中有一个狭窄的适用面，PIVENS 试验中 800 IU/天改善了组织学表现。那是肝病科的决定，不是自我保健。
Cons缺点
  • A dose-response meta-analysis of 19 trials and 135,967 participants found high-dose trials produced 39 additional deaths per 10,000 persons (95% CI 3 to 74, P=0.035). Low-dose trials showed -16 per 10,000.一项纳入 19 项试验、135967 名受试者的剂量效应 meta 分析发现，高剂量试验每 1 万人多出 39 例死亡（95% CI 3 至 74，P=0.035）。低剂量试验为每万人 -16 例。
  • SELECT (n=34,887 men): 400 IU/d of synthetic all-rac-alpha-tocopheryl acetate raised prostate cancer incidence by 17%, HR 1.17 (99% CI 1.004-1.36, P=0.008). The excess emerged in extended follow-up after supplementation had already stopped.SELECT（34887 名男性）：400 IU/天的合成全消旋α-生育酚醋酸酯使前列腺癌发病率升高 17%，HR 1.17（99% CI 1.004-1.36，P=0.008）。这个超出部分是在补充已经停止后的延长随访中出现的。
  • Haemorrhagic stroke RR 1.22 (1.00-1.48) across 9 trials and 118,765 participants, which is one additional haemorrhagic stroke per 1,250 people treated.9 项试验、118765 名受试者中出血性卒中 RR 1.22（1.00-1.48），相当于每治疗 1250 人多出 1 例出血性卒中。
  • Contraindicated with warfarin, direct oral anticoagulants, aspirin, clopidogrel and other antiplatelets, because impaired coagulation is the endpoint EFSA used to set its limit.与华法林、直接口服抗凝药、阿司匹林、氯吡格雷及其他抗血小板药禁用，因为 EFSA 设定上限所依据的终点正是凝血功能受损。
  • USPSTF grade D. Note the limits diverge sharply: 1,000 mg/d supplemental alpha-tocopherol in the US, but 300 mg/d from ALL sources in the EU.USPSTF 为 D 级。注意上限差异悬殊：美国为补充剂α-生育酚 1000 毫克/天，而欧盟为全部来源合计 300 毫克/天。
What it does, and what happens without it它有什么作用，缺了会怎样

The body's main fat-soluble antioxidant, protecting cell membranes and nerves from oxidative damage.人体主要的脂溶性抗氧化剂，保护细胞膜和神经免受氧化损伤。

Named deficiency disease有明确的缺乏症 Partly reversible部分可逆

In detail详细Alpha-tocopherol is the only form of vitamin E the body retains. After absorption, hepatic alpha-tocopherol transfer protein (TTPA) selectively loads alpha-tocopherol onto VLDL for export to tissues, while the other tocopherols and the tocotrienols are metabolised and excreted. Its established function is to break the chain reaction of lipid peroxidation in the polyunsaturated fatty acids of cell membranes and lipoproteins, donating a hydrogen atom to lipid peroxyl radicals and then being regenerated by ascorbate. The tissues that suffer first without it are peripheral nerve axons, the posterior columns and cerebellum, the retina, and the erythrocyte membrane. Converting the dose properly (1 mg alpha-tocopherol = 1.49 IU natural-source RRR, 2.22 IU synthetic all-rac), 400 IU is 268 mg of natural-source or 180 mg of synthetic alpha-tocopherol, roughly 12 to 18 times the adult RDA of 15 mg/d depending on which form the product uses, so at that level it is being used pharmacologically rather than to correct any dietary shortfall.α-生育酚是人体唯一保留的维生素E形式。吸收后，肝脏中的α-生育酚转运蛋白（TTPA）选择性地将α-生育酚装载到VLDL上以输送至各组织，而其余的生育酚及生育三烯酚则被代谢并排出。其确立的功能是阻断细胞膜及脂蛋白中多不饱和脂肪酸的脂质过氧化链式反应，向脂质过氧自由基提供一个氢原子，随后由抗坏血酸再生。缺乏时最先受损的组织是周围神经轴突、脊髓后索和小脑、视网膜以及红细胞膜。按正确换算（1 mg α-生育酚=1.49 IU天然来源RRR型，或2.22 IU合成all-rac型），400 IU相当于268 mg天然来源或180 mg合成α-生育酚，约为成人RDA（15 mg/d）的12至18倍，具体倍数取决于产品所用的形式，因此该剂量已是药理性使用，超出了纠正膳食摄入不足所需的范围。

Deficiency disease缺乏症No classic single-name disease. The recognised syndrome is vitamin E deficiency ataxia, a spinocerebellar degeneration with peripheral neuropathy and pigmentary retinopathy; in preterm infants it presents as haemolytic anaemia of prematurity. Ataxia with isolated vitamin E deficiency (AVED) produces the same clinical picture but is an inherited TTPA gene defect, not a dietary deficiency.没有单一命名的经典疾病。公认的综合征是维生素E缺乏性共济失调，一种伴周围神经病变和色素性视网膜病变的脊髓小脑变性；早产儿则表现为早产儿溶血性贫血。孤立性维生素E缺乏性共济失调（AVED）临床表现相同，但其病因是遗传性TTPA基因缺陷，并非由膳食缺乏引起。

First signs早期表现Plasma alpha-tocopherol below roughly 12 micromol/L, or a low tocopherol-to-total-lipid ratio, precedes symptoms by months to years and is the practical marker. The first clinical signs are loss of ankle reflexes and reduced vibration and joint position sense in the feet, sometimes with unsteady walking in the dark. In preterm infants, a haemolytic anaemia with raised reticulocytes.血浆α-生育酚低于约12 micromol/L，或生育酚与总脂质比值偏低，通常先于症状出现数月至数年，是实用的监测指标。最早的临床体征是踝反射消失，以及足部振动觉和关节位置觉减退，有时伴暗处行走不稳。早产儿则表现为溶血性贫血伴网织红细胞升高。

Untreated不治疗会怎样Untreated, it progresses to a combined spinocerebellar and sensory picture: ataxia from posterior column degeneration, dysarthria, ophthalmoplegia, head titubation, proximal weakness, and pigmentary retinopathy with declining visual acuity. The endpoint is a person who can no longer walk unaided, with fixed sensory ataxia and neuropathy.若不治疗，将进展为脊髓小脑及感觉联合受损的表现：后索变性所致共济失调、构音障碍、眼肌麻痹、头部震颤、近端肌无力，以及伴视力下降的色素性视网膜病变。终末阶段患者无法独立行走，遗留固定性感觉性共济失调和神经病变。

Does it reverse补回来能修复吗High-dose repletion reliably halts progression, and when started early (within roughly a year of symptom onset, or before symptoms in a child with known malabsorption) much of the neuropathy recovers. Long-standing posterior column and cerebellar degeneration and established retinopathy usually do not fully resolve, so treatment prevents more than it restores.大剂量补充能可靠地阻止病情进展，若在早期开始治疗（症状出现后约一年内，或在已知吸收不良的患儿出现症状之前），大部分神经病变可恢复。长期存在的脊髓后索和小脑变性以及已形成的视网膜病变通常无法完全恢复，因此治疗的作用重在预防，已造成的损害难以逆转。

Who becomes deficient谁会缺乏Almost exclusively people who cannot absorb fat: cystic fibrosis, cholestatic liver disease and biliary atresia, short bowel syndrome, chronic pancreatitis, abetalipoproteinaemia and homozygous hypobetalipoproteinaemia. Preterm and very low birth weight infants. Separately, people with the inherited TTPA defect (AVED), which is a genetic transport disorder rather than a consequence of diet. In an adult with normal fat absorption, eating too little vitamin E essentially does not produce clinical deficiency. At the 400 IU/d dose this entry names, the established direction of effect is harm rather than repletion: in SELECT, 400 IU/d of alpha-tocopherol raised prostate cancer incidence in healthy men (HR 1.17, 99% CI 1.004-1.36; PMID 21990298).几乎仅见于脂肪吸收障碍者：囊性纤维化、胆汁淤积性肝病及胆道闭锁、短肠综合征、慢性胰腺炎、无β脂蛋白血症及纯合子低β脂蛋白血症。早产儿及极低出生体重儿。另外还有遗传性TTPA缺陷（AVED）患者，这是一种遗传性转运障碍，与膳食无关。脂肪吸收正常的成人，即使维生素E摄入过少，基本上也不会产生临床缺乏。就本条目所指400 IU/d剂量而言，已确立的效应方向是危害，并非补充效果：在SELECT试验中，400 IU/d α-生育酚使健康男性前列腺癌发生率升高（HR 1.17，99% CI 1.004-1.36；PMID 21990298）。

How common有多常见NOT ESTABLISHED for frank clinical deficiency, which is rare enough in the general population that no meaningful prevalence figure exists. The widely quoted claim that over 90% of Americans fail to meet the estimated average requirement for alpha-tocopherol is an intake statistic, not a deficiency rate, and no corresponding burden of neurological disease accompanies it (doi:10.3945/an.114.006254). Biochemical deficiency is common in untreated cystic fibrosis and cholestatic liver disease.明显临床缺乏无确切数据，在普通人群中足够罕见，因此没有有意义的患病率数据。广为引用的说法称超过90%美国人的α-生育酚摄入未达到平均需要量估计值，这只是摄入量统计，不是缺乏率，也没有相应的神经系统疾病负担伴随（doi:10.3945/an.114.006254）。未经治疗的囊性纤维化和胆汁淤积性肝病患者中，生化性缺乏较为常见。

Food and the body食物与身体
In food: Rich食物中：丰富 Dose from food: Out of reach靠吃达到剂量：达不到 Body makes it: Cannot身体自产：不能 Food data: Medium食物数据：中

Alpha-tocopherol is abundant in ordinary foods: seed and nut oils, sunflower seeds, almonds, hazelnuts, paprika and wheatgerm all supply meaningful amounts, and a normal diet covers the 15 mg/day RDA without effort. This is the clearest case in the group where the two questions come apart, because the nutrient is genuinely rich in food while the dose that defines this item is not obtainable from any diet. The original single RICH label sat directly above the entry's own sentence saying the dose 'cannot be reached by eating', which is why the two answers are now separated.α-生育酚在普通食物里很充足：籽油和坚果油、葵花籽、杏仁、榛子、红椒粉和小麦胚芽都能提供可观的量，普通饮食毫不费力就能覆盖 15 mg/天 的 RDA。本组中这一条最清楚地显示出两个问题会分开作答：这种营养素在食物中确实丰富，而定义本条目的那个剂量任何饮食都无法达到。原先单一的 RICH 标签，正好压在该条目自己那句“靠吃达不到”的话上面，因此现在把两个答案分开。

To match the dose要达到该剂量400 IU of natural vitamin E is 268 mg of RRR-alpha-tocopherol. Reaching that every day from food means about 762 g of sunflower seeds (roughly 4,450 kcal), or 1.05 kg of almonds, or 179 g of wheatgerm oil (about 13 tablespoons of neat oil), or 550 g of sunflower oil at the CoFID value and 654 g at USDA's lower one. If the capsule is synthetic all-rac (180 mg for 400 IU), it is still 512 g of sunflower seeds or about 8.9 tablespoons of wheatgerm oil daily. Habitual intakes cluster around 5 to 20 mg/day, so 400 IU sits one to two orders of magnitude above anything eating produces. No dietary pattern gets there.400 IU 天然维生素 E 等于 268 mg RRR-α-生育酚。每天从食物达到这个量，意味着约 762 g 葵花籽（约 4,450 kcal），或 1.05 kg 杏仁，或 179 g 小麦胚芽油（约 13 汤匙纯油），或按 CoFID 数值 550 g 葵花籽油、按 USDA 较低数值 654 g。如果胶囊是合成的 all-rac 形式（400 IU 对应 180 mg），每天仍需 512 g 葵花籽，或约 8.9 汤匙小麦胚芽油。习惯摄入量集中在 5 至 20 mg/天，400 IU 比吃出来的任何量高出一到两个数量级。没有任何饮食模式能达到。

Food vs supplement食物与补充剂Most 400 IU capsules contain all-rac-alpha-tocopheryl acetate, a synthetic mixture of eight stereoisomers of which only one eighth is the RRR form that human alpha-tocopherol transfer protein preferentially retains. Food contains only RRR, which is exactly why the label conversions differ (1 IU = 0.67 mg natural against 0.45 mg synthetic). Food also never delivers alpha-tocopherol in isolation: sunflower oil carries 48.7 mg alpha with 5.1 mg gamma per 100 g, rapeseed oil carries 18.4 mg alpha with 38.0 mg gamma (CoFID 17-045 and 17-041, both unconfirmed), red palm oil is tocotrienol-rich, and nuts add tocotrienols too. High-dose alpha-tocopherol actively removes part of what food supplies: 400 IU/day of RRR-alpha-tocopheryl acetate cut serum gamma-tocopherol by a median 58% (95% CI 51 to 66%) and reduced detectable delta-tocopherol in a two-month randomised placebo-controlled trial of 184 adult nonsmokers (Huang HY and Appel LJ, J Nutr 2003;133:3137-40, PMID 14519797, all elements confirmed). A 400 IU capsule is therefore something other than a concentrated handful of sunflower seeds; it shifts the balance of vitamin E forms in blood in a direction food never does.多数 400 IU 胶囊装的是 all-rac-α-生育酚乙酸酯，这是八种立体异构体的合成混合物，其中只有八分之一是人体 α-生育酚转运蛋白优先保留的 RRR 型。食物中只有 RRR 型，标签换算因此不同（天然型 1 IU = 0.67 mg，合成型 1 IU = 0.45 mg）。食物也从不单独提供 α-生育酚：葵花籽油每 100 g 含 48.7 mg α 和 5.1 mg γ，菜籽油含 18.4 mg α 和 38.0 mg γ（CoFID 17-045 和 17-041，均未证实），红棕油富含生育三烯酚，坚果也会带来生育三烯酚。大剂量 α-生育酚会主动清掉食物提供的一部分东西：在一项为期两个月、纳入 184 名成年非吸烟者的随机安慰剂对照试验中，每天 400 IU 的 RRR-α-生育酚乙酸酯使血清 γ-生育酚中位数下降 58%（95% CI 51 至 66%），并减少可检出的 δ-生育酚（Huang HY 与 Appel LJ，J Nutr 2003;133:3137-40，PMID 14519797，各项要素均已确认）。因此一粒 400 IU 胶囊与一把浓缩的葵花籽是两回事，它把血液中各种维生素 E 形式的比例推向食物从不会推的方向。

Absorption吸收Alpha-tocopherol needs dietary fat and bile for absorption, which nuts and oils supply intrinsically, so food forms are absorbed efficiently in ordinary meals. Fractional absorption falls as the single dose rises, and hepatic alpha-TTP selectively retains only the 2R stereoisomers, so the 2S half of a synthetic all-rac dose is largely excreted. The useful fraction of a 400 IU synthetic capsule is therefore well below its stated IU, plasma alpha-tocopherol does not scale linearly with dose, and the displacement of gamma- and delta-tocopherol documented by Huang et al. (PMID 14519797) does.α-生育酚的吸收需要膳食脂肪和胆汁，坚果和油脂本身就自带这些，所以在普通餐食中食物形式吸收效率不错。单次剂量越大，吸收分数越低；肝脏的 α-TTP 只选择性保留 2R 立体异构体，因此合成 all-rac 剂量中占一半的 2S 部分大体被排出。这就使 400 IU 合成胶囊真正有用的比例远低于其标称 IU，血浆 α-生育酚不随剂量线性上升，而 Huang 等（PMID 14519797）记录的 γ-生育酚和 δ-生育酚被置换的现象确实随剂量上升。

Food data note食物数据说明Six of the food values were checkable against USDA and have been replaced or ranged, so the corrected list is USDA-anchored where it matters most. The dose arithmetic is the strongest part of the item: the 268 mg and 180 mg conversions and every food requirement recompute exactly, and the conclusion is insensitive to residual uncertainty of a few tens of percent. Against that, the sunflower oil figure is unverifiable, several added foods (hazelnut, almond, safflower and cottonseed oils, paprika, peanuts, corn and soybean oils) rest on single indicative figures from the verification report, and the remaining CoFID rows could not be confirmed中。六个食物数值可以与 USDA 对照，已经替换或改为范围，所以在最要紧的地方，修正后的清单以 USDA 为锚。剂量算术是本条目最扎实的部分：268 mg 和 180 mg 的换算以及每一项食物需求量都能精确重算，几十个百分点的残余不确定性也不影响结论。另一方面，葵花籽油的数值无法核实，几种新增食物（榛子油、杏仁油、红花籽油和棉籽油、红椒粉、花生、玉米油和大豆油）依赖核查报告中的单一指示性数字，其余 CoFID 行也无法确认。

Does the body make it身体是否自产Alpha-tocopherol is entirely dietary: humans carry no tocopherol or tocotrienol biosynthetic pathway, and human enzymology handles absorption with dietary fat, hepatic selection of the alpha-tocopherol form and lipoprotein transport only. NONE here does imply a requirement, and a deficiency state exists, described in the recovered prose in fat malabsorption and abetalipoproteinaemia. The axis therefore supports correcting a documented shortfall and gives no argument for 400 IU/d and above, which is a pharmacological antioxidant dose to be judged on its own trial and risk record.alpha-tocopherol 完全依赖膳食: 人体没有 tocopherol 或 tocotrienol 的合成通路, 人体酶学只负责随膳食脂肪的吸收, 肝脏对 alpha-tocopherol 形式的选择以及脂蛋白转运。这里的 NONE 确实意味着必需, 并且存在缺乏状态, 恢复文本把它写在脂肪吸收不良和 abetalipoproteinaemia 中。因此这条轴支持纠正有记录的不足, 对 400 IU/d 及以上没有任何依据, 那属于药理性抗氧化剂量, 应按其自身的试验与风险记录判断。

Pathway合成通路NOT APPLICABLE. Humans have no tocopherol biosynthetic pathway; tocopherols and tocotrienols are made by plants and other photosynthetic organisms. Human handling covers intestinal absorption with dietary fat, hepatic selection of the alpha-tocopherol form and lipoprotein transport, with no synthetic step at any point.NOT APPLICABLE。人体没有 tocopherol 合成通路, tocopherols 与 tocotrienols 由植物和其他光合生物合成。人体只处理随膳食脂肪的肠道吸收, 肝脏对 alpha-tocopherol 形式的选择以及脂蛋白转运, 全过程没有任何合成步骤。

Amount made自产量0 mg/day synthesised, since no human biosynthetic pathway exists. The 400 IU/d in the name is a supplement dose; the recovered prose quotes no dietary reference value for vitamin E, so none is asserted here.合成量 0 mg/day, 人体不存在相应生物合成通路。名称中的 400 IU/d 是补充剂量; 恢复的文本没有给出维生素 E 的膳食参考值, 这里也不臆造。

Still matters when仍有意义的情形Documented vitamin E deficiency, which the recovered prose ties to fat malabsorption and abetalipoproteinaemia. During active cytotoxic chemotherapy the default is to hold high-dose antioxidant supplements: in SWOG S0221, self-reported use of any antioxidant supplement (vitamins A, C, E, carotenoids, CoQ10) both before and during treatment was associated with a higher recurrence rate (adjusted HR 1.41, 95% CI 0.98 to 2.04). For 400 IU/d and above in a well-nourished person, NEVER ON THIS AXIS.有记录的维生素 E 缺乏, 恢复文本把它与脂肪吸收不良和 abetalipoproteinaemia 联系在一起。细胞毒化疗期间的默认做法是暂停高剂量抗氧化补充剂: 在 SWOG S0221 中, 治疗前和治疗期间自报使用任一抗氧化补充剂 (维生素 A, C, E, 类胡萝卜素, CoQ10) 与更高复发率相关 (校正 HR 1.41, 95% CI 0.98 到 2.04)。对营养良好的人, 400 IU/d 及以上 NEVER ON THIS AXIS。

Synthesis source合成来源Derived using this dataset's classification rules (NONE = no human biosynthetic pathway) from two recovered entries: BCAAs sold separately, and B12, folate, thiamine, riboflavin, B6, biotin, pantothenate and vitamin E, which scores vitamin E NONE, and Antioxidants during chemotherapy, which states that alpha-tocopherol is entirely dietary and supplies the SWOG S0221 figures and the fat malabsorption and abetalipoproteinaemia deficiency settings.

AAAAFFDDBBXXSelenium at 200 µg/d硒 200 微克/天
Verdict结论Avoid不要吃
Evidence证据Grade AA 级
Dose tested已验证剂量RDA is 55 µg/d and food intake meets it in most Western diets. 200 µg/d is the dose used in the failed and harmful trials.推荐摄入量为 55 微克/天，多数西方饮食通过食物即可满足。200 微克/天是那些失败并有害的试验所用剂量。
Who适用人群People with genuinely low selenium status: low-soil regions, long-term parenteral nutrition, severe malabsorption.硒状态确实偏低的人：土壤低硒地区、长期肠外营养、严重吸收不良。
Pros优点
  • It prevents Keshan disease, a selenium-deficiency cardiomyopathy, in genuinely deficient populations. That is a real and important indication.在确实缺硒的人群中，它能预防克山病，一种缺硒性心肌病。这是一个真实且重要的适应证。
  • There is a Grade B signal for mild Graves orbitopathy in selenium-suboptimal European populations at 200 µg/d for 6 months, resting on a single 159-patient trial.在硒偏低的欧洲人群中，200 微克/天服 6 个月对轻度 Graves 眼病有一个 B 级信号，依据是一项 159 名患者的单一试验。
Cons缺点
  • Cochrane, 10 randomised trials and 27,232 participants: any cancer RR 1.01 (0.93-1.10) from the low-risk-of-bias studies. That is HIGH-certainty evidence of NO benefit. The cancer-prevention reputation rests on a secondary endpoint of a 1996 skin cancer trial that was not designed to test it.Cochrane 纳入 10 项随机试验、27232 名受试者：在低偏倚风险研究中，任何癌症 RR 1.01（0.93-1.10）。这是高确定性地证明无获益。它的防癌名声建立在 1996 年一项皮肤癌试验的次要终点上，而那项试验并非为此设计。
  • SELECT (n=35,533 men, 200 µg/d L-selenomethionine) found prostate cancer HR 1.09 (99% CI 0.93-1.27). No preventive effect, and the trial stopped early for futility.SELECT（35533 名男性，200 微克/天 L-硒代甲硫氨酸）显示前列腺癌 HR 1.09（99% CI 0.93-1.27）。没有预防作用，试验因无效提前终止。
  • Incident type 2 diabetes hazard ratio 1.55 (1.03-2.33) over a mean 7.7 years at 200 µg/d, with excess risk concentrated in those already in the highest tertile of baseline plasma selenium. This harm appears at HALF the US upper limit.在 200 微克/天下，平均 7.7 年内新发 2 型糖尿病风险比为 1.55（1.03-2.33），超额风险集中在基线血浆硒本已处于最高三分位的人身上。这个危害出现在美国上限的一半剂量处。
  • The therapeutic window is narrow. EFSA lowered its upper limit to 255 µg/d in 2023 with alopecia as the critical endpoint, and derived its lowest-observed-adverse-effect level of 330 µg/d from the SELECT trial itself.治疗窗很窄。EFSA 于 2023 年把上限下调至 255 微克/天，关键终点为脱发，其 330 微克/天的最低可观察不良作用水平正是取自 SELECT 试验本身。
  • Stacking is how people get there: a 200 µg tablet on top of a multivitamin containing 55-70 µg plus dietary intake.人们正是通过叠加达到这个剂量的：一片 200 微克的硒，加上含 55 至 70 微克的复合维生素，再加饮食摄入。
What it does, and what happens without it它有什么作用，缺了会怎样

Selenium builds the enzymes that mop up oxidative damage and switch on thyroid hormone.硒构成清除氧化损伤和激活甲状腺激素的酶系统。

Named deficiency disease有明确的缺乏症 Partly reversible部分可逆

In detail详细Selenium is incorporated as the amino acid selenocysteine into about 25 human selenoproteins. The glutathione peroxidases (GPX1 to GPX4) reduce hydrogen peroxide and lipid hydroperoxides, GPX4 specifically preventing ferroptotic membrane damage. Thioredoxin reductases maintain cellular redox state and support DNA synthesis. The iodothyronine deiodinases convert T4 to active T3, which links selenium status to thyroid function. Selenoprotein P is the plasma transport form and the best status marker. The dose in this entry matters. Plasma glutathione peroxidase (GPX3) plateaus near 55 micrograms per day, which is what the RDA is built on. Selenoprotein P plateaus somewhere in the range of roughly 50 to 105 micrograms per day depending on baseline status: about 49 micrograms per day in selenium-deficient Chinese subjects, against about 105 micrograms per day of total intake in UK adults (a 50 microgram supplement on top of roughly 55 micrograms habitual). Either way, 200 micrograms per day supplies three to four times the adult RDA and produces no further enzyme activity in someone already replete, while sitting halfway to the tolerable upper limit of 400 micrograms per day. In the Nutritional Prevention of Cancer trial, 200 micrograms per day for a mean 7.7 years raised type 2 diabetes incidence (hazard ratio 1.55, 95% CI 1.03 to 2.33), concentrated in participants who started in the highest baseline selenium tertile (hazard ratio 2.70).硒以硒代半胱氨酸(selenocysteine)的形式掺入约25种人体硒蛋白中。谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶(GPX1至GPX4)可还原过氧化氢和脂质氢过氧化物,其中GPX4特异性地防止铁死亡相关的膜损伤。硫氧还蛋白还原酶(thioredoxin reductase)维持细胞氧化还原状态并支持DNA合成。碘甲腺原氨酸脱碘酶(iodothyronine deiodinase)将T4转化为活性T3,这将硒的状态与甲状腺功能联系起来。硒蛋白P(selenoprotein P)是血浆中的转运形式,也是评估硒状态的最佳指标。本条目中的剂量至关重要。血浆谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶(GPX3)在每日约55微克摄入时达到平台,这正是每日推荐摄入量(RDA)的依据。硒蛋白P的平台值因基线状态而异,大致在每日50至105微克之间:在硒缺乏的中国受试者中约为每日49微克,而在英国成人中总摄入量约为每日105微克(在约55微克习惯摄入基础上加50微克补充剂)。无论按哪个指标,每日200微克都相当于成人RDA的三到四倍,对于已经硒充足的人不会带来任何进一步的酶活性提升,同时已达到每日400微克可耐受最高摄入量的一半。在Nutritional Prevention of Cancer(营养预防癌症)试验中,平均7.7年每日200微克使2型糖尿病发病率上升(风险比1.55,95%置信区间1.03至2.33),这一效应集中在基线硒水平处于最高三分位的受试者中(风险比2.70)。

Deficiency disease缺乏症Keshan disease, an endemic cardiomyopathy. Kashin-Beck disease, an endemic osteoarthropathy, occurs in the same low-selenium regions and is associated with, though not fully explained by, selenium deficiency.克山病(一种地方性心肌病)。大骨节病(Kashin-Beck disease,一种地方性骨关节病)见于同样的低硒地区,与缺硒相关,但并不能完全用缺硒解释。

First signs早期表现Plasma selenium and glutathione peroxidase activity fall with no symptoms at all. In endemic areas, subclinical ECG abnormalities and reduced ejection fraction appear before overt illness, which is how latent Keshan disease is detected on screening. Isolated cases outside endemic areas typically surface as unexplained myopathy, muscle pain, or whitened nail beds.血浆硒和谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶活性下降,但完全没有症状。在地方病流行区,亚临床心电图异常和射血分数下降会先于明显疾病出现,这也是通过筛查发现潜在克山病的方式。流行区之外的散发病例通常表现为不明原因的肌病、肌痛或甲床发白。

Untreated不治疗会怎样Keshan disease presents acutely with cardiogenic shock and arrhythmia, or chronically as congestive cardiomyopathy with cardiac enlargement and multifocal myocardial necrosis and fibrosis. It classically strikes children and women of childbearing age in low-soil-selenium areas and is fatal without treatment. A coxsackievirus co-factor is thought to trigger the acute form in a selenium-depleted host. Kashin-Beck disease destroys growth-plate and articular cartilage, producing shortened fingers, deformed ankles, knees, wrists and elbows, and permanently limited movement.克山病急性发作时表现为心源性休克和心律失常,慢性表现为充血性心肌病,伴心脏扩大及多灶性心肌坏死和纤维化。该病典型地侵袭低土壤硒地区的儿童和育龄期女性,若不治疗可致命。柯萨奇病毒被认为是在硒耗竭宿主中触发急性型的协同因素。大骨节病破坏生长板和关节软骨,导致手指变短、踝、膝、腕、肘关节畸形,并造成永久性活动受限。

Does it reverse补回来能修复吗Early Keshan disease responds well to selenium replacement, and heart failure can improve substantially or resolve if caught before the myocardium is remodelled. Once dilated cardiomyopathy with established fibrosis has developed, the myocardial damage does not fully reverse and outcomes are poor. Kashin-Beck cartilage necrosis and the resulting joint deformity are permanent. Prophylactic sodium selenite in endemic Chinese counties prevented new cases, which is the clearest evidence the causal direction is right.早期克山病对补硒反应良好,若在心肌发生重塑之前发现,心力衰竭可显著改善甚至消退。一旦发展为伴有明确纤维化的扩张型心肌病,心肌损伤就不能完全逆转,预后较差。大骨节病造成的软骨坏死及由此产生的关节畸形是永久性的。在中国地方病流行县实施预防性亚硒酸钠干预可预防新发病例,这是因果关系方向正确的最有力证据。

Who becomes deficient谁会缺乏Residents of low-selenium soil belts, chiefly the diagonal band across China from the northeast to the southwest, plus parts of Siberia. Long-term parenteral nutrition without added selenium. Severe malabsorption, short bowel, and cystic fibrosis. Dialysis patients. Dietary selenium deficiency is not a realistic concern for anyone eating a mixed diet in North America, where soil selenium is high; two Brazil nuts alone exceed the adult RDA.低硒土壤带的居民,主要是中国从东北到西南的对角带地区,以及西伯利亚部分地区。长期未添加硒的肠外营养支持者。严重吸收不良、短肠综合征和囊性纤维化患者。透析患者。对于在北美这种土壤硒含量高的地区摄入混合膳食的人来说,饮食性缺硒不是现实的担忧;仅两颗巴西坚果的硒含量就超过成人RDA。

How common有多常见NOT ESTABLISHED as a current global figure. Keshan disease was endemic across a defined low-selenium region of China and has been reduced to near-zero incidence since selenite supplementation and food-supply changes began in the 1970s. Dietary selenium deficiency is essentially absent in the United States, where median intake already exceeds the RDA from food alone.目前尚无确切数据可作为全球性数字。克山病曾在中国一个明确界定的低硒地区呈地方性流行,自20世纪70年代开始补充亚硒酸钠及改变食物供应以来,发病率已降至接近零。在美国,单是食物来源的硒摄入量中位数就已超过RDA,饮食性缺硒基本不存在。

Source来源Stranges S et al., Ann Intern Med 2007;147:217-223, PMID 17620655 (200 µg/d and type 2 diabetes, NPC trial); Hurst R et al., Am J Clin Nutr 2010, 'Establishing optimal selenium status', PMID 20181815 (selenoprotein P plateau in UK adults); Xia Y et al., selenoprotein P optimisation in selenium-deficient Chinese subjects, PMC2921536; Rayman MP, Lancet 2012;379:1256-1268; Keshan Disease, StatPearls, NCBI Bookshelf NBK603722; Institute of Medicine DRI for selenium (RDA 55 µg/d, UL 400 µg/d).

Food and the body食物与身体
In food: Rich食物中：丰富 Dose from food: Reachable靠吃达到剂量：可达到 Body makes it: Cannot身体自产：不能 Food data: High食物数据：高

Selenium is genuinely abundant in ordinary food, and offal and marine fish carry it most reliably: braised pork kidney is 312 ug per 100 g, braised lamb kidney 219 ug, cooked yellowfin tuna 108 ug and braised lamb's liver 111 ug. Brazil nuts are the richest known food source at a USDA average of 1,920 ug/100 g, about 96 ug in a single 5 g kernel, which makes them the one food where a supplement dose is met by two nuts, and that is a hazard rather than a reassurance because their selenium is set by the soil the tree grew in and varies more than thirty-fold between Amazon regions. Reference points used in the table: EFSA AI 70 ug/d for adults, and the EFSA tolerable upper intake level of 255 ug/d for adult men and women including pregnancy and lactation, set from alopecia as the critical endpoint with a LOAEL of 330 ug/d taken from the SELECT trial and an uncertainty factor of 1.3 (EFSA Journal 2023;21(1):e07704, DOI 10.2903/j.efsa.2023.7704; AI from EFSA, Dietary Reference Values for nutrients Summary report, doi 10.2903/sp.efsa.2017.e15121, Tables 5 and 7). The 200 ug/d dose comes from two landmark trials: selenised yeast in the Nutritional Prevention of Cancer trial and 200 ug/d L-selenomethionine in SELECT.硒在普通食物中确实丰富，内脏和海鱼提供得最稳定：炖猪肾每 100 g 含 312 ug，炖羊肾 219 ug，熟黄鳍金枪鱼 108 ug，炖羊肝 111 ug。巴西坚果是已知最富硒的食物，USDA 平均值为每 100 g 1,920 ug，单个 5 g 果仁约 96 ug，这使它成为唯一两颗就能达到补充剂剂量的食物，而这一点值得警惕，谈不上让人放心，因为其硒含量由树木生长的土壤决定，在亚马逊各地区之间相差三十多倍。表中使用的参考值：EFSA 成人 AI 70 ug/d；EFSA 可耐受最高摄入量为成年男性和女性 255 ug/d，包括孕期和哺乳期，以脱发为关键终点，取自 SELECT 试验的 LOAEL 330 ug/d 并使用 1.3 的不确定系数（EFSA Journal 2023;21(1):e07704，DOI 10.2903/j.efsa.2023.7704；AI 来自 EFSA，Dietary Reference Values for nutrients Summary report，doi 10.2903/sp.efsa.2017.e15121，表 5 和表 7）。200 ug/d 这一剂量来自两项标志性试验：Nutritional Prevention of Cancer 试验中的富硒酵母，以及 SELECT 中的 200 ug/d L-硒代甲硫氨酸。

To match the dose要达到该剂量There is almost no gap, and that is the finding. 200 ug/d is met by 2.1 average Brazil nuts (10 g), or 64 g of braised pork kidney, or 91 g of braised lamb kidney, or 185 g of cooked yellowfin tuna, or 180 g of braised lamb's liver, or 223 g of cooked blue mussels, or 243 g of simmered chicken liver, or 263 g of canned light tuna in oil, or 532 g of cooked cod, or 4 tins of sardines, or 13 eggs. Kidney and Brazil nuts overshoot in one normal portion: an 85 g portion of braised pork kidney is 265 ug, already 133 percent of the supplement dose and above the EFSA upper level on its own, and an 85 g portion of braised lamb kidney is 186 ug, 93 percent of the dose. Because the dose is so easy to reach, the useful calculation runs the other way. The EFSA AI is 70 ug/d and the EFSA upper level is 255 ug/d, a working margin of about 185 ug. A person on a 200 ug/d supplement plus an ordinary diet is at roughly 270 ug and already over the upper level; add two average Brazil nuts and they are at about 462 ug. The UL derives from alopecia observed in SELECT at a LOAEL of 330 ug/d, so this is an observed human effect at achievable intakes rather than a theoretical ceiling (DOI 10.2903/j.efsa.2023.7704). Selenium is the case where food easily matches the supplement, and the honest advice is to pick one route.几乎没有缺口，这本身就是结论。200 ug/d 可由 2.1 颗平均水平的巴西坚果（10 g）达到，或 64 g 炖猪肾、91 g 炖羊肾、185 g 熟黄鳍金枪鱼、180 g 炖羊肝、223 g 熟蓝贻贝、243 g 文火煮鸡肝、263 g 油浸罐装淡金枪鱼、532 g 熟鳕鱼、4 罐沙丁鱼，或 13 个鸡蛋。肾脏和巴西坚果在一份正常份量里就会超出：85 g 一份炖猪肾含 265 ug，已是补充剂剂量的 133%，单独就超过 EFSA 上限；85 g 一份炖羊肾含 186 ug，为该剂量的 93%。由于这个剂量太容易达到，有用的计算要反过来做。EFSA AI 为 70 ug/d，EFSA 上限为 255 ug/d，可用余量约 185 ug。一个每天服用 200 ug 补充剂并保持普通饮食的人，大约在 270 ug，已经超过上限；再加两颗平均水平的巴西坚果，就到约 462 ug。该上限源自 SELECT 中在 LOAEL 330 ug/d 观察到的脱发，这是在可达到的摄入量下观察到的人体效应，并非理论推算的天花板（DOI 10.2903/j.efsa.2023.7704）。硒是食物可以轻松匹配补充剂的例子，诚实的建议是两条路只选一条。

Food vs supplement食物与补充剂Brazil nuts are the textbook answer and a genuinely bad way to dose selenium deliberately, because the dose is unknowable at the point of eating. Median selenium varied from 2.07 mg/kg in Mato Grosso state to 68.15 mg/kg in Amazonas, which the authors attribute to soil selenium, soil pH and texture, location and genotype (PMID 28923728). On the 5 g kernel used throughout this item's table, one nut therefore supplies about 15 percent to about 490 percent of the 70 ug adult AI. The paper's own '11 percent to 288 percent' phrasing implies a 3.0 to 3.7 g kernel and cannot stand alongside a 5 g table, so the figures have been put on one basis. Nuts from the two extremes are visually identical, are not labelled by state of origin, and are routinely blended, so 'two Brazil nuts a day' is a dose ranging from about 20 ug to about 680 ug depending on a fact the eater cannot access, spanning deficient to well over the upper level. On form equivalence, selenium is unusual in a helpful way: the dominant species in Brazil nuts and cereals is selenomethionine, the same species used as the supplement in SELECT, so food and that supplement are pharmacologically comparable (PMID 18346307). But 200 ug of selenium is not one thing. The selenised yeast used in the earlier NPC trial was a poorly speciated mixture whose delivered selenium was variable, and the two trials produced opposite results, so the number 200 ug carries no single meaning across the literature (PMID 18346308, PMID 18346307). Finally, the case for supplementing collapses in a selenium-replete person: SELECT tested 200 ug/d L-selenomethionine in selenium-replete men, found no protection against prostate or other major cancers, and produced the alopecia signal that now defines the UL.巴西坚果是教科书答案，也确实是刻意补硒的糟糕方式，因为吃下去的那一刻剂量无从知道。硒的中位数从马托格罗索州的 2.07 mg/kg 到亚马逊州的 68.15 mg/kg，作者将其归因于土壤硒、土壤 pH 与质地、地点和基因型（PMID 28923728）。按本条目表中通用的 5 g 果仁计算，一颗坚果因此提供成人 AI 70 ug 的约 15% 到约 490%。论文自己的 11% 至 288% 的表述隐含的是 3.0 至 3.7 g 的果仁，无法与 5 g 的表格并存，因此这些数字已统一到同一基准。两个极端产地的坚果外观完全相同，不按产州标注，并且常规混装，所以每天两颗巴西坚果对应的剂量在约 20 ug 到约 680 ug 之间，取决于食用者无法获知的事实，横跨从缺乏到远超上限的范围。在形式等效性上，硒有一点很有帮助：巴西坚果和谷物中的主要形态是硒代甲硫氨酸，与 SELECT 使用的补充剂形态相同，因此食物与该补充剂在药理上可比（PMID 18346307）。但 200 ug 硒并不是一件事。更早的 NPC 试验使用的富硒酵母是形态不明确的混合物，实际提供的硒含量不稳定，而两项试验得出相反结果，所以 200 ug 这个数字在整个文献里没有单一含义（PMID 18346308，PMID 18346307）。最后，对硒充足的人来说，补充的理由完全崩塌：SELECT 在硒充足的男性中测试了 200 ug/d L-硒代甲硫氨酸，未发现对前列腺癌或其他主要癌症的保护作用，并产生了如今界定 UL 的脱发信号。

Absorption吸收Selenium bioavailability depends on chemical species more than on food matrix. Selenomethionine, the form in Brazil nuts, cereals and meat, is absorbed almost completely and is incorporated non-specifically into body proteins as a storage pool, which is why it raises plasma selenium readily and why its kinetics differ from inorganic selenite and selenate (PMID 18346307, PMID 28412747). That has a practical consequence the composition tables hide: the selenium content of any plant food is a proxy for the soil it grew in rather than a property of the species. The USDA wholemeal bread figure of 25.7 ug/100 g and the wheat germ figure of 79.2 ug/100 g both reflect North American wheat grown on selenium-rich soils. European and UK wheat grows on selenium-poor soils, so the same bread and the same wheat germ cannot be assumed to deliver the same selenium, and the wide between-country variation in intake driven by exactly this mechanism is the central theme of the food-chain intake review (PMID 18346308). Animal foods hold their values better across countries, because livestock feed is commonly selenium-supplemented, which is why kidney, liver, tuna, mussels and eggs travel better than bread or nuts do. Ranking for a reader who wants reliable selenium without a variable dose: kidney and liver first, then marine fish and shellfish including canned tuna and mussels, eggs as a steady background contributor, and Brazil nuts last precisely because they are the richest source.硒的生物利用度主要取决于化学形态，食物基质的影响较小。硒代甲硫氨酸是巴西坚果、谷物和肉类中的形态，几乎完全被吸收，并以非特异方式掺入体内蛋白作为储存池，这就是它容易提高血浆硒、而其动力学又与无机的亚硒酸盐和硒酸盐不同的原因（PMID 18346307，PMID 28412747）。这带来一个成分表掩盖了的实际后果：任何植物性食物的硒含量都是其生长土壤的代理指标，物种本身的属性并不决定它。USDA 全麦面包 25.7 ug/100 g 和小麦胚芽 79.2 ug/100 g 这两个数值都来自生长在富硒土壤上的北美小麦。欧洲和英国的小麦长在贫硒土壤上，所以不能假定同样的面包和同样的小麦胚芽能提供同样的硒，各国摄入量差异巨大正是由这一机制驱动，也是那篇食物链摄入综述的核心主题（PMID 18346308）。动物性食物的数值跨国稳定得多，因为畜禽饲料通常补硒，这也是肾、肝、金枪鱼、贻贝和蛋比面包或坚果更经得起地域迁移的原因。对想要稳定补硒又不愿面对波动剂量的读者，排序是：肾和肝居首，其次是海鱼和贝类，包括罐装金枪鱼和贻贝，蛋作为稳定的背景来源，巴西坚果排在最后，恰恰因为它是最富硒的来源。

Food data note食物数据说明Every original per-100 g figure matched FoodData Central to the digit (312, 1,920, 108, 111, 37.6, 52.7, 36.1, 31.1, 25.7, 19.7), the Brazil nut state medians were confirmed verbatim from PMID 28923728, and the EFSA UL derivation was confirmed word for word: alopecia as critical endpoint, LOAEL 330 ug/d from SELECT, uncertainty factor 1.3, UL 255 ug/d including pregnancy and lactation. EFSA itself notes that consumers are unlikely to exceed the UL except regular users of food supplements or regular consumers of Brazil nuts. The seven added rows use conventional portion sizes rather than USDA measure-table entries, so their per-portion figures are derived and flagged in place高。原稿每一个每 100 g 数值都与 FoodData Central 逐位一致（312、1,920、108、111、37.6、52.7、36.1、31.1、25.7、19.7），巴西坚果各州中位数已从 PMID 28923728 逐字确认，EFSA UL 的推导也逐字确认：脱发为关键终点，来自 SELECT 的 LOAEL 330 ug/d，不确定系数 1.3，UL 255 ug/d，包括孕期和哺乳期。EFSA 自己指出，除了经常使用食品补充剂或经常食用巴西坚果的人，消费者不太可能超过 UL。新增的七行使用常规份量而非 USDA 计量表条目，因此其每份数值是推算的，并已就地标注。

Does the body make it身体是否自产Selenium is chemical element 34, so none of it can be made, although its functional form is partly homemade: the body builds selenocysteine on its own tRNA and inserts it at recoded UGA codons, using selenium supplied entirely by diet. At 200 µg/d the limiting issue is saturation, since selenoprotein P was optimised at an estimated intake of 49 µg/d in 98 healthy Chinese adults whose baseline intake was only 14 µg/d, and 75 µg Se/d as l-selenomethionine is postulated rather than measured to allow full selenoprotein expression in US residents, so the extra 125 to 150 µg buys no further selenoprotein. Supplementing at this dose therefore makes sense only for documented deficiency, and above the plateau the dose is pharmacological, with type 2 diabetes incidence raised in the Nutritional Prevention of Cancer trial (overall hazard ratio 1.55) and high-grade prostate cancer in SELECT.硒是34号化学元素，本身完全无法合成，但它的功能形式部分是体内自制的：身体在自己的 tRNA 上组装硒代半胱氨酸，并把它插入被重新编码的 UGA 密码子，所用的硒全部来自膳食。在 200 µg/d 这个剂量上，关键问题是饱和：硒蛋白 P 在 98 名基线摄入仅 14 µg/d 的健康中国成年人中，估计摄入 49 µg/d 即可达到最优，而以 l-硒代甲硫氨酸形式 75 µg Se/d 可让美国居民完整表达硒蛋白（这是推定值，并非实测值），所以多出来的 125 至 150 µg 换不来更多硒蛋白。因此这个剂量只有在已确诊缺乏时才说得通，超过平台之后剂量已属药理范畴：Nutritional Prevention of Cancer 试验中2型糖尿病发生率升高（总体风险比 1.55），SELECT 中高级别前列腺癌增加。

Pathway合成通路NOT APPLICABLE for the element. For its functional form: dietary selenomethionine or selenite is reduced to selenide, SEPHS2 (with SEPHS1) makes selenophosphate, seryl-tRNA synthetase charges tRNA[Ser]Sec with serine, PSTK (phosphoseryl-tRNA kinase) phosphorylates it, SEPSECS converts O-phosphoseryl-tRNA[Ser]Sec to Sec-tRNA[Ser]Sec, and the SECIS-dependent recoding machinery (SECISBP2 with the dedicated elongation factor EEFSEC) inserts selenocysteine at UGA codons. Products include GPX1-4 and GPX6, TXNRD1-3, the deiodinases DIO1-3 and SELENOP as the plasma transport form.对元素本身 NOT APPLICABLE（不适用）。对其功能形式：膳食中的硒代甲硫氨酸或亚硒酸盐先被还原为硒化物，SEPHS2（连同 SEPHS1）生成硒磷酸，丝氨酰-tRNA 合成酶把丝氨酸装载到 tRNA[Ser]Sec 上，PSTK（磷酸丝氨酰-tRNA 激酶）将其磷酸化，SEPSECS 把 O-磷酸丝氨酰-tRNA[Ser]Sec 转变为 Sec-tRNA[Ser]Sec，依赖 SECIS 的重编码机器（SECISBP2 及专用延伸因子 EEFSEC）把硒代半胱氨酸插入 UGA 密码子。产物包括 GPX1-4 和 GPX6、TXNRD1-3、脱碘酶 DIO1-3，以及作为血浆转运形式的 SELENOP。

Amount made自产量0 µg/d of the element. Mass of selenocysteine synthesised per day: NOT ESTABLISHED. Reference points: RDA 55 µg/d; selenoprotein P optimised at an estimated intake of about 49 µg/d in selenium-deficient Chinese adults (baseline 14 µg/d), about 75 µg/d postulated for full selenoprotein expression in US residents; UL 400 µg/d, based on selenosis as the critical adverse effect.元素本身 0 µg/d。每日合成的硒代半胱氨酸质量：NOT ESTABLISHED（未确立）。参照点：RDA 55 µg/d；在缺硒的中国成年人中（基线 14 µg/d），估计摄入约 49 µg/d 可使硒蛋白 P 达到最优，约 75 µg/d 为美国居民完整表达硒蛋白的推定值；UL 400 µg/d，依据的关键不良效应是硒中毒。

Still matters when仍有意义的情形Justified only by low intake or loss: selenium-poor soil regions (historic Keshan and Kashin-Beck disease areas, parts of China, historically Finland), long-term parenteral nutrition without selenium, severe malabsorption, some critical-illness protocols under clinician direction. In all of those, doses near 50 to 75 µg/d cover the requirement, so 200 µg/d sits above the useful range for repletion and carries a documented metabolic and oncological cost in the already-replete: diabetes incidence in NPC and high-grade prostate cancer in SELECT.只有低摄入或额外损失才构成理由：土壤缺硒地区（历史上的克山病和大骨节病地区、中国部分地区、历史上的芬兰）、长期不含硒的肠外营养、严重吸收不良、临床医生指导下的部分危重症方案。在这些情形中，接近 50 至 75 µg/d 的剂量即可满足需要，因此 200 µg/d 高于补足所需的有用范围，对已经充足的人还带有明确的代谢和肿瘤学代价：NPC 试验中的糖尿病发生率，以及 SELECT 中的高级别前列腺癌。

Synthesis source合成来源Xia Y, Hill KE, Li P, et al. Am J Clin Nutr. 2010;92(3):525-31. PMID 20573787, DOI 10.3945/ajcn.2010.29642 (98 healthy Chinese adults, baseline intake 14 µg/d, selenoprotein P optimised at an estimated 49 µg/d, 75 µg/d postulated for US residents); IOM, Dietary Reference Intakes for Vitamin C, Vitamin E, Selenium, and Carotenoids (2000), selenium chapter, NCBI Bookshelf NBK225470 (RDA 55 µg/d, UL 400 µg/d with selenosis as the critical effect); NPC and SELECT trial results. Merged from the recovered entries Selenium at 200 µg/d and Selenium (element).

Refs.文献 Cochrane Vinceti PMID 29376219; SELECT PMID 19066370 and PMID 21990298; Stranges PMID 17620655; EFSA 2023
AADDFFDDBBXXPreformed vitamin A at or above 10,000 IU预成型维生素 A 10000 IU 及以上
Verdict结论Avoid不要吃
Evidence证据Grade DD 级
Dose tested已验证剂量RDA 900 µg RAE for men and 700 µg for women. The upper limit is 3,000 µg/d, which is exactly 10,000 IU.推荐摄入量：男性 900 微克 RAE，女性 700 微克。上限为 3000 微克/天，正好等于 10000 IU。
Who适用人群Clinical vitamin A deficiency in low-income settings, fat malabsorption, cystic fibrosis. In replete Western adults, nobody.低收入地区的临床维生素 A 缺乏、脂肪吸收不良、囊性纤维化。在营养充足的西方成人中，没有适用人群。
Pros优点
  • WHO supplementation saves lives in vitamin-A-deficient children, particularly in measles. That is one of the highest-value public health interventions in existence, and it is not what an over-the-counter 10,000 IU capsule is for.在维生素 A 缺乏的儿童中，尤其是麻疹患儿，WHO 的补充方案能挽救生命。那是现存价值最高的公共卫生干预之一，但这不是一粒非处方 10000 IU 胶囊的用途。
Cons缺点
  • CARET showed net harm: 25,000 IU/d of retinyl palmitate plus 30 mg beta-carotene gave all-cause death RR 1.17 (1.03-1.33) and lung cancer death RR 1.46 (1.07-2.00).CARET 显示净危害：25000 IU/天棕榈酸视黄酯加 30 毫克β-胡萝卜素，全因死亡 RR 1.17（1.03-1.33），肺癌死亡 RR 1.46（1.07-2.00）。
  • Over-the-counter products at 10,000 IU/d sit exactly AT the upper limit, leaving zero headroom for diet, liver consumption or a second supplement.10000 IU/天的非处方产品正好卡在上限，饮食、吃动物肝脏或第二种补充剂都没有余量。
  • It is teratogenic. Preformed vitamin A above the upper limit in pregnancy is a hard contraindication, and prenatal products should use beta-carotene rather than retinol.它有致畸性。妊娠期预成型维生素 A 超过上限属硬性禁忌，孕期产品应使用β-胡萝卜素而非视黄醇。
  • Unlike beta-carotene, preformed vitamin A is not subject to feedback regulation on absorption, so chronic excess accumulates and causes hepatotoxicity, intracranial hypertension and bone loss.与β-胡萝卜素不同，预成型维生素 A 的吸收不受反馈调节，因此长期过量会蓄积，导致肝毒性、颅内压升高和骨质流失。
  • Contraindicated in liver disease of any kind, since retinol is stored in and toxic to the liver.任何类型的肝病禁用，因为视黄醇储存于肝脏并对肝脏有毒。
What it does, and what happens without it它有什么作用，缺了会怎样

Makes the eye's dim-light pigment and keeps skin, gut and airway linings healthy.生成眼睛暗光视觉所需的色素，并维持皮肤、肠道及呼吸道黏膜的健康。

Named deficiency disease有明确的缺乏症 Partly reversible部分可逆

In detail详细Retinol is oxidised to 11-cis-retinal, which binds opsin to form rhodopsin, the photopigment of the rod cells that makes vision in dim light possible. By a separate route it is oxidised to all-trans and 9-cis retinoic acid, ligands for the nuclear RAR and RXR receptors, which regulate transcription of genes controlling epithelial differentiation (goblet cells and mucin production in the conjunctiva, cornea, respiratory tract and gut), embryonic patterning, haematopoiesis, and both innate and adaptive immunity including gut-homing of T lymphocytes. Preformed retinol from liver, dairy, eggs and supplements is absorbed efficiently and stored in hepatic stellate cells, which buffer plasma concentrations for months. 10,000 IU is about 3,000 micrograms retinol activity equivalents, roughly four times the adult RDA and at the tolerable upper intake level, so at this dose the clinically relevant question is excess rather than shortfall.视黄醇被氧化为11-顺式视黄醛，后者与视蛋白结合形成视紫红质，即视杆细胞的感光色素，使暗光视觉成为可能。经另一条途径，它被氧化为全反式及9-顺式视黄酸，是核内RAR和RXR受体的配体，调控相关基因的转录，这些基因控制上皮分化（结膜、角膜、呼吸道及肠道中杯状细胞和黏蛋白生成）、胚胎发育模式形成、造血功能，以及包括T淋巴细胞归巢肠道在内的固有免疫和适应性免疫。来自肝脏、乳制品、蛋类及补充剂的预成型视黄醇吸收效率高，储存于肝星状细胞中，可缓冲血浆浓度长达数月。10,000 IU约为3,000 micrograms视黄醇活性当量，约为成人RDA的四倍，已达到可耐受最高摄入量水平。因此在此剂量下，临床上真正需要关注的是过量问题，摄入不足并非重点。

Deficiency disease缺乏症Xerophthalmia, the spectrum running from night blindness (nyctalopia) through conjunctival and corneal xerosis to keratomalacia.眼干燥症（xerophthalmia），谱系涵盖从夜盲症（nyctalopia）到结膜及角膜干燥，再到角膜软化症（keratomalacia）。

First signs早期表现Impaired dark adaptation, then frank night blindness: trouble seeing after dusk or in a dimly lit room, which in a small child shows as reluctance to move about after dark. Conjunctival xerosis and Bitot spots, foamy grey triangular patches of keratinised conjunctiva, follow. Increased severity and duration of measles, diarrhoea and respiratory infection often precede any eye sign. Serum retinol below 0.70 micromol/L is the biochemical marker, though it falls only once liver stores are largely gone.首先出现暗适应障碍，随后是明显的夜盲：黄昏后或光线昏暗房间中视物困难，幼儿则表现为天黑后不愿活动。随后出现结膜干燥及Bitot斑（结膜角化形成的泡沫状灰白三角形斑块）。麻疹、腹泻及呼吸道感染的加重和病程延长常先于任何眼部体征出现。血清视黄醇低于0.70 micromol/L是生化指标，但只有在肝脏储备大量耗竭后才会下降。

Untreated不治疗会怎样Corneal xerosis progresses to punctate keratopathy, then corneal ulceration, then keratomalacia, in which the corneal stroma liquefies over a few days and frequently perforates. The eye is structurally destroyed and blindness is permanent. Deficiency also substantially raises child mortality from measles, diarrhoeal disease and respiratory infection, and roughly half of the children who go blind from it die within twelve months.角膜干燥进展为点状角膜病变，继而角膜溃疡，最终发展为角膜软化症：角膜基质在数天内液化，常伴穿孔。眼球结构被破坏，失明为永久性。缺乏还会大幅提高儿童因麻疹、腹泻及呼吸道感染导致的死亡率，因此致盲的儿童中约半数在12个月内死亡。

Does it reverse补回来能修复吗Night blindness, conjunctival xerosis and Bitot spots reverse within days to weeks of high-dose retinol. Once the cornea ulcerates or melts, the loss is structural and permanent, and vitamin A deficiency remains a leading cause of preventable childhood blindness worldwide. The window between the fully reversible and the irreversible stage can be only a few days in a sick, depleted child, which is why treatment is given on clinical suspicion without waiting for a retinol assay.大剂量视黄醇治疗后，夜盲、结膜干燥及Bitot斑可在数天至数周内恢复。一旦角膜发生溃疡或液化，损害即为结构性且永久性的，维生素A缺乏症至今仍是全球儿童可预防性失明的主要病因之一。在病情严重、储备耗竭的患儿中，从完全可逆到不可逆阶段之间的窗口期可能仅有数天，这也是临床一旦怀疑即予治疗、不等视黄醇检测结果的原因。

Who becomes deficient谁会缺乏Preschool children and pregnant and lactating women in low-income settings whose diets contain little animal-source food or provitamin A vegetables, particularly where measles and diarrhoeal disease are common. In high-income countries deficiency is rare and almost always secondary to disease: cystic fibrosis, cholestatic liver disease, short bowel syndrome, pancreatic insufficiency and bariatric surgery. It also occurs with extremely restricted eating, including the food selectivity seen in some autistic children, where xerophthalmia has been reported.低收入地区膳食中动物性食物或维生素A原蔬菜摄入不足的学龄前儿童及孕产妇，尤其在麻疹和腹泻性疾病常见的地区。在高收入国家，缺乏症罕见，几乎总是继发于疾病：囊性纤维化、胆汁淤积性肝病、短肠综合征、胰腺功能不全及减重手术。极度受限的饮食也可导致缺乏，包括部分自闭症儿童表现出的食物选择性，其中已有眼干燥症的病例报告。

How common有多常见WHO estimated that for 1995-2005, 190 million preschool-age children (33.3% of that age group in at-risk populations) and 19.1 million pregnant women had serum retinol below 0.70 micromol/L, with about 5.2 million preschool children affected by night blindness (WHO, Global prevalence of vitamin A deficiency in populations at risk 1995-2005, Geneva 2009). Deficiency in high-income populations is rare and disease-related rather than dietary; no useful population prevalence figure exists for those settings.世界卫生组织估计，1995至2005年间，190 million名学龄前儿童（占高危人群该年龄段的33.3%）及19.1 million名孕妇血清视黄醇低于0.70 micromol/L，其中约5.2 million名学龄前儿童患有夜盲症（WHO, Global prevalence of vitamin A deficiency in populations at risk 1995-2005, Geneva 2009）。高收入人群中的缺乏症罕见，多与疾病相关，与膳食因素关系不大；这些地区尚无有意义的人群患病率数据。

Source来源WHO, Global prevalence of vitamin A deficiency in populations at risk 1995-2005, WHO Global Database on Vitamin A Deficiency, Geneva 2009 (ISBN 978 92 4 159801 9); PMID 18806089 (Sommer A, J Nutr 2008, Vitamin A deficiency and clinical disease: an historical overview)

Food and the body食物与身体
In food: Rich食物中：丰富 Dose from food: Reachable靠吃达到剂量：可达到 Body makes it: Cannot身体自产：不能 Food data: Low食物数据：低

Liver is far more concentrated in preformed retinol than the supplement: 10,000 IU is 3,000 µg retinol, and every common liver in the UK tables carries 10,500 to 25,200 µg per 100 g. Hard cheese, butter, fortified fat spreads and egg yolk supply an everyday retinol baseline of tens to about a hundred micrograms per portion on top of that. This is the one item in the group where the food beats the pill, which is why liver carries a public-health warning rather than a recommendation.肝脏中预制型视黄醇的浓度远高于补充剂：10,000 IU 相当于 3,000 µg 视黄醇，而英国食物成分表里常见的每一种肝脏，每 100 g 都含 10,500 至 25,200 µg。在此之上，硬质奶酪、黄油、强化脂肪涂抹酱和蛋黄还提供每份数十到约一百微克的日常视黄醇基线。本组中只有这一条是食物胜过药片，所以官方对肝脏发出的是公共卫生警告，谈不上推荐。
