Rows tagged unconfirmed carry a figure the checking pass could not trace back to its cited source. Hover the tag for the reason.标记未核实的行，其数值在核查中无法追溯到所引来源。把鼠标移到标记上可看原因。

To match the dose要达到该剂量There is no gap to close. About 12 g of fried calf liver supplies the full 3,000 µg (10,000 IU) of a high-dose retinol capsule, and a normal 100 g portion of any liver delivers 3.5 to 8.4 times that dose in one sitting. A 40 g serving of liver pate is functionally a 10,000 IU tablet at 2,920 µg (9,730 IU). A tablespoon of cod liver oil is 2,448 µg (8,160 IU). Anyone eating liver weekly is already taking supraphysiological preformed vitamin A intermittently, and a 10,000 IU supplement on top compounds a load the body stores rather than clears. For scale, the US tolerable upper intake level for preformed vitamin A is 3,000 µg/day, which is the supplement dose itself, against a UK RNI of 700 µg for men and 600 µg for women.这里没有需要填补的缺口。约 12 g 油炸小牛肝就能提供高剂量视黄醇胶囊的全部 3,000 µg（10,000 IU），而任何一种肝脏的常规 100 g 份量，一餐就能送来该剂量的 3.5 至 8.4 倍。40 g 肝酱含 2,920 µg（9,730 IU），功能上等同一片 10,000 IU 的药片。一汤匙鱼肝油是 2,448 µg（8,160 IU）。每周吃肝的人已经在间歇性摄入超生理量的预制型维生素 A，再叠加 10,000 IU 补充剂，只会加重身体倾向储存而非清除的负荷。作为参照，美国预制型维生素 A 的可耐受最高摄入量是 3,000 µg/天，恰好就是这个补充剂剂量本身，而英国 RNI 为男性 700 µg、女性 600 µg。

Food vs supplement食物与补充剂The retinol in liver is the same molecule as the retinyl palmitate or acetate in capsules, absorbed by the same route and stored in the liver the same way, so the usual reassurance that food forms are safer does not apply here. Pregnancy is the sharp edge: UK advice is that people who are pregnant or who might become pregnant should avoid liver and liver products including pate, and should avoid supplements containing vitamin A including fish liver oils, because excess retinol is teratogenic (NHS pregnancy vitamins guidance). Cod liver oil is the common trap, bought for omega-3 or vitamin D and delivering 60,000 IU of retinol per 100 g, and the same trap has sharper versions that are eaten as ordinary food rather than dosed: canned cod liver (Icelandic and Polish tinned), which carries retinol in the cod-liver-oil range, and halibut liver oil, which is more concentrated again and sold in the same aisle. Liver is also eaten unnoticed as liver sausage, liverwurst, haggis, foie gras, and goose and duck liver, all in the same range as the livers tabulated. Outside pregnancy, chronic preformed retinol above the 3,000 µg/day UL is associated with reduced bone mineral density and fracture risk, which is why UK advice is to eat liver no more than once a week. Beta-carotene-rich foods are the safe substitute precisely because their conversion is regulated.肝脏里的视黄醇与胶囊里的视黄醇棕榈酸酯或乙酸酯是同一个分子，走同一条吸收途径，在肝脏中以同样方式储存，所以“食物形式更安全”这句常见的安慰话在这里不成立。孕期是最锋利的一处：英国的建议是，怀孕或可能怀孕的人应避免肝脏及包括肝酱在内的肝制品，并避免含维生素 A 的补充剂，包括鱼肝油，因为过量视黄醇有致畸性（NHS 孕期维生素指南）。鱼肝油是常见的陷阱，人们为了 omega-3 或维生素 D 买它，而它每 100 g 提供 60,000 IU 视黄醇；同一个陷阱还有更锋利的版本，那些是当作普通食物吃下去的，不是按剂量服用的：罐装鳕鱼肝（冰岛和波兰的罐头），其视黄醇含量与鱼肝油同一量级；还有大比目鱼肝油，浓度更高，就摆在同一排货架上。肝脏也常在不被注意的情况下被吃下：肝肠、德式肝肠（liverwurst）、苏格兰羊杂布丁（haggis）、鹅肝酱（foie gras），以及鹅肝和鸭肝，含量都与表中所列的肝脏处于同一区间。在孕期之外，长期摄入超过 3,000 µg/天 UL 的预制型视黄醇与骨密度下降和骨折风险相关，这也是英国建议每周吃肝不超过一次的原因。富含 β-胡萝卜素的食物是安全的替代，原因正在于其转化受到调节。

Absorption吸收Retinyl esters from liver and from supplements are absorbed at high efficiency and, critically, absorption is not down-regulated when stores are full, so intake accumulates in hepatic stellate cells over weeks and months. Carotenoid absorption works the opposite way, feedback-limited through retinoic-acid induction of the intestinal transcription factor ISX and consequent repression of SR-B1 and BCO1 (reviewed in Reboul E, Nutrients 2019;11(4):838, PMID 31013870, DOI 10.3390/nu11040838; the feedback loop itself originates with Lobo et al. and Widjaja-Adhi et al.). Cooking concentrates liver retinol rather than destroying it, through water loss: CoFID shows raw lamb liver at 17,300 µg/100 g rising to 19,700 fried, and raw ox liver at 14,200 rising to 17,300 stewed (codes 18-413, 18-494, 18-415, 18-416, all unconfirmed along with the rest of the CoFID series).来自肝脏和来自补充剂的视黄酯吸收效率都很高，而且关键在于，储备充足时吸收并不会下调，因此摄入量会在数周到数月间累积于肝星状细胞。类胡萝卜素的吸收方向相反，受反馈限制：视黄酸诱导肠道转录因子 ISX，进而抑制 SR-B1 和 BCO1（综述见 Reboul E，Nutrients 2019;11(4):838，PMID 31013870，DOI 10.3390/nu11040838；该反馈环路本身出自 Lobo 等和 Widjaja-Adhi 等）。烹饪通过失水提高肝脏视黄醇的浓度，并不会破坏它：CoFID 显示生羊肝为 17,300 µg/100 g，油炸后升至 19,700；生牛肝 14,200，炖后升至 17,300（编码 18-413、18-494、18-415、18-416，与 CoFID 系列其余部分一样均未证实）。

Food data note食物数据说明The item's central claim is robust, since the conclusion that food exceeds the supplement dose survives any plausible revision of the numbers, and every IU conversion and dose equivalence recomputes exactly. But the entire liver series, which carries the whole argument, rests on McCance and Widdowson CoFID 2021 codes that could not be retrieved or confirmed, and the two values in this item that were checkable against USDA both came back overstated (butter retinol by 43%, egg yolk by 17%), so the precision quoted for the liver figures is not yet earned. The added cheddar and fortified spread figures are indicative only低。本条目的核心论断很稳固，食物超过补充剂剂量这一结论在任何合理的数字修订下都成立，而且每一项 IU 换算和剂量等效都能精确重算。但承载全部论证的整个肝脏系列依赖 McCance and Widdowson CoFID 2021 的编码，这些编码既无法取得也无法确认；本条目中两个能与 USDA 对照的数值都被高估（黄油视黄醇高估 43%，蛋黄高估 17%），所以肝脏数字所给出的精度还不配得上。新增的切达奶酪和强化涂抹酱数字仅为指示性。

Does the body make it身体是否自产Retinol cannot be built from scratch at all, because human cells only cleave dietary provitamin A carotenoids to make it and there is no de novo retinoid pathway. NONE means required here, so ordinary vitamin A intake has a real target and deficiency is a genuine clinical state. The axis says nothing for 10,000 IU and above of preformed retinol, where the retinol load itself is the hazard, and high retinol doses are specifically to be avoided in pregnancy because of teratogenicity.视黄醇完全无法从头合成, 人体细胞只能裂解膳食中的维生素 A 原类胡萝卜素来获得它, 没有从头合成的类视黄醇通路。这里的 NONE 意味着必需, 所以常规维生素 A 摄入有真实的作用目标, 缺乏也是真实的临床状态。这条轴对 10,000 IU 及以上的预成型视黄醇没有任何依据, 那里的问题正是视黄醇负荷本身, 妊娠期尤其要避免高剂量视黄醇, 因为有致畸性。

Pathway合成通路NOT APPLICABLE for synthesis. Human cells only cleave dietary provitamin A carotenoids to retinoids; the remaining human enzymology handles absorption, storage and interconversion of dietary retinoids, with no synthetic step.合成为 NOT APPLICABLE。人体细胞只能把膳食中的维生素 A 原类胡萝卜素裂解为类视黄醇; 其余人体酶学只负责膳食类视黄醇的吸收, 储存和相互转化, 没有合成步骤。

Amount made自产量0 IU/day synthesised, since humans have no retinoid biosynthetic pathway. The 10,000 IU in the name is a supplement dose; the recovered prose quotes no dietary reference value for preformed vitamin A, so none is asserted here.合成量 0 IU/day, 人体没有类视黄醇的生物合成通路。名称中的 10,000 IU 是补充剂量; 恢复的文本没有给出预成型维生素 A 的膳食参考值, 这里也不臆造。

Still matters when仍有意义的情形Documented vitamin A deficiency and low-intake settings where a preformed or provitamin A source is needed. Not justified as a routine high-dose retinol source, and specifically to be avoided at high retinol doses in pregnancy because of teratogenicity, which is the recovered reason cod liver oil is a poor carrier and separate D3 plus fish or algal oil is the cleaner choice. High-dose vitamin A also sits in the antioxidant class the recovered prose says to hold during active cytotoxic therapy (SWOG S0221, adjusted HR 1.41, 95% CI 0.98 to 2.04).有记录的维生素 A 缺乏, 以及需要预成型或维生素 A 原来源的低摄入情形。把它当作常规高剂量视黄醇来源没有依据; 妊娠期尤其要避免高剂量视黄醇, 因为有致畸性, 这也是恢复文本判定鱼肝油是糟糕载体, 而分开使用 D3 加鱼油或藻油更干净的原因。高剂量维生素 A 同样属于恢复文本要求在细胞毒治疗期间暂停的抗氧化类 (SWOG S0221, 校正 HR 1.41, 95% CI 0.98 到 2.04)。

Synthesis source合成来源Derived using this dataset's classification rules from the recovered entry Cod liver oil, which scores retinol NONE, states that human cells only cleave dietary provitamin A carotenoids and flags teratogenicity at high retinol doses in pregnancy (Holick MF, N Engl J Med 2007;357(3):266-81, PMID 17634462 is that entry's cited source for the vitamin D component), together with Antioxidants during chemotherapy for the SWOG S0221 figures. IOM, Dietary Reference Intakes for Vitamin A, Vitamin K, Arsenic, Boron, Chromium, Copper, Iodine, Iron, Manganese, Molybdenum, Nickel, Silicon, Vanadium and Zinc is the reference volume cited elsewhere in the dataset for vitamin A.

Refs.文献 CARET PMID 8602180; Cochrane PMID 22419320; IOM DRI NBK56068
AABBFFDDBBXXHigh-dose vitamin B6大剂量维生素 B6
Verdict结论Avoid不要吃
Evidence证据Grade BB 级
Dose tested已验证剂量RDA is 1.3 mg/d. EFSA set the upper limit at 12 mg/d in 2023. The US IOM figure is still 100 mg/d.推荐摄入量为 1.3 毫克/天。EFSA 于 2023 年把上限定为 12 毫克/天。美国 IOM 的数字仍是 100 毫克/天。
Who适用人群People on isoniazid, cycloserine, hydralazine or penicillamine, where B6 is protective against drug-induced neuropathy. Pregnant women with nausea and vomiting, at obstetric direction.服用异烟肼、环丝氨酸、肼屈嗪或青霉胺者，此时 B6 可预防药物性神经病。妊娠恶心呕吐的孕妇，需遵产科医嘱。
Pros优点
  • It genuinely prevents isoniazid-induced peripheral neuropathy at 10-50 mg/d, which is a real and important indication.在 10 至 50 毫克/天下，它确实能预防异烟肼引起的周围神经病，这是一个真实而重要的适应证。
  • Pyridoxine with doxylamine is a first-line option for nausea and vomiting of pregnancy, ahead of antiemetics.吡哆醇与多西拉敏联用是妊娠恶心呕吐的一线选择，优先于止吐药。
Cons缺点
  • This is the clearest case in this document where the product category actively causes the harm it claims to prevent. Nerve support, neuropathy and PMS formulas routinely deliver 50-100 mg of B6 to people with no deficiency, which is four to eight times the current European upper limit.这是本文中最清楚的一个例子：一个产品品类主动造成了它声称要预防的那种伤害。“神经营养”“神经病变”和经前综合征类配方常规给到 50 至 100 毫克 B6，而使用者并不缺乏，这是当前欧洲上限的 4 至 8 倍。
  • Sensory peripheral neuropathy is the dose- and duration-dependent toxicity: numbness, burning, ataxia and loss of proprioception. EFSA set its 12 mg/d limit on exactly this, from a reference point of 50 mg/d in case reports.感觉性周围神经病是剂量和时长依赖的毒性表现：麻木、烧灼感、共济失调、位置觉丧失。EFSA 正是据此把上限定为 12 毫克/天，参考点取自个案报告中的 50 毫克/天。
  • Choosing pyridoxal-5-phosphate (P5P) at a premium does NOT prevent it. The toxicity is not form-specific.花高价选择磷酸吡哆醛（P5P）并不能避免这一点。毒性与形式无关。
  • Audit your total intake. Anyone on a B-complex, a fortified energy drink and a nerve or stress formula can easily stack past 100 mg without noticing.要核算总摄入量。同时在吃复合 B 族、喝强化能量饮料、又吃“神经”或“抗压”配方的人，很容易不知不觉叠加超过 100 毫克。
  • An observational safety signal exists: in men, a 10-year average intake above 20 mg/d from individual supplements gave lung cancer HR 1.82 (1.25-2.65). Confounding by smoking is possible, but the direction is not reassuring.存在一个观察性安全信号：在男性中，通过单一补充剂十年平均摄入超过 20 毫克/天，肺癌 HR 为 1.82（1.25-2.65）。可能受吸烟混杂影响，但这个方向并不令人安心。
What it does, and what happens without it它有什么作用，缺了会怎样

Vitamin B6 powers amino acid enzymes; at high doses it damages sensory nerves.维生素B6为多种氨基酸代谢酶提供动力，大剂量时则会损伤感觉神经。

Named deficiency disease有明确的缺乏症 Fully reversible完全可逆

In detail详细The active form, pyridoxal 5'-phosphate, is the cofactor for well over 100 enzymes, most of them in amino acid metabolism: transaminases, the decarboxylases that make serotonin, dopamine, GABA and histamine, the first committed step of haem synthesis (ALA synthase), glycogen phosphorylase, and cystathionine beta-synthase and gamma-lyase, which dispose of homocysteine by transsulphuration. Requirement rises with protein intake. Above the point where these enzymes are saturated, extra B6 adds no function. High-dose products (typically 50 to 500 mg/day, sold for premenstrual symptoms, carpal tunnel syndrome, nausea in pregnancy, or hidden inside B-complex and energy formulations) instead produce a dose-dependent and duration-dependent sensory neuropathy, with the dorsal root ganglion as the target. On toxicity, which is a separate question from the deficiency rated below: because the injury is to the sensory nerve cell bodies in the dorsal root ganglion rather than to the axon alone, recovery after stopping the supplement is often incomplete. Numbness and impaired position sense usually improve over several months, sometimes substantially, but residual deficit persists in some people (Schaumburg 1983). Time to onset is inversely related to dose, so grams per day can do it in weeks while tens of milligrams may take years, which is why EFSA applied an uncertainty factor of 4 to a 50 mg/day reference point when setting the 12 mg/day adult upper level in 2023.活性形式5'-磷酸吡哆醛是100多种酶的辅因子，其中多数参与氨基酸代谢：转氨酶、合成血清素、多巴胺、GABA和组胺的脱羧酶、血红素合成的第一个限速步骤（ALA synthase）、glycogen phosphorylase，以及通过转硫途径清除同型半胱氨酸的cystathionine beta-synthase和gamma-lyase。需要量随蛋白质摄入量增加而上升。超过这些酶的饱和点后，额外补充的B6不再增加任何功能。大剂量产品（通常每日50至500 mg，用于经前症状、腕管综合征、妊娠恶心，或隐藏在复合B族维生素和能量补充剂中）反而会产生与剂量和持续时间相关的感觉神经病变，靶点是背根神经节。关于毒性问题，这与下文评定的缺乏症是两个不同的问题：由于损伤的是背根神经节内感觉神经元的胞体而非仅是轴突，停用补充剂后的恢复往往并不完全。麻木和位置觉障碍通常在数月内改善，有时改善明显，但部分人会遗留残余缺陷（Schaumburg 1983）。起病时间与剂量成反比，每日以克计的剂量可在数周内致病，而每日数十毫克则可能需要数年，这正是EFSA在2023年设定成人每日12 mg上限时，对50 mg/day参考点采用不确定系数4的原因。

Deficiency disease缺乏症Pyridoxine deficiency: seborrhoeic dermatitis with cheilosis and glossitis, hypochromic microcytic anaemia, and seizures in infants; nearly always secondary to isoniazid, cycloserine, hydralazine or penicillamine, alcohol dependence, dialysis or malabsorption.吡哆醇缺乏症：脂溢性皮炎伴口角炎和舌炎、低色素小细胞性贫血，以及婴儿癫痫发作，几乎总是继发于异烟肼、环丝氨酸、肼屈嗪或青霉胺、酒精依赖、透析或吸收不良。

First signs早期表现Plasma pyridoxal 5'-phosphate below about 20 nmol/L, usually with no symptoms at all. When symptoms appear they are mucocutaneous and non-specific: angular cheilitis, glossitis, seborrhoeic dermatitis around the eyes, nose and mouth, plus irritability and low mood. Homocysteine may be mildly raised.血浆5'-磷酸吡哆醛低于约20 nmol/L，通常完全没有症状。若出现症状，多为皮肤黏膜方面且无特异性：口角炎、舌炎、眼鼻口周围的脂溢性皮炎，加上易激惹和情绪低落。同型半胱氨酸可能轻度升高。

Untreated不治疗会怎样Hypochromic microcytic anaemia from impaired haem synthesis (distinct from X-linked ALAS2 pyridoxine-responsive sideroblastic anaemia, which is genetic, not dietary), and a peripheral sensory neuropathy. In infants, deficiency causes seizures through failure of GABA synthesis. Isolated severe deficiency is rare and is nearly always secondary: isoniazid, cycloserine, hydralazine or penicillamine treatment, alcohol dependence, dialysis, or malabsorption. Note that both deficiency and excess of B6 produce peripheral neuropathy, so neuropathy in a supplement user is at least as likely to be caused by the supplement as corrected by it.血红素合成受损导致的低色素小细胞性贫血（不同于X连锁ALAS2基因相关的吡哆醇反应性铁粒幼细胞性贫血，后者是遗传性的，而非饮食性的），以及周围感觉神经病变。婴儿缺乏时会因GABA合成障碍而引发癫痫发作。单纯的重度缺乏很少见，几乎总是继发于：异烟肼、环丝氨酸、肼屈嗪或青霉胺治疗、酒精依赖、透析或吸收不良。需要注意的是，B6缺乏和过量都会导致周围神经病变，因此补充剂使用者出现的神经病变，由补充剂本身引起的可能性并不低于由其纠正的可能性。

Does it reverse补回来能修复吗This field rates recovery from the deficiency, and B6 deficiency corrects fully within weeks on modest repletion, with no residual deficit: the mucocutaneous signs clear, the anaemia resolves, and pyridoxine-responsive infantile seizures stop once the vitamin is given. Recovery from high-dose B6 neuropathy is a different question with a different answer (often incomplete) and is set out in the function description above, not here.本字段评定的是缺乏症的恢复情况，适度补充数周内B6缺乏即可完全纠正，不留残余缺陷：皮肤黏膜体征消退，贫血缓解，给予维生素后吡哆醇反应性婴儿癫痫发作停止。大剂量B6神经病变的恢复是另一个问题，答案也不同（往往不完全），已在上文的功能描述中说明，此处不再重复。

Who becomes deficient谁会缺乏For deficiency: people taking isoniazid, cycloserine, hydralazine or penicillamine; alcohol dependence; dialysis; malabsorption. Lower plasma PLP is also seen in older adults, smokers, and current or former oral contraceptive users. For toxicity: anyone taking a high-dose B6 or B-complex product for months to years, often without realising the dose, since a single tablet can exceed the European upper level several-fold.就缺乏而言：正在服用异烟肼、环丝氨酸、肼屈嗪或青霉胺者，酒精依赖者，透析患者，吸收不良患者。血浆PLP偏低也见于老年人、吸烟者以及正在或曾经使用口服避孕药者。就毒性而言：任何数月至数年服用大剂量B6或复合B族维生素产品的人，往往并未意识到摄入的剂量，因为单片药片就可能数倍超过欧洲的上限。

How common有多常见Around 23 to 27% of US adults not taking supplements had plasma PLP below 20 nmol/L in NHANES 2003 to 2004, mostly biochemical rather than symptomatic (PMID 18469270). On the toxicity side, EFSA set the adult tolerable upper intake at 12 mg/day in 2023, derived from a 50 mg/day reference point for peripheral neuropathy with an uncertainty factor of 4 (doi:10.2903/j.efsa.2023.8006).在NHANES 2003至2004年调查中，未服用补充剂的美国成年人约有23%至27%血浆PLP低于20 nmol/L，多数只是生化指标异常而非有症状（PMID 18469270）。在毒性方面，EFSA于2023年将成人可耐受最高摄入量定为每日12 mg，其推导依据是外周神经病变的50 mg/day参考点，并采用不确定系数4（doi:10.2903/j.efsa.2023.8006）。

Source来源PMID 18469270 (Morris et al., Am J Clin Nutr 2008, plasma PLP in NHANES 2003 to 2004); PMID 6308447 (Schaumburg et al., N Engl J Med 1983, sensory neuropathy from pyridoxine abuse); doi:10.2903/j.efsa.2023.8006 (EFSA 2023, tolerable upper intake level for vitamin B6)

Food and the body食物与身体
In food: Rich食物中：丰富 Dose from food: Out of reach靠吃达到剂量：达不到 Body makes it: Cannot身体自产：不能 Food data: High食物数据：高

Vitamin B6 itself is abundant and widely distributed, with fish, organ meat, poultry, potatoes, bananas, seeds, nuts and fortified cereals all carrying useful amounts, and dietary deficiency uncommon in people eating normally. The marketed high-dose object is a different thing: pyridoxine hydrochloride, a manufactured crystalline salt sold at 50, 100 and sometimes 250-500 mg per tablet, which is 40 to 400 times the 1.3 mg adult RDA and has no dietary counterpart at that concentration. Both statements are true at once, which is why the label is split here: the molecule is RICH in food (so RICH stands rather than being reclassified as synthetic), while the product as sold is unreachable by eating, which is what dose_from_food now records. All percentages below use the 1.3 mg RDA for ages 19-50; over 50 the RDA rises to 1.7 mg for men and 1.5 mg for women, so these percentages overstate the contribution for older adults.维生素 B6 本身分布广泛、含量充足，鱼、内脏、禽肉、马铃薯、香蕉、种子、坚果和强化谷物都带有可观的量，正常饮食的人很少出现膳食性缺乏。市面上的大剂量产品是另一回事：盐酸吡哆醇，一种人工制造的结晶盐，以每片 50、100、有时 250-500 mg 出售，相当于成人 RDA 1.3 mg 的 40 到 400 倍，膳食中没有任何东西达到这个浓度。两句话同时成立，所以这里把标签拆开：这个分子在食物中确实丰富（因此保留 RICH，不改判为合成），而以在售形态出现的产品靠吃达不到，这就是 dose_from_food 现在记录的内容。下面所有百分比都按 19-50 岁的 1.3 mg RDA 计算；50 岁以上 RDA 升至男性 1.7 mg、女性 1.5 mg，所以这些百分比高估了对年长成年人的贡献。

To match the dose要达到该剂量A 100 mg pyridoxine tablet is 77 times the RDA. Matching it by eating, in one day, takes 7.46 kg of dried sunflower kernels, 8.93 kg of pistachios, 9.80 kg of braised beef liver, 10.7 kg of raw yellowfin tuna, 16.7 kg of roasted chicken breast, or 27.2 kg of banana, about 231 medium bananas. A 50 mg tablet still needs 4.46 kg of pistachios or 116 bananas. Even the regulatory ceiling sits outside dietary reach: EFSA's 2023 tolerable upper intake level of 12 mg/day for adults corresponds to about 1.07 kg of pistachios or 3.27 kg of banana, roughly 28 bananas, every single day. Nobody eats any of that. Ordinary diets deliver a few mg per day, an order of magnitude below the UL and two to three orders below the supplement, and that is the mechanical reason dietary B6 has never produced the sensory neuropathy that supplements produce: no food is concentrated enough to approach the toxic range. The syndrome was described in seven adults taking megadose pyridoxine (Schaumburg H et al., 'Sensory neuropathy from pyridoxine abuse. A new megavitamin syndrome', N Engl J Med 1983;309:445-8, PMID 6308447), all of whom improved after withdrawal; the widely quoted 2-6 g/day range is secondary-literature summary that does not appear in the abstract, so treat it as unconfirmed and source any dose figure to the full text or to EFSA's case tabulation. Cases have since been reported at far lower supplemental doses, and EFSA cut the adult UL from the SCF's 25 mg/day to 12 mg/day on peripheral neuropathy grounds, from a 50 mg/day reference point with an uncertainty factor of 4 (EFSA NDA Panel, EFSA J 2023;21:e08006, PMID 37207271, DOI 10.2903/j.efsa.2023.8006). Not one case has been attributed to food B6.一片 100 mg 的吡哆醇是 RDA 的 77 倍。要在一天之内靠吃达到同样的量，需要 7.46 kg 干葵花籽仁、8.93 kg 开心果、9.80 kg 炖牛肝、10.7 kg 生黄鳍金枪鱼、16.7 kg 烤鸡胸肉，或 27.2 kg 香蕉，约 231 根中等大小的香蕉。50 mg 的片剂也仍需 4.46 kg 开心果或 116 根香蕉。连监管上限都在膳食可及范围之外：EFSA 2023 年为成人定的可耐受最高摄入量 12 mg/天，相当于每天约 1.07 kg 开心果或 3.27 kg 香蕉，约 28 根香蕉。这些没有人会吃。普通饮食每天提供几 mg，比 UL 低一个数量级，比补充剂低两到三个数量级，这就是膳食 B6 从未造成补充剂那种感觉神经病变的机械原因：没有食物浓到能接近中毒范围。该综合征最初描述于 7 名服用超大剂量吡哆醇的成年人（Schaumburg H 等, Sensory neuropathy from pyridoxine abuse. A new megavitamin syndrome, N Engl J Med 1983;309:445-8, PMID 6308447），停用后全部好转；被广泛引用的 2-6 g/天这个区间出自二手文献的概述，摘要里并没有，因此按未确认处理，任何剂量数字都应回到全文或 EFSA 的病例汇总去核对。此后在低得多的补充剂量下也有病例报告，EFSA 以周围神经病变为依据，把成人 UL 从 SCF 的 25 mg/天下调到 12 mg/天，参考点为 50 mg/天，不确定系数取 4（EFSA NDA Panel, EFSA J 2023;21:e08006, PMID 37207271, DOI 10.2903/j.efsa.2023.8006）。没有一例被归因于食物中的 B6。

Food vs supplement食物与补充剂This is a genuine case where the food is safe and the concentrated form is not, and the reason is dose plus kinetics rather than any exotic compound. Food B6 arrives as pyridoxal phosphate and pyridoxamine phosphate bound in the matrix, plus glycosylated pyridoxine in plant foods, released and absorbed gradually across a meal. A tablet delivers a bolus of free pyridoxine. The accepted mechanism for the neuropathy is that free pyridoxine at high concentration outruns conversion to pyridoxal 5-phosphate and acts at PLP-dependent sites in the dorsal root ganglion, which lacks a blood-nerve barrier. Pyridoxal-5-phosphate supplements are marketed as the safe alternative on the strength of that mechanism, but the human evidence is thin and EFSA applies its 12 mg/day UL to total B6 regardless of form, so treating P5P as exempt has no support. One practical consequence: because B6 is added to energy drinks, fortified cereals and B-complex products, people accumulate supplemental doses without intending to, and the UL is easy to cross by stacking products while eating a diet that contributes almost nothing to the risk.这是食物安全而浓缩形态不安全的一个真实案例，原因是剂量加动力学，与什么特殊化合物无关。食物中的 B6 以磷酸吡哆醛和磷酸吡哆胺的形式结合在食物基质里，植物性食物中还有糖苷化的吡哆醇，在一餐中被逐步释放和吸收。片剂送进去的是一次性的游离吡哆醇冲击量。公认的神经病变机制是：高浓度的游离吡哆醇超出了转化为 5-磷酸吡哆醛（PLP）的能力，并在背根神经节的 PLP 依赖位点上产生作用，而背根神经节没有血神经屏障。5-磷酸吡哆醛补充剂正是凭这套机制被当成安全替代品来卖，但人体证据薄弱，而且 EFSA 把 12 mg/天的 UL 用于各种形式的 B6 总量，所以把 P5P 当成例外没有依据。一个现实后果：由于能量饮料、强化谷物和复合 B 族产品里都加了 B6，人们会在无意中累积到补充剂级别的剂量，叠加几种产品就很容易越过 UL，而饮食对这个风险几乎没有贡献。

Absorption吸收Roughly 75% of dietary B6 is absorbed. Plant B6 is partly pyridoxine-5'-beta-D-glucoside, which is about half as available as free pyridoxine and can act as a weak antagonist: a diet supplying 27% of its B6 as PNG lowered plasma total B6 and red cell PLP in women, an effect the authors quantified as a 15-18% loss of total B6 intake (Hansen, Leklem and Miller, J Nutr 1996;126:2512-8, PMID 8857512). That is a real discount on high-PNG plant diets and a modest one, so it should not be stretched into a claim that plant-food B6 numbers are broadly unreliable. Cooking removes more. USDA Table of Nutrient Retention Factors Release 6 (2007) gives B6 retention of 50% for roasted beef (code 0601), 35% for beef braised or simmered without the drippings (0651/0653), 45% for liver simmered without drippings (1152), 80% for roasted chicken (0805), 50% for legumes boiled 2-2.5 h (0541), 65% for legumes boiled 45-75 min and drained (0521) and 85% for greens boiled in water to cover (3005). A raw-basis figure such as the 0.933 mg/100 g for raw tuna is not what lands on the plate.膳食 B6 约 75% 被吸收。植物中的 B6 有一部分是吡哆醇-5'-β-D-葡萄糖苷（PNG），可利用率约为游离吡哆醇的一半，还能起弱拮抗作用：一份 27% 的 B6 以 PNG 形式提供的饮食，降低了女性的血浆总 B6 和红细胞 PLP，作者把这一效应量化为总 B6 摄入量损失 15-18%（Hansen、Leklem 与 Miller, J Nutr 1996;126:2512-8, PMID 8857512）。对 PNG 比例高的植物性饮食，这是一个真实而幅度有限的折扣，不应被放大成植物性食物 B6 数据普遍不可靠。烹饪损失更多。USDA 营养素保留系数表（Table of Nutrient Retention Factors）第 6 版（2007）给出的 B6 保留率：烤牛肉 50%（代码 0601），牛肉炖或煮且不计肉汁 35%（0651/0653），肝脏煮制不计肉汁 45%（1152），烤鸡 80%（0805），豆类煮 2-2.5 h 为 50%（0541），豆类煮 45-75 min 后沥干 65%（0521），绿叶菜加水没过煮 85%（3005）。像生金枪鱼 0.933 mg/100 g 这样的生品数值，与最终上桌的量不是一回事。

Food data note食物数据说明All nine composition values and all gram weights verified against named FoodData Central records, including the pistachio data-point count of 13 and its 0.484-1.80 analytical range, and every dose-gap quantity recomputed line by line. The EFSA 2023 opinion, its 12 mg/day UL, the 50 mg reference point and the uncertainty factor of 4 all check out. The one weak link is flagged in place: the 2-6 g/day figure attached to Schaumburg 1983 is secondary-literature summary and is not in the abstract, so it is presented as unconfirmed高。九个成分值和所有克重都已对照具名的 FoodData Central 记录核实，包括开心果的 13 个数据点及其 0.484-1.80 分析范围，每一项剂量差距的用量都逐行重算过。EFSA 2023 意见、其 12 mg/天 UL、50 mg 参考点和不确定系数 4 全部核对无误。唯一的薄弱环节已就地标注：附在 Schaumburg 1983 上的 2-6 g/天出自二手文献概述，摘要中没有，因此以未确认的形式呈现。

Does the body make it身体是否自产Humans have no vitamin B6 biosynthetic pathway; human enzymology only absorbs the dietary vitamers, interconverts them and phosphorylates them to pyridoxal 5-phosphate, the cofactor form. NONE means required, and the recovered prose names seizures and dermatitis as the deficiency picture, so ordinary B6 intake has a real target. The axis supports correcting a shortfall and gives no argument for the high-dose part, which is pharmacological and has to be judged on its own trial and safety record.人体没有维生素 B6 的生物合成通路; 人体酶学只负责吸收膳食中的各种 vitamer, 在它们之间相互转化, 并磷酸化为辅因子形式 pyridoxal 5-phosphate。NONE 意味着必需, 恢复文本把缺乏表现写为癫痫发作与皮炎, 所以常规 B6 摄入有真实的作用目标。这条轴支持纠正不足, 对高剂量这一部分没有任何依据, 那属于药理用法, 应按其自身的试验与安全记录判断。

Pathway合成通路NOT APPLICABLE for synthesis. Human enzymology handles absorption, interconversion of the dietary vitamers and phosphorylation to pyridoxal 5-phosphate, which then serves as cofactor for kynureninase in the tryptophan to niacin equivalents route and for CBS in the transsulfuration of homocysteine.合成为 NOT APPLICABLE。人体酶学只负责吸收, 膳食 vitamer 之间的相互转化, 以及磷酸化为 pyridoxal 5-phosphate; 后者随后作为 kynureninase 的辅因子参与色氨酸生成烟酸当量的路线, 并作为 CBS 的辅因子参与 homocysteine 的转硫途径。

Amount made自产量0 mg/day synthesised, since no human pathway exists. The recovered prose quotes no B6 reference intake figure, so none is asserted here; the comparison it does supply is functional, since B6 deficiency breaks the kynurenine conversion and produces functional niacin deficiency.合成量 0 mg/day, 人体不存在相应通路。恢复的文本没有给出 B6 的参考摄入量数值, 这里也不臆造; 它给出的对照是功能层面的, B6 缺乏会破坏 kynurenine 转化, 造成功能性烟酸缺乏。

Still matters when仍有意义的情形Documented B6 deficiency, where seizures and dermatitis are the described picture; isoniazid therapy, which antagonises B6; and riboflavin or B6 deficiency states that break the kynurenine route to niacin equivalents, producing functional niacin deficiency. For the high-dose part specifically, NEVER ON THIS AXIS, since nothing about endogenous synthesis speaks to doses above requirement.有记录的 B6 缺乏, 表现为癫痫发作与皮炎; isoniazid 治疗, 它拮抗 B6; 以及破坏色氨酸经 kynurenine 生成烟酸当量的 riboflavin 或 B6 缺乏状态, 会造成功能性烟酸缺乏。就高剂量这一部分而言 NEVER ON THIS AXIS, 内源合成对超出需要量的剂量没有任何发言权。

Synthesis source合成来源Derived using this dataset's classification rules from the recovered entry BCAAs sold separately, and B12, folate, thiamine, riboflavin, B6, biotin, pantothenate and vitamin E, which scores B6 NONE and names seizures and dermatitis; pyridoxal 5-phosphate as cofactor for kynureninase from Niacin, choline, omega-3 EPA and DHA, vitamin A from beta-carotene, vitamin K2 (MK-4), inositol and from Niacin (vitamin B3, niacin equivalents), and for CBS from S-adenosylmethionine (SAMe). IOM, Dietary Reference Intakes for Thiamin, Riboflavin, Niacin, Vitamin B6, Folate, Vitamin B12, Pantothenic Acid, Biotin and Choline (1998) is the reference volume cited for this group in the dataset.

Who适用人群Nobody for the marketed indications. Drinking green tea is fine and is a different exposure.就其宣传的功效而言没有适用人群。喝绿茶没问题，那是完全不同的暴露方式。
Pros优点
  • Green tea as a beverage has no meaningful hepatotoxicity signal and is a perfectly reasonable drink.绿茶作为饮品没有有意义的肝毒性信号，是一种完全合理的饮料。
Cons缺点
  • EFSA was unable to identify ANY dose of EGCG from green tea extracts that can be considered safe, because catechin composition varies with cultivar, growing conditions and extraction method. That is an unusual regulatory conclusion.EFSA 无法确定绿茶提取物中任何一个可被认定为安全的 EGCG 剂量，因为儿茶素组成随品种、种植条件和提取工艺而变化。这是一个不寻常的监管结论。
  • NIH LiverTox documents more than 100 published cases of clinically apparent liver injury: median latency 42 days, 95% hepatocellular, severe in 35%, and transplantation in 8%, with fatal acute liver failure reported.NIH 的 LiverTox 收录了 100 例以上有明确临床表现的肝损伤：中位潜伏期 42 天，95% 为肝细胞型，35% 为重度，8% 接受肝移植，并有致死性急性肝衰竭的报告。
  • HLA-B*35:01 was present in 72% of green tea liver-injury cases versus 11-15% of controls, and essentially nobody is tested for it.在绿茶相关肝损伤病例中，72% 携带 HLA-B*35:01，对照组为 11 至 15%，而基本上没有人会去做这个检测。
  • The weight-loss claim, which is why most of it is sold, has clinically trivial effect sizes where measurable.减重这个卖点是它主要的销售理由，但在可测量的范围内，其效应量在临床上微不足道。
  • It was the second most used of six hepatotoxic botanicals in US national survey data. Avoid entirely with pre-existing liver disease, raised transaminases, or another hepatotoxic agent such as methotrexate, isoniazid, high-dose paracetamol or alcohol.在美国全国调查数据中，它是六种肝毒性植物里使用第二多的。已有肝病、转氨酶升高，或正在使用甲氨蝶呤、异烟肼、大剂量对乙酰氨基酚或酒精等其他肝毒性物质者，应完全避免。
What it does, and what happens without it它有什么作用，缺了会怎样

A tea polyphenol the body does not need; concentrated extracts can injure the liver.一种人体并不需要的茶多酚;高浓度提取物可能损伤肝脏。

No deficiency state exists不存在缺乏状态

In detail详细Epigallocatechin-3-gallate is the dominant catechin of green tea. It is poorly absorbed, extensively methylated, glucuronidated and sulfated, and degraded by gut microbiota, leaving free plasma EGCG in the sub-micromolar range. Proposed actions include inhibition of catechol-O-methyltransferase, modest effects on fat oxidation and binding to the 67 kDa laminin receptor, none of which establish any physiological requirement. The important safety fact runs the other way: concentrated extracts, especially taken while fasting, cause idiosyncratic hepatocellular injury, with published cases spanning intakes of roughly 140 to 1000 mg EGCG per day and a strong association with the HLA-B*35:01 allele. Brewed tea as a beverage is not implicated at these concentrations.表没食子儿茶素没食子酸酯(EGCG)是绿茶中含量最高的儿茶素。它吸收较差,会被大量甲基化、葡萄糖醛酸化和硫酸化,并被肠道菌群降解,使血浆中游离EGCG浓度维持在亚微摩尔范围。所提出的作用包括抑制儿茶酚-O-甲基转移酶、对脂肪氧化的轻微影响,以及与67 kDa层粘连蛋白受体的结合,但这些都不能确立任何生理需求。真正重要的安全事实方向恰恰相反:高浓度提取物,尤其是在空腹状态下服用时,可引起特异质性肝细胞损伤,已发表病例涉及的EGCG摄入量约为每天140至1000 mg,并与HLA-B*35:01等位基因存在密切关联。作为饮品的冲泡茶在这些浓度下不涉及该风险。

There is no deficiency state for this. It is not an essential nutrient, so being short of it is not a thing that can happen.它不存在缺乏状态。它不是必需营养素，所以“缺了它”这件事本身并不成立。

Source来源Oketch-Rabah et al., United States Pharmacopeia comprehensive review of the hepatotoxicity of green tea extracts, Toxicol Rep 2020;7:386-402; NIH LiverTox, Green Tea, NCBI Bookshelf NBK547925

Food and the body食物与身体
In food: Rich食物中：丰富 Dose from food: Reachable靠吃达到剂量：可达到 Body makes it: Cannot身体自产：不能 Food data: High食物数据：高

Green tea, matcha, white tea and gunpowder green tea all deliver EGCG at tens to over a hundred milligrams per cup or bowl from ordinary shop-bought products, so this is the one entry in the set where a normal beverage reaches the doses used in supplement trials. EFSA's exposure assessment puts mean adult intake at 86 to 321 mg EGCG/day across dietary surveys and high-level (95th percentile) intake at 308 to 866 mg/day, so the top of habitual tea drinking brushes the 800 mg supplement threshold. Oolong is often grouped in here, but no measured per-cup figure survived verification, so it gets no row; bottled ready-to-drink green tea is the commercially dominant form and is far weaker than anything listed, and it also lacks a verified figure here.绿茶、抹茶、白茶和珠茶都能以普通市售产品在每杯或每碗中提供数十至一百多毫克 EGCG，因此这是本组中唯一一项普通饮品即可达到补充剂试验剂量的条目。EFSA 的暴露评估显示，各项膳食调查中成人平均摄入量为每天 86 至 321 mg EGCG，高摄入人群（第 95 百分位）为每天 308 至 866 mg，习惯性饮茶的上限已逼近 800 mg 的补充剂阈值。乌龙茶常被归入此类，但没有每杯实测数值通过核实，故不单列一行；瓶装即饮绿茶是商业上的主流形态，含量远低于上列任何一项，此处同样缺少经核实的数据。

To match the dose要达到该剂量800 mg EGCG, the dose at which supplements produce measurable liver enzyme rises, is about 4 to 5 cups of green tea at EFSA's mean brewed concentration of 70.2 mg/100 mL, or 10 to 16 cups of more weakly brewed retail tea, or about 7 to 8 bowls of matcha at 2 g each. EFSA's high-level consumers already reach 308 to 866 mg/day from infusions alone, so the top of that range is at the supplement dose. What differs is the vehicle: the tea drinker's 800 mg arrives spread over a day in two to three litres of water, usually with food, while the supplement delivers it as a single fasted bolus.补充剂在 800 mg EGCG 这一剂量上会造成可测得的肝酶升高。按 EFSA 冲泡液平均浓度 70.2 mg/100 mL 计算，这相当于约 4 至 5 杯绿茶，或 10 至 16 杯冲泡较淡的零售茶，或每碗 2 g 的抹茶约 7 至 8 碗。EFSA 的高摄入人群仅靠冲泡茶饮就已达到每天 308 至 866 mg，该区间上限正处在补充剂剂量水平。差别在载体：饮茶者的 800 mg 分散在一天两到三升水中摄入，通常还伴随食物，而补充剂是空腹一次性大剂量给药。

Food vs supplement食物与补充剂State this plainly: the beverage carries no meaningful liver signal, the extract does. EFSA concluded that intake at or above 800 mg EGCG/day taken as a food supplement causes a statistically significant increase in serum transaminases, while catechins from green tea infusion prepared in the traditional way, and reconstituted drinks of equivalent composition, are in general considered safe. Same molecule, different product. Risk concentrates in high-dose, single-bolus, fasted dosing of concentrated extracts, and Commission Regulation (EU) 2022/2340 now prohibits supplements delivering 800 mg or more EGCG per day in the EU. Green tea extract is also the ingredient behind a large share of liver injury cases attributed to weight-loss and fat-burner blends, which is a warning about the extract rather than about tea.直说结论：饮品没有实质性的肝损伤信号，提取物有。EFSA 认为，以食品补充剂形式摄入每天 800 mg 及以上 EGCG 会导致血清转氨酶出现统计学显著升高；而传统方式冲泡的绿茶所含儿茶素，以及成分相当的复水饮品，总体上被认为是安全的。同一个分子，不同的产品。风险集中在浓缩提取物的高剂量、单次大剂量、空腹服用，欧盟委员会条例 (EU) 2022/2340 现已禁止在欧盟销售每日提供 800 mg 及以上 EGCG 的补充剂。绿茶提取物也是减肥和燃脂复方所致肝损伤病例中占很大比例的成分，这是针对提取物的警示，与饮茶无关。

Absorption吸收Systemic bioavailability of EGCG is low, on the order of 0.1 to 1% of an oral dose as the unchanged compound, with heavy glucuronidation, sulfation and methylation plus colonic degradation. The critical modifier is food: fasted dosing raises EGCG Cmax severalfold compared with the same dose taken with a meal, and fasted administration is both the way extracts are typically taken and the condition associated with hepatotoxicity. Milk and food proteins bind catechins and blunt peak levels, so tea with milk is pharmacologically not tea on an empty stomach. Brewing extracts only part of the leaf's EGCG whereas matcha delivers the whole leaf. The corrected numbers support the point that matcha is no many-fold EGCG upgrade per gram of leaf: matcha measures 50.53 to 56.57 mg/g against gunpowder green tea at 70.22 mg/g in the same 15-product HPLC survey, which found no statistically significant EGCG difference across tea types.EGCG 的全身生物利用度很低，以原型化合物计约为口服剂量的 0.1 至 1%，伴有大量葡萄糖苷酸化、硫酸化和甲基化，以及结肠内降解。关键的调节因素是食物：空腹服用可使 EGCG 的 Cmax 比同剂量随餐服用高出数倍，而空腹服用既是提取物的典型服法，也是与肝毒性相关的条件。牛奶和食物蛋白会结合儿茶素、削平峰值浓度，因此从药理学上看，加奶的茶与空腹喝的茶是两码事。冲泡只能浸出茶叶中一部分 EGCG，抹茶则把整片叶子都送进体内。修正后的数据支持这样一个判断：按每克茶叶计，抹茶在 EGCG 上并没有成倍的优势。在同一项涵盖 15 种产品的 HPLC 调查中，抹茶实测为 50.53 至 56.57 mg/g，珠茶为 70.22 mg/g，该调查未发现不同茶类之间 EGCG 存在统计学显著差异。

Food data note食物数据说明Every EFSA figure verified exactly (70.2 mg/100 mL from 100 samples across 12 references, 7,116 mg/100 g dry leaf, the intake ranges, the 800 mg transaminase conclusion), and the corrected matcha and gunpowder values come from an HPLC survey of 15 commercial products. The white tea row is the only indicative entry高。EFSA 的每一项数据都逐项核实无误（来自 12 篇文献 100 个样本的 70.2 mg/100 mL、干茶 7,116 mg/100 g、各摄入量区间、800 mg 转氨酶结论），修正后的抹茶和珠茶数值来自一项 15 种市售产品的 HPLC 调查。白茶那一行是唯一的参考性条目。

Does the body make it身体是否自产EGCG is a galloylated flavan-3-ol built in the tea plant by the shikimate and phenylpropanoid pathways plus chalcone synthase, with a dedicated epicatechin galloyltransferase adding the gallate group. Humans have none of those enzymes, starting with phenylalanine ammonia-lyase, so intake is the only source and no deficiency exists. On this axis EGCG is optional by definition, which shifts the whole question onto trial benefit and onto safety, where concentrated catechin extracts carry a documented liver injury signal that brewed tea does not.EGCG 是一种没食子酰化的黄烷-3-醇, 在茶树中由莽草酸通路、phenylpropanoid 通路以及 chalcone synthase 合成, 并由专门的 epicatechin galloyltransferase 加上没食子酰基。人体从 phenylalanine ammonia-lyase 起就没有这些酶, 因此摄入是唯一来源, 也不存在缺乏。在这个维度上 EGCG 按定义就是可选项, 于是全部问题落到试验获益和安全性上, 而浓缩儿茶素提取物有明确记录的肝损伤信号, 冲泡茶饮没有。

Pathway合成通路NOT APPLICABLE. Camellia sinensis route: phenylalanine through phenylalanine ammonia-lyase to 4-coumaroyl-CoA, chalcone synthase and the flavonoid branch to epigallocatechin, then galloylation by ECGT using galloyl-1-O-beta-D-glucose as donor.NOT APPLICABLE。Camellia sinensis 途径: 苯丙氨酸经 phenylalanine ammonia-lyase 生成 4-coumaroyl-CoA, 再经 chalcone synthase 和类黄酮分支生成 epigallocatechin, 随后由 ECGT 以 galloyl-1-O-beta-D-glucose 为供体完成没食子酰化。

Amount made自产量0 mg/day. Humans have no flavonoid biosynthetic pathway.0 mg/day。人体没有类黄酮生物合成通路。

Still matters when仍有意义的情形Only trial-supported endpoints. Dose and form are the safety-relevant variables, and there are usable thresholds: EFSA concluded that 800 mg EGCG/day or more taken as a food supplement produces a statistically significant rise in serum transaminases, with no evidence of hepatotoxicity below that level for up to 12 months, while catechins from traditionally brewed green tea infusion are generally considered safe (EFSA Journal 2018;16(4):5239, DOI 10.2903/j.efsa.2018.5239). The USP assessment of case reports concluded that concentrated green tea extract can cause hepatotoxicity, particularly when taken on an empty stomach, and recommended a label caution. Both support cautious use rather than routine use.只看试验支持的终点。剂量和形式是与安全相关的变量, 而且有可用的阈值: EFSA 的结论是, 作为食品补充剂摄入 800 mg EGCG/day 或更多会使血清转氨酶出现统计学显著升高, 在此水平以下最长 12 个月未见肝毒性证据, 而按传统方式冲泡的绿茶中的儿茶素一般被认为是安全的 (EFSA Journal 2018;16(4):5239, DOI 10.2903/j.efsa.2018.5239)。USP 对病例报告的评估结论是浓缩绿茶提取物可导致肝毒性, 空腹服用时尤其如此, 并建议在标签上加注警示。两者都支持谨慎使用而非常规服用。

AACCFFDDBBXXAshwagandha (Withania somnifera)南非醉茄（印度人参）
Verdict结论Avoid不要吃
Evidence证据Grade CC 级
Dose tested已验证剂量300-600 mg/d of root extract standardised to about 5% withanolides. Liver injury occurred at ordinary retail doses.标准化至约 5% 醉茄内酯的根提取物 300 至 600 毫克/天。肝损伤发生在普通零售剂量下。
Who适用人群No population with a demonstrated clinical need. Anyone with liver disease should be steered away entirely.没有任何人群有已证实的临床需要。有肝病者应完全避开。
Pros优点
  • There is a real but small and fragile efficacy signal: pooled Perceived Stress Scale -4.72 (-8.45 to -0.99), Hamilton Anxiety Scale -2.19 (-3.83 to -0.55) and serum cortisol -2.58 across 9 randomised trials and 558 patients.存在一个真实但微弱且脆弱的有效性信号：9 项随机试验、558 名患者中，感知压力量表 -4.72（-8.45 至 -0.99），Hamilton 焦虑量表 -2.19（-3.83 至 -0.55），血清皮质醇 -2.58。
  • A sleep meta-analysis of 5 trials and 400 participants found SMD -0.59, with larger effects at 600 mg/d or more over 8 weeks or longer.一项涵盖 5 项试验、400 名受试者的睡眠 meta 分析得出 SMD -0.59，在 600 毫克/天以上、8 周以上时效应更大。
Cons缺点
  • Hepatotoxicity is documented in a prospective case series from Iceland and the US DILIN network: jaundice with nausea, lethargy and pruritus after a latency of 2 to 12 weeks, cholestatic or mixed injury, symptoms lasting 5 to 20 weeks.肝毒性已被冰岛和美国 DILIN 网络的前瞻性病例系列记录：潜伏 2 至 12 周后出现黄疸伴恶心、乏力和瘙痒，损伤为胆汁淤积型或混合型，症状持续 5 至 20 周。
  • In an Indian case series, 5 of 23 patients had pre-existing chronic liver disease, 3 developed acute-on-chronic liver failure and ALL 3 DIED. Pre-existing liver disease is the hard contraindication.在一组印度病例中，23 名患者里有 5 人本已有慢性肝病，3 人发展为慢加急性肝衰竭，3 人全部死亡。已有肝病是硬性禁忌。
  • Denmark banned it in food supplements in 2023 after its national food institute concluded no safe intake level could be established.丹麦国家食品研究所认定无法确定安全摄入水平后，丹麦于 2023 年禁止其用于食品补充剂。
  • It raises T4 and can precipitate thyrotoxicosis or require a levothyroxine dose reduction. Published cases exist.它会升高 T4，可能诱发甲状腺毒症，或需要下调左甲状腺素剂量。已有公开病例。
  • Avoid in pregnancy (traditional abortifacient use), in autoimmune disease and in transplant recipients (immunostimulant effects), and with sedatives (additive).妊娠期（传统上有堕胎用途）、自身免疫性疾病和移植受者（免疫刺激作用）应避免，与镇静剂合用有叠加作用。
  • The trials are small, short, mostly single-centre and frequently manufacturer-sponsored, with subjective questionnaire endpoints and no hard endpoint anywhere in the literature.这些试验规模小、周期短、多为单中心，且常由厂商资助，终点是主观问卷，整个文献中没有任何硬终点。
What it does, and what happens without it它有什么作用，缺了会怎样

A root extract taken for stress; it plays no part in normal human physiology.一种用于缓解压力的根部提取物,在正常人体生理中不起任何作用。

No deficiency state exists不存在缺乏状态

In detail详细Withania somnifera root contains withanolides (principally withaferin A and withanolide A) together with sitoindosides, and commercial extracts are standardised to withanolide content. Randomised trials running 8 to 12 weeks report modest reductions in self-rated stress scales and in morning serum cortisol, while the proposed HPA axis and GABA-A receptor mechanisms rest largely on animal and in vitro work. Nothing in the human body synthesises withanolides and no metabolic pathway requires them, so this is a pharmacological exposure rather than a nutritional one. Liver injury is a documented harm: a case series from Iceland and the US Drug-Induced Liver Injury Network described five patients (3 male, 2 female, mean age 43, range 21 to 62) who became jaundiced 2 to 12 weeks after starting ashwagandha, with cholestatic or mixed injury (R ratios 1.4 to 3.3) and hyperbilirubinaemia persisting 5 to 20 weeks. Liver tests normalised within 1 to 5 months in four of the five and the fifth was lost to follow-up; no patient developed hepatic failure and there were no deaths or transplants in the series.睡茄(Withania somnifera)根含有睡茄内酯类成分(主要是withaferin A和withanolide A),并伴有sitoindosides,商业提取物通常按睡茄内酯含量进行标准化。为期8至12周的随机试验报告显示,自评压力量表评分和晨间血清皮质醇有轻度下降,而所提出的下丘脑垂体肾上腺轴及GABA-A受体机制主要依据动物和体外实验。人体没有任何组织合成睡茄内酯,也没有代谢通路需要它,因此这属于药理学暴露,而非营养摄入。肝损伤是已被记录的一种危害:冰岛与美国药物性肝损伤网络(DILIN)的一份病例系列报道了5例患者(男性3例,女性2例,平均年龄43岁,范围21至62岁),在开始服用南非醉茄后2至12周出现黄疸,呈胆汁淤积性或混合性损伤(R值1.4至3.3),高胆红素血症持续5至20周。5例中有4例的肝功能在1至5个月内恢复正常,第5例失访。该系列中无一例发展为肝功能衰竭,也无死亡或肝移植病例。

There is no deficiency state for this. It is not an essential nutrient, so being short of it is not a thing that can happen.它不存在缺乏状态。它不是必需营养素，所以“缺了它”这件事本身并不成立。

Source来源PMID 31991029 (Bjornsson et al., Liver Int 2020;40:825-829, ashwagandha-induced liver injury case series); LiverTox monograph NBK548536

Food and the body食物与身体
In food: Not food食物中：非食物 Dose from food: Out of reach靠吃达到剂量：达不到 Body makes it: Cannot身体自产：不能 Food data: High食物数据：高

Ashwagandha is the root, sometimes root plus leaf, of Withania somnifera, a small shrub in the Solanaceae. The root is a medicinal drug rather than a dietary item: bitter, taken as a churna or a decoction in milk, and present in no cuisine as an ingredient. The active steroidal lactones, withanolides such as withaferin A, withanolide A and withanone, occur in Withania and a few related genera and are absent from the food supply. The nightshades people actually eat, tomato, potato, aubergine, sweet and chilli peppers, contain a different class of steroidal compounds (glycoalkaloids such as tomatine and solanine), so botanical relatedness buys nothing here. A related species, Withania coagulans, has fruit used regionally as a vegetarian milk-clotting agent, which is a processing aid rather than a dietary source of withanolides.南非醉茄是 Withania somnifera 的根，有时是根加叶，该植物是茄科的一种小灌木。这个根属于药材，不属于膳食成分：味苦，通常做成 churna 药粉或用牛奶煎煮服用，任何菜系都不把它当配料。其活性成分是甾体内酯类，即睡茄内酯（withanolides），如 withaferin A、withanolide A 和 withanone，只见于醉茄属及少数近缘属，在食物供应链中不存在。人们真正吃的茄科作物，番茄、马铃薯、茄子、甜椒和辣椒，含的是另一类甾体化合物（番茄苷、茄碱等糖苷生物碱），所以植物学上的亲缘关系在这里没有帮助。近缘种 Withania coagulans 的果实在一些地区用作素食凝乳剂，那是加工助剂，并不构成睡茄内酯的膳食来源。

No ordinary food supplies this in a meaningful amount.没有普通食物能提供有意义的量。

To match the dose要达到该剂量Trials use 300-600 mg/day of standardised root extract. KSM-66 is a root-only extract standardised to a minimum 5% withanolides, Sensoril is a root-and-leaf extract at 10%, and Shoden is standardised to 35% withanolide glycosides, so a typical daily dose is roughly 15-60 mg of withanolides. Traditional practice uses 3-6 g/day of dried root powder to reach a comparable place. No food quantity supplies this at any size, because no food plant contains withanolides. Quoting an equivalent weight of an ordinary food would require inventing a content value, so the honest answer is that the dietary route does not exist.试验用量为标准化根提取物 300-600 mg/天。KSM-66 是仅用根的提取物，标准化到至少 5% 睡茄内酯；Sensoril 是根加叶提取物，含量 10%；Shoden 标准化到 35% 睡茄内酯糖苷。因此典型每日剂量约相当于 15-60 mg 睡茄内酯。传统做法用 3-6 g/天的干根粉达到大致相当的水平。任何份量的食物都无法提供这个量，因为没有食用植物含睡茄内酯。要给出某种普通食物的等效重量，就必须凭空编一个含量值，所以诚实的答案是：膳食途径不存在。

Food vs supplement食物与补充剂Plant part matters and so does the regulator's view. Root-only preparations have a better documented safety profile than preparations including leaf and aerial parts, which are richer in withaferin A, the most cytotoxic of the withanolides. Ashwagandha is banned in food supplements in Denmark, the Dutch national institute RIVM has published a risk assessment of Withania preparations (RIVM report 2024-0029), French authorities have advised against use in specific groups, the UK Food Standards Agency has logged rising incident reports and its committee reviewed associations with thyroid toxicity, hypoglycaemia and liver toxicity, and Australia's TGA issued a medicine safety update in July 2026 on continuing reports of ashwagandha-associated liver injury judged to be idiosyncratic. KSM-66's milk-based extraction is a marketing distinction rather than a safety one. Withanolide content also varies with chemotype, cultivation and plant part, so two products at the same milligram dose can differ several-fold in the compounds that matter.用哪个部位很关键，监管机构的态度同样关键。只用根的制剂，安全性资料比含叶和地上部分的制剂更完整，后者 withaferin A 含量更高，而它是睡茄内酯中细胞毒性最强的一个。丹麦禁止在食品补充剂中使用南非醉茄；荷兰国家研究院 RIVM 发布了醉茄属制剂的风险评估（RIVM 报告 2024-0029）；法国主管部门建议特定人群不要使用；英国食品标准局记录到不良事件报告上升，其专家委员会审查了与甲状腺毒性、低血糖和肝毒性的关联；澳大利亚 TGA 在 2026 年 7 月发布药品安全通报，指出与南非醉茄相关的肝损伤报告持续出现，判定为特异质性反应。KSM-66 的牛奶提取工艺是营销上的区别，谈不上安全性上的区别。睡茄内酯含量还随化学型、栽培条件和植物部位变化，所以同样毫克剂量的两个产品，在真正起作用的成分上可能相差数倍。

Absorption吸收Human pharmacokinetic data are thin and no standard bioavailability figure can be quoted with confidence. Withanolides are lipophilic and poorly water-soluble, which is why traditional preparation uses milk or ghee and why modern products add phospholipid or cyclodextrin carriers. Withanolide glycosides (withanosides) are more water-soluble and are the markers Shoden standardises on, so percent withanolides on two labels may refer to chemically different pools measured by different assays. Because there is no food form there is no food-versus-supplement absorption comparison to make; the meaningful comparison is between extract types, and it is not standardised.人体药代动力学数据薄弱，无法有把握地给出标准生物利用度数值。睡茄内酯亲脂、水溶性差，这也是传统制备用牛奶或酥油、现代产品加磷脂或环糊精载体的原因。睡茄内酯糖苷（withanosides）水溶性更好，是 Shoden 标准化所用的标志物，因此两个标签上的“睡茄内酯百分比”可能指化学上不同的成分池，并由不同方法测定。由于没有食物形式，也就无从比较食物与补充剂的吸收；有意义的比较是不同提取物类型之间的比较，而这一点并未标准化。

Food data note食物数据说明for the food and dose determination. The NOT_FOOD call was challenged and upheld, the withanolide dose arithmetic (15-60 mg from 300-600 mg of extract at 5-10%) was verified as correct, and there are no food-composition figures in this entry to be wrong. The verification pass specifically endorsed the refusal to invent a withanolide food content value. The regulatory statements were outside the scope of the numeric verification食物与剂量判定为高。NOT_FOOD 判定经质疑后维持，睡茄内酯剂量的算术（300-600 mg 提取物按 5-10% 计得 15-60 mg）核实无误，本条目也没有可能出错的食物成分数值。核查环节明确认可了拒绝编造睡茄内酯食物含量值的做法。监管方面的陈述不在数值核查范围内。

Does the body make it身体是否自产The active constituents are withanolides, steroidal lactones such as withaferin A and withanolide A, built in the plant from mevalonate-derived sterols. Humans make sterols but not withanolides, and there is no human enzyme that produces the withanolide lactone ring. Nothing about ashwagandha can be framed as replacing something the body has run short of.活性成分是 withanolides, 即 withaferin A 和 withanolide A 这类甾体内酯, 在植物体内由甲羟戊酸途径来源的甾醇构建。人能合成甾醇, 不能合成 withanolides, 也没有任何人类酶能生成 withanolide 的内酯环。因此不能把服用南非醉茄说成补充身体短缺的东西。

Pathway合成通路NOT APPLICABLE. Withanolide biosynthesis proceeds in Withania somnifera from 24-methylenecholesterol through plant cytochrome P450 oxidations; absent from human tissue.NOT APPLICABLE。Withanolide 的生物合成在 Withania somnifera 中由 24-methylenecholesterol 经植物 cytochrome P450 氧化完成; 人体组织中不存在该途径。

Amount made自产量0 (no human biosynthetic pathway)0 (人体没有相应的生物合成途径)

Still matters when仍有意义的情形Nothing on this axis. Screen on trial quality for the claimed indication (stress, sleep, testosterone), extract standardisation to withanolide content, and reported hepatotoxicity and thyroid effects.这条轴上没有理由。改用所声称适应症 (压力, 睡眠, 睾酮) 的试验质量, 提取物按 withanolide 含量的标准化, 以及已报告的肝毒性和甲状腺影响来筛查。

Synthesis source合成来源PMID 37063285 (Bashir A, Front Pharmacol 2023, An updated review on phytochemistry and molecular targets of Withania somnifera)

Refs.文献 Bjornsson Liver Int PMID 31991029; Arumugam PMID 39348746; Cheah PMID 34559859; DTU Denmark 2020
AADDFFDDBBXXWeight-loss, fat-burner and energy blends减重、燃脂与能量复方
Verdict结论Avoid不要吃
Evidence证据Grade DD 级
Dose tested已验证剂量Garcinia products commonly supply 500-1,500 mg of extract. No effective dose has been demonstrated for clinically meaningful weight loss.藤黄类产品常提供 500 至 1500 毫克提取物。对有临床意义的减重，没有任何剂量被证明有效。
Who适用人群No identifiable group. This is the worst-behaving corner of the entire supplement market.没有可界定的适用人群。这是整个补充剂市场表现最恶劣的角落。
Pros优点
  • None identified. The efficacy literature does not support clinically meaningful weight loss from these products.没有发现任何优点。有效性文献不支持这些产品能带来有临床意义的减重。
Cons缺点
  • Weight-loss and energy products account for 71.8% (67.6-76.1) of the supplement-related emergency department visits presenting with cardiac symptoms, out of an estimated 23,005 visits per year in the US.在美国每年约 23005 次补充剂相关急诊中，出现心脏症状的病例有 71.8%（67.6-76.1）来自减重和能量类产品。
  • Adults aged 20-34 accounted for 28.0% of all such visits, so the demographic bearing the harm is young and otherwise healthy.20 至 34 岁成人占全部此类就诊的 28.0%，也就是说承担危害的是年轻、本来健康的群体。
  • The FDA acted against Hydroxycut in 2009 after hepatotoxicity reports including a death. NIH LiverTox maintains a dedicated monograph for Garcinia cambogia acute liver injury including fulminant hepatic failure.2009 年，FDA 在收到包括一例死亡在内的肝毒性报告后对 Hydroxycut 采取行动。NIH LiverTox 为藤黄属的急性肝损伤（包括暴发性肝衰竭）专门设有专论。
  • These are proprietary blends, and 40.9% of all adulterated supplements in the FDA database are weight-loss products. Undeclared sibutramine, withdrawn from all major markets in 2010, and prohibited stimulants such as DMAA, deterenol, octodrine, oxilofrine and phenpromethamine are repeatedly found.它们是专有配方，而 FDA 掺假产品数据库中 40.9% 是减重产品。未标示的西布曲明（2010 年已从所有主要市场撤市）以及 DMAA、deterenol、octodrine、oxilofrine、phenpromethamine 等违禁兴奋剂被反复检出。
  • Serotonin syndrome has been reported with garcinia in combination with SSRIs, SNRIs and MAOIs. Contraindicated in liver disease, arrhythmia and hypertension.藤黄与 SSRI、SNRI 和 MAOI 合用已有 5-羟色胺综合征报告。肝病、心律失常和高血压者禁用。
What it does, and what happens without it它有什么作用，缺了会怎样

Stimulant and herbal blends for fat loss; adulteration with withdrawn drugs is common.用于减脂的兴奋剂与草本复合制剂,常被掺入已撤市药物。

No deficiency state exists不存在缺乏状态

In detail详细Typical declared ingredients are caffeine, green tea catechins, synephrine, yohimbine, garcinia and undisclosed stimulant analogues, often behind a proprietary blend label that conceals individual doses. Weight-loss products accounted for 317 of the 776 supplements associated with US FDA warnings from 2007 to 2016, and within them 84.9% contained sibutramine, an appetite suppressant suspended in the EU in January 2010 and withdrawn in the US in October 2010 over cardiovascular events, though it remained on the market in some countries afterwards; 23.7% contained the laxative phenolphthalein, 6.3% contained sibutramine analogues and 5.4% contained fluoxetine. Non-bodybuilding herbal and dietary supplements as a class carry the worst liver outcomes in the US Drug-Induced Liver Injury Network: among DILIN-enrolled liver-injury cases, death or liver transplantation occurred in 13% of the 85 non-bodybuilding supplement cases against 3% for conventional medications. That group is heterogeneous, covering weight-loss along with energy, joint, immune and mixed products, and the figure describes outcomes among adjudicated cases already in a hepatology referral network rather than the risk of taking such a product. This is a commercial product category built on stimulants and adulterants; there is no nutrient in it and nothing a person can be deficient in.常见标示成分包括咖啡因、绿茶儿茶素、辛弗林(synephrine)、育亨宾(yohimbine)、藤黄果(garcinia)以及未标明的兴奋剂类似物,通常隐藏在“专有配方”标签之下,掩盖了各成分的具体剂量。在2007年至2016年间美国FDA警告所涉及的776种补充剂中,减肥类产品占317种,其中84.9%含有西布曲明(sibutramine),这是一种食欲抑制剂,于2010年1月在欧盟暂停销售,2010年10月因心血管事件在美国撤市,但此后在部分国家仍继续在市场上销售;23.7%含有泻药酚酞(phenolphthalein),6.3%含有西布曲明类似物,5.4%含有氟西汀(fluoxetine)。在美国药物性肝损伤网络(DILIN)中,非健美类草本及膳食补充剂作为一类的肝脏结局最差:在DILIN登记的肝损伤病例中,85例非健美类补充剂病例中有13%发生死亡或肝移植,而常规药物这一比例为3%。该类别本身构成异质,涵盖减肥、能量、关节、免疫及混合类产品,该数字描述的是已经进入肝病转诊网络、被判定为病例的患者结局,而不是服用此类产品的风险本身。这是一个建立在兴奋剂和掺假物之上的商业产品类别;其中没有营养素,也没有人能在其中出现短缺。

There is no deficiency state for this. It is not an essential nutrient, so being short of it is not a thing that can happen.它不存在缺乏状态。它不是必需营养素，所以“缺了它”这件事本身并不成立。

Food and the body食物与身体
In food: Rich食物中：丰富 Dose from food: Partly靠吃达到剂量：部分 Body makes it: n/a身体自产：不适用 Food data: Medium食物数据：中

This category holds four different answers and the earlier single TRACE label hid the most important one. Caffeine is RICH and is the only component with a consistent thermogenic effect, available from coffee and tea by the cup. p-Synephrine is RICH as well: citrus juices carry up to 25 to 40 mg per quarter litre and Seville orange juice about 13 mg per 240 mL glass, which sits inside the clinical dose range, so the earlier NOT_FOOD label for bitter orange was wrong. Garcinia gummi-gutta rind (kodampuli, Malabar tamarind) is a genuine culinary souring agent in Kerala and parts of Southeast Asia, used in fish curry and asam laksa, and carries hydroxycitric acid at 10 to 30% of dry weight. The remainder splits differently: raspberry ketone is TRACE (up to 4.3 mg/kg in raspberries against 100 to 1,400 mg/day sold), green coffee chlorogenic acids come from unroasted beans that nobody eats, yohimbe bark and Coleus forskohlii root are NOT_FOOD, and higenamine and DMAA are synthetic with no food origin at all.这一类别包含四种不同的答案，此前统一标为 TRACE 掩盖了其中最重要的一个。咖啡因属于 RICH，是唯一具有稳定生热效应的成分，一杯咖啡或茶即可获得。对羟基辛弗林（p-synephrine）同样属于 RICH：柑橘类果汁每四分之一升可达 25 至 40 mg，塞维利亚苦橙汁每 240 mL 一杯约 13 mg，落在临床剂量范围之内，因此此前把苦橙标为 NOT_FOOD 是错的。藤黄果（Garcinia gummi-gutta）果皮（kodampuli，马拉巴罗望子）在喀拉拉邦和东南亚部分地区确实是烹饪用的酸味料，用于鱼咖喱和亚参叻沙，羟基柠檬酸含量为干重的 10 至 30%。其余成分的归类各不相同：树莓酮属于 TRACE（树莓中最高 4.3 mg/kg，而在售剂量为每天 100 至 1,400 mg），绿咖啡的绿原酸来自没人会吃的未烘焙咖啡豆，非洲催情树（yohimbe）皮和毛喉鞘蕊花（Coleus forskohlii）根属于 NOT_FOOD，去甲乌药碱（higenamine）和 DMAA 为合成物，完全没有食物来源。

Green tea, brewed (the EGCG and caffeine component of most fat-burner blends)冲泡绿茶（多数燃脂复方中的 EGCG 与咖啡因成分） 20 mg caffeine per 100 mL; for EGCG see the green tea extract entry (70.2 mg/100 mL brewed) 1 cup (200 mL)1 杯（200 mL） 40 mg caffeine, plus roughly 140 mg EGCG at EFSA's mean brewed concentration 20% of a 200 mg caffeine dose per cup每杯相当于 200 mg 咖啡因剂量的 20% Rocha PLA et al., Nutrients 2022;14(20):4417, PMID 36297100, PMC9608580 (green tea infused, 20 mg/100 mL and 40 mg per 200 mL cup, verified); EGCG from EFSA Journal 2018;16(4):5239, DOI 10.2903/j.efsa.2018.5239
Raspberries, raw生树莓 up to 0.43 mg raspberry ketone per 100 g (up to 4.3 mg/kg); published values for raspberries generally cluster around 1 to 4 mg/kg 1 cup / small punnet (125 g)1 杯 / 一小盒（125 g） up to 0.54 mg at the highest reported natural concentration, and typically far less up to 0.5% of a 100 mg supplement dose最高相当于 100 mg 补充剂剂量的 0.5% Bredsdorff L et al., Raspberry ketone in food supplements: high intake, few toxicity data, a cause for safety concern?, Regul Toxicol Pharmacol 2015;73(1):196-200, PMID 26160596, DOI 10.1016/j.yrtph.2015.06.022 (abstract verified: natural occurrence up to 4.3 mg/kg, recommended intake 100 to 1,400 mg/day, 100 mg is 56 times the 1,800 ug/day threshold of toxicological concern for Class 1 substances). The lower bound of 0.001 mg/kg previously stated does not appear in the paper and has been removed

Rows tagged unconfirmed carry a figure the checking pass could not trace back to its cited source. Hover the tag for the reason.标记未核实的行，其数值在核查中无法追溯到所引来源。把鼠标移到标记上可看原因。

To match the dose要达到该剂量Component by component. Caffeine: 200 mg is four to five 150 mL cups of filter coffee on the cited Brazilian table, or about two 240 mL US/UK mugs at roughly 95 mg each, or five cups of green tea, so this one is trivially reachable (guarana powder, yerba mate, cocoa and energy drinks belong in the same picture and appear in the same cited caffeine table, but no per-portion figure was verified here, so they get no row). p-Synephrine: a single 240 mL glass of Seville orange juice at about 13 mg already sits inside the 10 to 53 mg/day range used in the pooled overweight and obese subjects, whose individual study doses spanned 5.5 to 80 mg. Garcinia: 3 g of dried rind souring a pot for four carries 300 to 900 mg HCA at 10 to 30% w/w, about 75 to 225 mg per person against supplement doses of 72 to 900 mg HCA, and less again because HCA transfers only partly into the broth and the rind is fished out rather than eaten, so culinary use lands in the lower middle of the supplement range rather than at its top. Raspberry ketone: 100 mg, the smallest common dose, is about 23 kg of fresh raspberries at the highest natural concentration of 4.3 mg/kg, and the 1,400 mg top dose about 326 kg, so it is unreachable by three orders of magnitude, and the safety review notes even the lowest recommended dose is about 56 times the threshold of toxicological concern for its structural class. Green coffee: extracts standardised to 45 to 50% chlorogenic acids at 400 to 1,600 mg/day supply roughly 200 to 800 mg CGA, and the concentrated dose exists only because green beans are inedible; the cups-of-coffee comparison cannot be stated here, because the bean percentages it rested on were misattributed and have been withdrawn.逐个成分来看。咖啡因：按所引巴西数据表，200 mg 相当于四到五杯 150 mL 滤泡咖啡，或约两杯 240 mL 的美式/英式马克杯（每杯约 95 mg），或五杯绿茶，这一项轻易就能达到（瓜拉纳粉、马黛茶、可可和能量饮料同属这一图景，也出现在所引的同一张咖啡因表中，但此处没有核实过的每份数值，故不单列）。对羟基辛弗林：一杯 240 mL 塞维利亚苦橙汁约 13 mg，已落在超重和肥胖受试者汇总分析所用的每天 10 至 53 mg 范围内，其单项研究剂量跨度为 5.5 至 80 mg。藤黄果：3 g 干果皮为四人份的一锅菜提酸，按 10 至 30% w/w 计含 300 至 900 mg HCA，每人约 75 至 225 mg，而补充剂剂量为 72 至 900 mg HCA；实际还要更少，因为 HCA 只有部分转移到汤汁中，果皮通常被捞出而不吃掉，所以烹饪用量落在补充剂区间的中下段，达不到其上限。树莓酮：常见最小剂量 100 mg，按最高天然浓度 4.3 mg/kg 计约需 23 kg 新鲜树莓，1,400 mg 的最高剂量约需 326 kg，相差三个数量级，无法达到；安全性综述指出，即使最低推荐剂量也约为其结构类别毒理学关注阈值的 56 倍。绿咖啡：按 45 至 50% 绿原酸标准化的提取物，每天 400 至 1,600 mg 可提供约 200 至 800 mg CGA，这种浓缩剂量之所以存在，只是因为生豆不能吃；与咖啡杯数的对比在此无法给出，因为其依据的豆类百分比数据来源标注有误，已撤回。

Food vs supplement食物与补充剂The governing pattern in this category is that the food is safe while the concentrate is not, and Garcinia is the cleanest illustration. Centuries of culinary use of the dried rind as a souring agent in South and Southeast Asian cooking carry no liver-injury signal, while concentrated HCA supplements have produced 34 published hepatotoxicity case reports including nine liver transplants and one death, plus more than 200 adverse events of liver injury and 93 international case reports reviewed by Health Canada, with 17 cases meeting CIOMS/RUCAM causality. The injury looks idiosyncratic rather than dose-dependent, with a proposed HLA-B*35:01 association, so the absence of harm from culinary use says something about the product form rather than about a lower dose, and on corrected arithmetic the culinary serving delivers the middle of the supplement HCA range rather than the top of it. The same shape repeats across the category: green tea extract in fat-burner blends against drinking tea (see that entry), and bitter orange p-synephrine stacked with caffeine and linked to cardiovascular events, where the honest food comparison is a glass of citrus juice carrying a similar p-synephrine dose without the stimulant stack. Yohimbe bark extract has no edible counterpart at all, and raspberry ketone at food flavouring levels of milligrams per kilogram bears no relation to 100 to 1,400 mg/day capsules with essentially no human toxicology. Add the labelling problem: proprietary blends routinely under-declare caffeine and stack multiple stimulants, so the only reliable comparison available is to count your caffeine in cups and treat the rest of the label as unquantified.这一类别的主导模式是食物安全、浓缩物不安全，藤黄果是最清楚的例证。南亚和东南亚烹饪中把干果皮当酸味料使用已有数百年，没有肝损伤信号；而浓缩 HCA 补充剂已产生 34 例已发表的肝毒性病例报告，其中 9 例接受肝移植、1 例死亡，另有 200 多例肝损伤不良事件，以及加拿大卫生部审阅的 93 例国际病例报告，其中 17 例符合 CIOMS/RUCAM 因果关系判定。这种损伤看起来属于特异质反应，并不呈剂量依赖，并有人提出与 HLA-B*35:01 相关，因此烹饪用法没有出现危害说明的是产品形态问题，与剂量更低无关；按修正后的算法，烹饪一份提供的量处于补充剂 HCA 区间的中段，达不到上限。同样的模式在这一类别中反复出现：燃脂复方中的绿茶提取物与喝茶的对比（见该条目），以及与咖啡因叠加、并与心血管事件相关联的苦橙对羟基辛弗林，其诚实的食物对照是一杯柑橘汁，提供相近的对羟基辛弗林剂量而不带兴奋剂叠加。非洲催情树皮提取物完全没有可食用的对应物；树莓酮在食品香料层面的用量为每千克若干毫克，与每天 100 至 1,400 mg 的胶囊毫无关系，后者基本没有人体毒理学数据。再加上标签问题：专有配方常常少报咖啡因并叠加多种兴奋剂，因此唯一可靠的比较办法是按杯数算自己的咖啡因摄入，把标签上其余部分视为未量化。

Absorption吸收Caffeine is the outlier and the reason these blends do anything: it is almost completely absorbed, peaks in 30 to 60 minutes, and behaves much the same from coffee as from a tablet, with coffee's chlorogenic acids only modestly slowing absorption. Chlorogenic acids themselves are poorly bioavailable, with roughly a third absorbed in the small intestine and the remainder extensively metabolised by colonic microbiota into hydroxycinnamic acid derivatives, so the milligrams of CGA printed on a green coffee label map badly onto systemic exposure. Raspberry ketone is rapidly conjugated and cleared, which is one reason the human evidence for it is close to non-existent. Hydroxycitric acid absorption from Garcinia is incomplete and depends on the salt form (calcium, potassium or magnesium salts differ in solubility), which helps explain why the pooled human weight-loss effect is at best around 0.9 kg over placebo, despite doses in the same order as what a serving of Kerala fish curry supplies.咖啡因是这里的例外，也是这些复方能起作用的原因：它几乎被完全吸收，30 至 60 分钟达峰，来自咖啡与来自片剂的表现大致相同，咖啡中的绿原酸只是略微减慢吸收。绿原酸本身生物利用度差，约三分之一在小肠吸收，其余大量被结肠菌群代谢为羟基肉桂酸衍生物，所以绿咖啡标签上印的 CGA 毫克数与全身暴露的对应关系很差。树莓酮会被迅速结合并清除，这也是它的人体证据几近于零的原因之一。藤黄果中羟基柠檬酸的吸收不完全，且取决于盐的形式（钙盐、钾盐或镁盐的溶解度不同），这有助于解释为什么人体汇总分析中的减重效果最多只比安慰剂多约 0.9 kg，尽管其剂量与一份喀拉拉鱼咖喱所提供的量在同一数量级。

Food data note食物数据说明The BraCaffT caffeine table, the raspberry ketone occurrence and TTC figures, and the Garcinia hepatotoxicity case counts all verified exactly. The Garcinia rind HCA percentage and the supplement HCA dose range could not be traced to the cited review, the chlorogenic acid bean percentages were misattributed and have been withdrawn, and the p-synephrine figures come from the verification report's check rather than a direct read中。BraCaffT 咖啡因数据表、树莓酮的天然含量与 TTC 数值，以及藤黄果肝毒性病例数均已逐项核实无误。藤黄果果皮的 HCA 百分比和补充剂 HCA 剂量区间无法追溯到所引综述，绿原酸的豆类百分比数据来源标注有误、已撤回，对羟基辛弗林的数值来自核查报告的复核，并非直接查阅原文。

Does the body make it身体是否自产This is a blended product category whose actual contents are not a defined substance, so the axis label is NA and the split has to be stated: caffeine, synephrine, green tea catechins and yohimbine are plant compounds with no human biosynthetic route and read NONE, while the same blends routinely include L-carnitine, which is endogenously synthesised and CONDITIONAL in its own right, and sometimes CLA, whose c9,t11 isomer has a partial human route. The axis is also the wrong screen for this category, where the recurring analytical finding is undeclared pharmaceuticals, including the withdrawn anorectic sibutramine and banned stimulants, in products marketed as herbal slimmers.这是复方产品类别, 实际内容物并不是一种确定的物质, 所以轴标签为 NA, 拆分必须写明: 咖啡因, 辛弗林, 绿茶儿茶素和 yohimbine 是植物化合物, 人体没有合成途径, 读作 NONE; 而这类复方常含 L-carnitine, 它属内源合成, 本身状态为 CONDITIONAL, 有时还含 CLA, 其 c9,t11 异构体在人体有部分生成途径。这条轴也不是这一类别的正确筛查工具, 该类别反复出现的分析发现是未申报药物, 包括已撤市的减食欲药西布曲明和禁用兴奋剂, 出现在以草本减肥为卖点的产品中。

Pathway合成通路NOT APPLICABLE for the botanical stimulants and catechins. L-carnitine is synthesised in four steps from protein-derived trimethyllysine: TMLHE hydroxylates it to hydroxytrimethyllysine, aldolytic cleavage gives 4-trimethylaminobutyraldehyde, oxidation gives gamma-butyrobetaine, then BBOX1 (gamma-butyrobetaine dioxygenase) makes carnitine; BBOX1 is expressed in liver, kidney and brain and not in skeletal or cardiac muscle, which therefore import carnitine.植物兴奋剂和儿茶素为 NOT APPLICABLE。L-carnitine 由蛋白来源的 trimethyllysine 经四步合成: TMLHE 羟化为 hydroxytrimethyllysine, 醛缩裂解生成 4-trimethylaminobutyraldehyde, 氧化生成 gamma-butyrobetaine, 再由 BBOX1 (gamma-butyrobetaine dioxygenase) 生成肉碱; BBOX1 表达于肝, 肾和脑, 骨骼肌和心肌不表达, 所以这两处依赖转运摄取。

Amount made自产量0 for caffeine, synephrine, catechins and yohimbine. Endogenous L-carnitine synthesis is about 1.2 micromol/kg body weight/day, that is 84 micromol/day and about 13.5 mg/day for a 70 kg adult at MW 161.2, measured in strict vegetarians; in omnivores most body carnitine comes from the diet.咖啡因, 辛弗林, 儿茶素和 yohimbine 为 0。内源 L-carnitine 合成约 1.2 micromol/kg body weight/day, 即 84 micromol/day, 按 MW 161.2 折算 70 kg 成人约 13.5 mg/day, 该数据在严格素食者中测得; 杂食者体内肉碱大部分来自膳食。

Still matters when仍有意义的情形Nothing on this axis for the stimulants and catechins. Screen on undeclared sibutramine and stimulants, cumulative stimulant load on blood pressure and heart rhythm, herb-induced liver injury, and the small and short-lived weight effects even when the labelled ingredients are all that is present. For the carnitine content, diet already supplies most body carnitine in omnivores, so it adds little there, while in strict vegetarians and in the deficiency states listed in the carnitine row it is more than filler.就兴奋剂和儿茶素而言, 这条轴上没有理由。改用未申报的西布曲明和兴奋剂, 兴奋剂累积负荷对血压和心律的影响, 草本引起的肝损伤, 以及即便产品只含标注成分时体重效应也很小且短暂来筛查。至于其中的肉碱, 杂食者体内肉碱大部分已由膳食供给, 这一群体加它意义很小; 在严格素食者以及肉碱行列出的缺乏状态中, 它另有作用。

Synthesis source合成来源PMID 27338710 (Skalicka-Wozniak K, Food Chem Toxicol 2017;108:355-64, Adulteration of herbal sexual enhancers and slimmers); carnitine biosynthesis rate 1.2 micromol/kg body weight/day from the L-carnitine row. Enum note: the recovered label MIXED was mapped to NA as a blended product category.

Refs.文献 Geller NEJM PMID 26465986; Tucker PMID 30646238; LiverTox NBK548087; Cohen Clin Toxicol 2021
AADDFFDDBBXXBodybuilding and test-booster products健美与睾酮提升类产品
Verdict结论Avoid不要吃
Evidence证据Grade DD 级
Dose tested已验证剂量Not applicable. Dosing is label-driven and the label does not reflect the contents.不适用。剂量由标签决定，而标签并不反映实际成分。
Who适用人群Nobody. Any muscle gain is attributable to undeclared controlled substances the user did not consent to take.没有适用人群。任何增肌都归因于使用者未曾同意服用的、未标示的受管制物质。
Pros优点
  • None. There is no hype-versus-reality gap to argue about, because the products contain drugs they do not declare.没有优点。这里不存在“宣传与现实”的落差可争论，因为产品里就含有它们没有申报的药物。
Cons缺点
  • The DILIN prospective series enrolled 44 men, mean age 33, median latency 73 days of use. 100% were jaundiced, 84% had pruritus, 71% required hospitalisation, and liver biopsy in 59% showed mild hepatitis with profound cholestasis.DILIN 前瞻性病例系列纳入 44 名男性，平均 33 岁，中位使用潜伏期 73 天。100% 出现黄疸，84% 有瘙痒，71% 需住院，59% 做了肝活检的患者显示轻度肝炎伴重度胆汁淤积。
  • Chemical analysis of the implicated products repeatedly finds anabolic androgenic steroids not declared on the label. These are controlled substances.对涉事产品的化学分析反复检出标签上未申报的合成代谢雄激素类固醇。这些属于受管制物质。
  • Of 44 products sold as SARMs, only 23 (52%) contained any SARM, 17 (39%) contained a different unapproved drug, 4 (9%) contained no active compound at all, and only 18 (41%) had accurate labels.在 44 款以 SARM 名义销售的产品中，只有 23 款（52%）含有任何一种 SARM，17 款（39%）含有另一种未获批药物，4 款（9%）完全不含活性成分，只有 18 款（41%）标签准确。
  • Muscle building accounted for 11.9% of adulterated products in the FDA database, and bodybuilding products caused 45 of 130 herbal and dietary supplement liver injury cases in the DILIN cohort.在 FDA 掺假产品数据库中，增肌类占 11.9%；在 DILIN 队列中，130 例草药与膳食补充剂肝损伤病例中有 45 例由健美产品引起。
  • ABCB11 gene variants were over-represented in cases versus ethnically matched controls, so some individuals are genetically far more vulnerable and have no way to know.与族裔匹配的对照相比，病例中 ABCB11 基因变异更常见，因此某些人在遗传上更易受害，而他们无从得知。
What it does, and what happens without it它有什么作用，缺了会怎样

Muscle and testosterone products; nearly nine in ten flagged ones contain hidden synthetic steroids.增肌与促睾产品,被标记的产品中近九成含有隐藏的合成类固醇。

No deficiency state exists不存在缺乏状态

In detail详细These products promise anabolic effect from Tribulus terrestris, D-aspartic acid, fenugreek, boron and similar botanicals, none of which raises serum testosterone in men with normal gonadal function at the doses supplied. Of 92 muscle-building supplements associated with US FDA warnings between 2007 and 2016, 89.1% contained synthetic steroids or steroid-like compounds that were not declared on the label. In the US Drug-Induced Liver Injury Network, 45 of 130 supplement-related liver injuries came from bodybuilding products, causing prolonged cholestatic jaundice in young men that lasted weeks to months, though without deaths or transplants in that series. Liver injury attributed to herbal and dietary supplements rose from 7% to 20% of all DILIN cases between 2004 and 2013, and this category is a substantial part of that rise. It is a product class with no nutritional content, so no deficiency state exists.这类产品声称蒺藜(Tribulus terrestris)、D-天门冬氨酸(D-aspartic acid)、葫芦巴(fenugreek)、硼及类似植物成分具有合成代谢效果,但在所提供的剂量下,这些成分均不会提高性腺功能正常男性的血清睾酮水平。在2007年至2016年间美国FDA警告所涉及的92种增肌类补充剂中,89.1%含有标签未标明的合成类固醇或类固醇样化合物。在美国药物性肝损伤网络(DILIN)中,130例补充剂相关肝损伤病例中有45例来自健美类产品,在年轻男性中引起持续数周至数月的胆汁淤积性黄疸,但该系列中未出现死亡或肝移植病例。2004年至2013年间,归因于草本及膳食补充剂的肝损伤在全部DILIN病例中的占比从7%升至20%,这一类别是这一升幅的重要组成部分。这是一个不含任何营养成分的产品类别,因此不存在缺乏状态。

There is no deficiency state for this. It is not an essential nutrient, so being short of it is not a thing that can happen.它不存在缺乏状态。它不是必需营养素，所以“缺了它”这件事本身并不成立。

Source来源PMID 30646238 (Tucker et al., JAMA Netw Open 2018;1:e183337); PMID 25043597 (Navarro et al., Hepatology 2014;60:1399-1408, DILIN herbal and dietary supplement hepatotoxicity)

Food and the body食物与身体
In food: None食物中：无 Dose from food: No dose靠吃达到剂量：无剂量 Body makes it: n/a身体自产：不适用 Food data: High食物数据：高

There is no food source, because the active ingredients are undeclared anabolic androgenic steroids: manufactured pharmaceuticals and controlled substances. The label ingredients are largely decorative. Chemical analysis of the products implicated in liver injury repeatedly finds steroids the label does not mention.没有食物来源，因为其活性成分是未标示的合成代谢雄激素类固醇，也就是人工合成的药物和受管制物质。标签上列的成分基本是装饰。对那些造成肝损伤的产品所做的化学分析，反复检出标签上根本没写的类固醇。

No ordinary food supplies this in a meaningful amount.没有普通食物能提供有意义的量。

To match the dose要达到该剂量Not applicable. You cannot eat your way to an undeclared steroid dose, and you should not want to.不适用。你无法靠吃东西达到一个未标示的类固醇剂量，也不该想去达到。

Food vs supplement食物与补充剂The legitimate food-adjacent route to the advertised outcome is dull and well evidenced: enough total protein to reach about 1.6 g/kg/day, and creatine monohydrate. Both have their own entries with food tables. Neither requires buying a proprietary blend.要达到广告宣称的效果，正当且贴近食物的路径既枯燥又有充分证据：把总蛋白摄入提到约 1.6 克/公斤/天，再加一水肌酸。两者本文都有各自的条目和食物表。都不需要买什么专有配方。

Absorption吸收NONE. This entry is a product category rather than a single substance, so there is no single absorption comparison to make.不适用。本条目是一个产品类别，不是单一物质，因此没有单一的吸收对比可做。

Food data note食物数据说明The classification follows from what the product is, not from composition data高。这个判断来自产品本身是什么，不依赖成分数据。

Does the body make it身体是否自产NA because this is a commercial product category whose contents are not a defined substance, so the axis cannot be applied to the product itself; the recovered classification for its parts is FULL in healthy young men, CONDITIONAL in ageing, hypogonadism and HPG suppression, and NONE for the plant ingredients. A healthy man's testes already make about 7 mg of testosterone a day, output pinned where it is by LH feedback through the hypothalamic-pituitary-gonadal axis, so in a eugonadal man there is no idle synthetic capacity for a capsule to unlock, and the CONDITIONAL tier exists because total testosterone declines roughly 1 percent a year from midlife and the body demonstrably does not make enough in primary or secondary hypogonadism. Tribulus, fenugreek and ashwagandha withanolides score NONE with no requirement and no deficiency state attached, and the compounds that reliably move testosterone are drugs (anabolic steroids, SARMs, hCG, aromatase inhibitors) that work by overriding or suppressing that feedback loop, so no case for these products can be built on this axis.判为 NA, 因为这是商业产品类别, 内容物不是确定的物质, 这条轴无法作用于产品本身; 已研究的分类是健康年轻男性 FULL, 衰老, 性腺功能低下和 HPG 轴受抑制为 CONDITIONAL, 植物成分为 NONE。健康男性的睾丸每天已生成约 7 mg 睾酮, 产量由下丘脑垂体性腺轴的 LH 反馈固定在那个水平, 性腺功能正常的男性没有闲置的合成能力等一粒胶囊去解锁; CONDITIONAL 这一层的存在, 是因为总睾酮从中年起每年下降约 1%, 而在原发性或继发性性腺功能低下中身体确实造不够。tribulus, fenugreek 和 ashwagandha withanolides 判为 NONE, 这个 NONE 不含任何需求含义, 它们既无需求也无缺乏状态; 能可靠改变睾酮的化合物都是药物 (合成类固醇, SARMs, hCG, 芳香化酶抑制剂), 作用方式是压过或抑制那个反馈回路, 所以这些产品在这条轴上得不到支持。

Pathway合成通路NOT APPLICABLE, since the category is not a defined substance and no animal synthesises the plant ingredients. The endogenous process these products claim to raise is testicular steroidogenesis: cholesterol is imported into the mitochondrion by StAR, the rate-limiting step, cleaved to pregnenolone by CYP11A1, the rate-limiting enzymatic conversion, then processed by 3-beta-HSD type 2 (HSD3B2) and CYP17A1 to androstenedione and reduced to testosterone by 17-beta-HSD type 3 (HSD17B3) in LH-driven Leydig cells; human Leydig cells favour the delta-5 route (pregnenolone, 17-hydroxypregnenolone, DHEA, androstenedione or androstenediol, testosterone) because the 17,20-lyase activity of human CYP17A1 is poor on delta-4 substrates. Smaller contributions come from the adrenal cortex (DHEA, DHEA-S, androstenedione) and from peripheral conversion.NOT APPLICABLE, 该类别不是确定的物质, 其植物成分也没有动物能合成。这些产品声称要提高的内源过程是睾丸类固醇生成: 胆固醇由 StAR 转入线粒体, 这是限速步骤, 由 CYP11A1 裂解为 pregnenolone, 这是限速的酶催化转化, 随后经 3-beta-HSD 2 型 (HSD3B2) 和 CYP17A1 生成 androstenedione, 由 17-beta-HSD 3 型 (HSD17B3) 还原为睾酮, 发生在受 LH 调控的 Leydig 细胞内; 人的 Leydig 细胞偏好 delta-5 路线 (pregnenolone, 17-hydroxypregnenolone, DHEA, androstenedione 或 androstenediol, 睾酮), 因为人 CYP17A1 的 17,20-lyase 活性对 delta-4 底物很差。少量额外来源是肾上腺皮质 (DHEA, DHEA-S, androstenedione) 和外周转化。

Amount made自产量About 7 mg/day of testosterone in healthy adult men (NCBI Bookshelf NBK279031, Endotext), alongside smaller amounts of weaker androgens such as androstenedione and DHEA; the testes are the dominant source with small adrenal and peripheral contributions, and NBK279031 does not quantify that split, so the often-quoted over 95 percent figure is not used here. 0 mg/day for the plant ingredients, none of which any animal synthesises. No synthesis figure applies to the product category itself.健康成年男性每天约 7 mg 睾酮 (NCBI Bookshelf NBK279031, Endotext), 同时生成较少量的弱雄激素如 androstenedione 和 DHEA; 睾丸是主要来源, 肾上腺和外周转化贡献很小, NBK279031 未对这一比例给出数值, 因此这里不采用常被引用的超过 95 percent 来自睾丸的数字。植物成分为 0 mg/day, 任何动物都不合成。产品类别本身没有可用的合成量数值。

Still matters when仍有意义的情形Diagnosed hypogonadism, which is treated with prescription testosterone and clinician monitoring rather than with a booster; correcting a measured deficiency of a real cofactor such as vitamin D or zinc; and repairing the inputs that suppress the axis, meaning sleep, energy availability, alcohol and body fat. An analysis of best-selling online testosterone-boosting supplements found most ingredient claims unsupported by human data, with some products carrying very large vitamin and mineral doses (PMID 30621919, J Sex Med 2019;16:203-12), and the concrete consumer risk is adulteration, since over-the-counter boosters are among the products most often found spiked with SARMs, aromatase inhibitors or actual steroids, which do move testosterone and do suppress the axis. For these products themselves: NEVER ON THIS AXIS.确诊的性腺功能低下, 治疗方式是处方睾酮加临床监测, 不靠增强剂; 纠正实测的真实辅因子缺乏, 例如 vitamin D 或 zinc; 以及修复压制该轴的输入, 也就是睡眠, 能量可得性, 酒精和体脂。一项对网络畅销睾酮增强补剂的分析发现, 多数成分主张缺乏人体数据支持, 部分产品含极大剂量的维生素和矿物质 (PMID 30621919, J Sex Med 2019;16:203-12); 具体的消费者风险是掺假, 非处方增强剂是最常被检出掺入 SARMs, 芳香化酶抑制剂或真正类固醇的产品之一, 这些东西确实会改变睾酮, 也确实会抑制该轴。对这些产品本身: NEVER ON THIS AXIS (这条轴上永不适用)。

Synthesis source合成来源NCBI Bookshelf NBK279031 (O'Donnell L, Smith LB, Endocrinology of the Testis and Spermatogenesis, Endotext); PMID 30621919 (Balasubramanian A et al., Testosterone imposters: an analysis of popular online testosterone boosting supplements, J Sex Med 2019;16:203-12); Payne AH, Hales DB, Overview of steroidogenic enzymes. NA assigned under the dataset rule that a mixed commercial product category is not a defined substance; tier detail merged from the recovered entries Bodybuilding and test-booster products, Testosterone (the target of test-booster products), and Test-booster plant ingredients (tribulus, fenugreek, ashwagandha withanolides).

Cons缺点

  • The adulterants are PDE5 inhibitors, chiefly sildenafil and structural analogues designed to evade detection. What it does, and what happens without it它有什么作用，缺了会怎样

Pills sold for erections; a large share of the products FDA has flagged contain undeclared PDE5 inhibitors.用于治疗勃起功能的药丸,FDA所标记产品中有相当一部分含有未标明的PDE5抑制剂。

No deficiency state exists不存在缺乏状态

In detail详细Marketed as herbal or all-natural, these products routinely contain undeclared PDE5 inhibitors. Of 776 dietary supplements associated with US FDA warnings between 2007 and 2016, 353 (45.5%) were sexual enhancement products, and within that group sildenafil was identified in 47.0%, sildenafil analogues in 38.0%, tadalafil in 20.4% and the antidepressant dapoxetine in 4.0%. The botanicals actually named on the label (Panax ginseng, Tribulus terrestris, Epimedium, yohimbe, maca) have no established effect on erectile function at the quantities supplied, so any felt effect points to the hidden pharmaceutical. The concrete danger is a vasodilator taken unknowingly alongside nitrates or in the presence of cardiac disease, since the user believes the product is herbal and does not mention it to a clinician. As a product category there is no nutrient here and no deficiency state.这类产品以草本或纯天然为卖点,但经常含有未标明的PDE5抑制剂。在2007年至2016年间美国FDA警告所涉及的776种膳食补充剂中,353种(45.5%)为性功能增强类产品,在这一组产品中,西地那非(sildenafil)检出率为47.0%,西地那非类似物为38.0%,他达拉非(tadalafil)为20.4%,抗抑郁药达泊西汀(dapoxetine)为4.0%。标签上实际标注的植物成分(人参Panax ginseng、蒺藜Tribulus terrestris、淫羊藿Epimedium、育亨宾yohimbe、玛咖maca)在所提供的剂量下并无已确立的勃起功能改善作用,因此任何自觉的效果都指向隐藏的药物成分。真正具体的危险在于,使用者在不知情的情况下将一种血管扩张剂与硝酸酯类药物合用,或本身患有心脏病,却因为认为产品是“草本”而不会向临床医生提及。作为一个产品类别,这里面没有营养素,也不存在缺乏状态。

There is no deficiency state for this. It is not an essential nutrient, so being short of it is not a thing that can happen.它不存在缺乏状态。它不是必需营养素，所以“缺了它”这件事本身并不成立。

Source来源PMID 30646238, DOI 10.1001/jamanetworkopen.2018.3337 (Tucker et al., JAMA Netw Open 2018;1:e183337, unapproved pharmaceutical ingredients in dietary supplements associated with FDA warnings)
