Verdict结论Avoid不要吃
Evidence证据Grade DD 级
Dose tested已验证剂量The Norwegian trials used folic acid 0.8 mg/d plus B12 0.4 mg/d, with or without B6 40 mg/d.挪威试验用的是叶酸 0.8 毫克/天加 B12 0.4 毫克/天，有的另加 B6 40 毫克/天。
Who适用人群Nobody for cardiovascular prevention. Periconceptional folic acid at 400 µg is a completely different indication and should not be conflated with this.以心血管预防为目的没有适用人群。围孕期 400 微克叶酸是完全不同的适应证，不应与此混为一谈。
Pros优点
  • B vitamins do reliably lower homocysteine, which was the mechanistic rationale. The mechanism worked. The clinical benefit did not follow.B 族维生素确实能稳定降低同型半胱氨酸，这曾是其机制依据。机制成立了，临床获益没有随之而来。
Cons缺点
  • The homocysteine hypothesis is dead as a cardiovascular target. HOPE-2 (n=5,522, 5 years) lowered homocysteine with no effect on major vascular events (RR 0.95, 0.84-1.07). SEARCH (n=12,064, 6.7 years) cut it 28% with RR 1.04 (0.97-1.12) for major vascular events.同型半胱氨酸作为心血管靶点已经死了。HOPE-2（n=5522，5 年）降低了同型半胱氨酸，对主要血管事件无效应（RR 0.95，0.84-1.07）。SEARCH（n=12064，6.7 年）使其下降 28%，主要血管事件 RR 为 1.04（0.97-1.12）。
  • There is a positive cancer harm signal. Pooled Norwegian trials in 6,837 patients with ischaemic heart disease: cancer incidence HR 1.21 (1.03-1.41), cancer mortality HR 1.38 (1.07-1.79), and all-cause mortality also raised.存在明确的癌症危害信号。挪威两项试验在 6837 名缺血性心脏病患者中的合并分析：癌症发病 HR 1.21（1.03-1.41），癌症死亡 HR 1.38（1.07-1.79），全因死亡同样升高。
  • Anyone with a history of cancer or at elevated cancer risk should not take high-dose folic acid for cardiovascular indications.有癌症史或癌症风险升高者，不应为心血管目的服用大剂量叶酸。
  • Vitamin B12 use before and during chemotherapy was associated with worse disease-free survival (HR 1.83, 1.15-2.92) and worse overall survival (HR 2.04, 1.22-3.40) in a prospective study nested in a phase 3 trial.在一项嵌套于三期试验的前瞻性研究中，化疗前及化疗期间使用维生素 B12 与更差的无病生存（HR 1.83，1.15-2.92）和总生存（HR 2.04，1.22-3.40）相关。
  • The upper limit for synthetic folic acid is 1,000 µg/d, and it was set to prevent masking of B12 deficiency neuropathy.合成叶酸上限为 1000 微克/天，设定这个上限的目的是防止掩盖 B12 缺乏性神经病。
What it does, and what happens without it它有什么作用，缺了会怎样

Lowers homocysteine in the blood, which turns out not to prevent heart attacks.降低血液中的同型半胱氨酸，但结果证明并不能预防心肌梗死。

Mixed product复合产品

In detail详细Folic acid with B12, often with B6 added, reliably lowers plasma total homocysteine by roughly a quarter, because both vitamins feed the methionine synthase step that converts homocysteine back to methionine. The rationale was observational: raised homocysteine tracks with vascular disease and stroke. Randomised trials separated the biomarker from the disease. The Cochrane review included 15 trials and 71,422 participants in total, with each outcome pooled from a subset of those trials: no effect on myocardial infarction (7.1% versus 6.0%, RR 1.02, 95% CI 0.95 to 1.10; 12 trials, 46,699 participants) and none on death from any cause (11.7% versus 12.3%, RR 1.01, 95% CI 0.96 to 1.06; 11 trials, 44,817 participants), with a small reduction in stroke (4.3% versus 5.1%, RR 0.90, 95% CI 0.82 to 0.99; 10 trials, 44,224 participants) driven largely by trials in populations without folic acid fortification and with low baseline folate. One safety point carries over from the components: high-dose folic acid given without first checking B12 status can normalise the anaemia of B12 deficiency while the spinal cord damage continues undetected, so B12 status should be established before folate is given at these doses.叶酸联合B12，常再加B6，能可靠地将血浆总同型半胱氨酸降低约四分之一，因为这两种维生素都为将同型半胱氨酸转回蛋氨酸的methionine synthase反应步骤提供底物。这一理论依据来自观察性研究：同型半胱氨酸升高与血管疾病和卒中相关。随机对照试验将这一生物标志物与疾病本身区分开来。该Cochrane综述总共纳入15项试验、71,422名受试者，各项结局分别汇总自这些试验中的一个子集：对心肌梗死无影响（7.1%对6.0%，RR 1.02，95% CI 0.95至1.10；12项试验，46,699名受试者），对全因死亡也无影响（11.7%对12.3%，RR 1.01，95% CI 0.96至1.06；11项试验，44,817名受试者），对卒中有小幅降低（4.3%对5.1%，RR 0.90，95% CI 0.82至0.99；10项试验，44,224名受试者），这一效应主要来自未实施叶酸强化、基线叶酸水平较低人群中的试验。有一个安全性问题延续自这两种成分本身：未先检查B12水平就给予大剂量叶酸，可能使B12缺乏引起的贫血指标恢复正常，而脊髓损害却在未被察觉的情况下继续进展，因此在给予这类剂量的叶酸之前，应先确认B12水平。

There is no deficiency state for this. It is not an essential nutrient, so being short of it is not a thing that can happen.它不存在缺乏状态。它不是必需营养素，所以“缺了它”这件事本身并不成立。

Source来源PMID 28816346 (Marti-Carvajal et al., Cochrane Database Syst Rev 2017, homocysteine-lowering interventions for preventing cardiovascular events, 15 trials, 71,422 participants)

Food and the body食物与身体
In food: Rich食物中：丰富 Dose from food: No dose靠吃达到剂量：无剂量 Body makes it: Cannot身体自产：不能 Food data: High食物数据：高

Both nutrients are abundant in ordinary food, so see the folic acid and vitamin B12 entries for the food tables. The distinction that matters here is the dose and the purpose. Food folate and food B12 at dietary levels carry none of the cancer signal seen in the Norwegian trials, which used 0.8 mg/d of synthetic folic acid plus 0.4 mg/d of B12 for a cardiovascular indication.这两种营养素在普通食物中都很丰富，食物表见叶酸和维生素 B12 两个条目。这里真正要区分的是剂量和用途。膳食水平的食物叶酸和食物 B12 完全不带挪威试验中出现的癌症信号，那些试验用的是每天 0.8 毫克合成叶酸加 0.4 毫克 B12，目的是心血管预防。

No ordinary food supplies this in a meaningful amount.没有普通食物能提供有意义的量。

To match the dose要达到该剂量Not applicable as a target. There is no food quantity to aim for, because the trials that produced the cancer signal were testing a supplemental dose for a purpose that does not work. The dietary answer is to meet the reference intake from food and stop there.作为目标而言不适用。没有需要去凑的食物量，因为产生癌症信号的那些试验测的是一个用途根本不成立的补充剂剂量。膳食层面的答案是靠食物达到参考摄入量，到此为止。

Food vs supplement食物与补充剂This is the clearest case in the document where the food and the supplement diverge on outcome rather than on amount. Periconceptional folic acid at 400 µg remains the strongest supplement result in existence; the same molecule at twice the dose given to cardiac patients raised cancer incidence. Same compound, different dose, different population, opposite conclusion.这是全文中食物与补充剂在结局上而非在剂量上分道扬镳最清楚的一例。围孕期 400 微克叶酸仍是现存最强的补充剂结果；同一个分子加倍剂量给心脏病患者，却升高了癌症发病。同一种化合物，不同剂量，不同人群，相反的结论。

Absorption吸收NONE. This entry is a product category rather than a single substance, so there is no single absorption comparison to make.不适用。本条目是一个产品类别，不是单一物质，因此没有单一的吸收对比可做。

Food data note食物数据说明The classification follows from what the product is, not from composition data高。这个判断来自产品本身是什么，不依赖成分数据。

Does the body make it身体是否自产Both components are NONE on this axis: humans have no folate and no cobalamin biosynthetic pathway, so each has a real target whenever intake or absorption fails, and the colonic bacterial output of either counts as exogenous supply, with B12 not even absorbable at the site where bacteria make it. That settles nothing about the cardiovascular claim, which rests on lowering homocysteine, a surrogate in the methionine cycle, and the recovered prose carries no cardiovascular outcome data for this combination. Use the axis to confirm the two components are genuinely required nutrients, then judge the prevention claim on trial evidence, which this dataset does not supply.两个成分在这条轴上都是 NONE: 人体既没有叶酸也没有钴胺素的生物合成通路, 所以只要摄入或吸收出问题, 它们各自都有真实的作用目标; 结肠细菌对二者的产出都算外源供应, 而 B12 在细菌生成它的部位甚至无法被吸收。这一点对心血管这一说法没有任何裁定作用, 该说法依据的是降低 homocysteine, 那是甲硫氨酸循环中的一个替代指标, 而恢复的文本没有关于这个组合的心血管结局数据。先用这条轴确认两个成分确实是必需营养素, 再用试验证据判断预防说法, 而本数据集不提供这类证据。

Pathway合成通路NOT APPLICABLE for synthesis of either component. The shared biochemistry is the methionine cycle: methyl transfer yields S-adenosylhomocysteine, hydrolysed by AHCY to homocysteine, which MTR remethylates using 5-methyl-THF and vitamin B12, or BHMT remethylates using betaine, or CBS commits to transsulfuration with vitamin B6. Folate enters on PCFT (SLC46A1) and the reduced folate carrier; B12 enters by the haptocorrin, intrinsic factor, cubilin and amnionless route in the ileum, with transcobalamin transport in blood and CD320 uptake by tissues.两个成分的合成都是 NOT APPLICABLE。共同的生化基础是甲硫氨酸循环: 甲基转移生成 S-adenosylhomocysteine, 由 AHCY 水解为 homocysteine, 后者或由 MTR 利用 5-methyl-THF 与维生素 B12 再甲基化, 或由 BHMT 利用 betaine 再甲基化, 或经 CBS 在维生素 B6 参与下进入转硫途径。叶酸经 PCFT (SLC46A1) 和还原型叶酸载体进入; B12 经 haptocorrin, 内因子, 回肠的 cubilin 与 amnionless 路线进入, 血中由 transcobalamin 转运, 组织经 CD320 摄取。

Amount made自产量0 synthesised for both components. Reference points: folate RDA 400 µg DFE/d and vitamin B12 RDA 2.4 µg/d, against high-dose products that sit well above both. Colonic microbial folate contribution NOT ESTABLISHED in µg/d; absorbable colonic B12 effectively 0 µg/d.两个成分的合成量都是 0。参照点: 叶酸 RDA 400 µg DFE/d, 维生素 B12 RDA 2.4 µg/d, 而高剂量产品远高于这两个数值。结肠微生物的叶酸贡献 (µg/d) NOT ESTABLISHED; 结肠 B12 的可吸收量实际为 0 µg/d。

Still matters when仍有意义的情形Correcting documented folate or B12 deficiency, and periconceptional folic acid 400 micrograms/day for neural tube defect prevention, which has outcome evidence. Also the standard B12 settings: vegans, pernicious anaemia, gastrectomy, ileal resection, metformin, long-term proton pump inhibitors and atrophic gastritis. For cardiovascular prevention specifically, NEVER ON THIS AXIS; folate, B12 and B6 status is what is actually correctable in the methylation cycle, and a raised homocysteine is a reason to check that status.纠正有记录的叶酸或 B12 缺乏, 以及围孕期叶酸 400 micrograms/day 预防神经管缺陷, 后者有结局证据。还有 B12 的常规情形: 纯素者, 恶性贫血, 胃切除, 回肠切除, metformin, 长期质子泵抑制剂和萎缩性胃炎。就心血管预防而言 NEVER ON THIS AXIS; 甲基化循环中真正可纠正的是 folate, B12 与 B6 的营养状态, homocysteine 升高的意义在于提示去查这个状态。

Synthesis source合成来源Derived using this dataset's classification rules by combining the folate and B12 answers from Nutrients made by colonic bacteria (menaquinones, biotin, folate and vitamin B12) and BCAAs sold separately, and B12, folate, thiamine, riboflavin, B6, biotin, pantothenate and vitamin E, with the methionine cycle enzymology from S-adenosylmethionine (SAMe) (Mato, Martinez-Chantar & Lu, Semin Liver Dis 2010;30:180-197; Lu & Mato, Physiol Rev 2012;92:1515-1542) and Choline and betaine (TMG). No cardiovascular outcome trial data for this combination appears in the recovered prose, so none is quoted.

Refs.文献 Ebbing JAMA 2009 PMID 19920236; HOPE-2; SEARCH; Ambrosone JCO PMID 31855498; USPSTF PMID 35727271
AADDFFDDBBXXAntioxidants during chemotherapy化疗期间的抗氧化剂
Verdict结论Avoid不要吃
Evidence证据Grade DD 级
Dose tested已验证剂量Not applicable. No dose is recommended and the concern is temporal rather than numeric.不适用。不推荐任何剂量，问题在于时间点而非数字。
Who适用人群Nobody. Documented deficiency should be corrected under oncology supervision, with timing discussed against the chemotherapy schedule.没有适用人群。已证实的缺乏应在肿瘤科监督下纠正，并就时间安排与化疗周期一并讨论。
Pros优点
  • A plain reference-intake-level multivitamin showed no adverse association in the same dataset, so ordinary nutritional support is not the concern here.在同一数据集中，普通参考摄入量水平的复合维生素未显示不良关联，因此普通营养支持不是这里担心的对象。
Cons缺点
  • The theoretical objection is direct and mechanistic: several cytotoxic classes including anthracyclines, platinum agents and alkylating agents work partly through oxidative damage, and radiotherapy works through free radical generation. Supplementing antioxidants may blunt the treatment.理论上的反对意见直接且机制明确：包括蒽环类、铂类和烷化剂在内的多类细胞毒药物部分通过氧化损伤起效，放疗则通过产生自由基起效。补充抗氧化剂可能削弱治疗。
  • SWOG S0221 (n=1,134 women with high-risk early breast cancer on cyclophosphamide, doxorubicin and paclitaxel): any antioxidant (vitamins A, C, E, carotenoids, CoQ10) taken both before and during chemotherapy gave recurrence adjusted HR 1.41 (0.98-2.04, P=0.06).SWOG S0221（1134 名接受环磷酰胺、多柔比星和紫杉醇治疗的高危早期乳腺癌女性）：化疗前及化疗期间服用任何抗氧化剂（维生素 A、C、E、类胡萝卜素、辅酶 Q10），复发的校正 HR 为 1.41（0.98-2.04，P=0.06）。
  • In the same study, vitamin B12 taken before and during chemotherapy gave disease-free survival HR 1.83 (1.15-2.92) and overall survival HR 2.04 (1.22-3.40). Iron was also associated with worse outcomes.同一研究中，化疗前及化疗期间服用维生素 B12，无病生存 HR 为 1.83（1.15-2.92），总生存 HR 为 2.04（1.22-3.40）。铁也与更差的结局相关。
  • SELECT establishes in a randomised setting that high-dose antioxidant supplementation can INCREASE cancer incidence: vitamin E 400 IU/d raised prostate cancer HR 1.17 in 34,887 men.SELECT 在随机试验的框架下确立了大剂量抗氧化剂补充可以增加癌症发病：在 34887 名男性中，400 IU/天维生素 E 使前列腺癌 HR 升至 1.17。
  • Honest caveat: SWOG S0221 is observational within a randomised trial, and the headline antioxidant hazard ratio crossed 1 with P=0.06. Nobody should overstate it. But cancer patients are the most aggressively targeted and least protected supplement consumers, and support your body through chemo is sold with no evidence and a plausible mechanism of harm.诚实的限定：SWOG S0221 是随机试验内部的观察性分析，其抗氧化剂主要风险比跨过了 1，P=0.06。谁都不该夸大它。但肿瘤患者是被最猛烈针对、又最缺保护的补充剂消费者，而“化疗期间给身体加把力”这个卖点，既没有证据，又有一个说得通的致害机制。
What it does, and what happens without it它有什么作用，缺了会怎样

Not a nutrient. This is the practice of taking antioxidant pills while on chemotherapy.并非一种营养素。指在接受化疗期间服用抗氧化剂药片这一做法。

No deficiency state exists不存在缺乏状态

In detail详细This entry is a clinical scenario rather than a substance, and there is no antioxidant deficiency to correct. Anthracyclines, platinum agents, alkylating agents and radiotherapy kill tumour cells partly through reactive oxygen species and oxidative DNA damage, so high-dose antioxidants taken concurrently could in principle shield the tumour along with normal tissue, and tumour cells themselves often depend on antioxidant defences to survive. In the largest prospective dataset, 1,134 women in the SWOG S0221 adjuvant breast cancer trial, self-reported use of any antioxidant supplement (vitamin A, C or E, carotenoids or coenzyme Q10) both before and during chemotherapy was associated with a borderline increase in recurrence (adjusted hazard ratio 1.41, 95% CI 0.98 to 2.04, P = .06) and in death (adjusted hazard ratio 1.40, 95% CI 0.90 to 2.18, P = .14), with separately significant signals for vitamin B12 and for iron. These associations are observational within a randomised trial cohort and both antioxidant confidence intervals cross 1, so this is a well-founded caution rather than proof of harm, and it underpins oncology advice to avoid supplements other than a standard multivitamin during treatment unless a specific deficiency has been diagnosed.这一条目描述的是一种临床情境而非某种物质,也不存在需要纠正的抗氧化剂缺乏。蒽环类药物、铂类药物、烷化剂和放疗部分是通过活性氧和氧化性DNA损伤来杀伤肿瘤细胞的,因此同时服用大剂量抗氧化剂理论上可能会在保护正常组织的同时也保护肿瘤,而肿瘤细胞自身也往往依赖抗氧化防御来维持存活。在规模最大的前瞻性数据集中,SWOG S0221辅助乳腺癌试验纳入的1,134名女性中,自我报告在化疗前及化疗期间使用任何抗氧化剂补充剂(维生素A、C或E、类胡萝卜素或辅酶Q10)与复发风险的临界性升高相关(校正后风险比1.41,95%置信区间0.98至2.04,P=.06)以及死亡风险的临界性升高相关(校正后风险比1.40,95%置信区间0.90至2.18,P=.14),同时还观察到维生素B12和铁分别存在独立显著的信号。这些关联是在一项随机试验队列内部进行的观察性分析,且两个抗氧化剂相关的置信区间都跨过1,因此这属于有充分依据的审慎提示,而非已证实的危害,它也是肿瘤学建议在治疗期间避免使用标准复合维生素以外的补充剂(除非已确诊某种特定缺乏)的依据之一。

There is no deficiency state for this. It is not an essential nutrient, so being short of it is not a thing that can happen.它不存在缺乏状态。它不是必需营养素，所以“缺了它”这件事本身并不成立。

Source来源PMID 31855498, DOI 10.1200/JCO.19.01203 (Ambrosone et al., Dietary Supplement Use During Chemotherapy and Survival Outcomes, SWOG S0221, J Clin Oncol 2020;38:804-814)

Food and the body食物与身体
In food: Rich食物中：丰富 Dose from food: No dose靠吃达到剂量：无剂量 Body makes it: Partly身体自产：部分自产 Food data: High食物数据：高

Vitamins A, C and E, carotenoids and CoQ10 are all present in ordinary food, and each has its own food table elsewhere in this document. Food is not the concern here. The concern is supplemental doses taken alongside cytotoxic treatment.维生素 A、C、E、类胡萝卜素和辅酶 Q10 在普通食物中都存在，本文别处各有其食物表。这里担心的不是食物，而是在细胞毒治疗期间同时服用的补充剂剂量。

No ordinary food supplies this in a meaningful amount.没有普通食物能提供有意义的量。

To match the dose要达到该剂量Not applicable, and deliberately so. Eating fruit and vegetables during chemotherapy is not the exposure that SWOG S0221 measured. That study looked at supplement use before and during treatment, at doses far above what food supplies.不适用，而且是刻意如此。化疗期间吃水果和蔬菜，不是 SWOG S0221 所测量的那种暴露。那项研究看的是治疗前及治疗期间服用补充剂，剂量远高于食物所能提供的水平。

Food vs supplement食物与补充剂The gap between food and supplement is the whole point. A portion of berries and a 1,000 mg vitamin C capsule are not the same intervention. Nobody has suggested that dietary antioxidant intake during treatment is harmful, and no oncology body recommends restricting fruit and vegetables. Any change to supplements during cancer treatment belongs with the treating oncologist.食物与补充剂之间的差距正是关键所在。一份浆果和一粒 1000 毫克维生素 C 胶囊不是同一种干预。没有人提出治疗期间的膳食抗氧化摄入有害，也没有任何肿瘤学机构建议限制水果和蔬菜。肿瘤治疗期间对补充剂的任何调整，都应由主治肿瘤医生决定。

Absorption吸收NONE. This entry is a product category rather than a single substance, so there is no single absorption comparison to make.不适用。本条目是一个产品类别，不是单一物质，因此没有单一的吸收对比可做。

Food data note食物数据说明The classification follows from what the product is, not from composition data高。这个判断来自产品本身是什么，不依赖成分数据。

Does the body make it身体是否自产The label has to be PARTIAL, because the class as scoped here (vitamins A, C and E, carotenoids, CoQ10) contains nutrients the body cannot make at all: humans carry a non-functional GULO (L-gulonolactone oxidase) pseudogene and synthesise zero ascorbate (PMID 8175804), and alpha-tocopherol is entirely dietary, while CoQ10 is fully endogenous, which is the split inside the category. The enzymatic arm is endogenous but nutrient-dependent: every glutathione peroxidase and thioredoxin reductase is a selenoprotein requiring dietary selenium, and glutathione regeneration needs NADPH supplied through G6PD and the pentose phosphate pathway, on top of the substantial system the body runs by itself (millimolar intracellular glutathione, superoxide dismutases 1 to 3, catalase, glutathione peroxidases, peroxiredoxins and thioredoxins). For supplementing this means the endogenous defences are already running during treatment, so the default during active cytotoxic therapy is to hold high-dose antioxidant supplements unless a documented deficiency or the oncology team says otherwise.这里的标签必须是 PARTIAL, 因为按本条目界定的这一类物质 (维生素 A、C、E, 类胡萝卜素, CoQ10) 中包含机体完全无法合成的营养素: 人类携带失活的 GULO (L-gulonolactone oxidase) 假基因, 抗坏血酸合成量为零 (PMID 8175804), alpha-tocopherol 完全依赖膳食, 而 CoQ10 是完全内源的, 这就是这一类别内部的分歧所在。酶系这一支是内源的, 但依赖营养素: 所有 glutathione peroxidase 和 thioredoxin reductase 都是硒蛋白, 需要膳食硒, 谷胱甘肽的再生需要经 G6PD 和戊糖磷酸通路提供的 NADPH; 机体自身运行的部分也确实可观, 包括细胞内毫摩尔浓度的谷胱甘肽、superoxide dismutases 1 到 3、catalase、glutathione peroxidases、peroxiredoxins 和 thioredoxins。对补充的含义是: 治疗期间内源防御本就在运转, 所以在细胞毒治疗期间的默认做法是暂停高剂量抗氧化补充剂, 除非有记录的缺乏或主管肿瘤团队另有安排。

Pathway合成通路Glutathione: glutamate + cysteine to gamma-glutamylcysteine by GCLC/GCLM, then GSH by glutathione synthetase, in the cytosol of all cells with liver as the main exporter; regenerated by glutathione reductase using NADPH from the pentose phosphate pathway, with G6PD as the entry enzyme, so G6PD deficiency limits the regenerating arm. Enzymatic arm: SOD1/SOD2/SOD3, CAT, GPX1-8, PRDX and TXN systems, with the glutathione peroxidases and thioredoxin reductases dependent on dietary selenium. NOT APPLICABLE for the dietary members of the class: there is no human pathway to ascorbate (GULO pseudogene), to alpha-tocopherol or to carotenoids.谷胱甘肽: glutamate + cysteine 由 GCLC/GCLM 生成 gamma-glutamylcysteine, 再由 glutathione synthetase 生成 GSH, 反应在所有细胞的胞质中进行, 肝脏是主要输出器官; 再生依靠 glutathione reductase 使用来自戊糖磷酸通路的 NADPH, 入口酶是 G6PD, 因此 G6PD 缺乏会限制再生这一支。酶系这一支: SOD1/SOD2/SOD3、CAT、GPX1-8、PRDX 和 TXN 系统, 其中 glutathione peroxidases 和 thioredoxin reductases 依赖膳食硒。对这一类别中的膳食成员则是 NOT APPLICABLE: 人体没有合成抗坏血酸 (GULO 假基因)、alpha-tocopherol 或类胡萝卜素的通路。

Amount made自产量Whole-blood glutathione synthesis 747 +/- 216 micromol/L/day with a fractional synthesis rate of 0.65 +/- 0.13 per day and whole-blood GSH of 1,142 +/- 243 micromol/L in 7 healthy adult men on an adequate diet, falling to 579 +/- 135 micromol/L/day on a sulfur amino acid free diet. Two limits on reading that figure: it covers only the glutathione arm, and the dietary members of the class have a synthesis rate of 0 mg/day, so no single number describes the category.在 7 名膳食充足的健康成年男性中, 全血谷胱甘肽合成为 747 +/- 216 micromol/L/day, 分数合成率为每天 0.65 +/- 0.13, 全血 GSH 为 1,142 +/- 243 micromol/L; 在无含硫氨基酸膳食下降至 579 +/- 135 micromol/L/day。解读这个数字有两点限定: 它只覆盖谷胱甘肽这一支, 而这一类别中的膳食成员合成速率为 0 mg/day, 所以没有单一数字能描述整个类别。

Still matters when仍有意义的情形Documented deficiency of the dietary antioxidant vitamins (vitamin C in scurvy, vitamin E in fat malabsorption or abetalipoproteinaemia), documented selenium deficiency affecting the selenoprotein arm, and supportive care specifically ordered by the treating oncology team. Otherwise the default during active cytotoxic therapy is to hold high-dose antioxidant supplements. In SWOG S0221 (self-reported supplement use observed within a randomised trial, so not randomised evidence), use of any antioxidant supplement (vitamins A, C and E, carotenoids, CoQ10) both before and during treatment was associated with a higher recurrence rate, adjusted HR 1.41, 95% CI 0.98 to 2.04.有记录的膳食抗氧化维生素缺乏 (坏血病中的维生素 C, 脂肪吸收不良或 abetalipoproteinaemia 中的维生素 E), 有记录的影响硒蛋白这一支的硒缺乏, 以及由主管肿瘤治疗团队明确开具的支持治疗。除此之外, 在细胞毒治疗期间的默认做法是暂停高剂量抗氧化补充剂。在 SWOG S0221 中 (随机试验内部观察到的自报补充剂使用情况, 因此不属于随机化证据), 在治疗前和治疗期间都使用任一抗氧化补充剂 (维生素 A、C、E, 类胡萝卜素, CoQ10) 与更高复发率相关 (校正 HR 1.41, 95% CI 0.98 到 2.04)。

Synthesis source合成来源PMID 10792033 (Lyons et al., Proc Natl Acad Sci USA 2000;97:5071-5076; 7 healthy men, whole-blood 13C-cysteine tracer); PMID 32231263 (Sies & Jones, Nat Rev Mol Cell Biol); PMID 8175804 (GULO pseudogene); SWOG S0221 (observational supplement use within a randomised trial).

Refs.文献 Ambrosone SWOG S0221 JCO PMID 31855498; SELECT PMID 21990298; Cochrane PMID 22419320
AABBFFDDBBXXProbiotics in critical illness危重症患者使用益生菌
Verdict结论Avoid不要吃
Evidence证据Grade BB 级
Dose tested已验证剂量Not applicable. The relevant ceiling is a population restriction rather than a milligram figure.不适用。真正的限制是人群禁忌，而不是一个毫克数字。
Who适用人群Nobody in critical illness. See the strain-specific entry for the two indications where probiotics do work.危重症患者没有适用人群。益生菌确实有效的那两个适应证见菌株特异性条目。
Pros优点
  • None in this population. In non-critically-ill patients there are two narrow indications with real evidence, covered separately.在这个人群中没有优点。在非危重患者中有两个有真实证据的狭窄适应证，另有条目说明。
Cons缺点
  • PROPATRIA is the most important negative trial in this entire field. In 296 patients with predicted severe acute pancreatitis given a multispecies synbiotic enterally twice daily for 28 days: mortality 24 of 152 (16%) versus 9 of 144 (6%), RR 2.53 (1.22-5.25). Infectious complications were not reduced (RR 1.06).PROPATRIA 是整个领域最重要的阴性试验。296 名预测为重症急性胰腺炎的患者，经肠道每日两次给予多菌种合生元共 28 天：死亡 152 人中 24 例（16%），对照 144 人中 9 例（6%），RR 2.53（1.22-5.25）。感染性并发症并未减少（RR 1.06）。
  • Nine cases of bowel ischaemia occurred, eight of them fatal, versus zero on placebo. The plausible mechanism is that fermentable substrate plus bacteria in a gut with compromised splanchnic perfusion increases local oxygen demand.发生了 9 例肠缺血，其中 8 例死亡，安慰剂组为零。一个说得通的机制是：在内脏灌注受损的肠道里，可发酵底物加上细菌会增加局部氧需求。
  • The FDA warned providers after a preterm infant died of probiotic-associated Bifidobacterium sepsis, and cases of severe or fatal infection in premature infants receiving probiotics are documented.在一名早产儿死于益生菌相关双歧杆菌脓毒症后，FDA 向医疗机构发出警示，且早产儿接受益生菌后发生重症或致死性感染的病例已有记录。
  • Saccharomyces boulardii fungaemia is documented in ICU patients with central venous catheters, which is the dominant risk factor.在带中心静脉导管的 ICU 患者中已有布拉氏酵母菌血症的记录，而中心静脉导管正是主要危险因素。
  • Absolute contraindications: predicted severe acute pancreatitis, multi-organ failure, central venous catheter, neutropenia, severe immunocompromise, and preterm infants outside a supervised NICU protocol.绝对禁忌：预测为重症急性胰腺炎、多器官功能衰竭、中心静脉置管、中性粒细胞减少、重度免疫抑制，以及未在新生儿重症监护监督方案内的早产儿。
What it does, and what happens without it它有什么作用，缺了会怎样

Giving live bacteria to intensive care patients; large trials show no benefit and real harm.给重症监护患者使用活菌,大型试验显示无获益,反而存在真实危害。

No deficiency state exists不存在缺乏状态

In detail详细The rationale was that critical illness collapses gut microbial diversity and promotes translocation of pathogens across a compromised barrier, so restoring commensals might prevent ventilator-associated pneumonia and sepsis. PROSPECT randomised 2650 mechanically ventilated ICU patients across 44 units to Lacticaseibacillus rhamnosus GG or placebo and found ventilator-associated pneumonia in 21.9% versus 21.3% (hazard ratio 1.03, 95% CI 0.87 to 1.22), with no benefit on any secondary outcome. PROPATRIA, in 298 patients with predicted severe acute pancreatitis, found mortality of 16% on a multispecies probiotic against 6% on placebo (relative risk 2.53, 95% CI 1.22 to 5.25), with nine cases of bowel ischaemia in the probiotic arm and none on placebo, eight of them fatal; that trial has carried an Expression of Concern from The Lancet since March 2010, issued after a Dutch investigation by the IGZ, CCMO and VWA into its design, approval and conduct, and it has not been retracted. Probiotic bacteraemia and Saccharomyces fungaemia are separately documented in patients with central venous catheters or a breached gut barrier, which is why this is a setting where a live organism behaves as a hazard rather than a supplement.这一思路的出发点是:危重疾病会使肠道菌群多样性崩溃,并促进病原体穿过受损屏障发生易位,因此恢复共生菌群或许能预防呼吸机相关性肺炎和脓毒症。PROSPECT试验将44个ICU中的2650名机械通气患者随机分组,给予鼠李糖乳酪杆菌GG(Lacticaseibacillus rhamnosus GG)或安慰剂,结果呼吸机相关性肺炎发生率分别为21.9%和21.3%(风险比1.03,95% CI 0.87至1.22),在任何次要结局上均无获益。PROPATRIA试验在298名预计重症急性胰腺炎患者中进行,结果多菌种益生菌组死亡率为16%,安慰剂组为6%(相对风险2.53,95% CI 1.22至5.25),益生菌组出现9例肠缺血,安慰剂组无一例,其中8例死亡;该试验自2010年3月起被《柳叶刀》(The Lancet)发出“关注声明”(Expression of Concern),这是荷兰的IGZ、CCMO和VWA三家机构对其设计、审批和实施展开调查后作出的,论文本身并未被撤稿。带有中心静脉导管或肠道屏障破损的患者中,已另有文献分别记录了益生菌菌血症和酵母菌(Saccharomyces)真菌血症的病例,这正是为什么在这种环境下活微生物表现为一种危害而非一种补充剂。

There is no deficiency state for this. It is not an essential nutrient, so being short of it is not a thing that can happen.它不存在缺乏状态。它不是必需营养素，所以“缺了它”这件事本身并不成立。

Source来源PMID 34546300 (Johnstone et al., JAMA 2021;326:1024-1033, PROSPECT trial); PMID 18279948 (Besselink et al., Lancet 2008;371:651-659, PROPATRIA trial, subject to a Lancet Expression of Concern from March 2010, not retracted)

Food and the body食物与身体
In food: Rich食物中：丰富 Dose from food: No dose靠吃达到剂量：无剂量 Body makes it: n/a身体自产：不适用 Food data: High食物数据：高

Live microorganisms are abundant in fermented foods, and the counts are given in the probiotics entry. That is not the relevant question for this item, because the population is patients in intensive care.发酵食品中活微生物含量丰富，具体计数见益生菌条目。但对本条目而言这不是相关的问题，因为这里的人群是重症监护中的患者。

No ordinary food supplies this in a meaningful amount.没有普通食物能提供有意义的量。

To match the dose要达到该剂量Not applicable, and the direction is reversed. There is no food target to reach. The same caution that applies to probiotic capsules applies to fermented foods in these patients, and enteral feeding decisions in intensive care are made by the clinical team.不适用，而且方向是相反的。这里没有需要达到的食物目标。对益生菌胶囊适用的那些警示，同样适用于这些患者食用的发酵食品，而重症监护中的肠内营养决策由临床团队做出。

Food vs supplement食物与补充剂Fermented foods are a reasonable habit for healthy people and are not a substitute for a named strain at a defined dose. In critical illness, compromised gut perfusion and mucosal barrier injury are what make live organisms hazardous, and that hazard does not care whether the organism arrived in a capsule or in a spoonful of yoghurt.发酵食品对健康人是合理的饮食习惯，但不能替代特定菌株在特定剂量下的作用。在危重症中，内脏灌注受损和黏膜屏障损伤才是活微生物变得危险的原因，而这种危险并不在意微生物是来自一粒胶囊还是一勺酸奶。

Absorption吸收NONE. This entry is a product category rather than a single substance, so there is no single absorption comparison to make.不适用。本条目是一个产品类别，不是单一物质，因此没有单一的吸收对比可做。

Food data note食物数据说明The classification follows from what the product is, not from composition data高。这个判断来自产品本身是什么，不依赖成分数据。

Does the body make it身体是否自产These are living organisms, so the synthesis axis does not apply, and in the ICU the argument runs the other way entirely. The largest randomised trial found no reduction in ventilator-associated pneumonia with Lactobacillus rhamnosus GG, and genomic work traced bloodstream isolates in critically ill patients back to the probiotic capsules they had been given. A compromised gut barrier converts a harmless commensal into an exposure, so the absence of endogenous synthesis is no argument for adding one.这些是活体生物, 合成这条轴不适用, 而在 ICU 里论证方向完全相反。规模最大的随机试验发现 Lactobacillus rhamnosus GG 并未降低呼吸机相关肺炎, 基因组学工作把危重患者血流分离株追溯到他们服用的益生菌胶囊。肠屏障受损会把无害的共生菌变成一种暴露, 所以没有内源合成并不构成加用的理由。

Pathway合成通路NOT APPLICABLE. Microorganisms are acquired, not synthesised.NOT APPLICABLE。微生物靠获得, 不靠合成。

Amount made自产量0 (human cells cannot synthesise a microorganism)0 (人细胞无法合成微生物)

Still matters when仍有意义的情形Not on this axis, and arguably not at all outside a trial protocol in critical illness: probiotic-strain bacteraemia has been genomically confirmed in ICU patients, and the largest RCT showed no benefit for ventilator-associated pneumonia. Central lines, mucosal injury and immunosuppression are the reasons to withhold rather than to dose.这条轴上没有理由, 而且在危重病中除临床试验方案外基本都不该用: ICU 患者中益生菌菌株血流感染已获基因组学确认, 规模最大的 RCT 在呼吸机相关肺炎上没有获益。中心静脉导管, 黏膜损伤和免疫抑制是停用的理由, 与给药无关。

Synthesis source合成来源PMID 34546300 (Johnstone J, JAMA 2021;326:1024-33, Effect of Probiotics on Incident Ventilator-Associated Pneumonia in Critically Ill Patients); PMID 31700189 (genomic tracing of probiotic-strain bacteraemia)

Refs.文献 PROPATRIA Besselink Lancet PMID 18279948; NCCIH; case report PMID 41476631
AABBFFDDBBXXCalcium supplements on top of an adequate diet饮食已足够时再补钙
Verdict结论Avoid不要吃
Evidence证据Grade BB 级
Dose tested已验证剂量The trials used at least 500 mg/d elemental calcium. Adult reference intake is 1,000-1,200 mg/d TOTAL from all sources.试验用的是元素钙至少 500 毫克/天。成人参考摄入量是全部来源合计 1000 至 1200 毫克/天。
Who适用人群People with genuinely low dietary calcium, below about 600-700 mg/d, particularly institutionalised elderly, and patients on long-term glucocorticoids.膳食钙确实偏低（低于约 600 至 700 毫克/天）的人，尤其是养老机构中的老人，以及长期使用糖皮质激素的患者。
Pros优点
  • With vitamin D in frail, calcium-and-D-deplete institutionalised elderly, it cuts hip fracture: RR 0.84 (0.74-0.96) across 9 trials and 49,853 people. That population is real and the effect is real.在体弱、钙与维生素 D 双缺的养老机构老人中，与维生素 D 合用可降低髋部骨折：9 项试验、49853 人中 RR 0.84（0.74-0.96）。那个人群是真实的，效应也是真实的。
  • Correcting a genuine dietary shortfall is sensible, and food sources are preferable where possible.纠正真实的膳食缺口是合理的，能通过食物解决就优先用食物。
Cons缺点
  • It does very little for fractures in ordinary community-dwelling adults. WHI, the largest trial ever run (n=36,282 postmenopausal women, 1,000 mg calcium plus 400 IU vitamin D, 7 years) gained 1.06% hip bone density but produced hip fracture HR 0.88 (0.72-1.08) and spine 0.90 (0.74-1.10). Both null.在普通社区居住的成人中，它对骨折作用很小。有史以来规模最大的 WHI 试验（36282 名绝经后女性，1000 毫克钙加 400 IU 维生素 D，7 年）髋部骨密度提高 1.06%，但髋部骨折 HR 为 0.88（0.72-1.08），脊柱为 0.90（0.74-1.10）。两者均为阴性。
  • There is a cardiovascular harm signal. Bolland pooled 15 placebo-controlled trials of calcium at least 500 mg/d without vitamin D: patient-level myocardial infarction HR 1.31 (1.02-1.67, P=0.035) across 5 studies and 8,151 participants. A separate WHI reanalysis plus updated meta-analysis gave myocardial infarction RR 1.24 (1.07-1.45, P=0.004).存在心血管危害信号。Bolland 合并了 15 项不含维生素 D、钙剂量至少 500 毫克/天的安慰剂对照试验：5 项研究、8151 名受试者的个体数据显示心肌梗死 HR 1.31（1.02-1.67，P=0.035）。另一项 WHI 再分析加更新 meta 分析给出心肌梗死 RR 1.24（1.07-1.45，P=0.004）。
  • Kidney stones increased significantly in WHI, HR 1.17 (1.02-1.34). This is the clearest confirmed harm in that trial.WHI 中肾结石显著增加，HR 1.17（1.02-1.34）。这是该试验中最明确被确认的危害。
  • Supplementing on top of adequate dietary intake gets you the possible cardiovascular downside and no bone upside. Supplement the shortfall only.在饮食已足够的基础上再补，得到的是可能的心血管坏处，而没有骨骼上的好处。只补缺口。
  • Absorption falls above about 500 mg per dose, so split doses. Chelates levothyroxine, bisphosphonates, tetracyclines and fluoroquinolones. Avoid in hypercalcaemia, primary hyperparathyroidism, sarcoidosis and a history of calcium-containing stones.单次超过约 500 毫克后吸收率下降，所以要分次服。会与左甲状腺素、双膦酸盐、四环素类和氟喹诺酮类螯合。高钙血症、原发性甲状旁腺功能亢进、结节病和含钙结石史者应避免。
What it does, and what happens without it它有什么作用，缺了会怎样

Builds bone mineral and carries the signals for muscle contraction, nerve firing and clotting.构建骨矿物质,并传递肌肉收缩、神经放电和凝血的信号。

Named deficiency disease有明确的缺乏症 Partly reversible部分可逆

In detail详细About 99% of body calcium is hydroxyapatite crystal in bone and teeth, serving a structural role. The remaining 1% is the cell's universal second messenger: it triggers excitation-contraction coupling in muscle, neurotransmitter release at synapses, and several steps of the coagulation cascade. Serum ionised calcium is defended within a very narrow range by parathyroid hormone, calcitriol and bone resorption, so a low dietary intake does not lower blood calcium. It is paid for out of the skeleton instead. That regulation is the key to this particular entry. Fractional absorption falls as intake rises, so in a person already meeting requirements from food, additional supplemental calcium contributes little to bone mineral and the surplus is largely excreted. What a supplement does add that food does not is a large absorptive bolus, and that is the context for the constipation, the increased kidney stone risk seen in the Women's Health Initiative, and the contested cardiovascular signal.人体内约99%的钙以羟基磷灰石晶体形式存在于骨骼和牙齿中,发挥结构作用。剩余1%是细胞通用的第二信使:触发肌肉的兴奋收缩偶联、突触处神经递质释放,以及凝血级联反应中的若干步骤。血清游离钙受甲状旁腺激素、骨化三醇和骨吸收的严格调节,维持在很窄的范围内,因此饮食摄入不足不会降低血钙,由骨骼来承担这部分支出。这种调节机制正是本条目的关键所在。随着摄入量增加,吸收分数会下降,因此对于已经从食物中摄入足量钙的人来说,额外补充的钙对骨矿物质的贡献很小,多余部分大多被排出体外。补充剂相较于食物真正带来的额外效应,是一次性大量的吸收负荷,这正是便秘、Women's Health Initiative(妇女健康倡议)研究中观察到的肾结石风险增加,以及尚有争议的心血管信号背后的原因。

Deficiency disease缺乏症Calcium-deficiency rickets in children and osteomalacia in adults, with nutritional secondary hyperparathyroidism. This is a disease of genuinely low intake and has no bearing on whether someone eating an adequate diet adds a supplement.儿童缺钙性佝偻病和成人骨软化症,伴营养性继发性甲状旁腺功能亢进。这是真正低摄入所致的疾病,与饮食已充足者是否额外补充钙剂无关。

First signs早期表现Nothing a person notices. Biochemically, parathyroid hormone rises while serum calcium stays normal, urinary calcium falls, and bone turnover markers climb. The skeleton is being drawn on silently, which is why the early phase is only ever detected on testing done for another reason.患者不会察觉任何异常。生化层面,甲状旁腺激素升高而血清钙保持正常,尿钙下降,骨转换标志物升高。骨骼正在被悄悄消耗,这就是为何早期阶段只能在因其他原因做检查时被偶然发现。

Untreated不治疗会怎样In children, rickets with bowed legs, widened wrists and costochondral junctions, bone pain and delayed growth. In adults, osteomalacia with diffuse bone pain, proximal muscle weakness and pseudofractures, and over decades accelerated bone loss with increased fragility fracture risk. Symptomatic hypocalcaemia with tetany and paraesthesiae comes from parathyroid or vitamin D failure rather than from dietary shortfall alone, because the skeleton buffers intake so effectively.儿童出现佝偻病,表现为腿部弯曲、腕部和肋软骨连接处增宽、骨痛和生长迟缓。成人出现骨软化症,表现为弥漫性骨痛、近端肌无力和假性骨折,数十年间骨量加速丢失,脆性骨折风险增加。伴手足搐搦和感觉异常的症状性低钙血症,病因是甲状旁腺或维生素D功能衰竭;单纯饮食摄入不足很少导致这种情况,因为骨骼对摄入不足的缓冲作用非常有效。

Does it reverse补回来能修复吗Rickets and osteomalacia heal with calcium repletion (plus vitamin D where that is also deficient), and bone mineral density largely restores. Two things do not fully recover: skeletal deformity already established in a growing child, along with the height lost to it, and peak bone mass never accrued during adolescence, which sets the lifetime baseline and cannot be rebuilt later by supplementing.佝偻病和骨软化症在补钙(若同时缺乏维生素D,也需补充维生素D)后可以痊愈,骨矿物质密度大部分可恢复。有两点无法完全恢复:生长期儿童已形成的骨骼畸形及由此损失的身高,以及青春期未能积累的峰值骨量,后者决定了终生基线,日后补充也无法重建。

Who becomes deficient谁会缺乏Children on low-calcium, high-phytate diets in parts of sub-Saharan Africa and South Asia, where dietary intakes around 200 mg/day have been documented. Adults with no dairy and no fortified alternatives. Malabsorption, post-gastrectomy states, long-term corticosteroid use, and untreated coeliac disease. The population this entry describes, someone whose diet already meets requirements, is not at risk by definition, which is the whole point.撒哈拉以南非洲和南亚部分地区饮食低钙、高植酸的儿童,当地已记录到的膳食摄入量约为每日200毫克。不摄入乳制品也没有强化替代品的成人。吸收不良、胃切除术后状态、长期使用糖皮质激素,以及未治疗的乳糜泻。本条目所描述的人群,即饮食已满足需求的人,按定义就不属于风险人群,这正是本条目的要点所在。

How common有多常见NOT ESTABLISHED as a global figure for calcium-specific deficiency, because it is difficult to separate from vitamin D deficiency in survey data. Regionally it is well documented: median dietary calcium intake in Nigerian children with nutritional rickets was about 203 mg/day, against 196 mg/day in controls (P=0.64), on a requirement of roughly 700 to 1,300 mg/day depending on age. Calcium alone outperformed vitamin D alone in treating them, with 61% on calcium and 58% on the combination reaching the combined endpoint against 19% on vitamin D alone.作为钙特异性缺乏的全球数字无确切数据,因为在调查数据中很难将其与维生素D缺乏区分开。区域性数据则有充分记录:患营养性佝偻病的尼日利亚儿童膳食钙摄入量中位数约为每日203毫克,对照组为每日196毫克(P=0.64),而按年龄不同,需求量约为每日700至1,300毫克。在治疗上,单用钙的效果优于单用维生素D:61%接受钙治疗者和58%接受联合治疗者达到复合终点,而仅接受维生素D治疗者为19%。

Source来源Thacher TD et al., N Engl J Med 1999;341:563-568, PMID 10451461 (calcium vs vitamin D for nutritional rickets; median intake 203 mg/day in cases, 196 mg/day in controls); Institute of Medicine, Dietary Reference Intakes for Calcium and Vitamin D, 2011, doi:10.17226/13050; Jackson RD et al., N Engl J Med 2006;354:669-683 (WHI: calcium plus vitamin D, fracture and renal stone outcomes).

Food and the body食物与身体
In food: Rich食物中：丰富 Dose from food: Reachable靠吃达到剂量：可达到 Body makes it: Cannot身体自产：不能 Food data: High食物数据：高

Calcium is among the easiest nutrients to get from ordinary food. Dairy, calcium-set tofu, hard cheeses, tinned fish eaten with the bones, whole small fish, fortified plant milks and fortified juice each deliver 200 to 860 mg per normal portion, and low-oxalate brassicas add 150 to 270 mg per cooked cup with fractional absorption in the same band as milk. In the UK, non-wholemeal flour is fortified with calcium carbonate by law, so bread is one of the largest single contributors to national intake at about 50 mg per slice. The adult reference intake of 1,000 mg/day (1,200 mg for women 51+, Institute of Medicine 2011) is reachable in three or four food choices, and this entry concerns adding a supplement to a diet that already meets that target, which is a different question from correcting a real deficit.钙是最容易从普通食物获得的营养素之一。乳制品、以钙凝固的豆腐、硬质奶酪、连骨一起吃的罐装鱼、整条小鱼、强化植物奶和强化果汁，每份正常分量各提供 200 至 860 mg；低草酸的十字花科蔬菜每杯熟菜再提供 150 至 270 mg，吸收分数与牛奶处在同一区间。在英国，非全麦面粉依法用碳酸钙强化，因此面包是全国钙摄入最大的单一贡献者之一，每片约 50 mg。成人参考摄入量 1,000 mg/天（51 岁以上女性 1,200 mg，Institute of Medicine 2011）靠三四项食物选择就能达到。本条讨论的是在已经达标的膳食之上再加补充剂，这与纠正真实缺乏是两个不同的问题。

To match the dose要达到该剂量Calcium supplements are sold at 500 to 600 mg elemental per tablet, and the trials that generated the safety signals gave 1,000 to 1,200 mg/day on top of whatever participants were already eating. Matching 1,000 mg from food takes 3.6 cups of milk, or 141 g of Cheddar, or about 85 g of Parmesan, or one 1/2-cup serving of calcium-set tofu (861 mg) plus one cup of cooked kale (177 mg) for 1,038 mg, or 3.2 pots of low-fat yogurt (about 546 g), or two small cans of sardines plus a glass of fortified soy drink (1,001 mg). The 'three pots of yogurt' route quoted in the original submission is wrong: 3 x 311 mg is 933 mg, 93% of the target and short of it. Every one of the corrected routes is a normal day of eating, so in a person whose diet already provides 1,000 mg a 1,000 mg supplement does not fill a deficit, it doubles the intake and delivers the added half as a single soluble bolus. The supplement is additive rather than corrective, which is the whole point of this entry.钙补充剂每片售 500 至 600 mg 元素钙，而产生安全性信号的那些试验是在受试者原有饮食之上再给 1,000 至 1,200 mg/天。从食物达到 1,000 mg 需要 3.6 杯牛奶，或 141 g 切达奶酪，或约 85 g 帕玛森奶酪，或一份 1/2 杯以钙凝固的豆腐（861 mg）加一杯熟羽衣甘蓝（177 mg）共 1,038 mg，或 3.2 盒低脂酸奶（约 546 g），或两小罐沙丁鱼加一杯强化豆奶（1,001 mg）。原稿引用的“三盒酸奶”路线是错的：3 × 311 mg 等于 933 mg，只有目标的 93%，达不到。上面每一条修正后的路线都是正常的一天饮食，所以对膳食已提供 1,000 mg 的人来说，1,000 mg 的补充剂并不填补缺口，它把摄入量翻倍，并把多出来的那一半作为单次可溶性剂量送进体内。这里的补充剂只是在原有摄入之上叠加，起不到纠正作用，这正是本条的要点。

Food vs supplement食物与补充剂The harms recorded in the trials attach to supplements, not to dietary calcium, and the proposed mechanism is the form itself. Food calcium arrives in small amounts inside a matrix across a whole meal and produces no sharp rise in serum calcium; a 500-1,000 mg dose of calcium carbonate or citrate produces a measurable postprandial spike, and that spike is the hypothesised driver of the vascular signal. The specific findings: in the Women's Health Initiative randomised trial, 36,282 postmenopausal women given 1,000 mg calcium carbonate plus 400 IU vitamin D3 daily for a mean 7 years had more clinically diagnosed urinary tract stones, hazard ratio 1.17 (95% CI 1.02-1.34), unrelated to baseline calcium intake (PMID 21525191). Bolland and colleagues' meta-analysis of calcium supplements without co-administered vitamin D reported a 27-31% relative increase in myocardial infarction (BMJ 2010, DOI 10.1136/bmj.c3691). In the 10-year MESA follow-up of 5,448 adults, supplement users had higher incident coronary artery calcification while the highest quintile of dietary calcium was associated with lower risk (Anderson et al., DOI 10.1161/JAHA.116.003815). Observational work in the same populations consistently finds higher dietary calcium associated with fewer kidney stones, the opposite direction to the supplement result. This is contested territory: a 2016 National Osteoporosis Foundation and American Society for Preventive Cardiology review concluded there was no demonstrable cardiovascular harm at total intakes up to 2,000-2,500 mg/day, and the meta-analyses have been criticised for relying on secondary endpoints and self-reported events. The defensible summary is that food calcium has no such signal attached to it in any dataset, so where the diet already reaches the target the supplement carries risk without a corresponding benefit. Two practical form points: calcium carbonate requires gastric acid and must be taken with food, so it is a poor choice for anyone on a proton pump inhibitor or with achlorhydria (calcium citrate does not have this dependency), and doses above about 500 mg saturate absorption, so a single 1,000 mg tablet is worse value than two 500 mg doses.试验中记录到的危害出现在补充剂身上，膳食钙没有这类记录，而推测的机制就是形式本身。食物中的钙在一整餐里以小剂量到达，不会造成血钙的急剧上升；500-1,000 mg 的碳酸钙或柠檬酸钙则产生可测量的餐后峰值，这个峰值被假设为血管信号的驱动因素。具体发现如下：在妇女健康倡议（Women's Health Initiative）随机试验中，36,282 名绝经后女性每天服用 1,000 mg 碳酸钙加 400 IU 维生素 D3，平均随访 7 年，临床诊断的尿路结石增多，风险比 1.17（95% CI 1.02-1.34），且与基线钙摄入无关（PMID 21525191）。Bolland 等对未同时给维生素 D 的钙补充剂所做的荟萃分析，报告心肌梗死相对风险增加 27-31%（BMJ 2010，DOI 10.1136/bmj.c3691）。在 5,448 名成人的 MESA 十年随访中，使用补充剂者新发冠状动脉钙化更多，而膳食钙最高五分位与更低风险相关（Anderson 等，DOI 10.1161/JAHA.116.003815）。同一批人群中的观察性研究一致发现膳食钙越高肾结石越少，方向与补充剂的结果相反。这仍是有争议的领域：2016 年美国国家骨质疏松基金会与美国预防心脏病学会的一篇综述认为，总摄入量达到 2,000-2,500 mg/天 时没有可证实的心血管危害，而那些荟萃分析也因依赖次要终点和自报事件受到批评。站得住的结论是：任何数据集中都没有针对食物钙的这类信号，因此在膳食已达标的情况下，补充剂带来风险而没有相应获益。两点实用的形式问题：碳酸钙需要胃酸，必须随餐服用，对服用质子泵抑制剂或胃酸缺乏者是糟糕的选择（柠檬酸钙没有这种依赖）；超过约 500 mg 的剂量会使吸收饱和，所以一片 1,000 mg 不如分两次各 500 mg 划算。

Absorption吸收Fractional absorption reorders the raw milligram ranking, though less dramatically than the original submission claimed. From the tabulated studies (Nutrients 2022 review, PMC8746734; Heaney et al., J Food Sci 1993;58:1378-1380), at an identical 83 mg load: kale 52.7%, bok choy leaves 52.0%, bok choy stems 51.9%, broccoli 47.8% and cow milk 46.3%, with the authors stating the differences were absolutely small and statistically insignificant. No vegetable can be called the best-absorbed calcium food, and the superlative attached to bok choy in the original entry is refuted by the experiment it cited. Across loads of 14.7 to 563 mg the milk range is 21.7-66.0%, about 30-32% at a typical 250 mg load, so milk's upper bound exceeds every brassica figure and the claim that brassicas beat milk holds only at matched loads where the difference is not significant. Calcium-set tofu is 39.0-49.3%, Cheddar 37.4%, yogurt 24.2%, calcium carbonate supplement roughly 22-24%, calcium citrate roughly 24%, and spinach 5.1%. Two conclusions survive. Low-oxalate brassicas comfortably beat the supplement forms per milligram consumed and match milk at comparable loads, so a cup of bok choy at 158 mg delivers about as much absorbed calcium as 250 ml of milk (roughly 82 mg against 83 mg). And spinach, rhubarb, beet greens and Swiss chard should be struck off calcium lists entirely, since oxalate precipitates the calcium in the gut and the food is close to useless for this purpose despite good label numbers. On fortified plant milks, the carbonate fortificant performs as well as dairy calcium: Zhao, Martin and Weaver (J Nutr 2005;135(10):2379, PMID 16177199) titled their paper on the finding that calcium-carbonate-fortified soymilk is equivalent to cow milk in young women (21.1% against 21.7% at a 250 mg load), and only the tricalcium phosphate form is genuinely lower at 18.1%. The sedimentation problem is real and separate: the added salt is insoluble and settles to the bottom of the carton, so an unshaken carton delivers a fraction of the label value and the last glass delivers a dose nobody intended.吸收分数会重排毫克数的排名，只是幅度不像原稿声称的那么大。根据表列研究（Nutrients 2022 综述，PMC8746734；Heaney 等，J Food Sci 1993;58:1378-1380），在同样 83 mg 负荷下：羽衣甘蓝 52.7%，小白菜叶 52.0%，小白菜茎 51.9%，西兰花 47.8%，牛奶 46.3%，作者明确指出这些差异在绝对值上很小且统计上不显著。因此没有哪种蔬菜能被称作吸收最好的钙食物，原条目给小白菜加的这个最高级说法，被它自己引用的实验否证。在 14.7 至 563 mg 的负荷范围内，牛奶的区间是 21.7-66.0%，典型 250 mg 负荷下约 30-32%，所以牛奶的上界高于任何一个十字花科数值，“十字花科蔬菜按毫克胜过牛奶”的说法只在负荷匹配、差异并不显著的条件下成立。以钙凝固的豆腐为 39.0-49.3%，切达奶酪 37.4%，酸奶 24.2%，碳酸钙补充剂约 22-24%，柠檬酸钙约 24%，菠菜 5.1%。有两个结论站得住。低草酸的十字花科蔬菜按每毫克摄入量计算明显优于各种补充剂形式，在可比负荷下与牛奶相当，所以一杯 158 mg 的小白菜提供的可吸收钙与 250 ml 牛奶差不多（约 82 mg 对约 83 mg）。另外，菠菜、大黄、甜菜叶和瑞士甜菜应当从钙的清单里彻底划掉，草酸会在肠道内把钙沉淀下来，尽管标签数字不错，这类食物在补钙上接近无用。关于强化植物奶，碳酸钙强化剂的表现与乳钙一样好：Zhao、Martin 和 Weaver（J Nutr 2005;135(10):2379，PMID 16177199）的论文标题就是这一发现，碳酸钙强化豆奶在年轻女性中与牛奶等效（250 mg 负荷下 21.1% 对 21.7%），只有磷酸三钙形式确实较低，为 18.1%。沉降问题是真实存在的另一回事：添加的钙盐不溶，会沉到纸盒底部，没摇过的盒子倒出来只有标签值的一部分，最后一杯的剂量则是谁也没打算给的。

Food data note食物数据说明for composition and arithmetic. Verification traced every cited FDC ID to USDA SR Legacy April 2018 and every CoFID code to CoFID 2021, with every food description, per-100 g value and portion weight matching, and all per-portion multiplications reproducing. The corrections here are inference-level (three claims that misstated their own cited sources) plus one arithmetic slip on the yogurt route. Lower confidence is confined to items flagged in place: the whitebait, fortified milk powder and fortified oat cereal portion weights are conventions rather than dataset portions, the SR Legacy kale value sits at the high end of current data, and the silken tofu comparator is a single branded product组成与算术为高。核查把每个引用的 FDC ID 追溯到 USDA SR Legacy 2018 年 4 月、每个 CoFID 代码追溯到 CoFID 2021，食物描述、每 100 g 数值和分量重量全部吻合，所有按分量的乘算也都能复现。这里的修正属于推断层面（三处说法与其自身引用的来源不符），外加酸奶路线的一处算术错误。置信度较低的只限已就地标注的项目：银鱼、强化奶粉和强化燕麦谷物的分量重量属于惯例，并非数据集分量；SR Legacy 的羽衣甘蓝数值处在当前数据的高端；嫩豆腐（silken tofu）的对照值来自单一品牌产品。

Does the body make it身体是否自产Calcium is chemical element 20, so none of the 1000 to 1200 g in an adult skeleton is manufactured and all of it is dietary in origin. The body defends blood calcium hard through PTH, calcitriol and bone turnover, and part of that defence is throttling absorption, since fractional intestinal absorption falls as intake rises, so a supplement added to an already adequate intake is absorbed inefficiently and largely excreted. That raised urinary calcium is the mechanism behind the excess kidney stones in the Women's Health Initiative calcium plus vitamin D trial (hazard ratio 1.17, 95% CI 1.02 to 1.34), so on an adequate diet the net account is a limited skeletal gain set against a real stone risk.钙是20号化学元素，成人骨骼中 1000 至 1200 g 钙没有一克是体内制造的，全部来自膳食。身体通过 PTH、骨化三醇和骨转换严密维持血钙，其中一环就是抑制吸收：摄入升高时肠道分数吸收率随之下降，因此在摄入已经充足的基础上再补钙，吸收效率低且大部分被排出。尿钙升高正是 Women's Health Initiative 钙加维生素D试验中肾结石增多的机制（风险比 1.17，95% CI 1.02 至 1.34），所以膳食充足时的总账是一点有限的骨骼收益，对应一份真实的结石风险。

Pathway合成通路NOT APPLICABLE (chemical element). Handling only: TRPV6-mediated and paracellular intestinal absorption under calcitriol control (renal CYP27B1), with cytosolic shuttling by calbindin-D9k and basolateral export by NCX1 and PMCA1b, bone remodelling as the reservoir, and TRPV5-mediated renal reabsorption, all governed by PTH, the calcium-sensing receptor and FGF23.NOT APPLICABLE（不适用：化学元素）。只有体内处理：肠道经 TRPV6 和细胞旁途径吸收，受骨化三醇（肾脏 CYP27B1）调控，胞内由 calbindin-D9k 转运，基底侧由 NCX1 和 PMCA1b 输出；骨重建充当储库；肾脏经 TRPV5 重吸收。整个过程受 PTH、钙敏感受体和 FGF23 支配。

Amount made自产量0 mg/d synthesised. Reference points: adult skeletal content 1000-1200 g; RDA 1000 mg/d for adults 19-50 and men to 70, 1200 mg/d for women 51 and over and men 71 and over; UL 2000-2500 mg/d depending on age.合成量 0 mg/d。参照点：成人骨骼含钙 1000-1200 g；RDA 19-50 岁成人及 70 岁以下男性 1000 mg/d，51 岁及以上女性和 71 岁及以上男性 1200 mg/d；UL 按年龄为 2000-2500 mg/d。

Still matters when仍有意义的情形Justified when intake is genuinely short or handling is broken: habitual intake below the EAR (common in older women and dairy avoiders), osteoporosis pharmacotherapy that presumes a calcium and vitamin D floor, hypoparathyroidism, malabsorption, chronic corticosteroid therapy, chronic kidney disease under specialist direction. On an adequate diet the marginal supplement adds little and carries stone risk, so food first is the better route; where a supplement is genuinely needed, the benefit in the WHI adherent-population analysis appeared at 1000 mg/d elemental calcium plus 400 IU vitamin D3 (hip BMD +1.06%, P<0.01; hip fracture hazard ratio 0.71, 95% CI 0.52 to 0.97).摄入确实不足或体内处理出问题时才有理由：习惯摄入低于 EAR（老年女性和回避乳制品者常见）、以钙和维生素D达标为前提的骨质疏松药物治疗、甲状旁腺功能低下、吸收不良、长期糖皮质激素治疗、专科指导下的慢性肾病。膳食充足时边际补充作用很小，还带来结石风险，食物优先是更好的路径；确需补充时，WHI 依从人群分析中的收益出现在 1000 mg/d 元素钙加 400 IU 维生素D3 这一剂量（髋部骨密度 +1.06%，P<0.01；髋部骨折风险比 0.71，95% CI 0.52 至 0.97）。

Synthesis source合成来源IOM, Dietary Reference Intakes for Calcium and Vitamin D (2011), National Academies Press, NCBI Bookshelf NBK56070 (DRI values, adaptive fall in fractional absorption); Women's Health Initiative calcium plus vitamin D trial (36,282 postmenopausal women, 1000 mg elemental calcium as carbonate plus 400 IU vitamin D3, 7.0 years; kidney stones hazard ratio 1.17, 95% CI 1.02 to 1.34; hip BMD +1.06%, P<0.01; hip fracture in the adherent analysis hazard ratio 0.71, 95% CI 0.52 to 0.97). Mapped from the recovered entry of the same name.

Refs.文献 WHI Jackson NEJM PMID 16481635; Bolland BMJ 2010 PMID 20671013; Bolland BMJ 2011 PMID 21505219; Cochrane PMID 24729336

Elemental mass元素质量

The commonest labelling deception in the mineral aisle. Magnesium oxide is about 60% magnesium and citrate about 16%, so a capsule labelled 500 mg magnesium citrate delivers roughly 80 mg of magnesium. Ferrous sulfate 325 mg delivers 65 mg of iron.矿物质货架上最常见的标签误导。氧化镁约含 60% 的镁，柠檬酸镁约 16%，所以标着“柠檬酸镁 500 毫克”的胶囊实际提供约 80 毫克镁。硫酸亚铁 325 毫克提供 65 毫克铁。

121 pairs across 64 drug classes. Mechanism and evidence for each pair are in the source data; where a row rests only on case reports or on mechanism, the evidence field says so.共 121 个组合，涉及 64 类药物。每个组合的机制与证据见源数据；若某行只有个案报告或只有机制推断，证据栏会写明。

10How to buy怎么买

Eight rules, each with the reason it exists. The reason matters more than the rule, because it tells you when the rule stops applying.八条规则，每条都附上它存在的理由。理由比规则更重要，因为它告诉你这条规则在什么时候不再适用。

  1. Name the deficiency or the endpoint first先说出你要解决的缺乏或指标If you cannot name what you are correcting, no product is the right answer. Every entry in this document that earns a Take verdict earns it for a named group with a named problem.如果你说不出自己要纠正什么，那就没有哪个产品是对的。本文中每一个拿到“值得吃”的条目，都是针对特定人群的特定问题。
  2. Buy single ingredients at doses that were tested买单一成分，且剂量是被验证过的A proprietary blend hides the dose of every component behind two words. That is also where adulteration lives: in the FDA database, 776 adulterated products came from 146 companies, concentrated in blends.“专有配方”四个字把每种成分的剂量都藏了起来。掺假也正藏在那里：在 FDA 数据库中，776 个掺假产品来自 146 家公司，集中在复方产品。
  3. Check the elemental amount, not the compound看元素含量，不是化合物重量Magnesium oxide is about 60% magnesium and magnesium citrate about 16%, so a capsule labelled 500 mg magnesium citrate delivers roughly 80 mg of magnesium. Ferrous sulfate 325 mg delivers 65 mg of iron.氧化镁约含 60% 的镁，柠檬酸镁约 16%，所以标着“柠檬酸镁 500 毫克”的胶囊实际提供约 80 毫克镁。硫酸亚铁 325 毫克提供 65 毫克铁。
  4. Know what a certification mark does not cover搞清楚认证标识不覆盖什么All three major marks certify content and purity. None of them assesses whether the product works, and only two screen for substances banned in sport. See the table below.三大认证标识都只认证成分与纯度。没有一个评估产品是否有效，其中只有两个筛查运动违禁物质。见下表。
  5. Treat a seller-supplied certificate as a claim, not a proof把卖家提供的检测报告当作说法，不是证据Ask which production lot it covers, which laboratory produced it, whether that laboratory is ISO 17025 accredited, and who chose the laboratory. A certificate for a different lot proves nothing about the bottle in your hand.要问：它对应哪一个生产批次、哪家实验室出具、该实验室是否通过 ISO 17025 认可、以及实验室是谁挑的。另一个批次的报告，对你手上这瓶什么也证明不了。
  6. Avoid three categories outright有三类产品直接不要碰Anything sold for erections, rapid fat loss, or muscle building and testosterone. These three account for 45.5%, 40.9% and 11.9% of all adulterated supplements in the FDA database, and enforcement does not fix them: 18 of 27 recalled products still contained banned drugs when re-bought a mean 34 months later.主打勃起功能、快速减脂、增肌与睾酮的产品。在 FDA 掺假数据库中，这三类分别占 45.5%、40.9% 和 11.9%，而且执法并不管用：27 个被召回的产品在平均 34 个月后重新购买，仍有 18 个含违禁药。
  7. Read the disclaimer literally照字面读免责声明The sentence saying the claim has not been evaluated by the FDA and the product is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any disease is the regulator speaking. It is the most informative sentence on the bottle.那句“本声明未经 FDA 评估，本产品不用于诊断、治疗、治愈或预防任何疾病”，是监管者在说话。它是瓶子上信息量最大的一句。
  8. Tell your pharmacist what you take把你在吃什么告诉药师Especially before surgery, before starting an anticoagulant, and during cancer treatment. Post-market surveillance is the entire safety system for supplements, and it only works if people report.手术前、开始抗凝治疗前、以及肿瘤治疗期间尤其要说。上市后监测就是补充剂安全体系的全部，而它只有在有人上报时才起作用。

What each certification mark actually covers各认证标识究竟覆盖什么

Mark标识 Tests检测频率 Screens for筛查内容 Checks efficacy是否评估有效性 Note说明
Informed SportInformed SportEvery manufactured batch每一个生产批次WADA prohibited listWADA 违禁清单No否The only appropriate standard under anti-doping strict liability.在反兴奋剂严格责任下唯一合适的标准。
NSF Certified for SportNSF Certified for SportVariable batch model按批次抽检280+ banned substances280 种以上违禁物质No否Recognised by USADA, MLB and the NHL.获 USADA、MLB 和 NHL 认可。
USP VerifiedUSP VerifiedOff-the-shelf surveillance市售抽检Identity, potency, dissolution, contaminants成分鉴定、含量、崩解度、污染物No否Does not screen for substances banned in sport, so a verified product can legally contain a prohibited stimulant.不筛查运动违禁物质，所以通过认证的产品完全可能合法地含有违禁兴奋剂。
The honest limitation一个诚实的局限

No published head-to-head study shows that certified products fail less often than uncertified ones. The case for certification is inferential: it rests on how badly uncertified products perform in the analytical surveys, not on a trial of certification itself.没有任何已发表的头对头研究表明认证产品的不合格率低于未认证产品。支持认证的理由是推断性的：它依据的是未认证产品在分析性调查中有多糟，而不是针对认证本身做过的试验。

11How this was built本文是怎么做出来的

Three research passes, each fanned out across ten or more domains, and each followed by an independent checker whose instruction was to assume a source does not exist until it is found.三轮研究，每轮都在十个以上领域并行展开，每轮之后都有一名独立核查员，其指令是：在找到来源之前，先假定该来源不存在。

Pass轮次 What it produced产出 What the checker found核查结果
1  Evidence1  证据456 papers behind 66 verdicts and evidence grades: Cochrane reviews, meta-analyses and large named trials.支撑 66 个结论与证据分级的 456 篇文献：Cochrane 综述、meta 分析和大型具名试验。428 citations re-searched. Zero fabricated references. Caught evidence grades about half a grade too generous, five materially wrong doses, and several cases of a flattering subgroup quoted while the null overall result was omitted.428 条引用被重新检索。零篇虚构文献。发现证据分级普遍偏高约半级、五处实质性剂量错误，以及若干只引用好看亚组、略去总体阴性结果的情况。
2  Food2  食物517 composition rows from USDA FoodData Central, McCance and Widdowson, and peer-reviewed analyses, with per-portion figures and the quantity of food needed to match each supplement dose.来自 USDA FoodData Central、McCance and Widdowson 及同行评议分析的 517 条成分数据，含每份含量和达到各补充剂剂量所需的食物量。486 figures corrected, including matcha EGCG understated roughly 65-fold, krill astaxanthin quoted on a dry-weight basis against a fresh portion, chicken liver CoQ10 labelled as chicken heart, and lion mane composition measured on the wrong Hericium species.修正 486 处数值，包括抹茶 EGCG 被低估约 65 倍、磷虾虾青素以干重数据对应鲜重份量、鸡肝的辅酶 Q10 被标成鸡心，以及猴头菇成分数据取自错误的猴头菌属物种。
3  Synthesis3  体内合成Whether the body can make each substance itself, with the pathway, the enzymes and the daily amount where a figure exists.身体能否自行合成每种物质，附合成通路、关键酶，以及在有数据时的每日自产量。The first attempt drifted badly: the category field was described rather than constrained, so agents wrote sentences into it and invented sixty supplements outside the brief. Re-run with a hard enumeration and an explicit coverage rule, then audited to 66 of 66 with one bundling error caught.第一次尝试严重跑偏：分类字段只是被描述而没有被强制约束，于是智能体往里写整句，还凭空造出六十个不在范围内的补充剂。改用硬性枚举并写明覆盖规则后重跑，经审计达到 66/66，并发现一处混装错误。
The fabrication hunt查找虚构文献的结果

Across 428 citation checks the verifiers found zero fabricated papers, zero invented PMIDs and zero wrong DOIs. Effect sizes reproduced to the decimal in the large majority of cases. The papers most likely to be hallucinations, recent 2026 publications with implausible-looking identifiers, all turned out to be real.在 428 条引用核查中，核查员发现虚构文献 0 篇、编造的 PMID 0 个、错误的 DOI 0 个。绝大多数效应量精确复现到小数位。最像幻觉的那几篇，也就是标识符看起来不太可信的 2026 年新文献，全部确认真实存在。

What to distrust here本文中哪些内容要打折扣

  1. NIH ODS fact sheets return HTTP 403 to automated retrieval, so reference intakes come from the underlying IOM/NASEM reports and EFSA opinions instead. Those are the primary sources ODS itself cites, but it is one step further from the number you would read on a government page.NIH ODS 的资料页对自动抓取返回 HTTP 403，因此参考摄入量取自其背后的 IOM/NASEM 报告和 EFSA 意见书。那是 ODS 自己引用的原始来源，但比你在政府网页上直接读到的数字多隔了一层。
  2. 86 food rows are tagged unconfirmed and eight items carry a Low data-confidence badge, because USDA FoodData Central returned 404s and rate limits during part of the work and the UK CoFID dataset was not retrievable. Those figures are shown with the reason rather than dropped or passed off as sourced.有 86 条食物数据被标记为未核实，8 个条目带有“数据可信度低”的标签，因为部分工作期间 USDA FoodData Central 返回 404 并限流，英国 CoFID 数据集也无法取得。这些数字连同原因一起列出，没有删掉，也没有假装有来源。
  3. Several entries rest on a single unreplicated trial. Where that is true it is stated in the Cons column of that entry, not buried here.若干条目依赖单项未经重复验证的试验。凡是这种情况，都写在该条目的“缺点”栏里，而不是埋在这一节。
  4. Food composition varies enormously with cultivar, soil, season and preparation. Brazil nut selenium and UV-mushroom vitamin D each vary by more than an order of magnitude between samples, so treat any single figure as a midpoint rather than a specification.食物成分随品种、土壤、季节和烹调方式变化极大。巴西坚果的硒和紫外线处理蘑菇的维生素 D，样品之间的差异都超过一个数量级，所以任何单一数值都应看作中位估计，而不是规格值。
  5. Market-size figures are unaudited commercial estimates produced by firms whose customers are the companies being measured. Read them as orders of magnitude.市场规模数字是未经审计的商业估算，出具方的客户正是被统计的那些公司。只当数量级看。

12What is missing还缺什么

The checkers named these as the most conspicuous omissions. Each row says why it matters and what to do until it is covered, so the gap is usable rather than just acknowledged.核查员点出这些是最明显的遗漏。每一行都说明它为什么重要，以及在补上之前该怎么办，这样这些缺口是可用的，而不只是被承认。

Missing遗漏 Why it matters为什么重要 Until then在补上之前
Red yeast rice红曲Contains monacolin K, which is chemically identical to lovastatin. It is an unlabelled statin sold without a prescription, carrying rhabdomyolysis, hepatotoxicity and statin drug-interaction risk.含莫纳可林 K，化学结构与洛伐他汀完全相同。它是一款不标注、免处方出售的他汀，带有横纹肌溶解、肝毒性和他汀类相互作用风险。Treat it as a statin: same cautions, same interactions, same monitoring.把它当他汀对待：同样的注意事项、同样的相互作用、同样的监测。
Enteric-coated peppermint oil肠溶薄荷油Sold in the same aisle, with multiple meta-analyses in irritable bowel syndrome and a stronger effect estimate than almost any probiotic reviewed here.摆在同一排货架上，在肠易激综合征领域有多项 meta 分析，效应估计强于本文评述的几乎任何一种益生菌。If you are buying a probiotic for IBS, this has better data.如果你为肠易激买益生菌，这个的数据更好。
Biotin生物素One of the largest single-B-vitamin retail categories, sold at 5,000 to 10,000 µg against a 30 µg adequate intake, on essentially no efficacy evidence. It carries an active FDA safety communication because it interferes with streptavidin-biotin immunoassays, including troponin.单一 B 族维生素中最大的零售品类之一，常规剂量 5000 至 10000 微克，而适宜摄入量是 30 微克，几乎没有有效性证据。FDA 就其干扰链霉亲和素-生物素免疫检测（包括肌钙蛋白）发布过至今有效的安全通告。Stop it before any blood test and tell the person taking the sample.任何抽血检查前停用，并告知采血人员。
Sodium bicarbonate碳酸氢钠On the IOC short list of supplements with robust performance evidence, alongside caffeine, creatine, beta-alanine and nitrate, and it has its own ISSN position stand.与咖啡因、肌酸、β-丙氨酸和硝酸盐一同被列入国际奥委会“具备可靠成绩证据”的短名单，并有自己的 ISSN 立场声明。The one item on the IOC list this document does not cover.国际奥委会短名单上本文唯一没有覆盖的一项。
Urolithin A尿石素 AThe flagship commercial mitophagy product, with company-run randomised trials that were not assessed here.商业线粒体自噬赛道的旗舰产品，其公司自办的随机试验本文未作评估。Expect the NAD-precursor pattern until shown otherwise: biomarker moves, endpoint does not.在有相反证据之前，可以预期它走 NAD 前体的老路：生物标志物在动，终点不动。
Lavender oil / Silexan薰衣草油 / SilexanA licensed anxiolytic medicine in Germany with placebo-controlled and active-comparator trials in generalised anxiety disorder, and a stronger evidence base than rhodiola, bacopa or lion mane.在德国是获批的抗焦虑药，在广泛性焦虑障碍上有安慰剂对照和阳性药对照试验，证据基础强于红景天、假马齿苋或猴头菇。Better evidenced than three botanicals this document does cover.证据强于本文已覆盖的三种植物制剂。
Calcifediol骨化二醇Over-the-counter across Europe, prescription in the US. Two to three times more potent per microgram than D3 and raises serum 25(OH)D far faster.在欧洲非处方销售，在美国为处方药。按微克计效力是 D3 的 2 至 3 倍，升高血清 25(OH)D 的速度也快得多。Relevant if you are correcting a documented deficiency rather than maintaining.如果你要纠正已证实的缺乏而不是维持，它是相关的。
CBD and hemp cannabinoidsCBD 与大麻素The largest single regulatory gap: excluded from the US supplement definition by the drug-exclusion rule, and treated by the UK FSA as a novel food requiring authorisation.最大的单项监管空白：因药品排除规则被排除在美国膳食补充剂定义之外，英国 FSA 则视其为需要授权的新型食品。Regulatory status differs by country more than for anything else here.它的监管状态因国家而异的程度超过本文任何其他条目。
